wikirby-page:17.description_zh:
“Hiii！”
— 卡比（Kirby）
卡比（Kirby）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的主角和同名者。他是一种粉红色的小生物，居住并保护着整个波普之星（Planet Popstar），但他的真正起源尚不清楚。尽管卡比（Kirby）的外表很简单，但他球形的身材、闪亮的大眼睛和开朗的举止很容易被认出。人们经常看到他骑着传送之星（Warp Star），但也可以通过吸入空气并像气球一样膨胀来飞行。虽然卡比（Kirby）有很多方法来对抗他的敌人，但迄今为止最广为人知的是他能够张开大嘴吸走对手，然后将他们整个吞掉。这样做可以让卡比（Kirby）复制他刚刚吃的任何东西的属性，以难以预测的方式扩展他的力量。使用这些能力对于卡比（Kirby）克服冒险中面临的更大挑战通常至关重要。卡比（Kirby）被归类为沉默主角；也就是说，在大多数情况下，他不会以声音或文字方式与玩家交谈，但游戏中的角色暗示可以理解他。然而，某些补充材料，尤其是该系列历史的早期材料，表明卡比（Kirby）具有正常说话的能力，通常是在与游戏不同的连续性中。不管他说话的能力如何，他通常都很大声，使用大量的咕哝、喊叫和单音节词——最著名的是他欢快地拉长的“嗨！”
wikirby-page:17.description_en:
“Hiii!”
— 卡比（Kirby）
卡比（Kirby） is the main character and namesake of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He is a small pink creature who resides on and protects all of 波普之星（Planet Popstar）, though his true origins are unknown. Despite his simplistic appearance, 卡比（Kirby） is easily recognizable by his ball-like stature, his large glossy eyes, and his cheerful demeanor. He is often seen riding a 传送之星（Warp Star）, but can otherwise fly by taking in air and puffing up like a balloon. While 卡比（Kirby） has many ways to combat his foes, the most well-known by far is his ability to open his mouth wide to suck up his opponents and then swallow them whole. Doing this allows 卡比（Kirby） to copy the attributes of whatever he just ate, expanding his powers in ways that are difficult to predict. Using these abilities is often crucial for 卡比（Kirby） to overcome the greater challenges he faces on his adventures. 卡比（Kirby） is classified as a silent protagonist; that is, he does not speak audibly or in text to the player in most instances, but characters in-game are implied to understand him. However, certain supplementary material, especially earlier in the series' history, has shown 卡比（Kirby） with the ability to speak normally, often in separate continuities from the games. Regardless of his ability to speak, he is generally very vocal, using lots of grunts, shouts, and monosyllables — most famously, his cheery elongated "Hi!"

wikirby-page:25.description_zh:
“我将成为维护和平的人！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）、星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）（在一些较旧的游戏中为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）；有时缩写为Dedede）是一种肥胖的蓝色企鹅状生物，挥舞着一把锤子并自称为Dream Land的国王。他是一个经常出现的角色，是卡比（Kirby）的“宿敌”，通常作为Boss进行战斗。他贪吃，经常制造麻烦，比如偷走梦境乐园的所有食物和Sparkling Star，或者用大炮射击星仔（Mr. Star）。然而，随着时间的推移，他开始做出更多崇高的事迹，比如试图封印梦魇（Nightmare），帮助卡比（Kirby）与女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）战斗，以及陪伴卡比（Kirby）进行几次冒险。正因为如此，尽管他贪婪且自私，但他仍被视为主角。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）住在山顶的一座城堡里，瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的随从充当他的仆人。

在该系列的第一部分星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）可以说是该系列中最知名的角色星之卡比系列（Kirby series）除了粉色英雄本人之外，还以某种形式出现在该系列的几乎所有游戏中（星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）和Team Kirby Clash Deluxe除外），尽管并非所有这些出场都是主要角色。他也是除卡比（Kirby）之外该系列中唯一一个在自己的游戏（即衍生游戏Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe）中担任主角的角色。他经常被描绘成卡比（Kirby）的漫画陪衬，尤其是在衍生作品中。在较早的游戏中，他很少可玩，但从星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）开始，这种情况发生了变化，国王在随后的许多出场中都可以玩。
wikirby-page:25.description_en:
“I'll be the one to keep the peace!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） (帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in some older games; sometimes shortened to Dedede) is a portly, blue, penguin-like creature who wields a hammer and proclaims himself as king of Dream Land. He is a recurring character who serves as 卡比（Kirby）'s "arch frenemy" and is usually fought as a boss. He has a gluttonous streak, and he often engages in trouble-making, such as stealing all of Dream Land's food and the Sparkling Stars or shooting 星仔（Mr. Star） with a cannon. However, over time he began to perform more noble deeds, such as trying to seal away 梦魇（Nightmare）, helping 卡比（Kirby） battle 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）, and accompanying 卡比（Kirby） in several of his adventures. Because of this, he is considered a protagonist, despite his greediness and egotism. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） lives in a castle atop a mountain with a retinue of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s acting as his servants.

Having debuted in the series' first installment, 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） is arguably the most recognizable character from the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） besides the pink hero himself, having appeared in one form or another in nearly every game in the series (except 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） and Team Kirby Clash Deluxe), though not all of those appearances are major roles. He is also the series' only character besides 卡比（Kirby） to have starred in his own game, namely the spin-off Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe. He is often portrayed as a comic foil to 卡比（Kirby）, especially in spin-off titles. In older games, he was seldom playable, but this changed starting with 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, with the king being playable in many of his subsequent appearances.

wikirby-page:10892.description_zh: Benny是星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中独有的敌人，出现在Bubbly Clouds的Extra Game版本中-取代Dizzy -并且行为大致相同方式.
wikirby-page:10892.description_en: Benny is an enemy exclusively found in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, appearing in the Extra Game version of Bubbly Clouds - replacing Dizzy - and behaving in much the same way.

wikirby-page:6588.description_zh: Blatzy是一种不起眼的类似大炮的敌人，出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的Extra Game和Kirby Super Star Ultra的Revenge of the King中。它的外观和行为与黑大炮（Shotzo）非常相似，是一门几乎不渗透的固定大炮，能够将大炮瞄准卡比（Kirby）并开火，并取代了它出现的游戏模式中更熟悉的对应物。
wikirby-page:6588.description_en: Blatzy is an obscure cannon-like enemy that appears in the Extra Game of 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and in Revenge of the King from Kirby Super Star Ultra. It looks and behaves very similarly to 黑大炮（Shotzo）, being an all-but impervious stationary cannon with the ability to aim its cannon and fire at 卡比（Kirby）, and replaces its more familiar counterpart in the game modes in which it appears.

wikirby-page:2014.description_zh:
“这些时髦的鱼戴着护目镜。是时尚吗？来吧，它们是鱼。毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn”
— 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）中的
Cast描述是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中常见的水生敌怪，首次亮相于星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）。它在吸入时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability），其作案手法是游过清水（Water）的身体或跳出来尝试与卡比（Kirby）碰撞。当蛙镜鱼（Blipper）在水中时，它可能会在固定的巡逻路径中游泳或尝试追踪卡比（Kirby）。它的游泳速度通常很慢，但在某些情况下，它可能会拥挤入水点，使得卡比（Kirby）很难在不受伤的情况下进入水中。在陆地上，蛙镜鱼（Blipper）只能无用地翻滚，但无论如何它仍然可以通过碰撞伤害卡比（Kirby）。从外貌来看，蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的上半身通常是红色或橙色，下半身是黄色。它的每一侧都有一个白色的鳍，还有一条白色的尾巴。尽管它的解剖结构像鱼，但它戴着传统的潜水镜，下面有黑色的小眼睛。

蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的健康状况相对较差，在陆地上任何攻击都可以击败。在水下击败它有点困难，因为卡比（Kirby）的攻击仅限于用Water Gun喷射它，除非他有适合在水下使用的能力，如利剑（Sword）或枪（Spear）。另一种水生敌怪体型较大，蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee），与蛙镜鱼（Blipper）非常相似，官方插图暗示其是Blippers的母亲。
wikirby-page:2014.description_en:
“These funky fish wear goggles. Is it fashion? Come on, they're fish.”
— Cast description in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
蛙镜鱼（Blipper） is a common aquatic enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, making its debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled, and its modus operandi is to swim through bodies of 清水（Water） or leap out of it to try and collide with 卡比（Kirby）. When 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） is in the water, it may either swim in fixed patrol paths or try to home in on 卡比（Kirby）. Its swimming speed is generally slow, but in some instances, it may crowd entry points to the water, making it tricky for 卡比（Kirby） to enter without getting hurt. On land, 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） can only flop about uselessly, but it can still hurt 卡比（Kirby） by collision regardless. In terms of physical appearance, 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）'s upper body is often red or orange, and its lower body is yellow. It sports a white fin on each side, along with a white tail. Despite its fish-like anatomy, it wears traditional scuba goggles, with small black eyes underneath.

蛙镜鱼（Blipper） has relatively little health and can be defeated with any attack while on dry land. It is somewhat harder to defeat while underwater since 卡比（Kirby）'s attack is limited to spraying it with the Water Gun, unless he has an ability suited for use underwater, like 利剑（Sword） or 枪（Spear）. Another aquatic enemy larger in size, 蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee）, closely resembles 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）, and is implied by an official illustration to be the mother of Blippers.

wikirby-page:3768.description_zh: Blopper是仅在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的Extra Game中发现的敌怪。它出现在正常游戏中蘑菇怪（Cappy）占据的相同位置。
wikirby-page:3768.description_en: Blopper is an enemy found only in the Extra Game of 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It appears in the same places that are occupied by 蘑菇怪（Cappy）s in the normal game.

wikirby-page:10879.description_zh: Booler是一个漂浮的幽灵般的敌人，出现在早期的卡比（Kirby）游戏中。它类似于《马里奥》系列中的Boo，但其行为并不相似。它以各种模式飞行，要么直线飞行，要么绕圈飞行，要么弹跳飞行，或者直接寻找卡比（Kirby）。Booler在某些情况下会凭空出现。
wikirby-page:10879.description_en: Booler is a floating ghost-like enemy which appears in early 卡比（Kirby） games. It resembles a Boo from the Mario franchise, though it does not behave similarly. It flies about in various patterns, either going in straight lines, circles, bounces, or seeking 卡比（Kirby） directly. Booler can appear out of thin air under certain circumstances.

wikirby-page:10890.description_zh: KDL Boomer sprite.png Boomer是仅出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的敌人，仅在Bubbly Clouds关卡中出现。它仅出现在Extra Game中-取代弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）-并且行为方式大致相同。它的名字来源于“回旋镖”的剪裁形式，这是它的首选武器。Boomer击败时价值1000分。
wikirby-page:10890.description_en: KDL Boomer sprite.png Boomer is an enemy that appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found only in the Bubbly Clouds stage. It appears only in the Extra Game - replacing 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） - and behaves in much the same way. Its name comes from a clipped form of "boomerang", which is its preferred weapon. Boomer is worth 1000 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:1264.description_zh:
“啊哈！！我找到了下一个受害者！！Kirby's Avalanche”
— 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）中的
飞翅球球（Bronto Burt），最初名为Bront Burt，是一种圆形飞行生物，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最常见的敌人之一，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）并出现在随后的30多款卡比（Kirby）游戏中。在他的整个出现过程中，他的行为保持相对不变：他以各种模式在空中飞行并通过碰撞攻击卡比（Kirby）。一些Bronto Burt以设定的波浪图案飞行，其他的则遵循卡比（Kirby），还有一些在以设定的图案飞行之前通过俯冲和循环出现。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）经常出现在以天空为主题的关卡中，但他也可以出现在清水（Water）之外的任何地方。

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）通常可以被描述为小而圆，有两对半透明的昆虫状翅膀、黄色或橙色的小脚、长眉毛的大眼睛和一张小嘴。在后来的出场中，他有类似于卡比（Kirby）的脸红痕迹。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）在他的Super Smash Bros. Brawl奖杯中被描述为“一只看起来很像卡比（Kirby）的鸟……”，但这种“鸟”的名称并未在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）本身中得到证实。另外根据这个奖杯，他不发球帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），他时不时地俯冲轰炸，伤害卡比（Kirby）只是因为他挡路了。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）也有颜色变体，如星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）和Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中所示，尽管它们通常只是美观。这些颜色变体并不像粉色变体那么常见。

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最普遍的敌人之一，出现在除Kirby's Star Stacker (Game Boy)及其SNES重制版以及Team Kirby Clash游戏之外的所有游戏中。
wikirby-page:1264.description_en:
“Ah HA!! I have found my next victim!!”
— 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） in Kirby's Avalanche
飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, originally named Bront Burt, is a round flying creature who is one of the most prevalent enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and since showing up in over 30 subsequent 卡比（Kirby） games. Throughout his appearances, his behavior has stayed relatively unchanged: he flies through the air in various patterns and attacks 卡比（Kirby） by collision. Some Bronto Burts fly in a set wavy pattern, others follow 卡比（Kirby）, and still others appear by diving and looping before flying in a set pattern. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is often found in sky-themed levels, but he can occur anywhere outside of 清水（Water）.

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） can typically be described as being small and round with two pairs of semi-transparent, insect-like wings, tiny yellow or orange feet, large eyes with long eyebrows, and a small mouth. In later appearances, he has blush marks similar to 卡比（Kirby）'s. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is described in his Super Smash Bros. Brawl trophy as "A bird that looks a lot like 卡比（Kirby）...", but this designation of "bird" is not corroborated within the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） itself. Also according to this trophy, he does not serve 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and he divebombs from time to time, hurting 卡比（Kirby） only because he is in the way. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） also has color variants, as seen in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land） and Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, although they are typically only aesthetic. These color variants are not as common as the pink variation.

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is among the most ubiquitous enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, appearing in every game except for Kirby's Star Stacker (Game Boy) and its SNES remake, and the Team Kirby Clash games.

wikirby-page:1600.description_zh:
“小心这台扫地机器。”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）网站上的魔扫把（Broom Hatter）描述
魔扫把（Broom Hatter）（也可拼写为Broomhatter）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中反复出现的敌人。自从她在《星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）》中首次亮相以来，她继续在大部分主要系列和几个衍生作品中不断出现。魔扫把（Broom Hatter）通常不提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability），但在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，她为卡比（Kirby）提供了清洁（Cleaning）能力。
wikirby-page:1600.description_en:
“Watch out for this sweepin' machine.”
— Description of 魔扫把（Broom Hatter） from the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） website
魔扫把（Broom Hatter） (alternatively spelt Broomhatter) is a recurring enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. Since her debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, she has continued to make constant appearances throughout most of the main series and several spin-offs. 魔扫把（Broom Hatter） typically does not provide any 复制能力（Copy Ability）, but in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, she gives 卡比（Kirby） the 清洁（Cleaning） ability.

wikirby-page:2144.description_zh:
蘑菇怪（Cappy）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中大多数游戏中出现的共同敌人，在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相。蘑菇怪（Cappy）戴上帽子后看起来像一个有斑点的红色蘑菇，但没有帽子时，他的外观与日本埴轮人物相似：他是淡黄色的，没有脚或腿，但有一双粗短的手臂，与黑色的眼睛和圆点的嘴巴一起隐藏在帽子下。与许多其他反复出现的敌人不同，蘑菇怪（Cappy）几乎没有变化。卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）标志着他首次作为可玩角色出现。

蘑菇怪（Cappy）的主要攻击方式并不比撞到卡比（Kirby）复杂，这也会反过来伤害蘑菇怪（Cappy）。如果卡比（Kirby）尝试吸入蘑菇怪（Cappy），该生物的帽子会进入卡比（Kirby）的嘴里，而不是整个蘑菇怪（Cappy）。一旦没有帽子，蘑菇怪（Cappy）通常会惊慌或生闷气，然后可以通过将帽子吐回他身上或单独吸入他来击败，如果吞下卡比（Kirby），则不会获得复制能力（Copy Ability）。蘑菇怪（Cappy）也可以通过使用任何其他攻击在有或没有帽子的情况下被击败。
wikirby-page:2144.description_en:
蘑菇怪（Cappy） is a common enemy that appears in most games in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, making his debut appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. 蘑菇怪（Cappy） takes the appearance of a spotted red mushroom when he has his cap, but without it, he is revealed as a creature similar in look to a Japanese haniwa figure: he is pale yellow and has no feet or legs, but has a pair of stubby arms which he hides along with his black eyes and dot mouth under his cap. Unlike many other recurring enemies, 蘑菇怪（Cappy） has had few variations. 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） marked his first appearance as a playable character.

蘑菇怪（Cappy）'s main method of attack is no more complicated than bumping into 卡比（Kirby）, which also hurts 蘑菇怪（Cappy） in turn. If 卡比（Kirby） tries to inhale 蘑菇怪（Cappy）, the creature's cap goes into 卡比（Kirby）'s mouth instead of the whole 蘑菇怪（Cappy）. Once without his cap, 蘑菇怪（Cappy） will typically panic or sulk, and can then be defeated by spitting his cap back at him or inhaling him separately, granting 卡比（Kirby） no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. 蘑菇怪（Cappy） can also be defeated with or without his cap by using any other attack.

wikirby-page:10891.description_zh: Cawcun是来自星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）和Kirby Super Star Ultra的白色鹈鹕状敌怪。它出现在两款游戏的额外游戏模式中-替换星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的Puffy和Kirby Super Star Ultra.
wikirby-page:10891.description_en: Cawcun is a white, pelican-like enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, and Kirby Super Star Ultra. It is found in extra game modes in both titles - replacing Puffy in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and Tookey in Kirby Super Star Ultra.

wikirby-page:10880.description_zh: Chuckie是首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的敌人。它就像一张简单的卡通脸，有两只圆形的大眼睛，看着不​​同的方向，一张宽大的嘴巴，一直伸出一条大舌头。Chuckie已知隐藏在有点类似于《超级马里奥兄弟》系列中的? Blocks的盒子中，并且可以在接触时伤害卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:10880.description_en: Chuckie is an enemy which first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It resembles a simple cartoon face with two large circular eyes which are looking in different directions, and a wide mouth with a big tongue sticking out at all times. Chuckie is known to hide in boxes which somewhat resemble ? Blocks from the Super Mario Bros. series, and can hurt 卡比（Kirby） on contact.

wikirby-page:2815.description_zh: A Coconut是星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中引入的危险。它是基于实际的Coconut设计的，呈球形，中间有一条粗线。它的颜色主要是棕色，有一些绿色斑点。椰子是不动的，通常挂在树上。如果卡比（Kirby）在挂有Coconut的树下行走，则Coconut会掉落，当它到达地面或与卡比（Kirby）接触时会爆炸。如果卡比（Kirby）具有Parasol能力，则可以阻止椰子。它们也可以被吸入（尽管吞咽时不会赋予任何能力）或被任何攻击摧毁。除了在固定位置发现之外，椰子还与锤星猩（Bonkers）一起出现，几乎总是被他扔出去，即使在它们不存在的游戏中也是如此。
wikirby-page:2815.description_en: A Coconut is a hazard introduced in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It is based on an actual Coconut and is spherical with a thick line in the middle. Its color is mostly brown, with some green patches. Coconuts are immobile, usually found hanging from trees. If 卡比（Kirby） walks underneath a tree with a Coconut hanging from it, the Coconut will fall down, exploding when it reaches the ground or if it comes in contact with 卡比（Kirby）. Coconuts can be blocked if 卡比（Kirby） has the Parasol ability. They can also be inhaled (though granting no ability when swallowed) or destroyed with any attack. Apart from being found in set locations, coconuts also appear with 锤星猩（Bonkers）, almost always being thrown by him, even in games where they are otherwise absent.

wikirby-page:3556.description_zh:
Coner是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中寄居蟹形态的敌人。它在《星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）》中首次出现，此后又出现在该系列的一小部分后续游戏中。

Coner的外观是一只寄居蟹-它拥有一个圆锥形的螺旋壳，眼睛、腿和钳子从底部伸出。它有一双特别大的眼睛，从壳下面向外张望，使Coner显得害羞。Coner的原色是绿壳黄皮；然而，在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中，交替的颜色也赋予了它粉红色和黄色的色调变化。

Coner是少数同时居住在陆地和水中的敌人之一。掉落时，Coner会隐藏在壳中，如果到达固体表面（包括清水（Water）.
wikirby-page:3556.description_en:
Coner is an enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） with the form of a hermit crab. It made its first appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and has since appeared in a small selection of subsequent games in the series.

Coner's appearance is that of a hermit crab - it possesses a conical spiral shell with eyes, legs and pincers emerging from the base. It has exceptionally large eyes that peer out from below the shell, giving Coner a shy appearance. The original coloring of Coner is a green shell and yellow skin; however, in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）, alternate coloring gives it pink and yellow tone variations as well.

Coner is among the few enemies that dwell both on land and in water. When falling, Coner hides in its shell, then proceeds to crawl again if and when it reaches a solid surface, including the bottom of a body of 清水（Water）.

wikirby-page:10883.description_zh: Dizzy是来自星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的敌人，仅在Bubbly Clouds阶段出现。它在空中翻滚，要么沿直线运动，要么以方形图案旋转。在全速为卡比（Kirby）充电之前，它也可能会停止短暂的一段时间。Dizzy吞下后价值400点。在Extra Game中，Dizzy替换为Benny.
wikirby-page:10883.description_en: Dizzy is an enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found only in the Bubbly Clouds stage. It tumbles through the air, either going in straight lines, or spinning around in square-like patterns. It may also be found stopped for a brief moment, before it charges 卡比（Kirby） at full speed. Dizzy is worth 400 points when swallowed. In the Extra Game, Dizzy is replaced by Benny.

wikirby-page:10884.description_zh:
Flapper是在早期的卡比（Kirby）游戏中发现的飞行蝙蝠状敌人。它来回飘动，主要是在黑暗的房间里，并且很难被发现。它也可能偶尔追逐卡比（Kirby）。

Flapper类似于蝙蝠，但与身体尺寸相比，翅膀特别大。它通体黑色，除了巨大的翅膀外几乎看不到任何特征。这种深色的颜色使它很难在它经常居住的阴暗区域被发现。可以看到Flapper以中等速度直线飞行，但它可能会慢慢地追赶卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:10884.description_en:
Flapper is a flying bat-like enemy found in very early 卡比（Kirby） games. It flutters back and forth, mainly in dark rooms, and can be hard to detect. It may also occasionally pursue 卡比（Kirby）.

Flapper resembles a bat, though with particularly large wings compared to body size. It is entirely black, with few features visible aside from the massive wings. This dark coloration makes it tricky to spot in the gloomy areas it often resides in. Flapper can be seen flying at modest speed in straight lines, but it may instead pursue 卡比（Kirby） slowly.

wikirby-page:10889.description_zh:
Flotzo是一种类似章鱼的生物，在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中作为敌人首次亮相，并且也出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra独家游戏中- Revenge of the King.

Flotzo呈深栗色，利用触手在陆地和水中移动。Flotzo可以在许多不同的实例中找到，在地面上行走，并以多种不同的模式在空中飞行。其运动一般比乌贼怪（Squishy）更混乱。与乌贼怪（Squishy）一样，它可以被吸入，但吞咽后不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:10889.description_en:
Flotzo is an octopus-like creature which debuted as an enemy in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and that also appears in the Kirby Super Star Ultra exclusive game - Revenge of the King.

Flotzo sports a deep maroon color, and uses its tentacles to move about on land and in water. Flotzo can be found in many different instances, walking around on the ground, and flying through the air in many different patterns. Its movement is generally more chaotic than 乌贼怪（Squishy）. Like 乌贼怪（Squishy）, it can be inhaled, but yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

wikirby-page:10887.description_zh: Gaspar是一个不起眼的飞行幽灵般的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。它的操作方式与Booler非常相似，并且与其他幽灵敌人（例如Stogue）相似，尽管Gaspar只出现在两场游戏中，并且此后就没有在卡比（Kirby）媒体中出现过任何重要客串。
wikirby-page:10887.description_en: Gaspar is an obscure flying ghost-like enemy who made its first appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It operates very similarly to Booler and resembles other ghost enemies such as Stogue, though Gaspar has only appeared in two games, and has not made any significant cameos in the 卡比（Kirby） media since.

wikirby-page:2024.description_zh:
绿海葵（Glunk）是一种类似海葵的两栖敌人。它通常被描绘成绿色的身体，头顶有红色的触手（有点像头发），脸由两只又大又圆的眼睛和黑色的瞳孔组成。绿海葵（Glunk）在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中非常常见，出现在每个主系列游戏和几个衍生游戏中。它在任何外观中都不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

绿海葵（Glunk）通常位于清水（Water）内或周围。它可以通过从头顶吹出气泡状的射弹进行攻击，无论它面向哪个方向。绿海葵（Glunk）无法自行移动，而是附着在地板、墙壁或天花板上。如果绿海葵（Glunk）被击中，或者它所在的表面被破坏，它可能会被移动，掉到地板上并恢复其行为。在许多游戏中，绿海葵（Glunk）下落时在水中下沉非常缓慢。
wikirby-page:2024.description_en:
绿海葵（Glunk） is an amphibious enemy who resembles a sea anemone. It is usually depicted with a green body, red tentacles on top of its head (somewhat resembling hair), and a face consisting of two big, round eyes with black pupils. 绿海葵（Glunk） is extremely common throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having appeared in every main-series game, and several spin-off titles. It does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） in any of its appearances.

绿海葵（Glunk） usually resides in or around 清水（Water）. It can attack by blowing bubble-like projectiles out of the top of its head, in whichever direction it may be facing. 绿海葵（Glunk） is incapable of moving on its own, instead staying attached to a floor, wall, or ceiling. If 绿海葵（Glunk） is hit, or if the surface it is on is disrupted, it may be dislodged, where it will fall down to the floor and resume its behavior. In many games, 绿海葵（Glunk） sinks very slowly in water while falling.

wikirby-page:834.description_zh:
“他有着尖尖的身体，但眼神却很温柔。最好避开他。”
— Patch Plaza
黑刺球（Gordo）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的共同敌人，出现在主系列的每场游戏以及许多衍生作品中。他通常看起来像一个漂浮的蓝色或黑色球体，有着大眼睛和周围有尖刺。在几乎所有情况下，他都完全免疫任何攻击，并对与他接触的角色造成伤害。因此，他实际上是玩家必须避开的障碍。他通常会通过坐在走廊里、在两个垂直或水平的固体物体之间来回弹跳、绕着物块转圈、或沿着受重力影响的地面弹跳来阻挡卡比（Kirby）的路径。此外，戈多斯可以由多个Boss产生作为攻击，通常是由风语大树（Whispy Woods）及其亲属产生；以这种方式产生的戈多斯通常不会持续很长时间，并且会在短时间内弹离屏幕。

虽然黑刺球（Gordo）通常无法被摧毁，但有时可以通过其他方式处理他。如果一个人在走廊上弹跳，摧毁他弹跳的特定方块将导致他离开，或者在某些情况下，留下一个或多个方块将使他被困在一个无法到达的小空间中，从而使卡比（Kirby）能够安全地移动。卡比（Kirby）的许多攻击使他暂时无敌（就像用燃烧（Burning）或车轮（Wheel）获得的攻击一样），使他能够冲过戈多斯而不受到伤害，尽管戈多斯本身没有受到伤害。
wikirby-page:834.description_en:
“He has a spiky body but soft eyes. It's just better to avoid him.”
— Patch Plaza
黑刺球（Gordo） is a common enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having appeared in every game in the main series as well as many spin-offs. He typically takes the appearance of a floating blue or black ball with large eyes and spikes around his perimeter. He is completely immune to any attack in almost all cases and damages characters who make contact with him. As such, he effectively functions as an obstacle that the player must avoid. He tends to generally block 卡比（Kirby）'s path by sitting in corridors, bouncing back and forth between two solid objects vertically or horizontally, circling around blocks, or bouncing along the ground affected by gravity. Additionally, Gordos can be produced by several bosses as attacks, usually by 风语大树（Whispy Woods） and his relatives; Gordos produced in this way typically do not last for long, and will bounce off-screen after a short while.

While 黑刺球（Gordo） cannot typically be destroyed, he can sometimes be dealt with through other means. If one is bouncing around a hallway, destroying a specific block he bounces against will cause him to leave, or in some cases, leaving one or more will keep him trapped in a small unreachable space, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to move around safely. Many of 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks leave him temporarily invincible (like those gained with 燃烧（Burning） or 车轮（Wheel）), allowing him to dash through Gordos without taking damage, though the Gordos themselves remain unharmed.

wikirby-page:3530.description_zh:
“那个粉色头带意味着生意！头带熊（Grizzo）将全力冲锋！”
— Patch Plaza毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）
头带熊（Grizzo）中头带熊（Grizzo）的描述是在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相的敌人。他像一只大黄熊，用四肢行走。此外，他戴着头带，背上有两条红色条纹。在早期出场时，他是一个标准敌人，但他在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中的首次3D出场标志着他是一个大敌人。
wikirby-page:3530.description_en:
“That pink headband means business! 头带熊（Grizzo） will charge you with all his might!”
— Patch Plaza description of 头带熊（Grizzo） from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）
头带熊（Grizzo） is an enemy which debuted in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. He resembles a large yellow bear and walks on all fours. Additionally, he wears a headband, and on his back, he sports a pair of red stripes. In early appearances, he is a standard enemy, but his first 3D appearance in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） marks him as a large enemy.

wikirby-page:3444.description_zh:
Grumples是星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的隐秘敌人。它有点像石像怪（Kabu），但有一张更刻薄的脸和不同的形状。Grumples会漂浮，并且像石像怪（Kabu）一样，可以消失然后突然重新出现。它可以被卡比（Kirby）吸入，但吞咽时不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。Grumples的外观和颜色与石像怪（Kabu）相似，但其面部明显更加阴沉（因此得名Grumples，类似于“脾气暴躁”一词）。Grumples还具有更多棱角特征，在其艺术作品和Kirby Super Star Ultra中，其头部逐渐变细为一个点。

Grumples的行为与石像怪（Kabu）类似，沿着地板滚动，逐步进入和退出视线，出现在其他地方。尽管外观有所改变，Grumples并不比石像怪（Kabu）快多少，也没有更高的耐用性。
wikirby-page:3444.description_en:
Grumples is an obscure enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. It vaguely resembles 石像怪（Kabu）, but has a meaner face and a different shape. Grumples floats and, like 石像怪（Kabu）, can vanish and later reappear out of nowhere. It can be inhaled by 卡比（Kirby）, but grants no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Grumples is similar in look and color to 石像怪（Kabu）, though its face is notably more dour (hence the name Grumples, similar to the word 'grumpy'). Grumples also has more angular features, with its head tapering into a point in its artwork and in Kirby Super Star Ultra.

Grumples acts similar to 石像怪（Kabu）, rolling along the floor and phasing in and out of sight to appear somewhere else. Despite the altered look, Grumples is not much faster than 石像怪（Kabu）, nor does it have any more durability.

wikirby-page:10885.description_zh:
KDL Hurly sprite.png Hurly是来自星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的敌人，仅在Castle Lololo关卡中出现。它仅在Extra Game中找到-取代Chuckie -并且行为方式大致相同，但造成两点伤害而不是仅仅一点。Hurly与Chuckie的区别在于其较暗的体色和脸上的“微笑”。

Hurly从城堡大厅中带有问号的盒子中弹出，从屏幕上掉下来，如果卡比（Kirby）接触，就会伤害他。这些盒子会不断弹出Hurlies，无论吃多少个卡比（Kirby），都永远不会用完。

在Kirby's Pinball Land中，Hurly出现在Kracko Land阶段，每当闪亮先生&光亮先生（Mr. Shine & Mr. Bright）时，Chuckie就会从Chuckie转变出来了。它的弹跳弧度比Chuckie更高，击中时价值2000点。击中3次后，变为Maxim Tomato.
wikirby-page:10885.description_en:
KDL Hurly sprite.png Hurly is an enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found only in the Castle Lololo stage. It is found only in Extra Game - replacing Chuckie - and behaves in much the same way, though dealing two points of damage instead of just one. Hurly can be distinguished from Chuckie by its darker body color and "smile" on its face.

Hurly pops out of boxes with question marks in the halls of the castle, falling out and off the screen, hurting 卡比（Kirby） if he makes contact. These boxes will continuously pop out Hurlies, and never run out, no matter how many 卡比（Kirby） eats.

In Kirby's Pinball Land, Hurly appears in the Kracko Land stage, transforming from Chuckie whenever 闪亮先生&光亮先生（Mr. Shine & Mr. Bright） comes out. It bounces about in a higher arc than Chuckie, and is worth 2000 points when hit. When hit three times, it transforms into a Maxim Tomato.

wikirby-page:2057.description_zh:
“你的荣耀之路在这里结束”
— 石像怪（Kabu）在Kirby's Avalanche
石像怪（Kabu）中是一个反复出现的敌人，自其首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）以来，它已经出现在许多游戏中。它类似于雕刻的石头头部，类似摩艾石像的面孔，底部平坦，顶部圆形（尽管有时被描绘成立方体形状），通常为米色或棕色。它的面部由两个代替眼睛的孔、一个雕刻的楔形鼻子以及一个永远张开的嘴组成。

根据不同的游戏，石像怪（Kabu）可能会通过多种方式攻击，包括跳跃、滑行、飞行，甚至瞬移。大石像怪（Big Kabu），石像怪（Kabu）的一个更大的对应物，也可以吐出较小的石像怪（Kabu）。卡比（Kirby）可以吸入并吞下石像怪（Kabu），但反过来，并未接收复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:2057.description_en:
“Your road to glory ends here”
— 石像怪（Kabu） in Kirby's Avalanche
石像怪（Kabu） is a reoccurring enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having appeared in many games since its debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It resembles a sculpted stone head, similar to the faces of the moai, with a flat bottom and a rounded top (though sometimes being depicted as cubical), typically beige or brown in color. Its face consists of two holes in place of eyes, a sculpted wedge-like nose, and a perpetually open mouth.

Depending on the game, 石像怪（Kabu） may attack in a large amount of ways, including jumping, sliding, flying, and even teleporting. 大石像怪（Big Kabu）, a larger counterpart of 石像怪（Kabu）, can also spit out smaller 石像怪（Kabu）. 卡比（Kirby） can inhale and swallow 石像怪（Kabu）, but in turn, does not receive a 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:3982.description_zh:
Kookler是一种敌人，其外观为深蓝色、漂浮的圆角矩形头，其顶部生长着两个黄色尖角，类似于日本神话中鬼的角。它的脸由两只又大又圆的眼睛组成，眼睛全黑，里面有一个小白点，还有一张笑着的嘴，上面有一对尖尖的黄色獠牙。Kookler通常以椭圆形或三角形图案在空中飞行，可以通过吸气或其他攻击来击败。

Kookler首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，此后仅出现在Kirby's Block Ball和偶尔的外部媒体中。
wikirby-page:3982.description_en:
Kookler is an enemy taking on the appearance of a dark blue, floating head shaped like a rectangle with rounded corners, which is adorned by two small, yellow, pointy horns growing on top of it, similar to the horns of an oni from Japanese mythology. Its face consists of two big, round eyes that are completely black apart from a tiny white spot inside each, as well as a laughing mouth with a pair of pointed, yellow fangs. Kookler typically flies through the air in oval or triangular patterns, and can be defeated using an inhale or another attack.

Kookler first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, and has since only appeared in Kirby's Block Ball and in occasional external media.

wikirby-page:6674.description_zh: Koozer是一种不起眼的飞行敌人，出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的Extra Game和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的Revenge of the King中。当Koozer出现时，它取代了飞翅球球（Bronto Burt），并且比粉红色的对手具有更强的攻击和防御能力。与飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）一样，Koozer吞咽时不提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:6674.description_en: Koozer is an obscure flying enemy featured in the Extra Game of 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and Revenge of the King in Kirby Super Star Ultra. When Koozer appears, it replaces 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, and has greater offensive and defensive capability than its pink counterpart. Like 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, Koozer does not provide any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

wikirby-page:10886.description_zh: Mr. P. Umpkin是一个不起眼的飞行南瓜形敌人，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。他的功能与Two Face相似，当他换边时表现出两种不同的表情。
wikirby-page:10886.description_en: Mr. P. Umpkin is an obscure flying pumpkin-shaped enemy who first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. He is similar in function to Two Face, showing two different expressions when he switches sides.

wikirby-page:4173.description_zh:
芒比尸（Mumbies）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中反复出现的浮动绷带包裹的球形敌怪，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。它是一种不太常见的敌人，以其相对较高的耐用性以及对卡比（Kirby）吸入技术的免疫力而闻名（在某些游戏中，当卡比（Kirby）使用他的吸入技术时，他们的绷带会有点皱起）。芒比尸（Mumbies）的特点是拥有近乎完美的圆形体形，几乎完全被白色或灰黄色的绷带包裹着，在前面为他们的单眼留了一条缝，根据游戏的不同，单眼的颜色是红色或黄色。

芒比尸（Mumbies）通常在卡比（Kirby）面向他们的方向时保持完全静止，但当他移开目光时会慢慢追赶他。这使得芒比尸（Mumbies）在行为上类似于''Super Mario''游戏中的Boo。虽然芒比尸（Mumbies）很难，但仍然可以使用任何复制能力（Copy Ability）或物品攻击Star Bullet击败它，如果没有更好的选择，甚至可以用几个Air Bullet击败。
wikirby-page:4173.description_en:
芒比尸（Mumbies） is a reoccurring floating bandage-wrapped spherical enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, which made its first appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It is a somewhat uncommon enemy, and is notable for its relatively high durability, along with its immunity to 卡比（Kirby）'s inhale (in some games, their bandages will ruffle a bit when 卡比（Kirby） uses his inhale technique). 芒比尸（Mumbies） are characterized by their nearly perfectly round physique and are almost completely wrapped in white or off-yellow bandages, leaving a slit in the front for their single eye, which is either red or yellow depending on the game.

芒比尸（Mumbies） typically hold completely still when 卡比（Kirby） is facing in their direction, but will pursue him slowly when he looks away. This makes 芒比尸（Mumbies） similar to Boo from the ''Super Mario'' games in behavior. Although 芒比尸（Mumbies） is tough, it can still be defeated using any 复制能力（Copy Ability） or item attack, Star Bullet, or even by a few Air Bullets if no better options are available.

wikirby-page:2644.description_zh: Parasol是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的敌人，类似于红白色的Parasol，可以被Parasol能力吞噬。它通常由瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）、瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）或黑大炮（Shotzo）持有，使它们能够减缓坠落速度。在到达地面之前，前两者可以被吞噬，从而启用Parasol能力，而不是分别没有能力或光束（Beam）能力。这些敌人通常会在落地或与卡比（Kirby）接触时释放Parasol。此后，Parasol会浮起，如果与卡比（Kirby）相撞，则会伤害卡比（Kirby）。有时他们会瞄准卡比（Kirby）.
wikirby-page:2644.description_en: Parasol is an enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） resembling a red and white Parasol that can be swallowed for the Parasol ability. It is usually held by a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, or 黑大炮（Shotzo）, enabling them to slow their fall. Prior to reaching the ground, the former two can be swallowed, enabling the Parasol ability, rather than no ability or the 光束（Beam） ability, respectively. These enemies most often let go of the Parasol once they land on the ground, or if they come in contact with 卡比（Kirby）. After this, the Parasol will float up, hurting 卡比（Kirby） if he collides with it. Sometimes they home in on 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:2347.display_name: 阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:2347.description_zh:
Parasol Waddle Dees是卡比（Kirby）系列中反复出现的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。他是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的变体，使用Parasol，让他能够漂浮并在空中轻轻摇摆。如果用他的阳伞吞下，卡比（Kirby）获得Parasol能力。如果受到攻击并且没有被击败，阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）可以掉落他的阳伞并成为普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），而他的阳伞则成为一个单独的实体，要么飘走，要么自行变得敌对。然而，

阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）并不总是敌人。在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）、Kirby Super Star Ultra和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）可以是Helper，并且可以与卡比（Kirby）一起播放。阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）也作为可玩的战斗机出现在Kirby Battle Royale中，并简称为“瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）”。
wikirby-page:2347.description_en:
Parasol Waddle Dees are reoccurring enemies in the 卡比（Kirby） series, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. He is a variant of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who uses a Parasol, allowing him to float and sway gently down through the air. If swallowed with his parasol, 卡比（Kirby） gains the Parasol ability. If attacked and not defeated, a 阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee） can drop his parasol and become a regular 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, while his parasol becomes a separate entity, either floating away, or becoming hostile in its own accord.

阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee） is not always an enemy, however. In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, Kirby Super Star Ultra, and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, a 阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee） can be a Helper, and playable along with 卡比（Kirby）. A 阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee） also appears as a playable fighter in Kirby Battle Royale, and is simply referred to as '瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'.

wikirby-page:7185.description_zh: Parasol Waddle Doos是瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的变体，它们持有Parasol，允许它们在空中漂浮和轻轻摇摆。如果用遮阳伞吸入，卡比（Kirby）获得Parasol能力。如果受到攻击但未被击败，Parasol Waddle Doo将掉落其Parasol并成为常规瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），而其遮阳伞则成为一个单独的实体，要么飘走，要么自行变得敌对。
wikirby-page:7185.description_en: Parasol Waddle Doos are variants of 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）s who hold a Parasol, allowing them to float and sway gently through the air. If inhaled with its parasol, 卡比（Kirby） gains the Parasol ability. If attacked and not defeated, a Parasol Waddle Doo will drop its Parasol and become a regular 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, while its parasol becomes a separate entity, either floating away, or becoming hostile in its own accord.

wikirby-page:10888.description_zh:
KDL Peezer sprite.png Peezer是来自星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的敌怪，出现在Float Islands和Mt. DeDeDe关卡中。它只存在于Extra Game中，取代了Wizzer，并且行为非常相似。

Peezer就像一只长着一只大眼睛的螃蟹，静止在一处。它会遮住眼睛，直到准备好向卡比（Kirby）发射光束，并且以惊人的频率进行发射。这种光束攻击遵循与Wizzer和瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）相同的鞭状轨迹。卡比（Kirby）除非其眼睛未被遮盖，否则无法吸入Peezer，但可以用其他方式击败它，例如Star Bullet或Air Bullet。Peezer被击败时价值1000点。
wikirby-page:10888.description_en:
KDL Peezer sprite.png Peezer is an enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found in the Float Islands and Mt. DeDeDe stages. It is found only in Extra Game, replacing Wizzer, and behaves very similarly.

Peezer resembles a crab with a single large eye, and holds still in one place. It covers its eye until it's ready to fire a beam at 卡比（Kirby）, and does this with remarkable frequency. This beam attack follows the same whip-like trajectory as that of Wizzer and 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）. 卡比（Kirby） cannot inhale Peezer unless its eye is uncovered, but it can be defeated with other means, such as a Star Bullet or Air Bullet. Peezer is worth 1000 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:1643.description_zh:
“繁荣！我喜欢那个声音！”就是那个永远笑容满面的家伙！他正在进行一场爆炸性的冒险，但他真正想做的就是给人们的生活带来一点乐趣和烟火。”
— Guest Star Poppy Bros. Jr. Bombs Away!星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）中的暂停屏幕描述是一个常见的星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中反复出现的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。他是一个小型人形人物，穿着小丑服，戴着类似于利剑（Sword）卡比（Kirby）的帽子，尽管小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）的服装通常是淡蓝色。color.

小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的角色变化很大，在他最古老的出场中，他没有提供复制能力（Copy Ability），通常被看到骑在头带熊（Grizzo）上或在苹果和Maxim Tomato上保持平衡。星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）（也许是追随他年长亲戚Poppy Bros. Sr.的脚步），可以看到小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）投掷炸弹，并在被吞下时提供炸弹（Bomb）能力。该游戏还提供了小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）投掷回旋镖的功能。卡比（Kirby）从他那里获得了弯刀（Cutter）能力，在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）和随后的每场3D卡比（Kirby）游戏中，小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）始终提供炸弹（Bomb）能力，从此成为该能力的吉祥物。
wikirby-page:1643.description_en:
“BOOM! I love that sound!" It's the guy with the eternal grin! He's off on an explosive adventure, but all he really wants to do is bring a little fun and fireworks into people's lives.”
— Guest Star Poppy Bros. Jr. Bombs Away! Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） is a commonly reoccurring enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. He is a small humanoid figure who wears a clown suit with a cap similar to that of 利剑（Sword） 卡比（Kirby）'s, though 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）'s outfit is usually a pale blue in color.

小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）'s role has varied greatly throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. In his oldest appearances, he provided no 复制能力（Copy Ability） and was typically seen riding on 头带熊（Grizzo）s or balancing on apples and Maxim Tomatoes. Starting with 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） (and perhaps following in the footsteps of his older relative, Poppy Bros. Sr.), 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） could be seen tossing bombs, and providing the 炸弹（Bomb） ability when swallowed. This game also had 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） throw boomerangs, with this case resulting in 卡比（Kirby） gaining the 弯刀（Cutter） ability from him instead. In 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） and every subsequent 3D 卡比（Kirby） game, 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） consistently provides the 炸弹（Bomb） ability, having become the mascot for said ability ever since.

wikirby-page:10882.description_zh:
Puffy是仅出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的敌人，主要出现在Bubbly Clouds舞台上。它是一种飞行的云状敌人，能够发射射弹，击败后价值600分。

Puffy就像一团带有浓重阴影的白色烟雾，看起来与卡比（Kirby）的Air Bullet攻击相似。人们经常发现它在空中以俯冲运动飞行，在弧线中间时达到最高速度。这些弧的高度可以不同，并且可以向上或向下。Puffy还能够发射三重缓慢行进的圆形射弹，尽管需要相当长的时间才能完成这种攻击。大多数时候，如果它这样做的话，最终会通过碰撞伤害卡比（Kirby）。

Puffy仅出现在主游戏中。在Extra Game中，被Cawcun代替。
wikirby-page:10882.description_en:
Puffy is an enemy which appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found mainly on the Bubbly Clouds stage. It is a flying cloud-like foe which is capable of shooting projectiles, and is worth 600 points when defeated.

Puffy resembles a white puff of smoke with a pair of heavy shades and looks similar to 卡比（Kirby）'s Air Bullet attack. It is often found flying in swooping motions through the air, reaching its top speed when in the middle of its arc. These arcs can vary in height, and may aim upward or downward. Puffy is also capable of firing a triple spray of round projectiles which travel slowly, though it requires a fair amount of time to get this attack out. Most of the time, it will end up harming 卡比（Kirby） by collision if it does so at all.

Puffy only appears in the main game. In the Extra Game, it is replaced by Cawcun instead.

wikirby-page:1525.description_zh:
“他们一开始看起来很友好，但等等...”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）网站上的尖耳怪（Scarfy）的描述
尖耳怪（Scarfy）是一种橙色的、漂浮的猫状生物，是卡比（Kirby）系列中最古老和最普遍的敌人之一。出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，并出现在此后的所有主系列游戏以及一些衍生作品中。他漂浮在空中，有着一张卡比（Kirby）般的天真面孔和灿烂的笑容。然而，如果卡比（Kirby）激怒了他，尖耳怪（Scarfy）就会变成一个可怕的独眼恶魔，张开下巴，长着锋利的獠牙，全身呈暗褐色，被称为愤怒的尖耳怪（Scarfy），并追捕他，直到尖耳怪（Scarfy）被击败、爆炸或返回。正常。

在整个系列中，尖耳怪（Scarfy）可以采取多种不同的行为模式，但他最常见的策略是原地盘旋，只有在试图吸入卡比（Kirby）或以其他方式攻击他时才追逐卡比（Kirby）。有些人可能只会在卡比（Kirby）或其他角色持有钥匙等随身物品（这些被称为猎人围巾）时才会变形，而其他人可能会在卡比（Kirby）经过他们时变得敌对。其他人仍然可能立即变得敌对。当尖耳怪（Scarfy）生气时，他通常会追赶卡比（Kirby）几分钟，然后减速并爆炸。这种爆炸性可能就是为什么当在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中使用Copy进行扫描时，尖耳怪（Scarfy）授予爆裂（Crash）复制能力（Copy Ability）的原因。否则，尖耳怪（Scarfy）无法提供能力，因为他无法被吸入。
wikirby-page:1525.description_en:
“They look friendly at first, but just wait...”
— Description of 尖耳怪（Scarfy） from the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） website
尖耳怪（Scarfy） is an orange, floating catlike creature who is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest and most ubiquitous enemies in the series, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and being present in all of the main-series titles since then, as well as several spin-offs. He can be found floating in the air sporting an innocent-looking 卡比（Kirby）-like face and bright open smile. However, if 卡比（Kirby） angers him, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns into a hideous cycloptic demon with sharp fangs in a gaping jaw and a duller brown coloration, known as Angry 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, and chases him down until 尖耳怪（Scarfy） is defeated, explodes, or returns to normal.

Throughout the series, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） can take on a number of different behavior patterns, but his most common strategy is to hover in place, only chasing 卡比（Kirby） if he tries to inhale him or otherwise attacks him. Some may only transform when 卡比（Kirby） or another character is holding a carry item such as a key (these are called Hunter Scarfies), while others may turn hostile when 卡比（Kirby） passes by them. Others still may turn hostile immediately. When 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns angry, he will typically chase 卡比（Kirby） down for several moments before slowing down and detonating in an explosion. This explosive nature is likely the reason why 尖耳怪（Scarfy） grants the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when scanned using Copy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Otherwise, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） cannot provide an ability, because he cannot be inhaled.

wikirby-page:1266.description_zh:
“这门坚不可摧的大炮具有相当大的冲击力！”
— Patch Plaza对黑大炮（Shotzo）的描述来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）。
黑大炮（Shotzo）是一个坚不可摧的、会喷射射弹的敌人，也是卡比（Kirby）最古老、最常见的敌人，在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相。它们看起来像黑色金属制成的大炮，通过向卡比（Kirby）发射炮弹进行攻击。虽然大多数Shotzos无法移动，但它们有时会从Parasol上的天空掉落。常规Shotzos有两种变体：一种是严肃地保持面向一个方向，另一种是不断调整目标以击中卡比（Kirby）。非瞄准射击者经常会发射一连串的炮弹，只是每隔很短的时间就会停下来。与大多数敌人不同，肖佐通常不能被吸入或直接摧毁。然而，如果它们碰巧站在Star Block.
wikirby-page:1266.description_en:
“This indestructible cannon packs quite a wallop!”
— Patch Plaza description of 黑大炮（Shotzo） from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）.
黑大炮（Shotzo） is an impregnable, projectile-spitting foe and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest and most commonly-occurring enemies, making its debut appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. They look like cannons made of black metal and attack by shooting cannon balls at 卡比（Kirby）. While most Shotzos are unable to move, they sometimes drop from the sky on Parasol. Regular Shotzos come in two variants: One that sternly keeps facing in one direction, and one that constantly adjusts its aim to hit 卡比（Kirby）. The non-aiming Shotzos often fire whole barrages of cannon balls, only stopping at short intervals. Unlike most enemies, Shotzos cannot typically be inhaled or directly destroyed. However, they can be dropped into a bottomless pit if they happen to stand on a Star Block.

wikirby-page:1511.description_zh:
“就像我的剑一样，我不断回来！”那件盔甲里面有什么？机密！就像他的金刃一样，这家伙一次又一次地重返战斗。勇气是最好的盔甲！”
— Guest Star Sir Kibble Cutting in Style暂停星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）中的屏幕描述（称为星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的SirKibble以及星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）和星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的Sirkibble是整个星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中常见的敌人，出现在除星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）之外的所有主系列游戏中，而在衍生游戏中很少出现。从未在任何特定游戏中扮演过令人难以置信的主要角色，仅以基本敌人或帮助者的身份出现，最引人注目的是，当吸入并吞下卡比（Kirby）时，弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）的外观是一套圆形、球形、金属盔甲，将里面的任何东西笼罩在完全黑暗中。他的头盔顶部有一个可拆卸的弯曲刀片，当弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）防御时，他会关闭头盔。

弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）主要通过将刀片从头盔上取下并向他投掷来攻击他，类似于回旋镖。卡比（Kirby）恰好在他的视力之上，弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）通常会在投掷刀片之前跳跃，弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）通常是弯刀（Cutter）能力的主要代表，因此在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）、Kirby Super Star Ultra和Kirby Super Star Ultra中充当该能力的帮助者。星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）的大表弟弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）在该系列的许多游戏中担任中boss，弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）和弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）具有许多相似的特征，但弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）具有更详细的装甲。默认为铁灰色。
wikirby-page:1511.description_en:
“Just like my blade, I keep coming back!" What's inside that armor? Classified! Just like his golden blade, this guy returns to the fight again and again. Pluckiness is the best armor of all!”
— Guest Star Sir Kibble Cutting in Style Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） (called SirKibble in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Sirkibble in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） and 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）) is a commonly recurring enemy throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） that has appeared in every main-series title except 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, with only scant representation in spin-off games. 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） himself has never possessed an incredibly major role in any specific game, only appearing as a basic enemy or as a helper, most notably giving 卡比（Kirby） the 弯刀（Cutter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled and swallowed. 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）'s appearance is that of a round, spherical, metallic suit of armor that shrouds whatever may be inside in complete darkness. The top part of his helmet has a detachable curved blade which he uses to attack. When 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） guards, he closes his helmet.

弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） mainly attacks 卡比（Kirby） by taking the blade off his helmet and tossing it at him. It then returns to him, similarly to a boomerang. If 卡比（Kirby） happens to be above his eyesight, 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） will usually jump before throwing his blade. 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） is often the main representative of the 弯刀（Cutter） ability, and as such, serves as the helper for that ability in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, Kirby Super Star Ultra, and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

A larger cousin to 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） called 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） serves as a mid-boss in a number of games in the series. 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） and 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） share many similar characteristics, but 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） has more detailed armor and defaults to an iron gray color.

wikirby-page:4477.description_zh:
Skuller是出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的敌人。它看起来像一个白色的、漂浮的头骨，眼窝里有两颗黄色的小光在发光。它永远张开和闭合的嘴只包含三颗牙齿，这些牙齿都是其上颌的一部分。

骷髅只在Extra Game中遇到，它们取代了芒比尸（Mumbies）。就像他们所替代的敌人一样，它们只出现在Castle Lololo和专门针对它的Mt. Dedede部分中。骷髅要么遵循设定的波浪形路径，要么出没卡比（Kirby），这样做时比正常同伴移动得更快。

在洛洛洛城堡中箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala）中Boss战斗之后的第一个房间中，一旦卡比（Kirby）迈出一步，四名骷髅就会与四名Gaspar一起出现。靠近该部分开头附近的门。这些特殊的骷髅拥有独特的运动模式，绕门旋转，在接近卡比（Kirby）和再次远离他之间交替。

与芒比尸（Mumbies）一样，骷髅不能被吸入；因此，由于复制能力（Copy Ability）在他们唯一出现的游戏中缺席，所以只能通过向他们吐口水来击败他们。这样做会奖励卡比（Kirby）1000积分。
wikirby-page:4477.description_en:
Skuller is an enemy that appears in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. It resembles a white, floating skull with two small, yellow lights glowing in its eye sockets. Its perpetually opening and closing mouth contains only three teeth, which are all part of its upper jaw.

Skullers are only encountered in the Extra Game, where they replace 芒比尸（Mumbies）. Like the enemy they substitute, they are exclusively found in Castle Lololo and the Mt. Dedede section dedicated to it. Skullers either follow a set, wavy path or haunt 卡比（Kirby）, moving faster than their normal counterparts while doing so.

In the first room following the 箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala） mid-boss fight in Castle Lololo, four Skullers materialize alongside four Gaspars once 卡比（Kirby） steps close to the door near the beginning of the section. These particular Skullers possess a unique movement pattern, orbiting the door and alternating between closing in on 卡比（Kirby） and gaining distance from him again.

Like 芒比尸（Mumbies）, Skullers cannot be inhaled; thus, due to the absence of 复制能力（Copy Ability） in the only game they appear in, they can only be defeated by spitting something at them. Doing so awards 卡比（Kirby） 1000 points.

wikirby-page:3899.description_zh:
乌贼怪（Squishy）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）最古老、最常见的敌人之一，首次出现在该系列的第一款游戏星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，并出现在此后的大多数主要系列游戏中。乌贼怪（Squishy）的经典外观是一只长着两只细眼睛的白色鱿鱼，不过在最近的游戏中，它获得了更多显着特征，包括奶油色的身体颜色和头上的蓝色斑点。它可以在陆地和清水（Water）上运行，偶尔也可以在空中飞行。在陆地上，它通常会跳跃或摇摇晃晃，试图与卡比（Kirby）相撞。在水中，它会突然游泳，而不是连续游泳。吞咽时它不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

有时，乌贼怪（Squishy）会被模仿其行为的更强大的敌人所取代，称为Flotzo。星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中的Extra Game和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的Revenge of the King就是这种情况。在早期的游戏中，可以看到乌贼怪（Squishy）在水中游泳或在空中飞行。然而，从星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）开始，这些敌人变成了严格的水生游泳者，不再能够飞行，如果在水外发现，则会被接地。
wikirby-page:3899.description_en:
乌贼怪（Squishy） is one of the oldest and most recurring enemies of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, making its first appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, the first game of the series, and appearing in most main series titles since then. 乌贼怪（Squishy）'s classic look is of a white squid with two thin eyes, though in more recent titles, it has gained more distinguishing features, including a cream body color and blue spots on its head. It can operate both on land and in 清水（Water）, as well as occasionally fly through the air. On land, it usually jumps or waddles about, attempting to collide with 卡比（Kirby）. In the water, it will swim in bursts, rather than at a continuous pace. It does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Sometimes, 乌贼怪（Squishy） is replaced by a more formidable enemy that mimics its behavior, called Flotzo. This is the case in Extra Game in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, and in Revenge of the King in Kirby Super Star Ultra. In earlier titles, 乌贼怪（Squishy） could be seen swimming in water or flying through the air. Starting with 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, however, these enemies became strictly aquatic swimmers, and are no longer able to fly, instead becoming grounded if found outside of water.

wikirby-page:3557.description_zh: Tookey是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的敌人，其形状类似于一只白公鸡。它经常与小鸡般的敌人Twizzy配对。Tookey首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，此后又出现在Kirby's Pinball Land、星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）、Kirby Super Star Ultra和Kirby Mass Attack.
wikirby-page:3557.description_en: Tookey is an enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） that resembles a white rooster. It is often paired with the chick-like enemy Twizzy. Tookey made its first appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, and has since appeared in Kirby's Pinball Land, 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, Kirby Super Star Ultra, and Kirby Mass Attack.

wikirby-page:2803.description_zh:
Twizzy是出现在许多早期卡比（Kirby）游戏中的飞行敌人。它是一种（通常）黄色的鸟，类似于小鸡，头部比例较大。当人们看到时，Twizzies通常会向上飞，然后向左或向右飞，离开屏幕，不过也可以看到它们以波浪线形式飞行。这种攻击方法与飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）类似，并且像其更普遍的对应物一样，Twizzies在吞下时不会提供任何Copy能力。然而，可以看到它们中的许多人在地面上休息，如果卡比（Kirby）靠近，它们就会跳跃或飞向卡比（Kirby）。

Twizzy与Tookey密切相关，Tookey是一个类似的敌人，类似于Twizzy的成熟等价物。另一种类似的敌人出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）2中，称为破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick），尽管该敌人的独特之处在于它在攻击前从鸡蛋中出现。
wikirby-page:2803.description_en:
Twizzy is a flying enemy that appears in many early 卡比（Kirby） games. It is a (usually) yellow bird resembling a chick with a proportionally large head. When seen, Twizzies usually fly up and then fly left or right, leaving the screen, though they can also be seen flying in wave-like lines. This method of attack is similar to 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, and like their more ubiquitous counterparts, Twizzies do not give any Copy Abilities when swallowed. However, many of them can be seen resting on the ground and would hop or fly towards 卡比（Kirby） if he gets close to it.

Twizzy is closely related to Tookey, a similar enemy who resembles a mature equivalent to Twizzy. Another similar enemy appears in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） 2 known as 破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）, though this enemy is distinct in that it emerges from an egg before attacking.

wikirby-page:10881.description_zh:
Two Face是星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的敌人。这是一个挂在墙上的难以捉摸的面具形状的敌人。起初，它一动不动，表情柔和，睡着了，但当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会翻转到另一张脸，这张脸有邪恶的眼睛和张开的尖牙嘴，然后绕着卡比（Kirby）飞行来追击，如果接触就会造成伤害。Two Face在休眠状态下不能被吸入、攻击或以其他方式互动，但一旦开始追逐卡比（Kirby）就可以。

他们的名字来自于表达“双面”（欺骗性的、狡猾的），尽管在Two Face的情况下，这是文字.
wikirby-page:10881.description_en:
Two Face is an enemy in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. It is an elusive mask-shaped enemy which hangs on the wall. At first, it is immobile and bears a soft sleeping expression, but when 卡比（Kirby） approaches, it flips to its other face, which has evil eyes and an open fanged mouth, and then pursues 卡比（Kirby） by flying around him, dealing damage if they make contact. Two Face cannot be inhaled, attacked or otherwise interacted with while in its dormant state, but can be once it starts chasing 卡比（Kirby）.

Their name comes from the expression "two-faced" (deceitful, tricky), although in Two Face's case, this is literal.

wikirby-page:1087.description_zh:
“我有点害羞，所以我不知道他们为什么选择我来做这个！Kirby Battle Royale”
— Waddle Dees中的
瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）是一种非常和平的生物，在Dream Land中很常见，在更广泛的范围内波普之星（Popstar）区域，以及许多其他星球。Waddle Dees因其蹒跚的步态而得名，其体型与卡比（Kirby）大致相同，身体略呈梨形，皮肤呈橙红色，手臂无指，两只脚通常呈黄色，但也可能呈棕褐色或浅橙色。他们的脸是棕褐色的，有两只深棕色的眼睛，两颊有腮红，没有嘴或鼻子（尽管Waddle Dees虽然没有嘴，但仍能说话和吃饭）。虽然大多数Waddle Dees是橙色或红色，但也有绿色、黄色、蓝色或难以捉摸的金色Waddle Dees。

总体而言，Waddle Dees被描绘成梦想之地的和平居民，很少主动战斗。相反，它们通常只是阶段性地摇摇晃晃，偶尔在空中跳跃，既不关注也不主动攻击卡比（Kirby）。虽然它们通常不会构成太大的威胁，但如果它们遇到卡比（Kirby）或被他触碰，它们通常会损坏卡比（Kirby）。许多（但不是全部）Waddle Dees似乎都与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）有联系，而那些通常对他们的领导者表现出极大的尊重和忠诚的人，即使他们有时承认他的性格缺陷。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）经常使用他们作为仆人、士兵和守卫，使后者能够发挥不同程度的功效。其中最忠诚的是头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee），以他的蓝色头巾命名，他也恰好是卡比（Kirby）的朋友。
wikirby-page:1087.description_en:
“I'm kind of shy, so I don't know why they picked me for this!”
— 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） in Kirby Battle Royale
Waddle Dees are a species of very peaceful creatures that are a common sight in Dream Land, in the wider 波普之星（Popstar） region, and on many other planets. Named for their waddling gait, Waddle Dees are about the same size as 卡比（Kirby）, and have a slightly pear-shaped body with orange-red skin, fingerless stubs for arms, and two feet which are typically yellow, but may also be tan or a light orange. Their faces are tan in color and consist of two dark brown eyes, two cheek blushes, and no mouth or nose (though Waddle Dees are known to speak and eat despite lacking mouths). While most Waddle Dees are orange or red, there are also green, yellow, blue, or elusive golden Waddle Dees to be found.

Overall, Waddle Dees are depicted as peaceful denizens of Dream Land that seldom fight actively. Instead, they usually just waddle around in stages and leap in the air occasionally, neither paying attention to, nor actively attacking 卡比（Kirby）. While they are generally not much of a threat, they usually damage 卡比（Kirby） if they run into him or if he touches them. Many, but not all Waddle Dees seem to have affiliated themselves with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and those that have usually show a great amount of respect and loyalty towards their leader, even if they sometimes acknowledge his character flaws. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） often employs them as servants, soldiers, and guards, giving the latter of these spears to use to varying degrees of effectiveness. Among the most loyal of these is 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, named after his blue bandana, who also happens to be friends with 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:1510.description_zh:
“想要战斗吗？你来对地方了。”
— 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）在Kirby Battle Royale
瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）中是一个标志性的圆形生物，也是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的远亲，拥有许多与该生物相同的特性，只是用一个大眼睛代替了脸，并且能够从眼睛中发射光束。他最常作为敌人在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中出现，但在适当的游戏中可以被招募为助手，并且在某些情况下除了助手之外也可以被操控。瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）主要通过发射前述的眼睛光束进行攻击。吞下瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）通常会获得卡比（Kirby）的光束（Beam）能力，如果手持伞，他将获得卡比（Kirby）的Parasol能力。

瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的体型与瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）（以及顺带的卡比（Kirby））非常相似，并且常常出现在他那些更接地气的表亲所在的情境中。如果不从他的眼睛辨认，瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）还在配色上有所不同，他的身体呈现出更橙红色（在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中描述为“番茄酱”）的色调，脚为橙黄色，头上还有两缕头发。由于瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的脸仅由一只巨大的眼睛组成，他只能通过眼部表情来有效地表达情绪，例如流泪、瞳孔放大和眼睑动作。尽管如此，瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）仍然能够说话，这在Kirby Battle Royale和星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中有所体现。

瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）通常与重复出现的老板独眼云（Kracko）相关，他在大多数出现中都能够召唤它们，并且还拥有一个可以发射光束的巨型单眼。瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）还有一种更大的中级老板变体，称为瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo），出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot），以及其他一些标题中。
wikirby-page:1510.description_en:
“Want to battle? You're at the right place.”
— 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） in Kirby Battle Royale
瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） is an iconic round creature and distant relative of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, sharing many of that creature's characteristics, save for the single large eye in place of a face and the ability to fire beams from it. He is most commonly encountered in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） as an enemy, but he can be recruited as a helper in appropriate games and in some instances is playable aside from that. 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） attacks primarily by firing his aforementioned eye beam. Swallowing 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） will typically yield 卡比（Kirby） the 光束（Beam） ability, and if holding a parasol, he will yield 卡比（Kirby） the Parasol ability.

瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） bears a very similar physique to 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） (and 卡比（Kirby） by extension), and can often be found in the same situations as his more down-to-earth cousins. If not distinguished by his eye, 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） also differs in his color scheme, bearing a more orange-red (described in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet） as "ketchup") body hue with orange-yellow feet, as well as two strands of hair on his head. Given that 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）'s face consists only of a single giant eye, he can only meaningfully communicate his emotions using eye-based expressions such as tears, dilation of his pupil, and movements of his eyelid. Despite this, 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） is capable of speaking, as evidenced in Kirby Battle Royale and 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） is often associated with the recurring boss 独眼云（Kracko）, who is able to conjure them in most of his appearances and also has a giant singular eye which can fire beams. 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） also has a much larger mid-boss variation known as 瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） who appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, along with a few other titles.

wikirby-page:10893.description_zh: Whiskers是一种盘旋敌怪，仅出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，仅出现在Extra Game的Bubbly Clouds阶段，取代了Kookler，其行为与它.
wikirby-page:10893.description_en: Whiskers is a hovering enemy which appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found only in the Bubbly Clouds stage in the Extra Game, replacing Kookler, and behaves very similarly to it.

wikirby-page:10878.description_zh: KDL Wizzer精灵.png Wizzer是来自星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的敌人，主要出现在Float Islands关卡。它看起来像一只蛤蜊，壳内有一个巨大的单眼。它大部分时间都闭着壳固定在一个地方，但当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会打开壳进行攻击，通过发射光束攻击，类似于瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的光束。卡比（Kirby）只有在Wizzer打开壳进行攻击时才能吸入它。当壳关闭时，Wizzer可以通过其他方式击败，比如使用Star Bullet。在Extra Game中，Wizzer被Peezer替代。
wikirby-page:10878.description_en: KDL Wizzer sprite.png Wizzer is an enemy from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, found mainly in the Float Islands stage. It resembles a clam, with a large singular eyeball inside the shell. It sits in one place with its shell closed most of the time, but when 卡比（Kirby） approaches, it will open to attack by releasing a beam attack, similar to 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）'s beam. 卡比（Kirby） can only inhale Wizzer when its shell is open to attack. Wizzer can be defeated using other means when its shell is closed, such as a Star Bullet. Wizzer is replaced with Peezer in Extra Game.

wikirby-page:1748.description_zh:
“他在屏幕上左右跳动并投掷炸弹。”
— 在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）说明书的敌人角色部分中对Poppy Bros. Sr.的描述
Poppy Bros. Sr.是在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的几款游戏中出现的中级BOSS，首次亮相于首作星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）。他看起来像小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.），但体型更大。他的脚比小型的同类略长且更弯曲，并且拥有平白色的衬衫领以及连接脚部的韧带。
wikirby-page:1748.description_en:
“He jumps left and right while on screen and throws bombs.”
— Description of Poppy Bros. Sr. in the Enemy Characters section of the 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Instruction Booklet
Poppy Bros. Sr. is a mid-boss that appears in several games of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, debuting in the first installment, 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. He resembles 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）, but is bigger. He also has slightly longer and more hooked feet than his smaller counterpart and possesses a flat white shirt collar, as well as ligaments connecting his feet.

wikirby-page:3409.display_name: 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）
wikirby-page:3409.description_zh:
“Starship来得正是时候！你的敌人是卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)），天空领主！不愧是王者的飞行堡垒！”
— Vs。卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）Kirby Super Star Ultra
卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）中的暂停屏幕说明，最初称为Kaboola，是整个星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的众多主要Boss之一。她在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相，并在Kirby's Block Ball中再次出现，但之后直到Kirby Super Star Ultra才再次出现。她的整体外观类似于一个大型飞艇。尽管她最初没有脸，但她的现代外观（从Kirby Super Star Ultra开始）用类似于女性版鲨鱼脸图案的面部彩绘来描绘她，鲨鱼脸图案是一种流行的鼻子艺术形式，可以追溯到二战期间的德国、英国和美国飞行员。她的下侧锁着一门类似Blatzy的大炮（最初是黑大炮（Shotzo）），可以发射小型黑色炮弹。
wikirby-page:3409.description_en:
“The Starship comes just in time! Your foe is 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）, sky lord! It's the king's flying fortress!”
— Vs. 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)） Pause Screen Description in Kirby Super Star Ultra
卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）, originally known as Kaboola, is one of the many main bosses found throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. She made her debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and was seen again in Kirby's Block Ball, but did not reappear afterwards until Kirby Super Star Ultra. Her overall appearance resembles that of a large blimp. Although she originally did not possess a face, her modern appearance (starting with Kirby Super Star Ultra) depicts her with face paint resembling a feminine version of the shark face motif, a popular form of nose art dating back to German, British, and American pilots in World War II. Latched to her underside is a Blatzy-like cannon (originally a 黑大炮（Shotzo）), which fires small, black cannonballs.

wikirby-page:1313.description_zh:
“你…！你以为我会忘记吗？！你用你的跳高（Hi-Jump）撞向我的那次！还有那次我被助手背叛的时候！或者我被那个机械云替代的时候！我…我…呜…眼睛里有东西…”
— VS独眼云（Kracko）（非常困难）暂停屏幕说明，在Kirby Fighters Deluxe
独眼云（Kracko）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的一个循环出现的boss。他看起来像一个巨大的漂浮云，但中心有一个单眼，边缘有小尖刺。他的攻击在不同游戏中有所不同，但最常见的能力包括发射闪电、从眼睛射出光束以及从身体生成各种小怪（通常是瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）或Li'l Kracko）。他还有一个较弱、较不成熟的形态，叫做Kracko Jr.，通常在被击败后会变成独眼云（Kracko）。

就像风语大树（Whispy Woods）一样，独眼云（Kracko）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最具标志性的敌人之一，以某种形式（通常是作为头目）出现在大多数游戏中。虽然他通常是沉默的，独眼云（Kracko）有时也会偶尔短暂说话。独眼云（Kracko）有时被称为“天空之主”或“云灵统治者”，在系列的发展过程中，他的外观经历了许多变化。
wikirby-page:1313.description_en:
“YOU...! Did you think I'd forget?! The time you smashed into me with your 跳高（Hi-Jump）! That time I was betrayed by Helpers! Or when I was replaced by that mechanical cloud! I-I... Sniff...there's something in my eye...”
— VS 独眼云（Kracko） (Very Hard) Pause Screen description in the American English version of Kirby Fighters Deluxe
独眼云（Kracko） is a recurring boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He resembles a large floating cloud, but he has a single eyeball in his center and small spikes on his fringes. His attacks vary between games, but his most common abilities include shooting lightning bolts, firing beams from his eye, and generating various minions from his body (usually 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）s or Li'l Krackos). He also has a weaker, less mature form called Kracko Jr. who usually transforms into 独眼云（Kracko） after being defeated.

Much like 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, 独眼云（Kracko） is one of the most iconic enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, appearing in some form (usually as a boss) in the majority of its games. While he is typically mute, 独眼云（Kracko） does occasionally and briefly speak. 独眼云（Kracko） is sometimes referred to as the "lord of the sky" or the "cloud-spirit ruler", and has gone through many variations on his appearance over the course of the series.

wikirby-page:1884.description_zh:
Kracko Jr.是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的Boss，也是独眼云（Kracko）的少年形态，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中。他的外表由一只眼睛组成，周围有四个云球，这些球通常悬挂在适当的位置，尽管它们可以而且确实经常围绕中央眼睛旋转。大多数游戏都将这些球体描绘成粉红色，尽管摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中的摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的艺术作品有两个粉红色和两个浅蓝色，与成熟的独眼云（Kracko）的身体口音的配色方案相得益彰。

Kracko Jr.的攻击策略与独眼云（Kracko），除了Kracko Jr.的武器库中的攻击较少，这意味着他通常被认为是成熟的独眼云（Kracko）的更简单版本。有些游戏，例如星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2），最初有卡比（Kirby）战斗Kracko Jr.，只有他在战斗后期才能正确转变为独眼云（Kracko）。Kracko Jr.有时会在舞台中间面对，因此在某些情况下有时可以被视为中boss，尽管他的行为和属性更符合正确的boss（最值得注意的是他在失败后不会被吸入）。在其他情况下，例如在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中，Kracko Jr.根本没有战斗，因为他在出现后立即转变成独眼云（Kracko）。

每一个以Kracko Jr.为特色的游戏也都以独眼云（Kracko）为特色，但反之则不然。第一个以独眼云（Kracko）为特色但没有Jr.对手的游戏是Kirby's Dream Course.
wikirby-page:1884.description_en:
Kracko Jr. is a boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） and a juvenile form of 独眼云（Kracko）, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. His appearance consists of a single eye surrounded by four cloudy orbs which typically hang in place, though they can and do often spin around the central eye. Most games portray these orbs with a pink coloration to them, though Kracko Jr.'s artwork in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） has two pink and two light blue, complimenting the color scheme of the mature 独眼云（Kracko）'s body accents.

Kracko Jr.'s attack strategy is comparable to that of 独眼云（Kracko）, except that fewer attacks are in Kracko Jr.'s arsenal, meaning he is generally considered to be an easier version of the full-fledged 独眼云（Kracko）. Some games, such as 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, have 卡比（Kirby） battle Kracko Jr. initially, only for him to transform into 独眼云（Kracko） proper later in the fight. Kracko Jr. is sometimes faced in the middle of a stage, and can thus sometimes be considered a mid-boss in certain circumstances, though his behavior and properties more align with a proper boss (the most notable being that he is not inhaled after defeat). In other instances, such as in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, Kracko Jr. is not fought at all, since he immediately transforms into 独眼云（Kracko） proper after appearing.

Every game that features Kracko Jr. also features 独眼云（Kracko） proper, but the inverse is not the case. The first game that featured 独眼云（Kracko） without his Jr. counterpart was Kirby's Dream Course.

wikirby-page:1749.description_zh:
“哦，是吗？尝试找出摆脱困境的方法！Kirby's Avalanche”
— 箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala）中的
箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala）是一个二人首领，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，并再次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra，以及一些后来的衍生作品。它们主要通过推动绿色方块（称为翡翠框架者）进行攻击，或者偶尔通过推动黑刺球（Gordo）进行攻击，因为它们会在屏幕上从一扇门移动到另一扇门，如果卡比（Kirby）接触，就会伤害他。
wikirby-page:1749.description_en:
“Oh yeah? Try and figure your way out of this!”
— 箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala） in Kirby's Avalanche
箩箩箩＆菈菈菈（Lololo & Lalala） are a duo boss that first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and reappeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra, along with a few later spin-off titles. They primarily attack by pushing green blocks (called Emerald Framers) or, occasionally, 黑刺球（Gordo）s as they move across the screen from door to door, hurting 卡比（Kirby） if he makes contact.

wikirby-page:475.description_zh:
“请不要践踏我的根，这不是一个明智的决定。”
— 风语大树（Whispy Woods），在Kirby's Avalanche
风语大树（Whispy Woods）（简写为Whispy，在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中标题为森林守护者）是一个拟人化的居住在Dream Land的树，最著名的是卡比（Kirby）在许多冒险中面临的早期（如果不是第一个）Boss。在他最简单的化身中，他无法移动，只能通过在卡比（Kirby）处扔下苹果和吹Air Bullet来进行攻击，但他的多种外观和变体给了他各种额外的攻击，在某些情况下，允许他跳来跳去，甚至追赶对手。

与独眼云（Kracko）一起，风语大树（Whispy Woods）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最具标志性的Boss角色之一，自在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相以来，已出现数十次，并出现在Super Smash Bros.系列以及动漫和小说系列等其他媒体中。此外，整个系列中还有许多其他实体要么与风语大树（Whispy Woods）有关，要么受他启发，要么两者兼而有之。风语大树（Whispy Woods）几乎总是卡比（Kirby）的敌人，尽管他偶尔会作为中立角色甚至盟友出现。风语大树（Whispy Woods）作为盟友的最显着的例子是Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble和动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.
wikirby-page:475.description_en:
“Please don't tread on my roots, it would not be a wise decision.”
— 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, in Kirby's Avalanche
风语大树（Whispy Woods） (known in shorthand as Whispy, and titled Guardian of the Forest in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）) is an anthropomorphic tree who resides in Dream Land and is most well known as being an early (if not the first) boss that 卡比（Kirby） faces in many of his adventures. In his simplest incarnations, he is incapable of moving, and can only attack by dropping apples and blowing Air Bullets at 卡比（Kirby）, but his many appearances and variants give him a variety of additional attacks, and in some cases, allow him to hop around or even run after his opponents.

Along with 独眼云（Kracko）, 风语大树（Whispy Woods） is one of the most iconic boss characters in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having made dozens of appearances since his debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, as well as appearing in the Super Smash Bros. series and in other media such as the anime and novel series. Additionally, there are many other entities throughout the series that are either related to 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, inspired by him, or both. 风语大树（Whispy Woods） is almost always an enemy to 卡比（Kirby）, though he does very occasionally appear as a neutral character or even an ally. The most notable examples of 风语大树（Whispy Woods） being an ally are in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble and the anime series, 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

wikirby-form:2241.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:2241.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:2241.description_zh: Backdrop（也拼写为Drop）是来自星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）和星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）的复制能力（Copy Ability），可通过吞咽锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy）获得。它类似于投擲（Throw）、摔角手（Suplex）和格斗家（Fighter）能力，并且在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中，卡比（Kirby）戴着与格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby）最初拥有的红色头带相同的红色头带（红色的情况下为白色）卡比（Kirby））。有了它，卡比（Kirby）可以抓住敌人或其他物体，然后使用四种不同类型的摔跤式猛击之一来击败他们，具体取决于玩家在+控制板上点击的方向。他的能力非常强，能够挡住子弹，还能举起被击败的中boss。此外，卡比（Kirby）还出现在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）的北美和欧洲游戏封面上（实际上，这是来自星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby）的艺术作品）。
wikirby-form:2241.description_en: Backdrop (also spelled Back Drop) is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） from 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure） and 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）, obtainable by swallowing 锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy）. It is similar to the 投擲（Throw）, 摔角手（Suplex） and 格斗家（Fighter） abilities, and in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land） 卡比（Kirby） wears a red headband identical to the one 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby） originally had (white in the case of red 卡比（Kirby）). With it, 卡比（Kirby） can grab an enemy or other object, and then use one of four different types of wrestling-style slams to defeat them, depending on which direction the player taps on the + Control Pad. He is very strong with the ability, being able to stop bullets and lift defeated mid-bosses. Additionally, 卡比（Kirby） appears with the ability on the North American and European game covers of 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land） (which, in reality, is artwork of 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby） from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）).

wikirby-form:1297.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:1297.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:1297.description_zh: Ball是复制能力（Copy Ability），在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中很少出现。通过使用它，卡比（Kirby）可以变成类似Ball的形态，使他能够弹跳和滚动，伤害他所弹到的敌人。
wikirby-form:1297.description_en: Ball is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） appearing rarely in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. By using it, 卡比（Kirby） can transform into a Ball-like form, enabling him to bounce and roll, harming enemies he bounds into.

wikirby-form:461.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:461.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:461.description_zh:
光束（Beam）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），主要通过吸收能量光束（Beam）使用敌人（例如瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）或Laser Ball）以及使用Copy Essence。它允许卡比（Kirby）执行多种电动光束（Beam）攻击，例如具有大范围的神奇光束（Beam）鞭子，这对于击中坚固墙壁后面的开关、Bomb Block和Star Block非常有用，以便到达隐藏区域和物品。通常，当获得此复制能力（Copy Ability）时，卡比（Kirby）会获得橙色和红色的小丑帽。

光束（Beam）是卡比（Kirby）最古老的Copy能力之一，首次出现在星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）中，并且从那时起，在该系列中就有了坚实的代表性。除了基本能力外，还有几种衍生能力和形式，包括魔法光束（Beam Mage）、机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）、Beam Mode和奇迹光束（Flare Beam）Super Ability。它还能够将Zap能力效果（Power Effect）注入盟友的武器中星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.
wikirby-form:461.description_en:
光束（Beam） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） primarily obtained by absorbing an energy 光束（Beam）-using enemy, such as 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）s or Laser Balls, as well as by using Copy Essences. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to perform several electric 光束（Beam） attacks, such as a magical 光束（Beam） whip with a wide range, which is useful for hitting switches, Bomb Blocks, and Star Blocks behind solid walls in order to get to hidden areas and items. Typically, 卡比（Kirby） obtains an orange-and-red jester hat when this 复制能力（Copy Ability） is obtained.

光束（Beam） is among 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest Copy Abilities, first appearing in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, and having solid representation in the series since then. In addition to the base ability, there are several spin-off powers and forms, including the 魔法光束（Beam Mage）, the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） Beam Mode, and the 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） Super Ability. It is also able to infuse allies' weapons with the Zap 能力效果（Power Effect） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-form:868.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:868.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:868.description_zh: 燃烧（Burning）（也称为燃烧、火焰或火球，有时甚至被错误地称为烈火（Fire））是在早期卡比（Kirby）游戏中通过吸收特定类型的火热敌人获得的复制能力（Copy Ability），它给出卡比（Kirby）能够在被火焰吞没的情况下冲向敌人。该能力虽然在元素上相似，但与早期的烈火（Fire）能力不同，后者涉及在保持静止的情况下呼吸锥形火焰。这是卡比（Kirby）最古老的Copy能力之一，在星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）中首次亮相，尽管它在后来的游戏中很大程度上被纳入烈火（Fire）的动作组中。
wikirby-form:868.description_en: 燃烧（Burning） (also known as Burn, Flame, or Fireball, and even erroneously 烈火（Fire） occasionally) is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） obtained by absorbing specific types of fiery enemies in early 卡比（Kirby） games, and it gives 卡比（Kirby） the ability to charge towards his enemies while being engulfed in flames. This ability, though similar in element, is distinct from the early 烈火（Fire） ability, which instead involves breathing a cone of flame while holding still. This is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest Copy Abilities, making its debut in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, though it has largely been subsumed into 烈火（Fire）'s moveset in later titles.

wikirby-form:455.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:455.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:455.description_zh: 爆裂（Crash）是主要通过吸收弹头敌人漫步大炸弹（Bomber）获得的复制能力（Copy Ability）。它允许卡比（Kirby）执行一次巨大的爆炸攻击，清除屏幕上的大多数敌人并严重伤害Boss。在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中，该能力主要是从漂浮的圆形炸弹生物Searches.
wikirby-form:455.description_en: 爆裂（Crash） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） primarily obtained by absorbing a warhead enemy, 漫步大炸弹（Bomber）. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to perform a single gigantic explosion attack, which wipes the screen clear of most enemies and greatly injures bosses. In 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, the ability is obtained primarily from a floating round bomb creature, Searches.

wikirby-form:526.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:526.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:526.description_zh:
弯刀（Cutter）是复制能力（Copy Ability），它使用户能够将刀片回旋镖作为射弹投掷，或攻击近距离的敌人。通常，此能力会为用户提供顶部嵌入刀片的黄色帽子，尽管该能力的其他外观可能会让用户在使用它之前基本保持不变，最值得注意的异常示例是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）（其中卡比（Kirby）扔出自己的一块作为回旋镖）。使用此能力，用户可以通过操纵射弹从远处切割绳索和树叶，或者近距离使用毁灭性的Final Cutter攻击击败敌人。

弯刀（Cutter）首次出现在星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）中，使其成为整个系列中最古老的Copy能力之一。从那时起，它在随后的19场比赛中作为一项能力出现，使其成为整个系列中最普遍的能力。它的主要提供者是被称为弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）的黄色盔甲，但许多其他生物也提供这种能力，包括带回旋镖的小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）、Kapar、中Boss弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）以及使用Shooter Cutter作为灵魂形态Boss抛出的射弹。攻击.
wikirby-form:526.description_en:
弯刀（Cutter） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that grants the user the ability to throw blade boomerangs as projectiles, or strike enemies up close with them. Typically, this ability gives the user a yellow cap with the blade embedded in the top, though other appearances of the ability may leave the user largely unchanged until they use it, with the most noteworthy outlier example being in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） (where 卡比（Kirby） throws a piece of himself as the boomerang). Using this ability, the user can slice ropes and foliage from a distance by steering his projectiles, or get up close and defeat foes with the devastating Final Cutter attack.

弯刀（Cutter） first appeared in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, making it among the oldest Copy Abilities in the entire series. Since then, it has appeared as an ability in 19 subsequent games, making it the most ubiquitous ability in the whole series. Its primary provider is the yellow suit of armor known as 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）, but many other creatures provide this ability, including 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） with boomerangs, Kapar, the mid-boss 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）, and the projectiles thrown out by Soul-form bosses that use Shooter Cutter as an attack.

wikirby-form:50.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:50.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:50.description_zh:
烈火（Fire）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它使用户能够从嘴里呼吸锥形火焰，可以用来对抗敌人，点燃烈火（Fire）上的东西，如导火索、蜡烛或树叶，或者打破冰制成的东西。烈火（Fire）呼吸的范围充其量只是中等，但在某些游戏中，它可以在按住时延伸和倾斜。在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其后续游戏中，烈火（Fire）可以使用许多其他火焰攻击，例如点燃成火球（类似于燃烧（Burning）能力）、沿地面旋转火焰风车，甚至将用户变成一个大柴堆。在《星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）》中，烈火（Fire）卡比（Kirby）还可以为他的一些盟友赋予“嘶嘶声”能力效果（Power Effect）。

烈火（Fire）是最古老的Copy技能之一，首次亮相于星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）。当拥有烈火（Fire）能力时，使用者会佩戴一顶镶有绿色宝石的金色王冠。明亮的橙色火焰从头带中冒出，在一些较旧的游戏中，卡比（Kirby）的颜色略有变化，使他变成红色。烈火（Fire）能力通常可以从炽热头（Hot Head）、燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo）、Galbo或噴火輪（Flamer）等敌人那里获得（当他们不提供燃烧（Burning）时）。
wikirby-form:50.description_en:
烈火（Fire） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which empowers the user to breathe a cone of flame from their mouth, which can be used to fight enemies, light things on 烈火（Fire）, such as fuses, candles, or foliage, or break things made of ice. The range on the 烈火（Fire） breath tends to be middling at best, but in some games, it can be extended and angled while held down. In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and games that follow in its legacy, 烈火（Fire） has access to many other fiery attacks, such as igniting into a fireball (similar to the 燃烧（Burning） ability), spinning in a fiery pinwheel along the ground, or even turning the user into a big pyre. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 烈火（Fire） 卡比（Kirby） can also empower some of his allies with the "Sizzle" 能力效果（Power Effect）.

烈火（Fire） is one of the oldest Copy Abilities, making its debut in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）. When possessing the 烈火（Fire） ability, the user sports a golden tiara with a green jewel embedded in it. Bright orange flames emerge from the headgear, and in a handful of older titles, 卡比（Kirby）'s color slightly changes, making him red. The 烈火（Fire） ability can typically be obtained from enemies like 炽热头（Hot Head）, 燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo）, Galbo, or 噴火輪（Flamer） (when they don't provide 燃烧（Burning） instead).

wikirby-form:1249.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-form:1249.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-form:1249.description_zh:
冻结（Freeze）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的复制能力（Copy Ability），与冰冻（Ice）具有类似的属性。冻结（Freeze）是一种屏障技术能力，这意味着卡比（Kirby）在使用该能力时将自己包围在该能力的元素中，并且在使用该能力时无法移动。在所有出现的游戏中，冻结（Freeze）主要是通过吞噬粗眉雪人（Chilly）以及中boss冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）获得；如果冻结（Freeze）没有出现在游戏中，则这些对手会产生冰冻（Ice）能力。当卡比（Kirby）在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）、Kirby Air Ride及其续作中拥有冻结（Freeze）时，他穿着一件蓝色派克大衣，与他在Super Smash Bros.游戏中复制Ice Climbers时获得的几乎相同。

星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版，以及星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和后续标题，冻结（Freeze）不是能力，而是集成到冰冻（Ice）复制能力中的动作完全相同，称为冰冻（Ice）Storm.
wikirby-form:1249.description_en:
冻结（Freeze） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） that has similar properties to 冰冻（Ice）. 冻结（Freeze） is a barrier technique ability, which means 卡比（Kirby） surrounds himself in the ability's element while using it and cannot move while doing so.
