wikirby-page:1742.description_zh:
闪亮先生&光亮先生（Mr. Shine & Mr. Bright）是星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）、星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）、Kirby's Avalanche和星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中的二重头。它们还在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）（由Ado创作并赋予生命的画作）和摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）（它们在Paint Panic Sub-Game中客串为图画）中出现；

先生。Shine是一个有胳膊和腿的新月，而Bright先生是一个有胳膊但没有腿的炽热太阳。他们的面部表情从皱眉到咧嘴大笑，黄色或白色的四肢虽然相对较短，但纤细而灵活。

虽然这对二人组的两名成员通常都出现在同一场比赛中，但即使他们没有在一起，Bright先生也单独出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse和卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中。
wikirby-page:1742.description_en:
闪亮先生&光亮先生（Mr. Shine & Mr. Bright） are a duo boss in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, Kirby's Avalanche and 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）. They also make appearances in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） (as paintings created and brought to life by Ado) and in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） (where they cameo as drawings in the Paint Panic Sub-Game); in the latter, however, they are drawn separately.

Mr. Shine is a crescent moon with arms and legs, while Mr. Bright is a burning sun with arms but no legs. Their facial expressions vary from scowls to grins, and their yellow or white limbs are thin and flexible, albeit relatively short.

While both members of the duo usually appear in the same games as each other, even if they are not seen together, Mr. Bright appears alone in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

wikirby-page:1402.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-page:1402.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-page:1402.description_zh:
“这一切都始于梦魇出现在喷泉中。梦魇乘着梦之泉的水流，肆虐并折磨着梦境之地的居民。”
— 《星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）
梦魇（Nightmare）》中的叙述者（也称为梦魇）是恶梦的化身，他们来感染梦境。Fountain of Dreams在Rainbow Resort的中心，在Dream Land。他有两种主要形态：他最初采用梦魇（Nightmare）的能量球的形态，这是一个旋转的带有星星的魔法球，然后变身为梦魇（Nightmare）巫师，一个穿着长袍的术士，戴着巨大的肩甲，脖子上戴着一个大徽章，不透明的太阳镜，两个金角状的突起，和一个明显的下巴。他还拥有无形的双手，但没有真实的身体，而是由长袍下的龙卷风组成，这恰好是他的弱点，尽管只有星星神杖（Star Rod）可以在那里伤害他。

在星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）和星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中，梦魇（Nightmare）居住在梦想之泉为了腐蚀它，将通常令人舒缓和愉快的梦想变成痛苦的噩梦。为了阻止他使用喷泉的力量，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）粉碎了星星神杖（Star Rod），并将每块碎片都交给了他的一位朋友。然而，由于卡比（Kirby）没有被告知发生了什么事，他认为Dedede又不怀好意，并重新组装了星星神杖（Star Rod），当他将杆放回其正确位置时，意外地将梦魇（Nightmare）从喷泉中释放出来。从那里开始，卡比（Kirby）必须使用星星神杖（Star Rod）与梦魇（Nightmare）永久战斗并摧毁
wikirby-page:1402.description_en:
“It all began when the Nightmares appeared in the fountain. The Nightmares rode the currents of the Fountain of Dreams, wreaking havoc and tormenting the residents of Dream Land.”
— The narrator in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）
梦魇（Nightmare） (also referred to as the Nightmares) is the embodiment of bad dreams who had come to infect the Fountain of Dreams in the heart of Rainbow Resort, in Dream Land. He has two primary forms: he initially takes the form of 梦魇（Nightmare）'s Power Orb, a rotating magic orb with stars on it, and then transforms into 梦魇（Nightmare） Wizard, a robed warlock with giant pauldrons, a large medallion around his neck, opaque sunglasses, two golden horn-like protrusions, and a pronounced chin. He also possesses disembodied hands, but bears no real body, instead consisting of a tornado under his robe, which happens to be his weak point, though only the 星星神杖（Star Rod） may do him harm there.

In 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure） and 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）, 梦魇（Nightmare） inhabits the Fountain of Dreams in order to corrupt it, turning the normally soothing and pleasant dreams emanating from it into painful nightmares. To stop him from using the fountain's power, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） shatters the 星星神杖（Star Rod） and gives each piece to one of his friends. However, since 卡比（Kirby） was not told what had happened, he assumed that Dedede was up to no good again and reassembled the 星星神杖（Star Rod）, accidentally freeing 梦魇（Nightmare） from the fountain when he returned the rod to its rightful place. From there, 卡比（Kirby） has to use the 星星神杖（Star Rod） to battle and destroy 梦魇（Nightmare） permanently.

wikirby-page:1555.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语
wikirby-page:1555.display_work: 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）
wikirby-page:1555.description_zh:
“不要让这个老板把你逼到墙角。一旦他把你打倒了，你就逃不掉了。”
— 卡比（Kirby）的雪崩说明书（北美印刷）中画画滚轮（Paint Roller）的描述，第23页
画画滚轮（Paint Roller）是星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）的主要老板，其重制星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）和Kirby's Avalanche。他是一位轮滑艺术家，他的创作可以变得栩栩如生。除了主要出场外，画画滚轮（Paint Roller）还在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）子游戏Paint Panic和动画的一集星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中出现。
wikirby-page:1555.description_en:
“Don't let this boss paint you into a corner. Once he's got you down, there will be no escape.”
— Description of 画画滚轮（Paint Roller） in the 卡比（Kirby）'s Avalanche Instruction Booklet (North American print), page 23
画画滚轮（Paint Roller） is a main boss in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, its remake 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）, and Kirby's Avalanche. He is an artist on roller skates whose creations can come to life. Apart from his major appearances, 画画滚轮（Paint Roller） is featured in the 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） sub-game, Paint Panic, and an episode of the anime, 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

wikirby-page:38205.description_zh: Kirby Ball（也称为Ball卡比（Kirby）和Ball形卡比（Kirby））是指卡比（Kirby）在某些衍生游戏中采取的特定形式在卡比（Kirby）系列中，他被描绘成没有手和脚，只剩下一个粉红色的球体，上面有他的脸（尽管有时甚至连这个特征都缺失）。与Ball不同，这是卡比（Kirby）的更永久形式，可以在顶部添加其他复制能力（Copy Ability），并且恢复正常卡比（Kirby）的条件因外观而异（如果可能的话）。
wikirby-page:38205.description_en: Kirby Ball (also called Ball 卡比（Kirby） and Ball-shaped 卡比（Kirby）) refers to a specific form that 卡比（Kirby） takes in certain spin-off games in the 卡比（Kirby） series where he is portrayed without his hands and feet, leaving him as only a pink sphere with his face on it (though sometimes even this feature is missing). Unlike Ball, this is a more permanent form of 卡比（Kirby） which can have other 复制能力（Copy Ability） added on top, and conditions for reverting back to normal 卡比（Kirby） vary by appearance, if it is possible at all.

wikirby-page:3390.description_zh: 大石像怪（Big Kabu），原名Big Kaboo，又名Dekabu，是一款特大型石像怪（Kabu），也是卡比（Kirby）系列中的不常见敌人。他们在Kirby's Pinball Land中作为障碍首次亮相，Kirby's Block Ball作为Boss首次亮相，星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）作为敌人首次亮相。
wikirby-page:3390.description_en: 大石像怪（Big Kabu）, originally known as Big Kaboo, and also known as Dekabu, is an extra large 石像怪（Kabu） and an uncommon enemy in the 卡比（Kirby） series. They debuted in Kirby's Pinball Land as an obstacle, Kirby's Block Ball as a boss, and 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） as an enemy.

wikirby-page:82081.description_zh:
KPL Chick sprite.pngA Chick是仅出现在Kirby's Pinball Land中的障碍物。三只小鸡出现在Poppy Brothers' Land上板中间的蛋内，卡比（Kirby）必须击中它们三次才能使它们孵化，然后小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）到达它们并导致它们重置过程。Chick从蛋中孵化出来后，它会安全地走向门口，三只小鸡中的每只都会带着特定的物品出现：Apple、炸弹和传送之星（Warp Star）。随后每次击中Chick的蛋都会获得更多积分，从100到800。

在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中，Chick出现在“Kirby's Pinball Land (1)”上Character Treat.
wikirby-page:82081.description_en:
KPL Chick sprite.pngA Chick is an obstacle which appears exclusively in Kirby's Pinball Land. Three Chicks appear in the middle of the upper board of Poppy Brothers' Land inside of their eggs, and 卡比（Kirby） must hit them three times to make them hatch before a 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.） reaches them and causes them to reset the process. After a Chick hatches from its egg, it'll walk safely towards the doorway, and each of the three Chicks will emerge with a particular item: an Apple, a bomb, and a 传送之星（Warp Star）. Each subsequent hit of a Chick's egg is worth more points, from 100 to 800.

In 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）, a Chick appears on the "Kirby's Pinball Land (1)" Character Treat.

wikirby-page:25781.description_zh:
KPL Cloudy sprite.pngCloudy是一种云状敌人和障碍物，仅出现在Kirby's Pinball Land中。Cloudy出现在Kracko Land中间板的两侧，弹入时充当一种特殊的缓冲器。当被击中时，Cloudy会释放一个物体，该物体会穿过棋盘，直到消失在对方的Cloudy内。该对象可以是Apple、黑刺球（Gordo）、石像怪（Kabu）、Twizzy、飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）、Chuckie、Tookey、Chick、Maxim Tomato，或传送之星（Warp Star）。Cloudy无法被击败，但每次碰撞值得300分。

在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中，“Kirby's Pinball Land (2)”Character Treat.
wikirby-page:25781.description_en:
KPL Cloudy sprite.pngCloudy is a cloud-shaped enemy and obstacle which appears exclusively in Kirby's Pinball Land. Cloudy appears on both sides of the middle board of Kracko Land, and acts as a special sort of bumper when bounced into. When hit, Cloudy releases an object which travels across the board until it disappears inside the opposing Cloudy. This object could be an Apple, a 黑刺球（Gordo）, a 石像怪（Kabu）, a Twizzy, a 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, a Chuckie, a Tookey, a Chick, a Maxim Tomato, or a 传送之星（Warp Star）. Cloudy cannot be defeated, but it is worth 300 points per collision.

In 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）, two Cloudys appear on the "Kirby's Pinball Land (2)" Character Treat.

wikirby-page:25782.description_zh:
Nimbus是Kirby's Pinball Land中独有的云状敌人和障碍物。Nimbus是一个椭圆形的云，它在Kracko Land中板顶部附近的区域巡逻，充当一种特殊的保险杠。一旦被击中三下，Nimbus就会生气，变成灰色，并向其巡逻路径的中心移动，越过棋盘中间的卡比（Kirby）形状的保险杠。从那里开始，Nimbus开始在其下方下雨，促使卡比（Kirby）保险杠拉出遮阳伞，从而允许进入最上面的板。

Nimbus无法被击败，但每次碰撞值得800分。
wikirby-page:25782.description_en:
Nimbus is a cloud-shaped enemy and obstacle which appears exclusively in Kirby's Pinball Land. Nimbus is an oval-shaped cloud which patrols the area up near the top of the middle board of Kracko Land, acting as a special sort of bumper. Once hit three times, Nimbus becomes angry, changing to a gray color and moving toward the center of its patrol path, over the head of the 卡比（Kirby）-shaped bumper on the middle of the board. From there, Nimbus starts to rain underneath itself, prompting the 卡比（Kirby） bumper to pull out a parasol, granting access to the uppermost board.

Nimbus cannot be defeated, but it is worth 800 points per collision.

wikirby-page:1543.description_zh:
奇比（Keeby）是黄色卡比（Kirby）的名字，他是Kirby's Dream Course中的第二个玩家角色。他最初并没有被正确命名，因为“奇比（Keeby）”最初是游戏开发者给未命名的黄色卡比（Kirby）起的内部昵称。奇比（Keeby）第一次在游戏中被正确命名是在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）。

在Kirby's Dream Course的游戏中，奇比（Keeby）是一个亮黄色的卡比（Kirby），深黄色的脚。在官方艺术作品和卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中，他的脚更加橙色，与卡比（Kirby）在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中通过光束（Beam）能力获得的颜色相似。与卡比（Kirby）一样，他也能够获得复制能力（Copy Ability），并且在各方面都与他的粉红色对应物完全相同。
wikirby-page:1543.description_en:
奇比（Keeby） is the name of the yellow 卡比（Kirby） who serves as the second player character in Kirby's Dream Course. He initially wasn't properly named as such, as "奇比（Keeby）" was originally an internal nickname given by the developers of the game to an otherwise unnamed yellow 卡比（Kirby）. 奇比（Keeby） was properly named in a game for the first time in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）.

In-game in Kirby's Dream Course, 奇比（Keeby） is a bright yellow 卡比（Kirby） with dark yellow feet. In official artwork and 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）, his feet are more orange, bearing a resemblance to the coloring 卡比（Kirby） gets with the 光束（Beam） ability in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Like 卡比（Kirby）, he is also able to obtain 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and plays exactly the same in every respect to his pink counterpart.

wikirby-page:13144.description_zh:
Transformer是仅在Kirby's Dream Course的2人游戏模式中出现的敌人。它是一台红色的小型老虎机，有着三缕亮黄色的头发，头顶有大眼睛，蓝色的脚。

如果卡比（Kirby）或奇比（Keeby）通过撞到它来击败它，电量显示就会变成老虎机。如果玩家在被击中时按下A，则该老虎机不会出现。Transformers的独特之处在于，它们能够提供Kirby's Dream Course中的每一个复制能力（Copy Ability），即燃烧（Burning）、冻结（Freeze）、跳高（Hi-Jump）、针（Needle）、Normal、Parasol、电火花（Spark）、石块（Stone）、龙卷风（Tornado）、U.F.O.和车轮（Wheel）。卡比（Kirby）或奇比（Keeby）将根据玩家在老虎机上按下A Button的时间随机收到其中之一，类似于Mix能力。然而，应该注意的是，有可能从混合中根本没有获得任何能力，甚至因此失去卡比（Kirby）或奇比（Keeby）所具有的能力。
wikirby-page:13144.description_en:
Transformer is an enemy appearing only in the 2-Player Game mode of Kirby's Dream Course. It is a small, red slot machine, sporting three strands of bright yellow hair, large eyes at the top of its head, and blue feet.

If 卡比（Kirby） or 奇比（Keeby） defeats it by bumping into it, the power display turns into a slot machine. This slot machine does not appear if the player pressed A while it was hit. Transformers are unique in that they have the ability to provide every single 复制能力（Copy Ability） in Kirby's Dream Course, those being 燃烧（Burning）, 冻结（Freeze）, 跳高（Hi-Jump）, 针（Needle）, Normal, Parasol, 电火花（Spark）, 石块（Stone）, 龙卷风（Tornado）, U.F.O. and 车轮（Wheel）. 卡比（Kirby） or 奇比（Keeby） will receive one of these at random depending on the timing on when the player presses the A Button on the slot machine, similar to the Mix ability. It should be noted, however, that it is possible to receive no ability at all from the Mix, or even lose the ability that 卡比（Kirby） or 奇比（Keeby） had as a result.

wikirby-page:29122.description_zh:
Robo Dedede是Kirby's Dream Course的最终Boss，采用帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的巨型机械复制品的形式，国王亲自从内部驾驶。该机器人全身布满铆钉和槽，左手有夹子，右手有钻头，能够用脚缓慢向前移动，并且可以召唤较小的Dedede机器人来绊倒卡比（Kirby）。

在Kirby's Dream Course中，Robo Dedede是游戏中唯一的Boss，面临着自己的挑战完成前八门课程后的独特课程。一旦卡比（Kirby）进入竞技场，Robo Dedede就会被其飞行员带入，并开始向他的位置行进。随着战斗的进行，Robo Dedede将释放名为Chibi Dedede的小型发条Dedede机器人，该机器人将尝试接近卡比（Kirby），然后在他附近爆炸，这将立即导致卡比（Kirby）失去生命。卡比（Kirby）可以在它们爆炸之前猛烈撞击它们来阻止它们，也可以通过在适当的时刻向前射击来躲避它们。如果Robo Dedede到达卡比（Kirby）的起始位置，无论卡比（Kirby）还剩下多少生命，他都会被击败并交出Game Over。

为了对抗Robo Dedede，卡比（Kirby）可以在机械上发射自己威胁将其击退，卡比（Kirby）将自动返回到起始位置。在这种特殊情况下，卡比（Kirby）始终以最大功率发射。地面射击和飞行射击都可以用来将Robo Dedede击退，但只有对头部进行飞行射击才会造成伤害，导致每次成功击中机器人都会变得稍微更红。Robo Dedede将在四次成功攻击后被击败，迫使帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）逃离现场并完成Kirby's Dream Course.
wikirby-page:29122.description_en:
Robo Dedede is the final boss of Kirby's Dream Course, taking the form of a giant mechanical replica of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） which the king himself pilots from inside. The robot is covered in rivets and slots, has a clamp for a left hand and drill for a right hand, is capable of slow forward locomotion using its feet, and can call forth smaller Dedede robots to trip 卡比（Kirby） up.

In Kirby's Dream Course, Robo Dedede serves as the game's one and only boss, being faced as its own distinct course after completing the prior eight. Robo Dedede is brought in by its pilot once 卡比（Kirby） enters the arena, and begins marching toward his location. As the fight progresses, Robo Dedede will release small clockwork Dedede robots called Chibi Dedede that will try to approach 卡比（Kirby） and then explode near him, which will immediately cause 卡比（Kirby） to lose a life. 卡比（Kirby） can stop them by slamming into them before they explode, or can dodge them by shooting forward at the right moment. If Robo Dedede reaches 卡比（Kirby）'s starting position, he will be defeated and handed a Game Over, regardless of how many lives 卡比（Kirby） had remaining.

To combat Robo Dedede, 卡比（Kirby） can launch himself at the mechanical menace to knock it back, whereupon 卡比（Kirby） will automatically be returned to his starting position. In this particular instance, 卡比（Kirby） always launches at maximum power. Both grounder and flying shots can be used to knock Robo Dedede back, but only flying shots to the head will deal damage, causing the robot to turn slightly redder with each successful hit. Robo Dedede will be defeated after four successful strikes, forcing 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to flee the scene and completing Kirby's Dream Course.

wikirby-form:4622.description_zh:
“为了击败暗物质（Dark Matter），你需要Rainbow Sword。据说这把剑与隐藏在各个岛屿上的彩虹水珠有关。卡比（Kirby）能够拯救梦幻之地免受暗物质（Dark Matter）的侵害吗？”
— 最终关卡（对战暗物质（Dark Matter））——星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）说明书中的部分内容
KDL2 Rainbow Sword精灵.png Rainbow Sword是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）的Last Battle Ability。它是击败游戏主要反派邪恶暗物质（Dark Matter）所必需的。卡比（Kirby）在击败帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）后会自动获得这把剑，前提是游戏中隐藏的所有Rainbow Drop都已收集，它们会在一个简短的过场动画中合成为剑。
wikirby-form:4622.description_en:
“In order to defeat 暗物质（Dark Matter）, you need the Rainbow Sword. It is said that the sword has something to do with the Rainbow Drops hiding on the islands. Will 卡比（Kirby） be able to save the Dream Land from 暗物质（Dark Matter）?”
— Last Stage (vs. 暗物质（Dark Matter）) section of the 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） Instruction Booklet
KDL2 The Rainbow Sword sprite.png The Rainbow Sword is the Last Battle Ability of 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is required to defeat the evil 暗物质（Dark Matter）, the main villain of the game. 卡比（Kirby） obtains it automatically after defeating 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） if all the Rainbow Drops hidden throughout the game have been recovered, which combine into the sword in a short cutscene.

wikirby-page:2290.description_zh:
“在空中，空（Coo）来救援。暴风雨和强风简直就是小菜一碟！空（Coo）可以像鹰一样飞翔。”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）说明书
空（Coo）是一种大型猫头鹰生物，也是卡比（Kirby）的六只Animal Friend之一，首次出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）。他以紫色和白色的尖刺羽毛、锐利的眼睛和锋利的爪子而闻名。与其他动物（Animal）Friends一样，空（Coo）通常与卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）配对。他用爪子带着他的朋友在天空中飞行，轻松地冒着狂风。他还可以根据骑手所使用的复制能力（Copy Ability）进行多种不同的攻击。
wikirby-page:2290.description_en:
“In the air, it's 空（Coo） to the rescue. Storms and strong winds are a piece of cake! 空（Coo） can fly like an eagle.”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） instruction booklet
空（Coo） is a large owl-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s six Animal Friends, making his first appearance in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. He is distinguished by his spiky purple-and-white plumage, his piercing eyes, and his sharp talons. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 空（Coo） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. He uses his talons to carry his friends as he flies through the sky, easily braving fierce winds. He can also perform a number of different attacks depending on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） his rider wields.

wikirby-page:6182.description_zh:
Girl blob是蛊依（Gooey）的女性对应物，仅出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）的西方版本中。她可以通过她较浅的肤色（Super Game Boy为粉红色）和她佩戴的黑色丝带将她与蛊依（Gooey）区分开来。有1/8的机会，她将取代蛊依（Gooey）成为卡比（Kirby）可以从中老板手中救出的朋友，如果他已经有了他原本可以获得的Animal Friend。找到她会给卡比（Kirby）额外的生命，并计入游戏100%完成度。在舞台之外，她在《Sound Test》以及《BOSS》和《Bonus Chance》的片尾图像中也有少量亮相。

在《星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）》的日文原版中，Girl blob的角色由Chao担任，她是一位人类女孩，在《Chao》中客串。家庭计算机磁盘系统游戏Yūyūki。这个角色后来在《星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）》中作为Heart Star的朋友之一出现，她也在西方版本中出现。
wikirby-page:6182.description_en:
The Girl blob is a female counterpart to 蛊依（Gooey）, appearing only in the western version of 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. She can be distinguished from 蛊依（Gooey） from her lighter coloration (pink on the Super Game Boy) and the black ribbon she wears. There is a 1/8 chance that she will replace 蛊依（Gooey） as the friend that 卡比（Kirby） can rescue from a mid-boss if he is already with the Animal Friend he would otherwise have obtained. Finding her grants 卡比（Kirby） an extra life, and counts towards 100% completion of the game. Outside of stages, she makes a minor appearance in the Sound Test, as well as ending images for BOSS and Bonus Chance.

In the original Japanese version of 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, the Girl blob's role is filled by Chao, a human girl making a cameo from the Family Computer Disk System game Yūyūki. This character would later appear as one of the Heart Star friends in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, where she is seen in the western release as well.

wikirby-page:1638.description_zh:
“蛊依（Gooey）是卡比（Kirby）的好朋友。虽然他是由与暗物质（Dark Matter）相同的材料制成的，但他没有邪灵。”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）说明书
蛊依（Gooey）是卡比（Kirby）的朋友之一，主要出现在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3），尽管他是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次引入的。他看起来像一个蓝色（有时是紫色或黑色）的斑点，有一张脸和一条长舌头。虽然他没有任何额外的肢体，但他可以用舌头抓住东西，并在必要时伸展“身体”的一部分作为临时肢体。蛊依（Gooey）据说与暗物质（Dark Matter）“由相同的材料制成”，但他性格友善，没有恶意。他在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的出现表明，尽管他有语言能力，但他对自己或周围的世界知之甚少。

与卡比（Kirby）一样，他可以使用复制能力（Copy Ability），但用舌头抓住敌人而不是吸入敌人。除此之外，他还拥有与卡比（Kirby）相同的所有能力。在某些情况下，他还可以通过成为模拟物质来飞行，这使他的橙色花瓣与其他物种更加相似。他最初在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中作为不可玩的角色出现，但在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中他可以使用第二个控制器来玩，否则会作为CPU控制的同伴出现。除此之外，他在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中以Dream Friend的身份出现，在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中以好友的身份出现，在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中以骑手的身份出现，同时在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的其他地方也有其他较小的出场。他还在''Super Smash Bros.'' series中出现过几次。

在蛊依（Gooey）的名字在西方得到正式认可之前，他通常被称为斑点角色，在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）的非日文版本中，他有一个女性对手，称为Girl blob.
wikirby-page:1638.description_en:
“蛊依（Gooey） is 卡比（Kirby）'s good friend. While he's made from the same stuff as 暗物质（Dark Matter）, he doesn't have an evil spirit.”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instruction booklet
蛊依（Gooey） is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s friends who appears primarily in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, though he was first introduced in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. He resembles a blue (sometimes purple or black) blob with a face and a long tongue. While he does not have any additional limbs, he can use his tongue to grab onto things, and stretch parts of his "body" to use as makeshift limbs when necessary. 蛊依（Gooey） is said to be "made from the same stuff" as 暗物质（Dark Matter）, but he has a friendly personality and no ill will. His appearance in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） indicates that, though he is capable of speech, he knows little about himself or the world around him.

Like 卡比（Kirby）, he can use 复制能力（Copy Ability）, but uses his tongue to grab enemies rather than inhaling them. Besides this, he has all of the same abilities as 卡比（Kirby）. In certain circumstances, he can also fly by becoming Mock Matter, which gives him orange petals more similar to the rest of his species. He originally appeared as a non-playable character in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, but he is playable in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） using a second controller, otherwise appearing as a CPU-controlled companion. Apart from this, he appears in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） as a Dream Friend, 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2） as a Buddy, and in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） as a rider, while making other smaller appearances elsewhere in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He has also made a few minor appearances in the ''Super Smash Bros.'' series.

Prior to 蛊依（Gooey）'s name being officially recognized in the west, he was generically referred to as a blob character, and in the non-Japanese versions of 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, he has a female counterpart known as the Girl blob.

wikirby-page:3403.description_zh:
“在水下，海恩（Kine）可以完成工作。强电流没问题！海恩（Kine）是一位出色的游泳运动员。”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）说明书
海恩（Kine）是一种类似翻车鱼的海洋生物，也是卡比（Kirby）的六只Animal Friend之一，首次出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）。他的特点是明亮的蓝色身体、圆圆的大眼睛和张开的嘴巴。与其他动物（Animal）Friends一样，海恩（Kine）通常与卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）配对。海恩（Kine）擅长游泳，将朋友含在嘴里，使清水（Water）的潜水变得更加轻松。他还可以根据骑手所使用的复制能力（Copy Ability）进行多种不同的攻击。
wikirby-page:3403.description_en:
“Under water, 海恩（Kine） can get the job done. Strong currents are no problem! 海恩（Kine）'s a great swimmer.”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instruction booklet
海恩（Kine） is an ocean sunfish-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s six Animal Friends, making his first appearance in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. He is distinguished by his bright blue body, wide circular eyes, and gaping mouth. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 海恩（Kine） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. 海恩（Kine） is adept at swimming, and carries his friends inside his mouth to make diving in 清水（Water） an easier task. He can also perform a number of different attacks depending on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） his rider wields.

wikirby-page:1542.description_zh:
“在地面上，陆库（Rick）是最好的。他不会在冰上滑倒！跳上陆库（Rick）开始巡航！”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）说明书
陆库（Rick）是一种大型仓鼠状生物，也是卡比（Kirby）的六个Animal Friend之一，这是他的第一个出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中。他的特点是橙色和白色的皮毛、圆圆的眼睛和胡须，以及球根状的身躯和两只小脚，这使他能够穿越棘手的地形。与其他动物（Animal）Friends一样，陆库（Rick）通常与卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）配对。当他们骑在他的背上时，他可以根据骑手所使用的复制能力（Copy Ability）进行多种不同的攻击。
wikirby-page:1542.description_en:
“On the ground, 陆库（Rick）'s the best. He won't slide on ice! Hop on 陆库（Rick） and get cruisin'!”
— 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instruction booklet
陆库（Rick） is a large hamster-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s six Animal Friends, making his first appearance in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. He is distinguished by his orange and white fur, his beady eyes and whiskers, and his bulbous frame with two small feet, which allow him to cross tricky terrain. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 陆库（Rick） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. When they ride on his back, he can perform a number of different attacks based on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） his rider wields.

wikirby-page:3291.description_zh:
left Blade是目前仅出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的敌人。它的外观与利剑骑士（Sword Knight）非常相似，尽管它有黑色和紫色的盔甲，并带有头部尖刺，使其更类似于它的对应物铁球武士（Masher）。它与Butch和铁球武士（Masher）一起主要出现在Dark Castle中。

Blade只有一种攻击；挥剑。Blade可以用它的剑来阻止普通Star Bullet击中它，但它不能偏转穿透星弹。它也不能被吸入，但可以用Air Bullet或任何复制能力（Copy Ability）攻击来击败。Blade有时可能负责保护Protective Bag.
wikirby-page:3291.description_en:
left Blade is an enemy that currently only appears in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. Its appearance is very similar to 利剑骑士（Sword Knight）, though it has black and purple armor with a head spike, making it more closely resemble its counterpart 铁球武士（Masher）. It, along with Butch and 铁球武士（Masher）, primarily appear in Dark Castle.

Blade has only one attack; a swing of its sword. Blade can use its sword to prevent normal Star Bullets from hitting it, but it cannot deflect penetrating star bullets. It also cannot be inhaled, but it can be defeated with an Air Bullet or with any 复制能力（Copy Ability） attack. Blade may sometimes be responsible for guarding a Protective Bag.

wikirby-page:1268.description_zh:
“每个人都知道弹力球喜欢弹得这么高的唯一原因是因为它们喜欢从空中看到的景色。那里的一切看起来更加……平静。对于Bouncys来说，每一天都是美好的一天。没人能阻止他们！”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）中的雕像描述，最初称为弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）Ty（双关语“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）”）玩具”、“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）领带”，或者只是拼写错误），是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的敌人。她是一个粉红色的、有弹性的、像玩具一样的生物，戴着一条淡红色的丝带，有两只圆圆的眼睛，弹簧上方有一个红色的座位。正如她的名字一样，弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）不断弹跳，尽管有时她可能会向前跳跃并试图踩踏卡比（Kirby）。弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）吸入时不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:1268.description_en:
“Everyone knows the only reason Bouncys like to bounce so high is 'cause they like the view from up in the air. Things just seem more...peaceful up there. Every day is a good day to Bouncys. No one's gonna keep 'em down!”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）'s figurine description in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）, originally known as 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Ty (either a pun on "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Toy", "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Tie", or simply a misspelling), is an enemy debuting in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. She is a pink, springy, toy-like creature that wears a pale red ribbon, has two beady eyes and a red seat above her spring. Fitting to her name, 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） continually bounces, although sometimes she may leap forward attempting to stomp 卡比（Kirby）. 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled.

wikirby-page:5365.description_zh: KDL2 Butch sprite.png Butch是仅出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的敌人。它的总体外观几乎与斧头骑士（Axe Knight）完全相同，除了配色方案有所改变和没有角之外。在整个游戏中，经常可以看到它携带一把大型双刃战斧，用来攻击卡比（Kirby）。此外，它还配备了一个小型立方体头盔，在前板上刻有骷髅状贴花。它的整体外形呈矮胖状，周围呈圆柱形，有四个小球形四肢。与类似的表兄弟Blade和铁球武士（Masher）不同，Butch的头盔顶部没有角。
wikirby-page:5365.description_en: KDL2 Butch sprite.png Butch is an enemy that only appears in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. Its general appearance is almost precisely the same as that of 斧头骑士（Axe Knight）'s, besides an altered color scheme and a lack of horns. Throughout the game, it is often seen carrying a large, double-bladed battle axe, with which it uses to attack 卡比（Kirby）. As well, it sports a small, cubic helmet, portraying a skull-like decal across the frontal plate. Its overall body profile is squat, and cylindrical around, with four small, ball-shaped limbs. Unlike its similar cousins Blade and 铁球武士（Masher）, Butch lacks a horn atop its helmet.

wikirby-page:3432.description_zh: Elieel是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的生物。它是一条长长的深蓝色鳗鱼，有白色的下腹部和一对小鳍。通常可以看到它隐藏在管道或罐子等容器中。它只在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中作为真正的敌人出现，因为在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的其他主要出现中，它是卡比（Kirby）收到Heart Star的生物之一。
wikirby-page:3432.description_en: Elieel is a creature debuting in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is a long, dark blue eel with a white underbelly and a pair of small fins. It is usually seen hiding in containers like pipes or jars. It only appears as a proper enemy in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, since in its other main appearance in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, it is one of the creatures that 卡比（Kirby） receives a Heart Star from instead.

wikirby-page:10894.description_zh:
KDL2 Floaty the Drifter sprite.png Floaty the Drifter是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的敌人。它是游戏中第一个提供复制能力（Copy Ability）的敌人，首次出现在Grass Land第一阶段的侧室中。吞食时它提供Parasol能力。

与它的表亲Parasol一样，它可以在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）和类似敌人的手中看到，但它也可以通过跳跃自行移动。它与Parasol的区别在于其独特的眼睛和绿色。

Floaty在派遣时价值400点，无论是通过吸入还是被其他攻击击中。
wikirby-page:10894.description_en:
KDL2 Floaty the Drifter sprite.png Floaty the Drifter is an enemy in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is the first 复制能力（Copy Ability）-providing enemy that can be found in the game, first appearing in the side-room of the first stage of Grass Land. It provides the Parasol ability when swallowed.

Like its cousin, the Parasol, it can be seen in the hands of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s and similar enemies, but it can also move about on its own by hopping about. It is distinguished from the Parasol by its singular eye and green coloration.

Floaty is worth 400 points when dispatched, either by inhaling or when hit by another attack.

wikirby-page:3738.description_zh:
破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）（原名Crack-Tweet）是一种罕见的敌人，仅出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）和Kirby's Block Ball中。它看起来像一只黄色小鸡，与Twizzy类似，它有红色的喙和脚，头上还有三缕头发。它最初是在一个有水平裂缝的白鸡蛋中发现的。孵化后，破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）也可以与Twizzy区分开来，因为破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）的头部比例较小，外观更卷曲。

在蛋内时，破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）除了产生小啤酒花外什么也不做。如果它掉落一定距离或者卡比（Kirby）在这种状态下攻击它，鸡蛋就会破裂，导致小鸡从中孵化出来。外壳也可以通过吸入来去除。在它之外，这只鸟能够进行小跳跃，还可以拍打翅膀以减慢下落速度，并尝试飞越遇到的障碍物。暴露后，破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick）可以被任何攻击立即击败。
wikirby-page:3738.description_en:
破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick） (originally known as Crack-Tweet) is a rare enemy which is only known to appear in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） and Kirby's Block Ball. It resembles a small, yellow chick not unlike Twizzy, which possesses a red beak and feet, as well as three strands of hair on its head. It is initially found in a white egg with a horizontal crack running through it. When hatched, 破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick） can also be distinguished from Twizzy in that 破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick） has a proportionally smaller head and more frizzy appearance.

While inside the egg, 破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick） does nothing but make small hops. If it falls a certain distance or 卡比（Kirby） attacks it in this state, the egg breaks, causing the chick to hatch from it. The shell may also be removed by inhaling it. Outside of it, the bird is able to make small jumps, as well as flap its wings to slow down its fall and attempt to fly over obstacles it runs into. Exposed, a 破壳小鸡（Hatched Chick） can be defeated instantly by any attack.

wikirby-page:4042.description_zh:
冰柱是首先出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的危险物体。它们就像冰制成的尖刺，从天花板上垂下，指向下方。

当卡比（Kirby）经过Icicle下方时，它会摇晃并掉落下来，如果他触摸它就会伤害他。如果它撞到地面，Icicle通常会立即破碎或先弹跳一次，尽管它也可以通过攻击或吸入来摧毁。吞下它不会在Icicle的任何外观中赋予卡比（Kirby）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:4042.description_en:
Icicles are hazardous objects first appearing in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. They resemble spikes made of ice that hang from ceilings, pointing downwards.

When 卡比（Kirby） passes under an Icicle, it shakes and falls down, harming him if he touches it. Should it hit the ground, the Icicle will typically either shatter immediately or bounce once first, though it can also be destroyed by hitting it with an attack or inhaling it. Swallowing it does not grant 卡比（Kirby） a 复制能力（Copy Ability） in any of the Icicle's appearances.

wikirby-page:14813.description_zh:
“这些是训练中的Krackos。他们不是很强，但他们作为一个团队确实工作得很好！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Li'l Kracko，在英国版的毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）中解析了Lil'独眼云（Kracko），最初被称为Co-独眼云（Kracko），是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的敌人。它是独眼云（Kracko）的缩小版，在战斗中协助他。
wikirby-page:14813.description_en:
“These are Krackos-in-training. They're not very strong, but they sure work well as a team!”
— Patch Plaza description
Li'l Kracko, parsed Lil' 独眼云（Kracko） in the British version of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）, and originally known as Co-独眼云（Kracko）, is an enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. It is a smaller version of 独眼云（Kracko） that assists him in battle.

wikirby-page:25846.description_zh:
勋爵弯刀骑士（Load Kibble）是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的一个不起眼的敌人，出现在许多游戏的阶段中，将弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）的角色作为弯刀（Cutter）的主要提供者。

它的外观和行为与弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble），以至于可能会被误认为是不同名称的弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble），但在日本材料中，它始终被视为单独的字符，例如2022 Kirby Character Encyclopedia。两者在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的国际版本中被混为一谈，但从卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）开始，它在国际材料中也与弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）有所区别。

在区别特征方面，勋爵弯刀骑士（Load Kibble）的装甲比其同类装甲更加粗糙和简单（值得注意的是，它的面罩无法打开或打开）接近，并且存在只是为了强调它的小眼缝），而且它特别没有手臂。尽管自首次亮相以来，它还没有在任何游戏中实际出现过，但弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）和星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中从它身上汲取了许多视觉线索。
wikirby-page:25846.description_en:
勋爵弯刀骑士（Load Kibble） is an obscure enemy from 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） that appears in many of the games' stages, taking 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）'s role as the primary provider for 弯刀（Cutter）.

It looks and behaves very similarly to 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）, to such an extent that it can be mistaken for 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） under a different name, but it is consistently treated as a separate character in Japanese material such as the 2022 Kirby Character Encyclopedia. The two were conflated in international versions of 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, but as of 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）, it is distinguished from 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） in international material as well.

In terms of distinguishing features, 勋爵弯刀骑士（Load Kibble）'s armor is more crude and simplistic than its counterpart (noticeably, its visor cannot open or close, and only exists to give emphasis to its small eye slit), and it notably lacks arms. Although it has not physically reappeared in any games since its debut, 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） would take many visual cues from it in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） and 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）.

wikirby-page:3457.description_zh: 铁球武士（Masher）是一种重甲紧凑型骑士生物，在整个星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中以各种不同的形式少量出现。根据其出现的情况，它呈现出截然不同的特征，要么是普通敌人，要么是中头目，要么是怪物。尽管有这些描述，铁球武士（Masher）的一贯特征是其笨重的盔甲、黑色矩形护甲、尖刺头盔、十字形胸部徽章以及其武器选择（狼牙棒或连枷）。
wikirby-page:3457.description_en: 铁球武士（Masher） is a heavily armored compact knight-like creature who has sparingly appeared in various different forms throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. It takes on vastly different characteristics based on what it appears in, either being a regular enemy, a mid-boss, or a monster. Despite these portrayals, 铁球武士（Masher）'s consistent characteristics are its bulky armor, black rectangular visor, spiky helmet, cross-shaped chest insignia, and its choice of weapon (a mace or flail).

wikirby-page:23761.description_zh: Master Pengy是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）独有的敌怪，吞食时会提供冰冻（Ice）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它在游戏中扮演Pengy的角色，并且行为方式相同，尽管它们的外观有些遥远，Master Pengy具有看起来像是连体的眼睛或与腹部分开的“面具”以及明显较小的喙。
wikirby-page:23761.description_en: Master Pengy is an enemy exclusive to 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, which provides the 冰冻（Ice） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. It takes the role of Pengy in that game and acts the same way, though their appearances are somewhat distant, with Master Pengy having what appears to be either conjoined eyes or a "mask" separate from its belly as well as a noticeably smaller beak.

wikirby-page:4142.description_zh: Propeller，原名Propeller炸弹（Bomb），是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中登场的敌人。它是一种水滴状的生物，有两只眼睛、一张嘴，头顶上有一个Propeller（因此得名）。根据游戏的不同，不同的螺旋桨样本可能具有明显不同的颜色和面部表情，并且有不同的行为。大多数时候，螺旋桨是能力中立的，但它们在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）.
wikirby-page:4142.description_en: Propeller, originally known as Propeller 炸弹（Bomb）, is an enemy debuting in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is a drop-shaped creature with two eyes, a mouth and a Propeller attached to the top of its head (hence the name). Depending on the game, different specimens of Propellers may possess noticeably different colors and facial expressions, and have different behaviors. Most of the time, Propellers are ability-neutral, but they provide 冰冻（Ice） in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）.

wikirby-page:25849.description_zh: Sir Slippy是一种球状黄橙色青蛙状生物，有两只脚，类似于星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）中的Slippy。它首次出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中，常见于清水（Water）的水池中，但也可以看到在陆地上跳跃。它最近的出现是在Kirby's Block Ball.
wikirby-page:25849.description_en: Sir Slippy is a bulbous yellow-orange frog-like creature with two feet that resembles Slippy from 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）. It first appeared in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, commonly found throughout pools of 清水（Water）, but can also be seen hopping around on land. Its most recent appearance is in Kirby's Block Ball.

wikirby-page:3999.description_zh: Spikey是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）和Kirby's Block Ball中发现的敌人。它类似于刺猬或豪猪，有淡黄色的皮肤和黑色的刺。它的脸上只有两只椭圆形的黑色眼睛，拥有鳍状的手臂和一双圆形的红色脚。
wikirby-page:3999.description_en: Spikey is an enemy found in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） and Kirby's Block Ball. It resembles a hedgehog or porcupine with pale yellow skin and black spines. Of its face, only two oval, black eyes can be seen, and it possesses flipper-like arms and a pair of round, red feet.

wikirby-page:1464.description_zh:
大块头（Blocky）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中相对频繁出现的中boss。他有一个灰色或淡紫色的致密石头身体，形状像一个立方体，有两只圆眼睛和一张简单的嘴。两个由相同材料制成的长方体位于立方体下方，作为该生物的脚。他看起来很重，这一事实从他的主要攻击方式就可以看出：试图用他的体重压碎卡比（Kirby）。击败并吸入他会产生卡比（Kirby）的石块（Stone）能力。大块头（Blocky）通常以中boss的身份出现，或者继承了与卡比（Kirby）对立的另一个功能。大块头（Blocky）与硬石（Rocky）有着类似的概念，硬石（Rocky）也是一种石头生物，尽管硬石（Rocky）更像是天然岩石。

在早期游戏中，大块头（Blocky）的外观要简单得多，默认表情是微笑。从他在《星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）》中的出现开始，他就被彻底改造了，现在有着高大的鹅卵石框架，表情更加阴沉。星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中他的外貌更加不同，描绘他有又长又瘦的手臂，没有嘴，形状更像长方体，还有腿和相扑选手的服装。
wikirby-page:1464.description_en:
大块头（Blocky） is a mid-boss that appears relatively frequently throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He has a gray or pale purple dense body of stone that is shaped like a cube with two round eyes and a simple mouth. Two cuboids made of the same material are located below the cubic body and serve as the creature's feet. He appears to be very heavy, a fact which is reflected by his main method of attack: trying to crush 卡比（Kirby） with his body mass. Defeating and inhaling him yields the 石块（Stone） ability for 卡比（Kirby）. 大块头（Blocky） usually appears as a mid-boss, or inherits another function that consists of opposing 卡比（Kirby）. 大块头（Blocky） follows a similar concept as 硬石（Rocky）, who is also a creature made of stone, albeit 硬石（Rocky） more resembles a natural rock.

In early games, 大块头（Blocky） was much simpler in appearance and had a smile as his default expression. Starting with his appearance in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, he was given an overhaul, now bearing a tall cobbled frame with a more dour expression. His appearance in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） is more different still, depicting him having long skinny arms, no mouth, a more cuboid shape, and legs and a sumo wrestler's outfit.

wikirby-page:3394.description_zh: Captain Stitch是出现在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）和星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的中boss。它的外观是一个黑色的球体，眼睛周围有八个尖刺，使它像一个巨大的黑刺球（Gordo）。然而，与戈多斯不同的是，它通常露出愤怒的眼睛，而不是斗鸡眼。它还具有一张小嘴，只有在受伤时才可见。击败后可吸入针（Needle）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:3394.description_en: Captain Stitch is a mid-boss appearing in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） and 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. Its appearance is that of a dark sphere with eyes surrounded by eight spikes, making it resemble a large 黑刺球（Gordo）. Unlike Gordos, however, it usually sports angry eyes and is not cross-eyed. It is also shown to possess a small mouth, which is only visible when it becomes injured. When it is defeated, it can be inhaled for the 针（Needle） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:10895.description_zh: Efreeti是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的中Boss。Efreeti是一种有着黑色身体、红色脚和两只黄色小眼睛的生物。它比卡比（Kirby）稍大，并且以与燃烧（Burning）攻击类似的方式跳跃和向前倾斜进行攻击。Efreeti吞咽时产生燃烧（Burning）能力。
wikirby-page:10895.description_en: Efreeti is a mid-boss found within 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. Efreeti is a creature with a spiny-haired black body, red feet and two small yellow eyes. It is slightly larger than 卡比（Kirby）, and attacks by jumping about, and careening forward in a similar manner to the 燃烧（Burning） attack. Efreeti yields the 燃烧（Burning） ability when swallowed.

wikirby-page:7210.description_zh: Jumper Shoot，最初拼写为Jumpershoot，是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）和星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的中boss。从外观上看，它与Floaty the Drifter非常相似，不同之处在于Jumper Shoot有一只脚，与Drifter不同，而且要大得多。一旦被击败，吞噬时会释放Parasol能力。
wikirby-page:7210.description_en: Jumper Shoot, originally spelled Jumpershoot, is a mid-boss found within 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） and 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is very similar to Floaty the Drifter in terms of appearance, with the exception that Jumper Shoot has a foot, unlike the Drifter, and is much larger. Once defeated, it will give out the Parasol ability when swallowed.

wikirby-page:10934.description_zh: KDL2绿大师（Master Green）sprite.png绿大师（Master Green）是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中的中Boss。它首先在Ripple Field的Stage 2中被发现，吞食后产生电火花（Spark）能力。绿大师（Master Green）是一种类似水母的生物，通常在陆地上活动，用卷起的触手行走。尽管它的名字如此，但它并不总是绿色的。
wikirby-page:10934.description_en: KDL2 绿大师（Master Green） sprite.png 绿大师（Master Green） is a mid-boss found within 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is first found in Stage 2 of Ripple Field, and yields the 电火花（Spark） ability when swallowed. 绿大师（Master Green） is a jellyfish-like creature that usually operates on land, walking about with its tentacles bunched up. Despite its name, it is not always green.

wikirby-page:10990.description_zh: Waiu是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的中boss。它像一个穿着紫色服装的忍者，在失败后被吞噬时提供弯刀（Cutter）能力。
wikirby-page:10990.description_en: Waiu is a mid-boss that made its debut in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It resembles a ninja in a purple outfit and provides the 弯刀（Cutter） ability when swallowed after defeat.

wikirby-page:274.description_zh: 暗物质（Dark Matter）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的主要对手之一，迄今为止在两款游戏中主要亮相，即星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）和星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）。他还作为Kirby Quest的最终Boss（Sub-Game的Kirby Mass Attack）的一个小角色出现。他两次试图接管波普之星（Planet Popstar）并将其变成一个黑暗的世界；第二次，他召唤师父零（Zero）来帮助他。
wikirby-page:274.description_en: 暗物质（Dark Matter） is one of the primary antagonists of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, making major appearances in two games to date, namely 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2） and 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He also makes a minor appearance as the final boss of Kirby Quest, a Sub-Game of Kirby Mass Attack. He twice attempts to take over 波普之星（Planet Popstar） and turn it into a world of darkness; the second time, he calls upon his master 零（Zero） to assist him.

wikirby-page:4568.description_zh:
“面对可以冻结树叶的暴风雪，拿下冰龙（Ice Dragon）！”
— 来自Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
冰龙（Ice Dragon）的艰难任务风味文本是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的Boss。冰龙（Ice Dragon）是一种巨大、圆形、青色蜥蜴状生物，腹部白色，背上有四个蓝色尖刺。与许多其他龙（例如龙帝亚（Landia））不同，冰龙（Ice Dragon）没有翅膀，但他仍然可以通过快速拍打尾巴来在空中扑腾。他是一种古老的生命形式，已经经历了许多时代。除了在游戏中出现外，冰龙（Ice Dragon）还在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.
wikirby-page:4568.description_en:
“Facing blizzards that can freeze foliage solid, take down the 冰龙（Ice Dragon）!”
— Tough Quest flavor text from Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
冰龙（Ice Dragon） is a boss that debuted in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. 冰龙（Ice Dragon） is a large, rounded, cyan lizard-like creature with a white belly and four blue spikes on his back. Unlike many other dragons (such as 龙帝亚（Landia）), 冰龙（Ice Dragon） does not possess wings, but he can still flutter through the air by rapidly flapping his tail. He is an ancient life-form that has lived through a number of ages. Apart from his game appearances, 冰龙（Ice Dragon） also appears as a monster in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

wikirby-page:5559.display_name: 突进野猪&奈利（Nruff and Nelly）
wikirby-page:5559.description_zh: KDL2突进野猪&奈利（Nruff and Nelly）sprite.png突进野猪&奈利（Nruff and Nelly）（也写为突进野猪（Nruff）和Nelly）是星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中Big Forest的Boss，出现在Stage 4。突进野猪（Nruff）是主要敌人，外观像一头大毛野猪，耳朵膨胀，獠牙和单色棕色皮毛。耐莉是一头体型较小的野猪，外观基本相同，但耳朵塞进去，背上有白色条纹。几只Nellys陪伴突进野猪（Nruff）进行Boss战，并且会不断出现，直到突进野猪（Nruff）被击败。
wikirby-page:5559.description_en: KDL2 突进野猪&奈利（Nruff and Nelly） sprite.png 突进野猪&奈利（Nruff and Nelly） (also written 突进野猪（Nruff） & Nelly) are the bosses of Big Forest in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）, appearing in Stage 4. 突进野猪（Nruff） is the main enemy, having the appearance of a large woolly boar with distended ears, tusks and a monochrome brown coat. Nelly is a smaller boar who looks largely the same, but has its ears tucked in and has white stripes across its back. Several Nellys accompany 突进野猪（Nruff） in their boss fight, and will keep reappearing until 突进野猪（Nruff） is defeated.

wikirby-page:4453.description_zh: leftSweet Stuff是一个水生Boss，在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中唯一正确出现。它是一种类似鱼的棕色生物，有黄色的鳍和张开的嘴，长着锋利的牙齿，以琵琶鱼为原型，只是头上的吊钩末端有一个看起来像灯泡的东西。它的主要攻击策略是从灯泡中发射闪电或在卡比（Kirby）.
wikirby-page:4453.description_en: leftSweet Stuff is an aquatic boss who makes its only proper appearance in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. It is a brown fish-like creature with yellow fins and a gaping mouth with sharp teeth, based off an anglerfish, only with what appears to be a light bulb on the end of the dangler on its head. Its main attack strategy is shooting lightning bolts from its bulb or charging at 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:15679.description_zh:
KBBa Big Cappy sprite.png Big Cappy是仅出现在Kirby's Block Ball中的Boss。它是Stage 1的Boss，出现在第5轮。它本质上是蘑菇怪（Cappy）的放大版本，它唯一的“攻击”方法是从左向右摆动并击打侧面的桨，使其暂时变小。Big Cappy需要12次命中才能击败。当HP降至6时，它会失去上限，并召唤四只较小的无上限Cappy来保护自己。这些较小的跟随Big Cappy的动作，每次击中两次即可击败，尽管它们不值任何积分，并且当Big Cappy被击败时它们会消失。

Big Cappy被击败时价值50000分。
wikirby-page:15679.description_en:
KBBa Big Cappy sprite.png Big Cappy is a Boss which appears exclusively in Kirby's Block Ball. It is the boss of Stage 1, appearing in round 5. It is essentially a larger version of 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and its only method of 'attack' is to wobble from left to right and hit the paddles on the sides to temporarily make them smaller. Big Cappy takes 12 hits to defeat. When down to 6 HP, it loses its cap, and calls on four smaller capless Cappys to defend itself. These smaller ones follow Big Cappy's movements and take two hits each to defeat, though they are not worth any points and will disappear when the Big Cappy is defeated regardless.

Big Cappy is worth 50000 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:15687.description_zh: Big Squishy是Kirby's Block Ball中独家出现的Boss。它是Stage 2的boss，出现在第5轮。它本质上是乌贼怪（Squishy）的放大版，当被激怒时，它可能会抓住卡比（Kirby）并以不可预知的角度把他扔出去。乌贼怪（Squishy）在竞技场中定期从左向右移动，沿水平移动路径停在三个可能的位置。Big Squishy需要击中12次才能击败，击败后价值50000点。
wikirby-page:15687.description_en: Big Squishy is a boss appearing exclusively in Kirby's Block Ball. It is the boss of Stage 2, appearing in round 5. It is essentially a larger version of 乌贼怪（Squishy）, and when angered, it may grab 卡比（Kirby） and toss him at an unpredictable angle. 乌贼怪（Squishy） regularly moves from left to right in the arena, stopping in three possible positions along that horizontal moving path. Big Squishy takes 12 hits to defeat, and is worth 50000 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:15696.description_zh: Brobo是一个类似于机器人套装内的奇怪圆形生物的Boss。它是Kirby's Block Ball的Stage 10的Boss，并且是卡比（Kirby）将面对的最后一个Boss，除非在游戏的前10个阶段达到所有边界线分数。
wikirby-page:15696.description_en: Brobo is a boss who resembles a strange circular creature residing inside a robot suit. It serves as the boss of Stage 10 of Kirby's Block Ball, and is the last boss 卡比（Kirby） will face unless all of the border line scores were met in the first 10 stages of the game.

wikirby-form:409.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:409.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:409.description_zh:
炸弹（Bomb）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它允许卡比（Kirby）生产并向对手投掷无限量的圆形炸药。虽然炸弹（Bomb）的动作是最简单的，但由于其新兴技术，炸弹（Bomb）的能力相当多才多艺，因为卡比（Kirby）可以利用该能力反复压制强大的对手，留下炸弹自行引爆来解决谜题，或者覆盖自己周围的各个位置以阻止敌人。在某些游戏中，炸弹（Bomb）还具有火属性，可以点燃导火索。当卡比（Kirby）获得炸弹（Bomb）能力时，他会获得一顶深蓝色烟花圆锥形帽子，尽管在较早的游戏中，他会获得一顶与利剑（Sword）类似的蓝色软盘帽。

炸弹（Bomb）在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次出现，并已出现在大多数后续主要系列游戏中。虽然许多敌人和物体在吸入时提供炸弹（Bomb）能力，但其主要敌人代表是小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.），他充当Helper代表星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的能力。
wikirby-form:409.description_en:
炸弹（Bomb） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which allows 卡比（Kirby） to produce and then toss an unlimited supply of round explosives at his opponents. Although it is among the simplest in terms of its moveset, the 炸弹（Bomb） ability is quite versatile due to its emergent techniques, as 卡比（Kirby） can use the ability to repeatedly bear down on a strong opponent, leave bombs behind to detonate on their own to solve puzzles, or cover various positions around himself to keep his foes at bay. In some games, 炸弹（Bomb） also has a fiery property to it, allowing it to light fuses. When 卡比（Kirby） gains the 炸弹（Bomb） ability, he gains a dark blue fireworks cone hat, though in older titles, he would gain a blue floppy cap similar to the one for 利剑（Sword）.

炸弹（Bomb） made its first appearance in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, and has appeared in most subsequent main series games. Though many enemies and objects provide the 炸弹（Bomb） ability when inhaled, its primary enemy representative is 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）, who acts as the Helper representing the ability in both 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-form:458.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:458.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:458.description_zh:
料理（Cook）是复制能力（Copy Ability），在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相，后来在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）、Kirby Super Star Ultra和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中回归。它允许卡比（Kirby）将屏幕上出现的所有敌人和射弹强制放入一个大金锅中，并让料理（Cook）生产食物来补充他自己和他的朋友的力量。料理（Cook）是一次性能力，通常通过吸收击败的中boss厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）来提供，使用时会自动击败屏幕上的任何常规敌人。在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，该能力也可以对卡比（Kirby）的盟友使用（无害），并且会根据所加入的“成分”生产特定的食物。

当卡比（Kirby）获得料理（Cook）能力时，他会获得一顶白色厨师帽（上面有一个小星星）星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的一方）直到他使用完该能力。料理（Cook）卡比（Kirby）在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）钥匙串和卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）Character Treat中被错误地命名为Chef卡比（Kirby）。实际的“厨师”卡比（Kirby）指的是他在Kirby Café商品中的角色，与复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-form:458.description_en:
料理（Cook） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and later returned in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, Kirby Super Star Ultra, and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to force all enemies and projectiles present on screen into a large golden cauldron and 料理（Cook） them to produce food to replenish the strength of himself and his friends. 料理（Cook） is a single-use ability, typically provided by absorbing the defeated mid-boss 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）, and it will automatically defeat any regular enemy on screen when it is used. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, the ability can also be used (harmlessly) on 卡比（Kirby）'s allies, and will produce a specific food item based on what "ingredients" go in.

When 卡比（Kirby） gains the 料理（Cook） ability, he is given a white chef's hat (with a small star on the side in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）) until he finishes using the ability. 料理（Cook） 卡比（Kirby） is misnamed as Chef 卡比（Kirby） in the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） keychain and the 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet） Character Treat. The actual "Chef" 卡比（Kirby） refers to his role in the Kirby Café merchandise, which is not the same as the 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-form:422.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:422.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:422.description_zh:
Copy是通过吞咽喵客（Tac）获得的有限用途复制能力（Copy Ability），仅出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中。它允许卡比（Kirby）扫描敌人以获得他们的力量，这甚至可以对无法正常吸入的敌人起作用。扫描到的普通敌人会受到轻微伤害，但这一举动也适用于中头目，对他们造成中等伤害。当对不提供任何Copy能力的敌人使用时，该招式会对他们造成伤害，但对黑刺球（Gordo）或黑大炮（Shotzo）等无敌敌人不起作用。对喵客（Tac）使用该招式会对其造成伤害，就像它是一个不提供任何Copy能力的敌人一样，而不是复制其中的一些能力。

卡比（Kirby）也可以通过Copy Essences Deluxe获得Copy能力。装备Copy能力后，卡比（Kirby）可以创建喵客（Tac）作为助手。卡比（Kirby）的视觉外观没有改变，但卡比（Kirby）并没有吸入敌人，而是戴上护目镜来扫描他们的力量。
wikirby-form:422.description_en:
Copy is a limited-use 复制能力（Copy Ability） obtained by swallowing 喵客（Tac）, which appears exclusively in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to scan an enemy in order to obtain their powers, which can work even on enemies that cannot be inhaled normally. Common enemies scanned are slightly damaged, but the move also works on mid-bosses, dealing them moderate damage instead. When used on enemies that don't provide any Copy Abilities, the move damages them, but it does not work on invulnerable enemies such as 黑刺球（Gordo） or 黑大炮（Shotzo）. Using the move on a 喵客（Tac） damages it as if it was an enemy that doesn't provide any Copy Ability, instead of copying some ability out of it.

卡比（Kirby） can also obtain the Copy ability through Copy Essences Deluxe. With the Copy ability equipped, 卡比（Kirby） can create 喵客（Tac） as a helper. 卡比（Kirby）'s visual appearance does not change but rather than inhaling foes, 卡比（Kirby） puts on goggles to scan their powers.

wikirby-form:536.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:536.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:536.description_zh:
格斗家（Fighter）是复制能力（Copy Ability），它使卡比（Kirby）能够施展各种强大的武术技巧来击败对手。这些技术中包括火神刺拳、大乱斗（Smash）拳击、旋转踢和Rising Break等著名招式，所有这些招式都可以在近距离造成严重伤害。此外，卡比（Kirby）还可以从手中发射能量爆炸，类似于''Street Fighter'' series的战斗机，抓住对手并将其扔开。卡比（Kirby）通常在吞下格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）时获得此能力，并获得标志性的红色头带，在最近的游戏中，其上印有一颗星星。格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby）因拥有大量动作而闻名，这对于新玩家来说很难可靠地完成。

格斗家（Fighter）首次在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中作为复制能力（Copy Ability）出现，此后一直是继承其传统的后续游戏的中流砥柱。格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby）的许多招式将被纳入''Super Smash Bros.'' series中卡比（Kirby）的招式中，并且从那里，一些将通过大乱斗（Smash）能力回收回星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中。
wikirby-form:536.description_en:
格斗家（Fighter） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which empowers 卡比（Kirby） to be able to perform a wide array of strong martial arts techniques to defeat his opponents. Among these techniques are famous moves such as Vulcan Jab, 大乱斗（Smash） Punch, Spin Kick, and Rising Break, all of which can do heavy damage up close. In addition, 卡比（Kirby） can also fire energy blasts from his hands, similar to fighters from the ''Street Fighter'' series, and grab opponents to toss them away. 卡比（Kirby） typically gains this ability when he swallows 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）, and gains an iconic red headband which in more recent games has a star emblazoned on it. 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby） is well-known for having lots of moves, which can be difficult for new players to reliably pull off.

格斗家（Fighter） first appeared as a 复制能力（Copy Ability） in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, and has since been a mainstay in subsequent games that follow in its legacy. Many of 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby）'s moves would be incorporated into 卡比（Kirby）'s moveset in the ''Super Smash Bros.'' series, and from there, several would be recycled back into the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） through the 大乱斗（Smash） ability.

wikirby-form:503.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:503.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:503.description_zh:
喷射机（Jet）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），主要通过吸入和吞咽Capsule J系列敌人之一而获得。它允许卡比（Kirby）在空中快速飞行，以及执行各种基于喷射机（Jet）的攻击。仔细使用此能力，卡比（Kirby）可以利用突然的移动来快速前进，同时击退敌人。他还可以使用喷射机（Jet）的排气装置执行拦截技术和灯光引信。

当卡比（Kirby）获得喷射机（Jet）能力时，他会获得一顶蓝色和白色的帽子，类似于微型战斗机喷射机（Jet）。喷射机（Jet）的“挡风玻璃”形成了一副护目镜，卡比（Kirby）可以在飞行时佩戴，而后面的发动机则提供卡比（Kirby）使用此能力时所需的推进力。喷射机（Jet）发动机的火焰也是典型的蓝色。
wikirby-form:503.description_en:
喷射机（Jet） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） primarily obtained by inhaling and swallowing one of the Capsule J series of enemies. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to fly at rapid pace in the air, as well as performing various 喷射机（Jet）-based attacks. Using this ability carefully, 卡比（Kirby） can make rapid progress using sudden bursts of movement while knocking away his foes in the process. He can also perform tackling techniques and light fuses using his 喷射机（Jet）'s exhaust.

When 卡比（Kirby） gains the 喷射机（Jet） ability, he is given a blue and white hat which resembles a miniature fighter 喷射机（Jet）. The "windscreen" of the 喷射机（Jet） forms a pair of goggles which 卡比（Kirby） can wear while flying, and the engines on back perform the propulsion that 卡比（Kirby） needs when using this ability. The flame from the 喷射机（Jet）'s engines is characteristically blue in color as well.

wikirby-form:408.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:408.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:408.description_zh: 镜子（Mirror）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它允许卡比（Kirby）投射自己的镜子（Mirror）图像，用魔法玻璃般的射弹攻击，并将攻击反射回敌人。镜子（Mirror）能力首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中，主要通过吞食Simirror获得。镜子（Mirror）卡比（Kirby）的帽子最初类似于光束（Beam）能力的帽子，但帽子的两侧有红蓝配色方案和星星（尽管帽子的红色一侧在游戏中没有星星）。星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）更新为现代设计，改变了帽子的外观和颜色，使卡比（Kirby）成为更具特色的魔法棒。
wikirby-form:408.description_en: 镜子（Mirror） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which allows 卡比（Kirby） to project 镜子（Mirror） images of himself, attack with magical glass-like projectiles, and reflect attacks back at his enemies. The 镜子（Mirror） ability first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and is obtained primarily by swallowing Simirror. The hat for 镜子（Mirror） 卡比（Kirby） originally resembled that of the 光束（Beam） ability, though with a red and blue color scheme and stars on both sides of the hat (though the red side of the hat is starless in-game). It was updated to its modern design in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, changing the look and color of the hat and giving 卡比（Kirby） a more distinctive magic rod.

wikirby-form:470.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:470.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:470.description_zh:
忍者（Ninja）是一款复制能力（Copy Ability），其特点是其大量武器和技术的灵感来自典型的日本忍者（Ninja）武士。卡比（Kirby）主要通过吸入暗忍（Bio Spark）或月影（Moonja）来获得此能力，并获得多种攻击方式，例如用武士刀砍敌人、投掷刀、使用消失动作报复攻击者，或使用各种武术攻击，例如闪电般的快速攻击忍者（Ninja）Kick或毁灭性的Air Drop攻击。忍者（Ninja）卡比（Kirby）通常还具有紧贴墙壁的能力，或者在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中，在清水（Water）的表面上行走。

忍者（Ninja）能力首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中，并给出卡比（Kirby）独特的红色帽子，附有大马尾辫。从星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）开始，忍者（Ninja）帽子类似于带有镶钉头带的紫色兜帽。一些早期的游戏在使用此能力时会导致卡比（Kirby）呈现紫色。
wikirby-form:470.description_en:
忍者（Ninja） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） characterized by its large array of weapons and techniques inspired by the stereotypical Japanese 忍者（Ninja） warrior. 卡比（Kirby） can gain this ability primarily by inhaling either 暗忍（Bio Spark） or 月影（Moonja）, and gains access to a wide array of attacks, such as slashing foes with a katana, throwing knives, using a vanishing act to retaliate against attackers, or using various martial-arts strikes, like the lightning-fast 忍者（Ninja） Kick or the devastating Air Drop attack. 忍者（Ninja） 卡比（Kirby） also typically has the ability to cling to walls or, in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, walk on the surface of 清水（Water）.

The 忍者（Ninja） ability first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, and gave 卡比（Kirby） a distinctive red cap with a large ponytail attached. From 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and onward, the 忍者（Ninja） hat would resemble a purple cowl with a studded headband. Some earlier games would cause 卡比（Kirby） to take on a purple hue when using this ability.

wikirby-form:932.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:932.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:932.description_zh: Paint是出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的有限使用复制能力（Copy Ability），使用时会成为对Boss的强大攻击。Paint能力非常罕见，因为标准敌怪、Copy Essence或Mix无法提供该能力；它只能通过Heavy Lobster释放的稀有Paint Blobby敌人，或通过Chameleo Arm或魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）释放的Paint射弹获得。另外，在卡比（Kirby）恢复正常之前，Paint只能用于一次攻击。与其他限制使用能力一样，卡比（Kirby）无法通过Paint能力创建助手。Z​​XQ900003QXZ获得该能力后，卡比（Kirby）获得一顶灰色帽子、一把画笔和一桶Paint。当卡比（Kirby）使用Paint能力时，他会在屏幕上的几个地方喷洒大滴Paint，然后卡比（Kirby）用一些狂野的笔触进行猛烈攻击，根据他正在战斗的Boss而产生不同的效果。当Paint用于Chameleo Arm时，他的颜色会改变，或者如果他变得隐形，他会再次完全可见。如果该能力用在Heavy Lobster上，它会使其变红，并有一个Paint斑点遮住它的眼睛，使其失明，从而导致它随机攻击而不是瞄准卡比（Kirby）。然而这个技能用在魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）上时，视觉上并没有什么差别，只是对boss造成一点点伤害。如果在Boss战之外使用，Paint能力可用于普通敌人，其功能与爆裂（Crash）能力完全相同。
wikirby-form:932.description_en:
Paint is a limited-use 复制能力（Copy Ability） appearing in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra which, when used, becomes a powerful attack on bosses. The Paint ability is very rare, as it is not available from standard enemies, Copy Essences, or Mix; it can only be obtained via the rare Paint Blobby enemy released by Heavy Lobster, or through Paint projectiles released by Chameleo Arm or 魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）. Additionally, Paint can be used only for one attack before 卡比（Kirby） is reverted to normal. Like other limited-use abilities, 卡比（Kirby） cannot create a helper from the Paint ability.

Upon obtaining the ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a gray hat, a paintbrush and a bucket of Paint. When 卡比（Kirby） uses the Paint ability, he splatters large drops of Paint in several places on the screen, followed by 卡比（Kirby） lashing out with some wild brush strokes, causing a different effect depending on what boss he is fighting. When Paint is used on Chameleo Arm, his color is changed or he is made perfectly visible again if he had turned invisible. If the ability is used on Heavy Lobster, it causes it to turn red and a Paint blob to cover its eye, blinding it and thus causing it to attack randomly instead of aiming at 卡比（Kirby）. However, when this ability is used on 魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）, there is no visual difference, and all it does is cause a little bit of damage to the boss. If taken outside of a boss battle, the Paint ability can be used on normal enemies, where it functions exactly the same as the 爆裂（Crash） ability.

wikirby-form:413.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-form:413.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:413.description_zh:
电离子（Plasma）是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中引入的复制能力（Copy Ability）。电离子（Plasma）的能力允许卡比（Kirby）充电并发射不同强度的光束和电波，具体取决于已经积累了多少能量。在最大功率下，这些射击能够穿过墙壁和敌人，但充电需要玩家在方向键或模拟摇杆上快速捣碎。

当获得电离子（Plasma）能力时，卡比（Kirby）获得一个锯齿状的王冠，上面镶嵌着绿色的圆形或三角形的宝石，顶部是类似于火焰的绿色卷曲能量。早期出场时，装备电离子（Plasma）时，卡比（Kirby）的皮肤会变成绿色；《星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）》中的游戏精灵皮肤呈淡粉色，而《星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）》则没有任何变化。在大多数电离子（Plasma）作为能力出现的游戏中，它是由電離子團（Plasma Wisp）提供的，電離子團（Plasma Wisp）也可以作为该能力的Helper出现。在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，电离子（Plasma）由电插头（Plugg）提供并代表。

电离子（Plasma）与该系列中的另一个电力能力电火花（Spark）非常相似。然而，两者从未出现在同一个标​​题中，而电火花（Spark）则更为常见。电火花（Spark）从星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）开始获得电离子（Plasma）的部分属性，并将其大部分招式纳入星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。尽管如此，电离子（Plasma）作为自己独特的能力再次出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，因此两者并未完全合并，不像类似的重叠能力（如燃烧（Burning）和烈火（Fire），或冰冻（Ice）和冻结（Freeze）).
wikirby-form:413.description_en:
电离子（Plasma） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） introduced in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. The 电离子（Plasma） ability allows 卡比（Kirby） to charge up and fire beams and waves of electricity at various levels of strength, depending on how much energy has been built up. At maximum power, these shots are capable of going through walls and enemies alike, though charging them up requires the player to mash rapidly on the directional pad or analog stick.

When obtaining the 电离子（Plasma） ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a jagged diadem with a green circular or triangular gem inset, topped by green frizzy energy that resembles flames. In early appearances, 卡比（Kirby）'s skin would become green when equipping 电离子（Plasma）; his in-game sprites in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） feature pale pink skin, while 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） features no change at all. In most titles where 电离子（Plasma） appears as an ability, it is provided by 電離子團（Plasma Wisp）, who can also appear as the Helper for the ability. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 电离子（Plasma） is provided and represented by 电插头（Plugg）.

电离子（Plasma） bears a strong resemblance to 电火花（Spark）, another electricity-based ability in the series. However, the two have never appeared in the same title, and 电火花（Spark） is far more commonly seen. 电火花（Spark） began to gain some of 电离子（Plasma）'s properties beginning in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, and subsumed most of its moveset by 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. Nonetheless, 电离子（Plasma） reappears in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） as its own distinct ability, so the two have not been fully merged, unlike similar overlapping abilities (like 燃烧（Burning） and 烈火（Fire）, or 冰冻（Ice） and 冻结（Freeze）).

wikirby-form:537.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:537.description_zh: 摔角手（Suplex）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它允许卡比（Kirby）以几种不同的方式抓住和投掷他的敌人来击败他们。该能力由中boss锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy）、Jukid和象象（Phan Phan）（在Kirby Super Star Ultra中）提供，尽管锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy）是该能力的主要代表。当卡比（Kirby）获得此能力时，他获得类似于投擲（Throw）和格斗家（Fighter）能力的红色头带的蓝色头带，并在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）Ultra中获得较深的肤色。在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，卡比（Kirby）保持正常肤色，但头带改为类似摔跤带。
wikirby-form:537.description_en: 摔角手（Suplex） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which allows 卡比（Kirby） to grab and toss his foes in several different ways to defeat them. This ability is provided by mid-bosses 锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy）, Jukid, and 象象（Phan Phan） (in Kirby Super Star Ultra), though 锹形大甲虫（Bugzzy） is the primary representative of the ability. When 卡比（Kirby） obtains this ability, he gains a blue headband similar to 投擲（Throw） and to the red headband of the 格斗家（Fighter） ability, and gains a darker tone to his skin in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Ultra. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 卡比（Kirby） keeps his normal skin tone, but the headband is changed to resemble a wrestling belt.

wikirby-form:547.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:547.description_zh: 特技轮骑士（Wheelie Rider）是一种特殊能力，通过跳上友方特技轮（Wheelie）在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中可以使用。像这样配对时，卡比（Kirby）和特技轮（Wheelie）可以非常快速地移动并瞬间转向，还可以执行Infinity Jump，使得该能力总体上比单独使用车轮（Wheel）能力更有优势。
wikirby-form:547.description_en: 特技轮骑士（Wheelie Rider） is a special ability accessed by hopping on a friendly 特技轮（Wheelie） in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. When paired up like this, 卡比（Kirby） and 特技轮（Wheelie） can ride extremely quickly and turn on a dime, as well as perform an Infinity Jump, making the ability overall more advantageous to use than the 车轮（Wheel） ability on its own.

wikirby-form:482.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:482.description_zh: 风羽（Wing）是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的复制能力（Copy Ability）。它允许卡比（Kirby）在空中快速飞行，并执行一些优雅的风羽（Wing）机动、俯冲炸弹和冲锋攻击，以及不太优雅的羽毛枪攻击，尽管这种攻击可用于切断绳索和其他此类障碍物。通常由飞行鸟（Birdon）提供，此能力为卡比（Kirby）提供亮黄色羽毛头饰和红色条纹代替他正常的脸颊标记（尽管自Kirby Super Star Ultra以来就没有看到这些条纹）。风羽（Wing）卡比（Kirby）的卓越速度使得该能力成为大多数游戏中快速冲关的明显选择。能力效果（Power Effect）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中也被赋予了能力效果（Power Effect）效果，能够将元素赋予盟友的武器。
wikirby-form:482.description_en: 风羽（Wing） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to fly quickly through the air, as well as perform several graceful 风羽（Wing） maneuvers, dive-bombs, and charge attacks, along with the somewhat less graceful Feather Gun attack, though this attack can be used to cut ropes and other such obstacles. Typically provided by 飞行鸟（Birdon）, this ability grants 卡比（Kirby） a bright yellow feather headdress and red stripes in place of his normal cheek marks (though the stripes have not been seen since Kirby Super Star Ultra). 风羽（Wing） 卡比（Kirby）'s superior speed makes this ability the obvious choice for rushing through stages quickly in most games it appears in. It also was given the 能力效果（Power Effect） effect in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, being able to impart allies' weapons with the element.

wikirby-form:462.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:462.description_zh:
溜溜球（Yo-Yo）（也称为溜溜球（Yo-Yo）和星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的Yoyo）是可以通过吸入机姆（Gim）获得的复制能力（Copy Ability）。它在《星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）》中首次亮相，同样，它也是其重制版《Kirby Super Star Ultra》的一部分。该能力允许卡比（Kirby）利用亮红色溜溜球（Yo-Yo）从安全距离攻击敌人，与光束（Beam）或鞭子（Whip）能力相当。溜溜球（Yo-Yo）还可以穿过墙壁和地板，这使得它对于激活开关或解决谜题很有用。

卡比（Kirby）也可以通过Copy Essences Deluxe获得溜溜球（Yo-Yo）能力。配备溜溜球（Yo-Yo）后，卡比（Kirby）可以将机姆（Gim）创建为Helper。在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中，卡比（Kirby）在获得此能力时配备了向后的球帽。从星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）开始，这套服装在卡比（Kirby）的右脸颊上还配有绷带。
wikirby-form:462.description_en:
溜溜球（Yo-Yo） (also called 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） and Yoyo in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）) is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that can be obtained by inhaling 机姆（Gim）. It debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and likewise, it was also a part of its remake Kirby Super Star Ultra. The ability allows 卡比（Kirby） to utilize a bright red 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） to smack around enemies from a safe distance, comparable to the 光束（Beam） or 鞭子（Whip） ability. The 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） can also pass through walls and floors, making it useful for activating switches or solving puzzles.

卡比（Kirby） can also obtain the 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） ability through Copy Essences Deluxe. With the 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） equipped, 卡比（Kirby） can create 机姆（Gim） as a Helper. In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, 卡比（Kirby） is outfitted with a backwards ball cap when he acquires this ability. As of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, this outfit also comes with a bandage on 卡比（Kirby）'s right cheek.
