wikirby-form:577.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-form:577.description_zh: 卡比（Kirby）的Starship用于星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版的Milky Way Wishes游戏中的银河·新星（Galactic Nova）阶段。最初被称为射击能力，它类似于一辆有翼的战车，正面和侧面都有一颗星星。它是由卡比（Kirby）访问过的每个行星的七颗恒星组合而成，允许卡比（Kirby）追赶银河·新星（Galactic Nova），因为它试图实现魔噜酷（Marx）控制波普之星（Popstar）的愿望。在卡比（Kirby）摧毁Galactic Nova Nucleus并逃离新星后，七颗恒星离开Starship，因为它变成了传送之星（Warp Star），降落在魔噜酷（Marx）战斗的行星上；这个细节在重制版中与魔噜酷（Marx）战斗之前添加的“前往战场”过场动画中更加明显。这样，Starship被视为类似于星星神杖（Star Rod）的Last Battle Ability。在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）Ultra中，Starship也用于与卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）战斗，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的飞艇守护者在Revenge of the King期间在迪迪迪山上空巡逻；这次，Starship是由之前阶段收集的三个Sparkling Star卡比（Kirby）召唤出来的。一旦卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）被击败，Starship在接近Castle Dedede时再次变成传送之星（Warp Star）。
wikirby-form:577.description_en: 卡比（Kirby）'s Starship is used in the 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） stage in the Milky Way Wishes game of 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. Originally known as the Shooting ability, it resembles a winged chariot with a star on its front and sides. It is formed by the combination of the seven stars from each planet 卡比（Kirby） has visited, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to chase down 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） as it tries to grant 魔噜酷（Marx）'s wish to control 波普之星（Popstar）. After 卡比（Kirby） destroys the Galactic Nova Nucleus and escapes from Nova, the seven stars leave the Starship as it turns into a 传送之星（Warp Star） that lands on a planet where 魔噜酷（Marx） is fought; this detail is made more apparent in the "To the Battlefield" cutscene added in the remake before fighting 魔噜酷（Marx）. In this manner, the Starship is considered a Last Battle Ability akin to the 星星神杖（Star Rod）. In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Ultra, the Starship is also used to fight 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s airship guardian patrolling the skies of Mt. Dedede during Revenge of the King; this time, the Starship is summoned by the three Sparkling Stars 卡比（Kirby） collected in previous stages. Once 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)） is defeated, the Starship turns into a 传送之星（Warp Star） once again as it approaches Castle Dedede.

wikirby-variant:1525:angered-scarfy.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-scarfy.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-scarfy.description_zh:
发怒的尖耳怪（Angered Scarfy）是尖耳怪（Scarfy）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）》。
“他们一开始看起来很友好，但等等...”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）网站上的尖耳怪（Scarfy）的描述
尖耳怪（Scarfy）是一种橙色的、漂浮的猫状生物，是卡比（Kirby）系列中最古老和最普遍的敌人之一。出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，并出现在此后的所有主系列游戏以及一些衍生作品中。他漂浮在空中，有着一张卡比（Kirby）般的天真面孔和灿烂的笑容。然而，如果卡比（Kirby）激怒了他，尖耳怪（Scarfy）就会变成一个可怕的独眼恶魔，张开下巴，长着锋利的獠牙，全身呈暗褐色，被称为愤怒的尖耳怪（Scarfy），并追捕他，直到尖耳怪（Scarfy）被击败、爆炸或返回。正常。

在整个系列中，尖耳怪（Scarfy）可以采取多种不同的行为模式，但他最常见的策略是原地盘旋，只有在试图吸入卡比（Kirby）或以其他方式攻击他时才追逐卡比（Kirby）。有些人可能只会在卡比（Kirby）或其他角色持有钥匙等随身物品（这些被称为猎人围巾）时才会变形，而其他人可能会在卡比（Kirby）经过他们时变得敌对。其他人仍然可能立即变得敌对。当尖耳怪（Scarfy）生气时，他通常会追赶卡比（Kirby）几分钟，然后减速并爆炸。这种爆炸性可能就是为什么当在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中使用Copy进行扫描时，尖耳怪（Scarfy）授予爆裂（Crash）复制能力（Copy Ability）的原因。否则，尖耳怪（Scarfy）无法提供能力，因为他无法被吸入。
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-scarfy.description_en:
Angered Scarfy is a distinct form or variant of Scarfy in Kirby Super Star.
“They look friendly at first, but just wait...”
— Description of 尖耳怪（Scarfy） from the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） website
尖耳怪（Scarfy） is an orange, floating catlike creature who is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest and most ubiquitous enemies in the series, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and being present in all of the main-series titles since then, as well as several spin-offs. He can be found floating in the air sporting an innocent-looking 卡比（Kirby）-like face and bright open smile. However, if 卡比（Kirby） angers him, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns into a hideous cycloptic demon with sharp fangs in a gaping jaw and a duller brown coloration, known as Angry 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, and chases him down until 尖耳怪（Scarfy） is defeated, explodes, or returns to normal.

Throughout the series, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） can take on a number of different behavior patterns, but his most common strategy is to hover in place, only chasing 卡比（Kirby） if he tries to inhale him or otherwise attacks him. Some may only transform when 卡比（Kirby） or another character is holding a carry item such as a key (these are called Hunter Scarfies), while others may turn hostile when 卡比（Kirby） passes by them. Others still may turn hostile immediately. When 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns angry, he will typically chase 卡比（Kirby） down for several moments before slowing down and detonating in an explosion. This explosive nature is likely the reason why 尖耳怪（Scarfy） grants the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when scanned using Copy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Otherwise, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） cannot provide an ability, because he cannot be inhaled.

wikirby-page:5203.display_name: 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:5203.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:5203.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:5203.description_zh:
“你是对的，卡比（Kirby）。我们现在不能放弃。我们已经走得太远了！”
— 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）、Kirby Battle Royale
头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee），有时称为Bandana Dee，在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）之前最初被简单地称为瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），是一个经常出现的副词和星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的主要配角。正如他的名字所暗示的，他是一个头上戴着蓝色头巾的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。他选择的武器通常是枪（Spear），但在某些游戏中，例如Kirby Battle Royale，他会使用Parasol。最初被显示为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）最忠诚的臣民，后来的游戏将他描绘成卡比（Kirby）最亲密的朋友，他有时甚至协助卡比（Kirby）与国王作战。Megaton Punch。他的第一个主要角色是在《Kirby Super Star Ultra》中，作为《Revenge of the King》的次要对手。此后，他作为《星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》的四名可玩主角之一出现，并出演了此后《星之卡比系列（Kirby series）》中几乎所有游戏。虽然有一些暗示可能表明这两个角色是同一角色，但这一点尚未得到证实。
wikirby-page:5203.description_en:
“You're right, 卡比（Kirby）. We can't give up now. We've come too far!”
— 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, Kirby Battle Royale
头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, sometimes called Bandana Dee and originally known as simply 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） prior to 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, is a recurring deuteragonist and major supporting character in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. As his name implies, he is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） wearing a blue bandana on his head. His weapon of choice is usually a 枪（Spear）, but in some games, such as Kirby Battle Royale, he wields a Parasol instead. Originally shown to be 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s most loyal subject, later games portray him as 卡比（Kirby）'s closest friend, and he sometimes even assists 卡比（Kirby） in battling the king.

头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） as the first opponent in Megaton Punch. His first major role was in Kirby Super Star Ultra, as the secondary antagonist of Revenge of the King. After this, he appeared as one of the four playable protagonists of 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and has starred in nearly every game in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） since.

Additionally, a similar 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） character appeared as a supporting character in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. While several hints have been made that might suggest the two are the same character, this has not been confirmed.

wikirby-page:4888.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:4888.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:4888.description_zh:
“听着，你们这些笨蛋！我希望你们都知道卡比（Kirby）！Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 4中的卡比（Kirby）！”
— Captain Vul，Kirby Super Star Ultra
Captain Vul是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重拍中的角色。他在《Revenge of Meta Knight》中作为次要对手出现。他驾驶着Halberd，并且是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的朋友，尽管他似乎认为，无论真假，他拥有飞行堡垒。他只出现在对话肖像和子游戏的介绍性过场动画中。
wikirby-page:4888.description_en:
“Listen, you lubbers! I want you all after that 卡比（Kirby）!”
— Captain Vul in Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 4, Kirby Super Star Ultra
Captain Vul is a character in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. He appears as the secondary antagonist in Revenge of Meta Knight. He pilots the Halberd and is a friend of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, though he seems to think, truly or not, that he owns the flying fortress. He is only seen in dialogue portraits, and the sub-game's introductory cutscene.

wikirby-page:31003.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:31003.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:31003.description_zh:
Dyna Chicks是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的次要角色。他们出现在巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）故事模式的结尾，据透露，他们的母亲偷了Dream Land的庄稼，试图找到食物来喂养他们。击败她后，卡比（Kirby）独自抚养小鸡，并在它们与母亲一起飞向地平线时向它们挥手告别。

A单曲Dyna Chick也作为星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的既定角色出现。在那里，它被巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）严密守护，并显着地出现在The Empty Nest Mess.
wikirby-page:31003.description_en:
The Dyna Chicks are minor characters seen in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. They show up at the end of the 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） story mode, where it's revealed that their mother stole Dream Land's crops trying to find food to feed them. After defeating her, 卡比（Kirby） raises the chicks on his own and waves goodbye to them as they fly off into the horizon with their mother.

A single Dyna Chick also appears as an established character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. There, it is guarded fiercely by 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）, and prominently appears in The Empty Nest Mess.

wikirby-page:1622.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1622.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1622.description_zh:
“准备好。->我会满足你一个愿望... ->Milky Way Wishes中的”
— 银河·新星（Galactic Nova），Kirby Super Star Ultra
银河·新星（Galactic Nova）（通常称为Nova；也称为Nova，银河彗星）是首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）。它是一颗星际卫星，也是据说能够实现愿望的远古遗物。尽管没有恶意，银河·新星（Galactic Nova）通常以敌对势力的形象出现，不顾后果地竭尽全力实现每个愿望。在Milky Way Wishes中首次出现时，卡比（Kirby）被魔噜酷（Marx）欺骗召唤新星，新星窃取了他的愿望，转而要求接管行星波普之星（Popstar），并要求卡比（Kirby）摧毁它以阻止其行星运行

银河·新星（Galactic Nova）在Kirby Super Star Ultra的Meta Knightmare Ultra中回归，在那里它被重新组装并实现了魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）与银河系最伟大战士战斗的愿望。Nova也在《卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）》中作为Road Trip模式的主要对手出现，在接受佐拉（Zorah）自由漫游的愿望后，它将无机生命体转变为名为巨灵（Gigantes）的巨型毁灭机器。
wikirby-page:1622.description_en:
“READY. -> I WILL GRANT YOU ONE WISH... ->”
— 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） in Milky Way Wishes, Kirby Super Star Ultra
银河·新星（Galactic Nova） (commonly referred to as Nova; also called Nova, the Galactic Comet) is a character that first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. It is an interstellar satellite and an ancient relic said to be capable of granting wishes. Despite not possessing malicious intent, 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） usually appears as an antagonistic force, doing everything in its power to grant each wish no matter the consequences. In its first appearance in Milky Way Wishes, 卡比（Kirby） is tricked by 魔噜酷（Marx） into summoning Nova, who steals his wish to instead ask to take over Planet 波普之星（Popstar）, tasking 卡比（Kirby） with destroying it to stop its planetary domination.

银河·新星（Galactic Nova） returns in Kirby Super Star Ultras Meta Knightmare Ultra, where it is reassembled and grants 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s wish of fighting the greatest warrior in the galaxy. Nova also appears as the primary antagonist of the Road Trip mode in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, where, after receiving 佐拉（Zorah）'s wish to roam around freely, it transforms the inorganic lifeform into a giant machine of destruction known as 巨灵（Gigantes）.

wikirby-page:1620.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1620.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1620.description_zh:
“我做到了！一切都按计划进行！我得到了太阳和月亮来战斗。我让你进入太空……这一切都是按照我完美的小计划进行的！现在我可以随心所欲地制造恶作剧了！哈哈！稍后见！Milky Way Wishes中的”
— 魔噜酷（Marx），Kirby Super Star Ultra
魔噜酷（Marx）是来自波普之星（Popstar）的顽皮、小、圆形、小丑般的生物，是波普之星（Popstar）的最终Boss和主要对手Milky Way Wishes来自星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra。在这个角色中，他假装是卡比（Kirby）的盟友，并指示他召唤银河·新星（Galactic Nova）来阻止太阳和月亮的战斗，但随后在适当的时机窃取了卡比（Kirby）的愿望，要求完全控制波普之星（Planet Popstar）。魔噜酷（Marx）揭露了他的真实意图，他打算接管世界，以便他可以制造他想要的所有恶作剧，但卡比（Kirby）使用Starship追捕他；他击败了自己和银河·新星（Galactic Nova），并让魔噜酷（Marx）冲进发条星爆开的船体，将其炸成碎片。在The True Arena中，魔噜酷（Marx）随后通过吸收被摧毁的新星碎片转世为魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul），迫使卡比（Kirby）再次与他战斗。这场战斗是否正式发生在银河愿望的同一连续性中尚未确定。
wikirby-page:1620.description_en:
“I did it! It all went according to plan! I got the sun and moon to fight. I got you to go into space... it was all according to my perfect little plan! Now I can cause all the mischief I want! Haha! See you later!”
— 魔噜酷（Marx） in Milky Way Wishes, Kirby Super Star Ultra
魔噜酷（Marx） is a mischievous, small, round, jester-like creature from 波普之星（Popstar） who serves as the final boss and main antagonist of Milky Way Wishes from 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. In this role, he feigns to be 卡比（Kirby）'s ally and instructs him to summon 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） to stop the Sun and Moon from fighting, but then steals 卡比（Kirby）'s wish at just the right moment to demand total control over 波普之星（Planet Popstar）. Revealing his true intentions, 魔噜酷（Marx） intends to take over the world so that he can cause all the mischief he wants, but 卡比（Kirby） uses the Starship to chase him down; he defeats both him and 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）, sending 魔噜酷（Marx） careening into the clockwork star's burst-open hull to blow it to smithereens. In The True Arena, 魔噜酷（Marx） is subsequently reincarnated into 魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul） by absorbing pieces of the destroyed Nova, forcing 卡比（Kirby） to battle him again. Whether or not this battle officially happens in the same continuity of Milky Way Wishes is not confirmed.

wikirby-page:10994.display_name: 船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:10994.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:10994.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:10994.description_zh:
“哦不！哦不！我们该怎么办？！Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 1中的”
— 船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee），Kirby Super Star Ultra
船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee）是一个次要角色，首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）（以及后来的重制版）中Revenge of Meta Knight。他们是戴着水手帽的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee）从不直接与卡比（Kirby）互动，通常仅通过他们在Revenge of Meta Knight中的对话出现，或者在他们其他外观的背景中出现。
wikirby-page:10994.description_en:
“Oh no! Oh no! What do we do?!”
— 船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee） in Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 1, Kirby Super Star Ultra
船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee） is a minor character who first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） (and later in its remake) in Revenge of Meta Knight. They are a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who wear a sailor's cap. 船员瓦豆鲁迪（Sailor Waddle Dee） never directly interacts with 卡比（Kirby）, and is usually only present through their dialogue in Revenge of Meta Knight, or in the background in their other appearances.

wikirby-page:2474.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2474.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2474.description_zh:
“...我将走上大师之路。”在夜色的掩护下，隐藏在村庄里，这位精英忍者踏上了学习忍者之道的旅程。他带着紫色闪电之刃，疾驰穿过大地！”
— Guest Star Bio Spark Savage Silence暂停画面描述星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
暗忍（Bio Spark）（也拼写为Biospark）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的常见敌人，首先出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中，暗忍（Bio Spark）是一个忍者般的人物，他穿着斗篷，头盔上有羽毛。可以看到他戴着手套的手和被覆盖的脚，他唯一看到的实际身体部位是发光的眼睛，而且他根本没有手臂，类似于弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）和暗忍（Bio Spark）通常穿着黑色或紫色，但也可以看到穿着绿色。

暗忍（Bio Spark）可以做很多通常归因于的事情。对忍者来说，包括当卡比（Kirby）很远时投掷苦无刀，当卡比（Kirby）太近时用刀片快速切割，隐藏在阴影中，抓住敌人，跳起来，然后将他们扔到地上（称为Air Drop).

暗忍（Bio Spark）被卡比（Kirby）.
wikirby-page:2474.description_en:
“...I will walk the path of mastery." Under cover of the night, hidden in villages, this elite ninja takes a journey to learn the ninja's way. With his blade of violet lightning, he speeds through the land!”
— Guest Star Bio Spark Savage Silence Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
暗忍（Bio Spark） (also spelled Biospark) is a common enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, first appearing in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. 暗忍（Bio Spark） is a ninja-like figure, who wears a cloak with a plume on the helmet. Although glimpses of his gloved hands and covered feet are shown, his only actual body parts seen are his glowing eyes, and he has no arms at all, similar to 剑骑士（Blade Knight） and 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）. 暗忍（Bio Spark） usually wears black or purple, but is also seen wearing green.

暗忍（Bio Spark） can do many things usually attributed to a ninja, including throwing kunai knives when 卡比（Kirby） is far away, slicing rapidly with a blade when 卡比（Kirby） gets too close, hiding in the shadows, grabbing his foe, jumping up, and flinging them to the ground (known as Air Drop).

暗忍（Bio Spark） provides the 忍者（Ninja） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:3539.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3539.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3539.description_zh:
“飞向新的地平线！”他讨厌每天被困在鸟笼里，决定看看自己能飞多高！就这么简单，他就去寻找自由。飞得又高又快！”
— Guest Star Birdon Freedom in the Sky暂停星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
飞行鸟（Birdon）中的屏幕描述是一个正在飞翔的人在一些卡比（Kirby）游戏中发现的鸟敌人。他是一只戴着飞行员帽、头上戴着护目镜的鸟。虽然他有多种颜色，但最常见的是他的身体是洋红色的，翅膀上有绿色和黄色的条纹，有一簇橙色的头发，脚是橙色的。他的名字是亮黄色的。“鸟”。

飞行鸟（Birdon）飞来飞去，向卡比（Kirby）射击羽毛，偶尔会尝试撞击他。在他的助手形态下，他拥有风羽（Wing）卡比（Kirby）的所有能力。Copy能力，他获得风羽（Wing）能力很少见到飞行鸟（Birdon）从地面攻击。
wikirby-page:3539.description_en:
“Flapping to new horizons!" He hates spending every day stuck in a bird cage and decides to see how high he can fly! And just that easily, he's off to find freedom. Fly high and fast!”
— Guest Star Birdon Freedom in the Sky Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
飞行鸟（Birdon） is a flying bird enemy found in a handful of 卡比（Kirby） games. He is a multicolored bird with an aviator's cap and goggles on his head. While he can come in many colors, he is most often seen with a magenta body, green and yellow fringes on the wings, and an orange tuft of hair with orange feet. His eyes are very large and round, and his beak is bright yellow. His name is a derivation of "bird".

飞行鸟（Birdon） flies around, shooting feathers at 卡比（Kirby） and occasionally trying to ram him. In his helper form, he has all the abilities of 风羽（Wing） 卡比（Kirby）. When 卡比（Kirby） swallows him or scans him with the Copy ability, he receives the 风羽（Wing） ability. It is very rare to see a 飞行鸟（Birdon） attacking from the ground.

wikirby-page:61372.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:61372.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:61372.description_zh: Bolum是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的类似机器人炸弹的敌人。原本是只出现在Galactic Nova Nucleus战斗前阶段的敌人，后来在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中作为游戏秘密最终boss可以召唤的敌人回归，现在提供炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:61372.description_en: Bolum is a robotic bomb-like enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. Originally an enemy only appearing in the stage before the Galactic Nova Nucleus battle, it later returned in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） as an enemy that can be summoned by the game's secret final boss, now providing the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:1557.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1557.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1557.description_zh: 燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo），首次登场时名为Burnin' Leo，是卡比（Kirby）系列中的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中。如果吞下，他将赋予卡比（Kirby）烈火（Fire）能力。
wikirby-page:1557.description_en: 燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo）, named Burnin' Leo in his debut appearance, is an enemy in the 卡比（Kirby） series, who first appears in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. He grants 卡比（Kirby） the 烈火（Fire） ability if swallowed.

wikirby-page:13883.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:13883.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:13883.description_zh: Capillers，也称为毛毛虫、蠕虫或虫子，是一些卡比（Kirby）游戏中出现的罕见危险。它们是一种像蠕虫一样的小生物，身上有黄色和棕色的条纹，一端有两只巨大的珠状眼睛。如果卡比（Kirby）尝试吸入它们，他会受到伤害，因此必须避开它们或用攻击击中它们。
wikirby-page:13883.description_en: Capillers, otherwise known as Caterpillars, Worms, or Bugs, are an uncommon hazard that appear in some 卡比（Kirby） titles. They are small worm-like creatures with yellow and brown stripes on their bodies and two giant beady eyes on one end. If 卡比（Kirby） attempts to inhale them, he will take damage, so they must be avoided or hit with an attack instead.

wikirby-page:2703.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2703.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2703.description_zh:
KSS Capsule J Sprite.png Capsule J是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的敌人，吸入后会给卡比（Kirby）赋予喷射机（Jet）能力。它也是前面提到的复制能力（Copy Ability）的帮手。

Capsule J的体格与瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）相似，只不过身体是蓝色的，手上戴着白色的大手套，还有一只圆形的、绿屏般的眼睛。此外，Capsule J的背部还配备了一个巨大的火箭包，可以用来在空中短距离悬停。Capsule J本身并没有太大的攻击性，很多时候甚至没有看到它在飞行，而是更喜欢在地面上行走。作为敌人，它通常呈黄色而不是蓝色。

作为帮助者，Capsule J可以使用喷射机（Jet）卡比（Kirby）拥有的所有能力。

在Kirby Super Star Ultra中，Capsule J被替换由Capsule J2设计，其行为基本相同，但采用了更新的设计。鉴于此替换，Capsule J是这两款游戏中唯一无法在Helper to Hero中玩的常规助手。
wikirby-page:2703.description_en:
KSS Capsule J Sprite.png Capsule J is an enemy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, which when inhaled gives 卡比（Kirby） the 喷射机（Jet） ability. It is also the helper for the aforementioned 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Capsule J bears a physique similar to a 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, except with a blue body, large white gloves for hands, and a round, green screen-like eye. In addition, Capsule J sports a huge rocket pack on its back, which it can use to hover short distances through the air. Capsule J itself is not hugely aggressive, and often times is not even seen flying, instead preferring to walk along the ground. As an enemy, it typically bears a yellow color instead of blue.

As a helper, Capsule J can use all of the abilities that 喷射机（Jet） 卡比（Kirby） possesses.

In Kirby Super Star Ultra, Capsule J is replaced by Capsule J2, who acts mostly the same, but sports an updated design. Given this replacement, Capsule J is the only regular helper from either game which is not playable in Helper to Hero.

wikirby-page:61371.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:61371.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:61371.description_zh: Dakuga是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的类似鱼雷的敌人。原本是只出现在Galactic Nova Nucleus战斗前阶段的敌人，后来在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中作为游戏秘密最终boss可以召唤的敌人回归，现在提供Poison复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:61371.description_en: Dakuga is a torpedo-like enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. Originally an enemy only appearing in the stage before the Galactic Nova Nucleus battle, it later returned in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） as an enemy that can be summoned by the game's secret final boss, now providing the Poison 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:40350.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:40350.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:40350.description_zh: 鳄鱼是绿色的鳄鱼状敌人，首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中。它们有着表情丰富的大脸，长着四颗锋利的牙齿，背上有黄色的褶边，但没有任何四肢，迫使它们通过跳跃来移动。吞咽时它们不提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:40350.description_en: Gators are green, alligator-like enemies that first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. They have large expressive faces with four sharp teeth and a yellow frill on their backs, but do not have any limbs, forcing them to move by hopping around instead. They do not provide a 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

wikirby-page:3162.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3162.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3162.description_zh:
“终于轮到我了！”随着机械化入侵的消息传来，机姆（Gim）踏上了旅程！机器人看到了什么？他为什么要使用他的恶作剧噱头？谁知道呢？”
— Guest Star Gim Up-and-Down Dynamo暂停屏幕描述星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
机姆（Gim）是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的敌人。他是一个机器人球体，有红色脚，戴着蓝色棒球帽，背上有排气管，一个绿色镜片作为眼睛，还有一个孔，另一只眼睛似乎会从这个孔中伸出，并用手挥动一个红色溜溜球。作为武器。
wikirby-page:3162.description_en:
“Finally, it's my turn!" With word of a mechanized invasion in the the works, 机姆（Gim） sets out on a journey! What does the robot see? Why does he use his mischievous gimmick? Who knows?”
— Guest Star Gim Up-and-Down Dynamo Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
机姆（Gim） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. He is a robotic sphere with red feet, a blue baseball cap, exhaust pipes on his back, one green lens that serves as an eye, and a hole where the other eye would seem to go. He extends a hand from this hole, and uses the hand to swing a red yo-yo as a weapon.

wikirby-page:2299.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2299.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2299.description_zh:
Jungle Bomb是出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra中的相对罕见的敌人。它像一个有生命的菠萝，有两个椭圆形、黑色的眼睛和深蓝色的脚，通常头上戴着深绿色的头盔，叶子渗透并从顶部伸出。

与星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的许多其他敌人的情况一样，个别Jungle Bomb标本的行为可能有所不同。根据其行为，Jungle Bomb的攻击方式要么是在地面上放置炸弹，然后匆忙离开，直到被障碍物阻挡，上下跳跃并定期向卡比（Kirby）吐出炸弹，要么同时发射三颗炸弹。无论其行为如何，吸入并吞咽Jungle Bomb都会奖励卡比（Kirby）和炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:2299.description_en:
Jungle Bomb is a comparably rare enemy that appears in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. It resembles an animate pineapple with two oval, black eyes and dark blue feet that usually wears a dark green helmet on its head, which its leaves permeate and stick out of at the top.

As is the case with many other enemies in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, individual Jungle Bomb specimens may behave differently. Depending on its behavior, a Jungle Bomb attacks either by placing a bomb on the ground and scurrying away until blocked by an obstacle, hopping up and down and periodically spitting a bomb at 卡比（Kirby） or by discharging a triad of bombs simultaneously. Regardless of its demeanor, inhaling and swallowing a Jungle Bomb awards 卡比（Kirby） with the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:2354.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2354.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2354.description_zh:
“嘿嘿，战士！去给他们一个指关节三明治吧！”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）关于格斗家（Fighter）的复制能力（Copy Ability）在Kirby Battle Royale
格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）中是一个反复出现的角色星之卡比系列（Kirby series）。他看起来是一个人形人物，有着尖尖的金发，一张与卡比（Kirby）非常相似的脸，头上缠着头巾，还有一对尖尖的耳朵。格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中，作为共同敌人，吸入时给予格斗家（Fighter）复制能力（Copy Ability）；他也在大多数其他游戏中扮演这个角色。尽管如此，格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）仍然是一个相当著名的角色，在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中作为助手、在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中作为朋友、在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中作为骑手出现。此外，格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中扮演重复角色，并在Super Smash Bros. Brawl和后续Super Smash Bros.游戏中作为助攻奖杯出现。
wikirby-page:2354.description_en:
“Heya, fighter! Go give 'em a knuckle sandwich for me!”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） about the 格斗家（Fighter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） in Kirby Battle Royale
格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） is a recurring character in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He appears as a humanoid figure with spiky blonde hair, a face closely resembling 卡比（Kirby）'s, a bandana around his head, and a pair of pointy ears. 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） as a common enemy who grants the 格斗家（Fighter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled; he also fulfills this role in most other games. Despite this, 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） is a fairly notable character, making playable appearances as a helper in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra, a friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, and a rider in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. Additionally, 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） plays a recurring character role in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, and appears as an assist trophy in Super Smash Bros. Brawl and subsequent Super Smash Bros. titles.

wikirby-page:2263.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2263.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2263.description_zh: Lovely是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的敌人和花种，此后在超级Famicom版本的Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom)和Kirby Super Star Ultra中重新出现。如果卡比（Kirby）接近Lovely，她会将花瓣包围在他周围，类似于捕蝇器吞噬昆虫的方式。
wikirby-page:2263.description_en: Lovely is an enemy and species of flower who debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, and has since reappeared in the Super Famicom version of Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom) and Kirby Super Star Ultra. If 卡比（Kirby） approaches Lovely, she will enclose her petals around him, similar to the way a venus fly trap engulfs insects.

wikirby-page:3494.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3494.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3494.description_zh:
Magical Sweeper是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中的敌人。Magical Sweeper是一个发光的分段圆盘，带有金属面板，其中心有一个符号。它由从中心向外切割的八块面板组成，并绕其圆周再次拼接。它不断地闪烁着彩虹的多种颜色。它也可以被描述为一个轮子般的敌人，它的身体不断变化着明亮的彩虹色，不断散发出发光的彩色光环，白色的中心有黄色的衬里，上面有日文文字。

Magical Sweeper只出现在Sub-Tree和Revenge of Meta Knight的第7章中，非常罕见。它沿着地面移动，偶尔停下来打开并发射球形彩色子弹。它可以发射一颗大子弹，三颗中型子弹，或者大约二十颗小子弹，机枪式的。另一种攻击是将卡比（Kirby）或其助手悬停在其上方几秒钟，然后飞走。Magical Sweeper没有能力，它在空中盘旋，不遵循常规飞行模式。
wikirby-page:3494.description_en:
Magical Sweeper is an enemy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Magical Sweeper is a glowing, segmented disk with a metal panel with a symbol positioned in its center. It is composed of eight panels cut from the center outward and is spliced again around its circumference. It constantly flashes many colors of the rainbow. It can also be described as a wheel-like enemy whose body constantly changes bright, rainbow colors and constantly gives off a glowing colored aura, and its white center has yellow linings and Japanese writing on it.

Magical Sweeper only appears in Sub-Tree and in chapter 7 of Revenge of Meta Knight, making it very rare. It moves along the ground and occasionally stops to open up and shoot spherical colored bullets. It can shoot one big bullet, three medium-sized ones, or about twenty small ones, machine gun style. Another attack is to target 卡比（Kirby） or his helper by hovering over them for a few seconds before flying away. Magical Sweeper gives no ability, and it hovers through the air and does not obey a conventional flight pattern.

wikirby-page:2932.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2932.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2932.description_zh: Moto Shotzo是出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版中的敌人。它拥有一个球形身体，上半部分为白色，上面装有一门大炮，而橙色下半部分则固定有四个深色圆形球体作为支撑。
wikirby-page:2932.description_en: Moto Shotzo is an enemy appearing in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. It possesses a spherical body with a white upper half that has a cannon attached to it, while four dark, round spheres are affixed to its orange bottom half for support.

wikirby-page:61370.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:61370.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:61370.description_zh: Pata是在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相的敌人。最初是只出现在Galactic Nova Nucleus战斗之前的舞台上的敌人，后来在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中作为可以被游戏秘密最终boss召唤的敌人回归，现在提供电火花（Spark）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它隐约像一个巨大的双面斧头，带有青色发光的刀片。
wikirby-page:61370.description_en: Pata is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. Originally an enemy only appearing in the stage before the Galactic Nova Nucleus battle, it later returned in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） as an enemy that can be summoned by the game's secret final boss, now providing the 电火花（Spark） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. It vaguely resembles a large, double-sided axe head, with cyan glowing blades.

wikirby-page:3334.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3334.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3334.description_zh: 電離子團（Plasma Wisp）（在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中也称为電離子團（Plasma Wisp））是来自星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的浮动光谱敌人。它本质上是一个燃烧的等离子球，有一双圆圆的眼睛和两只漂浮的、戴着手套的手。它的色调通常是绿色的，除了在《星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）》及其重制版中作为敌人时，它是蓝色的。電離子團（Plasma Wisp）的主要攻击策略是悬停在距离卡比（Kirby）一定距离处并向他发射电波。电离子（Plasma）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:3334.description_en: 電離子團（Plasma Wisp） (also called 電離子團（Plasma Wisp） in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）) is a floating spectral enemy from the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. It is essentially a ball of flaming plasma with a pair of beady eyes and two floating, gloved hands. It is usually green in hue, except as an enemy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, where it is blue instead. 電離子團（Plasma Wisp）'s main attack strategy is to hover at a distance from 卡比（Kirby） and fire electric blasts at him. It can be inhaled and swallowed for the 电离子（Plasma） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:3374.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3374.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3374.description_zh:
Simirror是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中相对不起眼​​的敌人。Simirror就像一个小巫师，戴着厚厚的帽子和长袍完全遮住了它的身体。它通过向卡比（Kirby）投掷类似镜子的射弹进行攻击，并且还可以创建自身的镜像。当被击中但未被击败时，它会逐渐消失，并重新出现在其他地方，就像石像怪（Kabu）有时所做的那样。它在吞咽时赋予卡比（Kirby）镜子（Mirror）能力。

Simirror的名字是“相似”和“镜子”这两个词的双关语，指的是镜子如何产生反射。
wikirby-page:3374.description_en:
Simirror is a relatively obscure enemy from the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. Simirror resembles a small wizard with thick hat and robes completely obscuring its body. It attacks by throwing mirror-like projectiles at 卡比（Kirby）, and can also create mirror images of itself. When hit, but not defeated, it will phase out of sight, and reappear somewhere else, much like 石像怪（Kabu） sometimes does. It grants 卡比（Kirby） the 镜子（Mirror） ability when swallowed.

Simirror's name is a pun on the words "similar" and "mirror," referencing how mirrors create reflections.

wikirby-page:23729.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:23729.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:23729.description_zh:
Swinging Waddle Doo是一种不常见的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中。与Swinging Waddle Dee非常相似，Swinging Waddle Doo在绳子上来回摆动，绳子可以平行或垂直于卡比（Kirby）的作用平面移动。

Swinging Waddle Doo在摆动时的行为与Swinging Waddle Dee完全相同，因为它在开启时无法发射光束绳子。使用合适的能力将其砍倒会导致其掉落并恢复为标准瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），随后它将再次开始使用其光束。否则，可以通过直接攻击Swinging Waddle Doo来击败它，或者吞噬它以获得光束（Beam）能力。
wikirby-page:23729.description_en:
Swinging Waddle Doo is an uncommon enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. Much like Swinging Waddle Dee, Swinging Waddle Doo swings back and forth on a rope, which can either be moving parallel or perpendicular to 卡比（Kirby）'s plane of action.

Swinging Waddle Doo behaves exactly like Swinging Waddle Dee while it is swinging, as it cannot fire its beam while on the rope. Cutting it down using a suitable ability will cause it to fall and return to being a standard 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, whereupon it will start using its beam again. Otherwise, Swinging Waddle Doo can be defeated by attacking it directly, or swallowing it to obtain the 光束（Beam） ability.

wikirby-page:1778.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1778.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1778.description_zh: 喵客（Tac）（也称为T.A.C.）是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版中的敌人。当吸入时，他可以用“Copy”复制能力（Copy Ability）赋予卡比（Kirby）力量。喵客（Tac）的外观由深蓝色长袍搭配绿色袋子组成，带有风状线条，可窃取Helper或复制能力（Copy Ability）。他有猫耳和可见的眼睛，但不知道他脸的其他部分是什么样子。在《英雄帮手》中，喵客（Tac）的皮肤呈中褐色，穿着白色衣服，背着红色包。在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版中，喵客（Tac）可以通过丢弃复制能力（Copy Ability）用作Helper，并且也可以在Helper to Hero中玩。
wikirby-page:1778.description_en: 喵客（Tac） (also referred to as T.A.C.) is an enemy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. He can empower 卡比（Kirby） with the "Copy" 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled. 喵客（Tac）'s appearance consists of a dark blue robe with a green bag with wind-like lines to steal Helpers or 复制能力（Copy Ability）. He has cat ears and visible eyes, but it is unknown what the rest of his face looks like. In Helper to Hero, 喵客（Tac） appears to have a middle tan, white clothing, and a red bag. In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, 喵客（Tac） can be used as a Helper by discarding the 复制能力（Copy Ability） and is also playable in Helper to Hero.

wikirby-page:4175.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:4175.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:4175.description_zh: 大声公（Walky）是一个拟人化的麦克风敌人，经常出现在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中，首次出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中。他就像一个有知觉的老式舞台麦克风，有红色的脚和一张嘴，他的两侧各有一个黄色铰链，将深蓝色的头部与黄色或棕褐色的嘴连接起来。大声公（Walky）通常被发现四处走动或坐在原地；当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，他会通过唱歌进行攻击，并发射有害的音符弹丸。在他的所有出场中，如果卡比（Kirby）吸入并吞下大声公（Walky），他将授予他麦克风（Mike）复制能力（Copy Ability）。也许部分由于他提供了有限使用能力，大声公（Walky）从未作为Helper角色出现。
wikirby-page:4175.description_en: 大声公（Walky） is an anthropomorphic microphone enemy which makes regular appearances in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, first appearing in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. He resembles a sentient old stage microphone with red feet and a mouth, and his sides each have a yellow hinge that connect the dark blue head with the yellow or tan mouth. 大声公（Walky） is typically found walking around or sitting in place; when 卡比（Kirby） draws near, he attacks by singing, shooting out harmful musical note projectiles. In all of his appearances, if 卡比（Kirby） inhales and swallows a 大声公（Walky）, he will grant him the 麦克风（Mike） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Perhaps due in part to him providing a limited-use ability, 大声公（Walky） has never appeared as a Helper character.

wikirby-page:1771.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1771.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1771.description_zh:
“至尊盛宴？哎呀！我会做饭！”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）在他的Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!暂停屏幕描述星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki），最初被称为料理（Cook）川崎，是一个通常被视为中boss的角色在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中。他通常可以被描述为一个巨大的橙色蛋形生物，红脚，一张隐约像猫的脸，戴着厨师帽和围裙。在游戏中，他通过向卡比（Kirby）扔盘子和餐具来攻击他，或者可能尝试用伸出的汤勺接住他，然后在煎锅中煮他。击败并吸入他会授予卡比（Kirby）料理（Cook）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中首次亮相，此后多次出场和客串。他在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中首次以朋友的身份出现，能够使用料理（Cook）卡比（Kirby）不能使用的许多攻击，并且他还在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中作为可玩的骑手出现。除了卡比（Kirby）游戏之外，厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）在Super Smash Bros. Ultimate中以Assist Trophy的身份出现，并在动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:1771.description_en:
“Extreme feast? Eep! I'll get cooking!”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） in his Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go! pause screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）, originally known as 料理（Cook） Kawasaki, is a character usually seen as a mid-boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He can generally be described as a large orange egg-shaped creature with red feet, a vaguely cat-like face, and a chef's hat and apron. In the games, he attacks 卡比（Kirby） by throwing plates and cutlery at him, or may try to catch him with an extending soup ladle to cook him up in his frying pan. Defeating and inhaling him grants 卡比（Kirby） the 料理（Cook） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） made his debut in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and has made numerous appearances and cameos since. He made his first playable appearance as a friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, able to use many attacks that 料理（Cook） 卡比（Kirby） cannot, and he also appears as a playable Rider in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. Outside of the 卡比（Kirby） games, 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） has appeared as an Assist Trophy in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, and plays a prominent role in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）

wikirby-page:1886.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1886.description_zh: Iron Mam（原名Iron妈妈）是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版中的装甲中头目。她通过出拳并撞向卡比（Kirby）进行战斗。吸入后，卡比（Kirby）获得格斗家（Fighter）能力。
wikirby-page:1886.description_en: Iron Mam (originally known as Iron Mom) is an armored mid-boss in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. She fights by winding up punches and ramming into 卡比（Kirby）. When inhaled, 卡比（Kirby） gains the 格斗家（Fighter） ability.

wikirby-page:4156.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:4156.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:4156.description_zh: 左Jukid是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版中的一个中型Boss。它通过挥拳、抓住并投掷卡比（Kirby）、魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）或助手，以及向它们射出光束来攻击，尽管它赋予卡比（Kirby）摔角手（Suplex）能力。Jukid通常是一个身着武术家装束的粉色团块。它有金色头发、大脚和漂浮的手。
wikirby-page:4156.description_en: left Jukid is a mid-boss in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake. It attacks by throwing punches, grabbing and throwing 卡比（Kirby）, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, or a helper; and shooting beams at them, even though it gives 卡比（Kirby） the 摔角手（Suplex） ability. Jukid is a (normally) pink blob in a martial artists' outfit. It has blonde hair, large feet, and disembodied hands.

wikirby-page:1877.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1877.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1877.description_zh:
Chameleo Arm（星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的加梅莱奥手臂）是出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra中的Boss。它看起来像一只变色龙，有手臂（用来粘在墙上）、底部有爪子、背部有肿块和头发。它的移动方式主要是在地面上滚动、跳跃到空中、紧贴墙壁。它有一条粉红色的长舌头，而它的身体没有固定的颜色，每次挑战Boss时都会有不同的颜色。其官方图稿显示绿色为默认颜色。它在消失和重新出现后，或者在使用Paint能力攻击后也会改变颜色。

老板的策略是伪装自己的能力，吐出彩虹球（吸入和吞咽时赋予Paint能力），尝试吃掉卡比（Kirby），并用爪子攻击。在隐形状态下，攻击Chameleo Arm的身体可能会很困难，尤其是当Boss四处移动时。

一旦其生命值耗尽，Chameleo Arm就会被击出竞技场，从屏幕上掉下来，就像卡比（Kirby）在击败。

Chameleo Arm运动多种配色方案。在原版游戏中，Chameleo Arm以六种颜色出现：红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、粉。在重制版中，它有了新的紫色，并且还拥有另外一组仅出现在《Milky Way Wishes》和《英雄帮手》中的七种颜色：栗色、鲑鱼色、金色、橄榄色、青色、黑色和白色。Chameleo Arm的替代颜色版本也比标准版本有更多的生命值，就像其他几个Boss一样。
wikirby-page:1877.description_en:
Chameleo Arm (Ghameleo Arm in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）) is a boss that appears in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. It looks like a chameleon with arms (which it uses for clinging to walls), claws on the bottom, lumps on its back, and hair. It mainly moves by rolling on the ground, leaping into the air, and clinging to walls. It has a long pink tongue, whereas its body has no set color, possessing a different one each time the boss is challenged. Its official artwork shows green as the default color. It also changes color after disappearing and reappearing, or after being attacked using the Paint ability.

The boss's strategy is its power to camouflage itself, spit rainbow balls (which grant the Paint ability when inhaled and swallowed), attempt to eat 卡比（Kirby）, and attack with its claws. In its invisible state, striking Chameleo Arm's body can be tough, especially when the boss is moving around.

Once its health is depleted, Chameleo Arm is knocked out of the arena, falling off-screen much like 卡比（Kirby） does when defeated.

Chameleo Arm sports multiple color schemes. In the original game, Chameleo Arm appears in six colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and pink. In the remake, it has a new purple color, and it also has another set of seven colors which exclusively appear in Milky Way Wishes and Helper to Hero: maroon, salmon, gold, olive, cyan, black, and white. The alternate color version of Chameleo Arm also has more health than the standard version, much like with several other bosses.

wikirby-page:3947.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3947.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3947.description_zh: Combo Cannon（在Kirby Super Star Ultra中称为2号主炮，在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中也称为双联炮）是战列舰Halberd的主炮，位于舰艇的主甲板上。它由三个不同的部分组成；一个类似于黑大炮（Shotzo）的大型旋转炮塔，可以发射齐射，一个较低的炮塔可以发射强大的激光，还有一个机械臂，可以抓住入侵者并向他们投掷炸弹。在某些外观中，存在第二个机械臂，它操作使顶部转塔旋转的曲柄。在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的大部分出场中，这门大炮都是作为Boss或中Boss进行战斗，但它也有其他用途。
wikirby-page:3947.description_en: The Combo Cannon (known as Main Cannon #2 in Kirby Super Star Ultra and also referred to as the twin cannon in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）) is the main cannon of the Battleship Halberd, located on the ship's main deck. It consists of three distinct pieces; a large rotating turret which fires volleys similar to a 黑大炮（Shotzo）'s, a lower turret which shoots a powerful laser, and a robotic arm which can grab intruders and drop bombs on them. In some appearances, a second robotic arm is present which operates a crank that rotates the top turret. In most of its appearances in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, this cannon is fought as a boss or mid-boss, but it has seen other uses as well.

wikirby-page:1881.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1881.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1881.description_zh:
“你获得了___经验值！(虽然这无所谓。)”
— 在击败Computer Virus于星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）超级模式后显示的游戏内消息
Computer Virus是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra的一个Boss。它的Boss战斗很像一个活生生的角色扮演游戏。它的策略类似于回合制RPG战斗，除了当轮到卡比（Kirby）攻击时，显示的敌人会从屏幕上跳出来。在敌人的攻击回合，卡比（Kirby）根本无法伤害Boss。Computer Virus会向卡比（Kirby）投掷三个不同的对手，必须按顺序击败这三名对手才能赢得战斗，而这三名对手会根据游戏模式的不同而有所变化。

战斗中播放的音乐与Computer Virus是普通Boss音乐的8位混音版本，应用了噪声滤波器。
wikirby-page:1881.description_en:
“You gained ___ EXP! (Not that it matters.)”
— In-game message after defeating Computer Virus in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Ultra
Computer Virus is a boss in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. Its boss fight is much like a living role-playing game. Its strategy is similar to that of a turn-based RPG battle, except the enemy shown will pop out of the screen it is shown on when it is 卡比（Kirby）'s turn to attack. When it is the enemy's turn to attack, 卡比（Kirby） is not able to harm the boss at all. Computer Virus throws three different opponents at 卡比（Kirby）, who must be defeated sequentially in order to win the battle, and these three opponents differ depending on which game mode is being played.

The music that plays during the battle with the Computer Virus is an 8-bit remix of the normal boss music, with a noise filter applied.

wikirby-page:1769.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1769.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1769.description_zh:
“A一只巨大的鸟，可以通过伸长脖子或用爪子抓住对手来攻击。”
— 在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）说明书的敌人角色部分对巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）的描述
巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）是一只巨大的彩虹色鸟，翅膀尖端带刀锋，是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra中巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）游戏模式的最终Boss和名字来源。她栖息在Dream Land的Candy Mountain上，每当她生气时，常常在乡村造成混乱。在巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）游戏模式中，卡比（Kirby）的任务是阻止她对梦境之地农作物的袭击，但很快意识到她只是试图喂养她的幼鸟。最终两人变成了坚定的盟友，巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）后来在Revenge of Meta Knight游戏模式中帮助卡比（Kirby）登上Halberd。

自从她在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）登场以来，巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中多次出现，虽然很少超过客串或其他小角色。她也曾在Super Smash Bros.系列中出现过几次。除了在游戏中的登场外，巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）还是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的配角。巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）通常被认为是女性，但有几段附加文本错误地用男性代词称呼她。
wikirby-page:1769.description_en:
“A gigantic bird who can attack his opponent by either stretching out his neck or grabbing them with his claws.”
— Description of 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） in the Enemy Characters section of the 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Instruction Booklet
巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） is a giant rainbow-colored bird with blade-tipped wings who serves as the final boss and namesake of the 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） game mode in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake Kirby Super Star Ultra. She roosts atop Candy Mountain in Dream Land, and tends to cause havoc across the countryside whenever she is angered. In the 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） game mode, 卡比（Kirby） is tasked with putting a stop to her attack on Dream Land's crops, but soon comes to realize that she was only trying to feed her chicks. The two eventually become stalwart allies, and 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） later helps 卡比（Kirby） board the Halberd in the Revenge of Meta Knight game mode.

Since her debut in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） has made several subsequent appearances in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, though seldom as more than a cameo appearance or other small role. She has also appeared a couple of times in the Super Smash Bros. series. In addition to her appearance in the games, 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） is also a side character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） is generally understood to be female, but several bits of flavor text erroneously refer to her with masculine pronouns.

wikirby-page:1885.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1885.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1885.description_zh:
“A一只巨大鲸鱼，活力十足，攻击对手。”
— Fatty Whale在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）使用手册敌人角色部分的描述。
Fatty Whale是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra中的一个boss。他是少数几个需要在陆地上战斗的水性boss之一。

正如其名字所示，Fatty Whale是一只肥胖的蓝鲸，几乎与战斗场地的房间大小相同。他闭口中含着一个木制烟斗；在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的形象中这一细节已去除。他还穿着白色衬衫和红色颈巾。在重制版中被击败后，Fatty Whale面颊上会贴上绷带。
wikirby-page:1885.description_en:
“A huge whale that moves vigorously to attack his opponents.”
— Fatty Whale description in the Enemy Characters section of the 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） instruction booklet
Fatty Whale is a boss in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. He is one of the few water bosses to be fought on land.

As his name indicates, Fatty Whale is a fat blue whale, nearly the size of the room that is his battle arena. In his closed mouth, he holds a wooden pipe; this detail is removed in his appearance in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. He also wears a white collared shirt and red neckerchief. Upon his defeat in the remake, Fatty Whale gets a bandage on his cheek.

wikirby-page:3393.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:3393.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:3393.description_zh:
Galactic Nova Nucleus（最初被称为新星之心）是星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中Milky Way Wishes的倒数第二个Boss，以及其Nintendo DS重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra。这个Boss战发生在银河·新星（Galactic Nova）中，在银河许愿的同名关卡末端进行，并且在The Arena中再次战斗.

Star Dream Soul OS的最后阶段，星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中The True Arena的最终Boss，直接受Galactic Nova Nucleus战斗的启发，让卡比（Kirby）在摧毁周围的柱子后与一个心形物体战斗。银河·新星（Galactic Nova）的心（简单称为“银河·新星（Galactic Nova）”）也重新作为卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中Road Trip的真正最终Boss出现，这次使用Leo进行战斗，并且该心脏也出现在银河·新星（Galactic Nova）Air Ride课程.
wikirby-page:3393.description_en:
Galactic Nova Nucleus (originally called the Heart of Nova) is the penultimate boss of Milky Way Wishes in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, and its Nintendo DS remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. This boss fight takes place inside 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）, faced at the end of the eponymous stage in Milky Way Wishes, and is battled again in The Arena.

The last phase of Star Dream Soul OS, the final boss of The True Arena in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, is directly inspired by the Galactic Nova Nucleus fight, having 卡比（Kirby） battle a heart-shaped object after destroying the pillars surrounding it. 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）'s heart (simply referred to as "银河·新星（Galactic Nova）") also reappears as the true final boss of Road Trip in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, this time fought using Leo, and the heart also appears the end of the 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） Air Ride course.

wikirby-page:1880.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1880.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1880.description_zh:
“这一次我们一定会成功！Heavy Lobster，出发！”
— Captain Vul关于Heavy Lobster在Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 5，Kirby Super Star Ultra
Heavy Lobster是一个大型、金色、机械化、类似龙虾的Boss，最著名的是他在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中保护Halberd的角色。他配备了火箭推进器和火焰喷射器，能够冲破墙壁并释放迷你版本的自己（类似于重量级鼹鼠（Heavy Mole））。此外，Heavy Lobster可以射出一种名为Paint Blobby的黏性物质，赋予卡比（Kirby）Paint复制能力（Copy Ability），可用来致盲Heavy Lobster。在Kirby Super Star Ultra中，Heavy Lobster的一种更耐久的银色变体是Milky Way Wishes中Mekkai关卡的Boss。
wikirby-page:1880.description_en:
“This time we will succeed! Heavy Lobster, away!”
— Captain Vul about Heavy Lobster in Revenge of Meta Knight - Chapter 5, Kirby Super Star Ultra
Heavy Lobster is a large, golden, mechanical, lobster-like boss most notable for his role protecting the Halberd in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Equipped with rocket boosters and flamethrowers, he has the ability to charge through walls and deploy miniature versions of himself (similar to 重量级鼹鼠（Heavy Mole）). Additionally, Heavy Lobster can shoot out a goopy substance named Paint Blobby that gives 卡比（Kirby） the Paint 复制能力（Copy Ability） which can be used to blind Heavy Lobster. In Kirby Super Star Ultra, a more resilient silver variant of Heavy Lobster serves as the boss of the Mekkai stage in Milky Way Wishes.

wikirby-page:1879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1879.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1879.description_zh: Reactor（最初称为Halberds Reactor）是Halberd的核心动力源。没有它运作，飞船将无法为引擎供能，因此它配备了自己的自动防御系统。它出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra的Revenge of Meta Knight关卡中作为boss，并在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）及其重制版Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的战舰Halberd关卡末尾作为中boss。在每一次迭代中，它都是一个大型、固定不动的机械，附有一个或多个炮塔，并携带一颗宝石（被推测为其动力源）。它的独特之处在于Reactor本身无法被卡比（Kirby）伤害，只有通过它开火攻击的激光才能对其造成伤害。
wikirby-page:1879.description_en: The Reactor (originally called Halberds Reactor) is the core power source of the Halberd. Without it operational, the ship will not be able to power its engines, so it is equipped with its own automatic defenses. It appears as a boss in the Revenge of Meta Knight stage of 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra, and as a mid-boss at the end of the Battleship Halberd level of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and its remake, Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In each iteration, it's a large, stationary machine with one or more cannons attached, holding a gem (which is presumed to be its power source). It's unique in the fact the Reactor itself cannot be damaged by 卡比（Kirby）, but only by the lasers it shoots to attack.

wikirby-page:1878.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:1878.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:1878.description_zh:
“你到达了伙伴战士塔的顶峰，但小心！双重大树（Twin Woods）正在阻挡你的道路！当心他们产生的巨型苹果。如果你不小心，它会把你压扁！”
— 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2），双重大树（Twin Woods）Story Mode: The Destined Rivals第1章的特别页面
双重大树（Twin Woods）是一个双人首领，首次出现于星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra。它们看起来像两个彼此相对的风语大树（Whispy Woods），其顶部通常会重叠。
wikirby-page:1878.description_en:
“You reached Buddy Fighters Tower's Summit, but look out! 双重大树（Twin Woods） is blocking your way! Watch out for the giant apple the pair produces. If you get careless, it'll squash you flat!”
— 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, 双重大树（Twin Woods） Special Page in chapter 1 of Story Mode: The Destined Rivals
双重大树（Twin Woods） is a duo boss that first appears in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. They resemble two 风语大树（Whispy Woods） that are facing each other and whose canopies often overlap.

wikirby-page:2309.display_name: 哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）
wikirby-page:2309.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 超级豪华版
wikirby-page:2309.display_work: 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）
wikirby-page:2309.description_zh:
哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）是出现在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）及其重制版Kirby Super Star Ultra中的一个Boss。他是The Great Cave Offensive的最终Boss，并且还作为Milky Way Wishes中Cavius星球的Boss出现，以及作为The Arena中的一个对手。

在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）Ultra中，一个更强大的以宝石为主题的对应角色Wham Bam Jewel出现在《从助手到英雄》和The True Arena中。此外，哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）在与他战斗时会获得一个新的Boss主题，这个主题与巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）和Wham Bam Jewel共享。
wikirby-page:2309.description_en:
哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock） is a boss appearing in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. He is the final boss of The Great Cave Offensive, and he also appears as the boss of planet Cavius in Milky Way Wishes and as one of the opponents in The Arena.

In 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） Ultra, a stronger, jewel-themed counterpart named Wham Bam Jewel appears in Helper to Hero and The True Arena. Moreover, 哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock） receives a new boss theme when fighting against him, which is shared with 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） and Wham Bam Jewel.

wikirby-page:11855.description_zh:
“好吧……那就让游戏决定谁能保留它吧！”
— 星仔（Mr. Star）在Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom)的Super Famicom版本中（非官方翻译）出现。
星仔（Mr. Star）是一个在卡比（Kirby）的星之堆栈两版本中都出现的角色。他是一颗有知觉的五角星，每个侧翼上都有一个球体，能够飞行和进行星际旅行。
wikirby-page:11855.description_en:
“Alright then... we'll let a game decide who can keep it!”
— 星仔（Mr. Star） in the Super Famicom version of Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom) (unofficial translation)
星仔（Mr. Star） is a character who appears in both versions of 卡比（Kirby）'s Star Stacker. He is a sentient five-pointed star with a sphere in each of his flanks, and is capable of flight and interstellar travel.

wikirby-page:31523.description_zh: KSSGB Tic tac Jr sprite.png嘀嗒Jr.（Tick-Tock Jr.）（最初被称为Tic tac Jr.）是卡比（Kirby）的Star Stacker两个版本中的角色。他出现在游戏的计时赛模式中。
wikirby-page:31523.description_en: KSSGB Tic tac Jr sprite.png 嘀嗒 Jr.（Tick-Tock Jr.） (originally referred to as Tic tac Jr.) is a character in both versions of 卡比（Kirby）'s Star Stacker. He appears in the Time Attack mode of the games.

wikirby-form:4396.description_zh: 清洁（Cleaning），原名为Clean或Broom，是八个复制能力（Copy Ability）之一，卡比（Kirby）可以在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中从敌人那里获得。它也出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，这使它成为两次出现之间间隔最长的能力。该能力可以从与扫帚相关的敌人那里获得，它的攻击通常也与清洁（Cleaning）或扫帚相关活动相关。
wikirby-form:4396.description_en: 清洁（Cleaning）, originally known as Clean or Broom, is one of eight 复制能力（Copy Ability） that 卡比（Kirby） can acquire from his enemies in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It also appears as an ability in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, which currently makes it the ability with the longest gap between two appearances. The ability can be obtained from broom-related enemies, and its attacks are also usually associated with 清洁（Cleaning） or broom-related activities.

wikirby-form:10836.description_zh: 钥匙链LoveLoveStick.png Love-Love Stick是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的Last Battle Ability。它是击败暗物质（Dark Matter）所必需的，随后在游戏结束时击败零（Zero）。
wikirby-form:10836.description_en: Keychain LoveLoveStick.png The Love-Love Stick is the Last Battle Ability of 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is required to defeat 暗物质（Dark Matter）, and subsequently 零（Zero） at the end of the game.

wikirby-page:23781.description_zh: Angel是来自星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的友好角色，她出现在Iceberg的最后阶段。她失去了构成翅膀的羽毛（它们的藏匿地点由基于复制能力（Copy Ability）的障碍保护），她需要这些羽毛才能飞行。卡比（Kirby）需要使用他几乎所有的复制能力（Copy Ability）才能获得每一根羽毛。一旦Angel恢复了羽毛和飞行能力，她会奖励卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:23781.description_en: The Angel is a friendly character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） who appears in the last stage of Iceberg. She lost the feathers that make up her wings (their hiding spots are guarded by 复制能力（Copy Ability）-based barriers) and needs them to fly. 卡比（Kirby） needs to use nearly every one of his 复制能力（Copy Ability） to get each feather. The Angel rewards 卡比（Kirby） with a Heart Star once she regains her feathers and ability to fly.

wikirby-page:74889.description_zh: Bakasa是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一个圆形的黄色生物，脸下有一个绿色的环，头上有一把雨伞。它出现在Ripple Field的第二关，如果卡比（Kirby）在之前的侧室中使用海恩（Kine）的Parasol变体，它将在关底给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74889.description_en: Bakasa is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a round yellow creature with a green ring beneath its face and a parasol on top of its head. It appears in the second stage of Ripple Field and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses 海恩（Kine）'s variant of Parasol on it in an earlier side room.

wikirby-page:75299.description_zh: Caramelo是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一个蛋形生物，上半部分是白色的并有一张脸，下半部分是黄色的，并且经常被看到咀嚼类似口香糖的物质。它出现在Sand Canyon的第三阶段，如果卡比（Kirby）在本阶段开始之前成功完成“同样的脸有多少个？”小测验，它将在阶段结束时给予Heart Star。由于运行了一个小游戏，它也会再次出现在MG-5。
wikirby-page:75299.description_en: Caramelo is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is an egg-shaped creature with a face on its upper white part and a yellow bottom part, and is often seen chewing on a substance similar to bubblegum. It appears in the third stage of Sand Canyon and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he succeeds in the How many of the same face are there? Sub-Game earlier in the stage. Due to running a minigame, it also reappears in MG-5.

wikirby-page:3398.description_zh:
“I可以粘在天花板上！我也会飞，但不是很擅长。”
— 啾啾（ChuChu）在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）教学手册中
啾啾（ChuChu）（也拼写为啾啾（ChuChu））是一种章鱼状生物，是卡比（Kirby）的六个Animal Friend之一，她首次亮相于星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）。她的特点是红色丝带、闪亮的眼睛和像日本煎饼章鱼一样的粉色胶状身体。像其他动物（Animal）朋友一样，啾啾（ChuChu）通常会和卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）配对。啾啾（ChuChu）紧贴在她伙伴的头上，她的专长是抓取物体并用触手粘到天花板上。她还可以根据她的乘骑者wields.

卡比（Kirby）在啾啾（ChuChu）戴在头上时似乎带有满足或恋爱的表情，他们的一些互动暗示他们可能相互有浪漫兴趣。啾啾（ChuChu）也展现出勇敢的一面，特别是在其他动物（Animal）朋友和蛊依（Gooey）面前。啾啾（ChuChu）最显著的登场是在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3），但在后来的游戏中也经常客串出现；在三位星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的动物（Animal）朋友中，她的独立登场次数最多。
wikirby-page:3398.description_en:
“I can stick to ceilings! I can also fly, but not very well.”
— 啾啾（ChuChu） in the 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instructional Booklet
啾啾（ChuChu） (also spelled as 啾啾（ChuChu）) is an octopus-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s six Animal Friends, making her debut in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. She is distinguished by her red ribbon, sparkly eyes, and gelatinous pink body, which resembles the Japanese flapjack octopus. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 啾啾（ChuChu） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. 啾啾（ChuChu） clings to her partner's head, and her specialty is grabbing objects and sticking onto ceilings with her tentacles. She can also perform a number of different attacks depending on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） her rider wields.

卡比（Kirby） appears to have a content or lovestruck expression when 啾啾（ChuChu） is on his head, and several of their interactions imply that they may have a romantic interest in each other. 啾啾（ChuChu） also shows a feisty side, particularly around the other 动物（Animal） Friends and 蛊依（Gooey）. 啾啾（ChuChu） makes her most prominent appearance in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, but regularly makes cameos in later games; of the three 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） 动物（Animal） Friends, she has the most standalone appearances.

wikirby-page:74892.description_zh: Geromazudake是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一种有眼睛的棕色蘑菇。它出现在Sand Canyon的第一关，如果卡比（Kirby）踩过关卡的Tulip但没有踩到蘑菇，关卡结束时会得到一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74892.description_en: Geromazudake is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a brown mushroom with eyes. It appears in the first stage of Sand Canyon and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he tramples the stage's Tulips but not its mushrooms.

wikirby-page:74891.description_zh: HB-002是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一个呈旋转方形的黄色生物，由更小的方块组成。它出现在Ripple Field的第六关，如果卡比（Kirby）打破部分Star Block阵型使其在早期的侧室中看起来像它，关卡结束时会得到一个Heart Star。它的设计和名字参考了Mario's Picross的Easy Picross 2-B关卡“Diamond”。
wikirby-page:74891.description_en: HB-002 is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a yellow creature shaped like a rotated square, but made of smaller squares. It appears in the sixth stage of Ripple Field and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he breaks part of a Star Block formation to make it resemble it in an earlier side room. Its design and name are a reference to the Easy Picross 2-B level "Diamond" from Mario's Picross.

wikirby-page:75306.description_zh: HB-007是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一个不规则形状的粉色生物，最像一个酒杯。它出现在Cloudy Park的第六关，如果卡比（Kirby）在关卡结束时破坏了Star Block阵型的一部分，使其在早期旁边的房间中看起来像一个正立的HB-007，它将会给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。它的设计和名字参考了Mario's Picross中Easy Picross 7-B关卡“Wine Glass”（日语版，国际版被替换为“Silk Hat”）。
wikirby-page:75306.description_en: HB-007 is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a pink creature of an irregular shape, most resembling a wine glass. It appears in the sixth stage of Cloudy Park and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he breaks part of a Star Block formation to make it resemble a right-side up HB-007 in an earlier side room. Its design and name are a reference to the Easy Picross 7-B level "Wine Glass" (Japanese version, replaced by "Silk Hat" internationally) from Mario's Picross.

wikirby-page:75300.description_zh: Hibanamodoki是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一朵有绿色茎和叶子的花，黄色中心有两只眼睛，中心黄色部分周围有一个红色环。在Cloudy Park的第一个阶段中会出现，如果卡比（Kirby）使用空（Coo）或陆库（Rick）的Clean变体轻轻扑去类似的其他花而不踩到它们，将在阶段结束时获得Heart Star。
wikirby-page:75300.description_en: Hibanamodoki is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a flower with a green stem and leaves, two eyes in its yellow center, and a red ring around its central yellow part. It appears in the first stage of Cloudy Park and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses 空（Coo）'s or 陆库（Rick）'s variants of Clean to dust off other flowers like it without trampling them.

wikirby-page:74888.description_zh: Kamuribana是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一朵淡紫色的花，顶部有三个凸起，并有两只眼睛。它们出现在Ripple Field的第一阶段，如果他在使用哔奇（Pitch）的Clean变体为之前的一些侧室中的六朵花浇水且不踩踏它们，阶段结束时将给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74888.description_en: Kamuribana is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a lavender-colored flower with three bumps on its top and two eyes. They appear in the first stage of Ripple Field and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses 哔奇（Pitch）'s variant of Clean to water six flowers in earlier side rooms and does not trample them.

wikirby-page:74890.description_zh: Kogamugaeru & Gamugaeru是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的角色。他们是两只棕色的蟾蜍，有腮红，其中Kogamugaeru是没有腿的孩子，Gamugaeru是父母。他们出现在Ripple Field的第四阶段，如果Gamugaeru在阶段早些时候从侧室中救出Kogamugaeru，阶段结束时会给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74890.description_en: Kogamugaeru & Gamugaeru are characters in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. They are two brown toads with cheek blush, with Kogamugaeru being the legless child and Gamugaeru the parent. They appear in the fourth stage of Ripple Field and Gamugaeru will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he rescues Kogamugaeru from a side room earlier in the stage.

wikirby-page:75308.description_zh: Kogoesou是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一朵白色的雏菊，橙色的花心里有眼睛。它出现在Iceberg的第一个阶段，如果卡比（Kirby）使用燃烧（Burning）变体提前解冻阶段中的冰冻雏菊但没有踩踏它们，它将会给他一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:75308.description_en: Kogoesou is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a white daisy with eyes in its orange center. It appears in the first stage of Iceberg and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star if he uses a 燃烧（Burning） variant to thaw out frozen daisies earlier in the stage but doesn't trample them.

wikirby-page:75305.description_zh: Mikarin & Kagami Mocchi是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的角色。Mikarin是一个活生生的橙子，而Kagami Mocchi是一堆活生生的麻薯。它们出现在Cloudy Park的第四阶段，如果他在阶段早期使用空（Coo）救出Mikarin，它们将在阶段结束时给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:75305.description_en: Mikarin & Kagami Mocchi are characters in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. Mikarin is a living orange and Kagami Mocchi is a living pile of mochi. They appear in the fourth stage of Cloudy Park and they will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses 空（Coo） to rescue Mikarin earlier in the stage.

wikirby-page:11032.description_zh: 麦恩（Mine）是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个次要角色。麦恩（Mine）是海恩（Kine）的妻子，与他非常相似，但她是粉色的并且有脸颊腮红，这也使她看起来像卡比（Kirby）。她的嘴巴也小得多，没有明显的嘴唇。她出现在Grass Land - Stage 5的结尾，如果他把海恩（Kine）带给她，她会给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:11032.description_en: 麦恩（Mine） is a minor character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. 麦恩（Mine） is 海恩（Kine）'s wife, and resembles him greatly, but she is pink and has cheek blush, which also makes her look like 卡比（Kirby）. She also has a much smaller mouth with no visible lips. She appears at the end of Grass Land - Stage 5 and gives a Heart Star to 卡比（Kirby） if he brings 海恩（Kine） to her.

wikirby-page:74868.description_zh: Muchimuchi是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一个有两只眼睛和一个嘴巴的生物，中间部分为蓝色层状结构，顶部和底部为绿色。它出现在Grass Land的第二阶段，如果Chuchu在阶段较早时对它使用她的默认动作，它会在阶段结束时给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74868.description_en: Muchimuchi is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a creature with two eyes and a mouth with a blue layered midsection and a green top and bottom. It appears in the second stage of Grass Land and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he has Chuchu use her default move on it earlier in the stage.

wikirby-page:4448.description_zh:
“I可以执行三连跳。骑上我吧！”
— 喵果（Nago）出现在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）教学手册中
喵果（Nago）是一种猫科生物，也是卡比（Kirby）的六个Animal Friend之一，在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中首次亮相。他的特点是平时闭着的眼睛，头部和背部的橘棕色三花毛皮，以及浑圆的身体，隐藏的脚和短粗的尾巴，像Japanese Bobtail。像其他动物（Animal）朋友一样，喵果（Nago）通常会和卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）配对。他像球一样滚动他的伙伴，他的标志性动作是三连跳，比陆库（Rick）的双跳更强。他还可以根据骑手挥舞。

虽然现实中三花猫绝大多数是母猫，喵果（Nago）是雄性。它通常闭着眼睛，脸上带着微笑，但如果卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）选择其他动物（Animal）好友而非他，它会短暂地睁开眼睛，显出震惊的神情。他迄今为止最显著的出场仍然是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）。它在后续的游戏中也会客串出现，通常会与其他星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）动物（Animal）好友一同出现。
wikirby-page:4448.description_en:
“I can perform a triple jump. Hop on me!”
— 喵果（Nago） in the 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instructional Booklet
喵果（Nago） is a cat-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby）'s six Animal Friends, making his debut in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He is distinguished by his normally-shut eyes, his orange-and-brown calico coat on his head and back, and his bulbous body with hidden feet and a stubby tail, which resembles the Japanese Bobtail. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 喵果（Nago） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. He rolls his partner along like a ball, and his signature move is his triple jump, which beats out 陆库（Rick）'s double jump. He can also perform a number of different attacks depending on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） his rider wields.

Although calico cats are overwhelmingly female in real life, 喵果（Nago） is male. He typically has closed eyes and a smile on his face, but will briefly open his eyes in shock if 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey） select another 动物（Animal） Friend over him. His most prominent appearance to date remains 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He makes cameos in later games, generally with the other 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） 动物（Animal） Friends in tow.

wikirby-page:75310.description_zh: Name是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一只带有洋红色螺旋图案的黄色壳的蜗牛。它出现在Iceberg的第四阶段，如果他使用燃烧（Burning）、空（Coo）和啾啾（ChuChu）的组合来取回它的壳，在阶段结束时会给予卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:75310.description_en: Name is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a snail with a yellow shell that has a magenta spiral on it. It appears in the fourth stage of Iceberg and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses a combination of 燃烧（Burning）, 空（Coo）, and 啾啾（ChuChu） to retrieve its shell.

wikirby-page:11055.description_zh:
Nyupun是来自星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的一个配角。Nyupun是啾啾（ChuChu）的朋友，与她非常相似，但他们是黄色的，戴着类似水手帽的东西。他们的性别未知，在不同的漫画中被描绘为男性和女性。啾啾（ChuChu）的Nintendo Today!《梦幻之地目录》一文在英文中提及他们时没有使用性别化语言；其他语言则将他们称为男性、女性，或避免使用性别化语言。

Nyupun会在Sand Canyon - Stage 5的尽头等待，如果卡比（Kirby）带着啾啾（ChuChu）前来，他会分发一个Heart Star给他。Nyupun也会在工作人员名单中以Ado绘制的插图形式出现。
wikirby-page:11055.description_en:
Nyupun is a minor character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. Nyupun is 啾啾（ChuChu）'s friend and closely resembles her, but they are yellow and wear what appears to be a sailor's cap. Their gender is unknown, and they are depicted as both male and female in different manga appearances. The text of 啾啾（ChuChu）'s Nintendo Today! Dream Land Directory post does not use gendered language to refer to them in English; other languages refer to them as either male, female, or avoid gendered language.

Nyupun waits at the end of Sand Canyon - Stage 5 and gives out a Heart Star to 卡比（Kirby） if he brings 啾啾（ChuChu） with him. Nyupun also appears during the staff credits as an illustration drawn by Ado.

wikirby-page:74160.description_zh: Oba-chan是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。她是一个圆圆的黄色生物，有点像卡比（Kirby），但有圆圆的眼睛、手和脚，并穿着清洁工服装。她出现在沙子（Sand）峡谷的第二关，如果卡比（Kirby）成功使用清洁（Cleaning）清理关卡中两个房间的灰尘，她会给他一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74160.description_en: Oba-chan is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. She is a round yellow creature a bit similar to 卡比（Kirby）, but with round eyes, hands and feet, and wears a janitor costume. She appears in the second stage of 沙子（Sand） Canyon and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star if he successfully uses 清洁（Cleaning） to clean the dust of two rooms of the stage.

wikirby-page:11082.description_zh: 琵库（Pick）是来自星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的一个次要角色。琵库（Pick）与陆库（Rick）非常相似，并且是他的女朋友，但她的毛色斑块是粉色的而不是橙色，她头上戴着一条红色丝带。她出现在Cloudy Park - Stage 5的结尾，如果卡比（Kirby）把陆库（Rick）带到她身边，她会给他一个Heart Star。琵库（Pick）也出现在游戏工作人员名单的插图中，由Ado绘制。
wikirby-page:11082.description_en: 琵库（Pick） is a minor character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. 琵库（Pick） greatly resembles 陆库（Rick） and is his girlfriend, but her fur patches are pink rather than orange and she wears a red ribbon on her head. She appears at the end of Cloudy Park - Stage 5 and gives a Heart Star to 卡比（Kirby） if he brings 陆库（Rick） to her. 琵库（Pick） also appears in the game's staff credits illustrations, drawn by Ado.

wikirby-page:74887.description_zh: Pierre是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。他们是一个有着圆形红色底座、腰带、带小丑脸的棕色头、蓝色尖顶和两只分离白手的生物；整体外观类似小丑玩具。他们出现在Grass Land的第六关，如果卡比（Kirby）在关卡中提前收集了他们的三个杂耍物品，他们会在关卡结束时给他一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:74887.description_en: Pierre is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. They are a creature with a round red base, a belt, a tan head with a clown face, a blue pointed top, and two disjointed white hands; altogether, their appearance resembles that of a clown toy. They appear in the sixth stage of Grass Land and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he gathers all three of their juggling objects earlier in the stage.

wikirby-page:3577.description_zh:
“别忘了我！我可以让一些复制的能力更强！”
— 哔奇（Pitch）在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）使用说明书中
哔奇（Pitch）是一种鸟类生物，也是卡比（Kirby）六个Animal Friend中之一，首次登场于星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）。它的特点是体型小，眼睛小而表情少变，羽毛呈鲜艳的绿白相间，类似黄白啭鸟。像其他动物（Animal）朋友一样，哔奇（Pitch）通常配对与卡比（Kirby）或蛊依（Gooey）。他的搭档用手携带他，这使得二者能够快速移动，但相比空（Coo），限制了哔奇（Pitch）的飞行能力。他还可以根据骑手所使用的复制能力（Copy Ability）施展多种不同的攻击挥舞着武器。

许多哔奇（Pitch）的复制能力（Copy Ability）攻击允许他独立于骑手行动，从而能够进行各种攻击。哔奇（Pitch）是最小的动物（Animal）朋友，看起来很年轻，因为他的母亲比他大得多。他迄今为止最显著的亮相仍然是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）。他在后来的游戏中客串出现，通常与其他星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）动物（Animal）朋友一起出现。
wikirby-page:3577.description_en:
“Don't forget me! I can make some copied abilities better!”
— 哔奇（Pitch） in the 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） Instruction Booklet
哔奇（Pitch） is a bird-like creature and one of 卡比（Kirby） six Animal Friends, making his debut in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He is distinguished by his tiny frame, his beady eyes which rarely change expression, and his vivid green-and-white plumage, which resembles the warbling white-eye. Like the other 动物（Animal） Friends, 哔奇（Pitch） is typically paired up with 卡比（Kirby） or 蛊依（Gooey）. His partner carries him along in their hands; this enables the duo to move quickly, but limits 哔奇（Pitch）'s ability to fly compared to 空（Coo）. He can also perform a number of different attacks depending on which 复制能力（Copy Ability） his rider wields.

Many of 哔奇（Pitch）'s 复制能力（Copy Ability） attacks allow him to move independently from his rider, enabling a wide range of attack. 哔奇（Pitch） is the smallest 动物（Animal） Friend, and appears to be young, as his mother is much larger than him. His most prominent appearance to date remains 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He makes cameos in later games, generally with the other 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） 动物（Animal） Friends in tow.

wikirby-page:11043.description_zh: Pitch Mama是来自星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的一个次要角色。顾名思义，她是哔奇（Pitch）的母亲。因此，她与他非常相似，但为粉色且比儿子大。
wikirby-page:11043.description_en: Pitch Mama is a minor character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. As her title suggests, she is the mother of 哔奇（Pitch）. As such, she resembles him greatly, but is pink and larger than her son.

wikirby-page:74886.description_zh: Pitcherman是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。他的身体形状类似卡比（Kirby），但主体为浅蓝色，手脚为深蓝色，戴着红黄相间的棒球帽。他出现在Grass Land的第三阶段，如果他在关卡稍早的“投掷了哪一个黑刺球（Gordo）？”小游戏中成功，将会给予卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。由于主持了一个小游戏，他也会在MG-5中再次出现。
wikirby-page:74886.description_en: Pitcherman is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. He is a creature with a similar body shape to 卡比（Kirby）, but with a light blue main body, dark blue hands and feet, and a red and yellow baseball cap. He appears in the third stage of Grass Land and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star if he succeeds in the Which 黑刺球（Gordo） was thrown? minigame earlier in the stage. Due to hosting a minigame, he also reappears in MG-5.

wikirby-page:75303.description_zh: Piyo & Keko是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的字符。Piyo是一只黄色小鸡，Keko是一只白母鸡。它们出现在Cloudy Park的第二关，如果他使用针（Needle）的一个版本戳破Piyo系着的气球，在关卡结束时会给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。
wikirby-page:75303.description_en: Piyo & Keko are characters in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. Piyo is a yellow baby chick and Keko is a white hen. They appear in the second stage of Cloudy Park and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he uses a version of 针（Needle） to pop a balloon that Piyo is tied to.

wikirby-page:11148.description_zh:
Shiro是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个配角。她的原型是猫喵果（Nago），并且是他的女朋友。她的毛全白（正如她的名字在日语中意味着“白色”），与喵果（Nago）不同，她的眼睛通常睁得很大。

Shiro会给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star，如果他把喵果（Nago）带到Iceberg - Stage 5的终点，她会出现在那里。由于在关卡中找不到喵果（Nago），卡比（Kirby）必须从另一个关卡把他带过来。
wikirby-page:11148.description_en:
Shiro is a minor character from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. She is based on 喵果（Nago） the cat and is his girlfriend. She has all-white fur (as her name means white in Japanese), and unlike 喵果（Nago）, her eyes usually remain wide open.

Shiro gives out a Heart Star to 卡比（Kirby） if he brings 喵果（Nago） to the end of Iceberg - Stage 5 where she appears. Since 喵果（Nago） cannot be found in the stage, 卡比（Kirby） has to bring him from another stage.

wikirby-page:75304.description_zh: Tama-san是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是由三个球体组成的生物，一个红色，一个蓝色，还有一个黄色的，黄色的上有一张脸。它出现在Cloudy Park的第三阶段，如果他在“有多少个相同颜色？”的关卡中成功，它会在关卡结束时给卡比（Kirby）一个Heart Star。在阶段的早期，它会出现Sub-Game。由于运行了一个迷你游戏，它也会重新出现在MG-5.
wikirby-page:75304.description_en: Tama-san is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a creature made up of three spheres, one red, one blue, and one yellow, the last of which has a face. It appears in the third stage of Cloudy Park and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star at the end of the stage if he succeeds in the How many of the same color are there? Sub-Game earlier in the stage. Due to running a minigame, it also reappears in MG-5.

wikirby-page:73198.description_zh: Tulip是星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的一个角色。它是一朵有眼睛的大红花。它出现在草地的第一关，如果卡比（Kirby）在不踩到或攻击任何小郁金香的情况下完成关卡，它将给他一个Heart Star。那些小郁金香将在沙子（Sand）峡谷的第一关中被践踏，以满足Geromazudake的要求。
wikirby-page:73198.description_en: The Tulip is a character in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a large red flower with eyes. It appears in the first stage of Grass Land and will give 卡比（Kirby） a Heart Star if he completes the stage without stepping on or attacking any of the smaller tulips. Said smaller tulips are to be later trampled in the first stage of 沙子（Sand） Canyon to satisfy Geromazudake.

wikirby-page:4137.description_zh:
Apolo是一种只在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中发现的敌人。它是一种锥形生物，拥有双色身体和两只黑色的圆眼睛。Apolos看起来像（并且大概以之命名）一种名为「アポロ」Aporo（阿波罗）的巧克力糖果，该糖果由Meiji生产并在日本销售。

根据其所在的地区，Apolo可能有两种不同的颜色方案：靠近地面的个体为棕色，顶端带粉色，而生活在更高处的个体，如Cloudy Park，则为蓝色，身体的前半部分颜色比身体其他部分更浅且带有绿色调。

 Apolos首次在Grass Land第六关第四节中被遇见，数量稀少在整个游戏中随处可见。它们总是附着在垂直的圆柱形物体上，例如树或岩柱，并以一致的运动快速绕着它旋转。虽然它们没有攻击，但触碰它们会使卡比（Kirby）失去生命值。

Apolos容易受到任何攻击。吞食它们不会为卡比（Kirby）提供复制能力（Copy Ability），但吞食棕色Apolo可以恢复卡比（Kirby）半点生命值。然而，Cloudy公园中的蓝色Apolos被吞食时不会为卡比（Kirby）恢复生命值。
wikirby-page:4137.description_en:
Apolo is an enemy only found in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It is a conical creature with a bichrome body and two dark, round eyes. Apolos resemble (and are presumably named after) a type of chocolate confection called 「アポロ」Aporo (Apollo), which is produced by Meiji and sold in Japan.

Depending on the region it is found in, an Apolo may have one of two different color schemes: whereas the specimens dwelling closer to the ground are brown with a pink tip, those found in greater heights, such as Cloudy Park, are blue, their front half being a lighter and more greenish shade of the color than the rest of their body.

First encountered in the fourth section of the sixth stage of Grass Land, Apolos are sparsely seen throughout the game. They are always attached to a vertical, cylindrical body, such as a tree or a rock pillar, and rapidly circle around it in a consistent motion. Although they possess no attacks, touching them causes 卡比（Kirby） to lose health.

Apolos are vulnerable to any attack. While inhaling and swallowing them does not grant 卡比（Kirby） a 复制能力（Copy Ability）, doing so to the brown Apolo restores half a point of health to 卡比（Kirby）. The blue Apolos in Cloudy Park do not heal 卡比（Kirby） when swallowed, however.

wikirby-page:4112.description_zh: Babut是一个首次出现在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的敌人。它长得像一只黑色的蝙蝠，有红色的翅膀和耳朵，以及红色的鼻子和一双白色发光的眼睛。它没有可见的腿。Babuts经常挂在洞穴的天花板上，当卡比（Kirby）靠得太近时，它们会攻击，通过咬住卡比（Kirby）并固定住他的位置。与大多数其他敌人不同，Babuts由于其攻击方式，不能仅通过接触就被消灭，除非卡比（Kirby）在此过程中无敌。然而，它们对所有其他攻击都是脆弱的。吸入并吞下Babut并不会赋予卡比（Kirby）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:4112.description_en: Babut is an enemy first appearing in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. It resembles a black bat with red wings and ears, as well as a red nose and a pair of white, glowing eyes. It possesses no visible legs. Babuts often hang from the ceiling in caves, and attack 卡比（Kirby） when he comes too close, by biting 卡比（Kirby） while holding him in place. Unlike most other enemies, Babuts, due to their way of attacking, cannot be destroyed simply by touching them, unless 卡比（Kirby） is invincible while doing so. They are, however, vulnerable to all other attacks. Inhaling and swallowing a Babut does not grant 卡比（Kirby） a 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:3388.description_zh: KDL3 Batamon精灵.png Batamon是一种难以捉摸的卡比（Kirby）类生物，首次出现在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中。尽管它像卡比（Kirby）一样是粉色的，形状也相似，但它有一些不同之处；最明显的是，它的眼睛比卡比（Kirby）的更小、更像珠子，而且间距明显更宽。它也不像卡比（Kirby）那样圆，并且似乎不具备其能力，而只是行为像一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。吞下Batamon不会获得任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:3388.description_en: KDL3 Batamon Sprite.png Batamon is an elusive 卡比（Kirby）-like creature which first appeared in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）. Although it is pink like 卡比（Kirby） and of a similar shape, it possesses a few differences; most notably, its eyes are smaller, beadier, and significantly further apart than those of 卡比（Kirby）.
