wikirby-form:2829.description_en: 莉宝水晶（Ribbon's Crystal） is a Power Combo and the Last Battle Ability of 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）.

wikirby-form:1352.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:1352.description_zh:
Spark-Cutter是Power Combo中的一个功能，出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。它是电火花（Spark）和弯刀（Cutter）能力的组合。

通过施展该能力，卡比（Kirby）握持一把黄色的双刃激光剑，这把剑类似于Star Wars系列中的光剑（特别是Darth Maul的双刃光剑）或Mobile Suit Gundam中的MS-14S剑。激光剑还会发出类似光剑的嗡嗡声。

要使用此能力，卡比（Kirby）必须先拔出剑。然后，他可以在前后以及一定程度上向上挥舞剑进行炫目的攻击。如果他在剑拔出的情况下靠近敌人转身，也会对敌人造成伤害。卡比（Kirby）只能进行一次落地跳，不能手持剑悬空，所以他必须蹲下将剑收起。

像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他Copy技能一样，这个技能不会以任何方式改变卡比（Kirby）的外观。

Power Combos
wikirby-form:1352.description_en:
Spark-Cutter is a Power Combo featured in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is a combination of the 电火花（Spark） and 弯刀（Cutter） abilities.

By performing the ability, 卡比（Kirby） wields a yellow, double-bladed laser sword which resembles either a lightsaber from the Star Wars franchise (particularly Darth Maul's dual-blade lightsaber) or the MS-14S sword from Mobile Suit Gundam. The laser sword also makes a similar humming noise to that of a lightsaber.

To use this ability, 卡比（Kirby） must first take out the sword. He can then swing it about in a flashy twirl to attack enemies in front and behind him, as well as above to a certain extent. He will also harm enemies if he turns around near them while the sword is out. 卡比（Kirby） only gets one grounded jump and cannot hover with the sword in hand, so he must duck to put it away.

Like the other Copy Abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way.

Power Combos

wikirby-form:7589.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:7589.description_zh:
Spark-Spark是Power Combo在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个特点。它是两种电火花（Spark）能力的组合。

使用这个动作可以让卡比（Kirby）在自己周围生成一个巨大的电场，对接触到的敌人造成伤害。卡比（Kirby）在电场存在时可以缓慢地从左到右移动，但在过程中电场会逐渐缩小，直到卡比（Kirby）停止攻击。他在动作进行时不能跳跃，但任何进入电场的敌人都会被强力的闪电击中。在维持电场时，卡比（Kirby）不断挥动身体和手臂，并闭上眼睛，仿佛在冥想。

与星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他能力一样，这个能力不会改变卡比（Kirby）的在任何方面的外貌。这一个在使用时也不会改变他的外貌。

Power Combos
wikirby-form:7589.description_en:
Spark-Spark is a Power Combo featured in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is a combination of two 电火花（Spark） abilities.

Using the move allows 卡比（Kirby） to generate a large electric field around himself that damages enemies that come in contact with it. 卡比（Kirby） can move slowly from left to right while the field is up, though it will gradually shrink in the process until 卡比（Kirby） stops. He cannot jump while the move is in progress, but any enemy that enters the field will be zapped by a powerful bolt of lightning. While holding the field, 卡比（Kirby） continually waves his body and arms about and closes his eyes as if meditating.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way. This one also does not change his appearance while using it.

Power Combos

wikirby-form:3677.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:3677.description_zh:
Stone-Bomb是Power Combo在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个组合石块（Stone）和炸弹（Bomb）能力的技能。使用时，卡比（Kirby）会在自己前方不远处吐出一捆带有定时引线的炸药。当引线燃尽或接触到敌人时，炸药会产生巨大的爆炸，对宽广爆炸范围内的所有目标造成伤害，包括背景中的敌人。如果卡比（Kirby）处于范围内，爆炸也会对他造成伤害，但他可以通过蹲下带上黄色安全帽来保护自己。尽管如此，这个招式非常危险，而且比其他任何招式更容易导致卡比（Kirby）在操作中自我伤害。因此，不建议使用这个的能力使用得比必要的更频繁。

像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他能力一样，这种能力不会改变卡比（Kirby）的外貌（除非他在使用该招式时蹲下）。
wikirby-form:3677.description_en:
Stone-Bomb is a Power Combo in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that combines the 石块（Stone） and 炸弹（Bomb） abilities. When used, 卡比（Kirby） spits out a bundle of dynamite with a timed fuse a short distance in front of him.

When the fuse runs out or it makes contact with an enemy, the dynamite will produce a massive explosion, dealing damage to anything within a wide blast radius including to a foe in the background. The explosion will damage 卡比（Kirby） as well if he is within range, but he can protect himself from it with a yellow hardhat simply by crouching. Despite this, the move is very dangerous, and will – more often than any other – cause 卡比（Kirby） to take himself out in the process. As such, it is not advised to use this ability more often than necessary.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance (unless he crouches while using the move).

wikirby-form:859.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:859.description_zh: Stone-Cutter是Power Combo在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的特色。这个能力展示了石块（Stone）和弯刀（Cutter）能力的结合。使用这个招式时，卡比（Kirby）可以变形成他在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的六个Animal Friend之一的石像，从而获得不同的能力。
wikirby-form:859.description_en: Stone-Cutter is a a Power Combo featured in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. This power is featured as a combination of the 石块（Stone） and 弯刀（Cutter） abilities. Using this move, 卡比（Kirby） can transform into a stone replica of any one of his six Animal Friends from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, gaining varying abilities in the process.

wikirby-form:12549.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:12549.description_zh:
Stone-Ice是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards），它结合了石块（Stone）和冰冻（Ice）的能力。

使用此招式会使卡比（Kirby）变成一块带黄色手柄的冰封曲棍球石，滑过地面，冻结与之接触的任何敌人。在滑行过程中，卡比（Kirby）无法控制自己的移动，并会从墙壁反弹。在滑行时，他实际上是无敌的。要结束此招式，卡比（Kirby）必须等待直到完全停止，或者在滑行过程中再次使用该能力。

像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他能力一样，这个能力在使用前不会以任何方式改变卡比（Kirby）的外貌。
wikirby-form:12549.description_en:
Stone-Ice is a 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that combines the 石块（Stone） and 冰冻（Ice） abilities.

Using this move causes 卡比（Kirby） to transform into a freezing curling stone with a yellow handle and slide across the ground, freezing any enemies he makes contact with. While sliding, 卡比（Kirby） cannot control his movement, and will bounce off walls. He is effectively invulnerable while sliding. To end the move, 卡比（Kirby） must either wait until he comes to a complete stop, or simply use the ability again while sliding.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way until it is used.

wikirby-form:5597.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:5597.description_zh:
Stone-Needle是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards），它结合了针（Needle）和石块（Stone）的能力。它将卡比（Kirby）的右臂变成钻头，并且在地面和空中使用该能力的方式不同。

默认情况下，当使用Stone-Needle时，卡比（Kirby）会自动向前滑行。他在释放钻头之前无法跳跃或转身，不过如果他在空中，当开始钻地时，会短暂悬停在空中，然后正常落下。玩家可以通过按B键让卡比（Kirby）释放钻头，使其朝卡比（Kirby）面向的方向射出。当在按住+控制键的同时使用Stone-Needle时，卡比（Kirby）会向下钻地。

就像其他在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的能力，这种能力在使用之前不会以任何方式改变卡比（Kirby）的外观。
wikirby-form:5597.description_en:
Stone-Needle is a 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that combines the 针（Needle） and 石块（Stone） abilities. It transforms 卡比（Kirby）'s right arm into a drill, and the ability is used differently on the ground and in midair.

By default when using Stone-Needle, 卡比（Kirby） automatically slides forward. He cannot jump or turn around until he releases the drill, though if he is in midair, he does briefly hang in the air when he starts drilling before falling normally. The player can make 卡比（Kirby） release the drill by pressing the B button, causing it to shoot off in the direction 卡比（Kirby） is facing. When using Stone-Needle while holding down on the + Control Pad, 卡比（Kirby） drills downward.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way until it is used.

wikirby-form:7588.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:7588.description_zh: Stone-Spark是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一项Power Combo，它结合了石块（Stone）和电火花（Spark）的能力。凭借该能力，卡比（Kirby）可以吐出一块岩石，这块岩石通过电流与他相连。当石头飞出时，它会在舞台上飞来飞去，通常围绕卡比（Kirby）以旋转的模式移动。它会反弹并撞击墙壁及其他障碍物，并且伴随着电火花束缚，会对碰到的任何敌人造成伤害。卡比（Kirby）在石头飞出时无法悬停，但石头最终会移动并接触到卡比（Kirby），并在过程中破碎。卡比（Kirby）也可以让石头提前爆炸，对被爆炸波及的敌人造成伤害。像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards），这种能力在使用之前不会以任何方式改变卡比（Kirby）的外貌。
wikirby-form:7588.description_en:
Stone-Spark is a Power Combo in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that combines the 石块（Stone） and 电火花（Spark） abilities. With the ability, 卡比（Kirby） can spit out a rock, which is connected to him by a stream of electricity.

While the stone is out, it flies about the stage, generally following a rotating pattern around 卡比（Kirby）. It will bounce and ricochet off walls and other obstacles and, along with the spark leash, will damage any enemy it touches. 卡比（Kirby） cannot hover while the stone is out, but the stone will eventually move in and make contact with 卡比（Kirby）, breaking in the process. 卡比（Kirby） can also make the stone explode prematurely, damaging enemies caught in the blast.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way until it is used.

wikirby-form:7586.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-form:7586.description_zh:
Stone-Stone是一种由两种石块（Stone）能力组成的Power Combo。在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中，它或多或少与石块（Stone）相同，但会使卡比（Kirby）体积增大。

使用时，卡比（Kirby）会变成巨大的石块并落到地面，如果卡比（Kirby）当时正水平移动，会滚动一小段距离。从这里，石块可以形成卡比（Kirby）的巨型石头复制品并四处行走，损伤任何与之接触的敌人。到达山坡时，卡比（Kirby）将再次恢复常规石块形态并滚下山坡。恢复形态时，石块会爆裂，也会对敌人造成伤害。

如果卡比（Kirby）在Stone-Stone形态下接触到黑刺球（Gordo）或其他无敌障碍，他会从上面弹开并在过程中不受到伤害而恢复正常。

像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他技能一样，这个技能在使用之前不会以任何方式改变卡比（Kirby）的外观。
wikirby-form:7586.description_en:
Stone-Stone is a Power Combo of two 石块（Stone） abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is more or less identical to 石块（Stone）, but it causes 卡比（Kirby） to grow in size.

When used, 卡比（Kirby） becomes a giant stone and falls to the ground, rolling a short distance if 卡比（Kirby） was moving horizontally at the time. From here, the stone can form into a giant stone replica of 卡比（Kirby） and walk around, damaging any enemy he touches. When reaching a hill, 卡比（Kirby） will assume regular stone form again and roll down it. When transforming back, the stone bursts, which can also damage enemies.

If 卡比（Kirby） touches a 黑刺球（Gordo） or another invulnerable obstacle while in Stone-Stone form, he bounces off it and reverts to normal without taking damage in the process.

Like the other abilities in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, this ability does not change 卡比（Kirby）'s physical appearance in any way until it is used.

wikirby-page:631.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:631.description_zh:
“阿朵莱妮（Adeleine），一位有抱负的年轻艺术家，来到流行明星学习艺术，但发现自己陷入了暗物质（Dark Matter）的混乱之中。”
— 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）说明书，第22页
阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的年轻画家和主要角色，他与卡比（Kirby）联手，追寻星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的Crystal Shard。她看起来像一个人类女孩，这使她在许多其他星之卡比系列（Kirby series）角色中非常突出，尤其是因为她的身高大约是卡比（Kirby）的两倍。她的名字是法语“Adeline”的德语化形式，“Adeline”是“Adele”（贵族）的昵称。

阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）并非波普之星（Popstar）出生，而是来到这个星球学习艺术。她的家乡是未具体说明。她在外貌和举止上都与Ado非常相似，但他们是否是同一个角色则不明确。
wikirby-page:631.description_en:
“阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）, an aspiring young artist, comes to Pop Star to study art but finds herself in the middle of a 暗物质（Dark Matter） mess.”
— 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） instruction booklet, pg. 22
阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） is a young painter and major character in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, who joins forces with 卡比（Kirby） in his quest to collect the Crystal Shards in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. She looks like a human girl, which causes her to stand out greatly from many other 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） characters, particularly due to the fact that she stands at roughly twice the height of 卡比（Kirby）. Her name is a Germanization of the French "Adeline", which is diminutive for "Adele" (nobility).

阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） is not native to 波普之星（Popstar）, and instead visits the planet to study art. Her homeworld is left unspecified. She bears a strong resemblance to Ado, both in appearance and mannerisms, but whether or not they are the same character is left ambiguous.

wikirby-page:11013.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11013.description_zh: Queen是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个小角色，担任Ripple Star的最高统治者。
wikirby-page:11013.description_en: The Queen is a minor character from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, acting as the sovereign ruler of Ripple Star.

wikirby-page:275.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:275.description_zh:
“A，莉宝（Ribbon）携带仙子的水晶逃离了星球，却落入了暗物质（Dark Matter）的伏击。当她失去对水晶的控制时，她向卡比（Kirby）寻求帮助。”
— 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）使用说明书（北美），第22页
莉宝（Ribbon）是来自Ripple Star的一名小型Fairy，她首次亮相于星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）。她在家园星球的Queen麾下服务，并守护着Crystal——一种具有驱散暗物质（Dark Matter）力量的物体。她构成了莉宝水晶（Ribbon's Crystal）能力的一部分，并且在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中与阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）配对。从那以后，莉宝（Ribbon）仅在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）和卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）等游戏中有小规模客串。莉宝（Ribbon）体型显著小巧，但却拥有有足够的力量在飞行时举起卡比（Kirby）和阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）。她有杂乱的粉色头发和红色的莉宝（Ribbon）（以此命名），穿红色连衣裙、白色裤子、棕色鞋子（在卡比（Kirby）64中为黄色）、蓝色眼睛和红润的脸颊。
wikirby-page:275.description_en:
“A fairy from Ripple Star, 莉宝（Ribbon） escapes the planet with the fairies' Crystal, only to fall victim to a 暗物质（Dark Matter） ambush. When she loses control of the Crystal, she turns to 卡比（Kirby） for help.”
— 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） instruction booklet (North America), page 22
莉宝（Ribbon） is a small Fairy from Ripple Star who made her debut in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. She serves under her home planet's Queen and watches over the Crystal - an object with the power to dispel 暗物质（Dark Matter）. She forms one part of the 莉宝水晶（Ribbon's Crystal） ability, and is also paired up with 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. Since then, 莉宝（Ribbon） has made only small cameo appearances in games such as 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash） and 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）. 莉宝（Ribbon） is notably small, and yet has enough strength to pick up both 卡比（Kirby） and 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） while flying. She has messy pink hair with a red 莉宝（Ribbon） (after which she is named), a red dress, white pants, brown shoes (yellow in 卡比（Kirby） 64), blue eyes, and rosy cheeks.

wikirby-page:12363.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:12363.description_zh:
瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）是卡比（Kirby）在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的朋友和伙伴之一。他是唯一出现在本作中的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），因此没有头饰或其他装饰。在卡比（Kirby）64中，瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）在卡比（Kirby）将他从邪恶的云（Dark Matter）的附身中解救出来后加入了卡比（Kirby）的团队。虽然在故事模式中无法直接操作，但瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）会出现在某些关卡中帮助卡比（Kirby），通常是提供可乘坐的交通工具，或打穿地板和天花板的洞。

自卡比（Kirby）64以来，这名瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）尚未被确认在其他游戏中有新的实体出现，但已经被多次提及。
wikirby-page:12363.description_en:
瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s friends and companions in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. He is the only 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） to appear in this game and thus has no headgear or other adornments. In 卡比（Kirby） 64, 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） joins 卡比（Kirby）'s team after 卡比（Kirby） frees him from possession by 邪恶的云（Dark Matter）. While not directly playable in the story mode, 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） appears in some of the stages to help 卡比（Kirby）, usually by giving him something to ride in, or busting holes in floors and ceilings.

Since 卡比（Kirby） 64, this 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） has not been confirmed to have made any more physical appearances in other games, but has been referenced a number of times.

wikirby-page:835.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:835.description_zh:
Bivolt是一个带有简单面孔的活电火花，它偶尔会在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中出现作为一种危险。在某些可攀爬的物体上，如绳索、链条或电线，Bivolt会出现在顶部或底部，并沿着物体的长度移动，如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它移动路径上的生物，就会受到伤害。一旦到达物体另一端，Bivolt就会消失。卡比（Kirby）无法以任何方式攻击Bivolt，因此它是应该避免而不是遭遇的存在。

Bivolt也出现在第28个Enemy Info Card上。
wikirby-page:835.description_en:
Bivolt is a living spark of electricity with a simple face that appears as an occasional hazard in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. On certain climbable objects such as ropes, chains, or wires, Bivolt will appear at the top or bottom and proceed to travel along the length of the object, damaging 卡比（Kirby） if he comes in contact with the creature on its path. Once on the other end of the object, Bivolt will then disappear. 卡比（Kirby） cannot attack Bivolt in any way, making it something to be avoided rather than fought.

Bivolt also appears on the 28th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:839.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:839.description_zh:
Blowfish是一种绿色的水生敌人，只在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的Aqua Star上大量出现，在浅水区游动。与现实生活中的对应物不同，这种鱼如果卡比（Kirby）靠得太近会爆炸，如果卡比（Kirby）在它有机会爆炸之前吸入并吞下这个敌人，他将获得炸弹（Bomb）能力。如果卡比（Kirby）试图把Blowfish举过头顶，它在短时间后会爆炸，这对卡比（Kirby）同样危险。

在Stage 4 of的Aqua Star中，出现了一个大型Blowfish作为中BOSS。与较小的Blowfish不同，这个敌人不会爆炸，而是简单地在一个圈内游动，碰到卡比（Kirby）会造成伤害。它可以在反复攻击后被击败。
wikirby-page:839.description_en:
Blowfish is a green, aquatic foe exclusively found in abundance on Aqua Star in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, swimming about the shallow waters. Unlike its real life counterpart, this fish will explode if 卡比（Kirby） comes too close, and in the situation that 卡比（Kirby） inhales and swallows this enemy before it has the chance to blow up, he will gain the 炸弹（Bomb） ability. If 卡比（Kirby） tries to hold the Blowfish above his head, it will blow up after a short time, which is equally dangerous for 卡比（Kirby）.

In Stage 4 of Aqua Star, a large Blowfish appears as a mid-boss. Unlike smaller Blowfish, this enemy does not explode, and instead simply swims around in a circle, hurting 卡比（Kirby） on contact. It can be defeated after repeated attacks.

wikirby-page:11185.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11185.description_zh: 离开Bo是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。它首次出现在Stage 3 of Rock Star。如果吞下它，它不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。Bo是一个带有白色眼睛的黑色烟雾球。它在空中缓慢移动，如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它，会受到伤害。Bo看起来随机短暂移动，但似乎至少在某种程度上会寻找卡比（Kirby），如果他长时间保持不动，最终会与他接触。Bo通常可以成小群出现，看起来像一群虫子，但动作并不一致。如果卡比（Kirby）试图将Bo举过头顶，它会立即消散。
wikirby-page:11185.description_en: left Bo is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 3 of Rock Star. It does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. Bo is a black orb of smoke with white eyes. It moves about slowly through the air, and will harm 卡比（Kirby） if he makes contact with it. Bo appears to move randomly in short bursts, but does seem to seek 卡比（Kirby） at least somewhat, eventually coming into contact with him if he holds still for a long time. Bo can typically be found in small groups, appearing like a swarm of bugs, though not acting in unison. If 卡比（Kirby） attempts to hold Bo above his head, it will instantly dissipate.

wikirby-page:11183.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11183.description_zh:
左边Bonehead是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。它首次出现在Rock Star的第三关。如果吞下它，它不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Bonehead是一个躺在地上的骷髅。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会开始摇晃，然后长出翅膀。从这里，它会尝试向卡比（Kirby）冲锋或俯冲攻击，撞到墙壁或地板后会掉回地面，并失去翅膀。如果它活着，它会再次尝试这个动作.

它的名字来源于“Bonehead”一词，意思是“愚蠢的人”，同时也指它像骷髅的外形.
wikirby-page:11183.description_en:
left Bonehead is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 3 of Rock Star. It does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Bonehead is a skull that lies on the ground. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, it start to wobble about, then it sprouts wings. From here, it will attempt to charge or divebomb 卡比（Kirby）, falling back onto the ground and losing its wings once it hits a wall or the floor. If left alive, it will try to do this trick again.

Its name comes from the term "Bonehead", meaning "a foolish person", while also referring to its resemblance to a skull.

wikirby-page:11163.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11163.description_zh:
左Bumber是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人。它首次出现在波普之星（Popstar）的第2关。吞下它不会提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。Bumber是一种生物，由一个圆形的橙色头部和两只珠状眼睛组成，并戴着一个白色和紫色的太阳伞帽。它用这顶帽子轻轻飘到地面，然后从地面上长出紫色的脚开始走动。它接触到卡比（Kirby）时会造成伤害，但速度相当慢，而且很容易被吸入。

当卡比（Kirby）把Bumber举在头顶时，可以用它轻轻向下漂浮，好像在使用它的Parasol一样。
wikirby-page:11163.description_en:
left Bumber is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 2 of 波普之星（Popstar）. It does not provide any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Bumber is a creature which consists of a round orange head with two bead-like eyes, and a white and purple parasol hat. It uses this hat to gently float to the ground, and then from there, it will sprout purple feet and start walking about. It will hurt 卡比（Kirby） on contact, but it is fairly slow, and can be inhaled rather easily.

When 卡比（Kirby） holds a Bumber over his head, he can use it to float gently downward, as if he was using his Parasol.

wikirby-page:812.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:812.description_zh:
K64 Burnis精灵.png Burnis是一种类似凤凰的敌人，出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中，通常在温暖的火山地区飞行。在飞行时，它们会掉落仅能伤害卡比（Kirby）的火球，并在被吞食时赋予他燃烧（Burning）复制能力。Burnis看起来像小鸡，只是它的整个身体都是由火组成，嘴巴和眼睛除外。Burnis通常会在设定区域内来回移动，随机或在卡比（Kirby）靠近时投掷火球。它不会主动追击卡比（Kirby），只会继续沿着路线移动而不在意他的位置。它们的冰系对应物是Frigis。

大型Burnis作为中期Boss出现在Stage 4 of Shiver Star。这只Burnis在墙壁的管道中来回飞行，并不断掉落燃烧的火星。需要多次攻击才能击败。
wikirby-page:812.description_en:
K64 Burnis Sprite.png Burnis is a phoenix-like enemy seen in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, often flying around warm, volcanic regions. While flying, they drop pellets of fire made only to injure 卡比（Kirby）, and provide him with the 燃烧（Burning） copy ability when ingested. Burnis resembles a baby chick, except that its entire body consists of fire, save for its beak and eyes. Burnis will usually move back and forth over a set area, dropping fire at random intervals or at 卡比（Kirby） if he is near. It does not pursue 卡比（Kirby） actively and will merely continue along its path with no regard for his location. Their icy counterpart is Frigis.

A large Burnis appears as a Mid-Boss in Stage 4 of Shiver Star. This Burnis flies back and forth through pipes in the wall and continuously drops burning embers. It takes several hits to defeat.

wikirby-page:4801.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:4801.description_zh:
Cairn是一堆由三个活的椭圆形岩石组成的石堆，它们在大小和颜色上各不相同，向“头部”岩石逐渐变小，头部岩石有一双黑色珠状眼睛。它可以在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中作为一种相对常见的敌人出现，在那里它可以看到以不同跳跃高度的固定模式跳动或者原地跳动，如果被卡比（Kirby）吸入并吞下，会提供石块（Stone）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Cairn的岩石彼此没有连接，这导致Cairn的碎片在移动时会分开然后再聚集。这种分离特性意味着，如果卡比（Kirby）拿起并投掷Cairn，它会碎裂成块，每一块都会成为一个独立的弧形抛射物，对在撞击时敌人或单独与其他赋予能力的敌人或Ability Star结合以产生Power Combo.
wikirby-page:4801.description_en:
Cairn is a stack of three living oval-shaped rocks which differ in size and color, getting smaller toward the "head" rock which has two black beady eyes. It can be found as a relatively common enemy in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, where it can be seen hopping around or in place in a set pattern of differing jump heights and offers the 石块（Stone） 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled and swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

Cairn's stones are not attached to each other, which causes Cairn's pieces to fly apart and then come back together while it is moving. This detached nature means that if 卡比（Kirby） holds and throws a Cairn, it will fall to pieces, and each piece will become a separate arcing projectile which can deal damage to enemies on impact or individually combine with other ability-granting enemies or Ability Stars to make Power Combos.

wikirby-page:11202.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11202.description_zh:
K64 Chacha Sprite.png Chacha是一种较为罕见的敌人，可以在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中找到，首次出现于Stage 1 of Aqua Star。如果被吞下，它不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Chacha是一个戴着草裙、拿着两个沙锤的球形生物，它在原地跳舞时会挥舞沙锤。如果卡比（Kirby）靠近，Chacha会用沙锤对其方向进行一系列快速攻击，这可能会伤到他。然而，它通常被看到在背景中，卡比（Kirby）完全无法与其互动。

Chacha也曾计划作为可选图案包含在Kirby Family中，这是一款已取消的Game Boy Color应用程序，可以将图案发送到缝纫机进行制作。
wikirby-page:11202.description_en:
K64 Chacha Sprite.png Chacha is a somewhat uncommon enemy that can be found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first appearing in Stage 1 of Aqua Star. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Chacha is a spherical creature with a grass skirt and two maracas, which it flails about as it dances in place. If 卡比（Kirby） approaches, Chacha will make a series of quick strikes in his direction with the maracas, which can hurt him. Often, however, it is seen in the background, where 卡比（Kirby） cannot interact with it at all.

Chacha was also planned to be included as a selectable pattern in Kirby Family, a canceled application for the Game Boy Color that would send a pattern to a sewing machine for it to make.

wikirby-page:11213.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11213.description_zh:
左Drop是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人，首次出现在Neo Star的第2阶段。当吞下时，它不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Drop是一种蓝色液体、内部有红眼的活体Drop——看起来类似变形虫。它会在天花板上悬挂，当卡比（Kirby）接近时掉下来，目的是接触他并伤害他。与大多数敌人不同，如果卡比（Kirby）尝试把它举过头顶，Drop会立即消散。
wikirby-page:11213.description_en:
left Drop is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first sighted in Stage 2 of Neo Star. It does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Drop is a living Drop of blue fluid with a red eye inside - looking similar to an amoeba. It hangs about on ceilings, then drops down when 卡比（Kirby） approaches, the intent being to make contact with him and do him harm. Unlike most enemies, Drop will instantly disintegrate if 卡比（Kirby） attempts to hold it over his head.

wikirby-page:2831.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:2831.description_zh:
K64 Emp精灵.png Emp是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一只企鹅敌人。它首次出现在Aqua Star的Stage 1中，被吞下时会掉落冰冻（Ice）复制能力（Copy Ability）。当它看到卡比（Kirby）时，它会试图用肚子滑开，但它只能滑一段距离。Emp也出现在第67个Enemy Info Card。

鉴于Emps所基于的动物，其名称很可能来自一种被称为Emperor Penguins的企鹅物种。

Emp也曾计划作为可选图案包含在Kirby Family中，这是一款取消的Game Boy Color应用程序，原本可以将图案发送到缝纫机进行制作。
wikirby-page:2831.description_en:
K64 Emp Sprite.png Emp is a penguin enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 1 of Aqua Star and yields the 冰冻（Ice） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. When it spots 卡比（Kirby）, it will attempt to slide away on its belly, but it can only slide so far. Emp also appears on the 67th Enemy Info Card.

Given the animal that Emps are based on, it is likely that their name comes from a species of penguin known as Emperor Penguins.

Emp was also planned to be included as a selectable pattern in Kirby Family, a canceled application for the Game Boy Color that would send a pattern to a sewing machine for it to make.

wikirby-page:843.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:843.description_zh:
K64 Fishbone精灵.png Fishbone是一种悬浮的敌人，以能够向卡比（Kirby）发射类似其头部的投射物而闻名，首次出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中，此后未在其他游戏中出现。虽然在水下关卡中很常见，但这些敌人也可以在空中漂浮，通常在Star Block上方，或者出现在小洞穴中，从那里他们试图伏击并用他们回旋镖形状的骨头射击卡比（Kirby）。通过吞食这些生物，卡比（Kirby）可以获得弯刀（Cutter）能力。卡比（Kirby）也可以将Fishbone举过头顶，利用其攻击击中其他敌人。Fishbone看起来是扁平的，但它的各个部分确实有一定的深度。

是Fishbone的一个更大变体作为Rock Star中Stage 3的中级Boss。它会固定在原地，同时较小的鱼骨会出现在它附近。大型Fishbone会转向面对卡比（Kirby），但不会主动攻击，只有当他与其碰撞时才会造成伤害。需要多次攻击才能击败。
wikirby-page:843.description_en:
K64 Fishbone Sprite.png Fishbone is a hovering foe noted for its ability to shoot projectiles at 卡比（Kirby） that resemble its head, debuting in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, and appearing in no game since then. While common to underwater stages, these enemies can also float in thin air, usually above a Star Block, or within a small cave, from which they attempt to ambush and shoot 卡比（Kirby） with their boomerang-shaped bones. By ingesting these creatures, 卡比（Kirby） obtains the 弯刀（Cutter） ability. 卡比（Kirby） can also hold a Fishbone above his head to use its attack to hit other enemies. Fishbone appears to be flat, but its segments do have a small amount of depth to them.

A larger variant of Fishbone appears as a Mid-Boss in Stage 3 of Rock Star. It sits in place while smaller Fishbones appear near it. The large Fishbone will turn to face 卡比（Kirby）, but will not attack of its own accord, only harming him if he collides into it. It takes several hits to defeat.

wikirby-page:11175.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11175.description_zh:
左Flopper是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。在Rock Star的第一关首次出现。如果被吞下，不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。Flopper是一种红色身体、白色腹部、黄色鳍的鱼。Flopper通常出现在陆地上，在原地扑腾，因此得名。当在水中时，Flopper经常会跳出水面试图抓住卡比（Kirby）。鉴于卡比（Kirby）在本作标题中可以在水下吸气，因此Flopper可以被抓起来放在卡比（Kirby）的头上，帮助他更快地游过水域。

扑腾鱼也作为障碍物出现在100-Yard Hop的高难度关卡中，它们保持原地扑腾。当踩到赛跑者时会让其滑倒，然后消失，在较低难度设置中，其功能与香蕉皮完全相同。
wikirby-page:11175.description_en:
left Flopper is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 1 of Rock Star. It does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. Flopper is a fish with a red body, white belly and yellow fins. Flopper is usually seen on land flopping around in place, hence its name. When in water, Flopper will often leap out of it to try and catch 卡比（Kirby）. Given that 卡比（Kirby） can inhale underwater in the title this enemy appears in, Flopper can then be held over 卡比（Kirby）'s head to help him swim through the water faster.

Floppers also appear as obstacles in the intense level of 100-Yard Hop, where they stay in place, flopping. They slip up a racer when landed on and then disappear, functioning identically to the banana peel in lower difficulty settings.

wikirby-page:11211.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11211.description_zh:
左边的Flora是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人，首次出现在Neo Star的第1阶段。吞下它不会获得任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。Flora类似于一个原始的花头，一侧有一个面孔。它在空中缓慢旋转，等待卡比（Kirby）意外与其碰撞。如果卡比（Kirby）将其托在头顶，他可以利用它轻轻下降，方式类似于Parasol能力。

Flora也在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中短暂亮相，在“A Delicious Picnic”Celebration Picture中出现在图像的左侧背景。

Flora原本也计划作为可选图案出现在Kirby Family中，这是一个为Game Boy Color策划但已取消的应用程序会向缝纫机发送一个图案，让它制作。
wikirby-page:11211.description_en:
left Flora is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first sighted in Stage 1 of Neo Star. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Flora resembles a primitive flower head, with a face on one side. It spins about slowly in the air, waiting for 卡比（Kirby） to collide with it on accident. If 卡比（Kirby） holds one over his head, he can use it to float gently downward, in a similar fashion to the Parasol ability.

Flora also makes a small cameo in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, in the "A Delicious Picnic" Celebration Picture, appearing in the background on the left side of the image.

Flora was also planned to be included as a selectable pattern in Kirby Family, a canceled application for the Game Boy Color that would send a pattern to a sewing machine for it to make.

wikirby-page:11225.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11225.description_zh:
Flutter是出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的“敌人”。Flutter只是一只小白蝴蝶。它有时可以在地上被发现，如果卡比（Kirby）接近，它会飞动。它不能伤害他，他也不能伤害它。尽管如此，它仍被纳入Enemy Info Card。

Flutter类似于在星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）的各个阶段中发现的蝴蝶，它们的主要区别是那些蝴蝶有不同的颜色，而Flutter仅为白色。
wikirby-page:11225.description_en:
Flutter is an "enemy" which appears in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Flutter is nothing more than a small white butterfly. It can sometimes be found on the ground, and will Flutter about if 卡比（Kirby） gets near. It cannot harm him, and he cannot harm it. Despite this, it is included as an Enemy Info Card.

Flutter is similar to the butterflies found in various stages in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, their main difference being that those butterflies have different colors, while Flutter is only white.

wikirby-page:810.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:810.description_zh: K64 Frigis精灵.png Frigis是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一个冰冻、类似鸟类的敌人，最常出现在Shiver Star的雪覆盖关卡中。被吞食后，它会赋予卡比（Kirby）冰冻（Ice）的复制能力。Frigis在天空中水平飞行，并通过在卡比（Kirby）头上“投放”冰冷颗粒进行攻击。Frigis的名字来源于“frigid”一词。它的火焰对应敌人是Burnis，尽管Frigis相对罕见。
wikirby-page:810.description_en: K64 Frigis Sprite.png Frigis is a frozen, bird-like enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that appears most frequently during the snow-covered stages of Shiver Star. When ingested, it provides 卡比（Kirby） the 冰冻（Ice） copy ability. Frigis flies horizontally across the sky and attacks by "dropping" chilly pellets on 卡比（Kirby）'s head. Frigis' name is a derivative of the word "frigid". Its fiery counterpart is Burnis, though Frigis is considerably rarer.

wikirby-page:7510.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:7510.description_zh:
左侧的Ghost Knight是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。Ghost骑士是圆形的蓝色幽灵，有一只眼睛和一张微笑的嘴巴。他们持有一把红色尖端的白色长矛和一个蓝色盾牌。使用盾牌，他们可以抵挡Star Bullet和其他一些投射物。

当被吞下时，卡比（Kirby）将获得针（Needle）能力。卡比（Kirby）还可以将它们举过头顶，用盾牌阻挡敌人的投射物。他们总是保持静止，并试图用长矛刺击卡比（Kirby）。

在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）可以画出一个Ghost Knight，它会通过向前移动并用长矛刺击敌人来为她战斗。
wikirby-page:7510.description_en:
left Ghost Knight is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Ghost Knights are round, blue ghosts with a single eye and a smiling mouth. They carry a large white lance with a red tip and a blue shield. With the shield, they can deflect Star Bullets and some other projectiles.

When swallowed, 卡比（Kirby） will gain the 针（Needle） ability. 卡比（Kirby） can also hold them above his head to block enemy projectiles using their shield. They always remain stationary and attempt to stab 卡比（Kirby） by thrusting with their lances.

In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） can paint a Ghost Knight which will fight for her by moving forward and jabbing foes with its lance.

wikirby-page:527.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:527.description_zh: 左Glom是一种无敌的类两栖危险生物，只会出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。Glom在Enemy Info Card #22中有命名和表现。
wikirby-page:527.description_en: left Glom is an invulnerable amphibian-like hazard that only appears in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Glom is named and represented in Enemy Info Card #22.

wikirby-page:11177.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11177.description_zh:
Gobblin是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人，首次出现在Rock Star的第1阶段。它大部分时间无敌，并充当关卡中的危险。但卡比（Kirby）可以通过在它扑向前景时吸入其头部来击败它。

Gobblin类似仙人掌，拥有带刺的身体和鳄鱼般的头。它原地坐着并摇晃，等待卡比（Kirby）接近。然后它会冲向前景，并试图咬卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:11177.description_en:
Gobblin is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first encountered in Stage 1 of Rock Star. It is mostly invulnerable, and serves as a stage hazard. However, 卡比（Kirby） can defeat it by inhaling its head when it lunges into the foreground.

Gobblin resembles a cactus, with a thorny body and a head like an alligator. It sits in place and wobbles about, waiting for 卡比（Kirby） to approach. Then it will lurch into the foreground and attempt to bite 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:11179.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11179.description_zh:
K64 Hack Sprite.png Hack是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人，首次在Rock Star的第2关遭遇。尽管它看起来像一把斧头，但被吞下时会获得石块（Stone）的能力，而不是弯刀（Cutter）。Hack也出现在第51个Enemy Info Card。

Hack是一个具有人形的斧头，长着脚。它会原地停着，直到发现卡比（Kirby），然后冲向他并试图撞向他。
wikirby-page:11179.description_en:
K64 Hack Sprite.png Hack is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first encountered in stage 2 of Rock Star. Despite its appearance as a hatchet, it yields the 石块（Stone） ability when swallowed, as opposed to 弯刀（Cutter）. Hack also appears on the 51st Enemy Info Card.

Hack is an anthropomorphic hatchet with feet. It sits in place until it spots 卡比（Kirby）, prompting it to rush him down and try to smash into him.

wikirby-page:11228.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11228.description_zh:
左Ignus是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一个关卡危险物，首次出现在Neo Star的第4关。吞下后不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Ignus只是从天上落下的一块火山岩。它有三种尺寸。最小的一块仅比鹅卵石稍大，落地时会立即碎裂。中等的一块大小与卡比（Kirby）相当，落地后会弹跳一次再破裂。大的比卡比（Kirby）还要大，落地后会分裂成两块中等大小的Ignus。Ignus会持续从天上掉落，所以不可能清理掉所有的它们。
wikirby-page:11228.description_en:
left Ignus is a stage hazard from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first seen in Stage 4 of Neo Star. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Ignus is little more than a chunk of volcanic rock that will rain down from the sky. It comes in three sizes. The smallest one is barely larger than a pebble, and will break immediately upon hitting the ground. The medium one is comparable to 卡比（Kirby） in size, and will bounce once on the ground before breaking. The large ones are bigger than 卡比（Kirby）, and will split into two medium Ignus when they hit the ground. Ignus will fall continuously from the sky, so it is not possible to dispose of all of them.

wikirby-page:22927.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:22927.description_zh:
左侧I³是一种无敌的敌人和危险物，首次出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。它是一个带圆角的绿色梯形盒子，前侧有一个大眼睛。I³是无敌的，会反复上下移动，试图落在卡比（Kirby）上并伤害他。虽然如果它碰到卡比（Kirby）或者他碰到它会对他造成伤害，但它无法将他压扁，只会像其他敌人一样对他造成一条生命的伤害并将他击退。I³还出现在第32个Enemy Info Card中。

在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）可以在I³上涂色，使其通过向前跳跃，然后落到敌人身上来攻击敌人。
wikirby-page:22927.description_en:
left I³ is a type of invincible enemy and hazard which debuted in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is a green trapezoidal box with rounded edges and a single, large eye on its front side. I³ is invincible and repeatedly moves up and down, attempting to land on 卡比（Kirby） and do him harm. While it will hurt 卡比（Kirby） if it hits him or he touches it, it cannot crush him, instead just dealing him one bar of damage and knocking him away like any other enemy. I³ also appears on the 32nd Enemy Info Card.

In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） can paint an I³ which will fight her enemies by leaping forward, then landing on them.

wikirby-page:11173.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11173.description_zh:
K64 Kacti精灵.png Kacti是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。它首次出现在Rock Star的第一关。吞下它后会获得针（Needle）能力。Kacti也会出现在第60个Enemy Info Card。

Kacti是一个小型绿色生物，有两条像仙人掌一样的沉重手臂，没有脚。它保持静止，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近。一旦发生这种情况，它会开始在原地滚动，来回移动。如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它，会受到伤害，但可以安全吸入。Kacti也可能会在原地上下弹跳。

 Kacti的大型版本作为Rock Star第一关的中期Boss出现。它在沙堆上原地跳动，并执行不会主动尝试攻击卡比（Kirby）。相反，一堆较小的Kacti出现在它下面，如果有必要，卡比（Kirby）可以将其作为弹药使用。
wikirby-page:11173.description_en:
K64 Kacti Sprite.png Kacti is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 1 of Rock Star. It yields the 针（Needle） ability when swallowed. Kacti also appears on the 60th Enemy Info Card.

Kacti is a small green creature with two heavy arms raised like a cactus, and no feet. It remains motionless until 卡比（Kirby） gets near. Once this happens, it will start to roll about the place, moving back and forth. It will do 卡比（Kirby） harm if he touches it, but it can be inhaled without issue. Kacti may also be seen bouncing up and down in place.

A large version of Kacti appears as a mid-boss in stage 1 of Rock Star. It hops in place atop a sand pile and does not actively try to attack 卡比（Kirby）. Instead, a bunch of smaller Kacti appear below it which 卡比（Kirby） can use as ammunition if necessary.

wikirby-page:836.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:836.description_zh:
左边的Mahall是一种小型、生活在地面的敌人，当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，它会将小脑袋伸出地面，在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。Mahall在首次接近时看起来像一个绿色的圆盘，但受到威胁时会跳起来，并向卡比（Kirby）吐出一个弱小的泡泡。如果卡比（Kirby）试图在Mahall隐藏时走过去或用Slide攻击它，Mahall会爆炸，对卡比（Kirby）造成伤害。像星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的其他几个敌人一样，吞食Mahall不会获得能力复制。

Mahall也出现在第23个Enemy Info Card上。
wikirby-page:836.description_en:
left Mahall is a small, ground-dwelling foe that pokes its small head above the ground when 卡比（Kirby） comes close, in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Mahall appears as a green plate when first approached, but springs up when threatened and spits a weak little bubble at 卡比（Kirby）. If 卡比（Kirby） tries to walk over Mahall while it is concealed or tries to hit him with a Slide attack, Mahall will explode, dealing damage to 卡比（Kirby） in the process. Like several other enemies in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, when ingested, Mahall does not yield a copy ability.

Mahall also appears on the 23rd Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:813.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:813.description_zh:
左颚魔是一种大颚、以其名命名的敌人，类似于Ghost Knight，但没有护甲，栖息在罕见的区域，无论是在Shiver Star - Stage 2的云层中，还是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中Shiver Star - Stage 1的冰下。它潜伏等待卡比（Kirby）接近，然后尝试用嘴将其抓住。如果成功，它会咀嚼片刻，然后吐出，造成伤害。它无法被吸入，并且功能与其他游戏中的帕克特（Pacto）完全相同。

Maw也会出现在第44个Enemy Info Card。
wikirby-page:813.description_en:
leftMaw is a large-mandible, eponymous foe resemblant of Ghost Knight without its armor that dwells in seldom-seen areas, whether it be within the clouds within Shiver Star - Stage 2, or from below the ice as in Shiver Star - Stage 1 in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It lies in wait for 卡比（Kirby） to approach, then it will attempt to snatch him up in its mouth. If successful, it will chew for a moment, then spit him out, dealing damage. It cannot be inhaled, and functions exactly like 帕克特（Pacto） does in other games.

Maw also appears on the 44th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:11165.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11165.description_zh:
K64 Mite精灵.png Mite是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中找到的敌人。它是一个小型橙色生物，身体圆润，有两个小黑点作为眼睛，一个小巧的吻部，以及四条肢体，其中前两条较长并带有爪子。Mite大部分时间都待在地下，但当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会挖到地面上。从那里，它会向卡比（Kirby）奔跑，试图与其碰撞造成伤害。Mite容易被任何攻击击败，并且可以被吸入，但吞下它不会给予卡比（Kirby）任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。如果卡比（Kirby）拿着并扔出Mite，它会落在离他不远的地方，然后再次钻回地下，显然并未因处于卡比（Kirby）的mouth.

Mite还出现在第40个Enemy Info Card.
wikirby-page:11165.description_en:
K64 Mite Sprite.png Mite is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is a small orange creature with a round body, two small black dots for eyes, a petite snout, and four limbs, the front two of which are longer and have claws. Mite spends most of its time underground, but will dig up to the surface when 卡比（Kirby） approaches. From there, it will run toward 卡比（Kirby）, aiming to collide with him and do damage. Mite is easily defeated by any attack and can be inhaled, but swallowing it does not grant 卡比（Kirby） any 复制能力（Copy Ability）. If 卡比（Kirby） holds and throws Mite, it will land a short distance away from him and then burrow back underground, apparently unfazed from being in 卡比（Kirby）'s mouth.

Mite also appears on the 40th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:502.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:502.description_zh: K64恩之（N-Z）精灵.png恩之（N-Z）是一种仅在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中出现的敌人。它是一个灰色球形生物，大小类似卡比（Kirby），有尖尖的猫耳朵、白色的脚和小黑眼睛，模糊地类似尖耳怪（Scarfy），虽然没有嘴。它要么原地站立，要么向前走，若靠近边缘则会转身。恩之（N-Z）被吸入并吞下时不会给卡比（Kirby）任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。在Pop Star的第一关有一个更大的中boss变体恩之（N-Z），它会原地坐着，同时周围会出现更小的N-Z。恩之（N-Z）还出现在第10个Enemy Info Card.
wikirby-page:502.description_en: K64 恩之（N-Z） Sprite.png 恩之（N-Z） is an enemy that appears only in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is a gray spherical creature similar in size to 卡比（Kirby） with pointy cat-like ears, white feet and small black eyes, vaguely resembling a 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, though with no mouth. It either stands in place or walks forward, turning around if it is near an edge. 恩之（N-Z） does not give any 复制能力（Copy Ability） to 卡比（Kirby） when inhaled and swallowed. There is a bigger mid-boss variant of 恩之（N-Z） in the first stage of Pop Star which sits in place as smaller N-Zs spawn around it. 恩之（N-Z） also appears on the 10th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:11181.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11181.description_zh:
K64 Noo精灵.png Noo是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一种苍白透明、鬼魂般的敌人。它会在Rock Star的第2阶段出现，在其中一个房间里少量出现，作为阶段性的障碍，无法被击败。这个敌人的外观由圆形的身体和分离的双手组成，并且有一张夸张的脸。Noo会从墙上的洞中出现，并在消失前向卡比（Kirby）投掷炭火。这种炭火会沿浅弧线飞行，然后迅速下降，如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它会受到伤害。

Noo也会出现在第47个Enemy Info Card。
wikirby-page:11181.description_en:
K64 Noo Sprite.png Noo is a pale translucent ghost-like enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is encountered in Stage 2 of Rock Star, where a small number of them serve as a stage hazard in one room and cannot be defeated. This foe's appearance consists of a round body and disembodied hands, and sports a dramatic face. Noo emerges from holes in the wall and will toss an ember at 卡比（Kirby） before disappearing. This ember travels in a shallow arc before dropping quickly down and will damage 卡比（Kirby） if he touches it.

Noo also appears on the 47th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:11206.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11206.description_zh: Pedo是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一种水生鱼雷形敌人。被吞下后，它会赋予炸弹（Bomb）能力。Pedo也会出现在第46个Enemy Info Card上。Pedo看起来像一个绿色导弹，带有黄色尖端，能够在水下运作。它会从墙上的洞口射出，并且会以相当快的速度沿直线路径射出。如果卡比（Kirby）与它接触，它会在他面前爆炸。如果Pedi眼睛睁开，它们也会追踪卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:11206.description_en: Pedo is an aquatic torpedo-shaped enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It yields the 炸弹（Bomb） ability when swallowed. Pedo also appears on the 46th Enemy Info Card. Pedo resembles a green missile with a yellow tip, which operates underwater. It shoots out from holes in the walls, and will shoot in a straight path fairly quickly. If 卡比（Kirby） makes contact with it, it will blow up in his face. Pedos can also seek 卡比（Kirby）, if their eyes are open.

wikirby-page:837.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:837.description_zh:
“我是电插头（Plugg）！什么？从没听说过我？电插头（Plugg）已更新为可以发射等离子！他可能并不出名，但对于所有现在无法加入他的人来说，他将为了他们的缘故闪耀光芒！”
— Guest Star Plugg Powered Up暂停画面描述星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
电插头（Plugg）是一个恰如其名的插头状敌人，首次出现于星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）。电插头（Plugg）通常为青色，外形类似电源线的末端（但没有电线本身），头上有两根插脚，两只短胖的脚，眼睛是两个黑点，没有其他面部特征。作为敌人，电插头（Plugg）通过跳起并将插脚插入地面来攻击，产生两侧的小型电波。虽然他的攻击造成的伤害很小，但产生的电火花往往会在熄灭前传播一段距离。作为一个盟友，电插头（Plugg）获得了充能并释放电爆发的能力，就像电离子（Plasma）卡比（Kirby）一样，使他更加强大。
wikirby-page:837.description_en:
“I'm 电插头（Plugg）! What? Never heard of me?" 电插头（Plugg） has been updated to shoot plasma! He might not be well-known, but for all who couldn't join him now, he will shine brightly for all their sakes!”
— Guest Star Plugg Powered Up Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
电插头（Plugg） is an aptly named plug-like enemy that debuted in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. 电插头（Plugg） is typically cyan in color and resembles the end of a power cord (though without the cord itself), with two prongs coming out of his head, two stubby feet, and two black dots for eyes, with no other facial features to speak of. As an enemy, 电插头（Plugg） attacks by jumping up and pushing his prongs into the ground, causing small electrical waves on both sides. While his attacks do minimal damage, the electrical spark it creates tends to travel a bit of a distance before dying out. As an ally, 电插头（Plugg） gains the ability to charge and release bursts of electricity just like 电离子（Plasma） 卡比（Kirby）, making him much more potent.

wikirby-page:11193.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11193.description_zh:
K64 Pompey Sprite.png Pompey是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人，首次在Aqua Star的第一关被发现。被吞下时，它会赋予石块（Stone）能力。它也出现在Enemy Info Card #50。

Pompey看起来像一个蛤蜊，但有一个活火山作为壳。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会固定在原地并从头顶射出火山碎岩。
wikirby-page:11193.description_en:
K64 Pompey Sprite.png Pompey is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first discovered in Stage 1 of Aqua Star. It yields the 石块（Stone） ability when swallowed. It also appears on Enemy Info Card #50.

Pompey resembles a clam, but with an active volcano for a shell. It sits in place, and will shoot out pyroclastic rocks from atop its head when 卡比（Kirby） approaches.

wikirby-page:4816.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:4816.description_zh:
Punc是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的敌人。它看起来像一个球状的黑色生物，有两只小白眼和两只细长的橙色脚。头顶戴着一个绿色头盔，由三个部分组成，每个部分都有一根粗大的黄色尖刺突出。

首次出现在Pop Star的第一关，Puncs来回漫游，偶尔转身，并不会造成很大威胁。然而，当卡比（Kirby）接近它们时，它们会将头盔的部分包裹在自己身上，有效地卷成一个绿黑色的球，并开始在固定区域左右滚动，移动速度略快于行走速度。几秒钟后，它们会恢复正常，但只要卡比（Kirby）保持在它们的范围内，就继续定期重复该过程。

即使蜷缩起来，Puncs也容易受到任何攻击。吸入并吞下它们会赋予卡比（Kirby）针（Needle）能力。
wikirby-page:4816.description_en:
Punc is an enemy in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It appears as a spherical, black creature with two small, white eyes and two elongated, orange feet. Atop its head, it wears a green helmet, consisting of three sections, each with a thick, yellow spike protruding out from it.

First encountered in the first stage of Pop Star, Puncs wander back and forth, occasionally turning around, without posing much of a threat. When 卡比（Kirby） gets too close to them, however, they pull the sections of their helmet around themselves, effectively curling up into a green and black ball, and begin rolling left and right within a set area, moving at a slightly faster pace than their walking speed. After a few seconds, they return to normal, but continue to repeat the process regularly as long as 卡比（Kirby） stays within their range.

Even while curled up, Puncs are vulnerable to any attack. Inhaling and swallowing them grants 卡比（Kirby） the 针（Needle） ability.

wikirby-page:11166.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11166.description_zh:
左Pupa是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人。它首次出现在波普之星（Popstar）的Stage 2中。它不提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability），并且无法吸入。

Pupa是一种无肢体的泪滴状生物，拥有黑色的头（有两只小眼睛）和红黄相间的身体。它从一根绳子上倒挂着，当卡比（Kirby）靠近时会降低位置。它只能通过直接接触伤害卡比（Kirby），并且在降低之后保持静止。卡比（Kirby）无法吸入Pupa，但他可以通过切断绳子轻松击败它，或使用他的能力直接攻击Pupa。当Pupa的绳子被剪断后触地时会爆炸，所以卡比（Kirby）应该采取如果他以这种方式击败它请小心。

在Shiver Star的Stage 3中，Pupa的更大版本作为中期Boss出现。与其较小的同类不同，它的绳索无法被切断，并且在战斗中会反复重新定位。因此，这个Pupa只能通过直接攻击来击败，如果卡比（Kirby）在没有技能的情况下吸入并吐出不断出现在它周围的Bo就可以做到。
wikirby-page:11166.description_en:
left Pupa is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 2 of 波普之星（Popstar）. It does not provide any 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and cannot be inhaled.

Pupa is a limbless teardrop-shaped creature with a black head (with two beady eyes) and striped red and yellow body. It hangs upside-down from a string, lowering its position when 卡比（Kirby） approaches. It can only hurt 卡比（Kirby） by direct contact, and after it lowers, it remains motionless. 卡比（Kirby） cannot inhale Pupa, but he can defeat it easily by cutting its string, or by using his abilities to attack Pupa itself. Pupa will explode when it hits the ground after its string is cut, so 卡比（Kirby） should take caution if he defeats it this way.

A larger version of Pupa appears as a mid-boss in Stage 3 of Shiver Star. Unlike its smaller cousins, its string cannot be cut, and it will repeatedly reposition itself during the fight. As such, this Pupa may only be defeated by directly attacking it, which can be done if 卡比（Kirby） is without an ability by inhaling and spitting the Bos that continuously appear around it.

wikirby-page:11219.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11219.description_zh:
左Putt是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人，首次出现在Shiver Star的第一阶段。吞下它不会获得复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Putt形似一只大头青色蠕虫，头顶有一个小的黄色圆锥形尖。它会坐在一个十二面体棕色Boulder旁边，等待机会用头轻轻将其撞倒。如果这样做，巨石将沿山坡滚下，并可能成为卡比（Kirby）的潜在危险。虽然Putt可以被吸入，其巨石却不能。Putt也会出现在Enemy Info Card #76（没有其巨石）。
wikirby-page:11219.description_en:
left Putt is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first appearing in Stage 1 of Shiver Star. It does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Putt resembles a cyan worm with a large head, bearing a small yellow conical spike on top. It sits next to a dodecahedral brown Boulder and waits for an opportunity to gently knock it over with its head. If this is done, the boulder will then roll downhill and act as a potential hazard for 卡比（Kirby）. While Putt can be inhaled, its boulder cannot be. Putt also appears (without its boulder) on Enemy Info Card #76.

wikirby-page:11223.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11223.description_zh:
左Rockn是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的一种飞行导弹类敌人，被吞下后会赋予炸弹（Bomb）能力。Rockn也出现在第61个Enemy Info Card。

Rockn是一种导弹类生物，拥有蓝色的轴身和黄色的尖端。像Pedo一样，它会通过墙或地板的洞以直线发射。如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它，就会当场爆炸。
wikirby-page:11223.description_en:
left Rockn is a flying missile-like enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） which yields the 炸弹（Bomb） ability when swallowed. Rockn also appears on the 61st Enemy Info Card.

Rockn is a missile-like creature, with a blue shaft and a yellow nose. Like Pedo, it fires in a straight line through holes in the wall or floor. If 卡比（Kirby） makes contact with one, it will blow up in his face.

wikirby-page:2351.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:2351.description_zh: 左Sandman是一种蠕虫状、明亮的黄色沙制生物，在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中作为敌人出现。最初它会以一个小的圆顶状隆起出现在地面上，长着闪亮的黑色眼睛，如果卡比（Kirby）靠近，它会向上伸展，露出黑色的嘴巴，并可能阻挡卡比（Kirby）的路径，但除此之外它不会移动。它伤害卡比（Kirby）的唯一方式是接触。Sandman很容易被任何攻击击败，也可以被吸入，但如果吞下不会掉落任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。如果卡比（Kirby）试图把它举过头顶，它会分解成沙子。
wikirby-page:2351.description_en: left Sandman is a wormlike, bright yellow creature made of sand who appears as an enemy in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Initially appearing as a small, cupola-shaped bump in the ground with beady black eyes, it will stretch upward if 卡比（Kirby） approaches to reveal its black mouth and potentially block 卡比（Kirby）'s path, though otherwise it does not move. Its only method of harming 卡比（Kirby） is by contact. Sandman is easily defeated by any attack and can also be inhaled, though it yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. If 卡比（Kirby） attempts to raise one above his head, it will disintegrate into sand.

wikirby-page:11171.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11171.description_zh:
K64 Sawyer精灵.png Sawyer是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的敌人。玩家首次在波普之星（Popstar）的第三关内遇到它，在城堡内。被吞下后，它会获得弯刀（Cutter）的能力。Sawyer也会出现在Enemy Info Card的第55号关卡。

Sawyer是一个带动画的锯片，中间有一个红色的眼睛。它会通过在地面上滚动并旋转自己刀片来自行移动。它偶尔会短距离跳起，使自己更具危险性。尽管刀刃锋利，卡比（Kirby）吞下它时不会有问题。

 Sawyer的较大中型Boss变种出现在Ripple Star的第一关。它的攻击方式是从在不同位置着陆，而飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）出现在上方的空中。

在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，彩绘比比提安（Vividria）可以画一个Sawyer，它会通过下降并朝目标移动来为她战斗。它仍然可以被卡比（Kirby）吸入，这将赋予弯刀（Cutter）类似于其首次登场游戏的能力。
wikirby-page:11171.description_en:
K64 Sawyer Sprite.png Sawyer is an enemy from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It is first encountered in Stage 3 of 波普之星（Popstar）, inside the castle. It yields the 弯刀（Cutter） ability when swallowed. Sawyer also appears on Enemy Info Card #55.

Sawyer is an animated sawblade, with a red eye in the middle of the blade. It moves around on its own accord by grinding across the ground, spinning its blade as it does so. It will occasionally jump a short distance off the ground just to make itself a little more dangerous. Despite its sharp edges, 卡比（Kirby） will not have a problem inhaling it.

A larger mid-boss variant of Sawyer appears in stage 1 of Ripple Star. It attacks by popping into and out of the ground at different locations while 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）s appear in the air above.

In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 彩绘比比提安（Vividria） can paint a Sawyer which will fight for her by dropping down and moving towards the target. It can still be inhaled by 卡比（Kirby） which will give the 弯刀（Cutter） ability similar to its debut game.

wikirby-page:1265.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:1265.description_zh:
K64 Skud精灵.png Skud是一种在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中偶尔出现的小型火箭状敌人。被摄取后，它会奖励卡比（Kirby）炸弹（Bomb）的复制能力。它的名字指的是飞毛腿导弹。

Skud看起来像一个玩具火箭，白色的箭身和红色的锥形头。它还有一张简单的笑脸和锥体下的红色脚。由于星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的许多敌人都用脚移动，Skud也不例外。然而，当它发现卡比（Kirby）时，它会缩回双脚，长出鱼鳍（并失去脸部），然后发射。它随后会试图追踪卡比（Kirby），但它的转向能力较差。
wikirby-page:1265.description_en:
K64 Skud Sprite.png Skud is a miniature rocket-like enemy seen infrequently in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. When ingested, it rewards 卡比（Kirby） with the 炸弹（Bomb） copy ability. Its name refers to Scud missiles.

Skud resembles a toy rocket, with a white shaft and red cone. It also sports a simple smiling face and red feet under the cone. As many of the foes in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） use feet to move, Skud is no exception. When it spots 卡比（Kirby）, however, it will retract its feet, sprout fins (and lose its face), and launch. It will then attempt to home in on 卡比（Kirby）, but its turning ability is poor.

wikirby-page:11217.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11217.description_zh:
K64 Slushy Sprite.png Slushy是一种罕见的淡色水母状敌人，会出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。它可以在水下找到，轻轻地原地漂浮，通常不会移动。它只能通过碰撞对卡比（Kirby）造成伤害，如果被吸入和吞下，它不会给予卡比（Kirby）任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。然而，如果卡比（Kirby）将Slushy举过头顶，它会缓慢向上脉动，并带着卡比（Kirby）上升。

Slushy也会出现在第19个Enemy Info Card。
wikirby-page:11217.description_en:
K64 Slushy Sprite.png Slushy is an uncommon pale jellyfish-like enemy which appears in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It can be found underwater, gently bobbing in place, though not typically going anywhere. It can only harm 卡比（Kirby） by collision and does not give him any 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled and swallowed. However, if 卡比（Kirby） holds Slushy above his head, it will slowly pulse upward, carrying 卡比（Kirby） with it.

Slushy also appears on the 19th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:11188.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11188.description_zh:
Snipper是一种蚁狮状的剪刀，会从流沙陷阱中飞出来攻击卡比（Kirby）。它刀枪不入，是需要避免的危险。

Snipper是一种有巨大钳子的橙色小生物。它躲在沙坑里，如果卡比（Kirby）走近，它会用巨大的下颚跳起来剪咬他。Snipper经常被看到守护Food和其他物品。
wikirby-page:11188.description_en:
Snipper is an antlion-like pair of scissors which flies out of pits of quicksand to attack 卡比（Kirby）. It is invulnerable and serves as a hazard to be avoided.

Snipper is a small orange creature with huge pincers. It hides inside sand pits, and will jump up with its huge jaws to snip 卡比（Kirby） if he gets close. Snipper can often be seen guarding Food and other items.

wikirby-page:838.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:838.description_zh:
K64 Spark-i精灵.png Spark-i是一种蓝色、菱形的电气敌人，仅出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。它的外部结构会脉动，菱形本身由四个不同的部分组成，这些部分都可以伸缩以掩藏位于核心的暗物质（Dark Matter）样眼睛。像所有标准敌人一样，它的攻击造成的伤害很小，但Spark-i独特的一点是会向卡比（Kirby）的最后位置发射有节奏的火花，这是一种某种追踪装置的产物。当被吸入时，卡比（Kirby）会获得电火花（Spark）的复制能力。当举到头顶时，Spark-i会朝所面方向发射三枚投射物。Spark-i也出现在第16个Enemy Info Card。

一个更大的中boss的Spark-i变体出现在Rock Star的第4阶段。它的功能与其较小的“同类”非常相似，并且固定在位置上，因为较小的电火花（Spark）会持续出现以支撑它。
wikirby-page:838.description_en:
K64 Spark-i Sprite.png Spark-i is a blue, diamond-shaped, electrical enemy seen only in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Its external structure pulsates, with the diamond shape itself made of four distinct sections, all of which can expand and retract to conceal the 暗物质（Dark Matter）-looking eye at its core. Like all standard enemies, its attack deals minimal damage, but unique to Spark-i is in the firing of a rhythmic spark towards 卡比（Kirby）'s last position, as a product of some sort of homing device. When inhaled, 卡比（Kirby） gains the 电火花（Spark） copy ability. When held overhead, a Spark-i will fire three projectiles in the direction it is facing. Spark-i also appears on the 16th Enemy Info Card.

A larger mid-boss variant of Spark-i appears in stage 4 of Rock Star. It functions much the same as its smaller cousins, and sits in place as smaller 电火花（Spark）-is appear continuously to support it.

wikirby-page:11200.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11200.description_zh:
K64 Splinter精灵.png Splinter是来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的关卡危险物，首次出现于Aqua Star的第2阶段。它是无敌的。Splinter也出现在第25个Enemy Info Card上。

Splinter实际上只是一个多刺的木头。当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，它会开始向他滚动，如果碰撞会自然地伤害他。木屑通常成群出现。
wikirby-page:11200.description_en:
K64 Splinter Sprite.png Splinter is a stage hazard from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first seen in Stage 2 of Aqua Star. It is invulnerable. Splinter also appears on the 25th Enemy Info Card.

Splinter is effectively just a spiky log. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, it starts to roll toward him, and will naturally hurt him should it collide. Splinters often come in groups.

wikirby-page:23782.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:23782.description_zh: Squeaky Hammer Machine是一种大型机器人锤，设计用于粉碎Shiver Star - Stage 4工厂地板上的物体，来自星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）。它后来会作为一个关卡危险出现在Factory Tour Battle Stage的所有三款卡比（Kirby）战斗游戏中。
wikirby-page:23782.description_en: Squeaky Hammer Machine is a large robotic hammer designed to crush things on the floor of the factory in Shiver Star - Stage 4, from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It would later appear as a stage hazard on the Factory Tour Battle Stage in all three of the 卡比（Kirby） Fighters games.

wikirby-page:11204.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11204.description_zh:
K64 Squibby精灵.png Squibby是一种可以在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中找到的敌人，首次出现在Aqua Star的第1关。被吞下时，它不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。Squibby还出现在第36个Enemy Info Card。

Squibby是一种半透明的漂浮生物，外形类似海天使，后部尖锐，面部为桃色。它会固定在原地，通常试图与周围环境进行伪装。当它看到卡比（Kirby）时，会从头顶伸出触须，这些触须会伤害他。
wikirby-page:11204.description_en:
K64 Squibby Sprite.png Squibby is an enemy that can be found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first appearing in Stage 1 of Aqua Star. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Squibby also appears on the 36th Enemy Info Card.

Squibby is a translucent floating creature resembling a sea angel, with a pointed posterior and a peach-colored face. It holds in place, usually attempting to camouflage with its surrounding environment. When it sees 卡比（Kirby）, it will extend tentacles from the top of its head, which can harm him.

wikirby-page:11209.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11209.description_zh:
K64 Turbite精灵.png Turbite是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中发现的敌人，首次出现在Rock Star的第2关。当被吞下时，它会提供电火花（Spark）能力。Turbite也出现在第56个Enemy Info Card中。

Turbite由一个紫色球体和四个金属尖刺组成。当它发现卡比（Kirby）时，会向他猛扑，尖刺会发出火花。Turbite能够在空中和水下操作，不受任何环境影响。
wikirby-page:11209.description_en:
K64 Turbite Sprite.png Turbite is an enemy found in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first sighted in Stage 2 of Rock Star. It yields the 电火花（Spark） ability when swallowed. Turbite also appears on the 56th Enemy Info Card.

Turbite consists of a purple orb surrounded by four metallic prongs. When it spots 卡比（Kirby）, it will lurch at him, the prongs emitting sparks. Turbite is capable of operating both in the air and underwater, unimpeded by either environment.

wikirby-page:1267.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:1267.description_zh: 左墙黑大炮（Shotzo）是黑大炮（Shotzo）的墙壁安装变体，黑大炮（Shotzo）出现在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中。它只出现在背景中，因此无法被攻击或直接互动。与普通的Shotzos不同，Wall Shotzo能够直接瞄准卡比（Kirby）的位置，并发射慢速的蓝色能量弹，而不是黑色炮弹。尽管具有这种精准性，Wall Shotzo的反应速度和它的普通同类一样慢，因此卡比（Kirby）应该很容易躲避它的攻击。Wall Shotzo还出现在第71个Enemy Info Card。
wikirby-page:1267.description_en: leftWall 黑大炮（Shotzo） is a wall-mounted variant of 黑大炮（Shotzo） which appears in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It appears only in the background and as such, cannot be attacked or directly interacted with. Unlike regular Shotzos, Wall Shotzo is capable of aiming directly at 卡比（Kirby）'s position, and fires a slow-moving blue energy shot instead of a black cannonball. Despite this precision, Wall Shotzo is just as slow to react as its normal cousin, and as such, 卡比（Kirby） should have an easy time avoiding its fire. Wall Shotzo also appears on the 71st Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:841.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:841.description_zh:
K64 Whispy Jr.精灵.png Whispy Woods Jr.是一个像幼苗一样的小敌人，它会在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的波普之星（Popstar）首领战中与风语大树（Whispy Woods）一起出现。这些树形生物在圆形舞台上跳来跳去，有时会行走，并定期吹出小Air Bullet。三个Whispy Jr.完全同步移动，但尽管它们的体型是卡比（Kirby）的两倍，却不会对他构成重大威胁。即使卡比（Kirby）无法吸入它们，他仍可通过任何可能的方式伤害它们，包括使用复制能力以及在战斗中由风语大树（Whispy Woods）掉落的可用苹果。

Whispy Woods Jr.出现在Enemy Info Card #2。
wikirby-page:841.description_en:
K64 Whispy Jr. Sprite.png Whispy Woods Jr. is a small, sapling-like foe that appears alongside 风语大树（Whispy Woods） during the boss battle on 波普之星（Popstar）, in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. These tree beings jump about the circular stage, walking at times, and blow small Air Bullets in regular intervals. Each of the three Whispy Jr.s move in perfect synchronization with each-other, but do not pose a significant threat to 卡比（Kirby）, despite being twice his size. Even though 卡比（Kirby） cannot inhale them, he can injure them by any means possible including the use of copy abilities and the available apples dropped during the battle by 风语大树（Whispy Woods）.

Whispy Woods Jr. appears on Enemy Info Card #2.

wikirby-page:840.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:840.description_zh:
左Yariko是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中一个像孩子一样的投矛敌人，它会在上方向卡比（Kirby）投掷有节奏的飞行物。外观上，它是一个非常矮小的敌人，有一大撮橙色头发，并且腰间还披着一条小布。Yariko往往会向卡比（Kirby）投掷矛，直到达到他的眼睛高度，这时就可以相当容易地将其打败；然而，尽管Yariko具有类似针（Needle）的倾向，它在被吞下时并不会提供复制能力。它们的设计类似于Yaban。

Yariko也出现在第69个Enemy Info Card。
wikirby-page:840.description_en:
left Yariko is a child-like, spear-throwing enemy in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） that makes its appearances chucking rhythmic projectiles at 卡比（Kirby） from above. Physically, it is a very short foe with a large clump of orange hair, not to mention a small loin cloth draped about its waist. Yariko tends to throw its spears at 卡比（Kirby） up until it is at his eye level, upon which it can then be defeated quite easily; however, Yariko does not yield a copy ability when ingested, despite its 针（Needle）-like inclinations. Their design is similar to Yaban.

Yariko also appears on the 69th Enemy Info Card.

wikirby-page:11198.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:11198.description_zh:
K64 Zoos Sprite.png Zoos是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的一个敌人，首次在Aqua Star的Stage 1中被发现。吞下它会获得电火花（Spark）复制能力（Copy Ability）。Zoos也会出现在第59个Enemy Info Card上。

Zoos是一个小巧灵动的生物，它坐在一朵小雷云上。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会悬停在他上方并试图向他施放闪电。如果卡比（Kirby）正好在其正下方，它会改用从云中掉下的大水滴攻击他。尽管在大多数情况下可以吸入Zoos，但鉴于它通常的位置，卡比（Kirby）可能会难以做到这一点。
wikirby-page:11198.description_en:
K64 Zoos Sprite.png Zoos is an enemy in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, first discovered in Stage 1 of Aqua Star. It yields the 电火花（Spark） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Zoos also appears on the 59th Enemy Info Card.

Zoos is a small spritely creature that sits atop a small thundercloud. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, it will hover over him and attempt to cast lightning down at him. If 卡比（Kirby） is directly underneath, it will instead attack him using a large raindrop from its cloud. Though inhaling Zoos is possible in most cases, 卡比（Kirby） may have difficulty with doing so given its usual position.

wikirby-page:23153.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:23153.description_zh: Big Bouncy是弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）的超大型变体，它在卡比（Kirby）系列中出现过两次，首次亮相是在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中，作为波普之星（Popstar）第二关的中途Boss。从那以后，它直到星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）才再次出现，并且在Heroes in Another Dimension的Guest Star Adeleine & Ribbon Artful Adventurers和Dimension IV中都有出现。
wikirby-page:23153.description_en: Big Bouncy is an extra large variant of 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） which has appeared a total of two times in the 卡比（Kirby） series, making its debut appearance in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards） as a mid-boss in the second stage of 波普之星（Popstar）. From there, it would not appear again until 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, where it appears both in Guest Star Adeleine & Ribbon Artful Adventurers and in Dimension IV of Heroes in Another Dimension.

wikirby-page:273.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:273.description_zh:
K64 02 Sprite.png零二（0²）（也拼写为O²、02和零（Zero）Two）是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）的真正最终Boss，它居住在Dark Star最终世界的中心，其被击败会导致星星爆炸。它与星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的零（Zero）有一些相似之处，但目前尚不清楚它们是否是同一个角色。

零二（0²）也在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）和卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中客串出现。此外，它还以Boss形象出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中，并具有数字化设计。
wikirby-page:273.description_en:
K64 02 Sprite.png 零二（0²） (also spelled O², 02, and 零（Zero） Two) is the true final boss of 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, who inhabits the center of the final world of Dark Star and whose defeat causes the star to explode. It bears some similarities to 零（Zero） from 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）, but it is not known if they are meant to be the same character.

零二（0²） also makes cameo appearances in both 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） and 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）. In addition, it appears as a boss in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, with a digital design.

wikirby-page:269.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:269.description_zh: HR-H是Shiver Star的未来拟人化守护者，在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中战斗。HR-H每次攻击都高度注重身体力量，所有攻击都试图将卡比（Kirby）碎裂或炸成粉末。然而，与之前的Boss一样，HR-H的弱点几乎在其身体上任何地方，卡比（Kirby）都可以命中。根据Enemy Info Card的资料，HR-H在进入第二形态时会将名字改为HR-E。
wikirby-page:269.description_en: HR-H is the futuristic, anthropomorphic guardian of the Shiver Star, battled in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. HR-H places a firm focus on physicality in each of its attacks, all of which attempt to either smash or blow 卡比（Kirby） to smithereens. Like previous bosses, however, HR-H's weak point is practically anywhere on its body that 卡比（Kirby） can land a shot. According to the Enemy Info Cards, HR-H changes its name to HR-E when it enters its second form.

wikirby-page:271.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:271.description_zh: 左容炎（Magman）是Neo Star在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的火焰状、球状Boss。它主要使用基于熔岩的攻击，还可以召唤Magoo和Burnis攻击卡比（Kirby）。战斗在卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们进入容炎（Magman）所居住的洞穴之后开始。
wikirby-page:271.description_en: left 容炎（Magman） is the fiery, glob-like boss of Neo Star in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It mainly uses lava-based attacks, and can also summon Magoo and Burnis to attack 卡比（Kirby）. The battle begins after 卡比（Kirby） and his friends make their way into the cavern 容炎（Magman） makes its home in.

wikirby-page:272.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:272.description_zh: K64 Miracle Matter Sprite.png Miracle Matter是星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中Ripple Star领域的变形组成Boss。如果卡比（Kirby）尚未收集所有之前的Crystal Shard，它将是导致坏结局的最终Boss。收集所有之前的碎片并击败Miracle Matter将解锁Dark Star以及真正的最终Boss。
wikirby-page:272.description_en: K64 Miracle Matter Sprite.png Miracle Matter is the composition-shifting boss of the Ripple Star realm in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. If 卡比（Kirby） hasn't collected all the prior Crystal Shards, it would be the final boss that leads to the bad ending. Collecting all the prior shards and defeating Miracle Matter will unlock Dark Star and the true final boss.

wikirby-page:268.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:268.description_zh:
K64 Pix精灵.png Pix是由能源-钻石三合一组成的敌人，作为Rock Star领域的头目战斗，它由三个各自移动和悬浮的八面体组成，每个八面体颜色不同（红色、绿色和蓝色），大小约为卡比（Kirby）的尺寸。每个Pix的部分都能够召唤三角形刀片攻击卡比（Kirby），并且也可以投放彩色炸弹。Pix可以在位于摇滚明星沙漠地区的未来金字塔状结构内找到，并在一部电梯上作战，该电梯会升到结构顶部尖塔的顶端。击败Pix会获得丢失的Crystal Shard之一，并允许卡比（Kirby）及其团队进入下一个世界Aqua Star.

Pix出现在Enemy Info Card #3中。Pix也在Boss Battles模式中作为第二个对手进行战斗。
wikirby-page:268.description_en:
K64 Pix Sprite.png Pix is the energy-diamond trio fought as the boss of the Rock Star realm in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. It consists of three separately moving and hovering octahedrons, each of which is a different color (red, green, and blue) and each of which are about 卡比（Kirby）'s size. Each piece of Pix is capable of conjuring a triangular blade to attack 卡比（Kirby） with, and can also drop bombs of color. Pix may be found within the futuristic pyramid-like structure located in the Rock Star desert area, and is fought on an elevator which moves up to the pinnacle of a spire atop the structure. Defeating Pix yields one of the missing Crystal Shards, and allows 卡比（Kirby） and his team to access the next world of Aqua Star.

Pix appears on Enemy Info Card #3. Pix is also battled as the second opponent in the Boss Battles mode.

wikirby-page:23432.display_work: 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）
wikirby-page:23432.description_zh:
[[文件:KSA莉宝（Ribbon）.png|缩略图|莉宝（Ribbon）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中Fairy的一个显著例子。]]缩略图|左|在卡比（Kirby）64:《水晶碎片》的真实结尾字幕中看到的各种妖精。

妖精是首次在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中登场的一个种族，生活在Ripple Star星球。他们的统治者是波纹星的Queen，他们最著名的成员是莉宝（Ribbon）。

在外貌方面，妖精看起来是身材矮小的类人，拥有半透明、圆形的翅膀、动漫风格的眼睛，以及类似小孩的身体比例；大部分妖精甚至比卡比（Kirby）还小。在所有妖精中，Queen是最高的，她的身高约为阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）。它们看起来都是全女性物种，全部穿裙子或连衣裙；各个成员主要通过发型、发色和配饰来区分。她们的设计与星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3）中的Angel以及星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中的People of the Sky非常相似，尽管两者都略小，眼睛细节较少，更类似于卡比（Kirby）的风格。

这些精灵在Ripple星上和平地生活，在Queen的统治下保护她们的力量来源——水晶。然而，暗物质（Dark Matter）势力入侵了这个星球，使她们无忧无虑的生活陷入混乱。Queen惊慌失措，直到她与莉宝（Ribbon）交谈，后者同意携带水晶逃离Ripple星。在途中，她遭到暗黑Rimuro、暗黑Rimura和暗黑Rimuru的伏击，水晶被破裂成碎片，导致她坠落到波普之星（Popstar）。从这里，莉宝（Ribbon）与卡比（Kirby）联手拯救她的星球。这对搭档，以及他们在途中遇到的朋友们，最终收集了所有的水晶碎片并击败了暗物质（Dark Matter），妖精们再次感到快乐。
wikirby-page:23432.description_en:
[[File:KSA 莉宝（Ribbon）.png|thumb|莉宝（Ribbon） is a notable example of a Fairy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）.]] thumb|left|Various fairies as seen in 卡比（Kirby） 64: The Crystal Shardss true ending credits.

The fairies are a race that debuted in 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, dwelling on the planet Ripple Star. Their ruler is the Queen of Ripple Star, and their most notable member is 莉宝（Ribbon）.

In terms of physical appearance, fairies appear to be short humanoids with translucent, rounded wings, anime-style eyes, and body proportions similar to a small child; most are smaller than even 卡比（Kirby）. Out of them all, the Queen is the tallest, and she is around 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）'s height. They appear to be an all-female species, and all wear skirts or dresses; individual members are largely distinguished by their hairstyles, hair colors, and accessories. Their design is quite similar to the Angel found in 星之卡比3（Kirby's Dream Land 3） and the People of the Sky found in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, though both are slightly smaller and have less detailed eyes more similar to 卡比（Kirby）'s.

The fairies live in peace on Ripple Star under the rule of the Queen, protecting their source of power, the Crystal. However, the 暗物质（Dark Matter） force invades the planet, throwing their carefree life into havoc. The Queen panics until she talks with 莉宝（Ribbon）, who agrees to flee Ripple Star with the Crystal. She is ambushed en route by Dark Rimuro, Dark Rimura, and Dark Rimuru and the Crystal is split into shards, causing her to crash land onto 波普之星（Popstar）. From here, 莉宝（Ribbon） joins forces with 卡比（Kirby） to save her planet. The duo, along with the friends they meet along the way, eventually collect all of the Crystal Shards and defeat 暗物质（Dark Matter）, and the fairies are happy once more.

wikirby-page:15643.description_zh:
“这些坏蛋会在卡比（Kirby）靠近时突然俯冲攻击他。在网格地板下滚动是安全通过的好方法。”
— 手册中对扁福（Blinkbat）的描述。
KTnT扁福（Blinkbat）.png扁福（Blinkbat）是一种飞行的蓝色蝙蝠状敌人，只有一只眼睛，出现在Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble中。它会在看到卡比（Kirby）时追击他，并在接触时造成伤害，但卡比（Kirby）可以通过从网格地板下穿过而不被发现地悄悄经过。扁福（Blinkbat）可以使用Microphone击败，也可以用Invincible Candy与之碰撞击败。一些闪烁蝙蝠在卡比（Kirby）从Treasure Chest获取Key时也会消失。
wikirby-page:15643.description_en:
“These baddies will swoop down at 卡比（Kirby） anytime he gets near. Rolling under mesh floors is a good way to get by safely.”
— Description of 扁福（Blinkbat） from the manual.
KTnT 扁福（Blinkbat）.png 扁福（Blinkbat） is a flying blue bat-like enemy with a single eye appearing in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble. It will pursue 卡比（Kirby） whenever it can see him and hurt him on contact, but 卡比（Kirby） can sneak past unnoticed by passing under mesh flooring. 扁福（Blinkbat） can be defeated using the Microphone or by running into it with Invincible Candy. Some Blinkbats will also vanish when 卡比（Kirby） grabs a Key from a Treasure Chest.

wikirby-page:15645.description_zh:
“这些发条装置会阻挡道路并守卫门口。卡比（Kirby）可以碰撞它们而不会受到任何伤害。”
— 手册中对诺博特（Blockbot）的描述。
诺博特（Blockbot）是Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble中出现的一个大型发条玩具机器人敌人。它不能直接伤害卡比（Kirby），但如果他撞到它，它会将他弹开，并且经常可以看到它阻挡通道。诺博特（Blockbot）有两种不同的类型。红色和蓝色通常在移动，如果静止，通常可以通过撞到它们使其移动。这些阻挡机器人也可以通过翻转Game Boy Color改变方向。黄色阻挡机器人则在被相应的开关激活前保持静止。移动完成后，他们经常会石化，变成墙的一部分，再也不会移动。有些Blockbots还可以在它们周围生成平台，卡比（Kirby）经常需要使用这些平台在某些区域移动。

诺博特（Blockbot）可以使用Microphone或使用无敌状态来击败。
wikirby-page:15645.description_en:
“These wind-up contraptions block paths and guard doors. 卡比（Kirby） can bump into them without taking any damage.”
— Description of 诺博特（Blockbot） from the manual.
诺博特（Blockbot） is a large wind-up toy robot enemy appearing in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble. It cannot harm 卡比（Kirby） directly, but it will repel him if he runs into it, and can often be seen blocking passageways. There are two different varieties of 诺博特（Blockbot）. The red and blue ones are often seen on the move, and if stationary, can typically be made to move by bumping into them. These Blockbots can also be forced to change direction by flipping the Game Boy Color. Yellow Blockbots, on the other hand, stay stationary until they are activated by corresponding switches. After they finish moving, they often petrify, turning into part of the walls and never moving again. Some Blockbots can also make platforms appear around them, which 卡比（Kirby） will often need to use to move along in certain areas.

诺博特（Blockbot） can be defeated using the Microphone or by using invincibility.

wikirby-page:15647.description_zh:
“这些敌人会向卡比（Kirby）发射炮弹，但他可以使用空气冲击反击！”
— 手册中对Cloud Cannon的描述。
Cloud Cannon是一种黑大炮（Shotzo），由一个有脸的气球携带，出现在Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble中。它可以被看作与卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）相似，因为它的战斗方式类似，并且也可以通过在飞行中快速射击Air Bullet来击败。

Cloud Cannon在空旷的天空中漂浮，并会追踪卡比（Kirby），以便一旦他靠近，就能保持在其瞄准范围内。Cloud Cannon会定期向卡比（Kirby）射击，接触时会造成伤害，同时Cloud Cannon本身触碰也会造成疼痛。击败Cloud Cannon需要三发空气子弹。每次Cloud Cannon受到攻击，它的面部表情发生变化，从中性变为严肃，然后是震惊。当被击败时，Cloud Cannon的气球会爆炸，黑大炮（Shotzo）会掉入开阔的天空。如果卡比（Kirby）没有足够快地击败Cloud Cannon，它将飞走。
wikirby-page:15647.description_en:
“These enemies will blast cannonballs at 卡比（Kirby）, but he can fire right back with an Air Blast!”
— Description of Cloud Cannon from the manual.
Cloud Cannon is a 黑大炮（Shotzo） being carried by a faced balloon which appears in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble. It can be seen as similar to 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）, as it fights in a similar manner, and is also defeated using rapid-fire Air Bullets while flying.

Cloud Cannon is found floating around in the open sky, and will track 卡比（Kirby） in order to keep him in its sights once he gets close enough. Cloud Cannon regularly fires shots at 卡比（Kirby） which will hurt him on contact, and Cloud Cannon itself is also painful to the touch. Cloud Cannon takes three Air Bullets to defeat. Each time Cloud Cannon is hit, its facial expression changes, going from neutral, to dour, and then shocked. When defeated, the balloon of Cloud Cannon pops, leaving the 黑大炮（Shotzo） to fall into the open sky. If 卡比（Kirby） does not defeat Cloud Cannon quickly enough, it will fly away.

wikirby-page:15648.description_zh:
“每次当手抓住你时，跳到平台的左边以获得更多的星片和额外生命。”
— 《Nintendo Power》第143期，第71页对God Hand的描述。
God Hand是一只大型镶板的分离手套，出现在Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble中。它的主要用途是在奖励游戏中抓住并携带卡比（Kirby），然后卡比（Kirby）必须把握时机释放以获取奖励物品。God Hand无法被击败，对卡比（Kirby）也实际上没有危险。它可以被视为某种Cannon。

在本游戏中可以找到两种God Hand的变体。第一种带有红色装饰，会自行前后移动，按下A键时释放卡比（Kirby）。另一种God Hand有灰色的装饰，可以通过倾斜Game Boy Color来引导。这个将在10秒后消失，并在最后位置掉落卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:15648.description_en:
“Jump to the left-hand side of the platform each time the hand grabs you for more Star Pieces and 1-Ups.”
— Description of God Hand from Issue 143 of Nintendo Power, page 71.
God Hand is a large plated disembodied gauntlet which appears in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble. Its main purpose is to grab and carry 卡比（Kirby） during a bonus game, where 卡比（Kirby） must then time a release to grab bonus items. God Hand cannot be defeated, nor is it actually dangerous to 卡比（Kirby）. It can be seen as a Cannon of sorts.

There are two variants of God Hand that can be found in this game. The first has red accents and moves back and forth on its own, releasing 卡比（Kirby） when the A button is pressed. The other variety of God Hand has gray accents, and can be guided by tilting the Game Boy Color. This one will disappear after 10 seconds, dropping 卡比（Kirby） at its last position.

wikirby-page:15653.description_zh:
“要击败这些坏家伙之一，请瞄准眼睛并跳跃。”
— Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble说明书中眼珠子（Orbservor）的描述
