眼珠子（Orbservor）是一个大型球形Boss，顶部有一只眼睛。在Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble中多次遇到它，出现过几种不同颜色和变体。它的主要攻击策略是弹射卡比（Kirby）以将其送入坑或其他危险区域。要攻击眼珠子（Orbservor），卡比（Kirby）必须进入发射器并在其暴露眼睛时攻击。所有眼珠子（Orbservor）变体需要三次命中才能击败。
wikirby-page:15653.description_en:
“To take out one of these bad guys, aim for the eye and jump.”
— Description of 眼珠子（Orbservor） from the Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble Instruction Booklet
眼珠子（Orbservor） is a large spherical boss with a single eye on top. It is faced several times in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble, appearing in a couple different colors and variants. Its main attack strategy is to bounce 卡比（Kirby） around in order to launch him into a pit or other hazard. To attack 眼珠子（Orbservor）, 卡比（Kirby） must get into a launcher and strike its eye when exposed. All variants of 眼珠子（Orbservor） take three hits to defeat.

wikirby-form:14206.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-form:14206.description_zh:
“那就是...Baton卡比（Kirby）!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），在Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Baton中有一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中。它赋予卡比（Kirby）用Baton控制敌人的能力。它被加入Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II，是因为它赢得了日本Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest比赛（由来自福岛县的西内悠也提交）。然而，它只在一个梦境场景中使用，因此其正史性存疑。卡比（Kirby）在吸入来自某个Air Riders的Baton后获得了这个能力。
wikirby-form:14206.description_en:
“That is...Baton 卡比（Kirby）!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, in Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Baton is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which appears only in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It gives 卡比（Kirby） the ability to control his enemies with a Baton. It was added into Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II as the result of it being one of the winners of the Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest in Japan (being submitted by Yuya Nishiuchi from Fukushima prefecture). However, it is only used in a dream sequence, making its canonicity questionable. 卡比（Kirby） gains this ability after inhaling a Baton from one of the Air Riders.

wikirby-form:28378.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-form:28378.description_zh:
“它是Iron卡比（Kirby）！”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），在Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Iron中有一个复制能力（Copy Ability），卡比（Kirby）只在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的一集中使用，在该集中Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II。它在这一集中亮相，因为它的两种形态是Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest在日本获胜者之一。然而，由于它是与其他获奖能力一起在梦境序列中使用的，所以其正史性存在疑问。卡比（Kirby）在吸入来自一个Air Riders的金属连枷后获得了这种能力。

值得注意的是，Iron卡比（Kirby）的两种形态是由两个不同的参赛者提交的。最初的蛇装（最初名为ツタンカービィ或Tutankirby，是Tutankhamun和卡比（Kirby）的组合词）由来自东京县，Iron球形形式（原名Metal卡比（Kirby））由来自岛根县的Yuki大石提交。
wikirby-form:28378.description_en:
“It is Iron 卡比（Kirby）!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, in Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Iron is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that 卡比（Kirby） only uses in one episode of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, in the episode Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II. It was featured in the episode as its two forms were among the winners of the Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest in Japan. However, as it was used in a dream sequence alongside other winning abilities, its canonicity is questionable. 卡比（Kirby） gains this ability after inhaling a metal flail from one of the Air Riders.

Notably, the two forms of Iron 卡比（Kirby） were submitted by two different contestants. The initial snake suit (originally named ツタンカービィ or Tutankirby, a portmanteau of Tutankhamun and 卡比（Kirby）) was submitted by Yoichi Muramoto from Tokyo Prefecture, and the Iron ball form (originally named Metal 卡比（Kirby）) was submitted by Yuki Oishi from Shimane prefecture.

wikirby-form:13981.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-form:13981.description_zh: Kabuki是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），出现在Kirby 3D中，这是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的特别篇。卡比（Kirby）在吸入Lobzilla的小龙虾后获得此能力。使用时，首先将卡比（Kirby）变成穿着传统Kabuki演员服装的大型类人形。表演一些姿势后，卡比（Kirby）恢复原形（但仍穿着类似衣服）并发射激光束，使Lobzilla爆炸。Kabuki卡比（Kirby）在剧集结尾再次摆出姿势。
wikirby-form:13981.description_en: Kabuki is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which appears in Kirby 3D, a special episode of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. 卡比（Kirby） obtains this ability when inhaling Lobzilla's baby lobsters. When used, it first turns 卡比（Kirby） into a large humanoid figure dressed as a traditional Kabuki actor. After performing some poses, 卡比（Kirby） returns to his original form (though still dressed in similar clothing) and fires a laser beam which causes Lobzilla to explode. Kabuki 卡比（Kirby） is seen posing again at the end of the episode.

wikirby-form:31657.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-form:31657.description_zh:
“他现在是Top卡比（Kirby）！”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），在Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Top是复制能力（Copy Ability）独属于星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!），这使得卡比（Kirby）能将锋利的陀螺投向敌人。此能力仅出现过一次，在Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II集中，因为它是日本限定Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest的获奖作品之一（由奈良县的前田正信提交）。然而，它仅在梦境场景中使用，因此其正史性尚存疑问。卡比（Kirby）在吸入来自其中一个Air Riders的爆炸Top后获得此能力。
wikirby-form:31657.description_en:
“He is now Top 卡比（Kirby）!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, in Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
Top is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） exclusive to 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, which allows 卡比（Kirby） to toss razor-sharp tops at his enemies. This ability has only made one appearance, in the episode Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II as the result of it being one of the winners in the Japan-only Kirby of the Stars: New Ability Contest (being submitted by Masanobu Maeda from Nara prefecture). However, it is only used in a dream sequence, making its canonicity questionable. 卡比（Kirby） gains this ability after inhaling an exploding Top from one of the Air Riders.

wikirby-page:33774.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33774.description_zh:
“所以，这里是森林里最古老的树，对吧？在我的壁炉里烧起来一定很不错！”
— 描述Acore在War of the Woods
Acore是一棵居住在动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的Eastern Forest的古老有智慧的橡树。他是风语大树（Whispy Woods）的朋友，并且是一些聪明动物的家，包括常驻角色陆库（Rick）和空（Coo）。他只出现在War of the Woods这一集中，在那里他受到帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和Escargoon的威胁，他们仍然想建造他们的皇家乡村俱乐部，并将他和他的森林视为障碍。Acore在大部分剧集中都是睡着的，只有在帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和Escargoon被赶走之后的最后才醒来，去迎接那些拯救他的人。
wikirby-page:33774.description_en:
“So, this here's th'oldest tree in the forest, huh? Oughta' burn real nice in my fireplace!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） describing Acore in War of the Woods
Acore is an ancient sentient oak tree that resides in the Eastern Forest in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a friend of 风语大树（Whispy Woods） and is home to several intelligent animals, including recurring characters 陆库（Rick） and 空（Coo）. He appears only in the episode War of the Woods, where he is threatened by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and Escargoon who still wish to build their royal country club and consider him and his forest an obstacle. Acore remains asleep through most of the episode, only waking at the very end after 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and Escargoon are driven off to greet those who saved him.

wikirby-page:38100.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:38100.description_zh:
“他们不是怪物，Tuff。有些迹象告诉我，他们要糟糕得多！”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），关于Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II中的Air Riders
Air Riders是一群为Night Mare Enterprises而战的士兵，他们骑着Air Ride Machine并使用各种武器。当卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们潜入Fright to the Finish中的ENeMeE的Fortress时，他们会被派去追捕，但他们首先在石像怪（Kabu）为卡比（Kirby）和Tiff提供的梦境战斗中交手，以在Air-Ride-in-Style - Part I和Part II中训练他们。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）解释说他们不是怪物，但无论如何战斗方式类似。
wikirby-page:38100.description_en:
“They are not monsters, Tuff. Something tells me they are much worse!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, regarding the Air Riders in Air-Ride-in-Style - Part II
The Air Riders are a collection of soldiers who fight for Night Mare Enterprises by riding Air Ride Machines and wielding various weapons. They are sent after 卡比（Kirby） and his friends when they infiltrate ENeMeE's Fortress in Fright to the Finish, but they are first engaged in a dream battle that 石像怪（Kabu） offers 卡比（Kirby） and Tiff in order to prepare them in Air-Ride-in-Style - Part I and Part II. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） explains that they are not monsters, but they are battled in a similar way regardless.

wikirby-page:31058.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:31058.description_zh:
“I我猜我仍然需要一些练习！”
— Benikage，在Ninja Binge
Benikage中是一个不熟练的忍者，也是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的客串角色。他发现自己身处Dream Land尝试找回丢失的成绩单以掩盖自己的羞耻，而这份成绩单被Professor Curio认为是古代神器。在向卡比（Kirby）、Tiff和Tuff揭示自己的无能后，他无意中与邪恶忍者Yamikage对峙，而卡比（Kirby）必须救他。
wikirby-page:31058.description_en:
“I guess I still need a little practice!”
— Benikage, in Ninja Binge
Benikage is an unskilled ninja and a guest character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He finds himself in Dream Land to try and obtain his lost report card to hide his shame, which was thought by Professor Curio to be an ancient artifact. After revealing his incompetence to 卡比（Kirby）, Tiff, and Tuff, he inadvertently finds himself up against the evil ninja Yamikage, and 卡比（Kirby） has to save him.

wikirby-page:33224.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33224.description_zh:
Biblio是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个小型重复配角。他是蘑菇怪（Cappy），经营Cappy Town的当地书店。他是系列中最后引入的常规命名角色Cappies：他首次出现在Watermelon Felon，但在A Novel Approach之前没有台词。

Biblio可以通过他的小眼镜、棕色浓密的胡子和棕色背心区分。他在大多数出现的剧集中很少超过客串出场，因此作为角色几乎没有得到发展。他通常在出现的剧集中不说话，即使有台词，也通常只有一句。他通常被描绘为一个勤奋好学的紧张兮兮的簿记员，对于任何打扰书店的行为都会勃然大怒。他的角色非常偶然，以至于在任何一集的剧情中都没有一个时刻他能直接有所贡献。
wikirby-page:33224.description_en:
Biblio is a minor recurring supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） who runs the local book store in Cappy Town. He was the last of the regular named Cappies to be introduced in the series: he first appeared in Watermelon Felon, but did not have a speaking role until A Novel Approach.

Biblio can be distinguished by his small spectacles, brown bushy mustache, and brown vest. He rarely makes more than a cameo appearance in most of the episodes he is featured in, and as such, receives very little development as a character. He usually doesn't speak in the episodes he appears in, and even where he does, he typically only has one line. He is generally characterized as a studious and uptight bookkeeper, who becomes furious at any disruptions to his bookstore. His role is so incidental that there is not a single moment where he directly contributes to the storyline of any episode.

wikirby-page:23639.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23639.description_zh:
“Roses是红色的。Violets是蓝色的。我们来了，Tiff。我们要画你！”
— Biggy, Boney, and Sleepy一起说，从Tooned Out
Biggy, Boney, and Sleepy是三名为Night Mare Enterprises签约的宅动画师，他们出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Tooned Out中。他们被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）带入Dream Land，为了制作一部关于他的专业动画，但三名动画师决定把他们的动画改成关于Tiff，并开始跟踪她以获取项目素材。他们很快被Tiff和她的朋友发现，但设法逃脱，然后被关在Castle Dedede地牢里以紧迫的时间表完成动画。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）很快意识到他们的真实意图并试图通过叫另一位动画师来规避他们，但当这失败时，他被迫播放他们的卡通，这最终引起了Tiff的愤怒。
wikirby-page:23639.description_en:
“Roses are red. Violets are blue. Here we come, Tiff. We're gonna draw you!”
— Biggy, Boney, and Sleepy in unison, from Tooned Out
Biggy, Boney, and Sleepy are three geeky animators under contract for Night Mare Enterprises who appear in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Tooned Out. They are brought into Dream Land by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in order to make a professional cartoon about him, but the three animators decide to make their cartoon about Tiff instead, and proceed to stalk her in order to get material for their project. They are shortly caught by Tiff and her friends, but manage to slip away and are then locked up in the Castle Dedede dungeon in order to finish the cartoon under a tight schedule. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） is soon made aware of their real intentions and tries to circumvent them by calling in another animator, but when that fails, he is forced to air their cartoon, which ends up drawing Tiff's ire.

wikirby-page:29271.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29271.description_zh: Blade Knight（简称Blade）是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个经常出现的配角。他是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的学徒之一，与他的伙伴利剑骑士（Sword Knight）一起。在英文配音中，Blade Knight说话几乎无法理解，这可能是因为他总是戴着完全遮住脸的面具。有时，可以听到他发出的一些词语，通常是人物的名字。在原版日语以及该节目的其他配音版本中，Blade Knight能够清楚地说话。
wikirby-page:29271.description_en:
Blade Knight (Blade for short) is a recurring supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is one of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s apprentices, along with his companion 利剑骑士（Sword Knight）.

In the English dub, Blade Knight is basically unintelligible when he speaks, perhaps due to the fact that he always wears a mask that completely covers his face. Sometimes, certain words can be heard from him, typically character names. In the original Japanese version, as well as in other dubs of the show, Blade Knight is capable of speaking clearly.

wikirby-page:29273.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29273.description_zh: 布克姆夫人是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要重复出现的配角。她是蘑菇怪（Cappy），也是Chief Bookem的妻子。她不常说台词，但给人真诚和善良的印象，尤其是对她的丈夫。她有时会与Hana和Mabel闲聊。
wikirby-page:29273.description_en: Mrs. Buttercup Bookem is a minor recurring supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. She is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and the wife of Chief Bookem. She does not often have dialogue, but she comes across as sincere and kind, particularly toward her husband. She can sometimes be seen gossiping with Hana and Mabel.

wikirby-page:25069.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:25069.description_zh:
Captain Waddle Doo是动漫星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个配角。尽管没有嘴巴，Captain Waddle Doo能够说话，并担任Castle Dedede的守卫队长。他指挥城堡中的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），并且可以随时召唤他们。尽管如此，Captain Waddle Doo并不直接与Waddle Dees有关系，也不知道城堡里有多少人。他腰间总是佩戴一把短剑，虽然很少使用它。

在日本版动画中，他的声音很尖，而在英文版中，他的声音相当低沉，并带有典型的布鲁克林口音。
wikirby-page:25069.description_en:
Captain Waddle Doo is a supporting character from the anime 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） Despite having no mouth, Captain Waddle Doo has the ability to speak and serves as the captain of the guard for Castle Dedede. He commands the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s in the castle and is able to call upon them at any time. Despite this, Captain Waddle Doo is not directly related to the Waddle Dees, and does not know how many are in the castle. He has a short sword strapped to his waist at all times, though he seldom uses it.

In the Japanese version of the anime, his voice is high-pitched, while in the English version, his voice is quite deep, with a stereotypical Brooklyn accent.

wikirby-page:29347.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29347.description_zh:
“啊，天哪，我是镇上唯一的餐馆，但我仍然没有顾客！”
— Chef Kawasaki在《灾难食谱》中
Chef Kawasaki是动漫系列中的一个反复出现的配角；星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）首次出现在A Blockbuster Battle中，但直到The Big Taste Test才扮演重要角色。他拥有并经营着Cappy Town中唯一的餐馆，通常提供东亚风味的菜肴。他的厨艺被大多数角色描述为糟糕，但当他们不想在家吃饭时，偶尔还是会去那里。镇上唯一持续喜欢川崎食物的人是卡比（Kirby），这部分解释了为什么卡比（Kirby）和川崎大多数时间都是坚定的盟友。尽管有这样的名声，Chef Kawasaki非常认真地对待他的手艺，因为他是由他崇拜的著名的Chef Shiitake教导的。像其他村民一样，Chef Kawasaki并不喜欢帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），但他通常不会试图挑战国王，尤其是在少数德德德来他的餐馆就餐的情况下。

Chef Kawasaki在英文4Kids配音版中由Maddie Blaustein配音，在原版日语中由户田信武配音。在英文配音中，Chef Kawasaki说话时带有明显的口吃。
wikirby-page:29347.description_en:
“Ah. Goodness me, I'm the only restaurant in town and still I get no customers!”
— Chef Kawasaki in A Recipe for Disaster
Chef Kawasaki is a recurring supporting character in the anime series; 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, first appearing in A Blockbuster Battle, though not playing a major role until The Big Taste Test. He owns and runs the only restaurant in Cappy Town, which typically serves east Asian-style cuisine. His cooking is described as awful by most of the cast, but they occasionally eat there anyway when they do not feel like having a meal at home. The only person in town who consistently enjoys Kawasaki's food is 卡比（Kirby）, which goes in part to explain why 卡比（Kirby） and Kawasaki are strong allies most of the time. Despite his reputation, Chef Kawasaki takes his craft seriously, as he was taught by the famous Chef Shiitake, whom he idolizes. Like the rest of the villagers, Chef Kawasaki is not fond of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, but he does not typically try to challenge the king, especially in the rare cases where Dedede comes to eat at his restaurant.

Chef Kawasaki is voiced by Maddie Blaustein in the English 4Kids dub and by Nobuo Tobita in the original Japanese version. In the English dub, Chef Kawasaki is portrayed with a noticeable lisp in his speech.

wikirby-page:37104.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37104.description_zh:
“嘿，大家听着！我想让你们认识名古屋！他是我多年前的老朋友，那时候我们都是烹饪学校的学生！”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki），在A Chow Challenge
Chef Nagoya中是一位游历的厨师，也是厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）的老朋友，他出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Chow Challenge。在这一集中，他与老朋友重聚，以评估朋友的烹饪技巧，但后来发现川崎作弊让自己看起来比实际更出色。为了了结此事，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和Escargoon主持了一场两人的烹饪比赛，希望把厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）彻底赶出Cappy Town，但名古屋很快发现Escargoon在破坏川崎的菜肴，并保护他的朋友不受伤害。duplicity.
wikirby-page:37104.description_en:
“Hey, listen up everybody! I want you all to meet Nagoya! He's an old buddy of mine from way back when we were both students in cooking school!”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）, in A Chow Challenge
Chef Nagoya is a wandering chef and old friend of 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Chow Challenge. In this episode, he reunites with his old friend to ascertain his cooking skill, but later finds out that Kawasaki cheated to make himself appear to be a better chef than he was. To settle things, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and Escargoon host a cooking competition between the two in the hopes of driving 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） out of Cappy Town for good, but Nagoya soon discovers that Escargoon was sabotaging Kawasaki's dishes, and defends his friend from his duplicity.

wikirby-page:24807.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24807.description_zh:
“A一位伟大的厨师必须利用手头的一切来创作他的料理。这就是我想教给你的！”
— Chef Shiitake在《灾难的食谱》中
Chef Shiitake是一个客串角色，他首次出现在动画系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中。他是一个小而圆的生物，以烹饪技巧闻名世界。他曾经是厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）的老师，尽管他的学生未能很好地继承他的遗产。
wikirby-page:24807.description_en:
“A great chef must use everything at his disposal to create his cuisine. That is what I wanted to teach you!”
— Chef Shiitake in A Recipe for Disaster
Chef Shiitake is a guest character who first appeared in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a small round creature who is famous around the world for his culinary skill. He was once 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）'s teacher, though his student does not live up well to his legacy.

wikirby-page:29277.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29277.description_zh:
“I可以自己说话，谢谢！”
— Chief Bookem来到蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇。
Chief Bookem是动画系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个反复出现的配角。他是蘑菇怪（Cappy），并且是Cappy Town的警察局长。他的妻子是Buttercup，而Tuff将他视为榜样。Chief Bookem出现在该系列的大多数剧集中，尽管他直到第10集《向局长致敬》中才担任主要角色。他的名字可能是对Hawaii Five-O中那句“Book 'em, Danno!”的致敬。
wikirby-page:29277.description_en:
“I can speak for myself, thank you!”
— Chief Bookem in 卡比（Kirby） Comes to 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town
Chief Bookem is a recurring supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and the chief of police for Cappy Town. His wife is Buttercup, and Tuff looks up to him as a role model. Chief Bookem appears in most episodes of the series, though he does not play a leading role in one until Episode 10: Hail to the Chief. His name is likely a reference to the phrase "Book 'em, Danno!" from Hawaii Five-O.

wikirby-page:30559.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30559.description_zh:
Doctor Yabui是一个仅在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中出现的配角。他是Cappy Town中为数不多的非蘑菇怪（Cappy）居民之一，同时担任镇上的医生，经营一家偶尔接待病人的诊所。他较为显著的角色之一出现在A Dental Dilemma集中，他提议为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）进行蛀牙钻治，这让国王大为恐惧。

Doctor Yabui的穿着比蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇的大多数居民更加厚重，穿着整套白色西装，佩戴蓝色围裙、听诊器和一副遮住眼睛的非透明眼镜。他的发型和面部毛发使他看起来像一个疯狂科学家，这种印象因他古怪而疏离的个性而更加突出。
wikirby-page:30559.description_en:
Doctor Yabui is a supporting character who appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is one of the few non-蘑菇怪（Cappy） residents of Cappy Town, and serves as the town physician, operating a clinic which occasionally sees patients. One of his more notable roles is in the episode A Dental Dilemma, where he offers to drill 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s decaying teeth, much to the fear of the King.

Doctor Yabui is more heavily-dressed than most of the residents of 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town, wearing a full white suit with a blue apron, a stethoscope, and a pair of opaque glasses which hide his eyes. His hairstyle and facial hair give him the look of a mad scientist, which is accented by his eccentric and aloof personality.

wikirby-page:29350.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29350.description_zh:
Doron是蘑菇怪（Cappy），也是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要配角。他是一个相对沉默的角色，大部分时间都待在Chief Bookem警察局的监狱牢房里。在少数他出现在牢房外的场景中，他通常在犯罪，通常是偷窃。Doron在系列中唯一的重要角色是在The Thing About the Ring这一集中，他试图偷走Sir Ebrum的订婚戒指，而这枚戒指在此之前已经经过了其他几位角色的手中。当卡比（Kirby）威胁要吸入他时，他最终不得不放弃。

Doron几乎没有显著特征，圆形山羊胡是主要特征。他还有三根细他头上的几缕头发。他几乎没有台词，通常只用“嗯”或“啊-嗯”来回应是非问题。在日文版中，他几乎完全沉默。他似乎只对盗窃感兴趣，这导致他在警察局里或多或少一直被关押。然而，在那里，他性格温和，甚至在一定程度上与Chief Bookem相处得不错。
wikirby-page:29350.description_en:
Doron is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a relatively silent character who spends most of his time inside the jail cell in Chief Bookem's police station. In the rare scenes where he is outside the cell, he is usually committing some sort of crime; typically theft. Doron's only significant role in the series is in the episode The Thing About the Ring, where he attempts to steal Sir Ebrum's engagement ring after it had already passed through several other characters' hands. He eventually ends up having to give it up when 卡比（Kirby） threatens to inhale him.

Doron has few distinguishing features, though his round goatee is the main one. He also has three thin strands of hair on his head. He has very little dialogue, usually only responding with "uh-huh" or "uh-uh" to yes and no questions. In the Japanese version, he is almost completely silent. He seems to only be interested in committing theft, which results in him being more-or-less constantly incarcerated in the police station. While there, however, he is mild-mannered and even gets along with Chief Bookem to a certain degree.

wikirby-page:30791.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30791.description_zh: Dream Land princess是一个仅出现在Kirby of the Stars Pilot中的角色，这部作品成为了动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的跳板。在短片中，她是Dream Land中第一个遇见卡比（Kirby）的角色，并且很快就和他成为朋友。除了她与卡比（Kirby）一起参与的活动外，她在影片中没有重要的角色。后来她被揭示为角色Tiff的早期版本。
wikirby-page:30791.description_en: The Dream Land princess is a character who appears exclusively in the Kirby of the Stars Pilot, which acted as a springboard for the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. In the short film, she is the first character in Dream Land to meet 卡比（Kirby）, and she quickly befriends him. Aside from the activities she takes part in with 卡比（Kirby）, she has no significant role in the film. She would later be revealed to be an early version for the character of Tiff.

wikirby-page:29281.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29281.description_zh:
“Heh。来到这里是一个错误，卡比（Kirby）。如你所见，你和你那微不足道的星际战士队伍对我毫无威胁。挑战我是你们能犯的最后一个错误！”
— ENeMeE在Combat Kirby
ENeMeE中是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的总反派，同时也是Night Mare Enterprises的首领。在节目前的事件中，ENeMeE利用他的怪物和军队成功统治了已知的宇宙，在此过程中消灭了大部分Star Warrior，并建立了以他的漂浮要塞为中心的银河帝国。通过N.M.E. Sales Guy，他将怪物派入Dream Land，而卡比（Kirby）必须将其击败。

在节目的大部分时间里，ENeMeE保持隐藏，并且说话相对较少。他在主系列的最终集《惊吓终局》中更加突出——在这一集中，卡比（Kirby）使用星星神杖（Star Rod）击败了他，从而将银河系从N.M.E.的控制中解放出来。
wikirby-page:29281.description_en:
“Heh. It was a mistake to come here, 卡比（Kirby）. As you can see, you and your puny band of Star Warriors pose no threat to me. Challenging me is the last mistake you will ever make!”
— ENeMeE in Combat Kirby
ENeMeE is the overarching antagonist of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, and the head of Night Mare Enterprises. Before the events of the show, ENeMeE had managed to dominate the known universe using his monsters and forces, wiping out most of the Star Warriors in the process and creating a galactic empire centered on his floating fortress. Through the N.M.E. Sales Guy, he sends monsters into Dream Land which 卡比（Kirby） must defeat.

Throughout the majority of the show, ENeMeE remains hidden, and has relatively little dialogue. He is much more prominent in the final episode of the main series - Fright to the Finish - where 卡比（Kirby） defeats him using the 星星神杖（Star Rod）, thus liberating the galaxy from N.M.E.'s clutches.

wikirby-page:4877.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:4877.description_zh:
“I我不明白，尽管我这些年来一味卑躬屈膝，为什么会受到如此粗暴的对待！为什么，我甚至假装你赢得了我的尊敬和钦佩！”
— Escargoon
Escargoon是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的主要角色和辅助反派之一。他是一个拟人化的蜗牛状生物，担任帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的主要助手，并几乎总是在他身边，尽管Escargoon对他心存疑虑。Escargoon个性神经质且整体上相当糟糕，尽管他更常引起同情，而不是德德德，这主要是因为他经常受到国王的虐待。他经常喜欢欺负其他Castle Dedede居民，尽管当他遇到严重问题时，他同样常常向他们求助。问题。

Escargoon的名字是“escargot”（法语中意为“蜗牛”）和“goon”这两个词的组合，很贴切地描述了他的性格。在4Kids的英文配音版中，Escargoon由Ted Lewis配音，他也为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）配音。在日语版中，他由Naoki Tatsuta配音，并且经常在句子末尾加上“de gesu”，这是礼貌连系动词“desu”的变形。
wikirby-page:4877.description_en:
“I don't understand why I'm being treated so shabbily after all my years of shameless grovelin'! Why, I even pretended you earned my respect and admiration!”
— Escargoon
Escargoon is one of the primary characters and supporting villains of the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is an anthropomorphic snail-like creature who serves as 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s primary assistant and is almost always at his side, despite Escargoon's misgivings toward him. Escargoon has a neurotic and generally rotten personality, though he is more often sympathetic than Dedede is primarily due to the regular abuse he receives from the king. He often likes to bully his fellow Castle Dedede residents, though he just as often pleads to them for help when he has a serious problem.

Escargoon's name is a play on the words "escargot" (French for "snail") and "goon," aptly describing his character. In the 4Kids English dub, Escargoon is voiced by Ted Lewis, who also voices 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）. In the Japanese version, he is voiced by Naoki Tatsuta, and often ends his sentences with "de gesu", a corruption of the polite copula "desu".

wikirby-page:31123.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:31123.description_zh: Escargoon's mother是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个客串角色。她的真实姓名没有说明，虽然其他角色偶尔称她为Queen母亲。她唯一一次出现在Escargoon Rules集，在那里她拜访了她的儿子，他为了她假装自己是Dream Land的国王，并让整个小镇的人都参与其中。
wikirby-page:31123.description_en: Escargoon's mother is a guest character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. Her actual name is not specified, though she is occasionally referred to by the characters as the Queen Mother. She makes her only appearance in the episode Escargoon Rules, where she visits her son who pretends to be the King of Dream Land for her sake and gets the whole town in on it.

wikirby-page:37491.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37491.description_zh:
“请允许我介绍我们无畏的领袖：Fang！”
— Turbo，在《生来温和第一部分》中
Fang是一个暴力且残忍的摩托车帮派领袖，他出现在《生来温和第一部分》和Part II几集中。他被Night Mare Enterprises雇佣去与手下Rip and Turbo一起恐吓Dream Land，并打败卡比（Kirby），尽管他还有一个私人恩怨要在前同伴Gus和传奇摩托车手Melman之间了结，他相信对方就住在那里。在那里，Fang和他的帮派与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）结盟并骚扰Cappy Town，导致居民们联合起来反抗他们。最终，通过设置一场比赛解决了这一问题Fang和梦之旅者，最终Fang在先后被斯特潘沃尔夫打败，然后被卡比（Kirby）打败后失利。在此过程中，Fang变成了怪物特技轮（Wheelie），但当赛道倒塌在他身上时被打败并可能死亡。
wikirby-page:37491.description_en:
“Allow me to introduce our fearless leader: Fang!”
— Turbo, in Born to Be Mild - Part I
Fang is the violent and ruthless leader of a biker gang who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episodes Born to Be Mild - Part I and Part II. He is sent on contract by Night Mare Enterprises to terrorize Dream Land along with his minions Rip and Turbo and defeat 卡比（Kirby）, though he also has a personal score to settle between his former companion Gus and the legendary biker Melman, who he believes to be residing there. While there, Fang and his gang ally themselves with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and terrorize Cappy Town, leading the residents to mobilize against them. Eventually, the matter is settled by setting up a race between Fang and the Dream Landers, which Fang eventually loses after being bested by first Steppenwolf, then 卡比（Kirby）. In the process, Fang transforms into the monster 特技轮（Wheelie）, but is defeated and presumably killed when the raceway collapses on top of him.

wikirby-page:2151.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:2151.description_zh:
“没关系！我们可能有两个身体——“”——但我们只有一颗心！”
— 羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala），The Fofa Factor
羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的角色。他们与Sir Ebrum、Lady Like、Tiff和Tuff的家庭一起住在Castle Dedede，并协助做家务。它们是小型会飞的泪滴形生物，看起来像双胞胎，彼此陪伴，直到The Fofa Factor集才揭示其起源于名为福法的怪物。尽管被归类，Fololo和Falala并不敌对，也不再与Night Mare Enterprises有任何关联。
wikirby-page:2151.description_en:
“That's okay! We may have two bodies—" "—But we got one heart!”
— 羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）, The Fofa Factor
羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala） are characters from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. They reside in Castle Dedede alongside the family of Sir Ebrum, Lady Like, Tiff, and Tuff, and help with housework. They are small flying tear-drop shaped creatures who appear to be twins who never leave each-others' company, and whose origin is not revealed until the episode The Fofa Factor, where they are shown to have originated from a monster named Fofa. Despite the classification, Fololo and Falala are not hostile, and no longer have any affiliation with Night Mare Enterprises.

wikirby-page:29792.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29792.description_zh:
Gangu是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的蘑菇怪（Cappy）和Cappy Town的居民。Gangu是一名非常肥胖的蘑菇怪（Cappy），他在镇上经营着玩具店。除了接收外部运来的玩具，他也能够自己制作玩具。

Gangu以其矮胖的体型、橙色背带裤以及带有装饰的帽子而易于辨认。在整个系列中，他并没有表现出特别聪明，但他总是乐于助人，并关心顾客。在他首次主演的Kirby's Pet Peeve集中，他试图为卡比（Kirby）免费制作一个替代的Electronic Pet，因为原来的丢失了，但最终决定不把它送给卡比（Kirby），因为他制作的任何东西都无法成为合适的替代品。在Snack Attack - Part I，他突发奇想，想与Tuggle合作，将他们滞销的商品重新组合成畅销产品。这后来被用来对付两人，当Night Mare Enterprises把同样产品的巨大版本送到他们家门口时。
wikirby-page:29792.description_en:
Gangu is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. Gangu is an exceptionally portly 蘑菇怪（Cappy） who runs the toy store in the town. In addition to receiving toys from external shipments, he is also capable of making them himself.

Gangu is recognizable by his short and stout physique, along with his orange overalls and accented cap. Through the series, he is not shown to be particularly clever, but he is always helpful and cares about his customers. In his first starring role in the episode Kirby's Pet Peeve, he attempts to make a replacement Electronic Pet for 卡比（Kirby） after the original is lost at no charge, but ultimately decides against presenting it to 卡比（Kirby）, since nothing he could make would be a suitable replacement. In Snack Attack - Part I, he gets an idea to collaborate with Tuggle to repurpose their poorly-selling merchandise by combining them together into a hit product. This is later used against the two when Night Mare Enterprises sends their own monstrous version of that same product to their doorstep.

wikirby-page:29352.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29352.description_zh: Gus是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个粗犷的蘑菇怪（Cappy）和Cappy Town的居民。他在镇上经营当地的加油站。在大多数系列中，他是一个无足轻重的角色，但他在两部分的剧集中获得了亮相的机会，即《天生温和-第一部分》和Part II，在那里他与前朋友Fang进行摩托车比赛，并帮助卡比（Kirby）击败他。
wikirby-page:29352.description_en: Gus is a rough-hewn 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He runs the local gas station in town. For most of the series, he is an insignificant character, but he gets his time in the spotlight for the two-part episode Born to Be Mild - Part I and Part II, where he races his motorcycle against his former friend Fang and helps 卡比（Kirby） defeat him.

wikirby-page:24910.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24910.description_zh:
Hana Blustergas是一位配角，首次登场于星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!），并且是Cappy中的一员。她的丈夫，Mayor Len Blustergas，是Cappy Town的市长。

Hana是一位老年女士，通常不参与任何特定剧集的剧情。她佩戴着一条珍珠项链和一顶紫色亚麻帽。她几乎总是在她丈夫身边出现，且只是偶尔说话。她通常表现得比较内敛，虽然她有时也会与Buttercup和Mabel交往。尽管她的丈夫有些古怪且偶尔健忘，Hana仍然真心爱他，他们的婚姻非常幸福。

Hana首次出现在卡比（Kirby）来到蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇，但是会在The Kirby Derby - Part I和Part II之前从未在一集中担任主角，在那两集中，她作为丈夫的副驾驶参加比赛，并庆祝他们的40周年纪念。
wikirby-page:24910.description_en:
Hana Blustergas is a supporting character who debuted in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） and is one of the Cappy. Her husband, Mayor Len Blustergas, is the mayor of Cappy Town.

Hana is an elderly lady who usually does not participate in the plot of any given episode. She wears a pearl necklace and a purple linen cap. She is almost always seen near her husband, and only occasionally speaks. She can generally be seen as reserved, though she does occasionally mingle with Buttercup and Mabel. Despite her husband's eccentricities and occasional forgetfulness, Hana does sincerely love him, and their marriage is a happy one.

Hana first appeared in 卡比（Kirby） Comes to 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town, but would not take a leading role in an episode until The Kirby Derby - Part I and Part II, where she joins her husband as his co-pilot in the race and celebrates their 40th anniversary.

wikirby-page:29354.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29354.description_zh:
Honey是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个配角。她是蘑菇怪（Cappy），也是Cappy Town的居民。与Iro和Spikehead一起，她是那些经常和Tiff、Tuff以及卡比（Kirby）玩耍的孩子之一，有时也会与他们共同经历危险。

Honey是一个矮胖的蘑菇怪（Cappy），她的两个小麻花辫用蓝色发带绑着，并点缀着橙色珠子，非常容易辨认。她小心、谨慎、害羞，通常无法为自己辩护，但她的良心比其他孩子更健全。在节目过程中，她和Spikehead互生好感，有时可以看到他们手牵手，但这种关系不是没有被详细关注。Honey在任何一集中都没有重要角色，尽管她经常可以看到与Tiff、Tuff和卡比（Kirby）一起参与他们的一些冒险，尤其是在Abusement Park、War of the Woods和Trick or Trek剧集中。
wikirby-page:29354.description_en:
Honey is a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. She is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town. Along with Iro and Spikehead, she is one of the children who often plays with Tiff, Tuff, and 卡比（Kirby） and sometimes shares their perils.

Honey is a short and stout 蘑菇怪（Cappy） recognizable by her two small pigtails tied with blue hair ties and adorned with orange beads. She is careful, cautious, shy, and is generally unable to stand up for herself, but she has a more robust conscience than the other kids. She and Spikehead develop a crush on each other through the course of the show, and can sometimes be seen holding hands, but this relationship is not focused on in any great detail. Honey has no significant role in any episode, though she can often be seen associating with Tiff, Tuff, and 卡比（Kirby） in some of their adventures, most notably in the episodes Abusement Park, War of the Woods, and Trick or Trek.

wikirby-page:29357.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29357.description_zh:
Iro是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要配角。他是一个蘑菇怪（Cappy），并且是Cappy Town的居民。和Honey及Spikehead一起，他是经常与Tiff、Tuff和卡比（Kirby）玩耍的孩子之一，有时也会与他们一同经历危险。

Iro是蘑菇怪（Cappy）孩子中最大也是年龄最长的，他因穿着条纹衬衫和戴着小帽子而容易被辨认。尽管他年龄较大，但他的成熟度并不相当，与Spikehead一样，他对自己行为的后果通常不太在意，这常常使他陷入麻烦。Iro通常是蘑菇怪（Cappy）孩子中话最多的，但他也是最不负责任的，因为经常是他挑唆孩子们做任何不良行为。他经常因为自私而惹父母生气，尽管这些场景通常只出现在该节目的日语版本中。尽管有这些坏习惯，Iro通常会跟随其他孩子的带领，并尝试帮助他人。在日语版本中，Iro（叫Hohhe）的配音由Makiko Ohmoto完成，与为卡比（Kirby）配音的演员相同。
wikirby-page:29357.description_en:
Iro is a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town. Along with Honey and Spikehead, he is one of the children who often plays with Tiff, Tuff, and 卡比（Kirby）, and sometimes shares their perils.

Iro is the biggest and oldest of the 蘑菇怪（Cappy） children, and is recognizable by his striped shirt and small hat. Despite his age, he is not comparably mature, having the same general disregard for the consequences of his actions as Spikehead, which often gets him in trouble. Iro is generally the most verbose of the 蘑菇怪（Cappy） kids, but he is also the most irresponsible, as he is often the one who instigates whatever bad behavior the kids get into. He often gets into trouble with his parents due to his selfishness, though these scenes often only appear in the Japanese version of the show. Despite these bad habits, Iro generally follows the other kids' lead and tries to help others.

In the Japanese version, Iro (called Hohhe) is voiced by Makiko Ohmoto, the same actress who voices 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:36095.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36095.description_zh:
“我们是来自南海的Island Sisters。”
— 在Caterpillar Thriller
Island Sisters是一对来自星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的微小双胞胎仙女，她们与Mosugaba一起住在南海的Embrya岛上。她们与巨型怪物Mosugaba有着特殊的联系，并且拥有用歌声同时召唤和安抚这只巨型昆虫的能力。为了利用这一点，Island Sisters被Night Mare Enterprises绑架，并被迫召唤Mosugaba到Dream Land为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）服务。在王国引起骚动后，Tiff、Tuff和卡比（Kirby）将姐妹与Mosugaba重新团聚，她们平安返回了自己的岛屿。

Island Sisters的原型来自电影Mothra中的Shobijin。
wikirby-page:36095.description_en:
“We are the Island Sisters from the South Seas.”
— Island Sisters, in Caterpillar Thriller
The Island Sisters are a pair of tiny twin fairies from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） who live with Mosugaba on the Embrya Island in the South Seas. They have a peculiar bond with the giant monster Mosugaba, and have the power to both summon and calm the giant insect using their singing. To take advantage of this, the Island Sisters are kidnapped by Night Mare Enterprises and forced to call Mosugaba to Dream Land for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）. After causing a stir in the kingdom, Tiff, Tuff, and 卡比（Kirby） reunite the sisters with Mosugaba and they return to their island in peace.

The Island Sisters are based on the Shobijin from the film Mothra.

wikirby-page:29279.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29279.description_zh:
“Kabu能看到未来！”
— Kabu在卡比（Kirby）来到蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇
Kabu，更正式地称为大圣Kabu，是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个配角。他是一个巨大的石像，居住在恰如其名的Kabu Canyon，受到Cappy Town居民的尊敬，居民们经常成群结队地来到峡谷寻求他的指导。Kabu能够预知未来，当人们接近他时，他会将这些信息传达给他们。Kabu经常受到帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和Escargoon的威胁，因为人们比起他们更尊重他的权威。

Kabu是空心的，里面充当了一个避难所。正是在这里，卡比（Kirby）的传送之星（Warp Star）最终被保存以确保安全，而每当Tiff需要它时，它就会从Kabu的嘴里飞出来协助卡比（Kirby），然后在危机结束后返回。Kabu召唤传送之星（Warp Star）通常伴随着一个特定的动画序列，这个序列在整个系列中多次重复出现，而且经常构成他在若干集中的唯一作用。
wikirby-page:29279.description_en:
“Kabu can see da future!”
— Kabu in 卡比（Kirby） Comes to 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town
Kabu, more formally Great Sage Kabu, is a supporting character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a massive stone idol who resides in the aptly named Kabu Canyon and is revered by the residents of Cappy Town, who often come to the canyon in large congregations to seek his council. Kabu is able to predict the future, and will relay this information to the people when they approach him. Kabu is often threatened by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and Escargoon, since the people respect his authority more than theirs.

Kabu is hollow, with his inside acting as a sanctuary. It is here that 卡比（Kirby）'s 传送之星（Warp Star） is eventually kept for safekeeping, and whenever Tiff calls for it, it flies out of Kabu's mouth to 卡比（Kirby）'s aid, then returns when the crisis is over. Kabu summoning the 传送之星（Warp Star） is usually accompanied by a specific animation sequence that is reused many times across the series, and often constitutes his only role in several episodes.

wikirby-page:24851.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24851.description_zh:
“我会让那些孩子们见识见识！如果我无法赢得尊重，我就买……从梦魇企业买！”
— King Dedede在A Dark & Stormy Knight
King Dedede中是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的主要角色之一及配角反派。他是一个体型庞大、蓝色、胖乎乎的鸟状男人，自称Dream Land的国王，并与他的宫廷住在Castle Dedede。他声称对Cappy Town的人民拥有管辖权和权威，但他们通常对此不予理会。这种行为促使迪迪德试图通过使用Night Mare Enterprises怪物投放系统唤进怪物到梦幻之地来强迫他们注意，尽管在此过程中他也因此永远欠下N.M.E.的债务，而他的怪物则被卡比（Kirby）.

King Dedede在该节目的英文配音中由Ted Lewis配音，在原版日语中由小形健一配音。在日语版本中，他经常在句末加上“zoi”，这实际上没有任何意义，但可能是日语句末助词“zo”的变体，“zo”可以让句子听起来更有自信。在日语对话中，这种语言习惯也被King Dedede在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的过场动画中使用过，以及Kirby and the Rainbow Curse漫画"In the Name of Fashion"中。
wikirby-page:24851.description_en:
“I'll show them kids! If I can't earn respect, I'll just buy it...from Night Mare Enterprises!”
— King Dedede in A Dark & Stormy Knight
King Dedede is one of the principal characters and supporting villains of the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a large blue portly bird-like man who proclaims himself the king of Dream Land and resides with his court in Castle Dedede. He claims jurisdiction and authority over the people of Cappy Town, but they often ignore him in this regard. This behavior prompts Dedede to try and force their attention by calling monsters into Dream Land using the Night Mare Enterprises monster delivery system, though placing him in perpetual debt to N.M.E. in the process while his monsters are bested by 卡比（Kirby）.

King Dedede is voiced by Ted Lewis in the English dub of the show and by Kenichi Ogata in the original Japanese version. In the Japanese version, he often ends his sentences with "zoi", which does not actually mean anything, but may be a corruption of the Japanese sentence-ending particle "zo", which can make sentences more assertive. In Japanese dialogue, this verbal tic has also been used by King Dedede in the cutscenes of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, along with the Kirby and the Rainbow Curse comic "In the Name of Fashion".

wikirby-page:23784.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23784.description_zh:
“Poyo!”
— Kirby
Kirby以星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的主角身份登场。他是一个没有经验的Star Warrior，并试图在Dream Land坠机后磨练自己的技能。他被描绘得比游戏中更无助，经常逃避危险而不是尝试战斗，尽管在获得复制能力（Copy Ability）后情况改变，他变得非常强大，表演的壮举常常超越他的视频游戏对手。他最好的朋友是Tiff和Tuff，而魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）则充当这个小圆球的导师和守护者。他经常受到帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和Escargoon的对抗。

像他的游戏对手一样，Kirby由Makiko Ohmoto配音，他是唯一的角色的日语配音在该系列的所有国际配音中基本保持原样。然而，非日语版本通常会删除Kirby说日语台词的部分，要么用大本的其他片段进行配音，要么完全重新配音。Amy Birnbaum在英语配音中为大本的声音进行过配音（这些配音延续到了大多数其他国际配音版本），而Lee Ja-myeong则提供了专门用于韩语配音的台词。
wikirby-page:23784.description_en:
“Poyo!”
— Kirby
Kirby is featured as the main protagonist of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is an inexperienced Star Warrior, and is attempting to hone his skills after crash-landing in Dream Land. He is portrayed as more helpless than in the games, often running from danger rather than attempting to fight it, though this changes once he obtains a 复制能力（Copy Ability）, becoming immensely powerful and performing feats that often dwarf his video game counterpart. His best friends are Tiff and Tuff, and 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） acts as a type of mentor and guardian to the puffball. He is often antagonized by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and Escargoon.

Like his game counterpart, Kirby is voiced by Makiko Ohmoto, and he is the only character whose Japanese voice acting is kept largely intact in every international dub of the series. However, the non-Japanese versions generally remove lines which feature Kirby speaking Japanese phrases, either overdubbing them with other clips from Ohmoto or redubbing them entirely. Amy Birnbaum dubbed Ohmoto's voice in certain instances in the English dub (which were carried over to most other international dubs), while Lee Ja-myeong provided lines specific to the Korean dub.

wikirby-page:30954.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30954.description_zh: Kit Cosmos是一位老军士长Star Warrior，他只在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中出现。他主要出现在Island of the Lost Warrior这一集里，在该集中是主要角色。多年来，他独自生活在远离Dream Land的荒岛上，起初当卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们洗上岸时，他非常多疑，以为他们是要来抓他的怪物，但在卡比（Kirby）帮他抵御风怪Tornadon之后，他最终理解了他们的真实身份。后来，Kit Cosmos会在节目最后几集中以Halberd乘员的身份出现。
wikirby-page:30954.description_en: Kit Cosmos is an old drill sergeant Star Warrior who appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He appears primarily in the episode Island of the Lost Warrior, where he is the main focus of the episode. Having lived alone on a deserted island far from Dream Land for years, he is initially paranoid that 卡比（Kirby） and his friends are monsters out to get him when they wash ashore, but eventually come to understand who they really are after 卡比（Kirby） defends him from the wind monster Tornadon. Later on, Kit Cosmos would appear as part of the crew of the Halberd in the final episodes of the show.

wikirby-page:29280.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29280.description_zh: Lady Like是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个配角。她是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的内阁大臣Sir Ebrum的妻子，同时也是Tiff和Tuff的母亲。她被刻画成一个傻乎乎、浮华但心地善良的贵妇，她真正关心的只是家人的安全与福祉，以及卡比（Kirby）。她在大部分剧集中只是一个偶然出现的角色，但在第85集《A Sunsational Puzzle》中，她因为过分担心避免阳光暴晒而短暂地变成夜行性动物，从而担任主要角色。
wikirby-page:29280.description_en: Lady Like is a supporting character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. She is the wife of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s cabinet minister Sir Ebrum, and the mother of both Tiff and Tuff. She is portrayed as a ditsy and foppish, but kind-hearted noblewoman who only truly cares about the safety and well-being of her family and for 卡比（Kirby）. She is an incidental character for most of the show's duration, but has a leading role in Episode 85: A Sunsational Puzzle, where her exaggerated concern for avoiding overexposure to sunlight leads her to briefly become nocturnal.

wikirby-page:24911.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24911.description_zh: 玛达姆Mabel是一个蘑菇怪（Cappy）及配角，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中，首次出现在A Dark & Stormy Knight集的一个小场景中。她担任Cappy Town的神秘学家和占卜师，并使用水晶球作为工作的一部分，尽管Samo解释说她实际上并非通灵者，而只是依靠镇上的流言蜚语以占卜的方式为其他Cappy提供指导。
wikirby-page:24911.description_en: Madame Mabel is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and supporting character appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, making her debut in the episode A Dark & Stormy Knight in a minor scene. She acts as Cappy Town's mystic and fortune teller and uses a crystal ball as part of her work, though Samo explains that she is not actually clairvoyant, but merely relies on town gossip to counsel the other Cappy in the guise of reading their fortune.

wikirby-page:17689.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:17689.description_zh:
“当然！我有勇气、决心，还有另一件事：我是镇上唯一拥有汽车的蘑菇怪（Cappy）！”
— 市长Len在The Kirby Derby - Part I
Mayor Len Blustergas中是一个蘑菇怪（Cappy）和配角，只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中。他是Cappy Town的市长，作为地方当局与Chief Bookem一起运作，而他经常与后者发生分歧。虽然在技术上效忠于Castle Dedede的法庭，Len市长通常更尊重石像怪（Kabu），并会在遭遇困难时带领他的人民去请教伟大的智者。Len市长有一个名叫Hana的妻子，三个（未命名的）孙子，以及一名管家；他们都住在镇外的一个宽敞但仍然有些朴素的别墅里。在在外观方面，市长莱恩的体型和身材与典型的蘑菇怪（Cappy）相近，尽管与他们不同，他留着胡子并穿着正式的服装。他在镇上具体做什么尚不清楚，但值得注意的是，在Junk Jam一集中，Chief Bookem坚持认为他有责任处理卫生问题，而市长任命了“垃圾清理工作组”的总负责人。

Mayor Len Blustergas通常可以被描述为一位尽管年纪已大但仍充满活力的古怪老人。他有些喋喋不休，并且经常代表Cappies向帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）提出投诉，但除此之外，在镇上的工作并不多。根据他的财物，莱恩市长很可能是镇上最富有的人，因为他是唯一一个既拥有私家汽车又拥有大量牧场、羊群以及雇佣牧羊人管理羊群的蘑菇怪（Cappy）。虽然确切的Lenn市长年龄不详，但他与Hana已婚超过40年，并且装有假牙。Lenn市长的一个爱好是摄影，因为人们常常看到他拿着一台老式胶片相机。
wikirby-page:17689.description_en:
“Sure! I've got guts, determination, and one other thing: I'm the only 蘑菇怪（Cappy） in town who owns a car!”
— Mayor Len in The Kirby Derby - Part I
Mayor Len Blustergas is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and supporting character who appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is the mayor of Cappy Town, operating as the local authority along with Chief Bookem, who he often has disagreements with. Though technically subservient to the court of Castle Dedede, Mayor Len is more often deferential to 石像怪（Kabu）, and will lead his people to consult the great sage in times of trouble. Mayor Len has a wife named Hana, three grandchildren (who go unnamed) and a butler; all of whom live in a spacious but still somewhat modest villa just outside of 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town proper. In terms of appearance, Mayor Len is close in size and body shape to a typical 蘑菇怪（Cappy）, though unlike them, he sports a mustache and wears formal attire. It is unknown what he actually does in town, but it is worth noting that in the episode Junk Jam, Chief Bookem insists he has the responsibility to handle sanitation problems, while the mayor names the chief head of the "Trash Removal Task Force."

Mayor Len Blustergas can be generally described as an old eccentric man with lots of energy despite his age. He is somewhat of a windbag, and often represents the Cappies when they have a complaint for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, but otherwise does not do a whole lot of work around the town proper. Based on his possessions, Mayor Len is likely the richest man in town, as he is the only 蘑菇怪（Cappy） who has a personal automobile as well as an extensive amount of pastureland, a flock of sheep to graze it, and a shepherd in employ to tend the flock. While it is not known exactly how old Mayor Len is, he has been married to Hana for over 40 years, and has dentures in place of teeth. One of Mayor Len's hobbies is photography, as he is often seen carrying an old-fashioned film camera.

wikirby-page:29443.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29443.description_zh: Melman是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要配角。他是Cappy Town中最年长的蘑菇怪（Cappy），其他角色经常评论他的高龄。顾名思义，他是蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇的邮递员，经常以这个身份出现，为其他角色送信。他在剧中的重要性不大，除了《天生温和-第二部分》这一集中，揭示他曾经是一位名叫Steppenwolf的传奇摩托车手。在这一集中，他最后一次出场，在DDD赛道比赛中击败Fang。
wikirby-page:29443.description_en: Melman is a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is the oldest 蘑菇怪（Cappy） in Cappy Town, and his advanced age is often commented on by other characters. As his name suggests, he is the mailman for 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town, and is often seen in that role, delivering letters to other characters. He does not have a significant role in the series outside of the episode Born to Be Mild - Part II, where it is revealed that he was once a legendary motorcyclist who went by the name Steppenwolf. In this role, he returns one last time to defeat Fang in the DDD Speedway race.

wikirby-page:24874.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24874.description_zh: Sir梅塔奈特（Meta Knight）是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个主要配角。他是经验丰富的Star Warrior，已经定居在King Dedede王庭，假装为国王效力，以保护Dream Land不受通过Night Mare Enterprises定期召唤的怪物伤害。卡比（Kirby）坠落到梦之地后，梅塔奈特（Meta Knight）自己承担起指导和训练这位年轻粉色泡泡的任务，教他如何战斗怪物，尽管他的方法常常极端，会将卡比（Kirby）置于危险之中。梅塔奈特（Meta Knight）持有神圣之剑Galaxia，尽管他很少直接使用它。
wikirby-page:24874.description_en: Sir 梅塔奈特（Meta Knight） is a major supporting character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a veteran Star Warrior who has settled in King Dedede court, feigning to serve the king in order to protect Dream Land from the monsters which are summoned on the regular through Night Mare Enterprises. After 卡比（Kirby） crash-lands in Dream Land, 梅塔奈特（Meta Knight） tasks himself with guiding and training the young pink puffball in the art of fighting monsters, though his methods are often extreme, putting 卡比（Kirby） in harm's way. 梅塔奈特（Meta Knight） wields the sacred blade Galaxia, though he rarely uses it directly.

wikirby-page:36909.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36909.description_zh:
“我是Mr. Chip，我是一名老师。”
— Mr. Chip，在Teacher's Threat
Mr. Chip是一个合同学校教师，他仅出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Teacher's Threat中。他热爱自己的职业，并致力于以各种方式帮助学生，但由于很难找到教学工作，他被Night Mare Enterprises雇佣并派往Dedede Academy攻击卡比（Kirby）和其他学生。尽管有这份合同，Mr. Chip拒绝实施他受雇执行的暴力行为，于是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）命令教师怪物Rekketsu代替他，但Rekketsu被卡比（Kirby）连同学院一起摧毁。

Mr. Chip的名字可能参考了主角齐普斯先生(Mr. Chips)。of ''Goodbye, Mr. Chips''，一部关于一个平庸但备受尊重的教师的中篇小说。这个引用在《教师的威胁》的日语版本最后一行中尤其容易看出，「チップ先生さようなら」——几乎与《再见，基普先生》（『チップス先生さようなら』）的日语标题一模一样。
wikirby-page:36909.description_en:
“I'm Mr. Chip, and I'm a teacher.”
— Mr. Chip, in Teacher's Threat
Mr. Chip is a contract schoolteacher who makes his only appearance in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Teacher's Threat. He is passionate about his profession and is dedicated to helping his students any way he can, but due to his difficulty finding teaching work, he was hired by Night Mare Enterprises and sent to Dedede Academy to attack 卡比（Kirby） and the other students. Despite this contract, Mr. Chip refuses to carry out the violence he was hired to commit, so 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） orders the teacher monster Rekketsu to take his place, but Rekketsu is destroyed by 卡比（Kirby） along with the academy.

Mr. Chip's name is likely a reference to Mr. Chips, the protagonist of ''Goodbye, Mr. Chips'', a novella about a mediocre but well-regarded schoolteacher. The reference is particularly easy to see in the final line of the Japanese version of Teacher's Threat, 「チップ先生さようなら」 — almost exactly the Japanese title of Goodbye, Mr. Chips (『チップス先生さようなら』).

wikirby-page:4699.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:4699.description_zh:
“再见！与你闪电交易一直都是一种真正的乐趣，陛下。”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy在Combat Kirby
中，N.M.E. Sales Guy是Night Mare Enterprises的公众形象，也是动画系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中反复出现的配角反派。他通常只会在Castle Dedede内的电视屏幕上出现，每当帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）想要从公司订购怪物或其他产品时，他就会出现。N.M.E. Sales Guy是一个类人形象，穿着商务西装，显得专业。尽管如此，很明显，他只希望尽可能榨取帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的钱财，并试图用N.M.E.的怪物来击败卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:4699.description_en:
“Bye-bye! It's always been a real pleasure double-dealing with you, Your Majesty.”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy in Combat Kirby
The N.M.E. Sales Guy is the public face of Night Mare Enterprises and a recurring supporting antagonist in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is usually seen only on a television screen from within Castle Dedede, appearing whenever 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） wants to order a monster or other product from the company. The N.M.E. Sales Guy is a humanoid figure who wears a business suit and gives off a professional demeanor. Despite this, it is clear that he wishes only to exploit 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） for as much money as he can, and try to defeat 卡比（Kirby） using N.M.E.'s monsters.

wikirby-page:30906.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30906.description_zh: Princess Rona是来自皮皮星球的外星公主，她只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中。她在A Princess in Dis-Dress集中担任主角，在该集中她大部分时间伪装成她的私人保镖兼女侍长指挥官Vee。在前往Dream Land的外交任务中，她结识了卡比（Kirby）、Tiff、Tuff以及Cappy Town的居民，并且还与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）及其鱼怪Susshi进行战斗。
wikirby-page:30906.description_en: Princess Rona is an alien princess from Planet Pipi who appears exclusively in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. She has a starring role in the episode A Princess in Dis-Dress, where she spends most of the episode disguised as her personal bodyguard and lady-in-waiting Commander Vee. On a diplomatic mission to Dream Land, she gets to know 卡比（Kirby）, Tiff, Tuff, and the residents of Cappy Town, and also engages in combat with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and his fish monster Susshi.

wikirby-page:24912.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24912.description_zh: Professor Curio（也称作库里奥先生或仅称库里奥）是一位年长的蘑菇怪（Cappy），同时也是Cappy Town的居民，他在镇上担任考古学家、古生物学家和历史学家。他对自己的工作有着深厚的热爱和激情，可以说是Dream Land中学术资格最丰富的人，但由于其他Cappies普遍对他的研究兴趣不大，他在照料自己脆弱的文物时财务状况并不宽裕，这些文物被存放在一个杂乱的“商店”中，这个商店兼作他的居所。库里奥是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的常规配角，尽管他的出场通常是偶然的，他唯一的两个重要角色出现在Curio's Curious Discovery和Mumbies Madness。
wikirby-page:24912.description_en: Professor Curio (also referred to as Mr. Curio or just Curio) is an elderly 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town who serves as the town's archaeologist, paleontologist, and historian. He has a deep love and passion for his work, and is arguably the most academically accredited individual in Dream Land, but due to the general lack of interest from the other Cappies in his pursuits, he is left in a poor financial state to look after his fragile relics in a cluttered "shop" which doubles as his own home. Curio is a regular supporting character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, though his appearances are usually incidental, with his only two major roles being in Curio's Curious Discovery and Mumbies Madness.

wikirby-page:24805.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24805.description_zh:
“是的。当我想象派比的世界时，感觉就像我真的在那里一样！这就是想象力的力量！无论我们多么伤心或处境多么糟糕，我们都可以用想象力去梦想更美好的事物！我们永远不应该放弃我们的梦想，因为它们塑造了我们的明天！”
— Rowlin，在A Novel Approach
Rowlin中是一个客串角色，她只在动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的A Novel Approach集中出现。她的名字是对哈利·波特小说作者J.K. Rowling的致敬。她是《派比·波特与愚人的石块（Stone）》的著名作者，看起来与Tiff及其家人属于同一物种。卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们在她到达时第一次见到她Castle Dedede，尽管事实证明这是一个被称为Broom King的怪物用来伪装以便杀死卡比（Kirby）的手段。真正的Rowlin后来在魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的保护下出现，并揭露了这个作弊者。

Rowlin在节目的日语版本中才有这个名字，而在4Kids版本中则没有名字。
wikirby-page:24805.description_en:
“Yes. When I imagined Pappy's world, it felt like I was really there! That's the power of imagination! No matter how sad we feel or how bad our circumstances, we can use our imaginations to dream something better! We should never give up on our dreams because they are what build our tomorrows!”
— Rowlin, in A Novel Approach
Rowlin is a guest character making her only appearance in the episode A Novel Approach in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. Her name is a reference to J.K. Rowling, the author of the Harry Potter novels. She is the famous author of the book "Pappy Pottey and the Fool's 石块（Stone）" who appears to be the same species as Tiff and her family. 卡比（Kirby） and his friends first meet her when she arrives at Castle Dedede, though this turns out to be a disguise that a monster known as the Broom King is using so he can kill 卡比（Kirby）. The real Rowlin later shows up under 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s protection and exposes the faker.

Rowlin is named as such only in the Japanese version of the show, and goes nameless in the 4Kids version.

wikirby-page:29360.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29360.description_zh: Samo是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的蘑菇怪（Cappy）和Cappy Town的居民。他经营着镇上的酒吧，这意味着他更显著的场景通常在4Kids版本的节目中被剪掉。他在节目中是一个相对次要的角色，尽管他确实出现在几个剧集中，包括在最终集作为Halberd队伍的一部分。他最显著的个性特征是对Mabel的近乎痴迷的暗恋。
wikirby-page:29360.description_en: Samo is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He operates the town's bar, which means his more notable scenes are often cut from the 4Kids version of the show. He is a relatively minor character in the show, though he does appear in several episodes, including as part of the Halberd crew in the finale. His most notable personality trait is his borderline obsessive crush on Mabel.

wikirby-page:4898.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:4898.description_zh: Sir Ebrum是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的配角。他是Tiff和Tuff的父亲，也是Lady Like的丈夫，并担任帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的首相，尽管他在朝廷的实际职责从未明确说明。Sir Ebrum的特点是性格胆小且有时显得冷漠，他似乎并没有在指导孩子方面扮演重要角色，但他确实真心关心他们和他的妻子。Sir Ebrum在大多数剧集中没有太多戏份，除了他在The Thing About the Ring和Cooking Up Trouble中的角色。
wikirby-page:4898.description_en: Sir Ebrum is a supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is the father of Tiff and Tuff and husband of Lady Like, and serves as 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s prime minister, though his actual duties at court are never made clear. Sir Ebrum is defined by his timid and sometimes aloof personality, and does not appear to play much of a role in mentoring his children, though he does sincerely care for them and for his wife. Sir Ebrum does not have much of a role in most episodes, excepting his roles in The Thing About the Ring and Cooking Up Trouble.

wikirby-page:34568.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34568.description_zh:
“我被称为Sir Gallant！你肯定听说过我！”
— Sir Gallant在One Crazy Knight
Sir Gallant中是一个异想天开的太空骑士，他只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集One Crazy Knight中。他是一个矮胖圆润的生物，穿着薄弱的中世纪盔甲，手持弯曲的长矛。他扮演一个同名的虚构漫画角色，并且似乎真心相信这种角色扮演，但在他短暂的幻想破灭时刻，他承认Sir Gallant只是一个漫画英雄。因此，Sir Gallant的真实名字尚不清楚。

Sir Gallant的创作灵感很大程度上来自经典小说Don Quixote的主角。他的日文名字Quixano也有这一寓意。直接.
wikirby-page:34568.description_en:
“I am known as Sir Gallant! Surely you've heard of me!”
— Sir Gallant in One Crazy Knight
Sir Gallant is a quixotic space-faring knight who appears exclusively in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode One Crazy Knight. He is a stout round creature who wears flimsy medieval armor and carries a crooked lance. He takes on the guise of a fictional comic book character by the same name, and appears to genuinely believe in this role-playing act, but during his brief moment of disillusionment, he admits that Sir Gallant is merely a comic book hero. As such, it is unclear what Sir Gallant's real name is.

Sir Gallant is heavily inspired by the main character of the classic novel Don Quixote. His Japanese name Quixano references this more directly.

wikirby-page:7216.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:7216.description_zh:
“她是一个拿着大枪又充满态度的小女孩！”
— Escargoon描述Sirica在《Crusade for the Blade》中，
Sirica是一位年轻的太空战士，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中，她的主要亮相是在《Crusade for the Blade》。她是已故Star Warrior Garlude的女儿，最初为了替母亲复仇而误入Dream Land，试图从魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）手中夺回剑Galaxia，因为她认为对方背叛了Garlude来得到这把剑。在尝试拿取Galaxia后，她从中了解了真相，并将剑交给卡比（Kirby），让他去击败怪物Kirisakin。
wikirby-page:7216.description_en:
“She's a little girl with a big ol' gun and a whole lot of attitude!”
— Escargoon describing Sirica in Crusade for the Blade
Sirica is a young space-faring warrior who appears in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, making her primary appearance in Crusade for the Blade. She is the daughter of the deceased Star Warrior Garlude, and initially comes to Dream Land on a mistaken quest to avenge her by recovering the sword Galaxia from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, who she believes betrayed Garlude to obtain it. After attempting to claim the Galaxia, she learns the truth from it, and hands the sword to 卡比（Kirby） in order for him to defeat the monster Kirisakin.

wikirby-page:29358.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29358.description_zh:
Spikehead是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要配角。他是一个蘑菇怪（Cappy），同时也是Cappy Town的居民。他和Iro以及Honey一起，是经常与Tiff、Tuff和卡比（Kirby）玩耍的孩子，有时也会参与他们的冒险。

Spikehead是一个矮小而瘦弱的蘑菇怪（Cappy），他的名字来源于自己那簇竖起的尖刺头发。他的脸颊上有螺旋形的标记，常常随身带着一根小树枝。Spikehead通常表现得不成熟且不负责任——尽管没有Iro那么严重——他说话不多，更喜欢用简短有力的感叹。他在这一点上起到了对Tuff的补充作用，尤其是会出现。Spikehead通常只对玩游戏感兴趣，尽管他也愿意在力所能及的情况下帮助别人，例如在Delivery Dilemma中。他和Honey在节目过程中互生好感，有时可以看到他们牵手，尽管这种关系并没有详细描述。
wikirby-page:29358.description_en:
Spikehead is a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） and resident of Cappy Town. Along with Iro and Honey, he is one of the children who often plays with Tiff, Tuff, and 卡比（Kirby）, and sometimes shares in their perils.

Spikehead is a short and thin 蘑菇怪（Cappy） who gets his name from his tuft of spiky hair. He is also recognizable by his swirl-shaped cheek marks and often carries around a small twig. Spikehead is generally immature and irresponsible — though not quite to the same extent as Iro — and is not very verbose, preferring short punchy exclamations. He serves as a complement to Tuff in that regard, particularly when Tuff is opposed to Tiff over some issue. Spikehead is generally only interested in playing games, though he is also willing to help others where he can, an example being in Delivery Dilemma. He and Honey develop a crush on each other over the course of the show, and can sometimes be seen holding hands, though this relationship is not elaborated on much.

wikirby-page:29272.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29272.description_zh: Sword Knight（简称利剑（Sword））是动画系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中反复出现的配角。他是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的学徒之一，与他的同伴剑骑士（Blade Knight）一起；他几乎总是站在旁边。Sword Knight与他在电子游戏中的外貌非常相似；总是穿着浅绿色盔甲，从不露出脸。他通常使用一把金色剑，并且剑法相当熟练，尽管他和Blade还有其他兴趣和技能。在4Kids配音版中，Sword Knight带有英国伦敦口音，这使他与通常无法理解的搭档剑骑士（Blade Knight）区分开来。在日语版本中，他的声音很尖，但比剑骑士（Blade Knight）和另一人经常会说完对方的句子，类似于羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）。
wikirby-page:29272.description_en:
Sword Knight (利剑（Sword） for short) is a recurring supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is one of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s apprentices, along with his companion 剑骑士（Blade Knight）; whom he is almost always seen standing nearby. Sword Knight greatly resembles his appearance from the video games; wearing pale green armor at all times and never showing his face. He typically wields a golden sword and is decently skilled with it, though he and Blade also have other interests and skills.

In the 4Kids dub, Sword Knight speaks with a British cockney accent, which sets him aside from his partner 剑骑士（Blade Knight） who is usually unintelligible. In the Japanese version, his voice is high-pitched, though slightly deeper than 剑骑士（Blade Knight）'s, and the two often finish each-others' sentences, similar to 羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）.

wikirby-page:3689.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:3689.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）……只要你需要星级待遇，告诉我就行！”
— Tiff，星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
Tiff是动漫星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的第二主角。她是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）内阁部长Sir Ebrum和Sir Ebrum的妻子Lady Like的女儿和长女。她和父母以及弟弟Tuff住在Castle Dedede。Tiff是卡比（Kirby）最亲密的盟友之一，并受到魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的指导。Tiff被认为在同龄人中非常聪明，并且她是唯一有能力在需要时召唤传送之星（Warp Star）的人，因为她最关心卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:3689.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby）...just let me know when you need the Star treatment!”
— Tiff, 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
Tiff is the deuteragonist of the anime 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. She is the daughter and eldest child of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s Cabinet Minister, Sir Ebrum, and Sir Ebrum's wife, Lady Like. She lives with her parents and younger brother, Tuff, in Castle Dedede. Tiff is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s closest allies and is mentored by 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. Tiff is known to be very intelligent for her age, and she is the only one who has the ability to call upon the 传送之星（Warp Star） when needed since she is the one who cares about 卡比（Kirby） the most.

wikirby-page:13974.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:13974.description_zh:
“我们一直是最好的朋友，对吧，卡比（Kirby）？对吧，卡比（Kirby）？KIRBY!!当我跟你说话的时候请听好！”
— Tokkori
Tokkori是一只会说话的小鸟，是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的配角。他是一只黄色的虎皮鹦鹉，住在Kirby's House附近的一棵树上的巢里，尽管他经常可以被看到睡在卡比（Kirby）的床上。他首次出现在第1集：卡比（Kirby）来到蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇，但直到第70集：Buccaneer Birdy，他的角色才得到比较多的发展。Tokkori通常被描绘为性格爱争吵，很难与他人相处，但他最终并不是卡比（Kirby）的敌人，并且经常帮助他和Tiff处理各种困难。
wikirby-page:13974.description_en:
“We've always been the best of buddies, huh, 卡比（Kirby）? Huh, 卡比（Kirby）? KIRBY!! Listen when I'm talkin' to ya!”
— Tokkori
Tokkori is a small talking bird and a supporting character in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a yellow parakeet that lives in a nest in a tree near Kirby's House, though he can often be seen sleeping in 卡比（Kirby）'s bed instead. He first appears in Episode 1: 卡比（Kirby） Comes to 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town, though he does not get very much development as a character until Episode 70: Buccaneer Birdy. Tokkori is generally portrayed as having a quarrelsome personality, and has difficulty getting along with anyone else, but is ultimately not 卡比（Kirby）'s enemy, and often helps him and Tiff out with their various troubles.

wikirby-page:4625.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:4625.description_zh:
“等一下！我喜欢冒险！”
— Tuff
Tuff是一名年轻男孩，在动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中担任第三主角。他是Tiff的弟弟，帮助她保护并引导卡比（Kirby）在成为一名合格的Star Warrior的道路上，尽管Tuff有时因冲动和不成熟而给两人带来麻烦。尽管有时在剧中只是一个次要角色，Tuff在每一集都会出现，并且通常扮演主要角色，其中比较显著的例子是在“Hail to the Chief”、Flower Power和War of the Woods集中出现。
wikirby-page:4625.description_en:
“Wait! I like danger!”
— Tuff
Tuff is a young boy who serves as the tritagonist of the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is Tiff's younger brother and helps her to protect and guide 卡比（Kirby） on his road to becoming an able Star Warrior, though Tuff sometimes causes problems for the two due to his rashness and immaturity. Despite sometimes being only a minor character in the show, Tuff appears in every episode, and often serves a leading role, with notable examples being in the episodes Hail to the Chief, Flower Power, and War of the Woods.

wikirby-page:29565.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29565.description_zh:
Tuggle是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的一个次要配角。他是一个蘑菇怪（Cappy），经营着Cappy Town杂货店，可以通过他戴的绿色圆柱形帽子和带有星形徽章的围裙区分。关于Tuggle的性格或与其他角色的关系所知甚少，但他被表现出性格上有些直率和暴躁，同时有点小气。尽管如此，他大多数时候都能顺利经营自己的商店。

Tuggle在动漫中的作用并不大，除了第52集：Snack Attack - Part I。在这一集中，他与Gangu搭档出售他们的商品；这些商品是由旧产品重新利用并组合而成的，因为原本的产品无法单独销售。这款新产品最终在Cappy Town引起轰动，使他们俩赚了很多钱。后来，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）让Night Mare Enterprises向Tuggle的商店运送一种非常相似的产品，而店主实际上看到它掉在门口。尽管情况可疑，他和Gangu仍毫不犹豫地销售这些新商品。
wikirby-page:29565.description_en:
Tuggle is a minor supporting character in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a 蘑菇怪（Cappy） who runs the Cappy Town grocery store, and can be distinguished by his green cylindrical hat and apron with star-like insignia on them. Little is known about Tuggle in terms of personality or his relationship with other characters, but he is shown to be somewhat frank and cranky in character, as well as a bit of a cheapskate. Despite this, he runs his store without issue most of the time.

Tuggle does not serve a particularly big role in the anime aside from Episode 52: Snack Attack - Part I. Here, he partners up with Gangu in order to sell their merchandise; repurposed and combined from older products that could not sell individually. This new product ends up becoming a sensation in Cappy Town, making both of them a lot of money. Later on, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） gets Night Mare Enterprises to ship a very similar product to Tuggle's store, and the shopkeeper literally sees it falling from the sky at his doorstep. Despite the shady circumstances, he and Gangu sell these new wares without a second thought.

wikirby-page:26887.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:26887.description_zh:
“Waddle Dees觉得有责任留下来报答他们的主人。”
— Professor Curio，关于Waddle Dees在Pink-Collar Blues
这一集中。Waddle Dees在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）是Castle Dedede安静忠诚的仆人，他们充当士兵和劳动者，照顾帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的所有需求。尽管国王经常虐待他们，但他们因为得到的食物和住所而留下来。Waddle Dees由Captain Waddle Doo指挥，尽管他们不是同一种生物，但仍与他们有紧密关系。人们经常可以看到Waddle Dees执行Dedede的各种命令，这通常包括试图（尽管通常不成功）保护他免受敌人的威胁。
wikirby-page:26887.description_en:
“Waddle Dees feel that it's their duty to stay and repay their host.”
— Professor Curio, regarding the Waddle Dees in the episode Pink-Collar Blues
The Waddle Dees in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） are the quiet faithful servants of Castle Dedede, who act as soldiers and laborers, taking care of all of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s needs. Despite the King's often abusive treatment of them, they stay due to the food and shelter they are provided. The Waddle Dees are commanded by Captain Waddle Doo who, while not the same species as them, nonetheless has a close relation to them. The Waddle Dees can often be seen performing various tasks on Dedede's orders, which often includes trying (though not usually succeeding) to defend him from enemy threats.

wikirby-page:35775.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35775.description_zh:
“那是一只鲸鱼！这本书说Whales是最大的现存哺乳动物！它们通过头顶的喷气孔呼吸！”
— Tiff,在A Whale of a Tale
Whales是两只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Whale of a Tale的巨型生物。当小鲸鱼从母亲身边失踪时，它们最终出现在Dream Land海岸附近。由于小鲸鱼的体型，最初观察它的人误以为它是母亲，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）试图用各种方式骚扰它，首先用捕鲸船撞击它，然后试图将潜水艇甲板附在它身上。最终，小鲸鱼成功与母亲团聚，两只鲸鱼离开了梦幻之地。
wikirby-page:35775.description_en:
“That's a whale! This book says Whales are the largest living mammals! They breathe through a blowhole in the top of their heads!”
— Tiff, in A Whale of a Tale
The Whales are two giant creatures which appear in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Whale of a Tale. They wind up off the coast of Dream Land when the baby whale goes missing from its mother. Due to the baby's size, it is initially confused by those observing it as the mother, and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） tries to harass it in various ways, first by ramming into it with his whaling ship, then by trying to attach a submarine deck to it. Eventually, the baby whale is able to reunite with its mother, and the two leave Dream Land.

wikirby-page:31059.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:31059.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）!总有一天，我会复仇的！”
— Yamikage，在Ninja Binge
Yamikage是一个小反派，也是动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的前Star Warrior。他是一名忍者大师，并且出于未知原因背叛了星际战士，与Night Mare Enterprises并肩作战。他仅出现在Ninja Binge集中，挑战Benikage和卡比（Kirby），并为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）找回一卷忍者卷轴。
wikirby-page:31059.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby）! One day, I will get my revenge!”
— Yamikage, in Ninja Binge
Yamikage is a minor villain and former Star Warrior in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a master ninja, and betrayed the Star Warriors to fight alongside Night Mare Enterprises for reasons unknown. He appears only in the episode Ninja Binge to challenge Benikage and 卡比（Kirby） and recover a ninja scroll for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）.

wikirby-page:23525.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23525.description_zh:
“现在我们像狼一样嚎叫，我们将像狼一样潜行！走！”
— Amon，在Sheepwrecked
Amon中有一只怪物羊，它只在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的Sheepwrecked集中出现。Amon曾经是一只普通的羊，直到他从Dream Land逃脱，因为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）试图把他做成晚餐，之后在荒野中被雷击，这使得Amon解释说赋予了他狼的心智。Amon有两种不同的形态：一种像普通羊，另一种则更大，长着可以像导弹一样发射并再生的角。Amon试图在梦之国召集羊群发动反对梦之国及其居民的叛乱，但最终他给了一旦他意识到在其他羊在牧羊人的号角下投降后他无法帮助它们，这场斗争就会升级。

Amon只有在日语中才被赋予正式名称，因此本文使用该名称。在英文版中，他只被称为“坏羊”。
wikirby-page:23525.description_en:
“Now that we howl like wolves, we will prowl like wolves! Go!”
— Amon, in Sheepwrecked
Amon is a monster sheep who makes his only appearance in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Sheepwrecked. Amon used to be a regular sheep until he escaped from Dream Land after 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） attempted to have him made into dinner and was then struck by lightning out in the wilderness, which Amon explains imbued him with the heart and mind of a wolf. Amon has two different forms: One resembles a regular sheep, while the other is much larger and has horns which can be fired like missiles and regrown. Amon attempts to rally the sheep of Dream Land in a revolt against Dream Land and its inhabitants, but he ends up giving up this struggle once he realizes he cannot help the other sheep after they give in to a blow of the shepherd's horn.

Amon is only given a proper name in Japanese, so that is the name used for this article. In the English version, he is only referred to as "the bad sheep".

wikirby-page:23516.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23516.description_zh:
“好了，伙计们，我要给你们介绍最顶尖的动画师！让我介绍传奇人物迪斯·沃尔尼！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy正在介绍Anige，他在Tooned Out
Anige中伪装成迪斯·沃尔尼，是一只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集中的电脑怪物。他最初伪装成一位名叫迪斯·沃尔尼的著名动画师，并利用计算机设备设置了一个场景，让帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）最初自愿，然后在不情愿的情况下攻击卡比（Kirby），而后者被迫承受惩罚，当两者的动作都被附着的光学传感器控制时。不久之后，Anige揭示了他的真实形态，卡比（Kirby）也从控制他的传感器中获救，使他能够向Anige报复并使用电火花（Spark）复制能力（Copy Ability）摧毁他。

由于在4Kids版本中从未给怪物本地化名称，因此本文使用了该怪物的日文名称。
wikirby-page:23516.description_en:
“Alright, boys, I'm sending you the ace of all animators! Allow me to introduce the legendary Dis Walney!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy introducing Anige, who is disguised as Dis Walney in Tooned Out
Anige is a computer monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Tooned Out. He is initially disguised as a famous animator named Dis Walney, and using computer equipment, sets up a scenario where 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） first willingly, then against his will, attacks 卡比（Kirby）, who is forced in turn to endure the punishment when both their movements are controlled by the monster using attached optical sensors. Shortly after Anige reveals his true form, 卡比（Kirby） is freed from the sensors that were controlling him, allowing him to retaliate against Anige and destroy him using the 电火花（Spark） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

The Japanese name of this monster is used for this article, since a localized name for the monster was never given in the 4Kids version.

wikirby-page:34803.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34803.description_zh:
“这简直是天方夜谭！”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）描述Belly Buster在A Half-Baked Battle中的样子
Belly Buster是一个巨大的浮动胃怪，覆盖着馅饼皮和蛋奶酱，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Half-Baked Battle中。它由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises召唤出来，目的是用馅饼攻击卡比（Kirby），而这些馅饼他无法简单地吞下。在最初的形态下，它投掷的馅饼味道非常恶心，即使卡比（Kirby）都不愿意吃，尽管当人们评论这些馅饼有多糟糕时，它也会感到不快。后来，它脱去外层的馅饼覆盖，并吞下了Royal Racecar，同时帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）、Escargoon和卡比（Kirby）在里面。随后在卡比（Kirby）获得炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability）并从内部引爆许多炸弹后，Belly Buster被击败。
wikirby-page:34803.description_en:
“It's pie in the sky!”
— 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） describing Belly Buster in A Half-Baked Battle
Belly Buster is a giant floating stomach monster covered in pie crust and custard which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Half-Baked Battle. It is called in by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） from Night Mare Enterprises in order to pelt 卡比（Kirby） with pies that he cannot simply inhale. In its initial form, it tosses pies which taste so vile that even 卡比（Kirby） will not eat them, though it also becomes upset when people comment on how terrible the pies are. Later on, it sheds its outer pie covering and swallows the Royal Racecar with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, Escargoon, and 卡比（Kirby） inside. Belly Buster is then defeated after 卡比（Kirby） gains the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability） and detonates many bombs from inside it.

wikirby-page:24806.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24806.description_zh:
“任何胆敢反抗我的人都将被扫荡！”
— Broom King，在A Novel Approach
Broom King是一个大型扫帚怪，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Novel Approach中。他最初伪装成Rowlin，以便控制Dream Land的人攻击卡比（Kirby），使用为他作战的魔法扫帚。然而，当真正的Rowlin出现在现场时，Broom King被迫揭开伪装，直接攻击卡比（Kirby）。稍后，当卡比（Kirby）从他的其中一把扫帚中获得清洁（Cleaning）复制能力（Copy Ability）并将他拍开时，他被击败了。
wikirby-page:24806.description_en:
“Anyone who dares to oppose me will be swept away!”
— Broom King, in A Novel Approach
The Broom King is a large broom monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Novel Approach. He is initially disguised as Rowlin in order to possess the people of Dream Land into attacking 卡比（Kirby） using magical broomsticks that fight for him. When the real Rowlin appears on the scene, however, Broom King is forced to throw off his disguise and attack 卡比（Kirby） directly. He is later defeated when 卡比（Kirby） gains the 清洁（Cleaning） 复制能力（Copy Ability） from one of his brooms and swats him away.

wikirby-page:36317.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36317.description_zh:
“只需从指定对象采集一小份DNA样本，我们就可以制造出无限数量的怪物！”
— Doctor Moro描述Chimera Dinosaurs在Fossil Fools - Part II
中。Chimera Dinosaurs是一群巨大的类似恐龙的怪物，类似于动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中反复出现的角色，是由Doctor Moro利用它们的DNA创造的。它们出现在Fossil Fools - Part I和Part II集中，并在帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的主题公园恐龙王国追踪冒险的Dream Landers。一开始，Chimera Dinosaurs可以互相争斗，但在Doctor Moro使用粉红色Star Warrior的DNA创造卡比（Kirby）-恐龙后，它们最终联合起来围攻卡比（Kirby）和他的同伴。尽管做出了这一努力，所有会被立即消灭。
wikirby-page:36317.description_en:
“Just one small DNA sample taken from a given subject and we can make an infinite number of monsters!”
— Doctor Moro describing the Chimera Dinosaurs in Fossil Fools - Part II
The Chimera Dinosaurs are a group of giant dinosaur-like monsters that resemble recurring characters from the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） and were created by Doctor Moro using their DNA. They appear in the episodes Fossil Fools - Part I and Part II and stalk the Dream Landers who ventured into 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s theme park Dinosaur Kingdom. At first, the Chimera Dinosaurs can be seen quarreling with each-other, but they are eventually brought together to corner 卡比（Kirby） and his companions after Doctor Moro creates the 卡比（Kirby）-saurus using the pink Star Warrior's DNA. Despite this effort, all of the Chimera Dinosaurs are wiped out at once when 卡比（Kirby） gains and uses the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability） on them.

wikirby-page:33034.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33034.description_zh:
“*笑*Cobgoblin，你上！现在去搞定卡比（Kirby）吧！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在《灾难食谱》中，
Cobgoblin是出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）《灾难食谱》一集中的怪物。它看起来像一个巨大的玉米棒，有手、脚和眼睛，并通过向对手射击玉米粒进行攻击。卡比（Kirby）轻松地用料理（Cook）复制能力（Copy Ability）击败了它。

它的英文名字是“hobgoblin”和“cob”（意为“玉米棒”）的双关语。
wikirby-page:33034.description_en:
“*chuckles* Cobgoblin, you're up! Now you go take care of 卡比（Kirby）!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in A Recipe for Disaster
Cobgoblin is a monster which appears in the episode A Recipe for Disaster from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It resembles a giant corn-on-the-cob with arms, feet, and eyes, and attacks by shooting its corn kernels at its opponents. 卡比（Kirby） defeats it easily using the 料理（Cook） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Its English name is a pun on "hobgoblin" and "cob", as in "corn cob".

wikirby-page:37178.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37178.description_zh:
“我们被背叛了！当我们的森林被摧毁时，我带领你们来到这里，King Dedede承诺会喂养我们，但他和他的臣民把我们赶走了，所以现在我们必须让他付出代价！”
— Crowemon在Waste Management
