Crowemon向他的乌鸦发表讲话是一只会说话的乌鸦，也是扰乱Dream Land和平的乌鸦群体的首领，在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Waste Management中。Crowemon在它们原来的栖息地被毁后带领它的乌鸦前往梦境之地，并被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）承诺以食物残渣的形式喂养，但乌鸦太多，垃圾无法满足它们，而它们贪婪的饥饿很快给梦境居民带来了麻烦。在被Dedede背叛后，Crowemon发现并喝下了剩余的安装怪物混合物并变成一个和巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）一样大的巨型怪物，很快就向那只鸟发起挑战，争夺这片土地的统治权。卡比（Kirby）通过获得风羽（Wing）复制能力（Copy Ability）帮助巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）击败Crowemon，之后他恢复到原来的形态。

Crowemon只在日语版中被命名，所以本文使用该名字。在4Kids版本中，他只被称为“眼睛上有标记的那一个”。
wikirby-page:37178.description_en:
“We have been betrayed! When our forest was destroyed, I led you here and the King Dedede promised to feed us, but he and his subjects drove us away, so now we must make him pay!”
— Crowemon addressing his crows in Waste Management
Crowemon is a talking crow and the leader of a murder of his fellows who disturb the peace in Dream Land in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Waste Management. Crowemon leads his crows to Dream Land after their original habitat was destroyed, and is promised by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to be fed in the form of their food waste, but there are far too many crows for the trash to satisfy, and their ravenous hunger soon causes problems for the Dream Landers. After being betrayed by Dedede, Crowemon discovers and drinks leftover insta-monster mixture and transforms into a giant monster the size of 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade）, and soon challenges that bird for mastery over the land. 卡比（Kirby） helps 巨大锋翼鸟（Dyna Blade） defeat Crowemon by gaining the 风羽（Wing） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and he afterward reverts to his original form.

Crowemon is only named in the Japanese version, so that is the name used for this article. In the 4Kids version, he is only referred to as "the one with the mark on his eye".

wikirby-page:34305.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34305.description_zh:
“你看，他很难区分朋友和敌人。可怜的小家伙有时会感到困惑。我想我会小心处理这个家伙，大D！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy描述Dangerous Bomb在Kirby Takes the Cake
Dangerous Bomb中是一个小型投掷炸弹的怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Kirby Takes the Cake中。他被Night Mare Enterprises派往帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），在德德德请求他们最强大的怪物之后，他最初藏在一个巨大的蛋糕里，那个蛋糕是给卡比（Kirby）的。Dangerous Bomb无法区分朋友和敌人，会用炸弹攻击任何人，但他对同样的炸弹也很脆弱，在炸弹（Bomb）卡比（Kirby）将其归还给他后，被一枚炸弹击败。

Dangerous Bomb在4Kids英语版中没有直接命名。不是动漫的配音演员，也不是原版日语发布的配音演员。他的名字直到2023年Kirby of the Stars HD Remastered Edition All-Round Complete Box发布时才为公众所知。在此之前，粉丝们通常称他为“Danger”。
wikirby-page:34305.description_en:
“You see, he has trouble distinguishing between friend and foe. Poor little fella gets confused sometimes. I'd wanna handle this one with care, Big D!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy describing Dangerous Bomb in Kirby Takes the Cake
Dangerous Bomb is a small bomb-tossing monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Kirby Takes the Cake. He is sent to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） by Night Mare Enterprises after Dedede asks them for their most powerful monster, and he initially appears concealed in a giant cake meant for 卡比（Kirby）. Dangerous Bomb does not distinguish friend from foe, and will attack anyone with his bombs, but he is also weak to these same bombs, being defeated by one after 炸弹（Bomb） 卡比（Kirby） returns it to him.

Dangerous Bomb is not directly named in the 4Kids English dub of the anime, nor the original Japanese release. His name was not public knowledge until the release of the Kirby of the Stars HD Remastered Edition All-Round Complete Box in 2023. Before this, fans commonly referred to him as "Danger".

wikirby-page:34215.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34215.description_zh:
“那些东西真帅！它们一定很漂亮，因为它们看起来就像我！它们是Dedede娃娃！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在《别指望它》中描述Dedede娃娃
Dedede娃娃（也叫迷你（Mini）-D娃娃）是小型中空的玩偶，长得像帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），并出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的《别指望它》一集中。这些玩偶是Night Mare Enterprises为帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）制作的特别礼物，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）能够用它们施展魔法咒语，让Dream Land的人们信任他并把钱交给他存进银行。然而，后来发现，如果这些玩偶受到任何伤害，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）本人也会同样受到伤害，这一事实在本集结尾时对他产生了影响卡比（Kirby）吸入了其中一个玩偶。
wikirby-page:34215.description_en:
“Them things is handsome! They've gotta be good lookin', cause they look just like me! They're Dedede Dolls!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） describing the Dedede Dolls in Don't Bank on It
The Dedede Dolls (also called 迷你（Mini）-D Dolls) are small hollow dolls which resemble 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and appear in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Don't Bank on It. These dolls were made for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） by Night Mare Enterprises as a special deal, and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） is able to use them in a magic spell to hypnotize the people of Dream Land into trusting him and giving him their money to keep in a bank. Later on, however, it is revealed that if any harm comes to the dolls, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） himself will be similarly harmed, and this fact comes to bite him at the end of the episode when 卡比（Kirby） inhales one of the dolls.

wikirby-page:29992.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29992.description_zh:
“Y‘你们不能像丢掉嚼过的口香糖一样把我扔掉！我有一个秘密武器：Dedede Stone！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），关于Curio's Curious Discovery
Dedede Stone中的怪物，它是在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Curio's Curious Discovery中出现的怪物。它是一个巨大的帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）石像，能够自主移动。虽然卡比（Kirby）无法将其整体吸入，但其中的碎片可以赋予他石块（Stone）的能力。
wikirby-page:29992.description_en:
“Y'all can't toss me out like chewed-up chewing gum! I got a secret weapon: The Dedede Stone!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, regarding the monster in Curio's Curious Discovery
Dedede Stone is a monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Curio's Curious Discovery. It is a giant stone statue of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） which is capable of autonomous movement. Though it cannot be inhaled in whole by 卡比（Kirby）, pieces of it can grant him the 石块（Stone） ability.

wikirby-page:35553.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35553.description_zh:
“那个Delivery Man确实非常快！”
— Mayor Len Blustergas，在Delivery Dilemma
Delivery Man是一只骑着摩托车的送货怪兽，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Delivery Dilemma中。他被从Night Mare Enterprises叫到Dream Land，以便快速将食物从Kawasaki's送到帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和其他居民手中，尽管他的真正目标是找到并摧毁卡比（Kirby）。一旦他找到了目标，他就试图撞倒这只粉红色的球状生物，但在得到魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的一些帮助后，卡比（Kirby）能够使用喷射机（Jet）复制能力（Copy Ability）击败Delivery Man。
wikirby-page:35553.description_en:
“That Delivery Man sure is speedy!”
— Mayor Len Blustergas, in Delivery Dilemma
Delivery Man is a motorcycle-riding delivery monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Delivery Dilemma. He is called into Dream Land from Night Mare Enterprises in order to speedily deliver food from Kawasaki's to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and the other residents, though his real objective is to find and destroy 卡比（Kirby）. Once he finds his target, he proceeds to try and run the pink puffball down, but after receiving some help from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, 卡比（Kirby） is able to defeat the Delivery Man using the 喷射机（Jet） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:23419.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23419.description_zh: Demon Frog是一只出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集里的小怪物青蛙。它拥有卡比（Kirby）并利用它在Cappy Town中造成破坏，然后在Castle Dedede中继续破坏，直到帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）将Demon Frog收为己有并变成怪物魔鬼帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）。无助的卡比（Kirby）被它殴打，直到之前被命令的Heavy Anaconda到达。Demon Frog失去对它的控制后，它吞下了帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），导致Demon Frog被击败，同时也被Heavy Anaconda吞下的过程中消灭了。
wikirby-page:23419.description_en: The Demon Frog is a small monster frog that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Frog Wild. It possesses 卡比（Kirby） and uses him to cause destruction in Cappy Town and then Castle Dedede until 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） takes the Demon Frog for himself and turns into the monster Devil 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）. A helpless 卡比（Kirby） is beat upon by him until the previously ordered Heavy Anaconda arrives. It swallows 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） after the Demon Frog loses control over him which results in the Demon Frog's defeat, as it is also swallowed by the Heavy Anaconda in the process.

wikirby-page:35490.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35490.description_zh:
“这群人看起来对坐牢比做作业更在行。”
— Escargoon描述Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk在The School Scam中的情节。
Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk是三只青少年犯罪怪物，来自星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集The School Scam。他们被Night Mare Enterprises派来，用各种恶作剧和攻击折磨Dedede Academy的老师和学生。他们特别欺负并攻击Tiff，那时她正试图教他们数学，她通过向魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）学习防身术来应对，并通过挡开他们的攻击回击。不久之后，Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk通过合体成一个巨大的怪物形态来报复，攻击Tiff和卡比（Kirby），但卡比（Kirby）在一场激烈的战斗后使用格斗家（Fighter）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:35490.description_en:
“This crew looks like they know more about doin' time than doin' homework.”
— Escargoon describing Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk in The School Scam
Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk are three juvenile delinquent monsters from the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode The School Scam. They are sent by Night Mare Enterprises in order to torment the teachers and students at Dedede Academy using various pranks and attacks. They bully and attack Tiff in particular, who was trying to teach them mathematics, and she responds by learning self-defense from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and returning to beat them down by parrying their attacks. Shortly after, Dirk, Kirk, and Smirk retaliate by combining into a single monstrous form and attacking Tiff and 卡比（Kirby）, but 卡比（Kirby） defeats them after a tough battle using the 格斗家（Fighter） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:36303.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36303.description_zh:
“见见Doctor Moro！他是这种事情的专家。实验愉快！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy介绍Doctor Moro在Fossil Fools - Part I
Doctor Moro（4Kids版本中发音为“more-oh”）是一个疯狂科学家怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Fossil Fools - Part I和Part II中。他的专长是基因工程，利用他的实验室和设备，他能够在短时间内使用其他生物和角色的DNA创造出巨大的Chimera Dinosaurs。通过利用帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）、Tiff等作为他研究中不知情的棋子，Doctor Moro最终创造出了卡比（Kirby）的混合体——他称之为自己的杰作——几乎成功地消灭了粉色Star Warrior，但最终被卡比（Kirby）获得并使用爆裂（Crash）复制能力（Copy Ability），摧毁了他和他所有的恐龙。

Doctor Moro基于文学角色H.G.威尔斯小说The Island of Doctor Moreau中的医生（Doctor）。
wikirby-page:36303.description_en:
“Meet Doctor Moro! He's a specialist in this kind of thing. Happy experimenting!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy introducing Doctor Moro in Fossil Fools - Part I
Doctor Moro (pronounced 'more-oh' in the 4Kids version) is a mad-scientist monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episodes Fossil Fools - Part I and Part II. His specialty is in genetic engineering, and using his laboratory and equipment, he is able to create giant Chimera Dinosaurs in mere moments using the DNA of other creatures and characters. By using 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, Tiff, and others as unwitting pawns in his research, Doctor Moro ends up creating a hybrid of 卡比（Kirby） - which he proclaims to be his magnum opus - and nearly succeeds in wiping out the pink Star Warrior, but is foiled when 卡比（Kirby） gains and uses the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, destroying him and all of his dinosaurs.

Doctor Moro is based on the literary character 医生（Doctor） Moreau, from H.G. Wells' novel The Island of Doctor Moreau.

wikirby-page:33984.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33984.description_zh:
“这是我们的最新作品：我们的Domestic Servant Robot！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，关于Pink-Collar Blues中的怪物
Domestic Servant Robot，是一个出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集中Pink-Collar Blues的机器人怪物。它大致呈洗衣机形状，具有可伸缩的手臂和履带，可以执行各种家务任务，但也可以变形为拥有战斗能力的战斗机器人。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises订购这个机器人以取代他的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）仆人，但这些Waddle Dees在发现它为了迫使德德偿还对N.M.E.
wikirby-page:33984.description_en:
“It's our latest creation: our Domestic Servant Robot!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, regarding the monster in Pink-Collar Blues
Domestic Servant Robot is a robotic monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Pink-Collar Blues. It is roughly washing machine-shaped with extendable arms and tank treads which is capable of performing a wide variety of household tasks, but can also transform into a battle robot with combat abilities. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） orders this robot from Night Mare Enterprises to replace his 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） servants, but these Waddle Dees come back to help 卡比（Kirby） destroy the robot after it is revealed it was stealing treasure from Castle Dedede in order to force Dedede to repay his debt to N.M.E.

wikirby-page:37106.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37106.description_zh:
“烹饪怪物最大的问题是你最后会得到一个想要吃你的菜！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）提到Ebifryer在A Chow Challenge中
Ebifryer是一个炸虾怪物，短暂出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Chow Challenge中。它从Chef Nagoya制作的炸虾中出现并攻击卡比（Kirby），但在卡比（Kirby）获得料理（Cook）复制能力（Copy Ability）后很快被击败。
wikirby-page:37106.description_en:
“Biggest trouble with cookin' up monsters is you end up with a dish that wants to eat you!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） referring to Ebifryer in A Chow Challenge
Ebifryer is a fried prawn monster which appears briefly in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Chow Challenge. It emerges from a fried prawn prepared by Chef Nagoya and attacks 卡比（Kirby）, but is quickly defeated after 卡比（Kirby） gains the 料理（Cook） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:30510.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30510.description_zh:
“那是其中一只电脑犬！我也想要一只，他从哪儿弄到的？！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）描述Electronic Pet在Kirby's Pet Peeve
Electronic Pet是一个由Night Mare Enterprises派来摧毁卡比（Kirby）的机器人玩具狗怪物，在与他成为朋友后。它出现在Kirby's Pet Peeve这一集，是该集的核心焦点。在与卡比（Kirby）建立感情、几次被对方拯救后，Electronic Pet最终未能完成其任务，反而为了保护卡比（Kirby）自我牺牲，而没有背叛他。
wikirby-page:30510.description_en:
“That's one of them computer canines! I want one of them, too, where he get?!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） describing the Electronic Pet in Kirby's Pet Peeve
Electronic Pet is a robotic toy dog monster sent by Night Mare Enterprises to destroy 卡比（Kirby） after befriending him. It appears in the episode Kirby's Pet Peeve, and is the central focus of said episode. After bonding with 卡比（Kirby）, who had grown quite attached to it and saved it several times, the Electronic Pet ultimately fails to carry out its mission, sacrificing itself to protect 卡比（Kirby） instead of betraying him.

wikirby-page:33397.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33397.description_zh:
“当心Erasem！我很可怕，但你不会记得！凡是被我攻击的人……注定会被永远遗忘！”
— Erasem，在Escar-Gone
Erasem中是一个像鬼一样的小怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的Escar-Gone集中，被描述为Night Mare Enterprises最可怕的怪物之一。它是一种虚无的生物，通过进入受害者的身体攻击他们，并让周围的人忘记他们是谁。Erasem如果受害者受到极度疼痛，可以被驱逐，此时它会飞出去寻找其他受害者附身。目前尚不清楚Erasem究竟如何才能被击败。
wikirby-page:33397.description_en:
“Beware of Erasem! I'm fearsome, but you won't remember! Whoever is attacked by me...is destined to be forgotten forever!”
— Erasem, in Escar-Gone
Erasem is a tiny ghost-like monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Escar-Gone, described as one of Night Mare Enterprises' most fearsome monsters. It is an ethereal creature which attacks its victims by entering their bodies and making everyone around them forget who they are. Erasem can be ejected if the victim is delivered extreme pain, whereupon it will fly out and seek a different victim to possess. It is unclear how Erasem can actually be defeated.

wikirby-page:36581.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36581.description_zh:
“不，陛下！我建造这个机器人是为了让我们的生活更轻松！Escar-droid将全天候听从您的指挥！”
— Escargoon描述Escar-droid时Right Hand Robot
Escar-droid是Escargoon的机器人复制品，由蜗牛建造，用来接管他在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Right Hand Robot中对帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的职责。这个机器人被编程为服从帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的命令，但国王滥用这些命令，导致机器人多次损坏。为了彻底修复它，Escargoon将来自Night Mare Enterprises的心形部件插入机器人，使其拥有感情，但这最终将机器人变成了一个会飞的发射导弹的喷气怪物。在它恐吓Dream Land之后，卡比（Kirby）使用炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability），让Escargoon非常懊恼。
wikirby-page:36581.description_en:
“No, Sire! I built this robot to make life easier for us both! Escar-droid will be at your command twenty four hours a day!”
— Escargoon describing Escar-droid in Right Hand Robot
Escar-droid is a robotic duplicate of Escargoon built by the snail to take over his duties to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Right Hand Robot. The robot was programmed to obey 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s commands, which the King abuses, causing the robot to be wrecked several times. In order to fix it for good, Escargoon inserts a heart-shaped part from Night Mare Enterprises into the robot to give it feelings, but this ends up turning the robot into a flying missile-launching jet monster instead. After it terrorizes Dream Land, 卡比（Kirby） destroys Escar-droid using the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, much to Escargoon's chagrin.

wikirby-page:34047.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34047.description_zh:
“这是一种名为Flame Feeder的新型火焰怪物。你看到其内部的火焰为它提供能量。Flame Feeder吸收的热量越多，它就越强大。”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，关于Tourist Trap中的怪物
Flame Feeder是一只巨大的会飞的火焰水母怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Tourist Trap中。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises订购了这只怪物，以增添游客的体验，同时也希望击败卡比（Kirby）。当他收到Flame Feeder时，它起初只是一个蛋，但他将其扔进Booma-Dooma Volcano后使其孵化。在使用烈火（Fire）复制能力（Copy Ability）未能伤害它之后，卡比（Kirby）后来通过冰冻（Ice）能力轻松击败了它。
wikirby-page:34047.description_en:
“It's a hot new monster called Flame Feeder. That fire you see inside gives it its energy. The more heat Flame Feeder absorbs, the more powerful it becomes.”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, regarding the monster in Tourist Trap
Flame Feeder is a giant flying fiery jellyfish monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Tourist Trap. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） orders this monster from Night Mare Enterprises in order to spice up the experience of his tourists and hopefully to also defeat 卡比（Kirby）. When he receives Flame Feeder, it is initially just an egg, but he causes it to hatch after tossing it into the Booma-Dooma Volcano. After failing to harm it with the 烈火（Fire） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, 卡比（Kirby） is later able to best it easily using the 冰冻（Ice） ability instead.

wikirby-page:33525.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:33525.description_zh:
“这个大家伙可以把任何东西都冻住！我们喜欢叫他Fridgy！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在Prediction Predicament - Part I
Fridgy是一个巨大的毛象怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的Prediction Predicament - Part I一集中。他通过用巨大的身体撞击敌人并从象鼻射出冰冻箭来攻击。Fridgy被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）召唤来冻结卡比（Kirby），以便他无法变成Dedede噩梦中的火焰幻影，但在卡比（Kirby）从魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的火炬中获得烈火（Fire）复制能力（Copy Ability）后，最终被卡比（Kirby）击败。
wikirby-page:33525.description_en:
“This big guy can put the deep freeze on anything! We like to call him Fridgy!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in Prediction Predicament - Part I
Fridgy is a giant woolly mammoth-like monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Prediction Predicament - Part I. He attacks by using his girth to slam into foes and shooting freezing bolts out of his trunk. Fridgy is called in by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to freeze 卡比（Kirby） so that he cannot turn into the fiery apparition in Dedede's nightmares, but is ultimately defeated by 卡比（Kirby） after he gains the 烈火（Fire） 复制能力（Copy Ability） from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s torch.

wikirby-page:2500.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:2500.description_zh:
“请允许我介绍我们的烹饪大师Fryclops！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在Hunger Struck
Fryclops是一位出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集的球状中国厨师怪兽。他被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）召唤来喂养他叛逆的Waddle Dees并安抚他们，然后Fryclops利用他们对他的新忠诚来攻击卡比（Kirby）。卡比（Kirby）进行报复，通过获得料理（Cook）复制能力（Copy Ability）并用它来反过来喂养Waddle Dees，从而安抚他们。之后，卡比（Kirby）在直接战斗中击败了Fryclops。

Fryclops的名字是由“炸”和“独眼巨人”两个词组合而成的。
wikirby-page:2500.description_en:
“Allow me to introduce our culinary master Fryclops!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in Hunger Struck
Fryclops is a bulbous Chinese chef monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Hunger Struck, He is called in by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to feed his mutinous Waddle Dees and mollify them, then Fryclops uses their new loyalty to him to attack 卡比（Kirby）. 卡比（Kirby） retaliates by gaining the 料理（Cook） 复制能力（Copy Ability） and using it to feed the Waddle Dees in turn, pacifying them. 卡比（Kirby） then defeats Fryclops in direct combat.

Fryclops's name is a portmanteau of the words "fry" and "cyclops".

wikirby-page:34989.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34989.description_zh:
“好的，但我想到的甲壳类动物是巨型的！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy在Garnie中描述The Meal Moocher
Garnie是出现在动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的巨型敌人螃蟹。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）当他向Night Mare Enterprises要求一只螃蟹时，意外地订购了这只怪物，尽管他没有正确表达自己是想要吃它。因此，Garnie一出现，就开始攻击帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和附近的其他人。卡比（Kirby）最终使用料理（Cook）复制能力（Copy Ability）击败了这个怪物，主要是出于之后想吃它的欲望。

这个怪物只在日文补充资料中有名字，在节目中从未命名。
wikirby-page:34989.description_en:
“Okay, but the crustacean I've got in mind is monster-sized!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy describing Garnie in The Meal Moocher
Garnie is a giant enemy crab which appears in the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） inadvertently orders this monster from Night Mare Enterprises when he asks them for a crab, though he failed to properly communicate that he wanted one to eat. As such, as soon as Garnie emerges, it proceeds to attack 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and others nearby. 卡比（Kirby） ends up defeating this monster using the 料理（Cook） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, mainly through a desire to eat it afterwards.

This monster has only been named in Japanese supplemental materials and is never named in the show itself.

wikirby-page:30343.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30343.description_zh:
“Kiiiing Dedede！付清你欠的！”
— Ghost，在Escargoon Squad
Ghost是一只出现在Escargoon Squad的怪物，该集来自星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）。它是一种可以在空中飞行并穿越固体物体的虚灵生物，并且担任Night Mare Enterprises的逾期付款收集者。它是本系列中为数不多的不与卡比（Kirby）战斗且未被击败的怪物之一。

Ghost的正式名称在该动画的4Kids英语配音版或原版日语版中均未提及，所以直到2023年Kirby of the Stars HD Remastered Edition All-Round Complete Box发布时才为公众所知。
wikirby-page:30343.description_en:
“Kiiiing Dedede! Paaay what you ooowe!”
— Ghost, in Escargoon Squad
Ghost is a monster which appears in the episode Escargoon Squad from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It is an ethereal creature capable of flying through the air and passing through solid objects, and serves as a collector of overdue payment for Night Mare Enterprises. It is one of the few monsters in the series which does not battle 卡比（Kirby） and is not defeated.

Ghost's proper name is not mentioned in the 4Kids English dub of the anime or in the original Japanese version, so it was not public knowledge until the release of the Kirby of the Stars HD Remastered Edition All-Round Complete Box in 2023.

wikirby-page:29795.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29795.description_zh:
“A怪物来了！如果你不相信我，就看看电视上吧！”
— Tuff，关于Un-Reality TV的怪物
。Great Sea Slug Monster是一个出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Un-Reality TV的虚构怪物。它被展示给Cappy Town的市民，在Channel DDD作为一个摧毁他们村庄的真实怪物出现，但实际上，它是穿着服装的Escargoon。
wikirby-page:29795.description_en:
“A monster is comin'! If you don't believe me just look, it's on T.V.!”
— Tuff, regarding the monster in Un-Reality TV
The Great Sea Slug Monster is a fictional monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Un-Reality TV. It is presented to the citizens of Cappy Town on Channel DDD as a real monster destroying their village, but in reality, it is Escargoon inside a suit.

wikirby-page:32867.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:32867.description_zh:
“认识我们的全天然牙齿怪兽，它可以在不打麻醉的情况下修理牙齿！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy描述Hardy在A Dental Dilemma
Hardy是一个出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集的机器人牙医怪兽。它的唯一目的是强行修理它能找到的人的牙齿，并且在帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises叫它过来后，它开始追赶他，但事先没意识到Hardy是“无麻醉操作”。Hardy后来被龙卷风（Tornado）卡比（Kirby）解决，在它试图检查他的嘴时发现没有牙齿可以修理。

在该动漫的4Kids英文配音版中，Hardy没有被命名。因此，它的名字来源于日文版本。
wikirby-page:32867.description_en:
“Meet our all-natural dental monster who fixes teeth without anesthetic!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy describing Hardy in A Dental Dilemma
Hardy is a robotic dentist monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Dental Dilemma. Its only purpose is to forcefully fix the teeth of whoever it can find, and it chases down 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） after he calls it in from Night Mare Enterprises, not realizing beforehand that Hardy operates "without anesthetic". Hardy is later dispatched by 龙卷风（Tornado） 卡比（Kirby） after it tries to examine his mouth, but finds no teeth to fix up.

In the 4Kids English dub of the anime, Hardy is not named. Hence, its name is derived from the Japanese version.

wikirby-page:35305.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35305.description_zh:
“这个感冒头怪非常小。然而，价格却非常高……但如果你不想感冒……”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy在《值得打喷嚏》中描述Head Cold Monsters
Head Cold Monsters是一群出现在《值得打喷嚏》一集中微小的病毒怪。这些怪物会在被吞食的人身上引起严重的类似感冒的症状，作用类似真正的病毒，尽管它们似乎没有那么容易传染给他人。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises订购这些怪物，并错误地认为感冒能证明自己不愚蠢而将其吞下。后来，他试图通过使用缩小光线缩小卡比（Kirby）并吞下他来治愈自己，以便吸入病毒，但这个计划最终失败了.
wikirby-page:35305.description_en:
“This Head Cold Monster is extremely tiny. The price, however, is extremely large...but if you don't want a cold...”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy describing the Head Cold Monsters in Something to Sneeze At
The Head Cold Monsters are a swarm of tiny virus monsters that appear in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Something to Sneeze At. These monsters cause severe cold-like symptoms in whoever ingests them, acting much like a real virus, though they do not appear to be as easily transmitted to others. 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） orders these monsters from Night Mare Enterprises and swallows them on the false assumption that becoming sick with the cold would prove he is not stupid. He later tries to cure himself by shrinking 卡比（Kirby） with a shrink ray and then swallowing him so he can inhale the viruses, but this plan ends up failing.

wikirby-page:24667.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:24667.description_zh:
“这是你最终摆脱卡比（Kirby）的机会。你看，Demon Frog有一个天敌，可以在其盘绕中将它压制住。”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy关于Frog Wild中Heavy Anaconda的事情向帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）汇报。
Heavy Anaconda是一只在Frog Wild集星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中出现的大蛇怪物。它是由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）命令的，用来对付Demon Frog及附身于它的怪物Demon Frog。当Heavy Anaconda到达时，它吞下帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），随后盘绕在其中一座Castle Dedede的塔上追捕烈火（Fire）卡比（Kirby），地点在传送之星（Warp Star）。一旦Heavy Anaconda盘绕住它，烈火（Fire）卡比（Kirby）就将其点燃并击败。
wikirby-page:24667.description_en:
“This is your chance to finally get rid of 卡比（Kirby）. You see, the Demon Frog has a natural enemy that can crush it in its coils.”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） about the Heavy Anaconda in Frog Wild.
The Heavy Anaconda is a large snake monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Frog Wild. It is ordered by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in order to deal with Demon Frog and the monster possessing him, the Demon Frog. Once the Heavy Anaconda arrives, it swallows 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and afterwards spirals around one of Castle Dedede's towers in pursuit of 烈火（Fire） 卡比（Kirby） on the 传送之星（Warp Star）. Once the Heavy Anaconda becomes coiled around it, 烈火（Fire） 卡比（Kirby） sets it ablaze and defeats it.

wikirby-page:30631.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30631.description_zh:
“这个大块头能像最棒的一样嗅出石头！他的名字是……Honker Stomper！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，关于The Thing About the Ring中的怪物，
Honker Stomper是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）剧集The Thing About the Ring中出现的怪物。他是一个中等大小的生物，以其巨大的鼻子为特点，能够嗅出宝藏并吸入类似卡比（Kirby）的物体，但通过他的鼻孔。
wikirby-page:30631.description_en:
“This big guy can sniff out a stone with the best of 'em! His name is...Honker Stomper!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, regarding the monster in The Thing About the Ring
Honker Stomper is a monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode The Thing About the Ring. He is a moderate-sized creature defined by his gargantuan nose, able to sniff out treasure and inhale objects similar to 卡比（Kirby）, but through his nostrils instead.

wikirby-page:32570.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:32570.description_zh: Ice Dragon Robot是一种机器人怪物，仅出现在Labor Daze；星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的第28集（4Kids播出版为第26集）。它以冰龙（Ice Dragon）为模型，因此能够喷出一阵锥形的冰冻气息。它是利用Cappy Town居民的无意劳动建造的，必须由驾驶员操控才能运作。
wikirby-page:32570.description_en: Ice Dragon Robot is a robotic monster which makes its only appearance in Labor Daze; episode 28 (26 in the 4Kids broadcast) of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It is modeled after 冰龙（Ice Dragon） and as such, is able to breathe a cone of freezing breath. It was built using the unwitting labor of the Cappy Town inhabitants and must be piloted to function.

wikirby-page:35187.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35187.description_zh:
“Kirisakin正要来夺回这把剑。我们必须阻止它！”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），在《为Blade
Kirisakin而展开的十字军东征》中，是一个手持刀剑、类猩猩的强大怪物，出现在《星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）》一集《为Blade的十字军东征》。在该集的事件发生之前，据说它是盗取并保管Galaxia给ENeMeE的怪物，直到剑被魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）和Garlude找回，尽管它在过程中最终杀死了Garlude。在该集的正式事件中，它被派往Dream Land，以杀死Sirica并再次取回Galaxia，但被卡比（Kirby）阻止，后者捡起神圣之剑并用它杀死了Kirisakin。
wikirby-page:35187.description_en:
“Kirisakin is coming to reclaim the sword. We must stop it!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, in Crusade for the Blade
Kirisakin is a formidable blade-wielding gorilla-like monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Crusade for the Blade. Before the events of the episode proper, it was said to be the monster responsible for stealing and keeping the Galaxia for ENeMeE before the sword was recovered by 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and Garlude, though it ended up killing Garlude in the process. In the episode proper, it is sent to Dream Land in order to kill Sirica and recover the Galaxia once again, but it is stopped by 卡比（Kirby） after he picks up the sacred sword and slays Kirisakin with it.

wikirby-page:36243.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36243.description_zh: Lobzilla是一个怪物，他只出现在Kirby 3D，这是星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的特别篇。他是一个类似小象的龙虾（在日语版本中是虾），可以通过喷出冰风进行攻击。他还可以长大成为一个巨大的飞行生物，喷出小龙虾。
wikirby-page:36243.description_en: Lobzilla is a monster who makes his only appearance in Kirby 3D, a special episode of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He is a small elephant-like lobster (shrimp in the Japanese version) that can attack by exhaling icy winds. He can also grow in size to become a giant, flying creature that exhales tiny lobsters.

wikirby-page:23182.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23182.description_zh:
“这个壳让我无敌……并且强大！”
— Maimaigon，在Shell-Shocked
Maimaigon中，是一个巨大的蜗牛怪，它在穿上由Night Mare Enterprises寄来的定制金属壳后被变成了这个样子，并出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Shell-Shocked中。Maimaigon的攻击方式是用他那条长长的“舌头”抓住对手，并用“麦麦光束（Beam）”射击他们。他只能通过把壳劈成两半来恢复正常，不过这需要锤子（Hammer）的投擲（Throw）技巧；这是锤子（Hammer）卡比（Kirby）武器库中最强大也是最终的攻击。

这只怪物的日文名字被用作本文的标题，因为Maimaigon在英文版本中从未有过本地化名称。
wikirby-page:23182.description_en:
“This shell makes me invincible...and powerful!”
— Maimaigon, in Shell-Shocked
Maimaigon is a giant snail monster which Escargoon was transformed into after putting on a custom-made metal shell sent by Night Mare Enterprises, and appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Shell-Shocked. Maimaigon attacks by grabbing his opponent with his long "tongue" and shooting at them with the "Mai Mai 光束（Beam）". He can only be restored to normal by splitting the shell in two, though this requires the 锤子（Hammer） 投擲（Throw） technique; the strongest and final attack in 锤子（Hammer） 卡比（Kirby）'s arsenal.

The Japanese name for this monster is used for this article's title, because Maimaigon never got a localized name in the English version.

wikirby-page:34467.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34467.description_zh:
“我喜欢这些新的武术玩偶！有一个拳击手，一个太极大师，一个功夫专家，一个相扑摔跤手，还有一个空手道高手！相信我，朋友们！这个新团队无敌！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）描述了Martial Arts All-Stars在Snack Attack - Part I
中的情况。Martial Arts All-Stars是来自动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的五个玩具战斗怪物组成的团队。它们被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises订购，以便向Cappy Town的人们报复他们的巧克力胶囊玩具热潮，并在角斗比赛中击败卡比（Kirby）。每个全明星使用不同的战斗形式，并最终都被格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby）一一打败，以拯救蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇免受战斗玩偶怪物的冲击。with.
wikirby-page:34467.description_en:
“I love these new martial arts figures! There's a boxer, a tai chi master, a kung-fu expert, a sumo wrestler, and a karate choppa! Believe me, folks! This new team is unbeatable!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） describing the Martial Arts All-Stars in Snack Attack - Part I
The Martial Arts All-Stars are a team of five toy fighter monsters from the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. They are ordered from Night Mare Enterprises by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in order to get revenge on the people of Cappy Town for their own choco-capsule toy fad and to defeat 卡比（Kirby） in a gladiatorial contest. Each of the all-stars uses a different form of fighting, and each ends up being defeated one-by-one by 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby） in order to save 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town from the onslaught of the Figure Monsters the fighters came with.

wikirby-page:11635.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:11635.description_zh:
“I不确定如何，但铁球武士（Masher）已经被重建，现在它要报复。”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe），在Masher 2.0
Masher 2.0中是一个巨大的机器人Monster，它出现在同名剧集的星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中。它对格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）怀有强烈的怨恨，后者最终摧毁了它过去的实体铁球武士（Masher）。这使他们在战斗中相遇。在格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）被迫撤退后，Masher 2.0追踪他到Dream Land。然而，它的停留时间很短，因为它被格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）及其来自梦幻之地的最亲密盟友的联合作用摧毁。
wikirby-page:11635.description_en:
“I ain't sure how, but 铁球武士（Masher）'s been rebuilt, and now it's out for revenge.”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）, in Masher 2.0
Masher 2.0 is a colossal robotic Monster which appears in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） in the episode of the same name. It holds a strong grudge against 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）, who ultimately destroyed its past entity 铁球武士（Masher）. This brings them together in battle. After 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） is forced to retreat, Masher 2.0 tracks him to Dream Land. Its stay is short-lived however, as it is demolished by the combined forces of 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe） and his closest allies from Dream Land.

wikirby-page:35189.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35189.description_zh:
“修复你的身体，也把它弄坏，当我们完成时，你会更瘦！”
— Max Flexer在Fitness Fiend
Max Flexer中是一个以舞蹈健身为导向的怪物，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Fitness Fiend中。他由Night Mare Enterprises派来，让卡比（Kirby）和帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）进行一项致命的锻炼课程，旨在恐吓并杀死他们，但最终适得其反，使卡比（Kirby）恢复正常，然后使用麦克风（Mike）复制能力（Copy Ability）击败Max Flexer。Max Flexer还在Kirby Mass Attack Sub-Game Kirby Quest的一个阶段中客串出现。
wikirby-page:35189.description_en:
“Fix your body, break it too, you'll be thinner when we're through!”
— Max Flexer in Fitness Fiend
Max Flexer is a dancing fitness-oriented monster who first appeared in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Fitness Fiend. He is sent by Night Mare Enterprises in order to subject both 卡比（Kirby） and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to a deadly exercise course meant to terrorize and then kill them, though it ends up backfiring by allowing 卡比（Kirby） to return to normal and then defeat Max Flexer using the 麦克风（Mike） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Max Flexer also makes a cameo appearance in the Kirby Mass Attack Sub-Game Kirby Quest in one of its stages.

wikirby-page:35697.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:35697.description_zh:
Moggy是一种大型鼹鼠状生物，在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Buccaneer Birdy中以怪物的形式出现。它是由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）从Night Mare Enterprises召唤的，目的是为他争取时间带着海盗的宝箱逃走。这个计划几乎成功，但帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）最终还是失去了宝藏，而Moggy被镜子（Mirror）卡比（Kirby）击败。

在4Kids版中，这个怪物从未被命名。因此，使用它的日文名字。
wikirby-page:35697.description_en:
Moggy is a large mole-like creature that appears as a monster in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Buccaneer Birdy. It is summoned by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） from Night Mare Enterprises in order to buy him time to get away with a pirates' treasure chest. This plan nearly succeeds, but 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） ends up losing the treasure anyway, and Moggy is defeated by 镜子（Mirror） 卡比（Kirby）.

In the 4Kids version, this monster is never named. Hence, its Japanese name is used.

wikirby-page:32650.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:32650.description_zh:
“我可以介绍一下……Monsieur Goan！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy在A Spice Odyssey中介绍Monsieur Goan
Monsieur Goan是一名熟练的厨师怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Spice Odyssey中。他被Night Mare Enterprises派遣去帮助帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在Cappy Town建造一家豪华餐厅，以同时让厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）倒闭，并诱骗Cappy吃掉卡比（Kirby）。最终，卡比（Kirby）在厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）的帮助下，使用Toxic Atomic Curry烧毁了他和他的餐厅，从而击败了Monsieur Goan。
wikirby-page:32650.description_en:
“May I introduce...Monsieur Goan!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy introducing Monsieur Goan in A Spice Odyssey
Monsieur Goan is a skilled chef monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Spice Odyssey. He is sent by Night Mare Enterprises to help 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） build a fancy restaurant in Cappy Town in order to both run 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） out of business and to trick the Cappy into eating 卡比（Kirby）. 卡比（Kirby） ends up defeating Monsieur Goan with the help of 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki） using the Toxic Atomic Curry to burn him and his restaurant down.

wikirby-page:36093.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36093.description_zh:
“你只是从它居住的岛屿上召唤这只怪物！当然，Mosugaba不会为了随便谁而出现！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在Caterpillar Thriller
Mosugaba是一只巨大的昆虫怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Caterpillar Thriller中。它最初以毛虫形态出现，生活在南海的胚苒岛上并以此为食，直到它的守护者——双胞胎Island Sisters——被Night Mare Enterprises绑架。在被送往Castle Dedede后，姐妹们用她们的歌声召唤Mosugaba来到Dream Land，它随后附着在城堡上，并把自己裹进茧中蜕变成一只巨大的飞蛾。蜕变后，它开始攻击所有人，通过撒出尘土使他们全部严重患上花粉热，但Mosugaba最终得以安抚，它们平静地飞回它们的家岛。

Mosugaba直接基于著名的日本怪兽Mothra。
wikirby-page:36093.description_en:
“You just summon the monster from the island where it lives! Of course, Mosugaba won't come for just anybody!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in Caterpillar Thriller
Mosugaba is a colossal insect monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Caterpillar Thriller. It initially appears in caterpillar form living and feeding on the Embrya Island in the South Seas until its guardians - the twin Island Sisters - are kidnapped by Night Mare Enterprises. After being sent to Castle Dedede, the sisters call Mosugaba to Dream Land using their song, and it proceeds to affix itself to the castle and wrap itself in a cocoon to metamorphose into a giant moth. After emerging, it proceeds to attack everyone by showering them in dust which gives them all severe hay fever, but Mosugaba is eventually pacified when its guardian fairies are returned to it, and they fly back to their home island in peace.

Mosugaba is directly based off of the famous Japanese monster Mothra.

wikirby-page:16448.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:16448.description_zh:
Octacon是一种怪物，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）。它是一种红色章鱼状生物，可以剧烈改变体型，从小巧无害的宠物变成城堡大小的喷火巨兽。它出现在动漫的第一集——卡比（Kirby）来到蘑菇怪（Cappy）镇——在这一集中，它通过夜间吃掉村民的羊来为村庄制造麻烦，同时伪装成King Dedede的宠物以避免被捕捉。

thumb|left|100px|Octacon的小巧不起眼的形态。

Octacon能够整体吞食生物，并快速将其消化至只剩骨头，然后吐出。Octacon能够在水中和水外生存，并可以在空中飞行。它可以在其大型形态下也会制造许多自身的较小复制体，并且能够喷火。然而，Octacon对火同样脆弱，这意味着卡比（Kirby）可以轻易通过将火焰反向对抗它来击败它。Octacon另一个不那么显眼的能力是能够催眠其他生物，使它们的眼睛变成绿色。它利用这一能力对帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）实施，使他陷入盲目愤怒并用锤子攻击卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:16448.description_en:
Octacon is a monster which first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It is a red octopus-like creature which can change size drastically, going from a small harmless-looking pet to a castle-sized fire-breathing titan. It appears in the first episode of the anime - 卡比（Kirby） Comes to 蘑菇怪（Cappy） Town - wherein it causes trouble for the village by eating their sheep at night, while disguising itself as King Dedede pet to avoid capture.

thumb|left|100px|Octacon in its small unassuming form.

Octacon is capable of swallowing creatures whole, and quickly digesting them down to the bones, which it will then spit out. Octacon is capable of living both in and out of water, and can fly through the air. It can also make many smaller copies of itself while in its large form, and can breathe fire. However, Octacon is also weak to fire, meaning 卡比（Kirby） can defeat it easily by reverting its flames back against it. One less-visible power of Octacon is its ability to hypnotize other creatures, turning their eyes green in the process. It uses this ability on 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to send him into a blind rage and attack 卡比（Kirby） with his hammer.

wikirby-page:37035.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37035.description_zh: Ozomashii是一种光谱龙形怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Sunsational Puzzle中。它被认为是导致Dream Land上方臭氧层出现一个漏洞的原因，这个漏洞让有害的紫外线大量进入。在发现它的存在后，卡比（Kirby）被派去用他的传送之星（Warp Star）对付这只怪物，最初尝试用喷射机（Jet）复制能力（Copy Ability）与它战斗，但后来用炸弹（Bomb）的能力打败了它。
wikirby-page:37035.description_en: Ozomashii is a spectral dragon-like monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Sunsational Puzzle. It is presented as responsible for a hole in the ozone layer above Dream Land which is letting in dangerous amounts of ultraviolet radiation. After discovering its existence, 卡比（Kirby） is sent to deal with the monster on his 传送之星（Warp Star）, first attempting to fight it with the 喷射机（Jet） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, but later defeating it with the 炸弹（Bomb） ability.

wikirby-page:30691.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30691.description_zh:
“他们以为闻到Pukey的气味会让他们清醒过来，但随后Pukey就会吃掉他们！”
— Escargoon描述了Pukey Flower在Flower Power
Pukey Flower（有时简称为Pukey，发音为poo-key）中，是一种食肉植物怪物，居住在Babagahara的洞穴深处。它出现在Flower Power这一集中，并且是需要克服的主要敌人。它的主要攻击策略是生成诺迪（Noddy），这会使其受害者患上昏睡病，然后引诱好心人进入它的巢穴以将其吞食。它的花瓣有唤醒Noddys目标的能力，而它的刺被卡比（Kirby）吞下时提供针（Needle）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:30691.description_en:
“They think a whiff of the Pukey will wake 'em up, but then the Pukey eats 'em up!”
— Escargoon describing the Pukey Flower in Flower Power
Pukey Flower (sometimes shortened to Pukey, pronounced poo-key) is a carnivorous plant monster which resides in the heart of Babagahara's caves. It appears in the episode Flower Power, and serves as the main enemy to be overcome. Its main attack strategy is to spawn 诺迪（Noddy）s which cause sleeping sickness in its victims, then draws well-wishers to its lair to consume them. Its flower petals have the ability to wake targets of its Noddys, and its spines provide the 针（Needle） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:36791.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36791.description_zh:
“太棒了！Red Viper！去抓卡比（Kirby）！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在Power Ploy
Red Viper是一只巨大的运动类蛇形怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Power Ploy中。Red Viper是由Night Mare Enterprises派遣的，目的是在卡比（Kirby）在使用Pump-Up D后筋疲力尽并误食Power-Down E时加以利用。起初，Red Viper可以随意猛击卡比（Kirby），几乎成功击败他，但卡比（Kirby）在最后一刻获得了厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）的体力炖汤，使这个粉色球形生物恢复了力量，并立即通过反复将Red Viper砸向地面，然后用传送之星（Warp Star）将其投向太阳击败了它。
wikirby-page:36791.description_en:
“Great! Red Viper! Go get 卡比（Kirby）!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in Power Ploy
Red Viper is a huge athletic snake monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Power Ploy. Red Viper is sent by Night Mare Enterprises in order to take advantage of 卡比（Kirby） while he is exhausted after burning out from using Pump-Up D and then being fed Power-Down E by mistake. At first, Red Viper has free reign to pummel 卡比（Kirby） as much as it wants and nearly succeeds in defeating him, but 卡比（Kirby） is given 厨师川崎（Chef Kawasaki）'s Stamina Stew at the last moment, allowing the pink puffball to regain his strength and promptly defeat Red Viper by slamming it into the ground repeatedly and then tossing it into the Sun using the 传送之星（Warp Star）.

wikirby-page:36912.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36912.description_zh:
Rekketsu是一名挥剑的教师怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Teacher's Threat。他被Night Mare Enterprises派来替代Mr. Chip——后者未能履行合同条款——去攻击卡比（Kirby）。然而，在一场短暂的决斗之后，卡比（Kirby）从Rekketsu的木剑中获得了利剑（Sword）复制能力（Copy Ability），然后使用利剑（Sword）光束（Beam）攻击击败了他，同时摧毁了Dedede Academy.

由于在4Kids配音版中未给这只怪物命名，因此使用了其日文名字。
wikirby-page:36912.description_en:
Rekketsu is a sword-wielding teacher monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Teacher's Threat. He is sent by Night Mare Enterprises as a replacement for Mr. Chip - who failed to fulfill the terms of his contract - to attack 卡比（Kirby）. After a brief duel, however, 卡比（Kirby） gains the 利剑（Sword） 复制能力（Copy Ability） from Rekketsu's bokken and then defeats him using a 利剑（Sword） 光束（Beam） attack, destroying the Dedede Academy with him.

The Japanese name of this monster is used due to him being left nameless in the 4Kids dub.

wikirby-page:23426.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:23426.description_zh:
“这个怪物叫Slice n' Splice！它会把敌人分开，然后混合他们的部位！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，用The Fofa Factor描述Slice n' Splice
Slice n' Splice是出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的The Fofa Factor集中的一个怪物，在那里它是主要反派。它手持两根法杖，用来切割敌人并混合他们的部位。它是造成Fofa被切成羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）的原因。当弯刀（Cutter）卡比（Kirby）用他的刀切断机器人的左臂，然后用毁灭性的Final Cutter把机器人切成两半时，Slice n' Splice和它的法杖被毁掉。

Slice n' Splice的日文名‘Kittarihattari’来源于日语中的切和贴这两个词。它的英文名Slice n' Splice来源于“Slice and Dice。”
wikirby-page:23426.description_en:
“This monster's called Slice n' Splice! It splits up its foes and mixes up their parts!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, describing Slice n' Splice in The Fofa Factor
Slice n' Splice is a monster which appears in the episode The Fofa Factor from 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）, where it serves as the main antagonist. It holds two staves which it uses to cut its foes and mix their parts. It is the reason why Fofa was cut into 羅羅與拉拉（Fololo & Falala）. Slice n' Splice and its staves are destroyed when 弯刀（Cutter） 卡比（Kirby） severs the robot's left arm off with his blade and then cuts the robot into two with a devastating Final Cutter.

Slice n' Splice's Japanese name 'Kittarihattari' comes from the Japanese words for cut and paste. Its English name, Slice n' Splice, comes from "Slice and Dice."

wikirby-page:36325.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36325.description_zh:
“好吧，SlicerDicer。让我们振作起来！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），在Cooking Up Trouble中，
SlicerDicer出现了一个巨大的机械机器人怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Cooking Up Trouble中。它分成各个部分，并在Channel DDD主办的烹饪比赛中被用作食物处理器。当这些部分合并成怪物时，SlicerDicer，卡比（Kirby）发现自己在与怪物战斗时无法集中注意力，因为它能够发射食物，于是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）采取行动，将Galaxia插入SlicerDicer，从而产生火花，卡比（Kirby）吸入这些火花以获得电火花（Spark）复制能力（Copy Ability）。随后，他利用SlicerDicer内的电力，使其发生故障并最终爆炸。
wikirby-page:36325.description_en:
“Alright, SlicerDicer. Let's get it together!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, in Cooking Up Trouble
SlicerDicer is a large mechanical robot monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Cooking Up Trouble. It is separated into individual parts and used as food processors in a cooking contest hosted by Channel DDD. After the parts combine into the monster, SlicerDicer, 卡比（Kirby） finds himself unable to focus as he battles the monster due to its ability to shoot food, so 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） takes action and plunges the Galaxia into the SlicerDicer, which creates sparks that 卡比（Kirby） inhales to gain the 电火花（Spark） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. He then uses his electricity from within the SlicerDicer, which causes it to malfunction and ultimately blow apart.

wikirby-page:30910.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30910.description_zh: Susshi是一种陆地鱼怪，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的A Princess in Dis-Dress集中。它作为意外遭遇出现在卡比（Kirby）和Princess Rona面前，他们必须在众人面前与它战斗，因为公主在剑术决斗中击败了帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）。
wikirby-page:30910.description_en: Susshi is a land-dwelling fish monster which appears in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） in the episode A Princess in Dis-Dress. It acts as a surprise encounter for 卡比（Kirby） and Princess Rona, who must battle it in front of a large crowd after the Princess had defeated 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in a sword duel.

wikirby-page:34875.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34875.description_zh:
“那是Teacher Creature!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），在eNeMeE小学
Teacher Creature是一个拟人化的教师帽怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集《eNeMeE小学》中。它一开始是一个无生命的绿色教师帽，会附身于任何戴它的人，并将那个人变成一个严厉且危险的纪律教师。当Tiff发现这顶帽子是罪魁祸首时，它会变形成更大的怪物形态，并用各种教学工具攻击卡比（Kirby）。在吸入其发射物后，卡比（Kirby）获得了格斗家（Fighter）复制能力（Copy Ability），并由此迅速击败了Teacher Creature。
wikirby-page:34875.description_en:
“That there's Teacher Creature!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, in eNeMeE Elementary
Teacher Creature is an anthropomorphic teacher's hat monster that appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode eNeMeE Elementary. It starts out as an inanimate green teacher's cap which possesses anybody who wears it and turns that person into a harsh and dangerous disciplinary instructor. After Tiff discovers the hat to be the culprit, it transforms into its larger monster form and attacks 卡比（Kirby） using various teaching implements. After inhaling its projectiles, 卡比（Kirby） gains the 格斗家（Fighter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） and from there quickly defeats Teacher Creature.

wikirby-page:34652.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34652.description_zh:
“哇，那只怪物超级生气！”
— Tuff描述Togeira在Sweet and Sour Puss
Togeira是一个充满愤怒的飞行球形机器人怪物，出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Sweet and Sour Puss中。它通过进入宿主体内并吸取宿主的愤怒情绪来充能，使宿主即使受到各种惩罚也完全被动。一旦Togeira吸取足够的愤怒，它就会从宿主体内爆裂出来，并使用强力爆炸针导弹进行攻击。

由于在4Kids配音版中没有命名，这个怪物使用了日文名字。
wikirby-page:34652.description_en:
“Whoa, that monster's super mad!”
— Tuff describing Togeira in Sweet and Sour Puss
Togeira is a rage-fueled flying spherical robotic monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Sweet and Sour Puss. It charges its power by embedding itself inside a host and siphoning the host's feelings of anger, causing that person to become completely passive even as they are subjected to all manner of punishment. Once Togeira has siphoned enough rage, it bursts from its host and attacks using powerful explosive needle missiles.

The Japanese name of this monster is used due to it being left nameless in the 4Kids dub.

wikirby-page:30957.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:30957.description_zh:
“你明白了，模糊宝宝！Tornadon，出来和这个傻瓜决斗！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），在Island of the Lost Warrior
Tornadon中，是来自动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的一个巨大多刺风怪。它出现在Island of the Lost Warrior这一集中，使用其制造龙卷风的能力将卡比（Kirby）及其朋友困在同名岛上，然后攻击他们。随后，卡比（Kirby）吸入了它的一个龙卷风，获得了龙卷风（Tornado）能力，从而迅速击败了它。
wikirby-page:30957.description_en:
“You got it, Fuzzy-Wuzzy! Tornadon, come out here and duel this fool!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, in Island of the Lost Warrior
Tornadon is a large spiky wind monster from the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. It appears in the episode Island of the Lost Warrior, where it uses its ability to conjure tornadoes to strand 卡比（Kirby） and his friends on the titular island and then attack them. It is promptly defeated by 卡比（Kirby） after he inhales one of its tornadoes to gain the 龙卷风（Tornado） ability.

wikirby-page:36853.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:36853.description_zh:
“Trash Basher：垃圾怪物！这太臭了！”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），在A Trashy Tale
Trash Basher中是一个拟人化的垃圾桶怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集A Trashy Tale。它被Night Mare Enterprises派来在Dream Land中喷出垃圾，以报复帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在剧集早些时候通过Monster Delivery System发送他的垃圾。Trash Basher随后被清洁（Cleaning）卡比（Kirby）击败，然后开始清理它在Cappy Town内外喷出的垃圾，尽管留下了许多垃圾在Castle Dedede由国王处理。
wikirby-page:36853.description_en:
“Trash Basher: the garbage monster! This stinks!”
— 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, in A Trashy Tale
Trash Basher is an anthropomorphic garbage can monster which appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode A Trashy Tale. It is sent by Night Mare Enterprises to spew garbage in Dream Land in retaliation for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） sending his trash through the Monster Delivery System earlier in the episode. Trash Basher is later defeated by 清洁（Cleaning） 卡比（Kirby）, who then proceeds to clean up the garbage it spewed in and around Cappy Town, though leaving much of the garbage in Castle Dedede for the King to deal with.

wikirby-page:37760.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:37760.description_zh:
“推出独一无二的Whippy！祝你好运。”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，在Cowardly Creature
Whippy是一个出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集Cowardly Creature的邪恶小丑怪物。他是“未来小怪物”怪物训练学校的头目，并被Night Mare Enterprises派去制服并接管逃跑的怪物象象（Phan Phan）。然后Whippy派象象（Phan Phan）去追击卡比（Kirby）并攻击他，但卡比（Kirby）通过获得投擲（Throw）复制能力（Copy Ability）并利用它捕获Whippy，然后把他扔进了外太空。
wikirby-page:37760.description_en:
“Presenting the one-and-only Whippy! Good luck.”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, in Cowardly Creature
Whippy is an evil clown monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode Cowardly Creature. He is the ringleader of the "Young Monsters of the Future" monster training school, and is sent by Night Mare Enterprises to subdue and take over the escaped monster 象象（Phan Phan）. Whippy then sends 象象（Phan Phan） after 卡比（Kirby） and attacks him, but 卡比（Kirby） counters by gaining the 投擲（Throw） 复制能力（Copy Ability） and using it to capture Whippy and toss him into outer space.

wikirby-page:34571.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:34571.description_zh:
“让我们看看你能否打败这个：Windwhipper！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）介绍Windwhipper，在One Crazy Knight
Windwhipper是一个巨大的风车形怪物，它出现在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）集One Crazy Knight中。它是由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）派来攻击并对抗Sir Gallant的。在怪物摧毁Sir Gallant的意志和精神之后，卡比（Kirby）出手并使用镜子（Mirror）复制能力（Copy Ability）打败了Windwhipper。
wikirby-page:34571.description_en:
“Let's see you defeat this: Windwhipper!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） introducing Windwhipper, in One Crazy Knight
Windwhipper is a giant windmill-shaped monster who appears in the 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） episode One Crazy Knight. It is sent by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to attack and antagonize Sir Gallant. After the monster breaks Sir Gallant's will and spirit, 卡比（Kirby） steps in and defeats Windwhipper using the 镜子（Mirror） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:11631.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:11631.description_zh:
“请允许我介绍……WolfWrath，相信我，大D。WolfWrath是我们最热门的怪物之一！”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy，描述WolfWrath
WolfWrath是来自动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的强大火焰狼怪物。他出现在Hour of the WolfWrath这一集中，在Castle Dedede造成了巨大破坏，放火焚烧，同时给呼唤他的帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）带来了很多麻烦，因为他不知道这只野性的怪物。WolfWrath非常强悍，能够单挑击败魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），并且需要利剑骑士（Sword Knight）、剑骑士（Blade Knight）和Galaxia卡比（Kirby）的共同努力才能将他击倒。
wikirby-page:11631.description_en:
“Allow me to introduce...WolfWrath, and trust me Big D. WolfWrath is one of our hottest monsters!”
— N.M.E. Sales Guy, describing WolfWrath
WolfWrath is a powerful fiery wolf monster from the anime series 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）. He appears in the episode Hour of the WolfWrath, where he wreaks havoc in Castle Dedede by setting the place on fire, meanwhile causing a great deal of trouble for 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） who had called him in, not knowing the beast's wild temperament. WolfWrath is extremely tough, able to defeat 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） in single combat, and it takes the combined efforts of 利剑骑士（Sword Knight）, 剑骑士（Blade Knight）, and Galaxia 卡比（Kirby） to bring him down.

wikirby-page:29275.display_work: 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）
wikirby-page:29275.description_zh: [[文件:KRBaY E001 Octacon围城截图.png|缩略图|右侧|250px|在星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）的第一集中，几只Cappies拿着火把和干草叉聚集在Castle Dedede外面。]]星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的Cappies是一群生活在Cappy Town的小村庄里的居民，该村庄受帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在Dream Land的统治。一般来说，Cappies的特征是他们基本的黄色圆锥形身体，黑色无特征的眼睛和用点表示的嘴巴。与视频游戏中的对应角色不同，Cappies不戴大蘑菇帽，而是经常穿着更平凡的衣服或拥有不同的发型。此外，Cappy镇的Cappies有各种形状和尺寸，只有少数符合默认外观。
wikirby-page:29275.description_en: [[File:KRBaY E001 Octacon enveloping castle screenshot.png|thumb|right|250px|Several Cappies gather with torches and pitchforks outside Castle Dedede in the first episode of 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.]] The Cappies in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!） are a group of people who live in Cappy Town, a small village under the rule of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in Dream Land. Cappies in general are defined by their basic conical yellow bodies with black featureless eyes and dots for mouths. Unlike the video game counterpart, Cappies do not wear large mushroom caps, instead often sporting more mundane clothing or hairstyles. Additionally, the Cappies of Cappy Town come in many shapes and sizes, with only a few conforming to the default look.

wikirby-page:1910.display_work: 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）
wikirby-page:1910.description_zh:
Gip是一种首次出现在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）的普通敌人。出于未知原因，它取代了原游戏Bounder的位置星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure），并且是少数几个取代原敌人的敌人之一（其他的是针虫（Needlous）和象象（Phan Phan））。它通常在地面巡逻或贴在墙上，向卡比（Kirby）发射星形投射物以伤害他。它也出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra中，再次取代Bounder在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的原始外观；它是重制版中的两个替代敌人之一，与Capsule J2一起。Gip像少数其他敌人一样，被吞下后不会获得任何能力。

Gip源自成语“猪飞”，即用于描述某些几乎不可能发生的事情。
wikirby-page:1910.description_en:
Gip is a regular enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）. For reasons unknown, it replaces Bounder from the original game, 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, and is one of the few enemies to replace an enemy from the original (the others being 针虫（Needlous） and 象象（Phan Phan）). It usually patrols the ground or clings to walls, shooting star-shaped projectiles at 卡比（Kirby） in order to hurt him. It also appears in Kirby Super Star Ultra, where it again replaces Bounder's original appearance from 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）; it is one of two replacement enemies in the remake, alongside Capsule J2. Gip, like a handful of other enemies, does not give any ability upon being swallowed.

Gip is based on the idiom "when pigs fly," which is used to describe something that is impossibly unlikely.

wikirby-page:2102.display_work: 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）
wikirby-page:2102.description_zh: 针虫（Needlous）是一个敌人，首次出现在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中，用来替代来自星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）的Spiny，后来又出现在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）、星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）、Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition的New Challenge Stages和星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）。在它的所有出现中，当针虫（Needlous）被卡比（Kirby）吸入并吞下时，会产生针（Needle）复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:2102.description_en: 针虫（Needlous） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land） as the replacement for Spiny from 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, and later appeared in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, the New Challenge Stages of Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition and 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）. In all of its appearances, 针虫（Needlous） yields the 针（Needle） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when it is inhaled and swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:1744.display_work: 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）
wikirby-page:1744.description_zh:
“第三次是幸运的！抓住他，象象（Phan Phan）！”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）正在Revenge of the King与象象（Phan Phan）交谈，Kirby Super Star Ultra
象象（Phan Phan）是首次在星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中亮相的中期Boss，它取代了原星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）中的Rolling Turtle，并且后来出现在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的各种其他游戏中。它最后一次作为敌人出现是在Kirby Super Star Ultra中，在Revenge of the King和The True Arena中出现。根据游戏的不同，当卡比（Kirby）击败并吞下它后，它会掉落投擲（Throw）或摔角手（Suplex）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

象象（Phan Phan）的外观类似于大象，只是它是双足行走，身体呈球形。它有一双大而黑的眼睛，以及三缕头发，类似于前两者。在瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）上的头发丝。象象（Phan Phan）经常通过在卡比（Kirby）上滚动、用象鼻抬起并投掷他，以及踩踏他来进行攻击。它还会向卡比（Kirby）投掷苹果，这些苹果可以被吸入然后吐向象象（Phan Phan）以造成伤害。

的名字来源于“elephant”的部分重复，指的是它所基于的物种。
wikirby-page:1744.description_en:
“Third one's the charm! Get him, 象象（Phan Phan）!”
— 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） talking to 象象（Phan Phan） in Revenge of the King, Kirby Super Star Ultra
象象（Phan Phan） is a mid-boss that debuted in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）, where it replaces Rolling Turtle from the original 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）, and has since appeared in various other games of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. It was last seen as an enemy in Kirby Super Star Ultra, where it appeared in Revenge of the King and The True Arena. Depending on the game, it yields either the 投擲（Throw） or the 摔角手（Suplex） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when 卡比（Kirby） inhales and swallows it after defeating it.

象象（Phan Phan）'s appearance is similar to that of an elephant, except that it is bipedal and has a spherical body. It has large, black eyes, and three strands of hair, similar to the two strands of hair on 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）. 象象（Phan Phan） often attacks by rolling at 卡比（Kirby）, lifting and throwing him with its trunk, and stomping on him. It also throws apples at 卡比（Kirby）, which can be inhaled and spat out at 象象（Phan Phan） to deal damage.

象象（Phan Phan）'s name comes from the partial repetition of "elephant", referring to the species it is based on.

wikirby-page:12387.description_zh:
Ant Doom是一种敌人和关卡危险物，只出现在Top Ride的沙子（Sand）课程中，来自Kirby Air Ride。它看起来像蚁狮和捕蝇草的混合体，占据课程左半部分的流沙坑。

Ant Doom经常从坑中间出现。当它不处于闲置或咆哮状态时，可以做两件事之一。它要么试图抓住一名赛车手——如果成功，就会把他们拖入坑中——要么开始吐出杂物，击中时会让赛车手停下。Ant Doom无法被赛车手伤害，并会吞噬掉掉入其坑中的任何物品。
wikirby-page:12387.description_en:
Ant Doom is an enemy and stage hazard which appears exclusively in the 沙子（Sand） course in Top Ride, from Kirby Air Ride. It resembles a mix between an antlion and a venus flytrap, and occupies the quicksand pit in the left half of the course.

Ant Doom appears frequently from the middle of the pit. When not idle or roaring, it can do one of two things. It will either try to nab one of the racers - and if successful, will drag them into the pit - or start spitting debris around, which can stop racers in their tracks if hit. Ant Doom cannot be harmed by the racers, and will eat any items that fall into its pit.

wikirby-page:3192.description_zh: 气球炸弹（Balloon Bomber）是出现在Kirby Air Ride和卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它的基本外观是一个拉长的、“鲨鱼鳍状”的炸弹壳，戴着骷髅面具，被认为本身就是一个炸弹，尽管它很少爆炸。然而，如果骑手直接攻击它，它会后退，飞走，并且——与大多数敌人不同——在飞行一小段距离后爆炸。
wikirby-page:3192.description_en: 气球炸弹（Balloon Bomber） is an enemy that appears in Kirby Air Ride and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. Its basic appearance is that of an elongated, "shark-finned" bombshell, bearing a skull mask, and is thought to be a bomb itself, although it rarely ever detonates. However, if a rider attacks it directly, it will recoil, flying away and — unlike most enemies — exploding after flying a short distance.

wikirby-page:3195.description_zh:
唤唤（Caller）是一个只在Kirby Air Ride中出现的敌人。它显然由多个不断旋转的部分组成。因此，它周围总是环绕着像龙卷风一样的轻盈雾气。当被吞下时，卡比（Kirby）会适当地获得龙卷风（Tornado）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它在Sky Sands和Beanstalk Park中最为常见，尽管它也会出现在其他关卡中。

唤唤（Caller）的基本外观是仙女和毛毛虫的结合体。它总共有四个小而圆的身体部分，最上面的最大，最后一个最小。它粉红色的头顶有心形的面孔，以及两根像翅膀一样的触角。环绕其身体的是轻盈的风弧，是由其身体部分不断旋转产生的。
wikirby-page:3195.description_en:
唤唤（Caller） is an enemy that only appears in Kirby Air Ride. It is visibly made up of multiple segments that constantly spin. Because of this, a light, tornado-like wisp is always surrounding it. When swallowed, 卡比（Kirby） is, appropriately, granted the 龙卷风（Tornado） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. It is most common among Sky Sands and Beanstalk Park, although it does make appearances in other courses.

唤唤（Caller）'s basic appearance is that of a cross between a fairy and a caterpillar. It possesses a total of four small, round body segments, the top of which being the largest, while the last is the smallest. It sports heart-shaped faces atop its pink head, along with two wing-like antennae. Circling around its body are wispy arcs of wind, which are created from the constant spinning of its body segments.

wikirby-page:3202.description_zh:
龙鸟（Flappy）是一种常见的敌人，仅能在Kirby Air Ride中找到。它是一种多彩的、半鸟半翼龙的生物。

卡比（Kirby）在吞下龙鸟（Flappy）时获得风羽（Wing）能力。
wikirby-page:3202.description_en:
龙鸟（Flappy） is a common enemy only found in Kirby Air Ride. It is a multicolored, half-bird half-pterosaur creature.

卡比（Kirby） obtains the 风羽（Wing） ability when swallowing 龙鸟（Flappy）.

wikirby-page:3208.description_zh:
Heat Phanphan是一种只出现在Kirby Air Ride中的普通敌人。Heat Phanphan看起来像一只小象。它有着浅红色的身体和两只火红色的脚。它的耳朵大部分与身体颜色相同，但耳尖为火红色。耳朵上也有火焰图案。它能够从鼻子喷出火焰并飞行。

Heat Phanphan与象象（Phan Phan）非常相似，因为它们的名字以及类似大象的外形。然而，它们之间的关系尚未得到确认。
wikirby-page:3208.description_en:
Heat Phanphan is a common enemy that appears only in Kirby Air Ride. Heat Phanphan resembles a small elephant. It has a pale red body and two fire red feet. Its ears are mostly the same color as its body but their tips being fire red. There are also fire patterns on its ears. It is capable of shooting fire out of its snout and flying.

Heat Phanphan bears a strong resemblance to 象象（Phan Phan）, due to their name and their elephant-like appearance. However, their relation has not been confirmed.

wikirby-page:3211.description_zh:
刺刺皮（Pichikuri）是一种鸟状敌人，出现在Kirby Air Ride及其续作卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中。它是一种戴着尖刺蛋壳状头盔的敌人，会漂浮四周，并在接触骑手时造成伤害。刺刺皮（Pichikuri）在被吸入或捕获时会赋予骑手针（Needle）能力。

刺刺皮（Pichikuri）也在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的Paint Panic中客串亮相，由画画滚轮（Paint Roller）绘制。
wikirby-page:3211.description_en:
刺刺皮（Pichikuri） is a bird-like enemy that appears in Kirby Air Ride and its sequel, 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is an enemy that wears a spiky eggshell top as a helmet, floats around, and hurts riders when touched. 刺刺皮（Pichikuri） gives riders the 针（Needle） ability when inhaled or captured.

刺刺皮（Pichikuri） also makes a cameo appearance in Paint Panic in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, where 画画滚轮（Paint Roller） draws it.

wikirby-page:3198.description_zh: 电头（Solite）是出现在Kirby Air Ride和卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它出现在赛道的黑暗区域，并通过其发光发亮照亮这些区域。当使用除吸入之外的方法击败它时，电头（Solite）会留下发光的光球，这些光球会持续照亮区域，直到它下降并消失。电头（Solite）并不打算攻击卡比（Kirby）或其他骑手，但其身体和留下的光会在触碰时伤害骑手。电头（Solite）在被吸入或捕获时不会产生任何特殊能力。
wikirby-page:3198.description_en: 电头（Solite） is an enemy that appears in Kirby Air Ride and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is found in dark areas of courses and it lights up the areas by its luminescent glow. When defeated by methods other than inhaling them, 电头（Solite） leaves behind glowing orbs of light that continue to light the area until it descends and disappears. 电头（Solite） doesn't intend to attack 卡比（Kirby） or other riders, but its body and the light it leaves behind damages riders when touched. 电头（Solite） doesn't yield any ability in particular when inhaled or captured.

wikirby-form:1254.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:1254.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:1254.description_zh: 天使（Cupid）（在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中称为Angel）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），首次出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。它也出现在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中。卡比（Kirby）通过吸收并吞食Cupie获得这种能力。当卡比（Kirby）拥有天使（Cupid）能力时，他拥有一个光环和一对翅膀，以及一张带有心形箭头的弓和箭。利用这些，他可以在空中轻轻飞行，同时向敌人倾泻箭雨。这种能力类似于狙击手（Archer）能力，因为两者都涉及用弓射箭。
wikirby-form:1254.description_en: 天使（Cupid） (referred to as Angel in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）) is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that first appeared in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It also appears in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. 卡比（Kirby） receives this ability by sucking up and swallowing a Cupie. While 卡比（Kirby） has the 天使（Cupid） ability, he possesses a halo and a set of wings, along with a bow and arrows with heart-shaped tips. Using these, he can gently fly through the air while raining arrows down on enemies. This ability is similar to the 狙击手（Archer） ability, as both involve firing arrows from a bow.

wikirby-form:1699.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:1699.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:1699.description_zh:
“聚拢过来仔细看！手里什么都没有！袖子里也什么都没有！”
— 暂停画面里的Magic风格来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
Magic是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中首次亮相，它赋予卡比（Kirby）执行各种典型Magic表演把戏作为攻击的能力。使用这种复制能力（Copy Ability）时，卡比（Kirby）会戴上魔术师的高顶帽，许多攻击从帽子中出现。虽然最初是一次性能力，但在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中回归时进行了大幅修改，现在拥有无限使用次数（大部分情况下）和不同的攻击排列。在它的两次亮相中，Magic都可以通过吞下Boxy或找到正确的Copy Essence获得。
wikirby-form:1699.description_en:
“Gather 'round and look closely! Nothing in my hand! Nothing in my sleeve!”
— Pause screen flavor of Magic from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
Magic is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） debuting in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, which grants 卡比（Kirby） the ability to perform various stereotypical Magic show tricks as attacks. When using this 复制能力（Copy Ability）, 卡比（Kirby） dons a magician's top hat, out of which many of the attacks emerge. Although originally a single use ability, it was changed drastically when it returned in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, now possessing unlimited uses (for the most part) and a different arrangement of attacks. In both of its appearances, Magic is obtained by swallowing Boxy or by finding the correct Copy Essence.

wikirby-form:4004.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:4004.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:4004.description_zh: Master是复制能力（Copy Ability）中的一个星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）。它是通过使用魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的金剑获得的，这把剑是在与暗意向（Dark Mind）的最终遭遇之前由他提供的，并在游戏完成后留在the Central Circle中。Master被认为是游戏的Last Battle Ability，但与大多数这些能力不同，它不是击败最终boss所必需的。它可以被丢弃，并且在击败最终boss后，可以像标准能力一样在游戏的其余部分使用。
wikirby-form:4004.description_en: Master is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is obtained by wielding 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s golden sword, provided by him just before the final encounter with 暗意向（Dark Mind）, and is left behind in the Central Circle after the game is completed. Master is considered the game's Last Battle Ability, but unlike most of these abilities, it is not required to defeat the final boss. It can be dropped, and after the final boss is defeated, it can be used in the rest of the game like a standard ability.

wikirby-form:2877.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:2877.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:2877.description_zh:
“缩小到极小的尺寸，这样你就可以通过狭窄的通道。”
— 星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）文字说明
迷你（Mini）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），仅在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）可获得，它会导致卡比（Kirby）缩小到更小的尺寸，从而允许他通过狭窄的通道。它是游戏中最稀有的能力之一，只能从米尼（Minny）获得，这是一种主要出现在Mustard Mountain的敌人，数量非常少。与大多数其他能力不同，它不是通过一次性吞下两个产能能力的敌人触发的能力轮盘的一部分，也不能作为Copy Essence在按下每个Big Switch后解锁的能力房间中找到。

到目前为止，迷你（Mini）只作为复制能力（Copy Ability）正式出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）（尽管有未使用的版本可以在星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）的数据中找到）。迷你（Mini）卡比（Kirby）的最后一次出现是在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe），在那里可以收集到他的精灵钥匙链。适当地，这是该游戏中最小的钥匙链。
wikirby-form:2877.description_en:
“Shrink down to tiny size so you can fit through tight passageways.”
— 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） flavor text
迷你（Mini） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） only available in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） which causes 卡比（Kirby） to shrink down to a smaller size, allowing him to fit through tight passageways. It is among the rarest abilities in the game, only being obtainable from 米尼（Minny）, an enemy primarily found in Mustard Mountain in very small numbers. Unlike most other abilities, it is not part of the ability roulette triggered by swallowing two ability-yielding enemies at once and cannot be found as a Copy Essence in the ability room unlocked after pressing every Big Switch.

So far, 迷你（Mini） has only appeared as a proper 复制能力（Copy Ability） in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） (though an unused version can be found in the data of 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）). 迷你（Mini） 卡比（Kirby）'s last appearance was in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, where a keychain of his sprite could be collected. Appropriately, this is the smallest keychain in that game.

wikirby-form:1256.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:1256.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:1256.description_zh:
导弹（Missile）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），主要可以从敌人的轟隆隆（Bang-Bang）获得，它允许卡比（Kirby）以火箭推进的爆炸物形式向敌人射击自己。它首次出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中，随后在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中出现，在那里它是四种拥有自己课程的Copy能力之一。

当未变形时，导弹（Missile）卡比（Kirby）帽子类似于导弹（Missile）的前端，虽然是粉色条纹。当变形时，导弹（Missile）卡比（Kirby）以直线方向飞行，可在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中直接使用控制板操控，或在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中使用彩虹线操控。尽管导弹（Missile）的速度在不同游戏中有所不同，但巧妙地在任何情况下控制它都不是一件容易的事，需要与车轮（Wheel）能力相似的灵巧。当导弹（Missile）攻击敌人或物体，或手动取消飞行时，它会爆炸，使任何被爆炸波及的敌人受到伤害。爆炸后，卡比（Kirby）立即恢复正常，并翻滚着向地面坠落。
wikirby-form:1256.description_en:
导弹（Missile） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that is obtainable primarily from the enemy 轟隆隆（Bang-Bang） which allows 卡比（Kirby） to fire himself at enemies in the form of a rocket-propelled explosive. It debuted in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） and later made an appearance in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, where it is one of the four Copy Abilities to have its own course in Rainbow Run.

When not transformed, 导弹（Missile） 卡比（Kirby） has a hat that resembles the business end of a 导弹（Missile）, though pink and striped. When transformed, 导弹（Missile） 卡比（Kirby） flies in a straight direction, steerable either directly using the Control Pad in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） or by using the Rainbow Line in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. Though the speed of the 导弹（Missile） differs between games, deftly controlling it in either case is no mean feat, requiring similar finesse to the 车轮（Wheel） ability. When the 导弹（Missile） strikes an enemy or object, or when canceling the flight manually, it explodes, causing any enemy caught in the blast radius to receive damage. After exploding, 卡比（Kirby） immediately reverts to normal and tumbles toward the ground.

wikirby-form:1244.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-form:1244.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-form:1244.description_zh: 左|34px大乱斗（Smash），星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）之前被称为大乱斗（Smash），是复制能力（Copy Ability）中的稀有个体，于星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）首次登场。该能力允许卡比（Kirby）在''Super Smash Bros.'' series中使用他的动作组合进行攻击，包括他的所有特技（除了Inhale，因为大乱斗（Smash）是复制能力（Copy Ability））。
wikirby-form:1244.description_en: left|34px 大乱斗（Smash）, known as 大乱斗（Smash） prior to 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, is a rare 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. This ability allows 卡比（Kirby） to attack with his moveset in the ''Super Smash Bros.'' series, including all of his special moves (save for Inhale, since 大乱斗（Smash） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability）).

wikirby-page:1741.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1741.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1741.description_zh:
暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight）是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的一个邪恶复制体，他在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中担任次要反派。他是由Dimension Mirror创造的，作为魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的黑暗对应物，是他内心邪恶部分的映射，并在他首次亮相的游戏中两次作为Boss进行对战，最初呈现出与其更熟悉的对应物相似的外观和颜色，在首次被击败后才露出真身。他还作为Dededetour的最终Boss出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中，并在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中作为可操控的Dream Friend出现；在这两款游戏中，他都拥有许多魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的能力，以及一些独特的以镜像为基础的力量。

对暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight）的动机所知甚少，只知道他总体上是邪恶的。他携带一件银色是Galaxia的版本，至少看起来与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）势均力敌，在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）开头的一场决斗中击败了他。暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight）并不像魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）那样拥有出色的空中机动能力，而是依靠与镜子相关的能力，能够复制自己的分身，用玻璃碎片攻击，并以类似镜子（Mirror）能力的方式反射敌人的投射物。随着时间的推移，他在游戏中与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的外观差异越来越明显，最显著的是获得了破旧的翅膀。
wikirby-page:1741.description_en:
暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight） is a sinister duplicate of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） who serves as the secondary antagonist of 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. He was created by the Dimension Mirror as a dark counterpart of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, as a reflection of the evil part of his heart, and is fought twice as a boss in his debut game, initially taking on the appearance and coloration of his more familiar counterpart before being uncovered after his first defeat. He also appears as the final boss of Dededetour in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） and as a playable Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）; in both games, he has many of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s abilities along with some unique mirror-based powers.

Little is known about 暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight）'s motives, aside from the idea that he is generally evil. He carries a silver version of Galaxia and appears to be 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s equal at the very least, having defeated him in a duel at the start of 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. In place of superb aerial mobility, 暗魅塔骑士（Dark Meta Knight） instead relies on powers related to mirrors, able to make duplicate copies of himself, attack with shards of glass, and reflect enemy projectiles in a similar manner to the 镜子（Mirror） ability. Over time, he has become more visually distinct from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） in-game, most notably gaining tattered wings.

wikirby-page:2890.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2890.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2890.description_zh:
“据说，这个调皮的影子是从镜子里反射出卡比（Kirby）那无辜纯洁的灵魂而诞生的。他拥有真正的卡比（Kirby）的所有能力，并且使用他的镜像复制技能来阻碍你！”
— 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）、暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby）特别页面、Story Mode: The Destined Rivals第四章
暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby）是卡比（Kirby）的一个调皮的黑暗镜像，首次出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby）是Mirror World的守护者，在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中最初被认为是敌人。他出现在各种地方，会根据卡比（Kirby）的行动来选择帮助或攻击他，并在与暗意向（Dark Mind）的最终战中，如果粉色主角还没有Master剑，将会将它交给他。

暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby）也是是星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）、Sub-Game和Kirby Fighters的最终对手，他使用自己的复制能力（Copy Ability）与卡比（Kirby）对战。他后来作为可解锁的可玩角色出现在Kirby Fighters Deluxe，并且作为卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）的Boss出现。在这些游戏中，他的配音演员是Makiko Ohmoto，就像卡比（Kirby）本人一样。
wikirby-page:2890.description_en:
“This naughty shadow was said to have been born from the mirror reflecting 卡比（Kirby）'s innocently pure soul. He has all the powers of the real 卡比（Kirby） and uses his mirror-copying technique to thwart you!”
— 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, 暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby） Special Page, Story Mode: The Destined Rivals Chapter 4
暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby） is a naughty dark mirror image of 卡比（Kirby） who first appeared in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. 暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby） is the guardian of the Mirror World, and in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） is initially taken to be an enemy. He appears in various places where he will either help or attack 卡比（Kirby） based on the latter's actions, and tosses the pink protagonist the Master sword during the final battle with 暗意向（Dark Mind） if he does not already have it.

暗影卡比（Shadow Kirby） is also the final opponent of the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） Sub-Game Kirby Fighters, where he battles 卡比（Kirby） using his own 复制能力（Copy Ability）. He later appears as an unlockable playable character in Kirby Fighters Deluxe and as a boss in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）. In these games, he is voiced by Makiko Ohmoto like 卡比（Kirby） himself.

wikirby-page:2740.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2740.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2740.description_zh: 轟隆隆（Bang-Bang）是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中首次亮相的敌人。它看起来像一个灰色和红色的火箭，有黄色的鼻子、白色的翅膀、一双愤怒的眼睛，并且在地面上有两只黄色的脚。轟隆隆（Bang-Bang）在它的三次出现中都会提供导弹（Missile）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:2740.description_en: 轟隆隆（Bang-Bang） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It resembles a gray and red rocket with a yellow nose, white wings, a pair of angry-looking eyes and, while on the ground, two yellow feet. 轟隆隆（Bang-Bang） grants the 导弹（Missile） 复制能力（Copy Ability） in all three of its appearances.

wikirby-page:2758.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2758.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2758.description_zh:
Batty是在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）和星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现的常见敌人。它是一种小型的紫色生物，有尖耳朵、一直闭着的眼睛和一张大嘴，嘴里有两颗长牙。它还有两只小脚，以及背上的一对红色蝙蝠翅膀，能够快速拍动。

 Batty通常在天花板上悬挂或在空中飘飞，主要栖息在黑暗的地方，如洞穴和建筑物，包括Moonlight Mansion和Carrot Castle。当卡比（Kirby）靠近Batty时，它会变得活跃，离开等待的位置去追逐他，并能够穿过墙壁和其他障碍物。如果它撞到卡比（Kirby），会对他造成伤害；然而，像大多数其他敌人一样，它在过程中自身也会受到伤害。离初始位置太远会导致它放弃追赶并返回最初被发现的位置。

虽然蝙蝠血量低，可以通过任何攻击击败，但它们体型小、移动迅速，使得命中它们变得困难。Inhaling，吞下Batty并不会赋予卡比（Kirby）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:2758.description_en:
Batty is a common enemy that appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） and 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is a small, purple creature with pointed ears, perpetually closed eyes and a large mouth containing two long fangs. It also has two small feet, as well as a pair of red bat wings on its back, which it is able to flap very quickly.

Batties are found either hanging from the ceiling or fluttering in midair in various locations, primarily dwelling in dark places like caves and buildings, including Moonlight Mansion and Carrot Castle. Once 卡比（Kirby） approaches a Batty, it becomes active, leaving its waiting spot to fly after him, moving through walls and other obstacles as it does. If it manages to bump into 卡比（Kirby）, it harms him; however, like most other enemies, it takes damage itself as well in the process. Straying too far from its initial position causes it to give up the chase and return to the spot it was originally found in.

Although Batties have low health and can be defeated with any attack, their small size and swift movements can make them difficult to hit. Inhaling and swallowing a Batty does not grant 卡比（Kirby） a 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:1773.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1773.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1773.description_zh: Big Waddle Dee是一个超大的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。它的具体大到什么程度取决于它出现的游戏，但至少大到与平均的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）对比时可以被注意到。除了大小之外，这个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）通常与普通的没有视觉上的区别。然而，它增大的体型通常意味着它有更多的生命值和/或卡比（Kirby）需要更长时间来Inhale。它也可能在被吐出时自行变成Blaster Bullet。尽管体型大，Big Waddle Dee通常对卡比（Kirby）的威胁不比普通的更大。
wikirby-page:1773.description_en: Big Waddle Dee is an extra large 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）.
