How much larger it is depends on the game it appears in, but it is at least large enough to be noticeable when compared to its average 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） counterparts. Apart from the size, there are typically no visual distinctions between this 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） and the normal ones. However, its increased size usually means that it has more health and/or it takes longer for 卡比（Kirby） to Inhale. It may also become a Blaster Bullet on its own when spat out. Despite its size, Big Waddle Dee is usually no more a threat to 卡比（Kirby） than the normal ones.

wikirby-page:3542.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:3542.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:3542.description_zh: Blockin是一种相对罕见的敌人，会伪装成Star Block直到被打扰。它首次出现于星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror），此后只在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现，在那里执行完全相同的功能。Blockin不能被吸入，但可以使用任何其他方式击败。
wikirby-page:3542.description_en: Blockin is a relatively uncommon enemy which disguises itself as a Star Block until disturbed. It debuted in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, and has since only appeared in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, where it served the exact same function. Blockin cannot be inhaled, but it can be defeated using any other means.

wikirby-page:1978.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1978.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1978.description_zh:
Boxin是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中相对罕见的敌人。正如其名字所示，以及爪子上的拳击手套，Boxin会在靠近卡比（Kirby）时进行刺拳攻击，虽然它也可以向他进行翻滚跳跃。与飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）、蛙镜鱼（Blipper）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）不同，Boxins通常不会成群出现，因为在关卡的任何房间或区域中通常只会发现单个个体。这个敌人的外形特征类似于小狗或鼹鼠，但略带拟人化，以呈现双足站立姿态。当吸入时，Boxin将赋予卡比（Kirby）格斗家（Fighter）复制能力（Copy Ability）的能力。

Boxin在某些方面可以说与中型BOSS Box Boxer相似，因为两者依赖类似格斗家（Fighter）的技术，尽管后者是用耳朵而不是手臂进行打斗。
wikirby-page:1978.description_en:
Boxin is a relatively uncommon enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. As indicated by its name and the boxing gloves on its paws, Boxin will jab at 卡比（Kirby） when he gets near, though it can also perform a rolling leap towards him. Unlike the 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）s, 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）s, and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s, Boxins generally are not found in groups as often only a single one can be found in any given room or area in a stage. The physical traits of this enemy resemble that of a small dog or mole, though somewhat anthropomorphized to be given a bipedal stance. When inhaled, Boxin will empower 卡比（Kirby） with the 格斗家（Fighter） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Boxin can be said to be similar in some respects to the mid-boss Box Boxer, as both rely on 格斗家（Fighter）-like techniques, though the latter uses its ears to box with instead of arms.

wikirby-page:2640.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2640.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2640.description_zh:
Chip是一种常见的圆形毛茸茸敌人，会出现在少数几款卡比（Kirby）游戏中。它是一种有弹性的、无四肢的圆形生物，拥有黄色毛发、两只大大的黑色圆眼睛、愉快的表情以及一条像红狐一样白色尾尖的尾巴。

Chip通过跳跃移动，在每次跳跃之间会在地面短暂停顿。它通过碰撞进行攻击，在攻击过程中会对卡比（Kirby）本身以及自己造成伤害。Chip生命值不多，容易受到所有攻击的伤害，并且被吞下时不会掉落复制能力（Copy Ability）。然而，Chip往往会与它同类的其他成员成群结队出现，这使它们比单独行动的敌人更具威胁性。solo.
wikirby-page:2640.description_en:
Chip is a common round fuzzy enemy that appears in a select number of 卡比（Kirby） games. It is a bouncy, limbless, round creature with yellow fur, two large round black eyes, a cheery expression, and a white-tipped tail resembling that of a red fox.

Chip moves by jumping around, periodically hesitating on the ground for a short while in-between each bound. It attacks via collision, harming both 卡比（Kirby） and itself in the process. Chip does not have much health, is vulnerable to all attacks and does not give a 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. However, Chip tends to be found in large groups with other members of its kin, making them somewhat more threatening than enemies which go solo.

wikirby-page:2747.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2747.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2747.description_zh: Cookin是一种罕见的厨师敌人，仅在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中出现。它是一个圆胖的亮黄色生物，有一双小眼睛和一张始终板着的嘴，还有两只红色的脚和一只戴着手套的手，手里拿着一只红色煎锅，漂浮在身体旁边。它头上戴着一顶白色厨帽，象征其厨师身份。它是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中唯一能掉落料理（Cook）能力的常规敌人，除了Prank在其中一个恶作剧中具有相同攻击。
wikirby-page:2747.description_en: Cookin is a rare chef enemy appearing exclusively in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a rotund, bright yellow creature with a pair of small eyes and a mouth that is constantly frowning, as well as two red feet and a singular, gloved hand holding a red frying pan floating next to its body. On its head, it wears a toque blanche, signifying its status as a cook. It is the only regular enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） to yield the 料理（Cook） ability, apart from Prank which has an identical attack in one of its pranks.

wikirby-page:6395.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:6395.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:6395.description_zh:
Cupie是一种不常见的飞行敌人，它看起来像一个绿色的鬼魂，带有翅膀和弓，脸和手与卡比（Kirby）类似。当被吞下时，它能提供天使（Cupid）的能力。

Cupie通常单独出现，悬空飞行或在狭小的圆圈里飞行。如果卡比（Kirby）在其射程内，Cupie会尝试向他射箭，这些箭在短距离后会以弧线落下。Cupie并不特别具有威胁性，因为它的移动缓慢且可预测，而且它射出的箭也不多。这些箭本身如果卡比（Kirby）直接在Cupie的上方或下方，是无法击中的。
wikirby-page:6395.description_en:
Cupie is an uncommon flying enemy who resembles a green ghost with wings and a bow, and a face and hands similar to that of 卡比（Kirby）. It provides the 天使（Cupid） ability when swallowed.

Cupie is typically seen on its own, flying in place or in tight circles. If 卡比（Kirby） is in range, Cupie will attempt to fire arrows at him, which travel a very short distance before falling down in an arc. Cupie is not particularly threatening, as its movement is slow and predictable, and its arrows are not fired very often. These arrows themselves are incapable of hitting 卡比（Kirby） if he is directly above or below Cupie.

wikirby-page:2717.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2717.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2717.description_zh: Droppy是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中的一个普通敌人。它是一个圆形的黄色生物，有两个尖尖的脚和头顶的另一个尖，呈滴状。它的脸只由两只大黑眼睛和一个小红嘴组成。如果卡比（Kirby）带着复制能力（Copy Ability）接近它，它会尝试窃取其能力，如果成功，将变成相应的敌人（有少数例外）。
wikirby-page:2717.description_en: Droppy is a common enemy in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a round, yellow creature with two pointed tips for feet and another at the top of its head, giving it a drop-like shape. Its face consists solely of two large black eyes and a small red mouth. If 卡比（Kirby） approaches it with a 复制能力（Copy Ability）, it will attempt to steal his ability and, if successful, transform into a corresponding enemy (with a few exceptions).

wikirby-page:2786.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2786.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2786.description_zh:
凤犁（Foley）是一种敌人，首次出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）。它是一种小型的黄色生物，头上有两片叶子，充当螺旋桨。凤犁（Foley）是一种常见敌人，通常悬浮在卡比（Kirby）上方，当其下方有卡比（Kirby）时会掉下来，类似于Coconut。凤犁（Foley）被卡比（Kirby）吸入并吞下后会掉落炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

凤犁（Foley）本质上可以看作是一个活的飞行炸弹，通过螺旋桨在空中固定位置或按照固定模式移动。当卡比（Kirby）经过下方时，凤犁（Foley）会从螺旋桨上分离并在短暂暂停后掉落。如果凤犁（Foley）碰到卡比（Kirby）或地面，它将爆炸，自我消灭并对是一个小区域。然而，在大多数游戏中，如果凤犁（Foley）被任何攻击击败（包括落在卡比（Kirby）的伞上），它是不会爆炸的，这与无论如何都会爆炸的Coconut不同。当然，如果凤犁（Foley）掉进无底深渊或水中，它也无法爆炸，并会分别被击败或消失。
wikirby-page:2786.description_en:
凤犁（Foley） is an enemy which first appeared in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a small, yellow creature with two leaves on its head, which act as a propeller. 凤犁（Foley） is a common enemy that usually hovers above 卡比（Kirby） and falls down when he is below it, similar to a Coconut. 凤犁（Foley） yields the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled and swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

凤犁（Foley） can essentially be seen as a living flying bomb, holding in place or moving in a fixed pattern through the air on its propeller. When 卡比（Kirby） passes underneath, 凤犁（Foley） will separate from its propeller and drop after a brief pause. If 凤犁（Foley） hits 卡比（Kirby） or the floor, it will detonate, defeating itself and dealing damage in a small area. However, in most games, 凤犁（Foley） will not detonate if it is defeated by any attack (including landing on 卡比（Kirby）'s parasol), unlike Coconuts which detonate regardless. Naturally, if 凤犁（Foley） falls into a bottomless pit or into a body of water, it will be unable to detonate, and will be defeated or disappear respectively.

wikirby-page:2653.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2653.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2653.description_zh: Giant Rocky是一个只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的大型敌人。它类似于硬石（Rocky），但体型更大，嘴巴和眉毛看起来很生气，并且头上戴的是黄色矿工头盔而不是头巾。像它的小型变体一样，巨型洛基的脚是扁平的、圆形的、橙色的。
wikirby-page:2653.description_en: Giant Rocky is a large enemy that appears exclusively in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It resembles 硬石（Rocky）, but is more massive, has an angry-looking mouth and eyebrows and wears a yellow mining helmet on its head instead of a bandana. Like its smaller variant, Giant Rockies' feet are flat, round, and orange.

wikirby-page:2896.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2896.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2896.description_zh: Golem是一种相对常见的大型敌人，首次出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。石像鬼是蛋形的石雕，大小约为卡比（Kirby）的三倍。它们的腿非常短，但手臂要长得多。
wikirby-page:2896.description_en: Golem is a type of relatively common large enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. Golems are egg-shaped stone statues about three times the size of 卡比（Kirby）. They have very short legs, but much longer arms.

wikirby-page:4166.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:4166.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:4166.description_zh:
Haley是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）专属的敌人。它看起来像刺猬或豪猪，皮肤呈桃色，眼睛是蓝色，身上覆盖着一层蓝色的尖刺，像火焰一样在它身后拖曳。它没有明显的嘴巴或四肢。

在整个游戏中，Haleys主要出现在高海拔地区。攻击时，这些简单的敌人只会根据卡比（Kirby）在它们出现时与自己的位置关系，沿直线向左或向右飞行；一旦进入卡比（Kirby）的视野，它们就无法再掉头。与Haley碰撞会使卡比（Kirby）失去生命，并将敌人稍微击退，但不会阻止它继续前进。尽管它的主要角色是空中生物，Haley也能够在水下生存。

虽然哈雷斯容易受到任何攻击，但吸入和吞咽它们并不会赋予卡比（Kirby）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它的名字似乎是以Halley's Comet命名的；考虑到它彗星般的外观以及在外太空区域的常见目击，这个名字很贴切。
wikirby-page:4166.description_en:
Haley is an enemy exclusive to 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It resembles a porcupine or hedgehog with peach-colored skin, blue eyes and a coat of blue spines trailing behind it like fire. It possesses no visible mouth or limbs.

Throughout the game, Haleys are primarily encountered at high altitudes. To attack, these simple opponents do nothing but fly leftwards or rightwards in a straight line, depending on 卡比（Kirby） position in relation to their own at the moment they appear on the screen; once in 卡比（Kirby）'s view, they cannot turn around anymore. Colliding with a Haley causes 卡比（Kirby） to lose health and knocks the enemy back a little, but does not keep it from proceeding on its path. Despite its primary role as an aerial creature, Haley is also capable of surviving underwater.

While Haleys are vulnerable to any attack, inhaling and swallowing them does not grant 卡比（Kirby） a 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Its name appears to be based after Halley's Comet; a fitting name given its comet-like appearance and its common sightings in outer-space regions.

wikirby-page:2156.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2156.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2156.description_zh:
Heavy Knight是一个大型敌人，可与其他持剑骑士敌人如剑骑士（Blade Knight）和利剑骑士（Sword Knight）相媲美。这个铁甲战士首次登场于星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror），并再次出现在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）。它常常被发现守护着镜子（Mirror）、Treasure Chest、开关，或者仅仅守护卡比（Kirby）通过该区域的通路。吞下Heavy Knight需要使用Super Inhale，这样做会给卡比（Kirby）带来利剑（Sword）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Heavy Knight的装备似乎是灰色盔甲，上面有红色和金色装饰。肩甲上也有尖刺，头盔正面有一个大尖刺。尽管其动作缓慢，但剑击会迅速下劈并向后切出强力斩击。这结合其体型和高生命值，使其成为一个不容小觑的可怕敌人。Heavy Knight对震颤也有一定抵抗力，只有像Star Bullet那样的强力打击才能将其击退。
wikirby-page:2156.description_en:
Heavy Knight is a large enemy comparable to other sword-wielding knight enemies such as 剑骑士（Blade Knight） and 利剑骑士（Sword Knight）. This iron clad warrior debuts in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, and appeared again in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It can often be found guarding a 镜子（Mirror）, Treasure Chest, switch, or just 卡比（Kirby）'s access through the area. Swallowing a Heavy Knight requires use of a Super Inhale, and doing so gives 卡比（Kirby） the 利剑（Sword） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Heavy Knight appears to have gray armor topped with red and gold trim. Spikes are also located on both of its shoulder pads, along with a large spike on the forehead of its helmet. Although its movements are slow, its sword strikes swoop down and slice backwards in powerful slashes. This combined with its size and high health makes it an imposing enemy not to be taken lightly. Heavy Knight is also somewhat resistant to flinching, only being knocked back by powerful strikes such as those from Star Bullets.

wikirby-page:6148.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:6148.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:6148.description_zh:
Jack是出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的敌人。它会藏在Fuse Cannon中，使卡比（Kirby）无法进入，除非它能将其驱逐。

Jack看起来像一个赛诺类的斑点小面孔的团块，头上连着一个像钓鱼灯一样的浅色球体。它会藏在大炮中，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近，它才会偶尔跳出来攻击，通过吐出星形投射物攻击它。在它尝试攻击之前是无法受到伤害的。另一种驱逐Jack的方法是射击大炮。

Jack被吞下时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。此外，与大多数敌人不同，如果卡比（Kirby）离开屏幕再回来，它也不会重新生成。
wikirby-page:6148.description_en:
Jack is an enemy that appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It hides in Fuse Cannons, making them inaccessible to 卡比（Kirby） unless he can dislodge it.

Jack resembles a cyanoid blob with a small dotted face and a pale bulb attached to a string on its head, much like the light on an anglerfish. It hides in the cannon until 卡比（Kirby） gets close, when it will occasionally pop out and attack him by spitting a star-shaped projectile. It cannot be harmed until it tries to attack. Another way to dislodge a Jack is by firing the cannon.

Jack gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Additionally, unlike most enemies, it will not respawn if 卡比（Kirby） leaves the screen and comes back.

wikirby-page:2647.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2647.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2647.description_zh: Leap是一个基本的，但相对罕见的敌人，只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。它看起来像一个小的浅蓝色生物，头顶有一对小小的白色翅膀，脸上红扑扑的，由两只圆圆的黑眼睛和一对大红嘴唇组成，嘴唇大得几乎和整个身体一样大。它的名字是“嘴唇”这个词的双关语。
wikirby-page:2647.description_en: Leap is a basic, but comparably rare enemy appearing exclusively in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It resembles a small, light blue creature with tiny, white wings attached to the top of its head and a blushing face consisting of two round, black eyes and a pair of large, red lips as big as the entire rest of its body. Its name is a pun on the word "lip".

wikirby-page:6070.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:6070.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:6070.description_zh:
Metal Guardian是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中一种罕见的大型敌人。它出现的频率很低，本质上是Laser Ball的大型版本，就像Heavy Knight是利剑骑士（Sword Knight）的大型版本，Giant Rocky是硬石（Rocky）的大型版本一样。像所有巨型版本一样，需要Super Inhale才能击败它，而且它的HP比普通敌人高得多。

当首次遇到它时，它正在休息。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会张开并开始在空中旋转漂浮。然后，它可以通过先冲撞，然后发射三道激光或一束强力激光来攻击卡比（Kirby）。当被吞下时，它提供镭射（Laser）能力。
wikirby-page:6070.description_en:
Metal Guardian is an uncommon large enemy in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It appears infrequently, and is essentially a large version of Laser Ball, very much like how Heavy Knight is a large version of 利剑骑士（Sword Knight） and how Giant Rocky is a large version of 硬石（Rocky）. Like all giant versions, it requires a Super Inhale to defeat, and it has significantly more HP than normal enemies.

When first encountered, it is resting. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches it, it opens and start floating in circles. Then, it can attack 卡比（Kirby） by first charging, then shooting three laser beams or one powerful one. It provides the 镭射（Laser） ability when swallowed.

wikirby-page:2879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2879.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2879.description_zh:
米尼（Minny）是在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中出现的敌人。它是一个非常小的类似瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的敌人，用四条小的柱状手臂和脚爬行。它的身体是红色的，脸部类似卡比（Kirby）。如果一个被他吸入并吞下，卡比（Kirby）会获得迷你（Mini）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

 Minnys在整个游戏中很少出现。有时它们被包裹在墙内，允许卡比（Kirby）吸入它们以获取能力，但无法接触到他并造成伤害。它们没有攻击，只是在高速来回奔跑，如果碰到卡比（Kirby）会造成伤害。它们非常弱，可以被任何攻击打败。
wikirby-page:2879.description_en:
米尼（Minny） is an enemy that appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a very small 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）-like enemy that crawls on four tiny peg-shaped arms and feet. It has a red body, and a face akin to 卡比（Kirby）'s. 卡比（Kirby） gains the 迷你（Mini） 复制能力（Copy Ability） if one is inhaled and swallowed by him.

Minnys are found infrequently throughout the game. Sometimes they are encased in walls, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to inhale them for their ability, but are unable to reach him and do harm. They have no attacks and merely run back and forth at a high speed, hurting 卡比（Kirby） if they happen to bump into him. They are very weak and can be defeated by any attack.

wikirby-page:2255.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2255.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2255.description_zh: 镜蓝（Mirra）是一种罕见敌人，只能在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中发现。它的外观是像水滴状的黄色生物，有两个大大的黑眼睛和一张小嘴。它栖息在镜框中——游戏中相当于门的存在——最初看起来似乎与镜框融合在一起。虽然对大多数Copy能力和投射物易受伤害，但Mirras对卡比（Kirby）的滑行攻击免疫，并且无法被吸入，因此不会获得任何能力。被击败的镜蓝（Mirra）除非卡比（Kirby）离开区域并再次进入，否则不会重生。
wikirby-page:2255.description_en: 镜蓝（Mirra） is a rare enemy exclusively found in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. Its appearance is that of a blob-like, yellow creature with two big, black eyes and a small mouth. It dwells in the frames of mirrors—the game's equivalent to doors—and appears to be fused to them initially. While vulnerable to most Copy Abilities and projectiles, Mirras are immune to 卡比（Kirby）'s sliding attack and cannot be inhaled, thus yielding no ability. A defeated 镜蓝（Mirra） does not respawn unless 卡比（Kirby） leaves the section and enters it again.

wikirby-page:11402.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:11402.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:11402.description_zh: Poison苹果是重复出现的有毒投掷物，通常由风语大树（Whispy Woods）及其亲属投掷。与普通Apple和大多数其他物体不同，这些水果可能吸入时有危险，会导致卡比（Kirby）受到少量伤害，有些甚至会使卡比（Kirby）无法将其再吐出。尽管如此，有毒苹果可以通过其他方式摧毁而不会产生后果。
wikirby-page:11402.description_en: Poison apples are recurring poisonous projectiles, typically dropped by 风语大树（Whispy Woods） and his relatives. Unlike regular Apples and most other objects, these fruit may be dangerous to inhale, causing 卡比（Kirby） to take a small amount of damage when doing so, with some causing 卡比（Kirby） to be unable to spit them back out again afterward. Despite this, poison apples can be destroyed by other means without consequence.

wikirby-page:4464.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:4464.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:4464.description_zh: Prank是一种紫色的、恶魔般的敌人，专门出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）。它是一种小型紫色生物，体形类似卡比（Kirby），但腿更长，头上有两根角。它相当稀有，并以新颖的方式攻击卡比（Kirby），并非所有攻击都会造成伤害。
wikirby-page:4464.description_en: Prank is a purple, fiend-like enemy exclusively found in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a small purple creature with physique similar to 卡比（Kirby）, though with longer legs and two horns atop its head. It is fairly rare, and attacks 卡比（Kirby） in novel ways, not all of which deal him damage.

wikirby-page:2705.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2705.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2705.description_zh: Roly-Poly是一种常见敌人，只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。它是一个圆形的蓝色生物，大约与卡比（Kirby）自身一样大，有两只圆形的黑眼睛、一个短鼻子和一双深蓝色的脚。
wikirby-page:2705.description_en: Roly-Poly is a common type of enemy appearing only in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a round, blue creature roughly the size of 卡比（Kirby） himself with two circular, black eyes, a short snout and a pair of dark blue feet.

wikirby-page:4319.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:4319.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:4319.description_zh: Shooty是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中的敌人。它像一架小型红蓝飞机，有两只红色的脚和一张脸，这张脸仅由两只带蓝色虹膜的愤怒眼睛和一个小嘴组成。
wikirby-page:4319.description_en: Shooty is an enemy in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It resembles a small, red and blue aeroplane with two red feet and a face, which consists solely of two angry eyes with blue irises and a small mouth.

wikirby-page:1111.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1111.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1111.description_zh:
Snooters是出现在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的敌对生物。它们看起来像泥土般的身影，拥有梨色的身体、短小的手臂和腿，以及一对明显的绿色嘴唇，这可能也是它名字的由来。它们的头顶还有一小撮金色头发。虽然它们最初被介绍为Mirror World的居民，但在Dream Land中也能找到一些。它们在各个关卡中悠闲地四处游荡，如果卡比（Kirby）不够小心，它们会通过吞下并吐出他来进行攻击。除了食量惊人，它们似乎还有暴躁的性格，当受到不会立即击败它们的攻击时，这一点尤为明显。当它们愤怒时，梨色的身体会变成红色，它们露出愤怒的怒视，他们头上的头发变得刺猬状，并开始失控地到处骚乱，同时头上冒出烟雾。在这种状态下，他们不再吞下卡比（Kirby），而是通过撞击来攻击他。一只愤怒的Snooter移动速度也比平静时快得多。

Snooter的一个更独特的特征是它能够吃诸如食物之类的物品，从而阻止卡比（Kirby）获得它们。
wikirby-page:1111.description_en:
Snooters are creatures that appear as enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. They look like cloddy figures with pear-colored bodies, stubby arms and legs, and a pronounced pair of green lips, which it is probably named after. It also has a small tuft of blonde hair on top of its head. While they were introduced as inhabitants of the Mirror World at first, there are also some to be found in Dream Land. They stroll around idly in various levels and attack 卡比（Kirby） by swallowing him and spitting him out again if he is not careful enough. Aside from their great appetite, they also seem to possess a hot temper which shows when they get hit by an attack that does not instantly defeat them. When enraged, their pear-colored bodies turn red, they adopt an angry glare, the hair on their heads becomes spiky and they begin to rampage around uncontrollably, while smoke emerges from their heads. They no longer swallow 卡比（Kirby） in this form, but attack him by ramming. An enraged Snooter also moves much faster than its calm counterpart.

One of Snooter's more unique traits is its ability to eat items such as food, thus preventing 卡比（Kirby） from getting them.

wikirby-page:6077.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:6077.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:6077.description_zh:
“你可能会认为Soarar在另一个层次上，但他实际上是个相当平易近人的家伙。不过，如果他开始攻击的话，最好还是让开。我是认真的。快跑！”
— Soarar的Figurine标题来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Soarar，是一种黄色橙色的飞行楔形生物，经常作为星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的小敌人首次出现于星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror），在他出现的游戏中，他在空中相对常见，通常以小幅直线或斜线飞行，速度适中。他主要通过碰撞攻击，有时会从背景俯冲而下，但在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中他也可能发射投射物。Soarar通常在他出现的游戏中只是一个次要角色，但有更多在Kirby Mass Attack和Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中都扮演着重要角色。Soarar相当容易击败，可以吸入，但吞下后不会提供任何能力。
wikirby-page:6077.description_en:
“You'd think Soarar is in another stratosphere, but he's actually a rather approachable sort. If he starts attacking, however, best to just get out of his way. I mean it. Run!”
— Soarar's Figurine caption from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Soarar is a yellow orange flying wedge-shaped creature who frequently appears as a minor enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. First appearing in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, he is a relatively common sight in the air in the games he appears in, usually flying in straight and slightly diagonal paths at a modest pace. He mainly attacks by collision, and may swoop in from the background, though he could also shoot projectiles in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. Soarar is usually a minor feature in whatever games he appears in, but has a more outsized role in both Kirby Mass Attack and Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. Soarar is fairly easy to defeat and can be inhaled, but provides no ability if swallowed.

wikirby-page:1829.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1829.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1829.description_zh: Batafire是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中出现的一个中级Boss。由于它是由火形成的，Batafire会掉落燃烧（Burning）复制能力（Copy Ability），可以在击败后通过吞噬获得。
wikirby-page:1829.description_en: Batafire is a mid-boss introduced in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. Corresponding to it being made of fire, Batafire yields the 燃烧（Burning） 复制能力（Copy Ability） which is available via engulfment upon defeat.

wikirby-page:2743.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2743.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2743.description_zh: Bombar是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中出现的一个中级Boss。它是一个绿色的飞机状生物，棕色的脚，戴着带有一颗星的双翼头盔，橙白色的围巾和大而愤怒的眼睛。吞下它后可以获得导弹（Missile）能力。
wikirby-page:2743.description_en: Bombar is a mid-boss who appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It is a green airplane-like creature with brown feet, a biplane helmet that has a star on the sides, an orange-whitish scarf, and large, angry eyes. It provides the 导弹（Missile） ability when swallowed.

wikirby-page:1856.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1856.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1856.description_zh:
左侧的Box Boxer是出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）和星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中的中型Boss。它的基本外观类似于棕色拳师犬。不过，与真正的狗不同，Box Boxer似乎缺少身体，主要由一个过大的头部组成。头部底部附有两只浅棕色、三趾的爪子，而它的垂耳充当手臂，末端为与爪子同色的手状延伸物。

根据小学馆出版的星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）日本攻略书，Boxin被称为Box Boxer的弟子。
wikirby-page:1856.description_en:
left Box Boxer is a mid-boss found in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） and 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It has a basic appearance similar to that of a brown boxer breed of dog. Unlike a real dog, however, Box Boxer appears to be lacking a body, being composed mainly of an oversized head instead. Attached to it are two pale brown, three-toed paws at the bottom, while its floppy ears act as arms, ending in hand-like extensions of the same color as its feet.

According to the 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） Japanese strategy guide by Shogakukan, Boxins are said to be the disciples of Box Boxer.

wikirby-page:1740.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:1740.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:1740.description_zh:
Boxy是一个中型Boss，出现在两个游戏中：星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）和星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）。它看起来像一个亮粉色的礼物盒，盒子上有一个红色蝴蝶结，底部长着一根藤蔓，藤蔓末端有两片绿色叶子。它有两个椭圆形的眼睛和一个带尖牙的大嘴，可以对卡比（Kirby）造成伤害。有时，它会生成包含泡泡、敌人或者能量道具的盒子。

Boxy的攻击方式是跳跃、向前冲刺，以及吐出包含各种物品的礼物盒。在它的两次出现中，Boxy在被击败后吸入并吞下时，会赋予Magic能力。
wikirby-page:1740.description_en:
Boxy is a mid-boss that appears in two games: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） and 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It resembles a bright pink present box with a red bow on top of it and a vine growing from the bottom, which ends in two green leaves. It possesses two oval eyes and a large mouth with sharp teeth, which can cause damage to 卡比（Kirby）. Sometimes, it creates boxes that contain bubbles, enemies, or power-ups.

Boxy attacks by jumping, rushing forward, and spitting out gift boxes which contain various objects. In both of its appearances, Boxy gives the Magic ability when inhaled and swallowed after its defeat.

wikirby-page:2878.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2878.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2878.description_zh:
“在梦境之地的天空之上，镜像世界需要帮助！一个阴影般的身影正在给这个和平的世界带来混乱！”
— 来自星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）开场叙述的趣味文本
暗意向（Dark Mind）是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的主要反派和最终Boss。他是一个可怕的敌人，由Dimension Mirror诞生，通过反映坏的想法和愿望来将Mirror World纳入他的控制之下。暗意向（Dark Mind）最初呈现类人的形态，类似梦魇（Nightmare），但后来转变为更为怪异的形态，类似零（Zero），与暗物质（Dark Matter）相似。

暗意向（Dark Mind）的战斗分为六个阶段，其中四个阶段是与他第一形态的战斗，难度逐步增加，然后是第五阶段，与他第二个也是最终的形态对战形式，以及他最终阶段的垂直射击者序列。在步行战斗时，卡比（Kirby）主要使用Master能力与暗意向（Dark Mind）作战，该能力来自魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的剑，但这并不是击败该Boss的绝对必要条件。
wikirby-page:2878.description_en:
“High above the skies of Dream Land, the mirror world needs help! A shadowy figure is unleashing chaos on the peaceful world!”
— Flavor text from the opening narration of 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
暗意向（Dark Mind） is the main antagonist and final boss of 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. He is a fearsome foe born from the Dimension Mirror reflecting bad thoughts and wishes to bring the Mirror World under his control. 暗意向（Dark Mind） initially takes a humanoid form which resembles 梦魇（Nightmare）, but later transforms into a more monstrous form which resembles 零（Zero）, similar to 暗物质（Dark Matter）.

暗意向（Dark Mind） is fought over six phases, with four dedicated to fights with his first form which subsequently increase in difficulty, then a fifth phase against his second and true form, and a vertical shooter sequence for his final phase. When battling on foot, 卡比（Kirby） mainly fights 暗意向（Dark Mind） with the Master ability, obtained from 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s sword, but this is not strictly a requirement for defeating said boss.

wikirby-page:4294.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:4294.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:4294.description_zh:
加百猎（Gobbler）是一个只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的boss。它守护着Olive Ocean的Mirror Shard，并在之后的Boss Endurance再次与之交战。

加百猎（Gobbler）是一只蓝色鲨鱼，腰间绑着红白相间的救生圈，尽管它能游泳。它的吻尖似乎有一个浅蓝色的星形图案；不过，这一细节在其官方艺术作品中并不存在。加百猎（Gobbler）的牙齿相对于其体型来说很大，因此得名。它的尾巴被一个螺旋桨取代，这使它能在水下保持漂浮。
wikirby-page:4294.description_en:
加百猎（Gobbler） is a boss that only appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. It guards the Mirror Shard of Olive Ocean and is fought again after that in Boss Endurance.

加百猎（Gobbler） is a blue shark with a red and white life preserver attached to its waist, despite its ability to swim. There appears to be a star-shaped pattern with a lighter shade of blue on the tip of its snout; this detail is not present in its official artwork, however. 加百猎（Gobbler）'s teeth are big in relation to its size, hence the name. What would be its tail is instead a propeller which keeps it afloat underwater.

wikirby-page:2516.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2516.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2516.description_zh:
King Golem是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）第二区域的Boss；Moonlight Mansion.

他出现在该区域最东南的房间，守护着其中一个Mirror Shard。他的外观像一座巨大的石塔，但有脸、胡须和手。
wikirby-page:2516.description_en:
King Golem is the Boss of the second area of 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）; Moonlight Mansion.

He is found in the south-easternmost room in the area, guarding one of the Mirror Shards. His appearance resembles a large stone tower, albeit with a face, mustache and hands.

wikirby-page:2632.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:2632.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:2632.description_zh: Mega Titan.png巨型泰坦是一个蓝色和银色的机器人Boss，到目前为止只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中。它守护着Carrot Castle的Mirror Shard，并在Boss Endurance中再次战斗。
wikirby-page:2632.description_en: Mega Titan.pngMega Titan is a blue and silver robot Boss that only appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror） so far. It guards the Mirror Shard of Carrot Castle and is fought again in Boss Endurance.

wikirby-page:3679.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:3679.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:3679.description_zh: Moley是星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的一个Boss，同时也是Kirby Mass Attack的中型Boss。他看起来像一只戴眼镜、系橙色领巾的大灰鼹鼠。
wikirby-page:3679.description_en: Moley is a boss from 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, as well as a mid-boss from Kirby Mass Attack. He resembles a large, gray mole with glasses and an orange neckerchief.

wikirby-page:3678.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫
wikirby-page:3678.display_work: 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）
wikirby-page:3678.description_zh:
left Wiz是一个只出现在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）的巫师或魔法师Boss。在游戏中，他守卫着Peppermint Palace的Mirror Shard，并且可以在Boss Endurance中再次战斗。他的名字是“wizard”一词的缩写。

Wiz除了两只黄色的眼睛外，没有明显的手臂、腿或脸。他戴着黑白相间的高顶帽，披着红色斗篷，戴着白手套并拿着魔杖。
wikirby-page:3678.description_en:
left Wiz is a wizard or magician Boss that only appears in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）. In the game, he guards the Mirror Shard of Peppermint Palace and can be fought again in Boss Endurance. His name is a clipping of the word "wizard".

Wiz has no visible arms, legs, or face, apart from two yellow eyes. He wears a black and white top hat, a red cape and white gloves and holds a wand.

wikirby-form:1675.description_zh: Balloon是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），首次亮相于摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse），也是第一款在衍生游戏中引入的。它允许卡比（Kirby）像Balloon一样膨胀并漂浮，并在大量膨胀后通过爆炸攻击敌人。尽管这种能力具有潜在的攻击用途，但其主要目的是增强卡比（Kirby）的移动能力，让他暂时摆脱平时依赖的Rainbow Line。在适当的动力下，Balloon卡比（Kirby）可以非常快速地穿越很远的距离，尽管膨胀后的体型比平时大得多，因此在使用该能力时需要小心以保护卡比（Kirby）的安全。
wikirby-form:1675.description_en: Balloon is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, and is the first one to be introduced in a spin-off game. It allows 卡比（Kirby） to inflate and float like a Balloon, and attack enemies by popping after expanding a lot. Despite this potential offensive use, the ability is primarily meant to enhance 卡比（Kirby）'s movement capabilities, momentarily freeing him from the Rainbow Lines he is normally dependent on. With the right amount of momentum, Balloon 卡比（Kirby） is capable of traversing great distances very quickly, though his inflated size makes him a much bigger target than usual, so care is needed when making use of the ability to keep 卡比（Kirby） safe.

wikirby-page:11586.description_zh:
“Blado当然看起来他在尽职尽责，但越来越明显的是，他的心已经不在其中。他内心一部分希望同事能对此说些什么；另一部分却害怕那场谈话。”
— Figurine对Blado的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Blado，是一种出现在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）及其精神继承者Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的无敌敌人。他在形状和功能上都类似黑刺球（Gordo），如果与卡比（Kirby）接触，会对其造成伤害。

Blado是一种圆形生物，有两只眼睛，很像黑刺球（Gordo），尽管他通常比年长的对应物表情更加凶狠。然而，他外部不是简单的尖刺，而是拥有四个弯曲的刀刃，看起来像斧头。这些刀刃会随着Blado的移动而旋转，使他看起来更具威胁性。尽管外观不同，但触碰Blado并不比黑刺球（Gordo）更危险。他唯一真正的功能差异是他沿着一个圆形路径移动，并与链条相连。
wikirby-page:11586.description_en:
“Blado certainly looks like he's doing his job, but it's becoming more and more obvious his heart is no longer in it. Part of him wants a co-worker to say something about it; the other part of him dreads that conversation.”
— Figurine description of Blado from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Blado is an invincible enemy which appears in both 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） and its spiritual successor - Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is similar to 黑刺球（Gordo） in both shape and function, and will harm 卡比（Kirby） if he comes into contact with him.

Blado is a round creature with two eyes, much like 黑刺球（Gordo）, though he usually bears a more menacing expression than his older counterpart. Instead of simple spikes on his exterior, however, he has four curved blades which resemble axe heads. These spin around Blado as he moves, making him look even more threatening. Despite the different appearance though, Blado is not any more dangerous to touch than 黑刺球（Gordo）. His only real functional difference is that he moves in a circular pattern, connected to a chain.

wikirby-page:11588.description_zh:
“当这个敌人发现卡比（Kirby）时，它会偶尔靠近他。”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）说明书（北美版），第16页。
气球球（Bloon）是一个首次在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中登场的敌人。与它碰撞时会提供Balloon能力。气球球（Bloon）是一个橡子形的生物，有两只圆形手、一顶尖头和两颗小黑点眼睛。它闭口漂浮在原地，推测是为了保持在空中。它对卡比（Kirby）并不构成太大威胁，如果被他击败，他将吸收它的力量。

气球球（Bloon）漂浮在原地，移动不多。像其他敌人一样，需要用Nintendo DS手写笔轻点使其眩晕，然后通过接触才能击败，否则会伤害卡比（Kirby）。而不是.
wikirby-page:11588.description_en:
“When this enemy finds 卡比（Kirby） it will occasionally approach him.”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） instruction booklet (NA print), page 16
气球球（Bloon） is an enemy which made its debut in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It provides the Balloon ability when collided with. 气球球（Bloon） is an acorn-shaped being with two round hands, a pointed head, and two small black dots for eyes. It floats in place with its mouth closed, presumably to keep in air. It doesn't pose much of a threat to 卡比（Kirby）, who will absorb its power should he defeat it.

气球球（Bloon） floats in place, and does not move much. Like other enemies, it needs to be stunned using a tap from the Nintendo DS stylus to be defeated by contact, else it will damage 卡比（Kirby） instead.

wikirby-page:22526.description_zh:
Cackling Painting是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中出现的敌人。它是一只古老、无色的相框，仅出现在最后一关The World of Drawcia。它有能力在空中悬浮。

狞笑的画作体积大且有些令人不安，因为它们的脸会出现并跟随卡比（Kirby）的动作，同时发出令人害怕的咯咯笑声（可能是在模仿绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）自己的笑声）。然而，它们无法伤害卡比（Kirby）。可以通过使用Nintendo DS的手写笔点击它们来击败它们，并且从它们出现的区域移除每一个Cackling Painting会导致Medal出现。

狞笑的画作是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中唯一在工作人员名单中没有列出的敌人，因此没有获得官方英文名。他们反而在仅限日语的百科全书《20周年卡比（Kirby）Pupupu百科全书》中被命名。
wikirby-page:22526.description_en:
Cackling Painting is an enemy featured in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It is an old, colorless photo frame that only appears in the final level, The World of Drawcia. It has the ability to levitate in midair.

Cackling Paintings are large and somewhat unsettling, as their faces will appear and then track 卡比（Kirby）'s movements while they giggle menacingly (presumably mirroring 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）'s own laughter). However, they are unable to harm 卡比（Kirby）. They can be defeated by tapping on them with the Nintendo DS stylus, and removing every Cackling Painting from the area they appear in causes a Medal to appear.

Cackling Paintings are the only enemy in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） that aren't listed during the staff credits, and thus not receiving an official English name. They are instead named in Japanese-exclusive encyclopedia 20th Anniversary 卡比（Kirby） Pupupu Encyclopedia.

wikirby-page:11919.description_zh:
“（火焰）Shotzos通过喷吐火焰进行攻击。彩虹线可以保护卡比（Kirby）免受它们的伤害。”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）使用说明书（北美版），第16页
KCC Flame Shotzo精灵.png KCC Flame Shotzo 2精灵.png Flame Shotzo是来自摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的无敌敌人和关卡障碍。顾名思义，它类似于黑大炮（Shotzo），但它喷吐连续的火焰而不是发射单独的子弹，类似于Galbo。Flame Shotzo有两种不同类型。一种以半规律的方式发射水平火焰，看起来像一个头盔，当它准备喷吐时头盔会打开。第二种看起来更像传统炮塔，可以无限向上或向下喷射火焰。

Flame Shotzo不能被眩晕或被击败。为了安全地躲避其火焰，玩家将需要使用Magical Paintbrush在黑大炮（Shotzo）的火线和卡比（Kirby）的前进路径之间画出一条彩虹线。
wikirby-page:11919.description_en:
“(Flame) Shotzos attack by spitting flames. Rainbow lines can protect 卡比（Kirby） from them.”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） instruction booklet (NA print), page 16
KCC Flame Shotzo sprite.pngKCC Flame Shotzo 2 sprite.png Flame Shotzo is an invincible enemy and stage hazard from 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. As the name implies, it is similar to a 黑大炮（Shotzo）, but it spews a continuous gout of flame instead of firing discrete bullets, similar to Galbo. There are two different types of Flame Shotzo. One fires horizontal flames on a semi-regular basis, and resembles a helmet, which opens up when it is ready to spew. The second looks more like a traditional turret, and fires continuous flames upward or downward without end.

Flame Shotzo cannot be stunned or defeated. To safely avert its flames, the player will have to use the Magical Paintbrush to draw a rainbow line between the 黑大炮（Shotzo）'s line of fire and 卡比（Kirby）'s path forward.

wikirby-page:11921.description_zh:
Fluff Waddle Dee是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中的一个敌人。Fluff Waddle Dee是一种瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），它紧贴在一株大蒲公英的茎上轻轻漂浮下来，类似于阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee），但没有任何复制能力（Copy Ability）可以获得。

Fluff Waddle Dee如果玩家使用Nintendo DS手写笔使瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）本身眩晕，或者点击蒲公英将其打碎，都可以轻松击败。蒲公英被打碎后，Fluff Waddle Dee将掉落到地面（如果在无底洞上方则会掉出舞台），并变成一个普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。
wikirby-page:11921.description_en:
Fluff Waddle Dee is an enemy in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. Fluff Waddle Dee is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who clings to the stem of a large dandelion, and floats gently downward, similar to 阳伞瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Waddle Dee）, though with no 复制能力（Copy Ability） to grant.

Fluff Waddle Dee can be defeated easily if the player uses the Nintendo DS stylus to stun either the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） itself, or by tapping the dandelion to break it. With the dandelion broken, Fluff Waddle Dee will fall to the ground (or off stage if above a bottomless pit), and become a standard 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）.

wikirby-page:11914.description_zh:
Gaveela是来自摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的一名无敌敌人和关卡威胁。它看起来像一只带有明显鳃的幼年蝾螈，栖息在某些洞穴关卡的墙壁中。

当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，Gaveela会从它所栖息的墙中伸出头来试图吃掉他，并且在此时可以被眩晕。然而，它仍然无法被击败，所以卡比（Kirby）必须绕开它，否则将会受到攻击。
wikirby-page:11914.description_en:
Gaveela is an invincible enemy and stage hazard from 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It resembles a larval salamander with prominent gills, and resides in walls in certain cave stages.

When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, Gaveela will poke its head out of the wall it is residing in and try to eat him, and can be stunned at this moment. However, it still cannot be defeated, so 卡比（Kirby） has to maneuver out of the way, or he will take a hit.

wikirby-page:11908.description_zh:
Para Matter是一个只会在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中出现的敌人。它由绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）召唤，如果与卡比（Kirby）接触，将会伤害他。

Para Matter起初是一个封闭的圆形实体，像一个花蕾。随后它会打开，露出位于四片“花瓣”中的眼球。Para Matter有三种颜色变化，每种基于主要颜色：红色、蓝色或黄色。它们都有独特的攻击方式，如下：*红色Para Matters会变成火球并追击卡比（Kirby）。它们会在短时间后爆炸。*蓝色Para Matters会变成冰球并从天而降。*黄色Para Matters会重新定位到高处，然后发射激光扫描stage.

如果使用Nintendo DS触控笔击中Para Matter在眼睛完全睁开时，它会反弹并撞到绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul），对她造成伤害。
wikirby-page:11908.description_en:
Para Matter is an enemy that appears exclusively in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It is summoned by 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）, and will hurt 卡比（Kirby） should it come into contact with him.

Para Matter starts off as an enclosed circular entity, resembling a flower bud. It will then open up to reveal an eyeball inside four 'petals' which fold open. There are three color varieties of Para Matter, each based on the primary color: red, blue, or yellow. They all have a unique method for attacking, as follows: *Red Para Matters turn into fireballs and pursue 卡比（Kirby）. They explode after a short while. *Blue Para Matters turn into iceballs and rain down from the sky. *Yellow Para Matters reposition high up then shoot out lasers which sweep the stage.

If a Para Matter is struck using the Nintendo DS stylus when its eye is fully open, it will rebound and hit into 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）, dealing her damage.

wikirby-page:11906.description_zh:
左侧Para Sorceress是仅在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中才会遇到的一个稀有敌人。它由绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）召唤，外形与她非常相似，虽然尺寸更小且设计更简单。Para Sorceress只会在这个Boss战中出现，尽管在片尾字幕的角色列表中也会出现它的位置。

Para Sorceress被召唤后会向前飞行，如果卡比（Kirby）与它接触，将会受伤，并在接触瞬间被冰冻片刻。可以通过玩家使用Nintendo DS触控笔轻点Magical Paintbrush来击败它。
wikirby-page:11906.description_en:
left Para Sorceress is an obscure enemy found exclusively in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It is conjured by 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）, and resembles her greatly, though is much smaller and simpler in design. Para Sorceress only appears during this boss fight, though it is given a place in the cast list during the credits sequence.

Para Sorceress flies forward after being conjured, and will hurt 卡比（Kirby） if he comes into contact with it, freezing him solid for a moment on contact. It can be defeated by tapping it using the Magical Paintbrush (by the player using the Nintendo DS stylus).

wikirby-page:11924.description_zh:
左侧Snoppy是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的敌人。被击败时会获得冻结（Freeze）能力。

Snoppy看起来有点像雪人，不过要小得多，外观也更简单。它可以在冰洞关卡中找到，如果受到威胁，它会卷成一团并滚向卡比（Kirby）。但仍可以通过先用Nintendo DS笔击晕它来轻松击败它。
wikirby-page:11924.description_en:
left Snoppy is an enemy from 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It yields the 冻结（Freeze） ability when defeated.

Snoppy looks somewhat like a yeti, though much smaller and simpler looking. It can be found in icy cave stages, and will curl up into a ball and roll into 卡比（Kirby） if threatened. It can still be defeated easily by stunning it first using the Nintendo DS stylus.

wikirby-page:2352.description_zh: 枪（Spear）Waddle Dees是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的持矛变种，出现在整个卡比（Kirby）系列中，首次出现在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）。枪（Spear）Waddle Dees有时似乎不会使用他们的矛（而是拥有更长的攻击范围来击中玩家），或在某些出现它们的游戏中将其作为近战武器或可投掷武器大力使用。到目前为止，枪（Spear）Waddle Dees在被吞下时不会授予任何能力，因为在具有枪（Spear）能力的游戏中，它们目前并未作为敌人出现。
wikirby-page:2352.description_en: 枪（Spear） Waddle Dees are a spear-wielding variant of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s encountered throughout the 卡比（Kirby） series, first appearing in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. 枪（Spear） Waddle Dees may appear to either not do much with their spear (instead having a longer reach to hit the player) or make use of it greatly as a melee or throwable weapon in some games where they appear. So far, 枪（Spear） Waddle Dees grant no ability when swallowed, as they currently do not appear as enemies in games where the 枪（Spear） ability is available.

wikirby-page:3397.description_zh:
“Thudds从上方落下，试图压碎卡比（Kirby）。”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）说明书（北美版），第16页
Thudd是一种银色块状的敌人，首次出现在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中。它的脸类似于石像怪（Kabu），并且有发光的眼睛。它是不可破坏的，所以无论卡比（Kirby）攻击多少次，它都不会受伤。Thudds有三种大小，它们唯一的任务是在卡比（Kirby）靠近时掉落，对其造成撞击伤害。因此，最好躲开它们。
wikirby-page:3397.description_en:
“Thudds fall from above and try to crush 卡比（Kirby）.”
— 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse） instruction booklet (NA print), page 16
Thudd is a silver block-like enemy which first appeared in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It has a face similar to that of a 石像怪（Kabu） and glowing eyes. It is indestructible, so no matter how much 卡比（Kirby） attacks it, it does not take damage. Thudds come in three sizes, and their only task is to drop when 卡比（Kirby） draws near, dealing him damage on impact. As such, they are best avoided.

wikirby-page:11916.description_zh:
左Topper是来自摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的一个不常见的敌人。它看起来像一个钥匙链环，中间有一个带脸的橙色方盒。其脸部某种程度上类似于普通电源插座。它悬挂在墙之间，形成一个静电场，阻挡通道。

要击败Topper，玩家可以使用Nintendo DS手写笔多次敲击它的方盒脸部，使其脱落。卡比（Kirby）可以通过使用复制能力（Copy Ability）或Touch Dash攻击其中央部分来击败它，但这可能有风险，因为卡比（Kirby）很可能会失手击中静电。
wikirby-page:11916.description_en:
left Topper is an uncommon enemy from 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. It resembles a key chain link with an orange box with a face in the middle. The face in question somewhat resembles a common electrical socket. It hangs in-between walls, creating a field of static current that blocks off a passageway.

To defeat a Topper, the player can use the Nintendo DS stylus to tap the creature numerous times on its box-face part to dislodge it. 卡比（Kirby） can defeat it by attacking its central piece using a 复制能力（Copy Ability） or a Touch Dash, but this can be risky, as 卡比（Kirby） has a good chance of missing and hitting the static instead.

wikirby-page:860.description_zh:
“突然，世界的色彩扭曲，一位奇怪的女巫出现了！她在空气中作画，将大地变成了一幅画。看到卡比（Kirby）后，女巫逃向天空，朝着一个奇异的漩涡飞去。卡比（Kirby）紧追不放……进入了一个画的世界。他向女巫挑战，但她的魔法将他变成了一个球！”
— 在摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）
绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）（更正式地称绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）巫女）中的叙述者是一个拥有魔力且邪恶的存在，她有能力将周围的世界变成一个活生生的画作，并施展各种魔法，包括拿走卡比（Kirby）的手和脚，使他成为Ball。她是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的主要反派和最终Boss，负责对Dream Land及其居民施加诅咒，并必须在Magical Paintbrush的帮助下击败卡比（Kirby），Magical Paintbrush曾属于那位女巫。尽管她拥有强大的力量，但她的出身和动机完全未知。

自从摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）首次登场以来，绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）在后续的卡比（Kirby）作品中仅有客串。然而，她的设计对后续角色影响深远，尤其是她可能的亲属Paintra、彩绘比比提安（Vividria）、黏土西亚（Claycia），以及所有使用绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）灵魂攻击的后续灵魂形态Boss。
wikirby-page:860.description_en:
“Suddenly, the world's colors warp, and a strange witch arises! Drawing in the air, the witch turns the land into a painting. Seeing 卡比（Kirby）, the witch flees to the sky, towards a weird vortex. 卡比（Kirby） gives chase... Into a world of paintings. He challenges the witch, but her magic turns him into a ball!”
— The narrator in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）
绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia） (more formally 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia） Sorceress) is a magical and malevolent being who has the power to turn the world around her into a living painting and cast various magical spells, including taking away 卡比（Kirby）'s hands and feet and leaving him as a Ball. She is the main antagonist and final boss of 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, responsible for placing a curse on Dream Land and its denizens, and whom 卡比（Kirby） must defeat with the help of the Magical Paintbrush, which used to belong to the sorceress. Despite her immense power, her origin and motives are completely unknown.

Since her debut in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia） has only made cameo appearances in subsequent 卡比（Kirby） titles. However, her design influence is vast on subsequent characters, particularly her possible relatives Paintra and 彩绘比比提安（Vividria）, 黏土西亚（Claycia）, and all of the subsequent Soul-form bosses that use 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia） Soul's attacks.

wikirby-page:4391.display_name: 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）
wikirby-page:4391.description_zh:
绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）是一个巨大的球形幽灵生物，由颜料制成，当她以“女巫”形态被击败时，会变成绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia）。绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）是摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的最终首领，也是第一个名字中带有“灵魂”的首领，在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中首次出现。迄今为止，她也是唯一一个在主要故事模式（Story Mode）中战斗的灵魂首领，而不是仅在Extra Mode或Boss Endurance模式中出现。

绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）看起来像一个巨大的颜料球，颜色经常变化，底部不断滴落。在球上有一张由五只眼睛和一个张口组成的脸，所有眼睛内部都是黄色，没有其他特征。球体周围环绕着绿色的幽灵光环，翻滚并闪烁。这暗示了绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）的具有以太般的特性，因为她看起来像光的投影一样闪烁和变形，而不像真正的实体。
wikirby-page:4391.description_en:
绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul） is a giant spherical ghostly creature made of paint that 绘画堕落锡安（Drawcia） turns into upon being defeated in her "Sorceress" form. 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul） serves as the final boss of 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, and is the first boss to have "Soul" addended to her name in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. To date, she is also the only Soul boss who is fought in a main 故事模式（Story Mode）, as opposed to only in an Extra Mode or Boss Endurance mode.

绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul） resembles a giant ball of paint that frequently shifts in hue and drips along the bottom. On the ball is a face consisting of five eyes and a gaping mouth, all of which are yellow on the inside with no features. The ball is surrounded by a green ghostly aura that roils and shimmers. This implies 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul）'s ethereal nature, as she seems to flicker and warp in shape like a projection of light rather than a real solid entity.

wikirby-form:1400.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-form:1400.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-form:1400.description_zh: 动物（Animal）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），它在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中首次（也是迄今为止唯一一次）亮相。它给卡比（Kirby）提供了一套带爪的动物（Animal）服装，使他可以在某些区域挖掘松软的泥土、雪或云。此外，卡比（Kirby）获得了一种突进攻击，可以让他冲撞敌人。
wikirby-form:1400.description_en: 动物（Animal） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that made its debut (and so far only) appearance in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It gives 卡比（Kirby） an 动物（Animal） costume with claws that allow him to dig through soft dirt, snow or clouds in certain areas. In addition, 卡比（Kirby） gains a lunge attack that allows him to tackle enemies.

wikirby-form:1690.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-form:1690.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-form:1690.description_zh: Bubble是一款在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）首次亮相的复制能力（Copy Ability）。当卡比（Kirby）获得此能力时，他会戴上一顶类似浴帽的蓝色帽子，上面冒出许多气泡。他还会获得一根Bubble魔杖，用于发射气泡。使用此能力时，卡比（Kirby）可以向对手射出一股气泡流，在击败对手时会将其变成包含Copy Essence的气泡。这股气泡流也可以用来打破障碍物和其他阻挡物，甚至能穿透墙壁。
wikirby-form:1690.description_en: Bubble is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. When 卡比（Kirby） gains this ability, he obtains a blue hat similar to a shower cap, topped with many bubbles spewing out of it. He also gains a Bubble wand, which is used for launching bubbles. Using this ability, 卡比（Kirby） is able to shoot a stream of bubbles at his opponents, which transforms them into bubbles containing Copy Essences upon defeat. The stream can also be used to break away blocks and other obstacles, even being able to shoot through walls.

wikirby-form:1698.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-form:1698.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-form:1698.description_zh: 幽灵（Ghost）指的是卡比（Kirby）或其他可玩角色变成幽灵（Ghost）类似实体的状态，他们失去了双脚，取而代之的是像挥动的布片一样的附肢。在这种状态下，角色与周围环境的互动方式有限，但可以无限期地漂浮在空中，尽管移动速度较慢。在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中，幽灵角色主要以两种形式出现：一种是通过复制能力（Copy Ability）在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中使卡比（Kirby）能够附身敌人并控制他们；另一种是在卡比（Kirby）格斗游戏中，格斗者在被击倒后可以变成幽灵，如果在决定胜者之前击中对手，有机会复活。除此之外这些两source，幽灵（Ghost）卡比（Kirby）也在其他卡比（Kirby）游戏中以客串或引用的形式出现过少数几次，最显著的是在Kirby Super Star Ultra的Gourmet Race中以及在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition的New Challenge Stages中作为玩家最佳配速的占位符。
wikirby-form:1698.description_en: 幽灵（Ghost） refers to the state where 卡比（Kirby） or another playable character has become a 幽灵（Ghost）-like entity, losing their feet in favor of a waving sheet-like appendage. While in this state, the character only has limited ways of interacting with their surroundings, but gains the ability to hover off the ground indefinitely, albeit slowly. In the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, ghostly characters manifest in two primary ways; one is via the 复制能力（Copy Ability） in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, which allows 卡比（Kirby） to possess his enemies and control them, and the other is in the 卡比（Kirby） Fighters games, where fighters can become ghosts after being KO'd, and get a chance to come back to life if they hit an opponent before a winner is decided. Aside from these two sources, 幽灵（Ghost） 卡比（Kirby） has also appeared a handful of times in other 卡比（Kirby） games as cameos or references, most notably serving as a placeholder for the player's best pace in Gourmet Race in Kirby Super Star Ultra and in the New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition.

wikirby-form:1401.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-form:1401.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-form:1401.description_zh: Metal是在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中推出的复制能力（Copy Ability）。这种能力不像大多数其他复制能力那样给卡比（Kirby）提供独特的帽子，而是完全将他的身体转变为Metal，使他拥有棱角分明的特征和流线型的银色外观，尽管他的脸颊腮红仍然是粉色。这种能力使卡比（Kirby）对大多数类型的伤害都无敌，包括熔岩等危险，但作为代价，卡比（Kirby）移动速度变慢，跳得不高，攻击选项也很少。
wikirby-form:1401.description_en: Metal is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） introduced in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. This ability doesn't give 卡比（Kirby） a unique hat like most other copy abilities, instead completely transforming his body into Metal, giving him angular features and a sleek silver appearance, though his cheek blush is still pink. This ability makes 卡比（Kirby） invincible to most kinds of damage, including from hazards such as lava, but in trade 卡比（Kirby） moves slower, doesn't jump as high, and is given few attack options.

wikirby-form:1709.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-form:1709.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-form:1709.description_zh: Triple Star是星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的Last Battle Ability，使卡比（Kirby）能够向敌人发射最多三颗星星。当星星未被发射时，它们会绕着卡比（Kirby）旋转，并在接触敌人时造成伤害。卡比（Kirby）可以将星星直线向前发射，也可以以一定角度向上发射，随后它们会返回到他身边。卡比（Kirby）还可以使用手杖在空中进行旋转攻击。与Master一样，Triple Star不需要用于击败最终Boss，可以被丢弃，并且在游戏完成后可以在普通关卡中使用。
wikirby-form:1709.description_en: Triple Star is the Last Battle Ability of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to launch up to three stars at enemies. When not being launched, the stars will orbit 卡比（Kirby）, and still deal damage to foes on contact. 卡比（Kirby） can launch the stars either straight ahead of him or upward at an angle, after which they will return to him. 卡比（Kirby） can also perform a spinning attack in the air using the cane itself. Like Master, Triple Star is not required to defeat the final boss, can be dropped, and is available to use in regular stages once the game is complete.

wikirby-variant:1701:dark-nebula-ice.display_name: 暗零（冰形态）（Dark Nebula Ice Form）
wikirby-variant:1701:dark-nebula-ice.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-variant:1701:dark-nebula-ice.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-variant:1701:dark-nebula-ice.description_zh:
暗零（冰形态）（Dark Nebula Ice Form）是暗零（Dark Nebula）的特殊形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）》。
“宝箱是冥界统治者暗零（Dark Nebula）的监狱。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）知道宝箱的秘密。他与卡比（Kirby）战斗，以防止暗零（Dark Nebula）被释放。”
— 在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中的叙述者
是一个黑暗的、星形的实体，担任星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的最终Boss。它被隐藏在一个宝箱中，卡比（Kirby）在击败怪盗洛切（Daroach）后获得该宝箱，之后被魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）偷走，以确保暗零（Dark Nebula）不会被释放。然而，卡比（Kirby）认为宝箱里装的是他在游戏开始时准备吃的蛋糕，便击败了魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），宝箱随后被怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）偷走。由于这一系列事件，暗零（Dark Nebula）从它的监狱，拥有怪盗洛切（Daroach）。在卡比（Kirby）第二次击败怪盗洛切（Daroach）之后，暗零（Dark Nebula）以一个带有其正常形象颜色的小黑星形式从怪盗洛切（Daroach）的身体中出现，卡比（Kirby）跟随它然后面对它，此时它会变大并长出一只眼睛。在卡比（Kirby）击败它之后，组成暗零（Dark Nebula）的星星从它体内掉出，只剩下它的眼睛，然后眼睛爆炸。在击败暗零（Dark Nebula）之后，卡比（Kirby）回家。到目前为止，暗零（Dark Nebula）在系列中仅作为一个完整实体出现过一次。但是在后续作品中，它以插图、引用和其他纪念品的形式获得了一些表现。
wikirby-variant:1701:dark-nebula-ice.description_en:
Dark Nebula Ice Form is a special form of Dark Nebula in Kirby: Squeak Squad.
“The treasure chest was the prison of 暗零（Dark Nebula）, ruler of the underworld. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） knew the secret of the chest. He fought 卡比（Kirby） to prevent 暗零（Dark Nebula） from being released.”
— The narrator in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
暗零（Dark Nebula） is a dark, star-shaped entity that serves as the final boss of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It was concealed in a treasure chest that 卡比（Kirby） receives after beating 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, before it was stolen by 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） to make sure 暗零（Dark Nebula） would not be released. However, 卡比（Kirby）, believing that the treasure chest contains the cake he was about to eat in the beginning of the game, beats 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and the treasure chest is then stolen by the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）. As a consequence of this, 暗零（Dark Nebula） is released from its prison, possessing 怪盗洛切（Daroach）. After 卡比（Kirby） defeats 怪盗洛切（Daroach） a second time, 暗零（Dark Nebula） exits 怪盗洛切（Daroach）'s body as a small dark star bearing its normal form's color which 卡比（Kirby） follows and then faces it, where it enlarges and gains an eye. After 卡比（Kirby） beats it, the stars that make up 暗零（Dark Nebula） fall out of it, leaving only its eye, which then explodes. Having defeated 暗零（Dark Nebula）, 卡比（Kirby） returns home.

暗零（Dark Nebula） has, to this point, only appeared once in the series as a proper entity. It has been given some representation in subsequent titles in the form of illustrations, references, and other memorabilia, however.
