wikirby-page:1890.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1890.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1890.description_zh:
“I必须关闭，因为寻宝者的工作永远不会完成。希望有一天我们能再次相见。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），Kirby Mass Attack
怪盗洛切（Daroach）是一个鼠类的披风小偷和魔法师，他作为怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）的神秘领袖出现，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的一个反复出现的角色。他首次作为星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的次要反派出现，在那里他因为偷走一个箱子而激怒了卡比（Kirby），卡比（Kirby）认为箱子里有他丢失的Strawberry Shortcake。在卡比（Kirby）打败了实际上被封印在箱子里的暗零（Dark Nebula）后，误会得以澄清，两人和解。怪盗洛切（Daroach）后来会作为同盟出现在Kirby Mass Attack中，在那里他通过给Kirby提示来帮助他们找到Medals。他还出现在在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中以Dream Friend的身份出场，并在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中以骑手的身份出现。
wikirby-page:1890.description_en:
“I must be off, since a treasure-hunter's job is never done. I hope we meet again someday.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, Kirby Mass Attack
怪盗洛切（Daroach） is a mouse-like caped thief and magician who serves as the mysterious leader of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） and a recurring character in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He first appears as the secondary antagonist of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, where he earns 卡比（Kirby）'s ire by stealing a chest which 卡比（Kirby） believes to contain his missing Strawberry Shortcake. After 卡比（Kirby） defeats 暗零（Dark Nebula）, who was actually sealed in the chest, the misunderstanding is cleared up and the two make amends. 怪盗洛切（Daroach） would later appear as an ally in Kirby Mass Attack, where he helps the Kirbys by giving them hints to find the Medals. He also makes playable appearances as a Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） and as a rider in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

wikirby-page:8504.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8504.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8504.description_zh:
KSqS Acchi Sprite.png Acchi是在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）首次亮相的大型敌人。被吞下时会生成烈火（Fire）能力，但需要Super Inhale才能实现。

Acchi是一种光滑的两栖类敌人，具有红色皮肤和白色腹部，带有小尾巴和燃烧的后背。它的外观可能参考了一个古老神话，声称蝾螈由火而生，这也启发了后来敌人Candlemander的设计。它不会移动，而是选择在卡比（Kirby）方向喷出火焰。这些火焰喷射在发射后会在地面上停留短时间。

在许多情况下，Acchi可以轻松地被避开，因为它很少挡在卡比（Kirby）的路上，也无法追击他。然而，作为一个大型敌人，Acchi拥有相当多的生命值。攻击它可能会使它弹开到不同的位置，然后它将恢复正常的吐射行为。
wikirby-page:8504.description_en:
KSqS Acchi Sprite.png Acchi is a large enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It yields the 烈火（Fire） ability when swallowed, but requires a Super Inhale to do so.

Acchi is a smooth amphibian-like enemy with red skin and a white underbelly, with a small tail and flaming backside. Its appearance may be a reference to an ancient myth claiming that salamanders are born from fire, something which also inspired the later enemy Candlemander. It does not move from its position, instead opting to spit out bursts of flame in whichever direction 卡比（Kirby） is. These flame bursts will linger on the ground for a short time after being fired.

In many cases, Acchi can simply be avoided easily, since it is seldom in 卡比（Kirby）'s way, and cannot pursue him. However, as a large enemy, Acchi has a good deal of health. Attacking it can cause it to bounce off to a different position, where it will then resume its normal spitting.

wikirby-page:8499.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8499.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8499.description_zh: KSqS Bubble Head sprite.png Bubble Head是星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）独有的敌人，吞下后会提供Bubble复制能力（Copy Ability）。从外观上看，它类似炽热头（Hot Head），并以类似的方式进行攻击，不过使用的是气泡而不是火焰。与卡比（Kirby）使用技能时不同，Bubble Head除非被Ghost卡比（Kirby）控制，否则无法用气泡困住任何东西。
wikirby-page:8499.description_en: KSqS Bubble Head sprite.png Bubble Head is an enemy exclusive to 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, which provides the Bubble 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. Aesthetically, it resembles 炽热头（Hot Head）, and attacks in a similar manner, albeit using bubbles instead of flames. Unlike 卡比（Kirby） when using the ability, Bubble Head is not able to trap anything using its bubbles unless it is being controlled by Ghost 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:8534.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8534.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8534.description_zh: KSqS Bun Sprite.png Bun是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的大型敌人，被吞噬时会获得投擲（Throw）能力。它的攻击方式是接近卡比（Kirby），然后抓住并投掷他。由于它是大型敌人，所以有大量的生命值，需要一段时间才能Inhale。目前，Bun是唯一使用投擲（Throw）能力的普通敌人，其他提供该能力的都是中期Boss。
wikirby-page:8534.description_en:
KSqS Bun Sprite.png Bun is a large enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, which yields the 投擲（Throw） ability when swallowed. It attacks by getting close to 卡比（Kirby）, then grabbing and tossing him. Because it is a large enemy, it has a big amount of HP, and takes a while to Inhale.

So far, Bun is the only common enemy which wields the 投擲（Throw） ability, with the other providers being mid-bosses.

wikirby-page:8452.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8452.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8452.description_zh: KSqS Cret精灵.png Cret是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的飞行敌人。它呈现为骑在云上的小型黄色球状生物，花时间朝单一方向飞行，偶尔会掉落Coconut。如果卡比（Kirby）尝试Inhale它，它的云会消失，然后它从存在中消失，留下某物。这个东西可能是Food物品、1-Up或黑刺球（Gordo）。它还与马里奥系列的Lakitu相似，并有类似的攻击策略。
wikirby-page:8452.description_en: KSqS Cret Sprite.png Cret is a flying enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. Appearing as a small yellow ball-shaped creature riding a cloud, it spends its time flying in singular directions, occasionally dropping Coconuts. If 卡比（Kirby） tries to Inhale it, its cloud is lost, and it pops out of existence, leaving something behind. This thing could be a Food item, a 1-Up, or a 黑刺球（Gordo）. It also bears a resemblance to Lakitu from the Mario series and has a similar attack strategy.

wikirby-page:8460.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8460.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8460.description_zh:
KSqS Crimp.png Crimp是在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中首次亮相的敌人。它通常会沿着墙壁爬行，并且如果卡比（Kirby）接近，它会尝试向其投掷绿色炸弹。它很容易被吞下，但不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。如果它从墙上被撞落且仍然存活，它会在地面上反弹，直到找到另一面墙。

Crimp在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中首次也是唯一一次出现。它可以在游戏的每一关找到，但最常见于Jam Jungle。锯齿敌通常会成小组沿着墙壁出现，并且常争先阻挡卡比（Kirby）的道路，尽管它们很容易被消灭，而且发射投射物的频率不高。
wikirby-page:8460.description_en:
KSqS Crimp.png Crimp is an enemy which debuted in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is typically found crawling along walls, and will attempt to shoot green bombs at 卡比（Kirby） if he gets too close. It can easily be swallowed, but provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability）. If it is knocked off a wall and is still alive, it will bounce around on the ground until finding another wall.

Crimp makes its first and only appearance in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It can be found in every level in the game, though it is most commonly found in Jam Jungle. Crimps often appear in small groups along walls, and often vie to get in 卡比（Kirby）'s way, though they are easy to dispatch and do not fire their projectiles very often.

wikirby-page:8455.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8455.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8455.description_zh: KSqS Gaw Gaw Sprite.pngGaw Gaw是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的一种稀有敌人。它类似于一个小鼹鼠状的生物，面部类似鼬科动物，会以不同的方式跳动，有些会试图扑向卡比（Kirby）。吞下它可以获得动物（Animal）的能力。
wikirby-page:8455.description_en: KSqS Gaw Gaw Sprite.pngGaw Gaw is an uncommon enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. Resembling a small mole-like creature with a face similar to a mustelid, it hops around in varying patterns, and some attempt to lunge at 卡比（Kirby）. Swallowing it yields the 动物（Animal） ability.

wikirby-page:6808.display_name: 黄金瓦豆鲁迪（Gold Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:6808.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:6808.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:6808.description_zh: 黄金瓦豆鲁迪（Gold Waddle Dee）是常见敌人瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的一种变体，首次出现在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中，后来在Kirby Mass Attack和Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中稍作出现。正如其名称所直接表明的，黄金瓦豆鲁迪（Gold Waddle Dee）呈金色，但外观与普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）完全相同。它通常被描绘为绿色眼睛，尽管在Kirby Mass Attack和卡比（Kirby）的梦境收藏特别版中，它们的眼睛是棕色的，就像普通Waddle Dees的眼睛一样。在它出现的游戏中，它通常作为稀有且常常难以捉摸的敌人，击败它会获得特殊奖励。
wikirby-page:6808.description_en: 黄金瓦豆鲁迪（Gold Waddle Dee） is a variation of the common enemy 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, first appearing in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） and later making minor appearances in Kirby Mass Attack and Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition. As directly stated in its name, 黄金瓦豆鲁迪（Gold Waddle Dee） is gold-colored, but otherwise looks identical to a regular 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. It is usually depicted with green eyes, although in Kirby Mass Attack and 卡比（Kirby）'s Dream Collection Special Edition, they are brown like the eyes of regular Waddle Dees. In games it appears in, it usually serves as a rare and often times elusive enemy that yields a special reward upon its defeat.

wikirby-page:8717.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8717.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8717.description_zh:
KSqS Gussa精灵.png Gussa是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的水生敌人。它看起来像一条蓝色的鱼，或者带有螺旋桨尾巴和头部前方突出大角的小鲨鱼。当它在水中发现卡比（Kirby）时，它会试图用角撞击他。撞击卡比（Kirby）会造成伤害，但它自己在过程中很可能也会受伤。如果它撞到墙壁，它会卡在那里一段时间，无法移动。

Gussa在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中首次亮相并唯一作为敌人出现。它相对罕见，在游戏后期才会遇到。

Gussa可以被Ghost卡比（Kirby）控制。被控制时，Gussa可以被引导游动并至用它的螺旋桨尾巴突进，还可以在空中和陆地上跳跃（虽然它只能在水下突进）。此外，它在突进时可能会让它的角卡在墙里。尽管有这个突进动作，Gussa攻击敌人时也会受到伤害。

吞下Gussa不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:8717.description_en:
KSqS Gussa Sprite.png Gussa is an aquatic enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It resembles a blue fish, or small shark with a propeller tail and a large horn sticking out the front of its head. When it spots 卡比（Kirby） in the water, it will attempt to ram him with its horn. It deals damage when striking 卡比（Kirby）, but will most likely also off itself in the process. If it runs into a wall, it will get stuck there for a while, unable to move.

Gussa makes its debut and only appearance as an enemy in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is relatively rare, not encountered until very late into the game.

Gussa can be possessed by Ghost 卡比（Kirby）. While possessed, Gussa can be made to swim and to charge with its propeller tail, as well as hop around in the air and on land (though it can only charge underwater). Additionally, it can be made to get its horn stuck in a wall when charging. Despite this charge move, Gussa cannot attack enemies without also taking damage itself.

Gussa yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

wikirby-page:8459.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8459.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8459.description_zh:
KSqS Maiga Sprite.png Maiga是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的敌人。它是一个偏绿色的类似粘液的生物，以不规则的模式跳动。如果卡比（Kirby）试图Inhale它，Maiga会附着在他的脸上，并弹回去，同时造成伤害。因此，它不能被吞下，而必须通过其他方式消灭。

尽管是一个没有固定形状的粘液体，Maiga在不移动时，头顶上往往会形成两个角状突起。
wikirby-page:8459.description_en:
KSqS Maiga Sprite.png Maiga is an enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is a green-ish blob-like creature that hops around in erratic patterns. If 卡比（Kirby） attempts to Inhale it, the Maiga will stick to his face, and bounce back off, dealing damage in the process. As such, it cannot be swallowed, and instead must be dispatched by other means.

Despite being a blob with no fixed shape, Maiga does tend to form two horn-like protuberances on the top of their heads when they are not moving.

wikirby-page:5529.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:5529.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:5529.description_zh: Metalun是一种只在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中发现的敌人。它是一种大型生物，呈多面角状的抛光金属固体，除了两只小黑眼睛和一双平坦的可收缩脚之外没有其他特征，非常像硬石（Rocky）在星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的外观。尽管对所有攻击都很脆弱，但Metaluns具有相对较高的生命值，并且像游戏中大多数类似大小的敌人一样，只能通过Super Inhale来吸入。吸入并吞下一个可以赋予卡比（Kirby）Metal的能力。
wikirby-page:5529.description_en: Metalun is an enemy exclusively found in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is a large creature that is an angular, multi-sided solid of polished metal, possessing no features apart from two small, black eyes and a pair of flat, retractable feet, much like 硬石（Rocky）'s appearance from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）. Although vulnerable to all attacks, Metaluns possess a relatively large amount of health and, like most similarly sized enemies in the game, can only be inhaled with a Super Inhale. Inhaling and swallowing one awards 卡比（Kirby） with the Metal ability.

wikirby-page:8449.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8449.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8449.description_zh: KSqS Perara精灵.png Perara是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的一种飞行敌人，如果被卡比（Kirby）吞下不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。它外观类似蓝色扁虫，通过摆动身体在空中漂浮。与大多数敌人一样，Perara唯一伤害卡比（Kirby）的方式是碰撞，这也会消灭Perara。它倾向于悬停在原地，直到卡比（Kirby）试图从它下面经过。这时，Perara会在下落的过程中来回摆动，直到碰到卡比（Kirby）、受到攻击或者触地。如果Perara落地，它会短暂休息，然后再次跃回空中，恢复悬停，直到卡比（Kirby）再次靠近。相反，如果Perara从上方经过，卡比（Kirby）将会被忽略。
wikirby-page:8449.description_en: KSqS Perara sprite.png Perara is a flying enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） which yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）. It resembles a blue flatworm in appearance, and floats in place by undulating its body. As with most enemies, Perara's only means of harming 卡比（Kirby） is by collision, which will also defeat the Perara. It tends to hover in place until 卡比（Kirby） attempts to pass underneath. At this, the Perara will sweep back and forth as it descends until it hits 卡比（Kirby）, is attacked, or touches the ground. In the event that Perara does land on the ground, it will rest for a short moment, and then leap back into the air and resume hovering in place until 卡比（Kirby） gets near again. Conversely, Perara will ignore 卡比（Kirby） if he passes overhead.

wikirby-page:8458.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8458.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8458.description_zh:
“我下面移动的朋友被称为吱吱队。他们负责这里的大部分情报收集。他们是发现大多数奖章所在位置的人。但吱吱队很胆小，所以只有你能帮我去拿那些奖章！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
吱吱队是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的敌人，属于怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）的一部分。吱吱队是怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）中等级最低的打手，但数量很多。他们看起来像小老鼠，但没有腿，而是像块状物一样跳来跳去。吱吱队有多种颜色，包括黄色、绿色、蓝色和红色；每种颜色的行为都不同。
wikirby-page:8458.description_en:
“My friends moving down below are known as the Squeakers. They do most of the intel gathering around here. They're the ones who found out where most of the medals are. But the Squeakers are timid, so that leaves only you to get those medals for me!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
Squeakers are enemies from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） that are part of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）. Squeakers are the lowest ranked henchmen of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）, but there are many of them. They resemble small mice, but do not have legs, instead opting to hop around like blobs. Squeakers come in multiple colors, including yellow, green, blue, and red; with each color acting differently.

wikirby-page:8532.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8532.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8532.description_zh:
Uja是来自星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的浮动敌人。它看起来像是一群昆虫聚集在一起，形成两种黑暗而模糊的形态之一。第一种形态类似Master Hand，第二种形态类似一把大弯刀。它缓慢地跟随卡比（Kirby），试图与他碰撞以造成伤害。当它出现或变换形态时，会发出令人毛骨悚然的声音，使它与游戏中大多数其他生物区分开来。如果它被击中，它会相位消失以避免受到更多伤害，并且通常会随后逃离现场。Uja拥有大量生命值，但它很容易被吸入。

当被Ghost卡比（Kirby）控制时，Uja可以被操纵飞行，改变方向，就像会朝给定的方向移动。Uja会自行变形为手或剑的形态，即使在被附身的情况下，也不能被强制变形，除非被击中。手形态下无法直接攻击，但剑形态下，可以用来刺击，切断绳索和植物，对敌人造成重创。
wikirby-page:8532.description_en:
Uja is a floating enemy from 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It appears to be a swarm of insects clouded together to create one of two dark and murky forms. The first resembles Master Hand, and the second resembles a large scimitar. It floats slowly after 卡比（Kirby）, in an attempt to collide with him to deal damage. When it appears or shifts shape, it makes a creepy noise, distinguishing it from most every other creature in the game. If it gets hit, it will phase out in order to avoid taking more damage, and will often flee the scene afterward. Uja has a great deal of hit points, but it can be inhaled easily.

When possessed by Ghost 卡比（Kirby）, Uja can be made to fly around, changing its orientation as it moves in a given direction. Uja will transform of its own accord into its hand or sword form, even while possessed, and cannot be forced to change unless it is hit. It cannot attack directly while in hand form, but when in sword form, it can be made to thrust, cutting ropes and foliage and dealing heavy damage to enemies.

wikirby-page:6390.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:6390.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:6390.description_zh:
左Big Metalun是一个只在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现的中级Boss。虽然它的名字暗示它是Metalun的大型版本，但它有不同的特征。它有点像卡比（Kirby），不像Metaluns那样没有任何手臂。它还有一只蓝色的眼睛。当击败后吸入，它会给予Metal技能。

它是一个体型大、行动缓慢的Boss，拥有大量HP。它可以通过缓慢走向卡比（Kirby）来攻击。当它眼睛上的部件折断时，会提示它在行走。它也可以滚向卡比（Kirby），这比走路攻击速度快，但撞到墙时容易受伤。同时，当卡比（Kirby）正在与Big Metalun作战时，天花板会落下岩石，对卡比（Kirby）构成危险，但如果卡比（Kirby）缺少复制能力（Copy Ability），他可以吸入这些岩石作为投射物。

 Big Metalun只能在Nature Notch - Stage 5和Vocal Volcano - Stage 3中找到。
wikirby-page:6390.description_en:
left Big Metalun is a mid-boss that appears exclusively in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. Although its name implies that it is a big version of a Metalun, it has different characteristics. It somewhat resembles 卡比（Kirby）, unlike Metaluns, which do not have any arms. It also has a single blue eye. Big Metalun yields the Metal ability when inhaled after its defeat.

It is a big, slow boss with a large amount of HP. It can attack by slowly walking into 卡比（Kirby）. It signifies when it walks when the piece over its eye snaps. It can also roll into 卡比（Kirby）, which is a faster attack than walking, but it is vulnerable when it hits a wall. Meanwhile, when 卡比（Kirby） is fighting Big Metalun, rocks fall from the ceiling, which act as a hazard for 卡比（Kirby）, but 卡比（Kirby） can inhale these rocks for projectiles if he lacks a 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Big Metalun can be found only in Nature Notch - Stage 5 and Vocal Volcano - Stage 3.

wikirby-page:8625.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8625.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8625.description_zh:
Buboo是一个仅在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现的中级boss，击败它会获得Bubble能力。

Buboo是一个漂浮生物，红色的脸上布满绿色泡泡。它的攻击不频繁，但一旦停止，就会抖动身体，释放出许多泡泡，卡比（Kirby）可以吞下这些泡泡并朝它吐回以造成伤害。它也可能掉落含有瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的泡泡。击败后，它的泡泡会消失，显现出它是一只小型螃蟹状生物。它也可能在未击败前就显示这种形态，在地面上四处奔跑释放更多泡泡。

Buboo仅在Jam Jungle - Stage 4和Secret Sea - Stage 2中出现。如果卡比（Kirby）已完成Ghost Medal，则它在Jam Jungle的出现是被Tedhaun.
wikirby-page:8625.description_en:
Buboo is a mid-boss found exclusively in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） which yields the Bubble ability when defeated.

Buboo is a floating creature with a red face covered in teal bubbles. Its attacks are infrequent, but once it stops, it shakes itself, releasing many bubbles which 卡比（Kirby） can swallow and spit back at it to deal damage. It can also drop bubbles containing 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s. When defeated, its bubbles disappear, revealing it to be a small crab-like creature. It may also show this form before defeat, scampering across the ground releasing more bubbles.

Buboo is found only in Jam Jungle - Stage 4 and Secret Sea - Stage 2. If 卡比（Kirby） has the completed Ghost Medal, its appearance in Jam Jungle is replaced by Tedhaun.

wikirby-page:1894.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1894.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1894.description_zh:
“我的漂浮朋友多库（Doc）建造了我的飞船。他在机械方面是个天才。对吧，多库（Doc）？嗯。他现在年纪有些大了，但我相信他脑海里仍有很多伟大的想法在运转。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
多库（Doc）是怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）的成员，隶属于怪盗洛切（Daroach），他首次亮相于星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）。他是所有有名字的小吱鼠成员中最小的，可以与吱鼠（Squeaker）相提并论，但他的巨大绿色胡子和典型的疯狂科学家护目镜让他与众不同。他经常被看到操作飞碟，这显示了他喜欢发明和操作机器人及其他机械的习性。多库（Doc）的显著发明包括他的飞碟、Mecha-Kracko、Yadgaine，以及Daroach's Airship。在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中，多库（Doc）曾多次作为中级Boss作战，并使用这些各种机器两次作为最终Boss作战。没有机器驾驶，他将无助。
wikirby-page:1894.description_en:
“My floating friend there, 多库（Doc）, built my airship. He's a genius when it comes to machines. Right, 多库（Doc）? Hmm. He's getting on in years now, but I'm sure he's got a lot of big ideas knocking around his head.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
多库（Doc） is a member of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） serving under 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, who debuted in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. He is easily the smallest of the named Squeak members, comparable to a 吱鼠（Squeaker） in size, but is distinguishable by his huge green mustache and stereotypical mad scientist goggles. He is often seen operating a flying saucer, which is indicative of his penchant for inventing and operating robots and other machines. Notable inventions of 多库（Doc） include his flying saucer, Mecha-Kracko, Yadgaine, and Daroach's Airship. In 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, 多库（Doc） is fought on several occasions as a mid-boss and twice as a boss using these various machines. Without a machine to pilot, he is helpless.

wikirby-page:8503.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:8503.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:8503.description_zh:
Gao Gao是一个只在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现的中级Boss，击败后会获得动物（Animal）能力。

Gao Gao看起来像一只大型蓝色食肉动物，拥有巨大的爪子。它通过突刺和旋转攻击进行攻击，也可以执行高旋转跳跃。它自身容易眩晕，使其相对容易击败。

Gao Gao可以在Nature Notch - Stage 3、Vocal Volcano - Stage 3、Ice Island - Stage 1和Gamble Galaxy - Stage 3中找到。与其他中级Boss不同，如果卡比（Kirby）已完成Ghost Medal，它不会被Tedhaun取代。
wikirby-page:8503.description_en:
Gao Gao is a mid-boss exclusively found in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） which yields the 动物（Animal） ability when defeated.

Gao Gao resembles a large blue carnivoran with massive claws. It attacks by performing lunging and spinning attacks, and can also perform high spinning jumps. It dazes itself rather easily, making it relatively simple to defeat.

Gao Gao can be found in Nature Notch - Stage 3, Vocal Volcano - Stage 3, Ice Island - Stage 1, and Gamble Galaxy - Stage 3. Unlike other mid-bosses, it is not replaced with Tedhaun if 卡比（Kirby） has the completed Ghost Medal.

wikirby-page:1891.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1891.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1891.description_zh:
“在我下面，你会看到鼠宾（Spinni），我帮派中最有型的成员。他像专业人士一样寻找宝藏。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
鼠宾（Spinni）中是一个中级boss，也是怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）中主要有名成员之一，和怪盗洛切（Daroach）、鼠泰隆（Storo）以及多库（Doc）一起。他的特点是时尚的红色太阳镜和长披风，并在战斗中利用他的速度和敏捷。他的主要武器是一套飞镖和一个金属爪，这两样武器都可以被击落并吞下用于各种复制能力（Copy Ability）。鼠宾（Spinni）首次出现于星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad），并作为怪盗洛切（Daroach）的Dream Friend招式组出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）。
wikirby-page:1891.description_en:
“Below me you see 鼠宾（Spinni）, the most stylish member of my gang. And he ferrets out treasure like a pro.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
鼠宾（Spinni） is a mid-boss and one of the major named members of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） alongside 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, 鼠泰隆（Storo） and 多库（Doc）. He is characterized by his stylish red sunglasses and long cape, and makes use of his speed and agility in fights. His main weapons are a set of throwing stars and a metal claw, both of which can be knocked away and swallowed for various 复制能力（Copy Ability）. 鼠宾（Spinni） made his first appearance in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, and would last appear as part of 怪盗洛切（Daroach）'s Dream Friend moveset in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-page:1893.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1893.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1893.description_zh:
“你身后的那个人叫鼠泰隆（Storo）。他一直都是个大块头，但别担心。他其实非常温顺。可以这么说。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
鼠泰隆（Storo）是怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）的一员，与怪盗洛切（Daroach）、鼠宾（Spinni）和多库（Doc）一起行动，充当他们的肌肉。他首次出现在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）。鼠泰隆（Storo）是一只蓝色、强壮的二足鼠。他戴着红色头巾、黑色眼罩，穿着露肚子的红色无袖衫。他有一个圆圆的黑色鼻子，嘴里只有一颗可见的牙齿。尽管没有可见的眼睛，鼠泰隆（Storo）在副游戏Speedy Teatime中被打时仍会哭。
wikirby-page:1893.description_en:
“The fellow behind you goes by the name 鼠泰隆（Storo）. He's always been a big guy, but don't worry. He's really a pussycat. So to speak.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
鼠泰隆（Storo） is a member of the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） alongside 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, 鼠宾（Spinni） and 多库（Doc）, acting as the muscle of them. He first appeared in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. 鼠泰隆（Storo） is a blue, burly bipedal mouse. He wears a red bandana, a black eyepatch and a red sleeveless shirt with the belly out. He has a round, black snout and a single visible tooth in his mouth. Despite having no visible eyes, 鼠泰隆（Storo） still cries when being beaten in the sub-game Speedy Teatime.

wikirby-page:2498.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:2498.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:2498.description_zh: 左侧的Tedhaun是一个中级Boss，只在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现过。Tedhaun看起来像典型的床单幽灵，但有一只邪恶的眼睛，戴着带星星的紫色睡帽。它还伴随着被称为Caper的小幽灵追随者，可以吸入并吐出以攻击它们的首领。Tedhaun是Ghost复制能力（Copy Ability）的唯一来源，除了Mix和Copy Ability Room。
wikirby-page:2498.description_en: left Tedhaun is a mid-boss that has only appeared in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. Tedhaun resembles a stereotypical sheet ghost, but has a single evil eye and wears a purple night cap with a star on it. It is also accompanied by small follower ghosts called Caper which can be inhaled and spat to attack their leader. Tedhaun is the only source of the Ghost 复制能力（Copy Ability）, other than Mix and the Copy Ability Room.

wikirby-page:6703.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:6703.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:6703.description_zh:
Bohboh是星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的第五个Boss，在Vocal Volcano中面对。它是一种火焰状的猫头鹰型生物，带有浣熊般的尾巴。它可以通过向卡比（Kirby）投掷火球进行攻击。它的主要攻击方式是用爪子朝卡比（Kirby）冲锋。如果它抓住卡比（Kirby），会将卡比（Kirby）扔向火焰危险区域，使卡比（Kirby）受到伤害，并且由于下面的熔岩经常立即失去能力。它也常常飞到背景中并出现在舞台的另一侧。

如果它的冲锋攻击未命中而击中地面，会被眩晕。与此同时，岩石会落下并伤害卡比（Kirby），但岩石也可以用来攻击Bohboh。恢复后，Bohboh缓慢升起，闭着眼睛，makes它容易受到攻击。一旦它的眼睛睁开，它会恢复攻击模式。

如果Bohboh冲锋未命中，但没有触地，它会直接飞出屏幕。

一旦Bohboh被击败，它获得的大宝箱卡比（Kirby）是一件描绘它的Boss Battle Badge。如果卡比（Kirby）收集所有的Boss战徽章，他可以玩一个新模式：Boss Endurance。
wikirby-page:6703.description_en:
Bohboh is the fifth boss of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, faced in Vocal Volcano. It is a fiery owl-like creature with a raccoon-like tail. It can attack by dropping fire balls on 卡比（Kirby）. Its primary attack is to charge at 卡比（Kirby） with its talons. If it grabs 卡比（Kirby）, it throws 卡比（Kirby） to the fire hazard, making 卡比（Kirby） take damage and often immediately lose his ability due to the lava below him. It may also often fly into the background and appear on the other side of the stage.

If it misses its charging attack and hits the ground, it gets stunned. Meanwhile, rocks fall and can hurt 卡比（Kirby）, but they can be used to attack Bohboh. After recovering, Bohboh slowly rises, its eyes closed, which makes it vulnerable to attack. Once its eyes open, it resumes its attacking patterns.

If Bohboh charges and misses, but does not hit the ground, it simply flies off screen.

Once Bohboh is defeated, the large treasure chest 卡比（Kirby） receives is a Boss Battle Badge depicting it. If 卡比（Kirby） collects all boss battle badges, he can play a new mode: Boss Endurance.

wikirby-page:1892.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1892.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1892.description_zh:
“毫不犹豫地，怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）打开了箱子。哦，卡比（Kirby）的蛋糕……可是箱子里没有蛋糕，只有一团黑暗、诡异的烟雾！烟雾笼罩了怪侠洛切团（Squeaks），然后消失在太空中。太可怕了！照这样下去，草莓奶油蛋糕将永远丢失。”
— 讲述者叙述暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach）在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中的附身情况
暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach）是一种强大的怪盗洛切（Daroach）形式，由暗零（Dark Nebula）附身，他在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中出现为倒数第二个Boss。他的配色比怪盗洛切（Daroach）的常规形象更暗，拥有紫色服装、深蓝色的毛发，以及橙色的爪子和眼睛。在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）之外，暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach）在其他几款游戏中也有提及。
wikirby-page:1892.description_en:
“Without hesitation, the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） open the chest. Oh, 卡比（Kirby）'s cake... But there's no cake in the chest, only a dark, eerie cloud of smoke! The smoke envelops the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） and disappears into space. How awful! At this rate the strawberry shortcake will be lost forever.”
— The narrator narrating 暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach）'s possession in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach） is a powerful form of 怪盗洛切（Daroach） possessed by 暗零（Dark Nebula） who appears as the penultimate boss of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. He has a darker color palette than 怪盗洛切（Daroach）'s regular appearance, possessing purple clothing, dark blue fur, and orange claws and eyes. Outside of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）, 暗怪盗洛切（Dark Daroach） has been referenced in several other games.

wikirby-page:1701.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1701.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1701.description_zh:
“宝箱是冥界统治者暗零（Dark Nebula）的监狱。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）知道宝箱的秘密。他与卡比（Kirby）战斗，以防止暗零（Dark Nebula）被释放。”
— 在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中的叙述者
是一个黑暗的、星形的实体，担任星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的最终Boss。它被隐藏在一个宝箱中，卡比（Kirby）在击败怪盗洛切（Daroach）后获得该宝箱，之后被魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）偷走，以确保暗零（Dark Nebula）不会被释放。然而，卡比（Kirby）认为宝箱里装的是他在游戏开始时准备吃的蛋糕，便击败了魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），宝箱随后被怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）偷走。由于这一系列事件，暗零（Dark Nebula）从它的监狱，拥有怪盗洛切（Daroach）。在卡比（Kirby）第二次击败怪盗洛切（Daroach）之后，暗零（Dark Nebula）以一个带有其正常形象颜色的小黑星形式从怪盗洛切（Daroach）的身体中出现，卡比（Kirby）跟随它然后面对它，此时它会变大并长出一只眼睛。在卡比（Kirby）击败它之后，组成暗零（Dark Nebula）的星星从它体内掉出，只剩下它的眼睛，然后眼睛爆炸。在击败暗零（Dark Nebula）之后，卡比（Kirby）回家。到目前为止，暗零（Dark Nebula）在系列中仅作为一个完整实体出现过一次。但是在后续作品中，它以插图、引用和其他纪念品的形式获得了一些表现。
wikirby-page:1701.description_en:
“The treasure chest was the prison of 暗零（Dark Nebula）, ruler of the underworld. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） knew the secret of the chest. He fought 卡比（Kirby） to prevent 暗零（Dark Nebula） from being released.”
— The narrator in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
暗零（Dark Nebula） is a dark, star-shaped entity that serves as the final boss of 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It was concealed in a treasure chest that 卡比（Kirby） receives after beating 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, before it was stolen by 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） to make sure 暗零（Dark Nebula） would not be released. However, 卡比（Kirby）, believing that the treasure chest contains the cake he was about to eat in the beginning of the game, beats 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and the treasure chest is then stolen by the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）. As a consequence of this, 暗零（Dark Nebula） is released from its prison, possessing 怪盗洛切（Daroach）. After 卡比（Kirby） defeats 怪盗洛切（Daroach） a second time, 暗零（Dark Nebula） exits 怪盗洛切（Daroach）'s body as a small dark star bearing its normal form's color which 卡比（Kirby） follows and then faces it, where it enlarges and gains an eye. After 卡比（Kirby） beats it, the stars that make up 暗零（Dark Nebula） fall out of it, leaving only its eye, which then explodes. Having defeated 暗零（Dark Nebula）, 卡比（Kirby） returns home.

暗零（Dark Nebula） has, to this point, only appeared once in the series as a proper entity. It has been given some representation in subsequent titles in the form of illustrations, references, and other memorabilia, however.

wikirby-page:1895.description_zh: Mecha-Kracko是独眼云（Kracko）的一个机器人变体，它首次作为星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）的Boss登场。它由多库（Doc）制造和控制，但直到Boss战斗进行到一半才揭露这一点。
wikirby-page:1895.description_en: Mecha-Kracko is a robotic variant of 独眼云（Kracko） that debuts as a boss in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is built and controlled by 多库（Doc）, though this is not revealed until halfway through the boss fight.

wikirby-page:5602.description_zh: Mrs. Moley是星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中Nature Notch关卡的Boss。她看起来与Moley一模一样，Moley是一个首次在星之卡比镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）中登场的灰色鼹鼠类Boss，但她头上有几朵粉色花和一朵红色花作为“头发”。此外，她的肚子上似乎有一个小袋或口袋。在一部关于两者的Dedede Directory中，确认他们是一对。
wikirby-page:5602.description_en: Mrs. Moley is the boss of the Nature Notch level in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. She looks identical to Moley, a gray, mole-like boss debuting in 星之卡比 镜之大迷宫（Kirby & The Amazing Mirror）, but possesses "hair" in the form of several pink flowers and a singular red one that grace her head. Additionally, what appears to be a pouch or pocket can be seen on her belly. In a Dedede Directory about the two, it was confirmed that they are a couple.

wikirby-page:1899.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1899.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1899.description_zh:
左Yadgaine是一台由多库（Doc）制造并驾驶的机器，它在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）中表现为Jam Jungle的Boss。它是一种类似寄居蟹的机器人，前部有金属驾驶舱（由多库（Doc）占据），两侧各有一个大爪子。其主体后面跟着一个大型带刺的绿色外壳。

在整个战斗过程中，整个屏幕向右滚动，因为Yadgaine位于最左侧，而卡比（Kirby）必须跟上移动，同时尝试击败Yadgaine。Yadgaine的攻击方式是偶尔加速向前冲刺，同时用爪子向卡比（Kirby）投掷石头，或通过脸部向卡比（Kirby）发射激光。当它移动时，天上会落下火山岩，这些岩石可以被吸入并向Yadgaine吐回。

如果Yadgaine受到大量伤害，它的前爪将会折断，不得不依靠后腿。在这种状态下，它不能再在冲刺前进时投掷岩石。不久之后，如果它受到更多伤害，它的脸部将被毁坏，从而无法发射激光。卡比（Kirby）必须使用前述的投掷岩石方法，或使用复制能力（Copy Ability）攻击它，以击败它。
wikirby-page:1899.description_en:
left Yadgaine is a machine built and piloted by 多库（Doc） which appears as the boss of Jam Jungle in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. It is a hermit crab-like robot with a metal cockpit (occupied by 多库（Doc）) at its front and a large claw on either side. Its main body is followed by a large, spiked green shell.

Throughout the battle the entire screen scrolls right, as Yadgaine is at the far left and 卡比（Kirby） must keep up with the movement whilst trying to defeat Yadgaine. Yadgaine attacks by occasionally picking up the pace and dashing forwards whilst throwing rocks at 卡比（Kirby） with its claws or firing lasers at 卡比（Kirby） through its face. As it moves, volcanic rocks fall from the sky, which can be inhaled and spit back at Yadgaine.

If Yadgaine takes a large amount of damage, its front claws will break, and it will have to rely on its back legs. At this state, it can no longer throw rocks while dashing forwards. Soon after that, if it takes more damage, its face will be destroyed, preventing it from firing lasers. 卡比（Kirby） must defeat it by using the aforementioned rock method, or attacking it with a 复制能力（Copy Ability） in order to defeat it.

wikirby-page:1865.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！
wikirby-page:1865.display_work: 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）
wikirby-page:1865.description_zh:
“这帮星际盗贼拥有广泛的能力，他们利用这些能力追捕各种形状和大小的宝物。怪盗洛切（Daroach）是领导者，鼠宾（Spinni）是速度担当，鼠泰隆（Storo）是力量担当，多库（Doc）是智囊，而黄色、蓝色和绿色的Squeakers则是手下。”
— 星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）手册
缩略图|卡比（Kirby）从怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）逃跑并带走宝物的艺术作品。

怪侠洛切团（Squeaks），也被称为Squeak队，是一群类啮齿动物的盗贼，首次出现在星之卡比怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）。怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）由无数被称为吱鼠（Squeaker）的小爪牙组成，这些小爪牙由三个更强壮的手下指挥，他们分别是鼠宾（Spinni）、鼠泰隆（Storo）和多库（Doc），而他们的领导者是魔术师老鼠，被称为怪盗洛切（Daroach）。目前还不清楚怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）最初来自何处，甚至不清楚它们是否有固定的基地。在Kirby Mass Attack中，怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）拥有一艘飞艇，这使它们能够在Popopo Islands中自由移动。
wikirby-page:1865.description_en:
“This gang of intergalactic thieves possesses wide-ranging abilities, which they use to hunt down and capture treasures of all shapes and sizes. 怪盗洛切（Daroach） is the leader, 鼠宾（Spinni） is the speed, 鼠泰隆（Storo） is the muscle, 多库（Doc） is the brains, and the yellow, blue, and green Squeakers are the henchmen.”
— 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad） manual
thumb|Artwork of 卡比（Kirby） fleeing with a treasure from the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）.

The 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）, also known as the Squeak Squad, are a band of rodent-like thieves first appearing in 星之卡比 怪侠洛切团登场！（Kirby: Squeak Squad）. The 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） consist of innumerable small lackeys known as 吱鼠（Squeaker）s who are commanded by the three stronger henchmen known as 鼠宾（Spinni）, 鼠泰隆（Storo） and 多库（Doc）, who are in turn led by the magician mouse known as 怪盗洛切（Daroach）. It is unclear where the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） first came from, or even if they have a permanent base of operations. In Kirby Mass Attack, the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） are in possession of an airship which allows them to move freely around the Popopo Islands.

wikirby-page:2661.description_zh: 离开Capsule J2是Kirby Super Star Ultra中首次亮相的敌人，用以替代原星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的Capsule J。除头部和面部区域外，它在体型上类似于原Capsule J。然而，其头部形状像喷气机的机头，并装有一对高功率火箭助推器。它还有类似下颚的延伸部分和发光的红色眼睛。
wikirby-page:2661.description_en: left Capsule J2 is an enemy debuting in Kirby Super Star Ultra, as a replacement for Capsule J from the original 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. With the exception of its head and facial area, it physically resembles the original Capsule J. However, its head is shaped like a jet's nose and it has a pair of high-powered rocket boosters. It also has a lower jaw-like extension and glowing red eyes.

wikirby-page:11647.description_zh:
Croucars是一个首次出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra游戏Revenge of the King中的敌人。Croucars类似于乌鸦，但羽毛呈深品红色。它与Twizzy非常相似，但移动模式更加不规则。吞下Croucars不会提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Croucars可以在关卡Purple Plants和Crash Clouds中找到。它经常与Koozer一起出现，尤其是在《Purple Plants》的开场动画中。
wikirby-page:11647.description_en:
Croucars is an enemy that debuted in Kirby Super Star Ultra, in the Revenge of the King game. Croucars resembles a crow, but with dark magenta plumage. It is very similar to Twizzy, but it moves in much more erratic patterns. Croucars provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Croucars can be found in the stages Purple Plants and Crash Clouds. It can often be seen alongside Koozer, most notably in the opening cutscene for Purple Plants.

wikirby-page:11646.description_zh:
Galbel是在Kirby Super Star Ultra中首次登场的敌人，出现在Revenge of the King游戏中。它是头带熊（Grizzo）的更强大版本，拥有同样的熊的基本体型和大小，但外观像一只带有淡黄色毛皮和棕色条纹的老虎。因此，它具有头带熊（Grizzo）的所有行为和物理属性，只是生命值更高。Galbel被吞食时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Galbel出现在Purple Plants和Illusion Islands场景中。它还出现在Crash Clouds的开场动画中，尽管在关卡本身并未出现。
wikirby-page:11646.description_en:
Galbel is an enemy that debuted in Kirby Super Star Ultra, in the Revenge of the King game. It is a more powerful version of 头带熊（Grizzo） that shares the bear's basic physique and size, but resembles a tiger with pale yellow fur and brown stripes. As such, it has all the same behaviors and physical properties of a 头带熊（Grizzo） save for higher health. Galbel provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Galbel appears in the Purple Plants and Illusion Islands stages. It also appears in the intro cutscene for Crash Clouds, despite not appearing in the stage proper.

wikirby-page:11636.description_zh:
Mister Anglep是一个漂浮的苹果敌人，只出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra的Revenge of the King主游戏中。他出现在两个关卡：Illusion Islands和Crash Clouds。

他从Spring Breeze取代尖耳怪（Scarfy），并具有类似的特性。Mister Anglep最初看起来像一个无害的绿色苹果，但像尖耳怪（Scarfy）一样，卡比（Kirby）无法吸入他。尝试这样做会导致Mister Anglep变成深红色的凶狠苹果，并追逐卡比（Kirby）。如果卡比（Kirby）放任他不管，Mister Anglep最终会在一段时间后爆炸。

就像尖耳怪（Scarfy）一样，卡比（Kirby）可以使用Copy直接扫描Mister Anglep以获取爆裂（Crash）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:11636.description_en:
Mister Anglep is a floating apple enemy that only appears in the Revenge of the King main game of Kirby Super Star Ultra. He appears in two levels: Illusion Islands and Crash Clouds.

He replaces 尖耳怪（Scarfy） from Spring Breeze and has similar characteristics to it. Mister Anglep initially appears as a harmless green apple, but like 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, 卡比（Kirby） cannot inhale him. Attempting to causes Mister Anglep to transform into a dark red, vicious apple and dash after 卡比（Kirby）. The Mister Anglep eventually explodes after a while if 卡比（Kirby） leaves him alone.

Just like 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, 卡比（Kirby） can use Copy to directly scan Mister Anglep for the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:11718.description_zh:
Perot是一个敌人，首次出现在Revenge of the King，这是一款来自Kirby Super Star Ultra的游戏。它在外观和功能上都与小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）非常相似，但脸上化了小丑妆，并且一直伸着舌头。它的生命值比普通版本更多，但仍然可以轻易被吸入。像小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）一样，它可以被看到在苹果上平衡、挥舞回力镖或投掷炸弹。它提供给卡比（Kirby）的复制能力（Copy Ability）取决于它手中持有的武器。

Perot出现在Purple Plants、Illusion Islands和Crash Clouds。
wikirby-page:11718.description_en:
Perot is an enemy which debuted in Revenge of the King, a game from Kirby Super Star Ultra. It is very similar in both look and function to 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）, but has a face painted like a clown and has its tongue sticking out at all times. It has more health than its normal counterpart, but can still easily be inhaled. Like 小波比兄弟（Poppy Bros. Jr.）, it can be seen balancing on apples, wielding a boomerang, or tossing bombs. Which 复制能力（Copy Ability） it provides to 卡比（Kirby） depends on what it is wielding.

Perot appears in Purple Plants, Illusion Islands, and Crash Clouds.

wikirby-page:3713.description_zh:
Poison Mash是出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra中的蘑菇敌人。它在Revenge of the King中替代蘑菇怪（Cappy）（而不是像Extra Mode的星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中那样替代Blopper），拥有比Cappies更多的生命值并且移动更快。Poison Mash可以在Purple Plants和Crash Clouds中找到。尽管名字如此，Poison Mash并不是真的有毒。

Poison Mash会作为路线角色在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中回归，并可以选择在Road Trip的Lake-Breeze Lane关卡使用。如果被选中，它将导致几朵蘑菇从水中生长，使骑手可以继续前往Mushgloom Route。
wikirby-page:3713.description_en:
Poison Mash is a mushroom enemy that appears in Kirby Super Star Ultra. It replaces 蘑菇怪（Cappy） in Revenge of the King (instead of Blopper like in Extra Mode of 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）), having more health and moving faster than Cappies. Poison Mash can be found in Purple Plants and Crash Clouds. Despite its name, Poison Mash isn't actually poisonous.

Poison Mash returns in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） as a route character that can be chosen for the Lake-Breeze Lane stage in Road Trip. If selected, it will cause several mushrooms to grow out of the water, allowing the rider to continue on to Mushgloom Route.

wikirby-page:11432.description_zh:
Rosely是首次出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra的敌人。它与Lovely非常相似，但更耐打且更少见。它只出现在Revenge of the King，出现在Purple Plants、Crash Clouds和The Revenge。

Rosely是一个静止的敌人，外形像一朵玫瑰，其花瓣的黑暗内部有两只眼睛。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会尝试扑向他。如果击中他，它会短暂抓住他，然后将他抛出，造成大量伤害。Rosely无法被吸入，但可以用任何标准攻击击败，例如Air Bullet或Slide，还有复制能力（Copy Ability）的攻击。与Lovely一样，Rosely只能击中头部。

自Kirby Super Star Ultra，Rosely仅以Keychain的形式出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中。这个出现揭示了它的官方本地化英文名称。
wikirby-page:11432.description_en:
Rosely is an enemy that debuted in Kirby Super Star Ultra. It is very similar to Lovely, but it is more durable and less common. It appears only in Revenge of the King, appearing in Purple Plants, Crash Clouds, and The Revenge.

Rosely is a stationary enemy which resembles a rose, with two eyes in the dark interior of its petals. When 卡比（Kirby） gets near, it will attempt to lurch at him. If it hits him, it will capture him for a brief moment, then toss him out, dealing significant damage. Rosely cannot be inhaled, but it can be defeated with any standard attack, such as Air Bullets or a Slide, along with those of 复制能力（Copy Ability）. As with Lovely, Rosely can only be hit in the head.

Since Kirby Super Star Ultra, Rosely has appeared only as a Keychain in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. This appearance revealed its official localized English name.

wikirby-page:11946.description_zh:
Swinging Waddle Dee是一个最早出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra的敌人。这种敌人是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），会以来回方式从绳子上摆动。在Kirby Super Star Ultra和星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，这种摆动通常与卡比（Kirby）的操作平面平行，但在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）和星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中，摆动的Waddle Dees可以改为垂直摆动，来回于背景之间。

Swinging Waddle Dee的绳子可以用任何能够在其他情况下切断绳子的复制能力（Copy Ability）切断，比如String Platform。这会导致Swinging Waddle Dee掉到地面上，然后像平常一样开始行走。然而，即使没有这种能力，Swinging Waddle Dee仍然可以通过直接攻击瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）来击败，并且仍然可以被吸入。瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）也可以偶尔看到从绳子上荡来荡去。
wikirby-page:11946.description_en:
Swinging Waddle Dee is an enemy that first appeared in Kirby Super Star Ultra. This enemy is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who is swinging from a rope in a back and forth motion. In Kirby Super Star Ultra and 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, this motion is typically parallel to 卡比（Kirby）'s plane of operation, but in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） and 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, Swinging Waddle Dees can swing in perpendicular instead, coming in and out of the background.

Swinging Waddle Dee's rope can be cut using any 复制能力（Copy Ability） that can cut ropes in other contexts, like a String Platform. This will cause the Swinging Waddle Dee to fall to the floor, then start walking as normal. Even without such an ability, however, Swinging Waddle Dee can still be defeated by attacking the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） directly, and can still be inhaled. 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） can also be seen swinging from a rope occasionally.

wikirby-page:1409.description_zh:
“你现在将与一位因其力量过于强大而被封印的战士战斗... ->我现在将再次召唤这位伟大的战士... -> 3… 2… 1…开始!”
— 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）在Meta Knightmare Ultra中，Kirby Super Star Ultra
星河骑士（Galacta Knight）（在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的任务中称为永恒英雄）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中一个强大的循环出现的Boss，通常被称为“古代英雄”、“时间战士”或“银河中最伟大的战士”。星河骑士（Galacta Knight）与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）十分相似，甚至大小一致，但在视觉上有关键差异。他的身体呈洋红色，面具下的眼睛也是洋红色（在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）之前的游戏中为红色）。他的面具有一个尖的十字形护目镜，而不是水平狭缝。与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的蝙蝠翅膀不同，星河骑士（Galacta Knight）有羽毛状的天使翅膀。星河骑士（Galacta Knight）还戴着一个面具，面具上有两只金色的角，这与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）不同。他使用一把品红色的长矛和一个带有四角星的盾牌作战，这与他的面具设计非常相似。
wikirby-page:1409.description_en:
“YOU WILL NOW FIGHT A WARRIOR WHO WAS SEALED AWAY FOR FEAR HIS POWER WAS TOO GREAT... -> I WILL NOW SUMMON THIS GREAT WARRIOR ONCE MORE... -> 3… 2… 1… GO!”
— 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） in Meta Knightmare Ultra, Kirby Super Star Ultra
星河骑士（Galacta Knight） (referred to as Aeon Hero in Quests in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）) is a powerful recurring boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, commonly referred to as an "ancient hero", the "Temporal Warrior", or "the greatest warrior in the galaxy". 星河骑士（Galacta Knight） greatly resembles 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, even being the same size, but sports key visual differences. His body is magenta in color, and his eyes behind his mask are magenta (red in games prior to 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）). His mask has a pointed cross-shaped visor on it instead of a horizontal slit. Unlike 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s bat wings, 星河骑士（Galacta Knight） has feathered angelic wings. 星河骑士（Galacta Knight） also has two golden horns protruding from his mask, unlike 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. He fights with a magenta lance and a shield with a four-pointed star on it, much like the design of his mask.

wikirby-page:1621.description_zh:
“他吸收了新星的力量以恢复他邪恶的灵魂……这真的是最后的战斗了！”
— Kirby Super Star Ultra暂停画面风味文本
魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）是只在Kirby Super Star Ultra的The True Arena中出现的Boss，是游戏真正的最终Boss。魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）是魔噜酷（Marx）的强化版本，被已毁灭的银河·新星（Galactic Nova）的力量变异成了一个可怖的怪物。他的战斗方式与常规形态相同，但攻击力更强，移动更快且更混乱。他的生命值（630）比之前（350）高1.8倍。魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）与他的常规形态在多方面不同。最显著的是，他可以变形为雨落在卡比（Kirby）上的油漆块，如果被吸入，会赋予卡比（Kirby）Paint能力；然而，这种能力对这个Boss只能造成少量伤害。

魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul）是主系列卡比（Kirby）游戏中的第一个灵魂Boss。整个系列中的第一个是来自摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）的绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul），它是一个衍生作品。
wikirby-page:1621.description_en:
“He absorbed a nova's power to bring back his evil soul... This really is the last battle!”
— Kirby Super Star Ultra pause screen flavor text
魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul） is a boss that appears exclusively in The True Arena of Kirby Super Star Ultra, serving as the game's true final boss. 魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul） is a stronger version of 魔噜酷（Marx）, mutated into a grotesque monstrosity by the power of the destroyed 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）. He fights in the same way as his regular form, but his attacks are much stronger and he moves in a faster and more chaotic manner. His health (630) is also 1.8× higher than before (350). 魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul） is different from his regular form in various ways. Most notably, he can morph into paint blobs that rain down on 卡比（Kirby）, and, if inhaled, give 卡比（Kirby） the Paint ability; however, this ability only does a small amount of damage against this boss.

魔噜酷灵魂（Marx Soul） is the first soul boss in the main-series 卡比（Kirby） games. The first one in the whole series is 绘画堕落锡安灵魂（Drawcia Soul） from 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）, which is a spin-off.

wikirby-page:3752.description_zh: 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的一个经常出现的“替身”，他首次作为boss出现在Kirby Super Star Ultra中，即Revenge of the King。这个版本的帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）配备了一个类似于暗意向（Dark Mind）设计的增强力量面具和一个机械锤，被称为“新Dedede锤子（Hammer）”或“面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）锤子（Hammer）2.0”。有了这些装备，面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）的生命值比平常更高，并且能够执行各种新攻击，包括从锤子发射导弹、激光束和火焰喷射器，并发动超级快速的锤子旋转攻击，但之后会变得相当头晕。面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）还拥有自己特殊版本的“King Dedede's Theme”，基于在Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom)的SNES重制版中演奏的一个版本，速度快得多。
wikirby-page:3752.description_en: 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） is a frequently-recurring "alter ego" of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） who first appeared as a boss in Kirby Super Star Ultra, in Revenge of the King. This version of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） comes equipped with a power-amplifying mask with a design similar to 暗意向（Dark Mind）'s and a mechanical hammer, variously referred to as the "New Dedede 锤子（Hammer）" or the "面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） 锤子（Hammer） 2.0". With this equipment, 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） has greater health than he does normally, and is capable of performing a variety of new attacks, including firing missiles, laser beams, and a flamethrower from his hammer, and initiating a super-speedy hammer spin attack, though becoming rather dizzy afterward. 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） also comes with his own special version of "King Dedede's Theme", based off the one that plays in the SNES remake of Kirby's Star Stacker (Super Famicom), which has a much faster tempo.

wikirby-page:3686.description_zh:
“钻石之手和三只眼睛！这个家伙喜欢闪亮的东西！他是Wham Bam之王！”
— Kirby Super Star Ultra暂停屏幕风格文字
Wham Bam Jewel是Kirby Super Star Ultra中的一个老板。他是《Helper to Hero》的最终老板，也是The True Arena的第八个老板，作为最终四强之一。

Wham Bam Jewel是一个大型三眼怪物，有三只红眼睛和锋利的獠牙。他的手由蓝色水晶宝石组成。Wham Bam Jewel戴着一对金色耳环和镶有闪亮浅蓝色宝石的王冠。他的整体外观和名字是基于哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）的。在战斗中，Wham Bam Jewel没有可见的身体。《真正竞技场》的开场动画显示，他没有身体，只是漂浮的面部特征，带着王冠和耳环。

Wham Bam Jewel的攻击方式与哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）很相似，只是在某些细节上略有差异。Wham Bam Jewel的其中一个攻击方式是从他手上松开水晶到卡比（Kirby）之上，卡比（Kirby）可以吸入它们以获得石块（Stone）复制能力（Copy Ability）。除了水晶，他也可以掉落炸弹（Bomb），卡比（Kirby）可以吸入它们以获得炸弹（Bomb）复制能力（Copy Ability）。最后，Wham Bam Jewel可以用他的手指发射多个能量爆。
wikirby-page:3686.description_en:
“Diamond hands and 3 eyes! This guy likes shiny stuff! He's the Wham Bam king!”
— Kirby Super Star Ultra pause screen flavor text
Wham Bam Jewel is a boss in Kirby Super Star Ultra. He is the final boss of Helper to Hero and the eighth boss of The True Arena, as one of the Final Four.

Wham Bam Jewel is a large triclops creature, with three red eyes and sharp fangs. His hands are made up of blue crystal gems. Wham Bam Jewel wears a golden pair of earrings and a crown with shining light blue gems. His overall appearance and name is based on 哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）'s. During battle, Wham Bam Jewel has no visible body. The intro cutscene for The True Arena reveals that he has no body, and is just floating facial features with a crown and earrings.

Wham Bam Jewel attacks in much the same way as 哇姆霸姆岩石（Wham Bam Rock）, with a few minor alterations here-and-there. One of Wham Bam Jewel's attacks is to unlatch crystals from his hand atop of 卡比（Kirby）, and 卡比（Kirby） can inhale them to obtain the 石块（Stone） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Instead of crystals, he can also drop 炸弹（Bomb）s, which 卡比（Kirby） can inhale to gain the 炸弹（Bomb） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Lastly, Wham Bam Jewel can shoot several blasts from his finger.

wikirby-form:4028.description_zh: Digger是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态中，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）都驾驶一种类似鼹鼠的特殊挖掘机器。该变形首次出现于Mole Hole的Grass Land或Cool Cave的Hot Land，这取决于玩家在击败Fangora之后是选择进行额外关卡，还是先继续前往Hot Land。
wikirby-form:4028.description_en: Digger is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） both pilot a specialized digging machine resembling a mole. The Transformation first appears either in Mole Hole in Grass Land or Cool Cave in Hot Land, depending on if the player decides to play the extra stages after defeating Fangora or continue to Hot Land first.

wikirby-form:4024.description_zh: Dolphin是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态中，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）在接触Metamortex时都驾驶一种类似Dolphin的机器，并且它们独立行动。该变形首次出现在Blub-Blub Ocean的Water Land。
wikirby-form:4024.description_en: Dolphin is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） both pilot a Dolphin-like machine when they touch the Metamortex, where they both act independently. The Transformation first appears in Blub-Blub Ocean in Water Land.

wikirby-form:4029.description_zh: Fire Engine是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的转变。在这种形式中，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）采取消防车的形式，它们都独立行动。该转换首次出现在Lava Landing的Hot Land中。
wikirby-form:4029.description_en: The Fire Engine is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） take on the form of a fire truck where they both act independently. The Transformation first appears in Lava Landing in Hot Land.

wikirby-form:4027.description_zh: Off-Roader是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一种Metamortex变形。在这种形态下，发起变形的玩家会变成类似怪物卡车的全地形车辆。仅在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）中可见，次要玩家会骑在Off-Roader的顶部。该变形首次出现在Pyramid Sands的Hot Land中。
wikirby-form:4027.description_en: The Off-Roader is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, the player who initiates the transformation turns into an all-terrain vehicle resembling a monster truck. Exclusive to 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）, the secondary player rides on top of the Off-Roader. The transformation first appears in Pyramid Sands in Hot Land.

wikirby-form:4020.description_zh: Rocket是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一种Metamortex变形。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）变形成Rocket船，它们可以独立行动。该变形首次出现在Stellar Way的Space Land中。
wikirby-form:4020.description_en: The Rocket is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） take form of Rocket ships where they can both act independently. The transformation first appears in Stellar Way in Space Land.

wikirby-form:4022.description_zh: Saucer是一种Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）都驾驶一种飞行的Saucer，其形状与U.F.O.能力相似，但更大，并且他们都可以独立行动。这种变形首次出现在Flower Fields的Grass Land中。
wikirby-form:4022.description_en: Saucer is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） both pilot a flying Saucer shaped similarly to the U.F.O. ability, though larger, where they can both act independently. The transformation first appears in Flower Fields in Grass Land.

wikirby-form:4025.description_zh: Spin Boarder是一种Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态下，根据谁抓住Metamortex，卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）会驾驶一套企鹅样的服装乘坐冲浪板。次要的玩家将被放置在另一玩家的头上，呈现较小且类似的外观。这种变形首次出现在Rainbow Falls的Grass Land中。
wikirby-form:4025.description_en: Spin Boarder is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, depending on who grabs the Metamortex, 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） pilot a penguin-like suit riding a surfboard. The secondary player will be placed upon the others' head as a smaller, similar look. The transformation first appears in Rainbow Falls in Grass Land.

wikirby-form:14811.description_zh: Star Shooter是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个变换。在这种形式中，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）驾驶由星星和云朵组成的飞行器，在那里他们可以独立行动。它非常类似于Rocket Metamortex和星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）与Kirby Super Star Ultra中的Starship。该变换首次出现在Cloud Palace中的Dream Land，并用于对抗独眼云（Kracko）。
wikirby-form:14811.description_en: The Star Shooter is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） ride a flying craft made of stars and clouds where they can both act independently. It is very similar to both the Rocket Metamortex and the Starship from 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. The transformation first appears in Cloud Palace in Dream Land and is used to battle 独眼云（Kracko）.

wikirby-form:4184.description_zh: Tankbot是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）驾驶一个大型圆形坦克状的车辆，其车身形状与它们有些相似。在双人模式下，主玩家变成坦克本身，而副玩家驾驶机器。该变形首次出现在Fountain Gardens的Grass Land中。
wikirby-form:4184.description_en: Tankbot is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） pilot a large round tank-like vehicle which somewhat resembles them in body shape. In 2 player mode, the primary player becomes the tank itself, whereas the secondary player pilots the machine. The transformation first appears in Fountain Gardens in Grass Land.

wikirby-form:4026.description_zh: Train是Metamortex在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的变形。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）变成机车Train的形态，而副玩家可以被看到作为Train内的列车长。该变形首次出现在Toy Tracks的Treat Land中。
wikirby-form:4026.description_en: Train is a Metamortex transformation in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） take on the form of a locomotive Train, whereas the secondary player can be seen as the conductor inside of the Train. The transformation first appears in Toy Tracks in Treat Land.

wikirby-page:4005.description_zh:
“喜欢探索世界。如果你遇到麻烦，她也可以帮你一把！”
— Cast的描述来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Angie是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个角色。她的白色翅膀和头顶的光环状毛线片让她看起来像一个Angel。每当卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）需要被救援时，Angie会出现并把他们带到安全的地方。Angie携带英雄的方式类似于Space Jump的动作模式。在联机模式中，也可以通过按A键召唤Angie。召唤后，Angie会将召唤她的角色带到另一个角色所在的位置。

在Angie的掌控下，卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）是安全的，不会受到敌人的伤害。然而，如果Angie正在救玩家免于被压碎或掉入坑中，玩家在被击中会失去的相同数量的珠子会在Angie抱着卡比（Kirby）或Fluff安全移动时形成一条轨迹。在被抱着期间，可以通过按2号按钮让Angie加速。

Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，可以通过在Devilish Mode中收集Life Piece来获得一个名为“高空栖息点”的Unique Furniture部件，这将允许Angie出现在Kirby's Pad。
wikirby-page:4005.description_en:
“Loves to explore the world. She can also help you out if you ever get into a jam!”
— Cast description from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Angie is a character in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. She resembles an Angel with her white wings and the halo-like yarn piece over her head. Whenever 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） need to be rescued, Angie will appear and carry them to safety. The way in which Angie carries the heroes follows a similar movement pattern to a Space Jump. Angie can also be summoned in co-op mode by pressing the A button. When summoned, Angie will carry the character that summoned her to wherever the other character is.

While in Angie's clutches, 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） are safe from enemies. However, if Angie is rescuing the player from being crushed or falling into a pit, the same amount of beads the player would lose upon being hit are spread in a trail as Angie carries 卡比（Kirby） or Fluff to safety. While being carried, Angie can be prompted to speed up with the 2 button.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, a Unique Furniture piece called the "Sky-High Perch" can be obtained via collecting Life Pieces in Devilish Mode, which will allow Angie to appear in Kirby's Pad.

wikirby-page:3974.description_zh:
“她喜欢闪亮的珠子和其他闪亮的物品！去和她一起收集一些吧！”
— Cast引自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Beadrix是一个出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的角色。在卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）用the Rainbow Arch and the Camel Sofa适当地装饰了201号公寓后，Beadrix将成为一名租户。她是一个蓝色的正方形，呈对角线方向，四周各有两个小正方形向上。Beadrix将为卡比（Kirby）提供一个名为“Beadrix's Run”的小游戏。与Beadrix对话时，她会给卡比（Kirby）提供在玩家已完成的各个关卡中收集珠子的任务。在这个小游戏中，卡比（Kirby）必须在关卡中收集一定数量的珠子a指定的时间。完成小游戏每个任务的奖励是Fabric。完成一个任务后，如果玩家已经清除了任务中涉及的关卡，将会出现另一个任务。总共有20个任务。

[[文件:KEY Fabric Beadrix.png|缩略图|一个以Beadrix为主要设计元素的Fabric。]]在游戏中完成关卡后，有机会让Beadrix过来拜访Kirby's Pad。完成Beadrix的所有任务后，在公寓里打招呼Beardrix将会获得一块以Beadrix为主要设计元素的赠送布料。

Beadrix的公寓使用天蓝色布料作为墙纸，青柠毡布作为的地板。
wikirby-page:3974.description_en:
“She loves sparkling beads and other shiny objects! Go collect some with her!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Beadrix is a character that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. After 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） properly decorate Apartment 201 with the Rainbow Arch and the Camel Sofa, Beadrix will become a tenant. She is a blue square that is oriented diagonally, with two smaller squares on each side facing upwards. Beadrix will provide 卡比（Kirby） with a minigame named "Beadrix's Run". Upon talking with Beadrix, she will provide 卡比（Kirby） with requests to collect beads across various stages the player has already completed. In this minigame, 卡比（Kirby） must collect an amount of beads throughout the stage in a designated amount of time. The reward for completing each request of the minigame is Fabric. After completing a request, another one will become available if the player has already cleared the stage featured in the request. There are 20 requests in all.

[[File:KEY Fabric Beadrix.png|thumb|A Fabric featuring Beadrix as the main design.]] After playing stages through the game, there is a chance Beadrix will come over to visit Kirby's Pad. After completing all of Beadrix's requests, greeting Beardrix in the apartment will result in a gifted fabric with Beadrix as the primary design element.

Beadrix's apartment utilizes the Sky Blue fabric for the wallpaper, and the Lime Felt fabric for the floor.

wikirby-page:4102.description_zh:
“知道一个绅士必须锻炼身体以保持健康！你能完成他的计划吗？”
— Cast引自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
Buster是一个出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的角色。在卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）用the Chimney, the Totem Pole, the Outdoor Bath and the Torch适当装饰了301公寓之后，Buster将成为一名租户。他是一个棕色六边形，里面有一个橄榄色六边形。Buster将为卡比（Kirby）提供一个名为“Buster's Training”的小游戏。与Buster交谈时，他将向卡比（Kirby）提出请求，让玩家在已经完成的各个关卡中打败敌人。在这个小游戏中，卡比（Kirby）必须在规定时间内击败关卡中的一定数量的敌人，否则会有惩罚将会发生五秒钟的效果。完成小游戏每个任务的奖励是Fabric。完成一个任务后，如果玩家已经清除了任务中涉及的关卡，将会出现另一个任务。总共有20个任务。

[[File:KEY Fabric Buster.png|缩略图|一个以Buster为主要设计的Fabric。]]在通关游戏中的各个关卡后，有机会Buster会过来拜访Kirby's Pad。完成Buster的所有任务后，在公寓中与Buster打招呼，将会获得以Buster为主要设计元素的赠送面料。

 Buster的公寓使用Candy Dot面料作为墙纸，和地板用绿点面料.
wikirby-page:4102.description_en:
“Knows that a gentleman must train to be healthy! Can you complete his program?”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
Buster is a character that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. After 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） properly decorate Apartment 301 with the Chimney, the Totem Pole, the Outdoor Bath and the Torch, Buster will become a tenant. He is a brown hexagon with an olive colored hexagon inside. Buster will provide 卡比（Kirby） with a minigame named "Buster's Training". Upon talking with Buster, he will provide 卡比（Kirby） with requests to defeat enemies across various stages the player has already completed. The reward for completing each request of the minigame is Fabric. After completing a request, another one will become available if the player has already cleared the stage featured in the request. [[File:KEY Fabric Buster.png|thumb|A Fabric featuring Buster as the main design.]] After playing stages through the game, there is a chance Buster will come over to visit Kirby's Pad. After completing all of Buster's requests, greeting Buster in the apartment will result in a gifted fabric with Buster as the primary design element.

Buster's apartment utilizes the Candy Dot fabric for the wallpaper, and the Green Dot fabric for the floor.

wikirby-page:3751.description_zh:
“喜欢可爱的东西和外出。带她出去，给她一个惊喜吧！”
— Cast引用了毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的话。
Carrie是卡比（Kirby）在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的邻居之一。在卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）用the Bronto Slide, the Stuffed Bear and the Dessert Dresser适当装饰202号公寓后，Carrie将成为租户。Carrie将为玩家提供一个名为“Carrie's Transport”的小游戏。在与Carrie交谈时，她会向卡比（Kirby）提出护送任务的请求，这些任务涉及玩家已完成的各个关卡。在这个小游戏中，Carrie会变成一个球形，卡比（Kirby）必须携带并投掷Carrie通过关卡，并将她投进指定的时间量，如果Carrie受到任何伤害，将会产生十秒的时间惩罚。此外，Carrie将会漂浮回靠近卡比（Kirby）的安全点，然后再变回她的球形，就像Angie救援玩家一样。投掷Carrie的轨迹类似于漫步大炸弹（Bomber）毛线球。完成小游戏的每个请求的奖励是Fabric。完成一个请求后，如果玩家已经通关了请求中对应的关卡，将会有另一个请求可用。总共有12个请求。

[[文件:KEY Fabric Carrie.png|缩略图|以Carrie为主要设计的Fabric。]]通过游戏中的关卡后，有机会Carrie将来拜访卡比（Kirby）的公寓。在完成了Carrie的所有请求后，在公寓里向Carrie打招呼将会获得一块以Carrie为主要设计元素的赠送布料。

Carrie的公寓使用黄色条纹布料作为墙纸，使用浅蓝色星星布料作为地板。
wikirby-page:3751.description_en:
“Loves cute things and going out. Take her out and treat her to a pleasant surprise!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Carrie is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s neighbors in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. After 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） properly decorate apartment 202 with the Bronto Slide, the Stuffed Bear and the Dessert Dresser, Carrie will become a tenant. Carrie will provide the player with a minigame called "Carrie's Transport". Upon talking with Carrie, she will provide 卡比（Kirby） with requests of an escort mission across various stages the player has already completed. In this minigame, Carrie turns into a ball form in which 卡比（Kirby） must carry and toss Carrie through a stage and toss her into the goal throne in a designated amount of time, where a time penalty of ten seconds will occur if Carrie takes any damage. Additionally, Carrie will float back to a safe point close to 卡比（Kirby） before transforming back to her ball form, similarly to how Angie rescues the player. Tossing Carrie has a similar trajectory to the 漫步大炸弹（Bomber） Yarn ball. The reward for completing each request of the minigame is Fabric. After completing a request, another one will become available if the player has already cleared the stage featured in the request. There are 12 requests in all.

[[File:KEY Fabric Carrie.png|thumb|A Fabric featuring Carrie as the main design.]] After playing stages through the game, there is a chance Carrie will come over to visit 卡比（Kirby）'s Pad. After completing all of Carrie's requests, greeting Carrie in the apartment will result in a gifted fabric with Carrie as the primary design element.

Carrie's apartment utilizes the Yellow Striped fabric for the wallpaper, and the Baby Blue Star fabric for the floor.

wikirby-page:14147.description_zh:
“A高档家具销售商，将高端风格带给大众。我们应该感谢他！”
— Cast引自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）。
Chaise Woole是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个配角。他是Dom Woole的兄弟之一，以蓝色贝雷帽和蓝色眼睛、领结以及短胡子而著称。他经营Furniture Shop，这家店与隔壁Loomis Woole的Fabric Shop同时开业。他的名字来源于法语中“椅子”的chaise，与他的职业相符。
wikirby-page:14147.description_en:
“A fine furniture seller who brings high-end style to the masses. We should thank him!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）.
Chaise Woole is a minor character in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is one of Dom Woole's brothers and is distinguished by his blue beret and eyes, bowtie, and short mustache. He runs the Furniture Shop, which opens up alongside Loomis Woole's Fabric Shop next door. His given name comes from chaise, which is French for "chair", fitting his occupation.

wikirby-page:3591.description_zh:
“Dom Woole管理Quilty Court。他在这里是个大人物！”
— Cast的描述来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Dom Woole是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个非玩家角色。他是Quilty Court的房东。他首次出现是在完成Patch Castle关卡之后，并为卡比（Kirby）提供了Quilty Court的一个房间，同时送了一份Normal Chair作为乔迁礼物。他的名字来源于“domicile”，意为“住所”，非常符合他的职业。Dom有两个兄弟，分别名为Chaise Woole和Loomis Woole，他们分别是Quilty Square家具店和布料店的店主。在游戏过程中，卡比（Kirby）有机会帮助Dom Woole扩展他的通过用珠子融资公寓大楼，并通过用游戏关卡中找到的家具装饰各种房间来帮助吸引租户入住。Dom Woole还会与他的兄弟Chaise和Loomis一起出现，每当在关卡中达到新的奖章阈值时庆祝，以及在Devilish Mode家具产生的各种效果期间出现。
wikirby-page:3591.description_en:
“Dom Woole manages Quilty Court. He's a big shot around here!”
— Cast description from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Dom Woole is a non-playable character in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is a landlord over Quilty Court. He is first seen after the Patch Castle stage is cleared, and gives 卡比（Kirby） a room in the Quilty Court, along with a Normal Chair as a housewarming gift. His given name comes from "domicile", which means "place of residence", fitting his occupation. Dom has two brothers, named Chaise Woole and Loomis Woole, who are the proprietors of the Furniture and Fabric shops in Quilty Square, respectively.

Over the course of the game, 卡比（Kirby） has the opportunity to help Dom Woole expand his apartment building by financing it with beads and helping attract tenants to the building by decorating the various rooms with furniture found in the game's stages. Dom Woole also appears alongside his brothers Chaise and Loomis to celebrate whenever a new medal threshold is reached while playing a stage, as well as during various effects from Devilish Mode furniture.

wikirby-page:14148.description_zh:
“每个人都在谈论的设计师！他总是在寻找灵感……”
— 引用自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）。
Loomis Woole是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个小角色。他是Dom Woole的兄弟之一，以金色的发型、红色领结和绿色眼睛为特点。他经营着Fabric Shop，该商店与邻居Chaise Woole的Furniture Shop同时开业。他的名字来源于“织机”，这是一种用于织布的设备，非常符合他的职业。
wikirby-page:14148.description_en:
“The designer everyone is talking about! He's always looking for inspiration...”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）.
Loomis Woole is a minor character in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is one of Dom Woole's brothers and is distinguished by his blond comb-over, red bowtie, and green eyes. He runs the Fabric Shop, which opens up alongside Chaise Woole's Furniture Shop next door. His given name comes from "loom", which is a device used for weaving fabric, fitting his occupation.

wikirby-page:4762.description_zh:
“她喜欢赛车和时尚。看看你能否在她喘息的时候超过她！”
— Cast摘自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Mara是一种淡紫色的兔子状生物，出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。在卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）使用the Clef Tree, the Jellyfish Light, the Knit-Cap Sofa and the Space Monitor妥善装饰302号公寓后，Mara将成为住户。Mara会为卡比（Kirby）提供一款名为“Mara's Race”的小游戏。在与Mara对话时，她会向卡比（Kirby）提出请求，让其在玩家已经完成的各个关卡中进行竞速。在这个小游戏中，卡比（Kirby）必须在整个关卡中朝目标泡泡跑去，并在Mara之前拉动绳子。玩家第一次比赛对抗Mara时，她在比赛过程中也会定期停下来喘口气，卡比（Kirby）和Fluff可以使用他们的Yarn Whip来减慢Mara的速度。每次玩家与Mara比赛时，她会在没有这些缺点的情况下匹配他们的最好时间。此外，玩家在被击中后重新站起来之前将有额外的3秒停顿时间。完成小游戏每个请求的奖励是Fabric。完成一个请求后，如果玩家已经清除了请求中展示的关卡，将会有另一个请求可用。总共有30个请求。

[[File:KEY Fabric Mara.png|thumb|一个以Mara为主要设计的Fabric。]]在通过游戏，有机会Mara会来拜访Kirby's Pad。在完成Mara的所有请求后，在公寓里迎接Mara将会赠送带有Mara作为主要设计元素的面料。

Mara的公寓使用紫色绗缝面料作为墙纸，使用粉红色菱形面料作为地板。
wikirby-page:4762.description_en:
“She loves racing and fashion. See if you can pass her when she's catching her breath!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Mara is a light purple rabbit-like creature that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. After 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） properly decorate Apartment 302 with the Clef Tree, the Jellyfish Light, the Knit-Cap Sofa and the Space Monitor, Mara will become a tenant. Mara will provide 卡比（Kirby） with a minigame named "Mara's Race". Upon talking with Mara, she will provide 卡比（Kirby） with requests to play race across various stages the player has already completed. In this minigame, 卡比（Kirby） must race towards the goal popper throughout a stage and pull the string before Mara does. The first time the player races against Mara, she will periodically stop and take a breath, as well, throughout the race, 卡比（Kirby） and Fluff can use their Yarn Whips to slow Mara down. Every following time the player races Mara, she will match their best time without these drawbacks. Additionally, the player will have an extra 3 seconds of downtime after being hit before getting back up. The reward for completing each request of the minigame is Fabric. After completing a request, another one will become available if the player has already cleared the stage featured in the request. There are 30 requests in all.

[[File:KEY Fabric Mara.png|thumb|A Fabric featuring Mara as the main design.]] After playing stages through the game, there is a chance Mara will come over to visit Kirby's Pad. After completing all of Mara's requests, greeting Mara in the apartment will result in a gifted fabric with Mara as the primary design element.

Mara's apartment utilizes the Purple Quilted fabric for the wallpaper, and the Pink Argyle fabric for the floor.

wikirby-page:3753.description_zh:
“谢谢你救了我！那是什么？你说你来自另一个世界？！哇！欢迎来到Patch Land！你跟着我，我会教你一切！”
— 毛毛（Prince Fluff）在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）
毛毛（Prince Fluff）（有时简称为Fluff）是Patch Land的王子，也是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的次要主角。当棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）将Patch Land分成七个不同部分时，毛毛（Prince Fluff）与卡比（Kirby）一起旅行，收集Magic Yarn的线索并将土地重新缝合。在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）中，毛毛（Prince Fluff）作为第二玩家角色，与卡比（Kirby）拥有相同的能力。在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，毛毛（Prince Fluff）则被降至非玩家的辅助角色，并通过寻找珠子来帮助卡比（Kirby）。分阶段为他准备其他物品.
wikirby-page:3753.description_en:
“Thanks for saving me! What's that? You say you're from another world?! Wow! Welcome to Patch Land! You just stick with me, and I'll show you the ropes!”
— 毛毛（Prince Fluff） in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）
毛毛（Prince Fluff） (sometimes shortened to just Fluff) is the prince of Patch Land and the secondary main character in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） splits Patch Land into seven distinct parts, 毛毛（Prince Fluff） travels with 卡比（Kirby） to collect strands of the Magic Yarn and stitch the land back together. In 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）, 毛毛（Prince Fluff） serves as the second player character and has the same abilities as 卡比（Kirby）. In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, 毛毛（Prince Fluff） is instead relegated to a non-playable supporting role, and helps 卡比（Kirby） by finding beads and other items for him in stages.

wikirby-page:3940.description_zh:
“他喜欢玩捉迷藏！试着找到他和他的朋友们！”
— 摘自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的引用。
Zeke是一种类猴子的生物，出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。在卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）用the Flower Sofa and the Flower Clock适当装饰102号公寓后，Zeke将成为住户。Zeke会为卡比（Kirby）提供一个名为“Zeke's Hide-and-Seek”的小游戏。与Zeke交谈时，他将向卡比（Kirby）提供在玩家已经完成的各个关卡中玩捉迷藏的请求。在这个小游戏中，Zeke和他的朋友们（其他与Zeke外形相同的生物）会分开，卡比（Kirby）必须在指定时间内在关卡中找到他们。时间。完成小游戏中每个请求的奖励是Fabric。完成一个请求后，如果玩家已经清除了该请求所涉及的关卡，将会出现另一个请求。总共有18个请求。

[[File:KEY Fabric Zeke.png|thumb|一块以Zeke为主要设计的Fabric。]]在游戏中完成关卡后，有机会Zeke会来拜访Kirby's Pad。在完成Zeke的所有请求后，在公寓里与Zeke打招呼，将会获得一块以Zeke为主要设计元素的赠送布料。

Zeke的公寓使用绿色菱形布料作为墙纸，棕色棉布料作为地板。
wikirby-page:3940.description_en:
“He loves to play hide-and-seek! Try to find him and his friends!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Zeke is a monkey-like creature that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. After 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） properly decorate Apartment 102 with the Flower Sofa and the Flower Clock, Zeke will become a tenant. Zeke will provide 卡比（Kirby） with a minigame named "Zeke's Hide-and-Seek". Upon talking with Zeke, he will provide 卡比（Kirby） with requests to play hide-and-seek across various stages the player has already completed. In this minigame, Zeke and his friends (other identical looking beings to Zeke) will split up, and 卡比（Kirby） must find them throughout the stage in a designated amount of time. The reward for completing each request of the minigame is Fabric. After completing a request, another one will become available if the player has already cleared the stage featured in the request. There are 18 requests in all.

[[File:KEY Fabric Zeke.png|thumb|A Fabric featuring Zeke as the main design.]] After playing stages through the game, there is a chance Zeke will come over to visit Kirby's Pad. After completing all of Zeke's requests, greeting Zeke in the apartment will result in a gifted fabric with Zeke as the primary design element.

Zeke's apartment utilizes the Green Argyle fabric for the wallpaper, and the Brown Cotton fabric for the floor.

wikirby-page:4360.description_zh:
“这种生物生活在深海中。如果你看到它，不要惊讶！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Amprey是一种无敌的鳗鱼状生物，出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）及其重制版中。它是一个相对较大的敌人，身体为紫色，眼睛像黄色按钮，鳍为绿色。Amprey的身体还会因为电流闪烁明亮的绿色和紫色。Amprey的尾部附有一排三个大珠子，卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）可以在不受伤的情况下收集这些珠子。然而，如果它们与Amprey的其他部分碰撞，就会失去一些珠子。只在Deep-Dive Deep中Water Land遇到，这条长长的紫色鱼会围绕地形的特定部分游动。
wikirby-page:4360.description_en:
“This creature lives deep in the ocean. Don't be shocked if you see it!”
— Patch Plaza description
Amprey is an invincible eel-like creature that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and its remake. It is a relatively large enemy with a purple body, yellow button eyes and green fins. Amprey's body also flashes bright green and purple due to its electricity. Attached to an Amprey's tail is a line of three large beads which 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） can collect without taking damage. However, if they collide with the rest of the Amprey, they will lose some of their beads. Encountered exclusively in Deep-Dive Deep in Water Land, this long purple fish swims circles around set features of the landscape.

wikirby-page:14527.description_zh:
“这个家伙一直在笑，因为他只需要等待食物送到他面前。”
— Patch Plaza
Anemonee是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型海葵敌人。他固定在水下的位置，触手伸展到主体之上，形成一个很大的障碍。如果卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）接触到Anemonee的触手，他们会暂时被缠住和困住。如果未能逃脱，他们会受到伤害，但如果逃脱成功，Anemonee的触手将暂时失效。Anemonee不能使用Yarn Whip捕捉，但可以使用毛线球或使用Dolphin Metamortex的冲击攻击击败。
wikirby-page:14527.description_en:
“This guy smiles all the time, because he only has to wait for food to come his way.”
— Patch Plaza
Anemonee is a large sea anemone enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He sits in place underwater, stretching his tentacles far above his main body, serving as a rather large obstacle. If 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） touch Anemonee's tentacles, they will become tangled up and trapped for a moment. If they fail to escape, they will take damage, but if they do escape, Anemonee's tentacles will be rendered useless for a while. Anemonee cannot be captured using the Yarn Whip, but he can be defeated using a yarn ball or by using the Dolphin Metamortex's surge attack.

wikirby-page:14345.description_zh:
“这种蝙蝠在你靠近时会攻击。他是一个沉默的猎手。”
— Patch Plaza
Battins是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的紫色蝙蝠类敌人。他可以在洞穴的天花板上休息，如果卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）接近或从他身边走过，他就会醒来。一旦醒来，Battins会俯冲下来，然后张开獠牙向前冲刺，这可能会伤害他的目标。如果用Yarn Whip捕获，Battins投掷时会分裂成三个追踪弹，就像Buttonbee一样。
wikirby-page:14345.description_en:
“This bat strikes when you get close. He's a silent hunter.”
— Patch Plaza
Battins is a purple bat-like enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He can be found resting on ceilings in caves and will stir if 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） approaches or walks past him. Once awake, Battins will swoop down, then dive forward with his fangs out, which can hurt his target. If captured with the Yarn Whip, Battins will split into three homing projectiles when thrown, much like Buttonbee.

wikirby-page:14516.description_zh:
“我希望这个家伙游泳技术好，以防那根尖刺刺到他的戒指。”
— Patch Plaza
Bobber Clod是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的水生敌人。他本质上是一个带着游泳圈的Uniclod，可以在水面上游泳，也可以在陆地上行走。当卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）靠近时，他会进行追击，并且自然会成为跳跃的危险目标，但可以很容易用Yarn Whip俘获或以其他方式击败。被捕获后，他会像普通独角兽一样变形成箭矢投射物。
wikirby-page:14516.description_en:
“I hope this guy is a good swimmer, in case that spike pops his ring.”
— Patch Plaza
Bobber Clod is a water-dwelling enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is essentially a Uniclod with an inner tube that can swim across the surface of water as well as walk on land. He will pursue 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） when they get close, and is naturally a danger to jump on, but can easily be captured with the Yarn Whip or otherwise defeated. When captured, he will transform into an arrow projectile like normal Uniclods would.

wikirby-page:14809.description_zh:
“这个奇怪的家伙如果你正好跳在它的头上，会给你一个很大的弹力！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Boinger是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的一个云状弹簧型敌人。它可以在Cloud Palace中找到，在那里它沿着弧形轨迹出现在游戏场地内外，同时还有许多相同的同类。Boinger不会伤害卡比（Kirby）；实际上，它通过提供前进的方式来帮助他。当卡比（Kirby）跳到Boinger的头上时，他会像蹦床一样被向上弹起。使用Weight变形可以让卡比（Kirby）在从Boinger的头上弹起时获得更高的高度。同样，Boinger也无法被伤害，因此它基本上可以被视为一个小小的移动弹簧平台。
wikirby-page:14809.description_en:
“This weirdo will give you quite a lift if you jump on its head just right!”
— Patch Plaza description
Boinger is a cloudy spring-shaped enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It can be found in Cloud Palace, where it floats on an arc-shaped trajectory in and out of the playing field along with numerous others of its kind. Boinger does not hurt 卡比（Kirby）; in fact, it helps him by giving him a way forward. When 卡比（Kirby） jumps on Boinger's head, he is propelled upward in a similar way to a trampoline. Using the Weight transformation allows 卡比（Kirby） to gain higher distance when bouncing from Boinger's head. Boinger likewise cannot be harmed, so it can be essentially seen as little more than a moving spring platform.

wikirby-page:4361.description_zh:
“黄色表示小心。当心那个尾刺！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Buttonbees是像昆虫一样的敌人，它们出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）及其Nintendo 3DS版本Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。它们看起来像一个黄色的按钮，有两条黑色条纹，小触角，一对翅膀和一个银色尾刺。
