 Buttonbees通常沿预定路径飞行，例如一个大循环或直线前进，不过如果卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）接近，它们有时会尝试蜇人。把它们卷起来会产生一个分裂的追踪线球，这个线球会分裂成三个副本，飞向附近的敌人。

在最终首领战中，棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）会召唤一组四个Buttonbees以及四个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。Buttonbees还会出现在在Buster的迷你游戏中，目标是在短时间内消灭多个敌人。
wikirby-page:4361.description_en:
“Yellow means CAUTION. Watch out for that stinger!”
— Patch Plaza description
Buttonbees are insect-like enemies that appear in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and its Nintendo 3DS port, Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They appear as a yellow button with two black stripes, small antennae, a pair of wings, and a silver stinger.

Buttonbees typically fly in a predetermined route, such as a large loop or straight forward, though some will attempt to sting 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） if they approach. Rolling one up yields a splitting homing yarn ball, which will split into three copies that will fly into nearby enemies.

During the final boss battle, 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） summons a group of four Buttonbees along with four 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. Buttonbees are additionally seen in Buster's mini-games, where the objective is to eliminate several enemies in a short period of time.

wikirby-page:14536.description_zh:
“红色表示危险。这种虫子会追着你，所以要小心！”
— Patch Plaza
Buttonbugs是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的飞行类蜜蜂敌人。它们与Buttonbee类似，但为红色，并会主动追击目标。如果Buttonbugs撞到墙壁，它们会短时间眩晕。尽管它们更具攻击性，但Buttonbugs可以使用任何普通招式击败。被卷成纱球后，Buttonbug可以作为一个回homing投射物，投掷时会分裂成三个。
wikirby-page:14536.description_en:
“Red means DANGER. This bug will chase you down, so be careful!”
— Patch Plaza
Buttonbugs are flying bee-like enemies from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They are similar to Buttonbees, but are red and will actively chase their target. If Buttonbugs hit a wall, they will be stunned for a short time. Despite their more aggressive nature, Buttonbugs can be defeated using any normal move. When wrapped up into a Yarn ball, Buttonbug can be used as a homing projectile that splits into three when thrown.

wikirby-page:4670.description_zh:
“绿色表示前进，但在这个家伙周围你仍然需要小心！”
— Cast引用自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
按钮飞虫是类昆虫的敌人，首次出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Flower Fields关卡中。它们看起来像一个绿色按钮，黑色线条作眼睛，有一对短翅膀和触角。

按钮飞虫以圆形动作原地飞行。与Buttonbee和Buttonbug不同，它们无法伤害卡比（Kirby），只能在接触时轻微碰撞他。

它们可以被卡比（Kirby）的任何攻击击败；使用毛线鞭或他的变身。把它滚起来会生成一个单一的追踪毛线球，它会飞向被投掷的敌人。

[[文件:KEY Fabric Buttonfly.png|缩略图|100像素|一款以Buttonfly为主要设计的Fabric。]] Buttonfly作为Buttonfly Fabric的主要设计，在完成Buster的第4个Buster's Training任务后获得。
wikirby-page:4670.description_en:
“Green means GO, but you still want to be careful around this guy!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Buttonflies are insect-like enemies that first appear in the stage Flower Fields in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They appear as a green button with black threads as eyes, a pair of short wings and antennae.

Buttonflies fly in place in a circular motion. Unlike Buttonbees and Buttonbugs, they cannot damage 卡比（Kirby）, only being able to slightly bump him on contact.

They can be defeated using any of 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks; the yarn whip or his transformations. Rolling one up yields a singular homing yarn ball, which will fly into an enemy it is thrown at.

[[File:KEY Fabric Buttonfly.png|thumb|100px|A Fabric featuring Buttonfly as the primary design.]] The Buttonfly is featured as the primary design of the Buttonfly Fabric, obtained after completing Buster's 4th request of Buster's Training.

wikirby-page:14328.description_zh:
“这个愤怒的小家伙不断喷发。小心熔岩灼伤！”
— Patch Plaza
Calderon是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的火山类敌人。它可以在熔岩湖中漂浮，不断从头顶喷出火焰。它会定期喷发，并将两块熔融岩石高高抛向空中，可以使用Yarn Whip捕捉。触碰Calderon的头顶或熔融岩石会伤害卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）。Calderon对Yarn Whip和Weight技能免疫，但可以通过向它投掷毛线球或使用Ravel Ability来击败。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Calderon可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 2中找到。在这里，它保持正常状态喷射熔岩的功能，魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）必须小心躲避。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）能够用他的剑劈开卡尔德龙，或者用他的Special击败它们，而做任何一件事都能为他赢得珠子。
wikirby-page:14328.description_en:
“This angry little guy erupts constantly. Watch out for lava burns!”
— Patch Plaza
Calderon is a volcano-like enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It can be found floating in lava lakes and constantly spews fire out the top of its head. It periodically erupts and spews two molten rocks high into the air, which can be captured using the Yarn Whip. Touching the top of Calderon's head or the molten rocks will hurt 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff）. Calderon is immune to the Yarn Whip and to the Weight move, but it can be defeated by tossing a yarn ball at it or by using a Ravel Ability.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Calderon can be found in Stage 2 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. Here, it retains its normal function of spewing molten rocks which 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） must carefully dodge. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） is able to slash through Calderons with his sword or defeat them with his Special, and doing either will net him beads.

wikirby-page:14182.description_zh:
“这个暴躁的家伙非常具有领地意识，所以不要靠得太近！”
— Patch Plaza
Candlemander是一种类蜥蜴红色敌人，在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的某些关卡中沿墙爬行。它有一只眼睛，从中发出火焰。它来回巡逻，如果受到威胁，它会变成火球追逐卡比（Kirby）短时间，然后回到初始位置。在它处于默认状态时可以使用Yarn Whip抓住它，但在变成火球时无法直接攻击。不过，无论其状态如何，仍然可以被落下的方块压碎。

Candlemander的外观基于对火与蜥蜴的文化关联；人们一直认为蜥蜴与火有关。早在古希腊时期就被认为代表火。这种信念在日本民间传说中也存在，「火蜥蜴」（"fire lizard"）是火螈的另一种名称。Acchi也可能基于这一概念。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Candlemander可以在Sub-Game的Slash & Bead中找到。它的行为与主游戏中完全一样，尽管在这里魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以自由地用剑劈它。
wikirby-page:14182.description_en:
“This hothead is very territorial, so don't get too close!”
— Patch Plaza
Candlemander is a red salamander-like enemy which crawls along the wall in certain stages of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It has a single eye from which a flame emanates. It patrols back and forth, and if threatened, it will turn into a fireball and pursue 卡比（Kirby） for a short time, then return to its initial position. It can be grabbed using the Yarn Whip when it is in its default state, but cannot be attacked directly while transformed into a fireball. It can however, still be crushed by a falling block regardless of its state.

Candlemander's appearance is based on the cultural association between salamanders and fire; salamanders have been thought to represent fire as far back as ancient Greece. This belief is also present in Japanese folklore, with「火蜥蜴」("fire lizard") being an alternate name for the fire salamander. Acchi may also be based upon this concept.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Candlemander can be found in the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. It behaves exactly as it does in the main game, although here 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） is freely able to slash it with his sword.

wikirby-page:14597.description_zh:
“这个家伙可以在水中自由移动并快速攻击！小心！”
— Patch Plaza
Cutfish是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的带刺鱼类敌人。它大致呈青柠绿色药丸形状，有一个按钮般的眼睛、一条细长的鞭状尾巴，以及沿身体周围的尖刺。Cutfish会尝试在Dolphin Metamortex区域追击卡比（Kirby），并在接触时造成伤害。当卡比（Kirby）处于这种Dolphin形态时，可以使用冲击攻击击败Cutfish。在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Sub-Game Slash & Bead中存在一个更大的变种。当魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）攻击时，它会不断分裂成更小的自身，直到最终被击败。
wikirby-page:14597.description_en:
“This guy moves freely through the water and attacks quickly! Watch out!”
— Patch Plaza
Cutfish is a spiky fish enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It takes the general shape of a lime green pill with a single button eye, a thin flagellum-like tail and spikes all along the circumference of its body. Cutfish will attempt to chase 卡比（Kirby） down in Dolphin Metamortex sections and will damage him on contact. When in this Dolphin form, 卡比（Kirby） can defeat Cutfish using the surge attack. A larger variation exists in the Sub-Game Slash & Bead in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） attacks, it continuously splits into smaller versions of itself until it is finally defeated.

wikirby-page:4668.description_zh:
“他会用全力攻击你！这不会造成伤害，但你可能会被飞出去！”
— Cast来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的描述。
独眼巨人是出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的敌人。它们与Uniclod非常相似，具有相同的身体风格、攻击方式和第一阶段外观（Flower Fields）；然而，它们之间的一个关键区别是独角兽（Uniclods）有角，而独眼巨人没有。因此独眼巨人是无伤害的敌人。然而，当卡比（Kirby）被Cyclod的攻击击中时，他仍然会被击退；类似于瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的攻击，但更强大。独眼巨人是由棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）创造的，用来帮助他接管Patch Land。它们有时也可以看到驾驶trucks.

Cyclods可以通过多种不同的方式被击败；使用卡比（Kirby）的纱线鞭，或者使用卡比（Kirby）的许多不同形式之一。

它的名字是“Cyclops”和“clod”（傻瓜）的双关；此外，“clod”是“klodde”（荷兰语中的“破布”）的同源词，呼应了游戏中的纱线和布料主题。
wikirby-page:4668.description_en:
“He'll tackle you with all he's got! It won't hurt, but you may go flying!”
— Cast description from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Cyclods are enemies that appear in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They are very similar to Uniclods, having the same body style, attack style and first stage appearance (Flower Fields); however a key difference between them is that Uniclods have horns, whilst Cyclods do not. Therefore Cyclods are non-damaging enemies. However, when 卡比（Kirby） is hit by a Cyclod's attack, he is still knocked backwards; similar to the attack of a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, but more powerful. Cyclods were created by 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） to help him take over Patch Land. They can also sometimes be seen driving trucks.

Cyclods can be defeated in many different ways; with 卡比（Kirby）'s yarn whip, or with many of 卡比（Kirby）'s numerous different forms.

Its name is a play on "Cyclops" and "clod" (a stupid person); also, "clod" is a cognate of "klodde" ("rag" in Dutch), reflecting to the yarn and fabric theme of the game.

wikirby-page:14175.description_zh:
“这个大师会发射能量球。靠近他以将其击倒！”
— Patch Plaza
Dandan是一种鸭子状的战斗类型敌人，出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，并且首次出现在Big-Bean Vine。他会固定在原地，并试图向接近的卡比（Kirby）发射蓝色能量波。被这个能量波击中会伤害卡比（Kirby），但也可以用Yarn Whip捕捉并反击向Dandan。Dandan本身也可以直接被卷起。他还可以被看到驾驶卡车。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Dandan可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 3中找到。在这里，他保持正常功能，发射能量波，魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）必须躲避。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以通过用剑劈他或在他出现在屏幕上时使用Special打败Dandan.
wikirby-page:14175.description_en:
“This master shoots out balls of energy. Get up close to take him out!”
— Patch Plaza
Dandan is a duck-like, fighter-type enemy which appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, and can be first seen in Big-Bean Vine. He sits in place and will attempt to fire a blue energy blast at 卡比（Kirby） when he approaches. Getting hit by this energy blast will harm 卡比（Kirby）, but it can also be captured using the Yarn Whip and tossed back at Dandan. Dandan himself can also be rolled up directly. He also can be seen driving trucks.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Dandan can be found in Stage 3 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. Here, he retains his normal function of firing energy blasts which 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） must dodge. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can defeat Dandan by slashing him with a sword or by using the Special while he is onscreen.

wikirby-page:14559.description_zh:
“Dweller of the deep，这个怪物用他的光来分散猎物的注意力！”
— Patch Plaza
Danglerfish是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型琵琶鱼敌人。他会在水下隧道里静静等待卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）靠近，然后试图吸入它们。如果Danglerfish捕捉到其中一个，他会咀嚼片刻，然后将其吐出以造成伤害。如果卡比（Kirby）或Fluff设法逃脱了他的吸力，他将停止并需要喘息，使自己变得容易受到攻击。然后可以通过使用Yarn Whip拖拉他的光杆来击败Danglerfish。

它的名字是“捕鱼者”和“悬挂”的双关语，可能是指琵琶鱼前方悬挂的生物发光体鱼用它来引诱猎物。
wikirby-page:14559.description_en:
“Dweller of the deep, this monster uses his light to distract his prey!”
— Patch Plaza
Danglerfish is a large anglerfish enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He sits and waits in underwater tunnels for 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） to draw near, then he will try to inhale them. If Danglerfish catches one of them, he will chew on them for a moment, then spit them out to deal damage. If 卡比（Kirby） or Fluff manage to escape his suction, he will stop and have to catch his breath, becoming vulnerable to attack. Danglerfish can then be defeated by pulling on his light rod using the Yarn Whip.

Its name is a pun on "anglerfish" and "dangle", possibly referring to the bioluminescent light of an anglerfish which dangles in front of the fish to lure in its prey.

wikirby-page:4345.description_zh:
“这些人在派对上总是孤身一人。他们真是聚会杀手！”
— Cast引用自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Dropso是一种蓝色固定的斑点敌人，出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。它首次出现在Patch Castle中，之后又在Cool Cave中重新出现。Dropsos不会移动或攻击，使卡比（Kirby）可以轻松将它们变成毛线球。当用毛线球形式的Dropso破坏方块或敌人时，会听到溅射声效果。这些敌人会不断从滴水的源头生成；即使摧毁了一个Dropso，片刻后在同一位置又会出现另一个。
wikirby-page:4345.description_en:
“These guys are always by themselves at parties. They're real ceiling drips!”
— Cast quote from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Dropso is a blue stationary blob enemy that appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It is first seen in Patch Castle and later reappears in Cool Cave. Dropsos do not move or attack, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to easily turn them into yarn balls. When destroying a block or enemy with a Dropso in yarn ball form, a splash sound effect is heard. These enemies spawn continuously from sources of dripping water; even after destroying a Dropso, another will appear moments later in the same location.

wikirby-page:14334.description_zh:
“这个家伙喜欢他那燃烧的生活方式，绝对讨厌水。”
— Patch Plaza
Emba是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的一个有生命的火球。他漂浮在空中，如果卡比（Kirby）或Fluff靠近，他会尝试接近他们，接触时会造成伤害。Emba可以被Fire Engine Metamortex扑灭并击败。然而，如果没有完全扑灭，他会慢慢恢复到原来的大小。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Emba可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 2中找到。在这里，魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以用他的剑劈砍它，或者使用他的Special击败它。
wikirby-page:14334.description_en:
“This guy loves his burning lifestyle and definitely hates water.”
— Patch Plaza
Emba is an animate ball of fire from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He floats about and will attempt to approach 卡比（Kirby） or Fluff if they get near, damaging them on contact. Emba can be doused and defeated using the Fire Engine Metamortex. If not fully doused, however, he will slowly return to his original size.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Emba can be found in Stage 2 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. Here, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can defeat it by slashing it with his sword or by using his Special.

wikirby-page:14376.description_zh:
“有人说在这条燃烧的蛇的身体里藏着珠子！你能相信吗？！”
— Patch Plaza
Embaconda是一条由火焰组成的飞蛇，来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。Embaconda通常可以看到在空中盘旋飞行，经常穿过格栅。像它更简单的Emba表亲一样，它对卡比（Kirby）和Fluff构成持续的接触危险，也可以使用Fire Engine Metamortex来击败。当用水喷射时，它的各个段将被逐一摧毁，同时掉落其中的物品。进一步喷射会彻底摧毁这个生物，可能会掉落一些Treasure。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Embaconda可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 2中找到。它主要出现在敌人埋伏的部分出现，它从屏幕外飞向魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以用他的剑劈它，或者使用他的Special。
wikirby-page:14376.description_en:
“Some say there are beads hidden in this snake's burning body! Can you believe it?!”
— Patch Plaza
Embaconda is a flying snake made of fire from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. Embaconda can typically be seen flying in circles, often through grates. Like its simpler Emba cousins, it poses a constant touching hazard to 卡比（Kirby） and Fluff, and can also be defeated using the Fire Engine Metamortex. When sprayed with water, its segments will be destroyed one-by-one, dropping whatever items were inside in the process. Further spraying will fully destroy the creature, which may yield some Treasures.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Embaconda can be found in Stage 2 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. It appears primarily during enemy ambush sections where it flies from offscreen around 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can defeat it by slashing it with his sword or by using his Special.

wikirby-page:14374.description_zh:
“这些是Hot Wings的孩子。他们会像他们的妈妈一样追你！”
— Patch Plaza
Embird是一种小型火焰鸟敌人，只会出现在Hot Wings战斗中，在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中均可见到。Embirds是这个特定Boss的孩子，会在战斗的不同阶段由它的母亲召唤，沿直线飞行，如果与卡比（Kirby）接触会造成伤害。Embird可以被Yarn Whip抓住并扔回给它的母亲以对她造成伤害。否则，Embird可以通过用另一个毛线球或Ravel Ability攻击来击败。

它们的名字是“ember”和“bird”两个词的合成词。
wikirby-page:14374.description_en:
“These are Hot Wings's kids. They'll come after you just like their mom!”
— Patch Plaza
Embird is a small fiery bird enemy which appears exclusively in the Hot Wings battle in both 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. Embirds are the children of this particular boss, and are conjured by their mother at various points during the fight, flying in a straight line and hurting 卡比（Kirby） if they make contact with him. Embird can be grabbed with the Yarn Whip and thrown back at its mother to deal her damage. Otherwise, Embird can be defeated by attacking it with another yarn ball or a Ravel Ability.

Their name is a portmanteau of the words "ember" and "bird".

wikirby-page:14672.description_zh:
“Freezo可能看起来很节日，但如果你碰到他，那就是冰块派对！”
— Patch Plaza
Freezo是黑大炮（Shotzo）的一种蓝色冰冷变体，戴着节日帽子并发射雪球。他出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，但仅出现在Evergreen Lift中。除了他射出的雪球，卡比（Kirby）如果碰到这个蓝色炮台也会被冻住。然而，这些都不会真正伤害卡比（Kirby），只会减慢他的速度。Freezo无法被Yarn Whip打败，但可以使用Weight或丢毛线球将其打败。他也可以使用Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的解线能力被打败。
wikirby-page:14672.description_en:
“Freezo may look festive, but it's an ice-cube party if you touch him!”
— Patch Plaza
Freezo is a blue icy variant of 黑大炮（Shotzo） which wears a festive hat and fires snowballs. He appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, only appearing in Evergreen Lift. In addition to the snowballs he shoots, 卡比（Kirby） will be frozen solid if he touches this blue cannon. Neither of these will actually hurt 卡比（Kirby）, however, instead just slowing him down. Freezo cannot be defeated by the Yarn Whip, but he can be defeated using the Weight or by having a Yarn ball tossed at him. He can also be defeated using the ravel abilities in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.

wikirby-page:40351.description_zh:
“他的咬伤很危险，但闭着嘴时他几乎无能为力！”
— Patch Plaza
Gator是一个固定的敌人和危险物体，只出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）及其港口Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。他休息在地面上，定期张开和闭合嘴巴。如果卡比（Kirby）落在张开的嘴上，他会受到伤害。然而，如果他在嘴闭合时落下，它可以用作平台帮助他跳得更高。鳄鱼可以使用卡比（Kirby）的纱线鞭或其他攻击方式击败。
wikirby-page:40351.description_en:
“His bite is dangerous, but he can't do much with a closed mouth!”
— Patch Plaza
Gator is a stationary enemy and hazard which only appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and its port Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He rests in the ground, opening and closing his mouth on a regular interval. If 卡比（Kirby） lands on an open mouth, he is damaged. However if he lands on a mouth while it is closed, it can be used as a platform to help him jump higher. Gators can be defeated using 卡比（Kirby）'s yarn whip or other attacks.

wikirby-page:48886.description_zh:
Halberd cannon是一个大型黑色固定火炮障碍物，只出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn主游戏的Battleship Halberd关卡中，以及Slash & Bead的Stage 4中。它的作用类似于黑大炮（Shotzo），在瞄准目标后保持位置，发射缓慢但大的按钮弹幕，如果碰撞可能会导致珠子损失。火炮弹和火炮本身都可以通过持续攻击被摧毁，后者可获得一些珠子。尤其是战舰Halberd关卡中的一个大型火炮，被摧毁时会掉落Galaxia Furniture组件。

 Halberd cannon有几种不同的大小，尽管它们都明显更大比卡比（Kirby）或魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）大。这种尺寸差异也影响它发射的炮弹大小，但不会改变它的耐久度或掉落的珠子数量。
wikirby-page:48886.description_en:
Halberd cannon is a large black stationary cannon obstacle that appears exclusively in the Battleship Halberd stage in the main game of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, as well as in Stage 4 of Slash & Bead. It acts similarly to 黑大炮（Shotzo）, holding position while it aims its cannon at its target to fire a slow-moving but large button volley which can cause a loss of beads if collided with. Both the cannonballs and the cannon itself can be destroyed with sustained attacks, yielding a few beads in the latter case. One large cannon from the Battleship Halberd stage in particular yields the Galaxia Furniture piece when destroyed.

The Halberd cannon comes in a few different sizes, though all of them are significantly larger than 卡比（Kirby） or 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. This size differential also affects the size of the cannonballs it fires, but does not change its durability or the number of beads it yields.

wikirby-page:14529.description_zh:
“这种果冻漂浮周围，用1万伏特电击遇到的一切！”
— Patch Plaza
Jelly Jr.是一种来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的小型刺胞动物敌人。它可以在几个水下场景中找到，懒洋洋地漂浮，偶尔会释放出电流。它放电时接触非常危险，即使使用Yarn Whip，但在其他情况下可以轻松击败。
wikirby-page:14529.description_en:
“This jelly floats around, shocking anything in its way with 10,000 volts!”
— Patch Plaza
Jelly Jr. is a small cnidarian enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It can be found in several underwater scenarios and floats lazily about, occasionally flaring up with an electric surge. It is dangerous to touch while it is discharging, even if using the Yarn Whip, but can otherwise be defeated easily.

wikirby-page:24369.description_zh:
“但是当他们被一个巨大的三眼纱线团攻击时，Fluff被打断了！”
— 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）的过场动画旁白Lickeur
Lickeur是一个由纱线组成的大型紫色团状生物，只在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的过场动画中出现。它是一个相当大的紫色团状怪物，有三只眼睛，背上有黄色斑点，没有四肢。它通过用舌头舔目标攻击（因此得名），尽管这似乎并不会真正伤害目标。毛毛（Prince Fluff）在首次完成Patch Castle后播放的过场动画中被这样攻击。Lickeur被卡比（Kirby）击败，后者使用Weight变身将该团状物压碎。然后它放弃了第一块Magic Yarn，两位无畏的英雄用它来进入Grass Land。

Lickeur的名字直到Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn才为人所知，在那里它的形象作为可收集的Fuse Bead Mat之一出现。
wikirby-page:24369.description_en:
“But Fluff was interrupted when they were attacked by a huge, three-eyed blob of yarn!”
— Cutscene narration of Lickeur from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）
Lickeur is a large purple blob creature made of yarn which appears only in a cutscene in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It is a rather large purple blob monster with three eyes, yellow spots along its back, and no limbs. It attacks by lapping up its target with its tongue (hence the name), though this does not seem to actually hurt the target. 毛毛（Prince Fluff） is attacked in this way in the cutscene that plays after completing Patch Castle for the first time. Lickeur is defeated by 卡比（Kirby） who uses the Weight transformation to crush the blob. It then relinquishes the first piece of Magic Yarn, which the two intrepid heroes use to gain access to Grass Land.

Lickeur's name was not known until Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, where its likeness appears as one of the collectable Fuse Bead Mats.

wikirby-page:14332.description_zh:
“这些家伙生活在熔岩中。如果你踩到它们，它们会下沉。小心！”
— Patch Plaza
Magmotamus是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型熔岩生物敌人。它在某种程度上类似于Galbo，尽管它不会喷火，也不会以任何直接方式攻击。相反，它会漂浮在熔岩中，如果卡比（Kirby）站在它的头上，它会下沉，充当下沉的平台。Magmotamus对Yarn Whip免疫，但它可以被Weight伤害（尽管由于下面的熔岩，这很危险）、两个毛线球或者Ravel能力伤害。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Magmotamus可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 2中找到。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以通过用剑劈它或者使用Special来击败它。
wikirby-page:14332.description_en:
“These guys live in magma. They sink if you step on them. Careful!”
— Patch Plaza
Magmotamus is a large magma-residing enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It somewhat resembles a Galbo, though it does not breathe fire or attack in any direct way. Instead, it floats in magma and will sink if 卡比（Kirby） stands on its head, acting as a sinking platform. Magmotamus is immune to the Yarn Whip, but it can be harmed by the Weight (though this is risky due to the lava below), two Yarn Balls, or a Ravel Ability.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Magmotamus can be found in Stage 2 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can defeat it either by slashing it with his sword or by using his Special.

wikirby-page:14576.description_zh: 水手是在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中出现的五种不同类型的敌人，他们使用多种武器。他们只会出现在Water Land关卡Boom Boatyard，并且与Soldiers非常相似。
wikirby-page:14576.description_en: The Mariners are five different types of enemies in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn that wield several weapons. They all appear only in the Water Land stage Boom Boatyard and are very similar to Soldiers.

wikirby-page:6817.description_zh:
“这些是Capamari的古怪孩子们。他们会同时发动攻击。”
— Patch Plaza
章鱼豌豆是小型红色章鱼状敌人，拥有大圆头和细小触手，它们是Capamari的孩子，会在战斗的第二阶段出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，以保护他们的父母。每次会出现八个——每个角落两个——然后两两形成阵型，接着向上或向下冲锋，如果接触到卡比（Kirby）会造成伤害。Octopea可以在其上场的任何时刻使用Yarn Whip抓住，并可以投掷回Capamari，从而击晕boss并使其容易受到攻击。
wikirby-page:6817.description_en:
“These are Capamari's wacky kids. They all attack at once.”
— Patch Plaza
Octopeas are small red octopus-like enemies with big round heads and tiny tentacles which are Capamari's children and appear in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn during the second phase of the fight to defend their parent. Eight will appear at a time—two from each nook—who will then form into positions in pairs, then dash either upward or downward, hurting 卡比（Kirby） if they make contact. Octopea can be grabbed using the Yarn Whip at any point while it is on stage, and can be thrown back at Capamari to stun the boss and leave it vulnerable to attack.

wikirby-page:3736.description_zh:
“这只调皮的猴子喜欢到处扔珠子，简直疯狂！”
— Cast描述来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Ookis是棕色的类猴毛线敌人，它们只出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn，是游戏中最早出现的一些敌人。它们首次出现的关卡是Fountain Gardens。Ookis会挂在树枝或平台上，无法直接伤害卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）。在关卡的主要游戏过程中遇到的Ookis会向卡比（Kirby）扔珠子，如果击中他，这些珠子会被自动收集，使这些Ookis无害。在Whispy's Forest的Tankbot Metamortex部分，可以找到更多Ookis，它们会改扔苹果。这些苹果会对卡比（Kirby）造成伤害，所以他应该小心。

过了一会儿扔珠子，Ookis会停止，可能是因为他们扔完了珠子。之后，他们只是挂在树枝上，直到卡比（Kirby）击败他们。
wikirby-page:3736.description_en:
“This cheeky monkey is bananas about throwing beads everywhere!”
— Cast description from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Ookis are brown monkey-like yarn enemies that make their only appearances in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, being some of the earliest enemies in the game. The first stage they appear in is Fountain Gardens. Ookis hang from the branches of trees or platforms and cannot harm 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） directly. Ookis encountered throughout the main gameplay of stages throw beads at 卡比（Kirby） which, if they hit him, are automatically collected, making these Ookis harmless. In Whispy's Forest during the Tankbot Metamortex section, more Ookis can be found which throw apples instead. These can damage 卡比（Kirby）, so he should be careful.

After a while of throwing beads, Ookis will stop, presumably having run out of beads to throw. After that, they simply hang on the branch until 卡比（Kirby） defeats them.

wikirby-page:14725.description_zh:
“这种太空虫喜欢与它最亲密的朋友一起成群攻击。”
— Patch Plaza
Orbitfly是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一种小型飞行按钮敌人。它是四种不同类型中最后被发现的一个（其他三种是Buttonfly、Buttonbee和Buttonbug），出现在Stellar Way和Outer Rings等太空关卡中。它们可以以各种阵型成群飞行，促使卡比（Kirby）在它们撞到他之前用Rocket变身击落。击败某个特定阵型中的每一个Orbitfly，比单独击败它们会获得更多的珠子。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Orbitflies可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead。在这里，它们也会成队飞行，通常朝向魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），并且主要出现在敌人的埋伏区域。
wikirby-page:14725.description_en:
“This space bug likes to attack in formation with a swarm of its closest friends.”
— Patch Plaza
Orbitfly is a small flying button enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It is the last of the four different types to be discovered (the other three being Buttonfly, Buttonbee, and Buttonbug) and is found in space stages like Stellar Way and Outer Rings. They can be seen flying in various formations in large numbers, prompting 卡比（Kirby） to shoot them down with the Rocket transformation before they crash into him. Defeating every Orbitfly in a particular formation will yield a larger number of beads then defeating them individually.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Orbitflies can be found in every stage of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. Here, they also fly in formations, often toward 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, and are encountered primarily in enemy ambush sections.

wikirby-page:14353.description_zh:
“这个大块头会一直滚动，直到撞到某物。”
— Patch Plaza
Rolling Clod是一个来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型尖刺敌人。他本质上像黑刺球（Gordo）一样是一个大型多刺的巨石，尽管他无法悬浮，并且他也可以被击败。如果卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）接触到Rolling Clod，他将受到伤害。可以使用Weight的技能击败Rolling Clod，但这也会伤到攻击者。在大多数情况下，正如其名字所示，Rolling Clod可以被看到沿着斜坡滚动，但他也可以在气流中漂浮。
wikirby-page:14353.description_en:
“This big lug will just keep rolling until he hits something.”
— Patch Plaza
Rolling Clod is a large spiked enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is essentially a large spiky boulder in a similar manner to a 黑刺球（Gordo）, though he is incapable of hovering and he can also be defeated. If 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） touches Rolling Clod, he will take damage. Rolling Clod can be defeated using the Weight move, but this will also harm the attacker. In most cases, true to his name, Rolling Clod can be seen rolling down slopes, but he can also be seen floating in wind currents.

wikirby-page:14514.description_zh:
“Sawgill是海里最吵闹、最淘气的鱼，他自己也知道这一点。他为自己那把壮观的锯感到非常自豪，但没人会靠近他。你能责怪他们吗？”
— Figurine对Sawgill的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sawgill，是一条锯鲨敌人，首次登场于毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn），并出现在其3DS移植版中，此外也再次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他通常可以在水域中找到，巡逻特定区域。如果被放置在陆地上，他只能乱扑腾。他的锯可以伤害卡比（Kirby），但从背后很容易击败他。
wikirby-page:14514.description_en:
“Sawgill is the rowdiest, most rambunctious fish in the sea, and he knows it. He takes great pride in that magnificent saw of his, but no one will come anywhere near him. Can you blame them?”
— Figurine description of Sawgill from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sawgill is a sawshark enemy which debuted in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and appeared later in its 3DS port, in addition to reappearing in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He can typically be found in bodies of water, patrolling a distinct area. If left on land, he will only be able to flop about. His saw can harm 卡比（Kirby）, but he can be easily defeated from behind.

wikirby-page:14434.description_zh:
“漂浮一整天一定感觉很棒。小心它的刺触手！”
— E美式英语Patch Plaza描述
Sea Jelly，在英式英语版本中名为Sky果凍（Jelly），是出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的大型浮动刺胞动物敌人。它有橙色的帽子、白色的触手和黄色的X形眼睛。

只在Mushroom Run关卡中出现，Sea Jelly漂浮在空中，会周期性释放孢子，这些孢子会在卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）身上生长蘑菇并使其无法移动，直到被抖掉。卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）可以短暂站在它的帽子上，但Sea Jelly如果它们停留太久将会电击它们。

Sea Jelly可以被纱球和Weight能力，也可以用Yarn Whip卷起或展开。
wikirby-page:14434.description_en:
“It must feel nice to float around all day. Beware of its stinging tentacles!”
— American English Patch Plaza description
Sea Jelly, named Sky 果凍（Jelly） in the British English version, is a large floating cnidarian enemy appearing in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It has an orange cap, white tentacles, and yellow, X-shaped eyes.

Found exclusively in the Mushroom Run stage, Sea Jelly floats in the air, where it will periodically release spores that will grow mushrooms on and immobilize 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） until they are shaken off. 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） can briefly stand on top of its cap, but the Sea Jelly will electrocute them if they remain for too long.

Sea Jelly can be defeated by yarn balls and the Weight ability, and can also be rolled up or undone with the Yarn Whip.

wikirby-page:14365.description_zh:
“蜗牛是孤独的，所以当它看到新的人时，它会兴奋地扑向他们！”
— Patch Plaza
Shelby是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的蜗牛敌人。尽管是蜗牛，Shelby在卷成球并攻击时可以相当快地移动。使用Yarn Whip抓起并投掷时，Shelby会沿地面前滚，直到撞到某物。向上投掷时也是如此，只是它会先沿弧线下落。
wikirby-page:14365.description_en:
“Snails are lonely, so when he sees someone new, he tackles them with joy!”
— Patch Plaza
Shelby is a snail enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. Despite being a snail, Shelby is capable of moving fairly quickly when he rolls up into a ball and strikes. When grabbed and thrown using the Yarn Whip, Shelby will roll forward along the ground until he hits something. This is also the case when thrown upward, through he will fall in an arc first.

wikirby-page:14349.description_zh:
“这个舌头粘乎乎的怪物会尝试舔几乎任何东西！”
— Patch Plaza
Slobba是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型类似青蛙的敌人。它会原地待着，并试图用舌头攻击接近的任何入侵者。如果它抓住了什么物体，Slobba会吞食它的受害者，咀嚼片刻，然后将其吐出来，造成伤害。Slobba对Yarn Whip免疫，但可以用Weight或扔毛线球来击败它。
wikirby-page:14349.description_en:
“This sticky-tongued monster will try to lick just about anything!”
— Patch Plaza
Slobba is a large frog-like enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It sits in place and will attempt to shoot its tongue out at any intruder who gets near. If it catches something, Slobba will eat its victim, chew on them for a moment, then spit them back out, dealing damage. Slobba is immune to the Yarn Whip, but can be defeated by using the Weight or throwing a yarn ball at it.

wikirby-page:14318.description_zh:
“这个小偷会偷珠子，如果你碰到他，他会消失！”
— Patch Plaza
Sneak Sack是一个袋子形状的敌人，会出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。他只有一个按钮眼，并且在不断地跑动时不停喘息。当活跃时，他会尝试逃离卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff），如果没有被打败，到达墙壁时会消失。如果以任何方式击败他，而不是把他卷成毛线球，他会掉落大量珠子。Sneak Sack可以在Pyramid Sands中找到，通过解开第二个Swadclod来辨认，辨别标志是黄色的眼睛。

除了在主游戏中的出现外，Sneak Sack也能在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的Sub-Game的Dedede Gogogo和Slash & Bead中找到。在Dedede Gogogo，当接近时，它通常会从帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）逃跑，但可以被追上以获得珠子。在Dedede Gogogo的Stage 4中，多只潜行包会向帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）冲来，有些甚至会从平台边缘跳到他身上。在《Slash & Bead》中只有一个Sneak Sack，它出现在Stage 2。它会保持原地，直到魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）靠近，这时它会试图逃跑。在它跑出屏幕之前，魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以用剑砍它或使用它的Special来击败它。
wikirby-page:14318.description_en:
“This thief steals beads and disappears if you touch him!”
— Patch Plaza
Sneak Sack is a bag-shaped enemy which appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He has a single button eye and pants continuously as he constantly runs around. While active, he will attempt to run away from 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff）, and will disappear upon reaching a wall if not defeated. If defeated by any means other than being rolled up into a yarn ball, he will drop plenty of beads. Sneak Sack can be found in Pyramid Sands by unraveling the second Swadclod, distinguished by its yellow eye.

Along with his appearance in the main game, Sneak Sack can also be found in the Sub-Games Dedede Gogogo and Slash & Bead in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. In Dedede Gogogo, he will typically run away from 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） when approached, but can be chased down to obtain beads. In Stage 4 of Dedede Gogogo, multiple Sneak Sacks will run toward 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and some even jump onto him from the edges of platforms. There is only one Sneak Sack in Slash & Bead, and it is encountered in Stage 2. It remains in place until 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） draws near, at which point it will attempt to run away. Before it runs offscreen, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can defeat it by slashing it with his sword or by using his Special.

wikirby-page:14351.description_zh:
“这种鲷鱼生活在狭窄的空间里。它可以伸展到你难以置信的程度！”
— Patch Plaza
Snip-Snap是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的蛇形敌人。它有一个长长的黄色身体，带有剪刀状的颚和一个红色的按钮眼。

Snip-Snap栖息在卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）可以通过Snake变形穿越的隧道中。当经过它的洞穴时，它会跳出来进行追击，将卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）拖回洞穴最近的出口，并在抓到它们时造成伤害。只有在它伸出隧道出口时使用Yarn Whip才能击败它。

在关卡Tube Town中，Snip-Snaps在为卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）可使用。他们必须引导Snip-Snap到地面上的一个插座处，Snip-Snap会自行插入并激活电线。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Snip-Snap可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 3中找到，通常出现在敌人的伏击区段。
wikirby-page:14351.description_en:
“This snapper lives in tight spaces. It can stretch like you wouldn't believe!”
— Patch Plaza
Snip-Snap is a serpentine enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It has a long, yellow body with scissor-like mandibles and a red button eye.

Snip-Snap inhabits tunnels that 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） can travel through with the Snake transformation. Upon passing its burrow, it will pop out and give chase, dragging 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） back to the closest exit to its burrow and damaging them if it catches them. It can only be defeated using the Yarn Whip when it extends out of a tunnel's exit.

In the stage Tube Town, Snip-Snaps play a crucial role in activating moving wires for 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） to use. They must guide the Snip-Snap to an outlet above ground, where it will plug itself in and activate the wires.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Snip-Snap can be found in Stage 3 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead, appearing in enemy ambush sections.

wikirby-page:4124.description_zh: 这些士兵是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中四种不同类型的方形类人敌人，他们使用多种武器。它们主要出现在Treat Land中，并且与Mariner非常相似。
wikirby-page:4124.description_en: The Soldiers are four different types of squarish humanoid enemies in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn that wield several weapons. They mostly appear in Treat Land and are very similar to Mariners.

wikirby-page:14830.description_zh:
“这些家伙在缝隙后面工作，以缝合出新的平台！”
— Patch Plaza
Soocher是一个小型虫子般的线和针，只在与棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）战斗时出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。编织术士在卡比（Kirby）在布幕后面时召唤它们，从那里，它们会沿着背面直线飞行，在各个地方创建缝合平台。如果卡比（Kirby）接触到飞过的Soocher，他会受到伤害，但他可以利用它们创建的平台。Soocher的平台在短时间后会消失，因此卡比（Kirby）需要迅速利用它们并跳回战斗。Soocher无法被击败。
wikirby-page:14830.description_en:
“These guys work behind the seams to stitch together new platforms!”
— Patch Plaza
Soocher is a small bug-like thread and needle which appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn solely during the fight with 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）. The woven sorcerer conjures them while 卡比（Kirby） is behind the sheet and from there, they will fly in a straight line across the back, creating stitching platforms in various places. 卡比（Kirby） will be hurt if he touches a Soocher as it flies by, but he can make use of the platforms they create. Soocher's platforms will decay after a short time, so 卡比（Kirby） will need to be quick to make use of them and hop back into the fray. Soocher cannot be defeated.

wikirby-page:14692.description_zh:
“这个外星生物在太空中漂浮，到处投下能量球！”
— Patch Plaza
Space Jelly是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型漂浮水母状敌人。顾名思义，Space Jelly出现在外太空环境中。它通过从触手中发射电球来攻击，这些电球撞击时会伤害卡比（Kirby）。由于体型巨大，它无法被Yarn Whip击败，但可以通过其他方式击败。通常，这涉及使用Saucer Metamortex的放电攻击来击败它。
wikirby-page:14692.description_en:
“This alien being floats through space, dropping energy spheres everywhere!”
— Patch Plaza
Space Jelly is a large floating jellyfish-like enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. As its name suggests, Space Jelly is found in outer space environments. It attacks by shooting out electric orbs from its tentacles, which can hurt 卡比（Kirby） on impact. Its large size means that it cannot be defeated using the Yarn Whip, but it can be defeated by other means. Typically, this involves defeating it using the discharge attack from the Saucer Metamortex.

wikirby-page:14727.description_zh:
“A Spore Jelly只是漂浮着，把孢子散落到所有地方。惊喜！”
— Patch Plaza
Spore Jelly是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的大型漂浮刺胞动物敌人。它可以在以太空为主题的关卡中找到，例如Stellar Way，在那里它作为Rocket卡比（Kirby）的危害，通过同时发射多个投射物。需要Rocket的星形射击多次命中才能消灭它。
wikirby-page:14727.description_en:
“A Spore Jelly just floats about, dropping spores on everything. Surprise!”
— Patch Plaza
Spore Jelly is a large floating cnidarian enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It can be found in space-themed stages such as Stellar Way, where it serves as a hazard to Rocket 卡比（Kirby） by shooting several projectiles at once. It takes many hits from the Rocket's star shots to destroy.

wikirby-page:14477.description_zh:
“这个幽灵散发出柔和的光芒。把他包起来，用作灯笼吧！”
— Patch Plaza
Stogue是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的白色幽灵状敌人。他漂浮在空中，散发出强烈的光芒，驱散周围的黑暗。他会接近卡比（Kirby）并触碰造成伤害，但动作一般较慢，可以轻松用Yarn Whip捕捉。如果卷成毛线球，Stogue会继续发光一段时间，但最终会变暗。在发光时，卡比（Kirby）可以使用包裹的Stogue照亮黑暗区域的道路，使他能够看到隐藏的珠子、收集物以及路径上的障碍物。
wikirby-page:14477.description_en:
“This ghost gives off a nice glow. Wrap him up and use him as a lantern!”
— Patch Plaza
Stogue is a white wisp-like ghost enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He floats around and gives off a large glow, dispelling darkness around him. He will approach 卡比（Kirby） and damage him on touch, but moves generally slowly and can be captured easily using the Yarn Whip. If rolled up into a Yarn ball, Stogue will continue to give off light for a while, but will eventually dim. While giving off light, 卡比（Kirby） can use the wrapped-up Stogue to illuminate his path through dark areas, allowing him to see hidden beads, collectables, and obstacles in his path.

wikirby-page:14156.description_zh:
“这只大蛞蝓喜欢碾碎他的敌人。他也会吐出一些厉害的丝线！”
— Patch Plaza
Sulkworm是一个大型毛毛虫状敌人，首次出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn），后来又出现在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。他相当罕见，而且不会四处移动。他的名字是对“sulk”（生闷气）和“silkworm”（蚕）的一个双关。

Sulkworm有两种攻击方式，这两种攻击都可以伤害卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）。第一种是他喷出的丝球，呈弧线飞出，可以被接住并反击他。第二种是近距离使用的身体冲撞攻击。如果卡比（Kirby）被击中，他的几个珠子可能会被困在Sulkworm的身体里，在击败这只怪物之前无法获得。Sulkworm无法直接被Yarn Whip，但有两种方法可以击败Sulkworm：向他扔两个物体，或者对Sulkworm的头部使用重量变换。

在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，Sulkworm可以在Sub-Game Slash & Bead的Stage 1找到。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以选择飞越它，或用他的剑击败它，或者使用Special。
wikirby-page:14156.description_en:
“This big slug likes to crush his foes. He spits some mean thread, too!”
— Patch Plaza
Sulkworm is a large caterpillar-like enemy which debuted in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and later appeared in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He is fairly uncommon and doesn't move around. His name is a play on "sulk" and "silkworm".

Sulkworm has two methods of attack, both of which can harm 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff）. The first is a silk ball which he spits out in an arc, which can be caught and used against him. The second is a body slam attack which he uses at close range. If 卡比（Kirby） is hit, several of his beads may become trapped inside Sulkworm's body, and be unobtainable until the beast is defeated. Sulkworm cannot be harmed directly using the Yarn Whip, but there are two ways to defeat Sulkworm: throw two objects at him to or use the weight transformation on Sulkworm's head.

In Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, Sulkworm can be found in Stage 1 of the Sub-Game Slash & Bead. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can choose to either fly over it or defeat it with his sword or Special.

wikirby-page:14319.description_zh:
“这个敌人裹着绷带和神秘感……他自己是这么认为的。”
— Patch Plaza
Swadclod是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的木乃伊类敌人。他会坐在原地，当卡比（Kirby）或毛毛（Prince Fluff）接近时，会尝试伸展他的绷带像手臂一样。抓住其中一个时，Swadclod会摇晃他的受害者，然后将其抛开，同时造成伤害。

如果卡比（Kirby）或Fluff对Swadclod使用他们的Yarn Whip，他将剥掉怪物的绷带，露出它是Cyclod或Sneak Sack。裹在绷带下的敌人可通过眼睛辨认。
wikirby-page:14319.description_en:
“This enemy is wrapped in bandages and mystery... So he thinks.”
— Patch Plaza
Swadclod is a mummy-like enemy from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He sits in place and will attempt to extend his bandages like arms out in front when 卡比（Kirby） or 毛毛（Prince Fluff） gets near. If he grabs one of them, Swadclod will shake his victim around, then toss him away, dealing damage in the process.

If 卡比（Kirby） or Fluff uses their Yarn Whip on Swadclod, he will strip the monster of his bandages, revealing him to be either a Cyclod or a Sneak Sack. The enemy concealed under the bandages can be identified by its eye.

wikirby-page:6855.description_zh:
“不要让这辆疯狂的改装车赢！向他展示谁才是公路之王！”
— Patch Plaza
Truck Monster是在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中，在Off-Roader关卡阶段出现的敌人。该术语并不指某一个特定敌人，而是指驾驶特定车辆的任何敌人，这种车是一种越野风格的汽车。驾驶者可能是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）、Dandan或Cyclod。

卡车怪物会在卡比（Kirby）变身为Off-Roader时出现，并向他发起赛跑挑战。当沿路行驶时，如果卡比（Kirby）保持速度，他将能够超过它们，但如果撞上会受到伤害。可以通过跳跃躲开它们，跳到它们上面，或者使用加速冲过去来避免碰撞。他们。在赛道的尽头，各个赛车手将出现在领奖台上，如果卡比（Kirby）在比赛中获得第三名或以上，将有一个空位。自然，获得更高名次会登上更高的领奖台，并在Beads.
wikirby-page:6855.description_en:
“Don't let this crazy hot rod win! Show him who's the king of the road!”
— Patch Plaza
Truck Monster is an enemy which appears in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn during Off-Roader sections of stages. The term refers not to one particular enemy, but to any enemy which drives the specific vehicle involved, being an off-roader style car. The driver could be a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, Dandan, or Cyclod.

Truck Monsters appear when 卡比（Kirby） transforms into an Off-Roader and challenge him to a race. When driving down the road, 卡比（Kirby） will be able to pass them if he keeps his speed up, but will be hurt if he collides into them. This can be averted by jumping over them, jumping on top of them, or using a boost to drive through them. At the end of the track, the various drivers will appear on a race podium, with an empty slot for 卡比（Kirby） if he placed third or above in the race. Naturally, getting a higher place will yield a higher podium, and yield a greater reward in Beads.

wikirby-page:4362.description_zh:
“这些树生活在梦境森林中。它们的叶子非常大！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Twiggy Woods是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn关卡中独有的敌人。它们非常像关卡的Boss，风语大树（Whispy Woods）。然而，与Whispy不同的是，它们没有苹果，只通过从叶子上掉落黑刺球（Gordo）来攻击。卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）无法永久击败它们；当英雄拉动悬挂在叶子上的绳子时，它们会暂时眩晕，使树体降低到英雄可以攀爬的高度。在这种被压扁的状态下，Twiggy Woods会像Whispy被击败后一样哭泣。过了一会儿，树木会恢复原状并继续掉落Gordos，直到字符串再次被拉动.
wikirby-page:4362.description_en:
“These trees live in the forests of Dream Land. They have great leaves!”
— Patch Plaza description
Twiggy Woods are enemies exclusive to the Whispy's Forest stage of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They greatly resemble the stage's boss, 风语大树（Whispy Woods）. Unlike Whispy, however, they do not have apples and attack only by dropping 黑刺球（Gordo）s from their leaves. 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） cannot permanently defeat them; they are temporarily stunned when the heroes pull on a string dangling from their leaves, bringing the tree low enough for the heroes to climb. In this flattened state, Twiggy Woods will cry similar to how Whispy cries after defeat. After a short period of time, the trees will regain their stature and resume dropping Gordos until the string is pulled again.

wikirby-page:4666.description_zh:
“Uniclod对他的角非常自豪……这就是为什么他想用它去刺每一个人。”
— Cast的描述来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn。
Uniclods是出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的敌人。他们首次在游戏中出现在Flower Fields关卡中的Grass Land（尽管在开场过场动画中，追逐毛毛（Prince Fluff）的怪物也是Uniclod）。Uniclods是由棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）创建的新敌人，帮助他征服Patch Land；他们非常自豪自己的角，并尝试用这些角去撞击卡比（Kirby），伤害他。如果卡比（Kirby）被冲撞的Uniclod击中，卡比（Kirby）会失去几个珠子。

可以使用卡比（Kirby）的毛线鞭来打败Uniclods。如果卡比（Kirby）试图用他的体重压碎他们，而他们正站着，他会在接触时受到伤害。如果卡比（Kirby）使用Roll Up卷起Uniclod，它会变形成一支箭，在投掷时穿透敌人。

 Uniclod的名字来源于“独角兽”，一种拥有单角的神话生物，以及“Cyclod”。
wikirby-page:4666.description_en:
“Uniclod is very proud of his horn... That's why he wants to spear everyone with it.”
— Cast description from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.
Uniclods are enemies who appeared in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. They first appear in-game in the Flower Fields stage, in Grass Land (although in the opening cutscene, the monster chasing 毛毛（Prince Fluff） around is a Uniclod as well). Uniclods are new enemies created by 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） to help him take over Patch Land; they are very proud of their horns and try to use those horns to charge into 卡比（Kirby）, harming him. If 卡比（Kirby） is hit by a charging Uniclod, 卡比（Kirby） will lose several beads.

Uniclods can be defeated by using 卡比（Kirby）'s yarn whip on them. If 卡比（Kirby） tries to crush them with his weight, while they are standing up, he will be damaged by the contact. If 卡比（Kirby） uses Roll Up to roll up Uniclod, it will transform into an arrow which will pierce through enemies when thrown.

Uniclod's name comes from "unicorn", a mythical creature with a single horn, and "Cyclod".

wikirby-page:14582.description_zh:
“这个巨大的水手发射巨大的大炮。偷走他的大炮并回击巨大的火力！”
— 补丁广场说明
Blast Mariner是一个超大的Mariner，它出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Boom Boatyard末尾。与其他水手不同，Blast Mariner无法被躲避，因此成为游戏中少数几个中Boss之一。

Blast Mariner不能使用Yarn Whip直接攻击，而且太大以至于无法跳过。他有两种不同的攻击方式。第一种是Blast Mariner依次发射三枚呈递增弧线的导弹。第二种是他发射一枚额外大的导弹，导弹缓慢飞行后着地时会产生很大的爆炸。要击败他，卡比（Kirby）可以在导弹飞行途中抓住它们并将它们送回发件人。Blast Mariner需要三次这样的打击才能击败，并在击败后掉落大量珠子。
wikirby-page:14582.description_en:
“This huge mariner shoots a huge cannon. Steal his huge shots and return huge fire!”
— Patch Plaza description
Blast Mariner is an extra large Mariner that appears at the end of Boom Boatyard in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. Unlike the other mariners, Blast Mariner cannot be avoided, thus serving as one of the few mid-bosses in the game.

Blast Mariner cannot be attacked directly using the Yarn Whip and is too large to jump over. He has two different methods of attack. The first has Blast Mariner fire three missiles in increasing arcs, one at a time. The second has him fire one extra large missile which slowly flies then makes a very large explosion upon landing. To defeat him, 卡比（Kirby） can grab the missiles mid-flight and return them to sender. Blast Mariner takes three such hits to defeat and drops a very large amount of beads upon doing so.

wikirby-page:14747.description_zh:
Gate Core是来自毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的装有加农炮的障碍物。它可以在Space Land的Moon Base关卡中找到三个位置。太空反应堆是一台装有两个或更多可转向加农炮的机器，其核心挂在电线上来回移动。卡比（Kirby）可以使用Tankbot变形攻击核心来摧毁它，不过需要四次导弹命中才能击败它（每次命中后都有短暂的无敌时间）。第一次被击中时，核心会打开以显示其核心晶体，每次后续命中会改变晶体的颜色，直到被摧毁。

Gate Core是游戏中少数几种没有在from Patch Plaza。因此，它在游戏中没有官方名称。它仅在日文攻略书中被命名。
wikirby-page:14747.description_en:
Gate Core is a cannon-laden obstacle from 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It can be found in three places in the Moon Base stage of Space Land. The space reactor is a machine with two or more re-directing cannons and a core on a wire which moves back and forth. 卡比（Kirby） can attack the core using the Tankbot transformation to destroy it, though it takes four missile hits to defeat (with a short amount of post-hit invulnerability after each one). When hit the first time, the core will open up to show its core crystal, and each subsequent hit changes the crystal's color before it is destroyed.

Gate Core is one of the few significant enemies in the game which does not have an entry in the Cast menu from Patch Plaza. As such, it does not have an official name in-game. It is instead named only in Japanese strategy guides.

wikirby-page:14760.description_zh:
“这是独眼云（Kracko）的远亲之一。他与他的小克拉科斯一起攻击。”
— E美式英语补丁广场描述
Space Kracko是独眼云（Kracko）的外太空亲属，由棉花制成，并有一个纽扣眼。他出现在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Outer Rings关卡末尾。他无法被躲避，因此是游戏中少数的中期Boss之一。Space Kracko的颜色是灰色，他的眼睛是绿色，尖刺是橙色。

卡比（Kirby）使用Rocket Metamortex变形与Space Kracko作战。Space Kracko的主要攻击方式是从眼睛射出大量小行星、盘旋攻击和发射旋转光束。他还有许多其他攻击手段，他使用得较少。要击败Space Kracko，卡比（Kirby）必须使用Rocket的星形弹连续向他开火。Space Kracko在受到伤害时会缩小几次，直到最终被击败。击败他后，Space Kracko将掉落Outer Rings CD供卡比（Kirby）捡起。
wikirby-page:14760.description_en:
“This is one of 独眼云（Kracko）'s distant relatives. He attacks along with his Li'l Krackos.”
— American English Patch Plaza description
Space Kracko is an outer-space relative of 独眼云（Kracko） made of cotton and with a button-eye. He appears at the end of the Outer Rings stage in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. He cannot be avoided, thus serving as one of the few mid-bosses in the game. Space Kracko is colored gray, while his eye is green and his spikes are orange.

卡比（Kirby） does battle with Space Kracko using the Rocket Metamortex transformation. Space Kracko attacks primarily by shooting large numbers of asteroids out of his eye, swooping around, and firing his cycle beam. He has a number of other attacks as well, which he uses less frequently. To defeat Space Kracko, 卡比（Kirby） has to fire continuously at him using the Rocket's star projectiles. Space Kracko will decrease in size a couple of times as he sustains damage until he is finally defeated. Upon his defeat, Space Kracko will drop the Outer Rings CD for 卡比（Kirby） to pick up.

wikirby-page:4346.description_zh:
“奇异森林中可怕的居民，这是一棵令人毛骨悚然的树！”
— 广场描述
Wicked Willow是在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）中首次登场的敌人，只出现在Weird Woods关卡中。顾名思义，它们是带有蓝紫色叶子的树木，覆盖着粉色和紫色的藤蔓，树干上有锋利的牙齿。它们还携带多彩的孢子，释放时会变得带刺，用作攻击。

邪恶柳树会阻止卡比（Kirby）前进，并阻止他继续通关，直到被击败。卡比（Kirby）只能在他的Saucer形态下击败邪恶柳树，因为他需要吸取孢子以使用电击攻击。它们需要被电击两次，卡比（Kirby）才能通过。
wikirby-page:4346.description_en:
“Scary inhabitant of Weird Woods, this is one spooky tree!”
— Patch Plaza description
Wicked Willow is an enemy that debuted in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）, exclusive to the Weird Woods stage. As suggested by their name, they are trees with blue-purple leaves, covered in pink and purple vines, with sharp teeth in the trunk. They also harbor multi-colored spores that become spiny on release, which they use as an attack.

Wicked Willows stop 卡比（Kirby） in his tracks, and prevent him from continuing the stage until they are defeated. 卡比（Kirby） can defeat Wicked Willows only in his Saucer form, since he needs to suck the spores up in order to use his electrical shock attack. They need to be shocked twice in order for 卡比（Kirby） to pass.

wikirby-page:3895.description_zh:
“这只海怪相当自负。我想知道那顶针织帽是怎么回事……？”
— Patch Plaza引用Capamari（条目#84）
Capamari是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中Water Land的水生首领。
wikirby-page:3895.description_en:
“This sea monster is rather vain. I wonder what the deal with that knit cap is...?”
— Patch Plaza quote for Capamari (entry #84)
Capamari is the aquatic boss of Water Land in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.

wikirby-page:3780.description_zh:
“这个火焰守护者能够喷火，但疲倦时会放下防御。”
— Patch Plaza描述
Fangora是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的第一个首领，在Grass Land中为获取Magic Yarn的第二条线作战。
wikirby-page:3780.description_en:
“This flaming guardian can breathe fire but will drop its guard when tired.”
— Patch Plaza description
Fangora is the first boss of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, fought in Grass Land for the second strand of Magic Yarn.

wikirby-page:3747.description_zh:
“这位火山守护者会从她的翅膀喷火！注意不要被烧伤！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Hot Wings是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中Hot Land的首领。
wikirby-page:3747.description_en:
“This guardian of the volcano shoots fire from her wings! Avoid getting burned!”
— Patch Plaza description
Hot Wings is the boss of Hot Land in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.

wikirby-page:3750.description_zh:
“待遇之地的反派手中不止有几个卑鄙的伎俩！”
— Patch Plaza描述
Squashini是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的一个老板，以及Treat Land中Magic Yarn的持有者。
wikirby-page:3750.description_en:
“The villain of Treat Land has more than a few mean tricks up his sleeve!”
— Patch Plaza description
Squashini is a boss in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, and the holder of the Magic Yarn in Treat Land.

wikirby-page:3784.description_zh:
“Nyahahahahaaa！很快，梦幻乐园将被我的编织针缠绕！”
— 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）在毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）中，也被称为棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）巫师，是毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn）和Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的主要反派，他涉及将Magic Yarn从Patch Land中夺走的恶作剧促使卡比（Kirby）和毛毛（Prince Fluff）开始他们的任务去击败他，并拯救补丁乐园免于支离破碎。

棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）是一名高超的活纱生物编织师，并利用Magic纱线的力量接管Dream Land并创造强大的纱线守卫。他还可以利用Magic Sock的力量将梦幻乐园的居民变成纱线，并使用Magic纱线附身。他做这一切的动机尚不清楚（即使对他自己也是如此），但最终他无论如何还是被卡比（Kirby）和Fluff在梦境之地击败，并被送回补丁之地。

在原版日语中，棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）有一个说话习惯，他会在每句话的结尾加上アミーボ或アモーレ，这是他日文名字的两部分，并按照这个顺序交替使用。
wikirby-page:3784.description_en:
“Nyahahahahaaa! Soon, Dream Land will be wrapped around my knitting needles!”
— 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） in 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）, also known as 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） the Sorcerer, is the main antagonist of 毛線卡比（Kirby's Epic Yarn） and Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn, whose antics involving tearing the Magic Yarn away from Patch Land prompt 卡比（Kirby） and 毛毛（Prince Fluff） to embark on their quest to defeat him and save Patch Land from being left in pieces.

棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） is a highly skilled weaver of living yarn creatures, and uses the power of the Magic Yarn to take over Dream Land and create powerful yarn guardians. He can also use the power of the Magic Sock to transform denizens of Dream Land into yarn and possess them using the Magic Yarn. His motives for doing all this are unclear (even to himself), but he is eventually defeated regardless by 卡比（Kirby） and Fluff in Dream Land and sent back to Patch Land.

In the original Japanese version, 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn） has a speech quirk in which he ends all his sentences with アミーボ or アモーレ, the two parts of his Japanese name, alternating between the two in that order as he talks.

wikirby-page:11002.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）！跟我来！我们可以一起对抗Necrodeus！”
— Kirby's heroic heart在被分离后呼唤自己的身体，这一幕来自Kirby Mass Attack
Kirby's heroic heart的开场动画（游戏中也简称为“星星”），它是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个星形物体，当卡比（Kirby）被Necrodeus分成10个小副本时，它会从中弹出。它悬浮在空中，引导Kirby们踏上冒险，击败分裂他们的反派，并使自己重新合为一体。尽管在游戏事件中它与卡比（Kirby）是分开存在的，但显然仍然是卡比（Kirby）的一部分，因为如果所有小Kirby们死亡，心脏会爆开并消失。值得注意的是，这颗心脏还能够说话，尽管它只会这样做通过Narrator在过场动画中传递的文字行。

Kirby's heroic heart作为玩家控制Kirbys的手段，因为Kirbys无法自行被控制。当玩家用手写笔轻触屏幕时，心形会出现，提示附近的Kirbys接近它。心形还可以用来将Kirbys投向物体，并使用魔力将他们全部拉到空中。然而，当在空中拖动Kirbys时，用来引导它们的线会慢慢变红，最终耗尽能量。当发生这种情况时，Kirbys不能再被拉动，英雄之心需要一段时间来恢复。

在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中，Kirby's heroic heart出现在Music Room，画中描绘了八个柯比紧握着它。
wikirby-page:11002.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby）! Follow me! We can fight Necrodeus together!”
— Kirby's heroic heart calling out to his body after being separated, from the intro cutscene for Kirby Mass Attack
Kirby's heroic heart (also referred to in-game as just "the star") is a star-shaped object in Kirby Mass Attack that pops out of 卡比（Kirby） when he is split into 10 smaller copies by Necrodeus. It hovers in the air and guides the Kirbys through their adventure to defeat the villain which split them and restore themselves to one again. Despite existing separately from 卡比（Kirby） during the events of the game, it is evidently still part of 卡比（Kirby） since if all the mini-Kirbys perish, the heart bursts and vanishes. Notably, the heart is also capable of speech, though it only does so through lines of text relayed by the Narrator in cutscenes.

Kirby's heroic heart serves as the means for the player to control the Kirbys, as they cannot be controlled on their own. When the player taps the stylus on the screen, the heart appears, prompting any Kirbys nearby to approach it. The heart can also be used to toss the Kirbys at objects, and pull them all into the air using magical force. When dragging the Kirbys through the air, however, the line used to guide them slowly turns red, and eventually runs out of energy. When this happens, the Kirbys cannot be pulled any further, and some time will be needed for the heroic heart to recover.

In Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, Kirby's heroic heart appears in the icon for songs from Kirby Mass Attack in the Music Room, where it depicts eight Kirbys holding on to it.

wikirby-page:12655.description_zh:
Awadoron是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一只长着两颗圆亮眼睛的蛤蜊，栖息在Volcano Valley的水域中。它不能伤害卡比（Kirby），但会尝试躲避它们。每当卡比（Kirby）撞击Awadoron时，它会释放一些气泡。被击中足够次数后，Awadoron会破裂，留下更多的气泡，但被摧毁后，就不再为Kirbys提供空气。

Awadoron看起来像一只带有两颗类似人类眼睛的橙色蛤蜊。它比卡比（Kirby）略大，被击败时可获得500分。当受到伤害时，Awadoron的壳会逐渐出现裂纹，直到最终破碎。为了充分利用对于这个敌人，卡比们需要不断追击，否则Awadoron在嘲讽卡比们后会消失在屏幕边缘。
wikirby-page:12655.description_en:
Awadoron is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a clam with two beady eyes that inhabits aquatic areas in Volcano Valley. It cannot harm the 卡比（Kirby）s, but it will try to evade them. Every time a 卡比（Kirby） slams into Awadoron, it will release some air bubbles. Once hit enough times, Awadoron will shatter, leaving many more air bubbles, but - being destroyed - will no longer be a source of air for the Kirbys after that point.

Awadoron resembles an orange clam with two beady human-like eyes. It is slightly larger than a 卡比（Kirby）, and is worth 500 points when defeated. When taking damage, Awadoron cracks progressively more severely along its shell until it eventually shatters. In order to make full use of this enemy, the Kirbys need to continually pursue it, or else Awadoron will disappear off the edge of the screen after taunting the Kirbys.

wikirby-page:12500.description_zh: Awasuki是一种来自Kirby Mass Attack的无害水生敌人。它看起来像一条非常小的金鱼，并且始终在自身周围产生一个气泡。当卡比们靠近时，Awasuki会试图逃跑。如果卡比（Kirby）抓住它，它们会得到它的气泡，而它会快速游开。
wikirby-page:12500.description_en: Awasuki is a harmless aquatic enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a very small goldfish, and generates an air bubble around itself at all times. When the Kirbys approach, Awasuki will attempt to flee. If the 卡比（Kirby）s catch it, they will get its air bubble and it will swim off quickly.

wikirby-page:12656.description_zh:
Banishback是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人，只会在Volcano Valley - Stage 4中出现。它是一种半透明的紫色云状兽，带有诡异的微笑，体型各异。它可以在区域内巡逻或静止不动，并能穿墙而过。它还可以时隐时现。如果甚至只有一个卡比（Kirby）接触到Banishback，这个生物会吞下它们所有，然后把它们吐回关卡的之前区域。如果发生这种情况，之前关卡中遭遇的任何障碍物——比如敌人和方块——都会重新生成。Banishback只能被Jumbo Candy伤害，最终它无害，最多只是一个麻烦。击败Banishback可以获得玩家获得500分。怪盗洛切（Daroach）表示他们是城堡的守卫，尽管在英式英语版本中他没有按名字提到他们。

 Checklist的其中一个目标（“前进者”）是让Kirby们在不接触任何Banishback且不使用捷径的情况下，通过火山谷-第4关。
wikirby-page:12656.description_en:
Banishback is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack which appears solely in Volcano Valley - Stage 4. It is a translucent purple cloud beast with a creepy smile which comes in different sizes. It can be seen patrolling areas or holding still, and can pass through walls. It can also phase in and out of existence. If even one of the 卡比（Kirby）s touches a Banishback, the creature will swallow all of them and spit them back to a previous area of the stage. If this happens, any pertinent obstacles that the Kirbys may have previously overcome before being sent back - such as enemies and blocks - will regenerate. Banishback cannot be harmed by anything other than Jumbo Candy, and it is ultimately harmless, if not a nuisance. Defeating a Banishback grants the player 500 points. 怪盗洛切（Daroach） states them to be the guards of the castle, though he doesn't mention them by name in the British English version.

One of the Checklist objectives ("Forward Mover") is for the Kirbys to make it through Volcano Valley - Stage 4 without ever touching a Banishback and without using a shortcut.

wikirby-page:5605.description_zh:
“据说巨大的Battybat守护着一枚勋章。我听说他住在一个潮湿的地方，这附近有一个非常潮湿的地方，经常下雨。那附近有一门大炮，但不要使用它，否则你永远找不到Battybat。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），关于Green Grounds - Stage 4中的Battybat，
Battybat是一种只在Kirby Mass Attack出现的大型飞行敌人。他的基本外观是一个球形的紫色蝙蝠，粉色眼睛，巨大的红色嘴巴，两颗小獠牙和小粉色角。他的头顶呈现兰花图案。根据怪盗洛切（Daroach）在他的飞船上交谈时所说，蝙蝠喜欢潮湿的地方。其中一只在Green Grounds - Stage 4的一处非常潮湿的洞穴里安了家，另外两只在与瀑布和水在Dedede Resort - Stage 7中。他们喜欢潮湿的地方，这可能解释了为什么在Volcano Valley中找不到他们与其他所有蝙蝠一起。

Battybat的主要攻击模式是他试图通过在卡比（Kirby）上方飞行并用下颚抓住一个来攻击它们。当这种情况发生时，其他Kirby必须在他击倒一个之前攻击他。如果Battybat错过了Kirby，他的下颚会卡在地上，这给了Kirby一个巨大的机会来击败他。击败Battybat会为玩家提供500点。
wikirby-page:5605.description_en:
“It's said that the huge Battybat guards a medal. I've heard he makes his home in a damp place, and there's a very damp spot around here where it rains. There's a cannon near that area, but don't use it, or you'll never find Battybat.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, regarding the Battybat in Green Grounds - Stage 4
Battybat is a large flying enemy appearing only in Kirby Mass Attack. His basic appearance is that of a spherical, purple bat with pink eyes, a massive red mouth, two small fangs, and little pink horns. He presents an orchid pattern atop his head. According to 怪盗洛切（Daroach） when talked to in his airship, Battybats like damp places. One of them made his home in a very damp cave spot in Green Grounds - Stage 4, and two of them are inside the pirate ship with waterfalls and water in Dedede Resort - Stage 7. They liking damp places may explain why they are not found in Volcano Valley with all the other bats.

Battybat's main attack pattern consists of him trying to attack the 卡比（Kirby）s by flying above them and snatching one up in his jaws. When this happens, the other Kirbys must attack him before he KOs one. If Battybat misses the Kirbys, his jaws will get stuck in the ground, giving the Kirbys a big opening to defeat him. Defeating Battybat confers 500 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:5408.description_zh:
KMA叶芽（Beanbon）Sprite.png叶芽（Beanbon）是一种小型且常见的绿色嫩芽状敌人，仅出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它通常会被看到缓慢地从左向右蹒跚而行，如果发现任何卡比（Kirby），它会尝试向其射出种子进行攻击。叶芽（Beanbon）是Kirby Mass Attack中最常见的敌人之一——几乎以各种形式出现在大多数关卡中，并有许多替代形态——并且基本上取代了瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）成为游戏中最基础的弱敌人，因为Waddle Dees在本作中较为少见。击败一个可为玩家获得100点分数。

卡比（Kirby）的大规模攻击之一Checklist目标，“叶芽（Beanbon）粉碎者”，可通过在游戏中击败至少50个常规Beanbons获得。
wikirby-page:5408.description_en:
KMA 叶芽（Beanbon） Sprite.png 叶芽（Beanbon） is a small and common green sprout-shaped enemy that is exclusive to Kirby Mass Attack. It can commonly be seen waddling slowly from left to right and if it spots any 卡比（Kirby）s, it will attempt to shoot a seed at them to attack. 叶芽（Beanbon） is among the most ubiquitous enemies in Kirby Mass Attack — appearing in most stages in some form or another and with many alternate forms — and essentially replaces 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） as the most basic weak enemy in the game, due to Waddle Dees being less common in this title. Defeating one confers 100 points to the player.

One of 卡比（Kirby） Mass Attacks Checklist objectives, "叶芽（Beanbon） Basher", is obtained by defeating at least 50 regular Beanbons throughout the game.

wikirby-page:5578.description_zh: Big Beanbon是叶芽（Beanbon）的大型版本，出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它具有大多数标准叶芽（Beanbon）的相同特性，但更强壮，并且在下落时能够用其体积碾压下方的卡比（Kirby）。它还能够快速连续发射三枚爆炸种子，而不是一枚。击败它会为玩家奖励500点。
wikirby-page:5578.description_en: Big Beanbon is a larger version of 叶芽（Beanbon） that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It has most of the same characteristics as a standard 叶芽（Beanbon）, but is tougher and has the ability to crush 卡比（Kirby）s below with its girth when it falls. It also has the ability to shoot three explosive seeds in quick succession instead of one. Defeating one confers 500 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12632.description_zh:
“每晚，从那座阴影笼罩的宅邸里都会传来可怕的砰砰声。当闪电劈下时，可以看到一个巨大的方形身影。闪电也会显露出它的弱点。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）描述Big Blucko在Kirby Mass Attack
Big Blucko是一种大型且罕见的方块敌人，只会出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它是标准Blucko的大型变体。但其外观截然不同，拥有厚重的金属框架和中间显眼的空腔，这个空腔可以放置各种物品，包括Fruit或Medal。

Big Blucko通过沿其侧面滚动来攻击，并会压碎任何被困在下面的卡比（Kirby），使其瞬间死亡。为了要获得里面的物品，卡比（Kirby）必须反复将自己投向Big Blucko的两个较弱的石质侧面之一，以击败生物，同时为玩家获得1000分。
wikirby-page:12632.description_en:
“Every night, a terrible thumping can be heard coming from the shadowy mansion. When the lightning catches it, an immense square figure can be seen. The lightning also reveals its weak spots.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） describing a Big Blucko in Kirby Mass Attack
Big Blucko is a large and uncommon block enemy that appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a larger variant of the standard Blucko. but its appearance is very different, sporting a heavy metal frame and a noticeable cavity in the middle which can contain various items, including Fruit or a Medal.

Big Blucko attacks by rolling along its sides in a given direction, and will crush any 卡比（Kirby）s caught underneath, defeating them instantaneously. In order to gain access to the item inside, the 卡比（Kirby）s must fling themselves repeatedly at one of the two weaker stony sides of the Big Blucko in order to defeat the creature, conferring 1,000 points onto the player in the process.

wikirby-page:12518.description_zh:
“在驾驶坦克时，你会看到一个开关，用来决定你行驶哪条路径。如果你激活那个开关，你将走上一条路径，在那里你会看到一个拿着奖章的敌人。他会试图逃跑，所以快点打败他，否则他会带着那枚奖章逃掉！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），指Volcano Valley - Stage 2中的Big Floof
Big Floof是Floof的一个较大变体，出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。他在大多数方面与较小的Floof相似，但正如人们所料，他具有更强的Health。他可以在各种阶段中找到，并且通常会试图带着其中一枚奖牌漂走。卡比（Kirby）们将需要追上他并猛烈攻击以获得他持有的奖牌。击败Big Floof将为玩家奖励1,000分。
wikirby-page:12518.description_en:
“While riding the tank, you'll see a switch that determines which of two paths you rumble down. If you activate that switch, you'll travel down a path where you'll see an enemy carrying a medal. He'll try to escape, so defeat him quickly, or else he'll get away with that medal!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, referring to the Big Floof in Volcano Valley - Stage 2
Big Floof is a larger variant of Floof that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. He is similar in most every respect to the smaller Floof, but he has greater Health, as one might expect. He can be found in various stages, and will usually attempt to float away with one of the medals. The 卡比（Kirby）s will need to chase him down and pummel him to get the medal he has. Defeating Big Floof confers 1,000 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12611.description_zh:
Big Iceton是一个大型冰块敌人，首次出现在Kirby Mass Attack的Dedede Resort - Stage 8中。与其较小的变体Iceton不同，它通过沿侧面滚动而非跳跃进行攻击。任何被这块滚动的冰块压到的卡比（Kirby）将立即被击败。要击败Big Iceton，Kirbys必须反复将其抛向冰块，将其击碎。击败后，它将赋予1,000点分数。

Big Iceton也出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中，作为路线角色出现在Road Trip的Neon Promenade上。它将Dimension Meteor砸下，摧毁了障碍物和自身，从而开启通向Crystal-Clear Crossing
wikirby-page:12611.description_en:
Big Iceton is a large, icy block enemy that first appears in Kirby Mass Attack, in Dedede Resort - Stage 8. Unlike its smaller variant Iceton, it attacks by rolling along its sides rather than jumping. Any 卡比（Kirby）s caught underneath this block as it rolls will be instantly defeated. To defeat the Big Iceton, the Kirbys must be flung into it repeatedly to shatter it after several hits. Once defeated it will be conferred into 1,000 points.

Big Iceton also appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） as a route character on Neon Promenade in Road Trip. It slams down on the Dimension Meteor blocking the way, destroying both the hazard and itself, which leads the way to Crystal-Clear Crossing

wikirby-page:12534.description_zh:
“那些用绷带包裹的敌人被称为木木怪。而大的呢？它们被称为大木木怪。无论大或小，它们看起来都像是真正的威胁。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Big Mummbon中是Mummbon的一种更大变体，出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它拥有和较小的同类相同的外观和能力，但可以一次吐出三个有毒小球，而且凭借体型可以压碎卡比（Kirby）。击败Big Mummbon可以获得500分，但像普通的Mummbon一样，Big Mummbon在一段时间后会重新形成并再次攻击。它只能通过舞台危险永久击败，被压碎，或在KAIRBYS受到Jumbo Candy效果时被击中才能彻底消灭。
wikirby-page:12534.description_en:
“The foes wrapped up in bandages are called Mummbons. And the big ones? They're known as Big Mummbons. Big or small, though, they seem like a real menace.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Big Mummbon is a larger variant of Mummbon that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It sports the same general look and abilities as its smaller cousins, though it can spit out three poisonous globs at once, and can crush 卡比（Kirby）s with its girth. Big Mummbon is worth 500 points when defeated, but like the regular Mummbon, Big Mummbon will reconstitute itself after a while and attack again. It can only be permanently defeated using stage hazards, by being crushed, or by being hit by Kirbys under the effect of Jumbo Candy.

wikirby-page:38670.description_zh:
“A Big Schnoz潜伏在那枚勋章附近。要击败他，你需要尽可能多次、尽可能快速地推动他。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Big Schnoz中，有一个稍大的Schnoz版本。他与较小的Schnoz区别在于他的红色外观和末端被磨平的大獠牙。Big Schnoz出现在Green Grounds - Stage 5中，同时伴随他的变种Schnoz和Bigger Schnoz。他还出现在大厦的Volcano Valley - Stage 6中以及隐藏房间的Sandy Canyon - Stage 9中。要击败他，卡比（Kirby）必须推动他的方块来困住他，然后压碎他，否则Kirbys会遭同样的命运。恰如其分的是，击败一个Big Schnoz比击败较小的Schnoz。击败Big Schnoz可为玩家获得500点。在Sandy Canyon -阶段9中，Big Schnoz可以被痛击。有趣的是，他只需要一个卡比（Kirby）就能被击倒，尽管需要一些时间。
wikirby-page:38670.description_en:
“A Big Schnoz lurks near that medal. To defeat him, you'll need to push against him as many times as you can, and as FAST as possible.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Big Schnoz is a slightly larger version of Schnoz in Kirby Mass Attack. He is distinguished from the smaller Schnoz by his red coloration and his larger tusks worn flat on the ends. Big Schnoz appears in Green Grounds - Stage 5 along with his variants, Schnoz and Bigger Schnoz. He also appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 6 in the mansion and Sandy Canyon - Stage 9 in a hidden room.To defeat him, the 卡比（Kirby）s must push back on his block to trap him, then crush him, lest the Kirbys suffer the same fate. Appropriately, it takes more effort to defeat a Big Schnoz than the smaller Schnoz. Defeating Big Schnoz confers 500 points onto the player. In Sandy Canyon - Stage 9, Big Schnoz can be pummeled. Interestingly, he only takes one 卡比（Kirby） to be taken down, although it takes time.

wikirby-page:12481.description_zh:
Big Soarar是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它是标准Soarar的一个更大版本。在Green Grounds - Stage 7中，如果卡比（Kirby）不能打破树顶的巨蛋，Big Soarar会出现并带走巨蛋。

后来在Volcano Valley - Stage 2中，Big Soarar成为战车需要击落的敌人之一。这样做会奖励玩家1,000点。
wikirby-page:12481.description_en:
Big Soarar is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a much larger version of a standard Soarar. In Green Grounds - Stage 7, if the 卡比（Kirby）s fail to break open the giant egg at the top of the tree, Big Soarar appears to take the egg away.

Later on, in Volcano Valley - Stage 2, Big Soarar appears as one of the enemies to be shot down by the tank. Doing so rewards the player with 1,000 points.

wikirby-page:12592.description_zh: Big Stackle是来自Kirby Mass Attack的Stickle的超大变种。它呈品红色，覆盖着金色尖刺，而这些尖刺上还有尖刺。Big Stackle只出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 6中，它会从水中跃出并摧毁金属方块。最终，它会偷走一扇门并游向钓竿，Kirbys可以从那里把它钓上来。击败Big Stackle可以获得1000分。
wikirby-page:12592.description_en: Big Stackle is an extra-large variant of Stickle from Kirby Mass Attack. It is magenta in hue and covered with gold spikes which themselves have spikes. Big Stackle appears only in Dedede Resort - Stage 6, where it leaps out of the water and destroys metal blocks. Eventually, it will steal a door and swim to a fishing rod, where the Kirbys can fish it out. Defeating the Big Stackle is worth 1,000 points.

wikirby-page:12523.description_zh:
“有一个Big Stactus正躺在某处由金属块组成的地板上。击败Big Stactus可以将它用作一个很好的冲撞器。它们能够召唤出荆棘风暴，因此如果发生这种情况，你们需要分散开来！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），关于Sandy Canyon - Stage 3中的Big Stactus，
Big Stactus是Stactus的一种较大的变体，出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。与它的较小表亲不同，Big Stactus通常是独自出现的。当它发现卡比（Kirby）s时，Big Stactus将尝试从它的花中射下四个带箭的种子，这些种子从上方落下，冲击时会伤害到Kirby。击败Big Stactus可以为玩家带来500分。

中型boss Bigger Stactus的头部非常像Big Stactus当部分埋入沙子中时。
wikirby-page:12523.description_en:
“There's a Big Stactus lounging on top of a floor made of metal blocks somewhere. A Big Stactus can make for a great battering ram, if you defeat it. They can summon a storm of thorns, so you'll have to scatter yourselves if that happens!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, regarding the Big Stactus in Sandy Canyon - Stage 3
Big Stactus is a larger variant of Stactus that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. Unlike its smaller cousins, Big Stactus is typically found on its own. When it spots the 卡比（Kirby）s, Big Stactus will attempt to shoot down four arrowed seeds from its flower, which fall from above and can harm the Kirbys on impact. Defeating Big Stactus confers 500 points to the player.

The mid-boss Bigger Stactus has a head that greatly resembles a Big Stactus when partially buried in the sand.

wikirby-page:12658.description_zh: KMA Big Zombon sprite.png Big Zombon是Zombon的一个较大变体，仅出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它的体型使Big Zombon比较小的同类更强壮。从悬崖跳下时，Big Zombon可以压扁下面的卡比（Kirby）。它也可以一次从头部发射三个使人僵尸化的球体。击败Big Zombon可以为玩家带来500分。像普通僵尸兽一样，它过一段时间会再次从地面冒出。再次击败它不会获得任何分数或水果。
wikirby-page:12658.description_en: KMA Big Zombon sprite.png Big Zombon is a larger variant of Zombon which appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack. Its size makes Big Zombon hardier than its smaller counterparts. When jumping from a cliff, Big Zombon can squish 卡比（Kirby）s below. It can also shoot three zombifying blobs from its head at a time. Defeating a Big Zombon confers 500 points onto the player. Like regular Zombons, it will pop back out of the ground after a while. Defeating it again won't grant any points or fruit.

wikirby-page:12485.description_zh:
Bigger Beanbon是Kirby Mass Attack中叶芽（Beanbon）的超大版本，只出现在Sub-Game中。它比已经很大的Big Beanbon还要大，并且与它较小的同类相比，脸部轮廓非常清晰。

Bigger Beanbon出现在两个子游戏中。在Strato Patrol EOS中，可以看到三个它守护风语大树（Whispy Woods）并一次射出五颗种子。击败较大的Beanbons需要多次射击。在Kirby Quest中，在第1章第8关会面对一个单独的Bigger Beanbon，拥有800点生命值。在这里，它每次未击中都会向Kirby射出四颗种子，击中的Kirby将在剩下的战斗中淘汰。

作为子游戏敌人，Bigger Beanbon的名字从日本版的敌人名册中从未显示。call.
wikirby-page:12485.description_en:
Bigger Beanbon is a super-sized version of 叶芽（Beanbon） from Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in the Sub-Games. It is significantly larger than the already large Big Beanbon, and has a very defined face compared to its smaller cousins.

Bigger Beanbon appears in two Sub-Games. In Strato Patrol EOS, three are seen guarding 风语大树（Whispy Woods） and shooting five seeds at a time. The Bigger Beanbons require several shots to be defeated. In Kirby Quest, a singular Bigger Beanbon is faced in Chapter 1 - Stage 8, and has 800 HP. Here, it shoots four seeds at the Kirbys for every miss, knocking out those hit for the rest of the battle.

As it is a Sub-Game enemy, Bigger Beanbon's name is never shown in the Japanese enemy roll call.

wikirby-page:12464.description_zh:
Bigger Schnoz是来自Kirby Mass Attack的Schnoz的更大型版本，只出现在Green Grounds - Stage 5的末端。它看起来和它的小型同类很相似，但它是绿色的，尾巴有环状，并且带有可伸缩的尖刺。当卡比（Kirby）遇到它时，Bigger Schnoz会试图将舞台出口从它们身边推开。要打败它，Kirbys必须在尾巴没有尖刺的时候抓住它，并尽全力拉。如果失败，Bigger Schnoz会把它们甩开，并使带刺的坚果掉到它们的头上。

要完成关卡而不使用捷径，必须打败Bigger Schnoz，并且会为玩家提供1000分。
wikirby-page:12464.description_en:
Bigger Schnoz is an even larger version of Schnoz from Kirby Mass Attack, appearing only at the end of Green Grounds - Stage 5. It looks similar to its smaller cousins, but it is green, and bears a ringed tail with retractable spikes. When the 卡比（Kirby）s encounter it, Bigger Schnoz will try to push the stage exit away from them. To defeat it, the Kirbys must grab onto its tail when it is not spiked, and pull as hard as they can. If they fail, Bigger Schnoz will shake them off, and cause spiked nuts to fall on their heads.

Defeating Bigger Schnoz is required to complete the level without using the shortcut, and confers 1,000 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12440.description_zh:
Birdee是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人和盟友。它是一只大圆鸟，会携带各种东西，包括水果、坚果，有时还有奖牌。在游戏的早期阶段，当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，它会试图向它们扔坚果。然而，Birdee可以被至少2个Kirby一次攻击击败，而且通常并不构成很大威胁。击败Birdee可以获得200分。

 Birdees有一个母亲叫Big Birdee，Kirby会在几次机会中遇到她。在Green Grounds - Stage 3与大Birdee战斗之前，Kirby必须面对一波向他们投掷红色尖球的Birdees。在Sandy Canyon - Stage 11救出Wee Birdee后，双方，Birdees成为Kirby们的盟友，给他们提供有用的物品，并协助他们对抗头骨大王（Skullord）。例如，在Dedede Resort - Stage 11中，可以找到拿着铃铛的Birdees；摇动它们的铃铛会召唤大Birdee，它会让Kirby们搭乘。拿着铃铛的Birdees不能被伤害，并且会甩掉任何试图抓住它们的Kirby们。
wikirby-page:12440.description_en:
Birdee is an enemy and ally in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a big round bird which carries various things, including fruit, nuts and sometimes medals. In early stages of the game, it will attempt to throw the nuts at the 卡比（Kirby）s when they approach. Birdee can be defeated in one attack by at least 2 Kirbys, however, and typically is not much of a threat. Birdee is worth 200 points when defeated.

The Birdees have a mother called Big Birdee, who the Kirbys run into on a couple occasions. Prior to the battle against Big Birdee in Green Grounds - Stage 3, the Kirbys must fight a wave of Birdees that throw red spiked balls at them. After rescuing the Wee Birdees in Sandy Canyon - Stage 11, an understanding is made between the two parties, and the Birdees become the Kirbys' allies instead, giving them helpful items, and aiding them against 头骨大王（Skullord）. For instance, in Dedede Resort - Stage 11, Birdees holding bells can be found; ringing their bell summons Big Birdee, who gives the Kirbys a lift. The Birdees with bells cannot be damaged, and will shake off any Kirbys that try to latch onto them.

wikirby-page:38682.description_zh: Biripper是蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的近亲，也是Kirby Mass Attack中的一种水生敌人。它看起来与其更常见的表亲几乎一模一样，只是采用了橙色和紫色的配色。然而，它与标准的蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的不同之处在于它能够在自身周围导电并释放电场，类似于電火花怪（Sparky）。在释放电流时，它会向卡比（Kirby）游去；任何被电流波及的卡比都会受到伤害。然而，由于这种电流释放只是周期性进行的，因此当Biripper没有发射火花时，通过猛烈攻击它可以将其击败并获得200分。
wikirby-page:38682.description_en: Biripper is a relative of 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） and an aquatic enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It looks practically identical to its more common cousin except for its orange and purple color scheme. What sets it apart from a standard 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）, however, is its ability to conduct and discharge an electric field around itself, similar to 電火花怪（Sparky）. When discharging, it swims towards the 卡比（Kirby）s; any Kirbys caught in this discharge will take damage. As this discharge is only sent periodically, however, Biripper can be defeated by pummeling when it is not emitting sparks to gain 200 points.

wikirby-page:12538.description_zh:
“确保带上10个Kirby进入关卡，并带上所有Blamboom炮台。这说起来容易做起来难。在那些Blambooms附近操作非常困难！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Blamboom中是一个敌人，它是一个机械旋转炮台，每当炮口面对左边或右边时就会开火。在每个部分的背面都有一个开关，如果完全按下，会摧毁该部分。击败Blamboom将为玩家增加400分。Blamboom的射击可以摧毁金属方块，这对于发现某些物品很有用，比如Medals。
wikirby-page:12538.description_en:
“Be sure to take 10 Kirbys into the stage with all the Blamboom cannons. That's easier said than done. It's hard to maneuver near those Blambooms!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Blamboom is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a mechanical set of rotating cannons which fire whenever the gun is facing left or right. On the back of each segment is a switch when, if pressed fully in, will destroy that segment. Defeating Blamboom will confer 400 points onto the player. Blamboom's shots can destroy metal blocks, which can be useful for uncovering certain items, such as Medals.

wikirby-page:5591.description_zh:
“那些会从嘴里喷射水柱的水生敌人被称为Blish。它们会试图向猎物喷水。我打赌你可以诱使它把宝物喷到你手里。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
