Blish是一种像水生射手鱼的敌人，只出现在Kirby Mass Attack。按定义，它被认为是大型敌人，但由于它生活在水中，其大体型并不构成威胁。大多数Blishes都被放置在无法到达的位置，但如果卡比（Kirby）能够接近它们，它们就像其他敌人一样脆弱，尽管它们有大量生命值。击败Blish可获得300分。

Blish的基本外观是一条圆形绿色的鱼有着大嘴唇和不成比例的小鳍。它们总是朝上，并且每当卡比（Kirby）靠近时，会从嘴里喷出尖锐如刺的水射流。这些刺可以将奖牌移动到卡比（Kirby）的可及范围内，破坏金属块，或者如果卡比（Kirby）触碰到，会造成伤害。
wikirby-page:5591.description_en:
“The aquatic foes that spit geysers upward from their mouths are called Blish. They try to spray water at their prey. I bet you can trick one into blasting its treasure into your hands.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Blish is an aquatic archerfish-like enemy that only appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It is considered a large enemy in size by definition, but since it resides in water, its large size is not a threat. Most Blishes are positioned such so that they cannot be reached, but if 卡比（Kirby） is able to get to it, they are as vulnerable as any other enemy, although they have a large amount of health. Blish is worth 300 points when defeated.

The Blish's basic appearance is that of a rounded, green fish with large lips and disproportionately small fins. They always face upwards, and project sharp barb-like water jets out of their mouths whenever 卡比（Kirby） approaches close. These barbs can move medals into 卡比（Kirby）'s reach, break metal blocks, or cause harm if touched by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:12601.description_zh: Blucko是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它类似于一个Star Block，并伪装成它，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近。然后它会露出眼睛，跃入空中，试图在接触时压扁柯比（Kirbys）。可以通过向它扔卡比（Kirby）来击败它，从而给予玩家100分。
wikirby-page:12601.description_en: Blucko is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a Star Block, and camouflages as one until the 卡比（Kirby）s get near. It then reveals its eyes, and leaps into the air, attempting to squish the Kirbys on contact. It can be defeated by throwing a 卡比（Kirby） at it, conferring 100 points to the player in the process.

wikirby-page:12633.description_zh:
Bohboh是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一种小型的红色猪状生物，会从嘴里喷火。任何被其火焰喷中卡比（Kirby）的都会被点燃，需要找到水来扑灭火焰，否则将会被击倒。击败Bohboh会为玩家带来300分。

Bohboh也可以用水扑灭，这时它会变成浅蓝色，并失去喷火能力，从而更容易被击败。
wikirby-page:12633.description_en:
Bohboh is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It's a small red pig-like creature that breathes fire from its mouth. Any 卡比（Kirby）s caught in its fiery breath will be ignited and will need to find water to douse the flames, or else they will be KO'd. Defeating Bohboh confers 300 points onto the player.

Bohboh can also be doused in water, wherein it will gain a light blue coloration and lose its ability to breathe fire, becoming more easily defeatable.

wikirby-page:12643.description_zh:
Bombpeller是Kirby Mass Attack中一种耐久的飞行敌人，它看起来像一个黑色卡通风格的炸弹，带有直升机元素，顶部有燃烧的引线和螺旋桨，因此得名，背部有尾桨。它还戴着一副飞行员护目镜，这也与它的特性相关。Bombpeller出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 2中，是卡比（Kirby）射击坦克的对手之一。如果长时间不干预，它会直接飞向坦克并爆炸。用卡比（Kirby）击中它可以防止这种情况发生。Bombpeller在被击中三次后会被摧毁，奖励玩家200分。

Bombpeller从未被怪盗洛切（Daroach）直接提及，也未在原版日文版本之外命名。
wikirby-page:12643.description_en:
Bombpeller is a durable flying enemy in Kirby Mass Attack which resembles a black cartoon-style bomb with elements of a helicopter, with a lit fuse and a propeller on top, hence its name, and a tail rotor on its back. It also sports a pair of aviator's goggles, which also ties in to its nature. Bombpeller appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 2, as one of the opponents for the 卡比（Kirby）-firing tank. If left alone for too long, it will fly right into the tank and explode. Hitting it with a 卡比（Kirby） will prevent this from happening. Bombpeller is destroyed after three such hits, rewarding the player with 200 points.

Bombpeller is never directly mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, nor is it named outside of the original Japanese release.

wikirby-page:12660.description_zh:
Buufuu是出现在Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一个猪鼻子敌人，戴着白色骷髅般的头盔，并在空中悬停。它会偶尔吹出强烈的气流，可以把卡比（Kirby）推开。虽然这种气流本身无害，但可能导致Kirby被吹到有危险的地方，例如Helmee的长矛或被吹下骷髅塔。击败Buufuu可以为玩家带来300分。

头骨大王（Skullord）——Volcano Valley的Boss——是一个由Necrodeus授权负责Skull Gang Popopo Islands上的“贪婪猪”。它看起来像Buufuu，但它们之间的关系尚未被直接确认。
wikirby-page:12660.description_en:
Buufuu is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a pig-nosed enemy that wears a white skull-like helmet and hovers in place. It will occasionally blow out large gusts of air which can push the 卡比（Kirby）s back. While this gust is harmless, it may result in the Kirbys getting blown into something that is not, such as a Helmee’s lance or getting blown off the Skull Tower. Defeating Buufuu confers 300 points onto the player.

头骨大王（Skullord） - the boss of Volcano Valley - is a "greedy pig" empowered by Necrodeus to oversee the Skull Gang on the Popopo Islands. He resembles Buufuu, but their relation has not been directly confirmed.

wikirby-page:38691.description_zh:
Child Ship是一艘小型银色宇宙飞船，在Kirby Mass Attack中作为一个小型敌人出现。它呈稍微的圆柱形，表面光滑，上半部分银色板之间有三个小的洋红色舷窗，顶部有一个小天线。在Volcano Valley - Stage 10中，在面对Mothership之前，卡比（Kirby）的飞船会遇到三个这样的飞船。当Child Ship接近时，它会快速传送以躲避任何可能的激光射击。过一段时间，如果它没有被击落，它会将一个Space Oohroo传送进Kirbys的飞船中。它会持续不断地传送并召唤Space Oohroos，尽管在任何时刻屏幕上被部署的Space Oohroos不会超过2个。子舰可以被摧毁伴随五次激光爆炸。

Child Ship是少数在游戏结尾的日本独占敌人点名中没有给出名字的敌人之一。它仍出现在点名中Space Oohroo的后面，带有游戏中其他地方没有的绿色色调。
wikirby-page:38691.description_en:
Child Ship is a small silver spacecraft that appears as a minor enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is somewhat cylindrical in shape with a sleek surface, three small magenta portholes in the upper half between the silver plates, and a small antenna on the top. Three of them are faced by the 卡比（Kirby）s in their spaceship in Volcano Valley - Stage 10, prior to facing down the Mothership. As a Child Ship approaches, it teleports around quickly to avoid any potential laser fire. After a while, if it is not shot down, it will beam a Space Oohroo into the Kirbys' ship. It continues teleporting around and summoning Space Oohroos indefinitely, although no more than 2 deployed Space Oohroos can be on-screen at any given time. Child Ships can be destroyed with five laser blasts.

Child Ship is one of the few enemies whose name is not given in the Japanese-exclusive enemy roll call at the end of the game. It still appears behind Space Oohroo in the roll call, with a green tint not seen elsewhere in game.

wikirby-page:12529.description_zh:
“从地里冒出的钳芽可以被引诱到你想让它攻击的准确位置。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Clanksprout中有一个敌人在Kirby Mass Attack。它由一条长链子组成，链子的头部是铁夹。它会保持在地下，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近，这时它会试图弹出。如果柯比们在它弹出时在它上方，将会有一个被Clanksprout的嘴捕捉，并且如果没有被其他人解救，将受到伤害。Clanksprout的头部是它的弱点，可以通过击打将其打败，使玩家获得500分。Clanksprout也可以通过使用Jumbo Candy轻松打败，使它在独特的死亡动画中分裂开。

Clanksprout能够破坏金属在它弹起时会阻挡。这可以被利用来获取某些物品。

 Clanksprout有两种颜色变体，它们的行为略有不同：青绿色变体总是停留在同一个位置，而紫色变体会尝试在地面上跟随Kirbys移动。

在Sandy Canyon的Stage 8中，会遇到一个巨大的对应体，称为Giga Clanksprout。这种Clanksprout的变体更机械化，比标准的同类给Kirbys带来更多麻烦。
wikirby-page:12529.description_en:
“And the Clanksprouts that shoot out of the earth can be lured to strike exactly where you want.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Clanksprout is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It consists of a long chain with a clamp for a head. It remains underground until the 卡比（Kirby）s approach, at which point it will try to spring out. If the Kirbys are above it when it springs up, one will be caught in Clanksprout's mouth and will take damage if not freed by the others. Clanksprout's head is its vulnerable part, and can be pummeled to defeat it, conferring 500 points onto the player. Clanksprout can also easily be defeated using Jumbo Candy, causing it to split apart in a unique death animation.

Clanksprout is capable of breaking metal blocks when it springs up. This can be taken advantage of to obtain certain items.

There are two color variants of Clanksprout that behave slightly differently from each other: the teal variant always stays in the same spot while the purple one attempts to follow the Kirbys as they move over the dirt.

In the Stage 8 of Sandy Canyon, a gigantic counterpart is encountered, known as Giga Clanksprout. This variant of Clanksprout is more mechanical and gives more trouble to the Kirbys than its standard cousin.

wikirby-page:12516.description_zh:
Crap是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个机器人敌人，只在Kirby Quest Sub-Game中出现。它的构造像一辆微小的绿色坦克，拥有两组小履带用于移动，两个圆形眼睛像望远镜，以及一个敞开的圆形口部，外观类似炽热头（Hot Head）或Flotzo。它头顶是平的，只有两个微小的耳状凸起。

Craps在Kirby Quest的第18关和第34关出现，分别成群4个和5个。每个拥有120 HP。如果卡比（Kirby）未能攻击，Crap将会跑向他，然后坍塌成一堆瓦砾，露出内部的炸弹（Bomb）并爆炸。这次攻击将立即击败目标卡比（Kirby）无论他的地位如何，都将摧毁Crap本身。Crap的名字在游戏中没有出现，即便是在日文版中也是如此。虽然它的内部文件名是“Crap”，但它的名字最早是由Kirby Mass Attack的设计师中山孝之在2021年通过Twitter官方公布的（存档）。这一点在2022年发布的日本卡比（Kirby）角色百科中得到了重申。“Crap”很可能来源于“scrap”，指该敌人很可能是由废金属制成的。
wikirby-page:12516.description_en:
Crap is a robotic enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, appearing only in the Kirby Quest Sub-Game. It is built like a tiny green tank with two sets of small treads for movement, two circular eyes resembling spyglasses, and an open circular port for a mouth, similar in look to that of 炽热头（Hot Head） or Flotzo. The top of its head is flat except for two tiny ear-like prongs.

Craps are fought in Stage 18 and Stage 34 of Kirby Quest, in groups of 4 and 5 respectively. Each one has 120 HP. If 卡比（Kirby） fails to attack, the Crap will run up to him and then collapse into a pile of rubble, revealing the 炸弹（Bomb） inside which will explode. This attack will immediately defeat the targeted 卡比（Kirby） regardless of his status, and will destroy the Crap itself.

Crap's name is not given in-game, even in the Japanese version. While its internal filename is "Crap," its name was first officially revealed by Takayuki Nakayama, a designer for Kirby Mass Attack, on Twitter in 2021 (archive). This was reaffirmed in the Japanese 卡比（Kirby） Character Encyclopedia, released in 2022. "Crap" most likely comes from "scrap", referring to how the enemy is likely built out of scrap metal.

wikirby-page:12513.description_zh:
“沙漠中有许多仙人掌生物。但很难忽视Crazy Stactus。他就是那个随着音乐摇摆的家伙。当音乐停止时，就是攻击他花瓣头的时候！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Crazy Stactus是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。他是Stactus的一种非常高瘦的变种，会随着舞台主题的节奏疯狂摆动。当他摆动时，任何试图攻击他头部的卡比（Kirby）都会被弹开，并且攻击底部的人会受到伤害。有时，Crazy Stactus会停止移动，打开他的花朵，让Kirbys有机会抓住并击败他。在Sandy Canyon - Stage 4中，会出现Crazy Stactus的黄色变种，除了能够随音乐摆动外，还能在地面上缓慢滑行。摇摆。

在击败后，玩家将获得700点，并且Crazy Stactus会分裂并落向他摇摆的一侧，在此过程中可能会撞破金属方块。
wikirby-page:12513.description_en:
“There are so many cactus creatures in the desert. But it's hard to miss Crazy Stactus. He's the one who sways to the music. When the music stops, that's the time to launch your attack on his petal head!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Crazy Stactus is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. He is a very tall, skinny variant of Stactus which wiggles around wildly to the beat of the stage theme. When he wiggles, he will bounce off any 卡比（Kirby）s who try to attack his head, and damage those who hit the base. On occasion, Crazy Stactus will stop moving, and open his flower, giving the Kirbys an opportunity to latch on and defeat him. In Sandy Canyon - Stage 4, a yellow variant of Crazy Stactus appears, that has the ability to slowly slide on the ground in addition to wiggling.

Upon defeat, the player will gain 700 points and Crazy Stactus will split and fall to whichever side he was swaying on, potentially crashing through metal blocks in the process.

wikirby-page:12635.description_zh:
“在这么炽热的地方你在哪里能找到水呢？嗯，有点棘手。你得动脑筋。注意Cryballs。如果你让那些奇怪的眼球哭泣，你就能吓到自己，从而得到一场漂亮的淋浴。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Cryball中是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一个带有勋章盖和睫毛刺的飞行眼球。当它发现卡比（Kirby）时，它会翻转过来，然后试图压碎它们。当眼睛被击中时，Cryball会哭泣，它的泪水可以让植物生长。Cryball在被击中三次后将被摧毁，并奖励玩家400分。
wikirby-page:12635.description_en:
“Where can you get water in such baking places? Hmm. Tricky. You'll have to be clever about it. Watch for Cryballs. If you make those odd eyeballs cry, you'll scare yourself up a nice shower.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Cryball is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a flying eyeball with a medal lid and spikes for eyelashes. When it spots the 卡比（Kirby）s, it will flip over, then attempt to crush them. When hit on the eye, Cryball cries, and its tears can grow plants. Cryball will be destroyed after 3 hits, rewarding the player with 400 points.

wikirby-page:12626.description_zh:
“这是一个在生活中帮我走得很远的小窍门。远离任何扔到你身上的蛋糕。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），指的是Dekofloof出现在Kirby Mass Attack
左边的Dekofloof，它是Floof的一个戴着紫色派对帽的亲戚，出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它会飞在卡比（Kirby）上方，偶尔向它们投掷蛋糕。如果卡比（Kirby）被蛋糕击中，该卡比（Kirby）会变得臃肿，并在吃蛋糕时静止不动。这最终是无害的，但在更危险的敌人行动时，它可能会使卡比（Kirby）无法移动。肿胀的卡比（Kirby）在一定时间后或玩家点击该卡比（Kirby）后会恢复正常。

Dekofloof可以被击败，获得500分，但它是比其标准对手更为坚韧。它还会在能力范围内无情地追击卡比，同时一路向它们投掷蛋糕。

Dekofloof仅出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 10中。Dekofloof在日文版之外没有名称，而怪盗洛切（Daroach）没有提到它的名字，但他确实在告诉卡比们避开敌人投掷的蛋糕时提及了它。
wikirby-page:12626.description_en:
“Here's a tip that's gotten me a long way in life. Steer clear of any cake that's thrown at you.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, referring to Dekofloof in Kirby Mass Attack
left Dekofloof is a purple party-hat wearing relative of Floof that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It flies above the 卡比（Kirby）s, tossing cake down on them on occasion. If a 卡比（Kirby） is hit by a cake, that 卡比（Kirby） will become bloated and sit still while eating the cake. This is ultimately harmless, but it can immobilize a 卡比（Kirby） while other more dangerous enemies make their moves. A bloated 卡比（Kirby） will return to normal after a certain amount of time, or if the player taps on said 卡比（Kirby）.

Dekofloof can be defeated for 500 points, but it is much more hardy than its standard counterparts. It will also relentlessly pursue the Kirbys while it can, dropping cakes on them as it goes.

Dekofloof appears solely in Dedede Resort - Stage 10. Dekofloof is unnamed outside the Japanese version and 怪盗洛切（Daroach） does not mention it by name, but he does refer to it when he tells the Kirbys to stay away from the cakes the enemy throws at them.

wikirby-page:12580.description_zh:
“在水下急流中，有一种名叫Eelongo的强大鱼类。它游动如此有力，以至于会摧毁它路上的一切，包括金属方块。所以跟随Eelongo，看看它是否会进入一些你不能进入的地方。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack中，
Eelongo是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人和关卡障碍。它的唯一目的就是向前直游，摧毁一切挡在它路上的东西，包括金属方块。它会出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 5中，其到来会由一群小橙色鱼预先警告。Eelongo无法被击败，并会击倒任何它撞上的卡比（Kirby）。在这一部分还存在该敌人的一些骨骼遗骸，显示它们有骨质眼睑和一些ribs.

这个敌人有一个机械中boss变种，叫做King Eelongo。奇怪的是，虽然Eelongo本身是无敌的，但King Eelongo却不是。
wikirby-page:12580.description_en:
“Within the underwater rapids is a formidable fish called the Eelongo. It races around so powerfully that it crushes anything in its path. That includes metal blocks. So follow the Eelongo to see if it breaks into any places you can't.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Eelongo is an enemy and stage hazard from Kirby Mass Attack. Its only purpose is to swim straight forward, destroying anything in its path, including metal blocks. It appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 5, where its arrival will be forewarned by a school of small orange fish. Eelongo cannot be defeated, and will KO any 卡比（Kirby） it rams into. A few skeletal remains of this enemy also exist in this section, where it is shown that they have bony eyelids and a few ribs.

There is a mechanical mid-boss variant of this enemy called King Eelongo. Strangely, while Eelongo itself is invincible, King Eelongo is not.

wikirby-page:12639.description_zh:
左侧的Flapbon是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它类似于叶芽（Beanbon），但有一个棕色的头，并且没有脚，而是用叶子像直升机一样飞行。Flapbon本身没有攻击能力，但它在飞行时会不断生成叶芽（Beanbon）、Zombon或Big Zombon，这取决于它出现的位置。

Flapbon可以通过揭开某些螺旋桨植物找到。
wikirby-page:12639.description_en:
left Flapbon is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is similar to a 叶芽（Beanbon）, but it has a brown colored head and has no feet, instead using its leaves to fly like a helicopter. Flapbon doesn't have any attacks of its own, but it will continuously produce 叶芽（Beanbon）s, Zombons or Big Zombons as it flies, depending on where it's found.

Flapbon may be found by uncovering certain propeller plants.

wikirby-page:12637.description_zh:
左边的Flare是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一个带有愤怒表情和角的飞行圆球。它可以有一个或多个火焰旋转在周围，接触到卡比（Kirby）时会灼伤它们。Flare也可以在给定的时间内向Kirbys发射这些火焰。

Flare的火焰可以在黑暗的地方提供光源。Flare还可以被水浇灭，获得淡蓝色并在短时间内变得无助。击败Flare可以为玩家带来400分。
wikirby-page:12637.description_en:
left Flare is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a flying circle with an angry face and horns. It can have one or more bolts of fire orbiting it, which will burn the 卡比（Kirby）s on touch. Flare can also shoot these bolts at the Kirbys given time to charge.

Flare's fire bolts will provide light in dark places. Flare can also be doused with water, gaining a light blue coloration and rendering it helpless for a short while. Defeating Flare confers 400 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12519.description_zh:
“我听说那些多云的Flickerfloofs已经出现在干旱的沙漠中。它们走到哪里就下雨，这可以帮助你种植植物。它们还会放电。如果你打算用它当浇水壶，要小心。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）描述Flickerfloof在Kirby Mass Attack
Flickerfloof中是一种小型云状敌人，只出现在Kirby Mass Attack的Stage 2中。它在大多数方面都类似于无害的Floof，但它呈深灰色，并且在自身下方持续产生风暴，形成无尽但非常局部的暴雨。偶尔，它会尝试释放闪电，这可能会伤害到任何卡比（Kirby）的下面。

在Sandy Canyon的第二关，Flickerfloof的雨水可以导致有几种植物可以生长，例如Jerkweed和Stactus（其中橙色的在其下方会获得更多绿色品种）。雨水对于生长Spire Vine是必要的，这些植物可以用来突破金属阻挡物以获得藏在其中的奖牌。然而，如果Flickerfloof的闪电击中植物，它们将被烧焦，无法再实现它们的用途。如果卡比们击败Flickerfloof，另一个将立即出现在其位置。击败Flickerfloof会给予玩家500分。
wikirby-page:12519.description_en:
“I've heard that those cloudy Flickerfloofs have been spotted in the dry desert. They sprinkle rain wherever they go, which can help you grow plants. They also strike with lightning. Be careful if you plan to use one as a watering can.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） describing Flickerfloof in Kirby Mass Attack
Flickerfloof is a small cloud-like enemy in Kirby Mass Attack appearing solely in Stage 2 of Sandy Canyon. It is similar in most every respect to the harmless Floof, but it is dark gray in hue and storms constantly underneath itself, creating an endless but very localized rainstorm. Occasionally, it will attempt to shoot lightning, which can harm any 卡比（Kirby） caught beneath.

In Stage 2 of Sandy Canyon, Flickerfloof's rain can cause several plants to grow, such as Jerkweeds and Stactuses (where the orange one will gain more of its green variety underneath it). Its rain is necessary to grow Spire Vines which can be used to bust through metal block barricades to obtain medals stashed therein. However, if Flickerfloof's lightning strikes a plant, they will be charred and cannot fulfill their purpose anymore. If the Kirbys defeat Flickerfloof, another will appear immediately in its place. Defeating Flickerfloof confers 500 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12490.description_zh:
“注意Floaty Woods。你可以把他掀倒，然后像乘木筏一样骑在他上面。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Floaty Woods是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，只会出现在Green Grounds - Stage 8。当卡比（Kirby）们第一次发现他时，Floaty Woods看起来像是一棵树，树干上有一个大洞。Kirby们可以被扔进这个洞里，他们将最终到达树冠。一旦所有的Kirby都在里面，他们和树之间将进行一场拔河比赛。如果Kirby赢了，Floaty Woods将被扔下悬崖，掉落的同时丢失叶子，落入水中，在那里他将成为Kirby们的木筏。
wikirby-page:12490.description_en:
“Keep an eye out for Floaty Woods. You can tip him over and ride him like a raft.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Floaty Woods is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in Green Grounds - Stage 8. When the 卡比（Kirby）s first spot him, Floaty Woods appears to be a regular tree with a large hole in the trunk. The Kirbys can be tossed in this hole, where they will end up in the tree's canopy. Once all the Kirbys are in there, a tug match will take place between them and the tree. If the Kirbys win, Floaty Woods will be thrown off the cliff, losing his leaves and landing in the water, where he will end up serving as a raft for the Kirbys.

wikirby-page:12517.description_zh: Floof是Kirby Mass Attack中一个无害的漂浮云状敌人。它可以被发现漂浮在空气中，带着水果和其他物品在它的身体上。为了获得这些物品，卡比（Kirby）需要在云朵逃走之前击打这个可怜的云朵。击败Floof会为玩家带来300分。
wikirby-page:12517.description_en: Floof is a harmless floating cloud-like enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It can be found drifting through the air carrying fruit and other items atop its body. To get those items, the 卡比（Kirby）s will need to pummel the hapless cloud before it gets away. Defeating Floof confers 300 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12620.description_zh:
“他们说这里有一只凶猛的恐龙。不要试图正面对抗那只怪物。只管拼命逃命吧！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Freezy Rex是Kirby Mass Attack中一个冰冷的霸王龙类敌人。它出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 9，当玩家坠入它所处的隧道后，它会在关卡中追逐Kirbys。它不能被直接伤害，而且会碾压一切挡在它路上的东西。除了触碰时造成伤害（触碰它的嘴是无害的，但任何卡比极有可能被碾坏）之外，Freezy Rex还有两种攻击方式。它可以冲撞，瞬间加速移动，或者向卡比喷冰，如果击中会将卡比冻结。它是最大的其中之一在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的角色，从其精灵尺寸来看。

要击败Freezy Rex，Kirbys需要到达关卡尽头，然后激活一个开关，使野兽掉落并被瓦砾掩埋。
wikirby-page:12620.description_en:
“They say that there's a vicious dinosaur living around here. Don't try to take that monster head-on. Just run for your life!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Freezy Rex is an icy tyrannosaurus rex-like enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 9, where it chases the Kirbys throughout the stage after they plummet into the tunnel it resides in. It cannot be harmed directly, and will crush anything that gets in its way. In addition to causing damage when physically touched (touching its mouth is harmless, but any Kirbys will most likely be crushed), Freezy Rex can attack in two ways. It can either charge, moving much quicker for a moment, or breathe ice at the Kirbys, freezing them solid if it connects. It is one of the largest characters in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, judging from the size of its sprite.

To defeat Freezy Rex, the Kirbys will need to make it to the end of stage, then activate a switch that will cause the beast to fall and get buried in rubble.

wikirby-page:12607.description_zh:
Fuufuu是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一种小型蓝色猪状生物，从嘴里喷出寒冰。任何被冰息击中的卡比（Kirby）都会被冻结，需要快速点击以解冻，否则会被击倒。击败Fuufuu可获得300分。

Fuufuu也出现在Sub-Game Kirby Quest的第24和38关卡，血量为150。
wikirby-page:12607.description_en:
Fuufuu is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It's a small blue pig-like creature which breathes ice from its mouth. Any 卡比（Kirby）s caught in the icy breath are frozen, and will need to be tapped rapidly to be released, or will be KO'd. Defeating Fuufuu confers 300 points onto the player.

Fuufuu also appears in the Sub-Game Kirby Quest, in stages 24 and 38. There, it has 150 HP.

wikirby-page:12539.description_zh:
“在沙漠中，你会被困在一个有些蛋状生物的房间里。它们叫做Gegs。并且有一个Geg在它的身体里面有一个拉环。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Geg是来自Kirby Mass Attack的有翼蛋形敌人。它以其粗糙的沙质外观与其他类型的Geg区别开来。它没有直接攻击卡比（Kirby）的方法，但它可以制造一个沙尘暴，遮蔽玩家的视线，这在间接方式上可能是危险的。然而，这次攻击会摧毁Geg。Geg可以通过反复撞击将其砸开来击败，从而为玩家提供300分，并有可能从其体内发现其他物品。Geg通常出现在Mech Geg和Paka Geg旁边。
wikirby-page:12539.description_en:
“In the desert, you're going to get trapped in a chamber with some egg-like creatures. They're called Gegs. And one Geg has a pull ring inside its body.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Geg is a winged egg-shaped enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is distinguished from the other types of Geg by its rough sandy appearance. It has no direct means of attacking the 卡比（Kirby）s, but it can create a dust storm that obscures the player's view, which can prove dangerous in indirect ways. This attack, however, destroys the Geg. Geg can be defeated by slamming into it repeatedly to crack it open, conferring 300 points onto the player, and potentially uncovering other items from inside its body. Geg typically appears alongside Mech Geg and Paka Geg.

wikirby-page:12673.description_zh:
Gloombat是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一种小型的类似蝙蝠的生物，可以在黑暗的地方找到。它会通过俯冲下来抓住任何接触到的卡比（Kirby）来进行攻击，并在有机会时啃咬该卡比（Kirby）。它可以被击打，但能够轻易摆脱数量不多的Kirby。击败Gloombat会奖励玩家300分。

Gloombat没有被怪盗洛切（Daroach）提及，并且仅在游戏的日文版中被命名。
wikirby-page:12673.description_en:
Gloombat is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a small bat-like creature which can be found in dark places. It attacks by swooping down and grabbing any 卡比（Kirby） it comes into contact with, gnawing on that 卡比（Kirby） when it gets the chance. It can be pummeled, but it can easily shake off Kirbys who are not in great numbers. Defeating Gloombat awards the player with 300 points.

Gloombat is not mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, and was only given a name in the Japanese version of the game.

wikirby-page:12602.description_zh:
“很难错过称为Glutbulb的植物。它是一个充满水的大球泡，浸入水中时会闪烁电光。因此，希望有某种方法让它不那么湿。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Glutbulb中是Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种植物状生物，固定不动，体内储存着一个巨大的Bubble水泡；它也可以在这个水泡中储存其他物品，包括奖章。它通常生活在水下，并且可以产生电流，当这样做时会向自身上方发射两道火花。卡比（Kirby）可以通过反复撞击水泡来击败Glutbulb，直到里面的水全部消失，但Glutbulb在接触周围水域时会迅速补充水量。水.
wikirby-page:12602.description_en:
“It's hard to miss the plant called the Glutbulb. It's a big water-filled bulb that flickers with electricity when it's underwater. So hopefully there's some way to make it less wet.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Glutbulb is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a plant-like creature which sits in place, holding a huge Bubble of water inside itself; it can also hold other items within this bubble, including medals. It typically resides underwater, and can generate electricity, shooting two sparks above itself when it does so. The 卡比（Kirby）s can defeat Glutbulb by slamming into its water bubble repeatedly until there's none left inside, though Glutbulb will quickly replenish its supply upon contact with the surrounding water.

wikirby-page:12623.description_zh:
“Ravenous的敌人称为Gobchomplins，它们住在墓地里。它们会一口吞下你。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
左边Gobchomplin是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它看起来和Super Mario系列中的Piranha Plant类似，行为也相似，但它的球体是黑色的，而且通常出现在开阔地而不是管道里。Gobchomplin会等待在地板或天花板上，当卡比（Kirby）接近时，会尝试通过前冲来吞食它们。如果它抓到一个，那个卡比（Kirby）就会被嚼碎，然后被击倒。Gobchomplin无法被连续攻击击倒，试图打它的Kirby会被弹开。这也会使他们短时间头晕。Gobchomplin通过常规手段唯一可以被击败的方式是通过拥有a卡比（Kirby）在Invincible Candy的影响下触摸它。
wikirby-page:12623.description_en:
“Ravenous foes called Gobchomplins live in the cemetery. They'll gulp you down in one bite.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
left Gobchomplin is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It looks and behaves similarly to a Piranha Plant from the Super Mario series, though its bulb is black, and it is typically found out in the open, rather than in pipes. Gobchomplin waits on floors or ceilings for 卡比（Kirby）s to approach, then will try to eat them by lunging forward. If it catches one, that 卡比（Kirby） will be munched on, then KO'd. Gobchomplin cannot be pummeled, and will bounce away any Kirbys who try to do so. This also causes them to be dizzy for a short period of time. The only way a Gobchomplin can be defeated through normal means is by having a 卡比（Kirby） touch it under the effects of Invincible Candy.

wikirby-page:12458.description_zh:
“传闻这座岛上生活着一种金色的生物。看起来是一个值得去猎捕的好猎物，不是吗！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），指的是Gold Beanbon在Kirby Mass Attack
Gold Beanbon中是Kirby Mass Attack的稀有敌人。它看起来像普通的叶芽（Beanbon），但颜色是金色的。当它发现卡比（Kirby）时，它会试图逃跑，如果它到达自己的洞穴就会挖洞躲开。在此之前击败它可以获得5000分，并且这是完成Checklist所必需的。

游戏中只有一个Gold Beanbon。它可以在Green Grounds - Stage 4中找到。此外，在员工名单的钓鱼小游戏中也可以钓到Gold Beanbon。
wikirby-page:12458.description_en:
“The scuttlebutt is that there's a gold creature living on this island. Seems like a good critter to go hunting for, doesn't it!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, referring to Gold Beanbon in Kirby Mass Attack
Gold Beanbon is a rare enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a standard 叶芽（Beanbon）, but is gold in color. When it spots the 卡比（Kirby）s, it will attempt to get away, digging itself out of reach if it reaches its burrow. Defeating it before that happens is worth 5,000 points, and is necessary to fill the Checklist.

There is only one Gold Beanbon in the game. It can be found in Green Grounds - Stage 4. Additionally, a Gold Beanbon can be fished up after during the staff credits' fishing mini-game.

wikirby-page:12530.description_zh:
“你骑过像乌龟一样的Gondolus吗？它会带你沿着沙河前行。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Gondolus里，有一个巨大的机械敌人，它位于Kirby Mass Attack。它像一个巨大的龟状石造生物，头上戴着耳机。当卡比（Kirby）在Sandy Canyon - Stage 4遇到它时，它会吃掉前方的门，迫使Kirby们打碎它的“壳”进入生物内部，然后使用它吞下的门。攻击敌人或抓住物体然后将其撞击到Gondolus的壳上可以实现这一点，这将暂时使它晕眩。它的“壳”有三层；要摧毁一层，需要将三件小物体或一件大物体（例如一个巨大的萝卜）砸到壳上。去破坏它。Kirbys在被大炮发射后落在它身上时，也会立即损坏它的壳。如果Kirbys未能及时摧毁Gondolus的壳，它将会游到沙地边缘的深渊中，把Kirbys一起带下去。
wikirby-page:12530.description_en:
“Have you ridden the turtle-like Gondolus? It will carry you along a river of sand.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Gondolus is a large mechanical enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a giant tortoise-like creature made of stone, with its head wearing headphones. When the 卡比（Kirby）s encounter it in Sandy Canyon - Stage 4, it eats the door forward, forcing the Kirbys to smash open its "shell" to get inside the creature and use the door it swallowed. This can be done by attacking enemies or latching onto objects and then slamming them into Gondolus' shell, which would temporary stun it. Its "shell" has three layers to it; in order to destroy a layer, three small objects or one large object (such as a huge turnip) need to be slammed on top of it to break it. The Kirbys also damage its shell the moment they land on it after being launched by a cannon. Should the Kirbys fail to destroy Gondolus' shell in time, it will swim right off the edge of the sand into a bottomless pit, taking the Kirbys with it.

wikirby-page:12666.description_zh:
“在墓地里，有些墓碑并不如表面所见。有些掩盖着秘密通道，还有一些实际上是敌人。如果不确定，可以扑向墓碑看看会发生什么。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Gravy中是Kirby Mass Attack的一个敌人。它伪装成普通墓碑，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近时才会飞到空中。它通过猛击地面进行攻击，会压碎下面的Kirby，但可以通过把Kirby弹到它身上来击败它。Gravy有两种类型。棕色版本击败时奖励300分。紫色版本则需要更多次攻击才能破坏，击败后奖励350分。

特别是位于Volcano Valley - Stage 6中的一个Gravy，据说怪盗洛切（Daroach）曾经是舞台所在的幽灵大厦的主人，并且正在守护一个Rainbow Medal。
wikirby-page:12666.description_en:
“In the graveyard, some tombstones aren't what they seem. Some cover secret passages, and others are actually enemies. When in doubt, hurl yourself against a tombstone and see what happens.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Gravy is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It disguises itself as a regular tombstone until the 卡比（Kirby）s approach, then flies up into the air. It attacks by slamming into the ground, crushing any Kirbys beneath, but can be defeated by flicking the Kirbys into it. There are two varieties of Gravy. The brown version awards 300 points when defeated. The purple variety requires many more hits to break, and is worth 350 points instead.

One Gravy in particular, found in Volcano Valley - Stage 6, is said by 怪盗洛切（Daroach） to have once been the owner of the haunted mansion which the stage takes place in, and is guarding a Rainbow Medal.

wikirby-page:12522.description_zh:
“如果你在废墟中听到隆隆声，你可能靠近一个Grindarr。那些东西如果你停在它们下面会把你压扁，所以不要那样做。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Grindarr中是一种出现在Kirby Mass Attack和Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的敌人。它是一个附着在链子上的大型石块生物，如果卡比（Kirby）接近，它会张开大口尝试压碎他。一旦它击中地面，Grindarr会慢慢被链子拉回，直到再次到达可以落下的位置。
wikirby-page:12522.description_en:
“If you hear a rumble in the ruins, you're probably near a Grindarr. Those things will squash you flat if you stop under them. So don't do that.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Grindarr is an enemy that appears in Kirby Mass Attack and Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is a large stone block creature attached to a chain, which attempts to crush 卡比（Kirby） if he draws near, opening its mouth wide before doing so. Once it has hit the ground, a Grindarr is slowly pulled back up by the chain until it is in position to fall again.

wikirby-page:12672.description_zh:
“那座笼罩在黑暗中的鬼宅是Gruegloom的理想家园。Grueglooms会聚集在一起试图吞噬你。所以当它们包围你时，要呆在光亮处！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Gruegloom中有一个出现在Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一个漂浮的骷髅形生物，喜欢黑暗，除非遭遇光照，否则呈现暗紫色烟雾状。Gruegloom在黑暗中不会受到伤害，它会吞食任何进入其嘴里的卡比（Kirby）。然而，在光中它非常脆弱，很容易被击打。击败它可获得500分。

存在第二种Gruegloom，带有蓝色调。这些通常成群出现在移动的聚光灯区域内，并且在暴露于光线时会消失。它们实际上作为一种无形且静止但致命的舞台危险，迫使Kirbys停留在有光照的区域。
wikirby-page:12672.description_en:
“The haunted mansion that's shrouded in darkness is the perfect home for the Gruegloom. Grueglooms cluster together and try to consume you. So when they surround you, stay in the light!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Gruegloom is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a floating skull-shaped creature which revels in the dark, taking on the appearance of a dark purple puff of smoke unless exposed to the light. The Gruegloom cannot be harmed while it is in darkness, and will eat any 卡比（Kirby）s it gets its mouth on. In the light, however, it is very vulnerable, and can be easily pummeled. Defeating it yields 500 points to the player.

A second variety of Gruegloom exists, which has a blue hue. These appear in swarms in a moving spotlight area, and will fade away when exposed to the light. They effectively serve as an intangible and motionless but deadly stage hazard which forces the Kirbys to stay in lit areas.

wikirby-page:12630.description_zh:
Hamsturr是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 10中，作为Kirbys必须克服的最终障碍。Hamsturr名字与其外形有些符合，它看起来像一只仓鼠，但比例与卡比（Kirby）相同。它拿着一把链球（连锁狼牙棒）和一面盾牌。Hamsturr从盾牌后面攻击，通过向前投掷链球攻击。盾牌可以被击破，如果有足够多的Kirby被投向它。之后，Hamsturr可以在一个阶段内被连续击打并打败。如果在其盾牌仍然激活时有任何Kirby被投向Hamsturr，它会将它们弹开。此外，Hamsturr是唯一会播放中Boss主题音乐的普通敌人（不包括Green Grounds - Stage 1).

Hamsturr之后会以钥匙链的形式出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中。
wikirby-page:12630.description_en:
Hamsturr is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 10, serving as the final obstacle which the Kirbys must overcome. Hamsturr is somewhat true to its name in that it resembles a hamster, but has the same proportions as 卡比（Kirby）. It holds a flail (chained mace) and a shield. Hamsturr attacks from behind its shield by throwing the flail forward. The shield can be broken, however, if enough Kirbys are tossed at it. From there, Hamsturr can be pummeled and defeated in a single phase. If any Kirbys are thrown at Hamsturr while its shield is active, it will throw them off. Additionally, Hamsturr is the only normal enemy that has the mid-boss theme play (excluding the Beanbons in Green Grounds - Stage 1).

Hamsturr would later appear as a keychain in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）.

wikirby-page:12662.description_zh:
Helmee是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它是一副悬浮在空中的分离盔甲，手持长矛。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，Helmee会停在它们上方，然后用长矛向下冲击它们。Kirbys可以像对待其他敌人一样击打Helmee并击败它，但过一会儿，Helmee会重新组成，能够再次攻击。第一次击败Helmee会获得300分。

这个敌人的英文名称可能是“helmet”或“helmed”的变体。
wikirby-page:12662.description_en:
Helmee is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a disembodied suit of armor which hovers in the air while carrying a lance. When the 卡比（Kirby）s approach, Helmee will stop above them, then dive onto them with its lance pointed downward. The Kirbys can pummel Helmee and defeat it like any other foe, but after a short while, Helmee will reconstitute, able to attack again. Defeating Helmee for the first time grants the player 300 points.

The English name for this enemy is possibly a corruption of "helmet" or "helmed".

wikirby-page:12476.description_zh:
“你将在一些地下洞穴里遇到Moley。那个魁梧的人有几个凶狠的小手下。其中一个戴着带刺的头盔。不要靠近那些尖刺！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Helmetmole是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它是一个类似鼹鼠的小生物，体型与Mogmole相似，它与Moley并肩作战，充当带刺的障碍。由于它重重的带刺盔甲，它无法被击败，必须在它从洞里冒出来时避开。
wikirby-page:12476.description_en:
“You're going to bump into Moley in some underground caves. That burly guy has some mean little henchmen. One of them wears a spiked helmet. Don't go near those spikes!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Helmetmole is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a small mole-like creature with similar proportions to Mogmole which fights alongside Moley by acting as a spiky barrier. Due to its heavy spiky armor, it cannot be defeated, and must instead be avoided whenever it pops out of a hole.

wikirby-page:12616.description_zh:
左Ice Dice是一种出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的小龙型敌人。它会原地停着，不断吐出冰块。这些冰块会慢慢地在空中飞行，直到碰到墙壁或其他障碍物，例如静止的冰块或水果，接触后会被破坏。如果卡比（Kirby）被冰块击中时夹在墙壁之间，它将会被压碎。冰块可以像其他方块一样，通过撞击来摧毁。

一旦卡比们到达Ice Dice，他们可以通过猛击它来击败它，从而为玩家获得300分。Ice Dice还有一种体型更大、更稀有的变体，叫做Ice Dinos。
wikirby-page:12616.description_en:
left Ice Dice is a small dragon-like enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It sits in place and spits out ice blocks at a continuous rate. These ice blocks will then fly slowly across the air before hitting a wall or other obstacle, such as static ice blocks or fruit, which are destroyed upon contact. If a 卡比（Kirby） is caught between the block and the wall when it hits, he will be crushed. The ice block can be destroyed like any other block by slamming into it.

Once the Kirbys reach Ice Dice, they can defeat it by pummeling it, conferring 300 points onto the player. There is also a larger and rarer variant of Ice Dice called Ice Dinos.

wikirby-page:12617.description_zh: Ice Dinos是Ice Dice的一个更大变体，它仅出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它在功能上与标准的Ice Dice相同，但体型更大，因此可以从口中吐出更大、更耐用的冰块。它的生命值也高于标准的Ice Dice，但如果被块体压住，将会瞬间被击败。击败Ice Dinos可获得500分。
wikirby-page:12617.description_en: Ice Dinos is a larger variant of Ice Dice which appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack. It is functionally the same as a standard Ice Dice, but is much larger, and can therefore spit out larger more durable ice blocks from its mouth. It also has more health than a standard Ice Dice, although it will be instantly defeated if it is crushed with a block. Ice Dinos is worth 500 points upon defeat.

wikirby-page:12609.description_zh: Iceton是一种冰块敌人，只出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它类似于Blucko，但由冰制成，而不是像Star Block。除此之外，它的攻击和移动模式相同，包括跳到卡比（Kirby）上将它们压扁。然而，鉴于它所处的冰雪环境，它可能比普通的同类敌人更难处理（或躲避）。击败Iceton会给予玩家100分。
wikirby-page:12609.description_en: Iceton is an ice block enemy that appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack. It is similar to Blucko, but made of ice, rather than resembling a Star Block. Otherwise, its attack and movement patterns are the same, involving jumping onto 卡比（Kirby）s to squish them flat. Given the icy environment in which it is found, however, it can be considerably more difficult to deal with (or dodge) than its normal counterpart. Defeating Iceton confers 100 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12678.description_zh: Ill Gate是一个伪装成Kirby Mass Attack门的敌人。它有一对蝙蝠翅膀，并且有一张凶狠的“脸”，看起来像个魔鬼。在Ill Gate出现的房间里，它会与卡比（Kirby）进行游戏，在黑暗中将自己与真正的门交换。如果卡比们通过Ill Gate而不是正确的门，他们将被送到一个小房间，在那里他们要么与Big Stactus战斗，要么与一群Mosomoso战斗，或者与一些Posula战斗。之后，他们必须再次玩这个游戏。Ill Gate本身是无害的，无法被击败。
wikirby-page:12678.description_en: Ill Gate is an enemy which disguises itself as a door from Kirby Mass Attack. It sports a pair of bat wings and has a menacing "face", giving it a devil-like appearance. In the rooms where Ill Gate appears, it will play a game with the 卡比（Kirby）s, swapping itself with the real door in the darkness. If the Kirbys go through the Ill Gate instead of the correct door, they will be sent to a small room where they either fight a Big Stactus, a horde of Mosomoso, or some Posulas. After that, they must play the game again. Ill Gate itself is harmless and cannot be defeated.

wikirby-page:12503.description_zh:
“其中一个传送门通向一个有巨大Jellifrizz.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）的房间，在Kirby Mass Attack
Jellifrizz中有来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种方形水母生物，能够通过身体传导电流。Jellifrizz有两种类型——一种是紫色的水基型，另一种是绿色的空间型——对于这两种变体，它们都可以是大或小的。被击败的大型Jellifrizz会分裂成五个较小的，并为玩家提供500分。每个较小的Jellifrizz被击败时价值100分（迷你（Mini）空间Jellifrizz则价值150分）。在Jellifrizz的不同类型中，在游戏中只能遇到一个巨大的空间Jellifrizz。
wikirby-page:12503.description_en:
“One of those portals goes to a chamber with a giant Jellifrizz.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Jellifrizz is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a squaroid jellyfish creature which can conduct electricity through its body. There are two varieties of Jellifrizz - one being purple and water-based, and the other being green and space-based - and for both variants, they can either be large or small in size. The larger Jellifrizz will split into five smaller ones when defeated, and confer 500 points into the player. Each smaller Jellifrizz is worth 100 points when defeated (迷你（Mini） Space Jellifrizz is worth 150 points instead). Of the Jellifrizz varieties, only one giant Space Jellifrizz can be encountered in the game.

wikirby-page:12504.description_zh:
Kyuin是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它可以在水下关卡中找到，充当关卡中的障碍。它无法被攻击或击败。

有三种类型的Kyuin。每种类型有不同的攻击模式：*绿色Kyuin会周期性地吸入水流，制造向它嘴巴方向的水流。如果一只卡比（Kirby）被Kyuin的底部吸住，它将被KO。*紫色Kyuin会吹出水流，将卡比推开。除此之外它无害，尽管它可以把卡比推到Stickle的尖刺上。*红色Kyuin则交替吸入水和吹出水。它只有在吸水时才危险。紫色和红色Kyuin仅出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 10。此外，游戏中只出现一个红色Kyuin.
wikirby-page:12504.description_en:
Kyuin is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It can be found in underwater stages, where it serves as a stage hazard. It cannot be attacked or defeated.

There are three types of Kyuin. Each has a different attack pattern: *The green Kyuin periodically sucks in water, creating a current toward its mouth. If a 卡比（Kirby） is caught at the Kyuin's base, he will be KO'd. *The purple Kyuin blows out water, pushing Kirbys away from it. Otherwise it is harmless, although it can push the Kirbys into a Stickle's spikes. *The red Kyuin alternates between sucking in water, and blowing it out. It is only dangerous when sucking water in. The purple and red Kyuin only appear in Dedede Resort - Stage 10. Additionally, only one red Kyuin appears in the game.

wikirby-page:38709.description_zh:
“当你唤醒Buzzybat时要小心。他的家人会蜂拥而至。我告诉你，他们都很危险！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
左边的Li'lbat是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它只在与Buzzybat战斗时出现，并作为小中boss的守护者。他们中的几个会围绕Buzzybat，以保护他免受卡比（Kirby）的攻击，但Li'lbat可以通过投掷卡比（Kirby）轻松击败，从而为玩家获得100分。如果Buzzybat本人被击中，其余的Li'lbats将立即消失。在Buzzybat的第三阶段，所有Lil'bats都会获得邪恶的凝视。
wikirby-page:38709.description_en:
“Be careful when you wake up Buzzybat. His family will swarm around him. They're all dangerous, I tell you!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
left Li'lbat is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It appears only during the fight with Buzzybat, and serves as a guardian for the small mid-boss. Several of them swarm around Buzzybat in order to defend him from the 卡比（Kirby）s, but Li'lbat can be easily defeated by throwing a 卡比（Kirby） at it, gaining the player 100 points in the process. If Buzzybat himself is hit, any remaining Li'lbats will disappear immediately. During Buzzybat's 3rd phase, all Lil'bats will gain an evil glare.

wikirby-page:12489.description_zh:
“你可以轻松击败这个岛上所有威胁性的树木。只需撞击它们的树干。我想知道是否值得先在它们繁茂的枝叶上搜索一番？”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
Little Woods是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，出现在Green Grounds - Stage 8中。它本质上是风语大树（Whispy Woods）的小型版本，并且固定在原地，意图阻挡卡比（Kirby）的前进。

Little Woods有两种攻击方式。它要么向卡比吹气以将它们击退，要么将鼻子插入尖刺以尝试伤害它们。为了击败它，卡比需要反复撞击Little Woods的树干以削弱它。卡比也可以挖掘Little Woods的树冠以将其移除，这可能会露出隐藏物品。击败Little Woods赋予玩家100分。

Little Woods也出现在Kirby Brawlball中，守护风语大树（Whispy Woods），以及在Strato Patrol EOS中，作为不攻击的障碍物。

Little Woods在游戏的日文版之外没有被命名，尽管怪盗洛切（Daroach）提到它们时会笼统地称它们为“树”。
wikirby-page:12489.description_en:
“You can easily defeat all of the menacing trees on this island. Just smash into their trunks. I wonder if it's worth searching their leafy branches first?”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
Little Woods is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, appearing in Green Grounds - Stage 8. It is essentially a smaller version of 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, and sits in place intent on blocking 卡比（Kirby）'s path.

Little Woods has one of two methods for attacking. It can either blow air at the Kirbys to knock them back, or shoot its nose into a spike to try and hurt them. To defeat it, the Kirbys need to slam into Little Woods' trunk again and again to chip it away. The Kirbys can also dig into Little Woods' canopy to remove that, which may reveal a hidden object. Defeating Little Woods confers 100 points onto the player.

Little Woods also appears in Kirby Brawlball, defending 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, and in Strato Patrol EOS, where it serves as a non-attacking obstacle.

Little Woods was not given a name outside of the Japanese version of the game, through 怪盗洛切（Daroach） does mention them where he generically refers to them as "trees".

wikirby-page:30144.description_zh: Magu是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它出现在Volcano Valley的Stage 1中，并从熔岩池中跳出来骚扰卡比（Kirby）并阻碍它们的前进。任何接触Magu的卡比（Kirby）都会受到伤害并且被点燃。Magu经常把自己放置在狭窄空间阻挡Kirbys的通行，但如果被水溅到，它可以被击败。这会使Magu变硬，从那时起，可以通过反复猛击安全地将其粉碎。击败Magu会奖励玩家1000分。
wikirby-page:30144.description_en: Magu is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Stage 1 of Volcano Valley and pops out of magma pools to harass the 卡比（Kirby）s and get in their way. Any 卡比（Kirby） who touches a Magu will take damage and also be lit on fire. Magu often positions itself to block the Kirbys' passage through tight spaces, but can be defeated if it is splashed with water. This causes Magu to harden, and from there, it can be safely pulverized by repeatedly pummeling it. Defeating Magu rewards the player with 1000 points.

wikirby-page:12535.description_zh:
Mech Geg是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种部分被装甲覆盖的Geg。它在水平运动中倒飞，并会翻正来用金属装甲压扁卡比（Kirby）。装甲无法被穿透，但Mech Geg身体的其余部分可以被Kirby们攻击。在Dedede Resort - Stage 10中，Mech Gegs也可以在描绘Medal的画作后面找到。玩家可以通过甩动Kirby攻击它以使其破裂，然后将其击碎，从而获得500点奖励。

Mech Geg后来会作为钥匙链出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）。
wikirby-page:12535.description_en:
Mech Geg is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a type of Geg which is partially encased in armor. It flies upside down in horizontal motion, and will turn rightside up to squish the 卡比（Kirby）s with its metal plating. The plating is unable to be penetrated, but the rest of Mech Geg's body can be damaged by the Kirbys. In Dedede Resort - Stage 10, Mech Gegs can also be found behind paintings depicting Medals. It can be defeated by flicking Kirbys into it to crack it, then break it apart, rewarding the player with 500 points.

Mech Geg would later appear as a keychain in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）.

wikirby-page:12546.description_zh:
“我们每个人都有自己的工作，而Mega Grindarr的工作就是降落到你身上。它的重量是普通Grindarr的10倍，所以冲击力相当大。但这就是它选择的任务，所以它只是咧嘴承受而已。”
— Figurine对Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的Mega Grindarr描述
Mega Grindarr是一种敌人，首次出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它是Grindarr的一个更大变体，下降时会伸出舌头。Mega Grindarr在每款出现的游戏中只出现一次，尽管它与标准Grindarrs相似，但实际上并不会对卡比（Kirby）构成太大威胁，因为它通常不会处于可以压到他的地方。相反，Mega Grindarr要么被用作关卡道具，要么卡比（Kirby）骑在上。
wikirby-page:12546.description_en:
“We've all got a job to do, and Mega Grindarr's job is to drop down on you. It weighs 10 times more than typical Grindarr, so it makes quite an impact. But that's what it signed up for, so it just grins and bears it.”
— Figurine description of Mega Grindarr from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Mega Grindarr is an enemy which debuted in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a much larger variant of Grindarr that sticks out its tongue as it falls. Mega Grindarr appears only once in each of the games in which it is found, and despite its similarity to standard Grindarrs, it doesn't actually end up posing much of a threat to 卡比（Kirby）, as it is not typically in a position to crush him. Instead, Mega Grindarr is either used as a stage prop, or 卡比（Kirby） rides on top of it.

wikirby-page:12644.description_zh:
Missile Roller是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，看起来像一枚带有面孔的导弹，但它只能在地面上行动，通过轮子滚动，而不是像人们预期的那样飞行。它出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 2中，是卡比（Kirby）发射坦克的对手之一。它沿地面滚动并接近坦克，如果碰到会爆炸并造成伤害。Missile Roller速度相当慢，但在下坡时会加速。它可以通过向它发射卡比（Kirby）来摧毁，这样玩家可以获得100分。

Missile Roller并未在怪盗洛切（Daroach）中直接提到，也没有在原版日语发行之外获得名称。它那类似鲨鱼的面孔与卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）相似，而Quad Gun出现在Missile Roller所在阶段的末尾时面临的情况。
wikirby-page:12644.description_en:
Missile Roller is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, resembling a missile with a face, though confined to the ground and rolling upon wheels instead of flying through the air as one might expect. It appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 2, as one of the opponents for the 卡比（Kirby）-launching tank. It rolls along the ground and approaches the tank, exploding and dealing damage if it hits. Missile Roller is fairly slow, but when rolling down slopes, it gains increased speed. It can be destroyed by firing a 卡比（Kirby） at it, which will reward the player with 100 points.

Missile Roller is not directly mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, nor was it given a name outside of the original Japanese release. Its shark-like face is similar to that of 卡钸拉（Kabula (Kirby Super Star Ultra onward)）, and the Quad Gun faced at the end of the stage in which Missile Roller appears.

wikirby-page:12473.description_zh:
“你见过那些像毛毛虫一样的生物，它们倒挂在你的上方行走吗？那些体内能携带水果、炸弹和其他东西的生物？其中一个的肚子里有一枚奖牌。如果你把它撬出来，赶紧拿住它，别让它消失。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Moggy，是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它看起来类似于《超级马里奥》系列中的Wiggler，但它的身体部分是由Bubbles组成的，可以容纳各种物品——包括水果、炸弹，甚至是奖牌。

Moggy会从泥土中出现，通常被看到沿着天花板爬行。要得到其身体部分里的物品，需要用卡比（Kirby）将这些身体部分弹开。Moggy的头部可以被攻击，击败它会导致其所有的果实一次性掉落，而炸弹则会直接消失而不是掉落后爆炸。以这种方式击败Moggy会为玩家提供500分，尽管由于Moggy不断尝试甩掉所有卡比，这一过程比较困难。

Moggy在日文版之外没有名字，但怪盗洛切（Daroach）提到它时，会笼统地称其为“毛毛虫状生物”。
wikirby-page:12473.description_en:
“Have you seen those caterpillar-like creatures that walk upside down above you? The one that carry fruit, bombs, and other things inside of them? One of them has a medal in its belly. If you pry it loose, grab it before it vanishes.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Moggy is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It looks similar to Wiggler from the Super Mario series, but its body segments are made of Bubbles which can hold various items - including fruit, bombs, and even medals.

Moggy appears from out of dirt patches, and is typically seen crawling along ceilings. To get the items inside its segments, the 卡比（Kirby）s need to be flicked at those segments to pop them. The Moggy's head can be attacked, and defeating it will cause all its fruit to be dropped at once, while the bombs simply disappear instead of dropping and exploding. Defeating Moggy in this way confers 500 points onto the player, although it is made difficult by Moggy's constant attempts at shaking off all the Kirbys.

Moggy is unnamed outside the Japanese version, but 怪盗洛切（Daroach） does mention it where he generically refers to it as a “caterpillar-like creature”.

wikirby-page:12474.description_zh:
Mogmole是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一种小鼹鼠状的生物，会与Moley并肩作战，通过向卡比（Kirby）投掷炸弹来攻击敌人。然而，它不是很强，如果被猛击，很快就会倒下。Mogmoles也会在与Moley作战前出现：它们会举着牌子指引Kirby们到一间有Switch的房间。一旦按下它，脚下的地板就会打开，将它们引向Moley的区域。紫色Mogmoles也会出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 5，但其他方面相同。

Mogmole也出现在几个Sub-Game中，包括Field Frenzy和Kirby Brawlball。
wikirby-page:12474.description_en:
Mogmole is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a small mole-like creature which fights alongside Moley by tossing bombs at the 卡比（Kirby）s. It is not very strong, however, so if it is pummeled, it will go down fairly quickly. Mogmoles also appear before fighting Moley: they hold signs to direct the Kirbys to a room with a Switch. Once they press it, the floor beneath them opens up, leading them to Moley's area. Purple Mogmoles also appear in Volcano Valley - Stage 5, but are otherwise the same.

Mogmole appears in several of the Sub-Games as well, including Field Frenzy and Kirby Brawlball.

wikirby-page:12482.description_zh: Mono Soarar是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它与标准的Soarar非常相似，但颜色为深灰色。不同于标准的Soarars，它们只会在携带物品时沿直线飞行，Mono Soarar会飞入、做一个向上的回旋，然后高速直线俯冲。如果它在俯冲时撞到卡比（Kirby），该卡比（Kirby）会受到伤害。否则，它可以像标准Soarar一样被殴打。击败Mono Soarar会为玩家获得100分。
wikirby-page:12482.description_en: Mono Soarar is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is very similar to a standard Soarar, but it is dark gray. Unlike standard Soarars, which are content to just fly by in a straight line while carrying items, Mono Soarar flies in, does an upward loop back, then dives straight down at high speed. If it hits a 卡比（Kirby） while it is diving, that 卡比（Kirby） will take damage. Otherwise, it can be pummeled like a standard Soarar. Defeating Mono Soarar confers 100 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12614.description_zh:
Mosomoso是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一种蓝色杂乱的生物，看起来几乎像一团带眼睛的毛球。它会缓慢地从天空下落，这时容易受到攻击。然而，当它落地后，会突然膨胀，变得又大又尖锐。触碰这种状态下的Mosomoso的卡比（Kirby）会受到伤害。击败Mosomoso可以为玩家获得300点。

有一种苍白类型的Mosomoso，可以在Volcano Valley的第六和第十一关找到。它被称为太空Mosomoso。这种Mosomoso在空中也会膨胀，使其更具危险性。当重力开关被激活时，所有太空Mosomoso都会膨胀，并试图飞向卡比（Kirby），尽管它们很慢。

Mosomoso也出现在Kirby Curtain Call中，作为舞台上众多杂乱物品之一。
wikirby-page:12614.description_en:
Mosomoso is an enemy appearing in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a blue scruffy creature resembling little more than a hairball with eyes. It falls slowly from the sky, where it is vulnerable to attack. Upon reaching the ground, however, it will flare up, becoming big and spiky. 卡比（Kirby）s who touch Mosomoso in this state will be harmed. Defeating Mosomoso confers 300 points onto the player.

There is a pale type of Mosomoso, which can be found in the sixth and eleventh stages of Volcano Valley. It is referred to as Space Mosomoso. This version of Mosomoso can flare up in midair, making it somewhat more dangerous. When a gravity switch is activated, all Space Mosomoso will flare up and try to fly into 卡比（Kirby）, although they are slow.

Mosomoso also appears in Kirby Curtain Call as one of the many objects cluttering the stage.

wikirby-page:5590.description_zh:
“包着绷带的敌人会不断反弹，恢复如新。如果他们挡住你的路，就扑上去攻击，但在他们恢复之前记得赶快离开。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），描述Kirby Mass Attack
中的木乃宝，Mummbon是一种由绷带包裹的小生物，外形和行为都类似叶芽（Beanbon）。如同标准的豆宝，它只在Kirby Mass Attack出现，并且有一种更大的变体，称为Big Mummbon。

Mummbon缓慢地在地上来回移动，如果发现任何卡比（Kirby），它会试图向它们喷射毒液。如果卡比（Kirby）被这种液体弄到，玩家必须快速点击该卡比（Kirby）以清除污物，否则会受到伤害。Mummbon可以被轻松击败，通过将其猛击，让玩家获得100分，并导致它解体成一堆散落在地上的绷带。然而，经过短时间后，被击败的Mummbon会自行复活并继续攻击，多次击败不会再获得任何分数，也不会有任何成果。为了永久击败这个敌人，它必须通过阶段危害击败、被压碎，或者被处于Jumbo Candy效果下的Kirby击中。
wikirby-page:5590.description_en:
“Enemies wrapped in bandages will keep bouncing back, good as new. Pounce on 'em if they get in your way, but then move along before they return.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, describing Mummbons in Kirby Mass Attack
left Mummbon is a small creature made of bandage wrap that resembles a 叶芽（Beanbon） in both look and behavior. Like standard Beanbons, it appears only in Kirby Mass Attack and has a larger variant, called Big Mummbon.

Mummbon shuffles slowly back and forth along the ground, and if it spots any 卡比（Kirby）s, it will attempt to spit poisonous fluid at them. If a 卡比（Kirby） gets doused in this fluid, the player must quickly tap that 卡比（Kirby） to get the gunk off before he takes damage. Mummbon can be defeated easily by pummeling it, granting 100 points to the player and causing it to unravel into a pile of bandages on the floor. However, after a short amount of time, the defeated Mummbon will revive itself and resume attacking, with repeat defeats not being worth any points nor bearing any fruit. In order to permanently defeat this enemy, it must either be defeated by a stage hazard, by being crushed, or by being hit by Kirbys under the effect of Jumbo Candy.

wikirby-page:12627.description_zh:
Nolly是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它是一种类似企鹅的紫色生物，戴着通常在平衡在某种球体上时看到的面具。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，Nolly会尝试在向前滚动时投掷带刺的球。然而，Nolly需要一些时间来取出球，所以它在这期间容易被Kirby攻击。击败后，玩家将获得300分，并且Kirby可能能够与Nolly平衡的球互动。铁球类似于钢球（Steel Ball），可以突破硬块并顺坡滚下。Nolly通常会与Dekofloof组队。

Nolly从未被怪盗洛切（Daroach）在游戏的英文版本，也从未在日本版以外被命名。
wikirby-page:12627.description_en:
Nolly is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a purple penguin-like creature wearing a face mask typically seen balancing atop a ball of some kind. When the 卡比（Kirby）s approach, Nolly will try to throw spiked balls at them while rolling forward. It takes some time for Nolly to pull out a ball, however, so it is vulnerable to attack by the Kirbys. After being defeated, 300 points will be awarded to the player, and it may be possible for the Kirbys to interact with the ball the Nolly was balancing on. The iron ball resembles 钢球（Steel Ball）, and can break through Hard Blocks and roll down hills. Nollys typically team up with Dekofloofs.

Nolly is never directly mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in the English version of the game, nor is it ever named outside of the Japanese release.

wikirby-page:5604.description_zh:
“那个矮小的Oohroo总是挥舞着手臂乱动。在他停止拳打之前不要与他纠缠。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
左边Oohroo是Kirby Mass Attack中常见的敌人。他的基本外观类似于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的戈力牙斯（Goriath），尽管他小得多，而且头和手臂比例失调。非常像大猩猩，Oohroo有小眼睛和小脚，浓眉和明显突出的下巴。他的毛皮呈亮紫红色。

Oohroo在Green Grounds的各个关卡中都相当常见，可以看到他要么保持不动，要么来回踱步。偶尔，他会愤怒地咆哮并快速旋转拳头。如果卡比（Kirby）s此时联系Oohroo，他们会被抛回并受到伤害。击败Oohroo会为玩家带来300点分数。

 Oohroo也出现在Field Frenzy、Kirby Brawlball和Kirby Quest Sub-Game中，在最后一个Sub-Game中还与锤星猩（Bonkers）一起出现，提到两者都是类人猿。

 Oohroo后来会以Keychain的形式出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中。
wikirby-page:5604.description_en:
“The runty Oohroo is always thrashing around with his arms. Don't tangle with him until he stops punching.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
left Oohroo is a common enemy that only appears in Kirby Mass Attack. His basic appearance is similar to that of 戈力牙斯（Goriath） in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, although he is much smaller, and his head and arms are disproportionately large. Strongly resembling a gorilla, Oohroo has tiny eyes and feet, thick brows and a greatly accentuated chin. His fur is bright magenta in hue.

Oohroo is fairly common throughout the various stages of Green Grounds, seen either holding still or pacing back and forth. From time to time, he fumes angrily and spins his fists about rapidly. If the 卡比（Kirby）s contact Oohroo at this time, they get hurled back and take damage. Defeating Oohroo confers 300 points onto the player.

Oohroo also appears in the Field Frenzy, Kirby Brawlball, and Kirby Quest Sub-Games, alongside 锤星猩（Bonkers） in the last of these, referencing the fact that both are simians.

Oohroo would later appear as a Keychain in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）.

wikirby-page:12540.description_zh: Paka Geg是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种Geg，特点是光滑的黄色外壳，中间有一道大的锯齿状裂缝。这道裂缝会周期性地打开，使Paka Geg吐出一个叶芽（Beanbon）来攻击卡比（Kirby），因为它自身没有直接攻击能力。Paka Geg可以通过用投掷的卡比（Kirby）连续击中几次来击败，击败后可为玩家增加400分。
wikirby-page:12540.description_en: Paka Geg is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a type of Geg that features a smooth yellow shell with a large jagged crack going through the middle. This crack periodically opens up, causing the Paka Geg to spit out a 叶芽（Beanbon） to attack the 卡比（Kirby）s, as it has no direct attack of its own. Paka Geg can be defeated after being hit several times with a thrown 卡比（Kirby）, conferring 400 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12457.description_zh:
Posula是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它看起来像一只拥有黑色珠状眼睛和头上有管子的蛞蝓，沿着墙壁、地板和天花板爬行。当卡比（Kirby）在附近时，它会喷出两个缓慢向它们移动的毒液团，如果触碰到它们，会将其包裹起来。为了拯救被包裹的Kirby，玩家需要在它们被击倒前轻触它们。击败Posula会给玩家带来200分。

有第二种Posula种类，称为太空Posula。它几乎与标准Posula相同，除了颜色不同并且会发射两个火花球。击败它可获得300分，只出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 11。
wikirby-page:12457.description_en:
Posula is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a slug with beady black eyes and tubes on its head, and it crawls along walls, floors and ceilings. When the 卡比（Kirby）s are near, it will spit out two poison blobs which travel slowly toward them, and will envelop them if they touch. In order to save any enveloped Kirbys, the player will need to tap them before they are KO'd. Defeating a Posula confers 200 points onto the player.

There is a second variety of Posula referred to as Space Posula . It is practically identical to the standard Posula, aside from its coloration and the fact that it shoots out two spark balls. It awards 300 points when defeated and only appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 11.

wikirby-page:12697.description_zh:
“也要避开任何刺蝠。它们的刺非常凶猛，所以在瞄准Buzzybat时尽量避免它们。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），位于Kirby Mass Attack
Pricklebat的是Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它只在与Buzzybat的战斗中出现，并作为小中Boss的带刺护盾。Pricklebat无法被击败，应尽量避开。

Pricklebat有两种不同的大小，这会影响它刺向卡比（Kirby）的距离。在战斗的最后几阶段，它们有几个会围绕Buzzybat旋转，使卡比（Kirby）在攻击中Boss时很难不受伤。然而，一旦Buzzybat被单个卡比（Kirby）抓住，所有刺蝠会立即消失。
wikirby-page:12697.description_en:
“Steer clear of any Pricklebats too. Their spikes are savage, so do your best to avoid them while aiming for Buzzybat.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Pricklebat is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It appears only during the fight with Buzzybat, and serves as a thorny shield for the small mid-boss. Pricklebat cannot be defeated, and should be avoided at all costs.

Pricklebat comes in two different sizes, which affects the distance at which it can prick 卡比（Kirby）. Several of them orbit Buzzybat during the last couple phases of the fight, making it difficult for 卡比（Kirby） to strike the Mid-Boss without getting hurt. Once Buzzybat is latched onto by a single 卡比（Kirby）, however, all Pricklebats will immediately vanish.

wikirby-page:12675.description_zh:
Puff是出现在Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它是一个小型的、类似白色幽灵的生物，戴着一顶绿色费兹帽（类似于近期游戏中的粗眉雪人（Chilly）），嘴唇总是嘟起。它不能伤害卡比（Kirby），但它会从无处出现，如果他们有火把的话，会将火把吹灭，使Kirby暴露在Gruegloom和其他怪物面前。击败Puff可以获得500分，但如果长时间不被攻击，它也会消失。

怪盗洛切（Daroach）并没有明确提到Puff，而且在游戏的非日语版本中也没有命名。
wikirby-page:12675.description_en:
Puff is an enemy which appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a small white ghost-like creature which wears a green fez (similar to 粗眉雪人（Chilly） in recent games) and has its lips puckered up at all times. It cannot hurt the 卡比（Kirby）s, but it will appear from out of nowhere and can blow out their torches if they have them, leaving the Kirbys vulnerable to Grueglooms and other monsters. Puff is worth 500 points when defeated, but will also vanish if left unharassed for long enough.

怪盗洛切（Daroach） makes no explicit mention of Puff, nor is it named outside of the Japanese version of the game.

wikirby-page:12647.description_zh:
Pult是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个固定机械敌人。它看起来像一个带有凶狠面孔的砖柱，这个面孔类似于King Golem，并且背部附有一个金属杯，用来投掷巨石。它仅在Volcano Valley - Stage 2中出现，作为坦克的对手之一。它固定在原地，会试图向卡比（Kirby）坦克投掷岩石。这些岩石可以被卡比（Kirby）的投射物击落。Pult本身需要三次攻击才能被摧毁，每次攻击都会使其受损，牙齿在此过程中碎裂。击败Pult会奖励玩家300点积分。

Pult没有被怪盗洛切（Daroach）提及，也未在的日文版中命名。
wikirby-page:12647.description_en:
Pult is a stationary mechanical enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a brick post with a menacing face similar to that of King Golem and has a metal cup attached to the back which is used to hurl boulders. It appears exclusively in Volcano Valley - Stage 2, as one of the opponents for the tank. It sits in place, and will attempt to throw rocks at the 卡比（Kirby） tank. These rocks can be blasted out of the sky with a 卡比（Kirby） projectile. Pult itself takes three hits to destroy, with each hit causing it to become more damaged, with its teeth shattering in the process. Defeating Pult rewards the player with 300 points.

Pult is not mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, nor was it given a name outside of the Japanese release.

wikirby-page:12683.description_zh:
“小心那个在骷髅塔高处纠缠你的巨型Rock Hand。你需要很多Kirby才能击败它。但这是值得的。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Rock Hand是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，只会出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 8。它是一个由石头组成的独立拳头，会试图猛击建筑物，以给卡比（Kirby）们制造麻烦。通过连续打它十次可以击败它，并奖励玩家1,000分。

在火山谷第8关逃离骷髅塔后，Kirby们还需要应对空中试图阻止他们的另一个Rock Hand。为了击败这个敌人，Kirby们必须赢得一个推挤比赛（涉及快速重复点击）。来自玩家）突破。否则，他们将被送到关卡中不太理想的位置。
wikirby-page:12683.description_en:
“Watch out for the giant Rock Hand that tangles with you high in the Skull Tower. You'll need a lot of Kirbys to defeat it. But it will be worth your while.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Rock Hand is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in Volcano Valley - Stage 8. It is a disembodied fist made of stone, which will attempt to slam into structures to cause problems for the 卡比（Kirby）s. It can be defeated by slamming into it ten times, rewarding the player with 1,000 points.

After escaping the Skull Tower in Volcano Valley - Stage 8, the Kirbys will need to contend with one more Rock Hand that tries to stop them in midair. In order to defeat this enemy, the Kirbys must win a pushing contest (involving quick repeated tapping from the player) to break through. Otherwise, they will be sent to a less desirable location in the stage.

wikirby-page:12594.description_zh:
“你看到那些向你投掷带刺球的鼹鼠了吗？它们被称为流氓鼹鼠。它们似乎在守护它们所在的区域。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Roguemole是来自Kirby Mass Attack的一个鲜为人知且隐居的敌人，仅在Dedede Resort - Stage 6中出现。它是一只戴着草帽、颜色类似三文鱼的鼹鼠，偶尔会从地面冒出一个绿色的、有弹性的带刺球。一旦它扔出刺球，卡比（Kirby）将有机会攻击Roguemole，然后它会再次钻入地下。击败Roguemole会让玩家获得300分。
wikirby-page:12594.description_en:
“Did you see the moles that throw spiked balls at you? They're called Roguemoles. They seem to guard the areas they're found in.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Roguemole is an obscure and reclusive enemy from Kirby Mass Attack, making its only appearance in Dedede Resort - Stage 6. It is a salmon-color mole wearing a straw hat, which occasionally pops out of the ground with a green, bouncy spiked ball. Once it tosses the spike ball, the 卡比（Kirby）s will have a chance to attack the Roguemole before it burrows underground again. Defeating Roguemole confers 300 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:38696.description_zh:
Rolling Pawn是附在Kirby Mass Attack链子上的石像，会影响中型boss Great Gear的旋转位置。在与这个中型boss战斗时，场地两侧可能会出现两组滚动小兵，它们互相平衡。卡比（Kirby）可以通过反复投掷来摧毁Rolling Pawn，随后它们会逐渐开裂直到崩塌。小滚动小兵价值200分，大滚动小兵价值400分。摧毁Rolling Pawn会改变天平相对于另一侧的平衡，大滚动小兵的重量是小滚动小兵的两倍。这样做会旋转Great Gear的面部，并可能暴露中级Boss的弱点。一旦Great Gear被击中这个部位，它会自动掉落它可能从链条中召唤出的任何滚动棋子，然后用新的棋子替换它们。

滚动棋子也可能伴随Rolling Spike出现，它们外形相似，但有可收缩的尖刺，会伤害Kirbys。
wikirby-page:38696.description_en:
Rolling Pawn is a stone idol attached to a chain in Kirby Mass Attack which influences the rotation position of the mid-boss Great Gear. During the battle with this mid-boss, two sets of Rolling Pawns may appear on each side of the arena which counterbalance each-other. The 卡比（Kirby）s can destroy a Rolling Pawn by being tossed at them repeatedly, whereupon they will become progressively more cracked until they crumble. Small Rolling Pawns are worth 200 points, and large Rolling Pawns are worth 400. Destroying a Rolling Pawn will change the balance of the weight scale relative to the other side, with the large Rolling Pawns weighing twice as much as the small ones. Doing this will rotate the face of Great Gear and potentially expose the mid-boss's weak point. Once Great Gear is hit in this spot, it will automatically drop any Rolling Pawns it may have conjured from the chains before replacing them with new ones.

Rolling Pawns may also be accompanied by Rolling Spikes, which look similar, but have retractable spikes which can harm the Kirbys.

wikirby-page:38697.description_zh: Rolling Spike是一个附有可伸缩尖刺并连接链条的石像，位于Kirby Mass Attack中，会影响中型boss Great Gear的旋转位置。在与这名中型boss战斗期间，滚动尖刺可能会与Rolling Pawn一起出现，对试图改变重量平衡的卡比（Kirby）构成潜在危险。为了击败这个敌人，Kirbys必须在其尖刺缩回时反复猛击它。与Rolling Pawn不同，该敌人没有更大更重的变体，击败它可获得200分。
wikirby-page:38697.description_en: Rolling Spike is a stone idol with retractable spikes attached to a chain in Kirby Mass Attack which influences the rotation position of the mid-boss Great Gear. During the battle with this mid-boss, Rolling Spikes may appear alongside Rolling Pawns, posing a potential danger to the 卡比（Kirby）s as they try to change the weight balance. In order to defeat this enemy, the Kirbys must repeatedly slam it while its spikes are retracted. Unlike Rolling Pawn, there is no larger heavier variant of this enemy, and it is worth 200 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:12463.description_zh:
“在这个岛周围有一个Schnoz，它会把一个方块推向一面金属方块的墙。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack左边
有一个敌人Schnoz。它是一个圆形、像猪的、双足生物，有天线状的耳朵和一个大圆鼻子，用它来推Heave-Ho Blocks。Schnoz最初出现在Green Grounds - Stage 5，和它更大的同类Big Schnoz和Bigger Schnoz一起。要打败它，卡比（Kirby）必须把它的方块推回去把它困住，然后压碎它，否则卡比们会遭遇同样的命运。击败Schnoz会奖励玩家300分。
wikirby-page:12463.description_en:
“There's a Schnoz around this island that shoves a block toward a wall of metal blocks.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
left Schnoz is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a round, porcine, bipedal creature with antenna-like ears and a big round nose which it uses to push Heave-Ho Blocks. Schnoz first appears in Green Grounds - Stage 5 along with its larger cousins, Big Schnoz and Bigger Schnoz. To defeat it, the 卡比（Kirby）s must push back on its block to trap it, then crush it, lest the Kirbys suffer the same fate. Defeating Schnoz rewards 300 points to the player.

wikirby-page:12691.description_zh:
“我也听说附近有一些可怕的东西。它是一种会制造黑洞的生物，会把你吸进去……”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）关于Schwarz，在Kirby Mass Attack
Schwarz是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。它居住在Volcano Valley - Stage 11，只能在外太空区域找到。它是一个大而圆的生物，嘴里满是锋利的牙齿。当Kirbys靠近时，Schwarz会在嘴周围制造巨大的重力，将卡比（Kirby）吸入。如果它们掉进去，就会被击倒。然而，过了一段时间后，Schwarz会停止并感到疲倦，给Kirbys一个攻击的机会。击败Schwarz可以获得1,000分。
wikirby-page:12691.description_en:
“I've also heard there's something terrible nearby. It's some sort of creature that makes black holes that will suck you in...”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） referring to Schwarz, in Kirby Mass Attack
Schwarz is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It resides in Volcano Valley - Stage 11, and can only be found in the outer space sections. It is a large circular creature with a mouth full of sharp teeth. When the Kirbys approach, Schwarz creates huge gravity around its mouth, drawing the 卡比（Kirby）s in. If they fall in, they will be KO'd. After a while of this, however, Schwarz will stop and get tired, giving the Kirbys a chance to attack. Schwarz is worth 1,000 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:12512.description_zh: Scoopy是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人，出现在各种水下关卡中。它是一种大型章鱼状生物，可以将触手变形成武器，包括带刺的锤子或长矛。当不变形成武器时，触手会形成一个环，卡比（Kirby）可以抓住并拉动它。击败Scoopy通常是推动所出现关卡进程的必要条件，并可奖励玩家1,000分。
wikirby-page:12512.description_en: Scoopy is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, appearing in various underwater stages. It is a large squid-like creature which can form its arms into weaponry, including a spiked mace, or a spear. When not formed into weaponry, the arms form a ring, which the 卡比（Kirby）s can grab onto and tug. Defeating Scoopy is often necessary to move forward in the stages it appears in, and rewards the player with 1,000 points.

wikirby-page:12680.description_zh:
“A只以轮廓出现的恶魔，居住在阴影笼罩的豪宅中。他以令人毛骨悚然的名字Shadowbite.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）为人所知，在Kirby Mass Attack
Shadowbite（在英国英语版本中称为Shadowmuncher）是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。他出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 7，靠近豪宅大厅的尽头。他是一个大型恐龙般的阴影，有尖牙，接触即可击倒Kirbys。他无法被正常伤害，因此必须避开。他会沿着大厅追击柯比们，直到到达一条窗帘。如果柯比们能及时拉起窗帘，一个轮廓形的卡比（Kirby）雕像会将Shadowbite击飞，同时获得一枚奖牌。

Shadowbite也作为障碍出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的Road Trip里必须用Holo Defense API或电插头（Plugg）克服。
wikirby-page:12680.description_en:
“A fiend seen only in silhouette lives in the shadowy mansion. He's known by the chilling name Shadowbite.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Shadowbite (called Shadowmuncher in the British English version) is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. He appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 7, near the end of the mansion halls. He is a large dinosaur-like shadow with pointy teeth, which can KO Kirbys on contact. He cannot be harmed normally, so he must instead be avoided. He will chase the Kirbys down the hall until reaching a curtain. If the Kirbys can pull the curtain up in time, a silhouetted 卡比（Kirby） statue will punch Shadowbite away, yielding a medal in the process.

Shadowbite also appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） as an obstacle in Road Trip that must be overcome with either Holo Defense API or 电插头（Plugg）.

wikirby-page:12581.description_zh: Shellmic是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它可以在水下部分的一些牡蛎壳内找到，并且如果卡比（Kirby）试图打开它的壳，它就会出现。一旦出现，它会开始迅速吸水，形成水流。如果Kirbys落入它的嘴中，他们将被击倒。在吸水几秒钟后，Shellmic会关闭它的壳并返回休眠状态，除非Kirbys再次打扰它。Shellmic可以通过在它藏在壳内时猛击三次它的壳来击败，为玩家提供400分。
wikirby-page:12581.description_en: Shellmic is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It can be found inside some oyster shells in underwater sections, and will appear if the 卡比（Kirby）s attempt to open its shell. Once out, it will start sucking in water at a rapid rate, creating a current. If the Kirbys fall into its mouth, they will be KO'd. After a few seconds of sucking in water, Shellmic will close its shell and return to dormancy unless the Kirbys disturb it again. Shellmic can be defeated by slamming into its shell three times while it is hiding inside, conferring 400 points onto the player.

wikirby-page:12699.description_zh:
“更强壮的骷髅狮守护着死灵星云。骷髅在一百年内会成长为骷髅狮。它们一定非常凶猛！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Skullion是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它与头骨儿（Skully）非常相似，但以其头上突出的小尖刺为特征。Skullion被认为是Skull Gang的高阶成员，只能在Necro Nebula上找到，包括过场动画、世界地图以及与Necrodeus的首领战中。根据怪盗洛切（Daroach）所说，骷髅在活过一百年后会成长为骷髅狮。

在战斗的第一阶段，当卡比（Kirby）们损坏Necrodeus的手时，一支骷髅狮舰队将尝试修复它们。在战斗后期，当Necrodeus全身心投入其中，他偶尔会召唤Skullions攻击Kirbys。它们并不比Skullys强多少，而且它们的尖刺对防御作用不大。然而，它们仍然能够捡起并带走Kirbys。击败一个Skullion会给玩家奖励500分。
wikirby-page:12699.description_en:
“The tougher Skullions guard the Necro Nebula. Skullys grow into Skullions over a hundred years. They must be fierce!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Skullion is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is very similar to 头骨儿（Skully）, but is distinguished by the small spike protruding from its head. Skullion is considered to be a high-ranking member of the Skull Gang, and can only be found on Necro Nebula, both in cutscenes, on the world map, and in the boss fight with Necrodeus. According to 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, Skullys grow into Skullions after living over a hundred years.

During the first part of the fight, a fleet of Skullions will try to repair Necrodeus's hands when the 卡比（Kirby）s damage them. Later in the fight, when Necrodeus is in it with his head, he will occasionally call Skullions to attack the Kirbys. They are not much tougher than Skullys, and their spikes don't do much to defend them. However, they are still capable of picking up and carrying the Kirbys away. Defeating a Skullion awards the player with 500 points.

wikirby-page:5306.description_zh:
“斯卡利族曾经躲藏在黑暗中。也就是，直到Necrodeus得到了他的魔法法杖。然后斯卡利族改变了。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
头骨儿（Skully）是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人。他们是Skull Gang的成员，他们是在紫色雾气中漂浮的骷髅。在骷髅钥匙维度中，他们漂浮四处，并试图绑架卡比（Kirby）。据怪盗洛切（Daroach）称，他们以前生活在黑暗中，直到Necrodeus得到了魔法法杖。他们巡逻Popopo Islands，因此每当Kirbys从一个岛屿前往另一个岛屿时，斯卡利族就会攻击他们，直到只剩下一个卡比（Kirby），所以卡比（Kirby）每次在岛屿之间旅行时都必须重新聚集Kirbys。当Kirbys打败头骨大王（Skullord）时，他们就停止巡逻群岛并开始巡逻Necro Nebula，因此直到卡比（Kirby）击败Necrodeus，每次进入或离开死灵星云时，他都会减少到只有一个卡比（Kirby）。

在主要故事模式（Story Mode）中，Skullys通常只会在骷髅钥匙维度中被遇到和战斗。在这里，他们会聚集成一大群，试图扑向Kirbys将其拉开。如果一个卡比（Kirby）被抓住，其余的Kirbys需要猛击抓住的头骨儿（Skully），将其释放，以防可怜的卡比（Kirby）被带出屏幕顶部并毁灭。击败头骨儿（Skully）可为玩家获得300分。在这些遭遇中，总会有一个特殊的红色头骨儿（Skully）携带着骷髅钥匙适用的宝箱。击败这个头骨儿（Skully）会奖励玩家500点，并提前结束战斗，让Kirby可以获得宝箱中的宝藏并回到常规关卡。直到Volcano Valley的后期阶段，Skully才会被发现巡逻在这些维度之外。
wikirby-page:5306.description_en:
“The Skullys used to hide in darkness. That is, until Necrodeus got his magic staff. Then the Skullys changed.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
头骨儿（Skully） is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. They are members of the Skull Gang and they are skulls floating in a purple haze. In the skull key dimension, they float around and try to kidnap the 卡比（Kirby）s. According to 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, they used to live in darkness until Necrodeus got the magic staff. They patrol the Popopo Islands, so whenever the Kirbys go from one island to another, the Skullys attack them until only one 卡比（Kirby） is left, so 卡比（Kirby） has to gather Kirbys again every time he travels between the islands. When the Kirbys defeat 头骨大王（Skullord）, they stop patrolling the islands and start patrolling Necro Nebula, so until 卡比（Kirby） beats Necrodeus, he is reduced down to one 卡比（Kirby） every time he enters or leaves the Necro Nebula.

In the main 故事模式（Story Mode）, Skullys are typically only encountered and fought in the skull key dimension. Here, they will gather in a large horde and try to dive at the Kirbys to pull them away. If a 卡比（Kirby） is grabbed, the remaining Kirbys need to slam the apprehending 头骨儿（Skully） to free its captive before the poor 卡比（Kirby） is carried out off the top of the screen and destroyed. Defeating a 头骨儿（Skully） confers 300 points onto the player. In these encounters, there will always be a special red 头骨儿（Skully） that carries the treasure chest which the skull key fits. Defeating this 头骨儿（Skully） rewards the player with 500 points and ends the battle early, allowing the Kirbys to obtain the treasure inside the chest and return to the regular stage. It is not until later stages of Volcano Valley when Skullys can be found patrolling outside of these dimensions.

wikirby-page:12480.description_zh:
Small Soarar是Soarar的婴儿版本，仅出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。在Green Grounds - Stage 7中的一个巨大的蛋里可以找到五个小型Soarars，如果卡比（Kirby）能在Big Soarar出现并带走蛋之前将其打破。它们每个都会携带物品——其中一个特别携带Medal。每个Small Soarar在被击败时价值50分。

Small Soarar没有被怪盗洛切（Daroach）明确提到，但他确实暗示可以在它们的蛋里找到一枚奖章。Small Soarar在日本版本之外也未命名，因为国际版本中并没有如意棒（Staff）片尾后的敌人点名环节。
wikirby-page:12480.description_en:
Small Soarar is a baby version of Soarar which appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack. Five Small Soarars can be found inside a giant egg in Green Grounds - Stage 7, if the 卡比（Kirby）s manage to bust it open before Big Soarar shows up to take the egg away. They will each be carrying items - and one in particular has a Medal. Each Small Soarar is worth 50 points when defeated.

Small Soarar is not mentioned explicitly by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, but he does allude to the idea that a medal can be found in their egg alongside them. Small Soarar is also left unnamed outside of the Japanese release, as the enemy roll call after the 如意棒（Staff） credits is not present in the international releases.

wikirby-page:12439.description_zh:
“你知道那些总是在打瞌睡的小植物吗？它们是瞌睡根。最好只在它们睡觉的时候去惹它们。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Snoozroot是一种在Kirby Mass Attack中相当常见的敌人类型。它是一种类植物生物，会固定在原地，由一个苞状的头部和一对弓形叶子组成，连接着一条长藤蔓。如其名字所示，它通常在睡觉，但当卡比（Kirby）接近时，它会醒来并试图向它们吐液。它的深紫色剧毒黏液如果击中卡比（Kirby），将会将其困住，如果不通过点击该卡比（Kirby）将其移除，他将被击倒。Snoozroot相当强壮，需要至少4个卡比一次攻击才能消灭。

大多数瞌睡根是能够挂在天花板上，有些Snoozroots会藏在Jerkweed植物下。其中有一个特别的Green Grounds - Stage 6会伪装成Spinwheel Flower.
wikirby-page:12439.description_en:
“You know those little plants that are always dozing off? They're Snoozroots. Probably best to mess with them only when they're sleeping.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Snoozroot is a fairly common type of enemy found in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a plant-like creature which stays in place, consisting of a bud-like head with a bow-like set of leaves, attached to a long vine. As its name implies, it is typically asleep, but when 卡比（Kirby）s draw near, it will awaken, and try to spit at them. Its dark purple poisonous goop will entrap a 卡比（Kirby） if it hits, and if not removed by tapping that 卡比（Kirby）, he will be KO'd. Snoozroot is fairly tough, requiring at least 4 Kirbys to take out in one attack.

Most Snoozroots are capable of hanging from ceilings, and some Snoozroots will hide under Jerkweed plants. One in particular in Green Grounds - Stage 6 disguises itself as a Spinwheel Flower.

wikirby-page:12686.description_zh:
“Space Oohroo可能看起来像愚蠢的猿猴，但它们实际上非常聪明。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Space Oohroo是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种Oohroo，穿着带有面罩和一对天线的华丽太空服。尽管有这些附加装备，两者之间唯一的区别是Space Oohroo拥有更多的Health。击败Space Oohroo会让玩家获得300分。

根据怪盗洛切（Daroach），Space Oohroo相当聪明，它们建造了宇宙飞船和实验室来制造这些飞船，估计是为了获取Volcano Valley中的Bananas，据说这是“宇宙中最甜的”。
wikirby-page:12686.description_en:
“The Space Oohroo may look like dumb apes, but they're actually very smart.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Space Oohroo is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a type of Oohroo which wears a fancy spacesuit with a visor and a pair of antennae. Despite these additions, the only difference between the two is that Space Oohroo has more Health. Defeating Space Oohroo confers 300 points onto the player.

According to 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, Space Oohroo are quite intelligent, having constructed spaceships and laboratories to build them in, presumably for the sole purpose of acquiring the Bananas in Volcano Valley, said to be "the sweetest in the universe".

wikirby-page:12450.description_zh:
“如果你在蜘蛛网后看到一丝宝藏，小心进入。那张网的主人可能会在你最意想不到的时候出现。要迅速撕掉蜘蛛网，否则准备好面对尖牙吧！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）指的是Spideroo，在Kirby Mass Attack
Spideroo中，Spideroo是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。他是一个紫色的类似蜘蛛的敌人，可以用丝从上方悬挂。通常，他会埋伏等卡比（Kirby）靠近，然后尝试抓住其中一个。如果卡比（Kirby）被抓住，Spideroo会尝试把该卡比（Kirby）拖走，如果成功就会带走他。然而，如果其他Kirbys在Spideroo逃走前猛击它，他们可以救回同伴。击败Spideroo可获得200分。

有一个绿色当卡比们试图解开蛛网茧时出现的一种Spideroo。它会试图抓住正在网中工作的卡比，但可以像普通的Spideroo一样被击败。

在Green Grounds - Stage 3中，其中一只蜘蛛鲁嘴里含着一个Rainbow Medal，如果卡比们不阻止，它会试图带走。
wikirby-page:12450.description_en:
“If you catch a glimmer of treasure behind a spiderweb, go in carefully. The owner of that web might just drop in when you least expect it. Tear down the web fast, or get ready to face some fangs!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） referring to Spideroo, in Kirby Mass Attack
Spideroo is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. He is a purple spider-like foe which hangs from above using silk. Normally, he will lie in wait for the 卡比（Kirby）s to approach, then will attempt to grab one. If a 卡比（Kirby） is grabbed, Spideroo will attempt to drag that 卡比（Kirby） off, taking him away if successful. However, the other Kirbys can save him if they pummel the Spideroo before he gets away. Spideroo is worth 200 points when defeated.

There is a green variety of Spideroo which appears when the Kirbys are trying to untangle cobweb cocoons. He will try to grab the Kirbys at work on the web, but can be defeated like a normal Spideroo.

In Green Grounds - Stage 3, one of the Spideroos has a Rainbow Medal in his mouth, and will try to get away with it unless the Kirbys stop him.

wikirby-page:12548.description_zh:
“一个巨大的尖刺Gegs会怀着复仇的心追赶你。别让他追上你。但在你奔跑时，不要错过你会经过的奖牌。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Spiky Geg是Kirby Mass Attack的一个敌人和危险。他是一种非常大的Geg类型，只有一只眼睛，拥有坚不可摧的尖刺壳。他出现在Sandy Canyon - Stage 11中，会试图追击卡比（Kirby）。他可以撞毁金属方块，并且会立即击倒任何接触到的卡比（Kirby），如果该卡比（Kirby）手中持有Wee Birdee且没有剩余的Kirby，关卡将结束。

Spiky Geg无法被任何方式击败，必须直接躲避。
