wikirby-page:12548.description_en:
“One of the giant Spiky Gegs will chase you with a vengeance. Don't let him catch up with you. But don't miss out on the medal that you'll pass as you run.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Spiky Geg is an enemy and hazard from Kirby Mass Attack. He is a very large type of Geg with a single eye, which has an impenetrable spiked shell. He appears in Sandy Canyon - Stage 11, where he will attempt to chase down the 卡比（Kirby）s. He busts through metal blocks, and will also instantly KO any 卡比（Kirby） he comes into contact with, ending the stage if that 卡比（Kirby） was holding a Wee Birdee and there are no Kirbys left to hold it.

Spiky Geg cannot be defeated by any means, and must simply be avoided.

wikirby-page:12506.description_zh:
“当你在水下急流中游泳时，你会遇到一些Squisters。如果那些类似鱿鱼的敌人看到你，它们会冲向你的位置。在某对Squisters周围有一枚奖牌。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Squister是来自Kirby Mass Attack的一个敌人。它的名字似乎来源于“乌贼怪（Squishy）”和“twister”。它确实看起来类似于乌贼怪（Squishy）——是一种类似鱿鱼的生物——但它不是在水中悠闲地漂浮，而是像鱼雷一样扭动并发射自己。在发射过程中，接触它是危险的，但一旦它撞到墙壁，就可以攻击它。

存在两种Squister。第一种在固定区域和方向发射，而另一种会试图瞄准卡比（Kirby）s在发射前。这第一种类型是蓝色的，当被击败时价值200分，第二种类型是紫色的，价值400分。
wikirby-page:12506.description_en:
“When you swim the underwater rapids, you'll encounter some Squisters. If those squid-like enemies see you, they'll rocket toward your position. There's a medal around a certain pair of Squisters.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Squister is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. Its name appears to derive from "乌贼怪（Squishy）" and "twister". It indeed looks similar to 乌贼怪（Squishy） — being a squid-like creature — though instead of drifting lazily about in the water, it instead twists and launches itself like a torpedo. While launching, it is dangerous to touch, but once it hits a wall, it can be attacked.

Two varieties of Squister exist. The first launches in a set area and direction, while the other will try to target the 卡比（Kirby）s before launching. This first type is blue in hue, and is worth 200 points when defeated, and the second type is purple, worth 400 points instead.

wikirby-page:12511.description_zh:
“这种经常成堆出现的小刺植物叫做Stactus。有一个快速击败它的方法。先打掉最上面的头。它会带下其它所有的头。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Stactus是一种常见敌人，只在Kirby Mass Attack中遇到，主要出现在Sandy Canyon。它是一种小而圆的绿色植物状生物，有着猫一样的脸，保持静止。顾名思义，它常常堆叠在同类之上，最上面的Stactus呈橙色。每个Stactus击败后可获得100分。
wikirby-page:12511.description_en:
“The little spiked plant that often comes in stacks is called a Stactus. There's a quick way to defeat it. Take out the top head. It will bring down all the others.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Stactus is a common enemy which is encountered exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack, appearing primarily in Sandy Canyon. It is a small round green plant-like creature with a cat-like face, remaining motionless. As its name implies, it often stacks on top of others of its kind, with the top Stactus taking on an orange hue. Each Stactus is worth 100 points when defeated.

wikirby-page:12527.description_zh:
Stappy是Tappy的一个较大变体，它出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它的外观与较小的Tappy相似，但下半部分有尖刺。Stappy还有一个更精致的脸部，带有类似卡比（Kirby）的面颊腮红，使其在某种程度上类似于弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）及其相关物种。当Stappy旋转时，会产生一场风沙暴，遮挡玩家的视线。当尘土被卷起后，Stappy可能会翻转，使卡比（Kirby）有机会进行攻击。击败Stappy会给玩家带来500分。

Stappy没有被怪盗洛切（Daroach）以名字提及，但他确实将其作为会“掀起沙暴”的敌人提到。Stappy也没有给出在原版日文发行之外的名称。
wikirby-page:12527.description_en:
Stappy is a larger variant of Tappy that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It is similar in look to the smaller Tappy, but has spikes on its lower half. Stappy also has a more detailed face with cheek blush similar to that of 卡比（Kirby）, making it somewhat resemble 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） and its relatives. When Stappy spins, it creates a sandstorm that will obscure the player's view. Once the dust is kicked up, Stappy may turn upside-down, giving the 卡比（Kirby）s an opportunity to attack. Defeating Stappy confers 500 points onto the player.

Stappy is not mentioned by name by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, but he does reference it as an enemy which can "stir up a sandstorm". Stappy is also not given a name outside of the original Japanese release.

wikirby-page:12590.description_zh:
Stickle是来自Kirby Mass Attack的水生敌人。它在形状和大小上类似于蛙镜鱼（Blipper），但全身覆盖着尖刺。在水下时，它基本上无法被触碰，但一旦离开水面，它就会变得脆弱。击败Stickle可为玩家带来300点积分。

Stickle可以说类似于蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的装甲版，并且眼睛上有类似的护目镜。
wikirby-page:12590.description_en:
Stickle is an aquatic enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is similar to a 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） in shape and size, but is covered in spikes. While underwater, it is essentially untouchable, but it becomes vulnerable once out of the water. Defeating Stickle confers 300 points onto the player.

Stickle can be said to resemble an armored version of 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）, and has a similar visor over its eyes.

wikirby-page:12585.description_zh:
“然而，附近有一个头上有数字10的生物。那个生物靠近一扇非常可疑的门……”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），指的是“10”Stoneik，在Kirby Mass Attack
Stoneik中是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一种大头、圆眼睛的大蝌蚪状生物。它居住在Dedede Resort - Stage 5的某些门口，阻挡通行。为了驱逐Stoneik，卡比（Kirby）必须先通过快速围绕它游动使其头晕。当这种情况发生时，Stoneik会伸出舌头，Kirbys可以抓住它将生物拉出。击败Stoneik可以获得700分。

有一种特殊的金色Stoneik，与标准品基本相同，但需要10个Kirby才能移动。常规的Stoneik完全没有被怪盗洛切（Daroach）提到，但他确实提到了黄金品种，并称其为“头上有10的生物”。Stoneik在日本以外的版本中也没有名字。
wikirby-page:12585.description_en:
“Nearby there was a creature with a 10 on its head, however. That creature was near a mighty suspicious door...”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, referring to the "10" Stoneik, in Kirby Mass Attack
Stoneik is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a large tadpole-like creature with a big head and wide round eyes. It resides inside certain doorways in Dedede Resort - Stage 5, blocking them off. To dislodge the Stoneik, the 卡比（Kirby）s must first cause it to become dizzy by swimming around it quickly. When this happens, Stoneik will let out its tongue, which the Kirbys can grab onto to pull the creature out. Stoneik is worth 700 points when defeated.

There is a special golden variety of Stoneik which is much the same as the standard, but requires 10 Kirbys to dislodge. The regular Stoneik is not mentioned at all by 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, but he does mention the golden variety as a "creature with a 10 on its head". Stoneik is also unnamed outside of the Japanese release.

wikirby-page:12493.description_zh:
“当这些Stumpees直接向你滚来时，它们真的很吓人。寻找Stumpee上被切掉的楔形。挤进缝隙让它通过。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Stumpee中是敌人和危险物，只会在Green Grounds - Stage 8中出现。它是一段沿地面滚动的大树干。如果卡比（Kirby）被其压到，它们会被压碎。Kirbys可以躲进Stumpee缺失的楔形块中以避免这个结局。Stumpee在滚动时能够摧毁金属方块。
wikirby-page:12493.description_en:
“Those Stumpees can really be scary when they're rolling right toward you. Look for the wedge chopped out of the Stumpee. Squeeze into the gap to let it pass.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Stumpee is an enemy and hazard in Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in Green Grounds - Stage 8. It is a large log segment which rolls along the ground. If the 卡比（Kirby）s are caught under its weight, they will be crushed. The Kirbys can take refuge in Stumpee's missing wedge to avoid this fate. Stumpee is capable of destroying metal blocks as it rolls over them.

wikirby-page:12596.description_zh: Tacotzo是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它是一个类似章鱼的大型敌人，头部后方有一根针。它会保持静止，同时一次从嘴里发射三个爆炸炮弹。Tacotzo通常会牢牢地固定在原地，并且可以在墙壁和天花板上做到这一点。可以通过拔掉它背后的针让它泄气来击败它，但如果打在其他地方，卡比（Kirby）只会弹开。击败Tacotzo会给玩家带来350分，并且它被击败后会掉落一个水果。与许多其他敌人不同，Tacotzo在游戏的英文版本中从未被怪盗洛切（Daroach）提及，它的名字仅在日文版本中出现。
wikirby-page:12596.description_en: Tacotzo is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It is a large octopus-like enemy with a pin on the back of its head. It holds still and fires three explosive cannonballs from its mouth at a time. Tacotzo tends to stay firmly rooted in place, and can do so on walls and ceilings. It can be defeated by pulling out the pin on its back, deflating it, but if hit anywhere else, the 卡比（Kirby）s will just bounce off. Defeating Tacotzo confers 350 points onto the player, and a fruit will fall after it is defeated. Unlike many other enemies, Tacotzo is never mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in the English version of the game, and it is named only in the Japanese release.

wikirby-page:12446.description_zh: Tappy是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它看起来像一个陀螺，但上半部分像猫。它漂浮在空中，并会在移动时旋转，使其在停止之前非常危险。停下来的瞬间，它会暂时眩晕。在这种眩晕期间，卡比（Kirby）可以攻击它。击败一个Tappy可为玩家获得200分。Tappy仅在Green Grounds的两个关卡中出现，是一种稀有敌人。有一个更大的变种叫做Stappy.
wikirby-page:12446.description_en: Tappy is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a spinning top, but its upper half is cat-like. It floats in the air, and will spin around while moving, making it dangerous to touch until it stops, becoming momentarily dizzy. It is during this dizziness that the 卡比（Kirby）s can attack it. Defeating a Tappy confers 200 points onto the player. Tappy is only found in two stages of Green Grounds, making it a rare enemy. A larger variant exists called Stappy.

wikirby-page:38725.description_zh: Tortletummy Thorn是来自Kirby Mass Attack的敌人。它看起来像Tortletummy的细长圆柱版本，戴着尖刺金属头盔，仅在Dedede Resort - Stage 5中与紫色Tortletummy战斗时出现，并作为膨胀的中级Boss试图将卡比（Kirby）推入的危险物。从战斗的第二阶段开始，每当Tortletummy在水中制造宽幅水流时，一排Tortletummy荆棘会出现在水流方向。Tortletummy荆棘不能被直接击败，但如果Kirby足够长时间避免被拉入它们的尖刺中，一旦它们的主人疲惫，Tortletummy荆棘就会消失。
wikirby-page:38725.description_en: Tortletummy Thorn is an enemy from Kirby Mass Attack. It resembles a thin cylindrical version of Tortletummy with a spiked metal helmet, appearing only during the fight with the purple Tortletummy in Dedede Resort - Stage 5 and serves as a hazard for the bloated mid-boss to try and push the 卡比（Kirby）s into. Starting from phase 2 of the fight, whenever Tortletummy creates a wide current in the water, a line of Tortletummy Thorns will appear in the direction of the current's flow. Tortletummy Thorns cannot be defeated directly, but if the Kirbys can avoid being pulled into their spikes for long enough, the Tortletummy Thorns will disappear once their master gets tired.

wikirby-page:12495.description_zh:
Tower Woods是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，它只出现在Green Grounds - Stage 8中。它由几个脸组成，这些脸像图腾柱一样在躯干上旋转。Tower Woods的脸有尖尖的鼻子，接触时会伤到卡比（Kirby）。因此，Kirbys需要在脸没有突出时攻击该部分以将其移除。有些部分上可能还有蘑菇，如果Kirbys碰到它会被反弹。击败Tower Woods的每个部分可以获得350分。

Tower Woods是Kirby Mass Attack中的敌人之一，在英文版中怪盗洛切（Daroach）从未直接提到它，也没有在日文版之外获得名字。它在关于“应对坚硬的树木”，可以用在它们身上，然而。
wikirby-page:12495.description_en:
Tower Woods is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in Green Grounds - Stage 8. It consists of several faces which rotate on the trunk in a totem pole-like fashion. The faces of Tower Woods have pointed noses, which will hurt the 卡比（Kirby）s on contact. As such, the Kirbys will need to hit that segment when the face is not sticking out to remove it. Some segments may also have mushrooms on them, which will bounce the Kirbys off if they strike it. Each segment of Tower Woods is worth 350 points when defeated.

Tower Woods is one of the enemies in Kirby Mass Attack which is never directly mentioned by 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in the English version, nor is it given a name outside of the Japanese release. Some of his small talk dialogue in the airship in reference to "taking on tough trees" could be applied to them, however.

wikirby-page:12574.description_zh:
Tury是一个像鱼一样的渔夫敌人，它居住在Kirby Mass Attack中出现的云上。它的攻击方式是将钩子钩在水果或其他物体上，使其偶尔上下摆动，同时保持在屏幕之外。如果卡比（Kirby）抓住了钩住的物品，他会被钩子钩住，如果其他人不救他，就会被带走。

只需要几只柯比就能救出被钩住的卡比（Kirby），但Tury将会逃掉。然而，如果有大量的柯比一起拉，它们可以将Tury拉下来并痛打它，从而获得更多的水果。以这种方式击败Tury可获得500分。
wikirby-page:12574.description_en:
Tury is a fish-like fisherman enemy which resides on a cloud that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. Its method of attack involves it hooking its line into a fruit or other object, causing it to bob up and down on occasion, while remaining off-screen. If a 卡比（Kirby） grabs the hooked item, he'll be caught on the hook, and will be carried away if the others don't save him.

Only a couple Kirbys are needed to save a hooked 卡比（Kirby）, but Tury will end up getting away. If a large number of Kirbys are pulling though, they can bring Tury down and pummel it, yielding much more fruit. Defeating Tury in this manner awards 500 points.

wikirby-page:12628.description_zh:
Waddle Dee portrait是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的敌人和变种，它只出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。它只能在Dedede Resort - Stage 10中找到，挂在墙上，与其他画作和肖像一起。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，肖像会明显地充能，然后抛出两颗炸弹——每边一颗——需要避开。要击败它，所有的Kirby只需附着并拉下肖像，就像对待其他敌人一样。

值得注意的是，这是Kirby Mass Attack中极少数从未获得官方名称的敌人之一，无论是日文还是其他语言。

Enemies in Kirby Mass Attack Waddle Dees
wikirby-page:12628.description_en:
Waddle Dee portrait is an enemy and variant of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） that only appears in Kirby Mass Attack. It can be found exclusively in Dedede Resort - Stage 10, hanging on walls with the other paintings and portraits. When the 卡比（Kirby）s draw near, the portrait will charge up visibly and then toss two bombs out - one on each side - which will need to be avoided. To defeat it, all the Kirbys need to do is latch on and pull down the portrait, like any other.

Notably, this is one of the few enemies in Kirby Mass Attack which was never given an official name, in Japanese or otherwise.

Enemies in Kirby Mass Attack Waddle Dees

wikirby-page:12471.description_zh:
“从地面冒出来的蠕虫怪物叫做战争蠕虫。我听说它们的脖子是弱点。但蠕虫哪一部分不是脖子呢？”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Warwiggle，是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人。它是一个巨大的蠕虫状生物，会在地面下挖洞，在松软的泥土中出现。它是半透明的，因此像水果和炸弹这样的物品可以在它的肠道中看到。要击败Warwiggle，卡比（Kirby）需要被发射到它的身体里（特别是脖子上的隆起部分），以拨出其中的物品。然而，它的头部有尖刺，不应触碰。如果将它吞下的所有物品都拨出，则Warwiggle将被击败，并奖励玩家500分。

最后Warwiggle出现在Green Grounds - Stage 6中，肠道里有一个Rainbow Medal。
wikirby-page:12471.description_en:
“The wormy monsters that pop up from the ground are called Warwiggles. I've heard word that their neck is their weak spot. But what part of a worm ISN'T its neck?”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Warwiggle is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a large worm-like creature which burrows through the ground, emerging in soft patches of dirt. It is translucent, so items like fruit and bombs can be seen in its gut. To defeat Warwiggle, the 卡比（Kirby）s need to be launched into its body (particularly the bulge on its neck) to dislodge the items inside. Its head is spiked however, and should not be touched. Warwiggle is defeated if all of the things it has swallowed are dislodged, rewarding the player with 500 points.

The last Warwiggle which appears in Green Grounds - Stage 6 has a Rainbow Medal in its gut.

wikirby-page:12487.description_zh:
Wicky Woods是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个敌人，只出现在Green Grounds - Stage 8的第一个房间里。它无法被击败，其唯一功能是在卡比（Kirby）出现时将它们向左吹走。它并不经常这样做，所以威胁不大。Wicky Woods被Spideroo张开口的嘴环绕着，这些Spideroo试图抓住Kirbys，但这两个敌人并不相互受益，因为即使被Spideroo抓住的Kirbys也可以被吹走。

Wicky Woods在某种程度上类似于风语大树（Whispy Woods），但更狭窄，还有胡子和眉毛。它的两侧还以交替模式排列有缺口。Wicky Woods在游戏的日文版本之外没有获得名称。
wikirby-page:12487.description_en:
Wicky Woods is an enemy in Kirby Mass Attack, which appears only in the first room of Green Grounds - Stage 8. It cannot be defeated, and its only function is to blow the 卡比（Kirby）s away to the left when they appear. It doesn't do this often, so it isn't much of a threat. The Wicky Woods are surrounded by Spideroos with open jaws who try to snatch the Kirbys, but the two enemies do not benefit from each other's presence, as even Kirbys caught by Spideroo can be blown away.

Wicky Woods resembles 风语大树（Whispy Woods） to a degree, but is much more narrow, and has a mustache and eyebrows. It also has notches spaced in an alternating pattern on its sides. Wicky Woods did not receive a name outside of the Japanese version of the game.

wikirby-page:12491.description_zh: Wobbly Woods是风语大树（Whispy Woods）的敌人和亲属，风语大树（Whispy Woods）只出现在Kirby Mass Attack中，仅在Green Grounds - Stage 8中出现。它是一棵高大而粗壮的树，尽管其树基大部分已经被磨损成细尖，使其非常不稳定。Wobbly Woods出现在河的尽头，其较小的表亲曾被用作木筏。卡比（Kirby）必须不断被弹入Wobbly Woods以将其击倒，从而开辟通路。否则，这棵树将碰撞到Kirby并压碎他们全部。
wikirby-page:12491.description_en: Wobbly Woods is an enemy and relative of 风语大树（Whispy Woods） which appears exclusively in Kirby Mass Attack, appearing only in Green Grounds - Stage 8. It is a tall and stout tree, though its base has been mostly worn away to a thin point, making it very unstable. Wobbly Woods is encountered at the end of the river where its smaller cousin had been used as a raft. The 卡比（Kirby）s have to continuously be flicked into Wobbly Woods to knock it over and allow passage. Otherwise, the tree will crash into the Kirbys and crush all of them.

wikirby-page:5608.description_zh:
“从墓地中出现的绿色恶魔被称为僵尸怪。它们大多很小，但要避开它们。如果它们得逞，会把你变成僵尸怪。立即攻击任何被变成恶魔的朋友以解除诅咒。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
KMA Zombon sprite.png中，Zombon是叶芽（Beanbon）的僵尸化版本，它出现在Kirby Mass Attack中。起初，它在Volcano Valley的某些关卡中担任最弱、最脆弱敌人的角色，本质上取代了Sandy Canyon关卡中的Mummbon。在它出现的一些区域，僵尸怪会不断从地面冒出来，替换被打败的敌人。击败Zombon可获得100分。

总体上, Zombon的外观与叶芽（Beanbon）类似。它有红色的眼睛，头顶上有两片叶子，看起来都像被啃咬过且破烂不堪。它呈病态的绿色，脸上有深绿色斑点，圆圆的紫色脚，以及一张似乎被缝合的嘴。Zombon有一个更大的变种，叫做Big Zombon，Zombon与其共享某些特征。

Zombon主要通过向卡比（Kirby）发射小型红色球状物来攻击，使其在接触时被困在毒性泡泡中。玩家必须点击卡比（Kirby）来戳破泡泡并救他。如果泡泡没有及时戳破，卡比（Kirby）将变成Zombon。攻击被变成僵尸的卡比（Kirby）会将他恢复正常。否则，僵尸化的卡比（Kirby）会钻入地下并消失。

名称'Zombon'来源于单词'僵尸'和叶芽（Beanbon），这是同一游戏中常见的敌人。
wikirby-page:5608.description_en:
“The green fiends that rise up from the cemetery are called Zombons. They're mostly small, but steer clear. They'll turn you into Zombons if they have their way. Attack any of your friends-turned-fiends immediately to break the curse.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
KMA Zombon sprite.png Zombon is a zombified version of 叶芽（Beanbon） that appears in Kirby Mass Attack. Initially, it takes on the role as the weakest, most vulnerable enemy in certain stages of Volcano Valley, and essentially replaces Mummbon from the Sandy Canyon stages. In some of the areas in which it appears, Zombons will continuously pop up from the ground, replacing those that are defeated. Zombon yields 100 points when defeated.

Overall, Zombon has a similar appearance to 叶芽（Beanbon）. It has red eyes and a two leaves atop its head that both appear to have been chewed and tattered. It is a sickly green color, with dark green spots on its face, round purple feet and a mouth that appears to have been stitched shut. There is a larger variant of Zombon called Big Zombon, with which Zombon shares certain characteristics.

Zombon mainly attacks by shooting small, spherical red blobs at 卡比（Kirby） that trap him in a poisonous bubble on contact. The player must tap 卡比（Kirby） to pop the bubble and save him. If the bubble is not popped in time, 卡比（Kirby） will turn into a Zombon. Attacking the zombified 卡比（Kirby） will transform him back to normal. Otherwise, the zombified 卡比（Kirby） will burrow into the ground and be lost.

The name 'Zombon' is derived from the words 'zombie' and 叶芽（Beanbon）, a common enemy from the same game.

wikirby-page:12452.description_zh:
“看到Big Birdee和小鸟们的亲密让我流泪……”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Big Birdee中是Kirby Mass Attack的Birdee们的保护母亲。她第一次作为中BOSS出现，但在Wee Birdee被卡比（Kirby）们拯救后，她后来与他们成为朋友。

她第一次出现在Green Grounds - Stage 1的过场动画中，当时她被看到提着一篮子Fruit。由于Kirbys被从加农炮发射出来，意外撞到她，导致她掉落了一篮子水果，Kirbys随后可以使用这些水果。

她后来出现在Green Grounds - Stage 3的树顶上，在那儿她在Kirbys击败小鸟们后与他们战斗。她通过向他们投掷红色带刺球进行攻击。当她swoops，Kirby们有机会通过抓住她进行反击。击败她会导致抓住她的Kirby们掉回森林里。Big Birdee随后飞走。

在游戏的后期，Big Birdee在Kirby们救了她的宝宝——Sandy Canyon - Stage 11里的小鸟后，和Kirby们成为朋友。从那时起，普通的小鸟也会帮助Kirby们。

在此之后，Big Birdee在Dedede Resort - Stage 11和Volcano Valley - Stage 8（“摇摆”关卡）中做了小出现，以通过搭载Kirby们来帮助他们。Big Birdee再次出现在Necro Nebula - Stage 2中，通过给他们Fruit来帮助Kirby们应对Lady Ivy的重赛。
wikirby-page:12452.description_en:
“Seeing how close Big Birdee and the Wee Birdees are makes me tear up...”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Big Birdee is the protective mother of the Birdees from Kirby Mass Attack. She first appears as a mid-boss, but later befriends the 卡比（Kirby）s once they save the Wee Birdees.

She makes her first appearance in a cutscene of Green Grounds - Stage 1, where she is seen carrying a basket full of Fruit. The Kirbys unintentionally hit her due to being launched from a cannon, causing her to drop the basket of Fruit that the Kirbys can then use.

She later appears atop of the trees in Green Grounds - Stage 3, where she fights the Kirbys after they defeat the Birdees. She attacks by dropping red spiked balls at them. When she swoops, the Kirbys have a chance to fight back by latching onto her. Defeating her causes the Kirbys latching onto her to fall back down into the forest. Big Birdee then flies away.

Later on in the game, Big Birdee becomes friends with the Kirbys after they save her babies, the Wee Birdees in Sandy Canyon - Stage 11. From then on, the normal Birdees also help the Kirbys.

After this point, Big Birdee makes small appearances in Dedede Resort - Stage 11 and Volcano Valley - Stage 8 (the "teetering" levels) in order to assist the Kirbys by giving them a ride. Big Birdee appears again in Necro Nebula - Stage 2 to assist the Kirbys against the Lady Ivy rematch by giving them Fruit.

wikirby-page:12498.description_zh:
Big Warwiggle是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中型boss。它是一种大型蠕虫状生物，会在地下钻洞，从软土的区域冒出。它是半透明的，所以舞台出口——它在Green Grounds - Stage 9中吞下的出口——可以在它的体内被看到。要击败它，卡比（Kirby）必须不断攻击它的腹部，虽然Big Warwiggle会经常潜入地下，这使得攻击变得困难。击败Big Warwiggle可获得3,000点分数。它也可以使用Jumbo Candy立即击败。

在Volcano Valley - Stage 9中，玩家会再次面对Big Warwiggle。然而，这次它的身体除了头部外还有刺状物，唯一安全的攻击点是颈部的凸起。

Big Warwiggle在Survival Rush中会再次出现，这时它可以被在一扇卡比（Kirby）门后面发现。
wikirby-page:12498.description_en:
Big Warwiggle is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a large worm-like creature which burrows through the ground, emerging in soft patches of dirt. It is translucent, so the stage exit - which it had swallowed in Green Grounds - Stage 9 - can be seen in its gut. To defeat it, the 卡比（Kirby）s have to continually hit its gut, though Big Warwiggle will be burrowing a lot, making that difficult. Big Warwiggle is worth 3,000 points when defeated. It can also be instantly defeated using Jumbo Candy.

In Volcano Valley - Stage 9, Big Warwiggle is faced again. This time, however, it has a prickly body as well as its head, leaving the only safe spot to hit at the bulge in its neck.

Big Warwiggle is faced one more time in Survival Rush, where it can be found behind the one-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12525.description_zh:
Bigger Stactus是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中级Boss。它出现在Sandy Canyon - Stage 3的舞台尽头的一个充满沙子的房间里。与其他Stactus不同，Bigger Stactus拥有自己的身体段，这些段不算作其他独立的Stactuses。除此之外，它的头部大小与Big Stactus相同。

 Kirbys必须在它们出现的房间里面对三个更大的Stactuses，一次一个。每个都会钻进地面并从地下出现，试图撞击Kirbys。头部开始时带刺，但最终它们会放低警惕，允许Kirbys攻击头部。身体始终带刺，不应触碰。击败Bigger Stactus可获得5,000分对玩家。

Bigger Stactus再次作为敌人在Survival Rush中出现，是一-卡比（Kirby）门背后的选项之一。
wikirby-page:12525.description_en:
Bigger Stactus is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Sandy Canyon - Stage 3, in a sand-filled room at the very end of the stage. Unlike other Stactuses, the Bigger Stactus has body segments of its own, which don't amount to other individual Stactuses. Otherwise, its head is the same size as a Big Stactus.

The Kirbys have to face down three Bigger Stactuses in the chamber where they appear, one at a time. Each one will burrow and appear from out of the ground, attempting to crash into the Kirbys in the process. The heads are initially spiked, but eventually they will lower their guard, allowing the Kirbys to attack the heads. The body is spiked at all times, and should not be touched. Defeating Bigger Stactus confers 5,000 points onto the player.

Bigger Stactus is faced again as an enemy in Survival Rush, as one of the options behind the one-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12604.description_zh:
“Waddle Dees被广泛认为是微不足道的敌人。但已知它们会尽力增强自己。我听说有些会穿块状物像护甲一样。那样它们就是硬汉了！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），指的是Block Waddle Dee在Kirby Mass Attack
Block Waddle Dee中是Kirby Mass Attack的中级Boss。它是一种Big Waddle Dee，通过穿戴由Star Block制成的护甲来保护自己。Block Waddle Dee出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 7中，也会在Survival Rush的One-卡比（Kirby）门后面对。

Block Waddle Dee攻击能力不强，即便被包裹在它的方块中。当它掉落时，冲击可以压碎卡比（Kirby），而当它跳跃时，会导致较小的Star Block有时还会让Blucko掉落，也可能压碎卡比（Kirby）。与它战斗时，卡比（Kirby）必须反复被投掷到Block Waddle Dee的块状护甲上以打破它，然后猛击暴露的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。重复三次后，Block Waddle Dee被击败，玩家将获得1,000分奖励。
wikirby-page:12604.description_en:
“Waddle Dees are known far and wide as puny foes. But they've been known to do what they can to bulk up. I've heard that some wear blocks like armor. Then they're tough guys!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, referring to Block Waddle Dee in Kirby Mass Attack
Block Waddle Dee is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. It is a Big Waddle Dee which protects itself by wearing armor made from a Star Block. Block Waddle Dee appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 7, and is also faced in Survival Rush behind the One-卡比（Kirby） door.

Block Waddle Dee isn't very good at attacking, even when encased in its block. When it falls, the impact can crush 卡比（Kirby）, and when it jumps, it causes smaller Star Blocks and sometimes Bluckos to fall, which can also crush 卡比（Kirby）. To fight it, 卡比（Kirby） has to repeatedly be flung into Block Waddle Dee's block armor to break it, then pummel the exposed 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. Done three times, Block Waddle Dee is defeated, rewarding the player with 1,000 points.

wikirby-page:12695.description_zh:
“当你醒来时要小心Buzzybat。他的家人会围着他。他们都很危险，我告诉你！当Buzzybat变成墓碑时要小心。如果他那样做就迅速逃开！也要远离任何刺蝠。它们的尖刺很凶猛，所以尽量在瞄准Buzzybat时避开它们。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Buzzybat是Kirby Mass Attack中的中级Boss，如果按顺序玩关卡，他是游戏中最后面对的敌人，出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 9。在他的正常形态下，他相当小，看起来只是黄色蝙蝠。然而，他能够生成许多其他蝙蝠来保护自己，包括Li'lbat和Pricklebat。卡比们可以通过猛击来攻击Buzzybat，但这样做一开始可能相当棘手。周期性地，Buzzybat会停止，并变成一个巨大的墓碑，然后试图砸向Kirbys。Buzzybat的战斗分为三个阶段，每次中心的蝙蝠都变得更难击中。一旦击败Buzzybat，他会变成骷髅，奖励玩家4500分，并让Kirbys前往头骨大王（Skullord）。

Buzzybat也出现在Survival Rush，位于三扇卡比（Kirby）门的后面。
wikirby-page:12695.description_en:
“Be careful when you wake up Buzzybat. His family will swarm around him. They're all dangerous, I tell you! Watch out when Buzzybat turns into a tombstone. Dash away if he does that! Steer clear of any Pricklebats too. Their spikes are savage, so do your best to avoid them while aiming for Buzzybat.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Buzzybat is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack, and is the final one faced in the game if the stages were played in order, appearing in Volcano Valley - Stage 9. In his normal form, he is quite small, and only appears to be a yellow bat. However, he is capable of generating many other bats to protect himself, including Li'lbats and Pricklebats. The Kirbys can attack Buzzybat by pummeling him, but doing this in the first place can be quite tricky. Periodically, Buzzybat stops, and transforms into a giant tombstone, then tries to crash down on the Kirbys. Buzzybat's fight takes place in three phases, with the central bat becoming harder to hit each time. Once Buzzybat is defeated, he turns into a skeleton, granting the player 4,500 points and leaving the Kirbys to make their way to 头骨大王（Skullord）.

Buzzybat also appears in Survival Rush, behind the three-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12541.description_zh:
Giga Clanksprout是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中Boss。它出现在Sandy Canyon - Stage 8中，在关卡的最尽头有一个充满沙子的房间。Giga Clanksprout比普通的同类更机械化。它可以抓住最多三个卡比（Kirby），如果被抓住，它会把这些Kirby放下，然后将它们击倒。



要击败Giga Clanksprout，Kirby们必须先躲避它的攻击，然后等它掉落一个Block Bomb。接下来，Kirby们必须让Clanksprout自己抓住它的炸弹，每次Giga Clanksprout出现的位置都会比上一次更难把炸弹推入。当它抓住炸弹时，这个怪物会被眩晕足够长时间，让Kirby能拉动它夹子上的链条。一旦Giga Clanksprout被拉得足够远，它的嘴巴会出现，Kirbys会与它进行拔河。如果成功，Kirbys会把Giga Clanksprout的夹子砸到它的身体上，将其摧毁，并奖励玩家3,000分。如果Kirbys失败，他们会被击倒，并且必须再次躲避它的攻击并推进另一颗炸弹。

Giga Clanksprout也会出现在Survival Rush，在One-卡比（Kirby）门的后面。
wikirby-page:12541.description_en:
Giga Clanksprout is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Sandy Canyon - Stage 8, in a sand-filled room at the very end of the stage. Giga Clanksprout is much more mechanical than its standard counterparts. It can grab up to three 卡比（Kirby）s, and if grabbed it will take those Kirbys off, then KO them.

To defeat Giga Clanksprout, the Kirbys must first dodge its attacks, then wait for it to drop a Block Bomb. From there, the Kirbys have to trick the Clanksprout to grab its own bomb, while each time Giga Clanksprout appears in a more difficult location to push the bomb into than the last. When it grabs the bomb, the beast gets stunned long enough for the Kirbys to yank at the chain in its clamp. Once Giga Clanksprout has been yanked far enough, its mouth will appear, and the Kirbys will engage in a tug-o-war with it. If successful, the Kirbys will slam Giga Clanksprout's clamp into its body, destroying it, and rewarding the player with 3,000 points. Should the Kirbys fail, they will be knocked off and will have to dodge its attacks again and push in another bomb.

Giga Clanksprout also appears in Survival Rush, behind the One-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:5505.description_zh:
“这个地方的传说讲述了一位被称为Great Gear的强大守护者。我想知道它是否真的存在过？”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Great Gear是一个机械齿轮怪物，也是Kirby Mass Attack中的中期首领。在他首次出现在Sandy Canyon - Stage 6时，Great Gear看起来只是卡比（Kirby）们必须推动通过关卡的障碍物。然而，当齿轮到达终点时，他会被拉到位并唤醒，然后攻击Kirbys。他的弱点是覆盖齿轮内部机制的蓝色板；然而，只有当齿轮倒置时才能攻击这个板。Great Gear通过多条链条上的重物（可以是Rolling Pawn或Rolling Spike的任何一种）保持自身位置。还用嘴里的尖刺果实击退卡比。为了暴露Great Gear的弱点，卡比必须破坏悬挂在链子上的棋子，使Great Gear失去平衡并旋转面部，从而露出弱点。在这个弱点位置攻击三次就足以击败Great Gear，玩家将获得3,000分。

 Great Gear在Volcano Valley - Stage 9中重新出现。战斗方式相同，只是中期boss会从嘴里释放Mummbon，并在第一轮之后将地面覆盖在流沙中。他在战斗的第一阶段还会吐出尖刺果实。

 Great Gear在Survival Rush中再次出现，位于三扇卡比（Kirby）门的后面。
wikirby-page:5505.description_en:
“The legends of this place tell of a mighty guardian known as the Great Gear. I wonder if it ever really existed?”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Great Gear is a mechanical gear monster and a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. In his first appearance in Sandy Canyon - Stage 6, the Great Gear appears only to be an obstacle which the 卡比（Kirby）s must push through the level. When the gear reaches the end, however, he is pulled into place and awakened, upon which he attacks the Kirbys. His weak point is a blue plate covering the gear's inner mechanisms; however, this plate can only be attacked when the gear is upside-down. Great Gear holds himself in place with a number of weights on chains (which can be either variety of Rolling Pawn or Rolling Spikes) and also fends off the Kirbys with spiky fruit from his mouth. In order to expose Great Gear's weak point, the Kirbys must destroy the pawns hanging from the chains in such a way that it throws Great Gear off balance and rotates his face to reveal the weak spot. Three attacks on this spot are enough to defeat the Great Gear, conferring 3,000 points onto the player.

Great Gear reappears in Volcano Valley - Stage 9. The battle is the same except that the mid-boss releases Mummbons from his mouth and, after the first round, covers the floor in quicksand. He also spits spiky fruit during the first phase of the battle.

Great Gear appears one more time in Survival Rush, behind the three-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12587.description_zh:
King Eelongo是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中boss。他出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 5的一个长长的水下隧道中。他通过不断沿隧道游动来攻击，在到达之前释放气泡来预告他的出现。与标准的Eelongos不同，King Eelongo看起来是由石头制成的，并且并非无敌。为了击败他，Kirbys必须撞击他坚硬的两侧以破坏它们，只留下脊椎。然而，如果触碰脊椎，Kirbys会受到伤害，如果King Eelongo直接击中他们，他们就会被击倒。一旦King Eelongo被击败，玩家将获得3,000分奖励。

在Volcano Valley - Stage 9中，King Eelongo将再次被挑战。在这里，Kirbys必须在浑浊的水中与他战斗，使他们的空气比以前更少。这个King Eelongo的颜色比第一个稍微红一些。在Survival Rush中第三次面对King Eelongo，就在三扇卡比（Kirby）门后面。
wikirby-page:12587.description_en:
King Eelongo is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. He appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 5, in a long underwater tunnel. He attacks by continuously swimming down the tunnel, forewarning his arrival by releasing air bubbles. Unlike standard Eelongos, King Eelongo appears to be made of stone, and is not invincible. To defeat him, the Kirbys have to slam into his stony sides to break them, leaving only the spine left. However, the Kirbys will take damage if they touch the spine, and will be KO'd if King Eelongo hits them directly. Once King Eelongo is defeated, the player will be rewarded with 3,000 points.

In Volcano Valley - Stage 9, King Eelongo is fought again. Here, the Kirbys have to fight him in murky water, leaving them less air than before. This King Eelongo has a slightly redder color than the first. King Eelongo is faced a third time in Survival Rush, behind the three-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12688.description_zh:
“A飞船。听起来像是一艘强大的船只。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Mothership是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中型Boss，位于Volcano Valley - Stage 10中。它是一艘由Space Oohroo建造并驾驶的巨大紫色飞碟。为了对抗它，Kirbys必须使用来自Space Oohroo实验室的蓝图建造自己的飞船。

Mothership通过打开其三个舱口中的一个或多个来攻击，暴露大炮、小炮或反射伞。柯比们必须射中大炮并摧毁它们才能对飞船造成伤害。任何暴露太久的炮塔都将向柯比们的飞船开火；然而，小炮不会开火，并且会在来得及开火前迅速收回。被击毁。Mothership的遮阳伞也会吸收任何射击并将其反射回Kirbys的飞船。这场战斗在Mothership被摧毁前经历三个阶段。

与其他敌人不同，Mothership的名字不会出现在游戏的日文点名中。
wikirby-page:12688.description_en:
“A spaceship has been sighted in this area. It sounds like a formidable vessel.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Mothership is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack, found in Volcano Valley - Stage 10. It is a giant purple flying saucer constructed and piloted by the Space Oohroos. To combat it, the Kirbys have to build their own ship using blueprints from the Space Oohroo laboratory.

The Mothership attacks by opening one or more of its three hatches to reveal big turrets, small turrets, or reflecting umbrellas. The Kirbys have to fire at the big turrets and destroy them to do damage to the ship. Any turrets left out too long will fire on the Kirbys' spaceship; however, the small turrets do not fire, and are quickly retracted before they can be shot down. The Mothership's parasols will also absorb any shots and fire them back at the Kirbys' spaceship. The fight goes through three phases before the Mothership is destroyed.

Unlike other enemies, the Mothership's name is not shown in the Japanese roll call of the game.

wikirby-page:12649.description_zh:
Quad Gun是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中级Boss。它出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 2中，并追逐卡比（Kirby）坦克。它本身就是一个非常大的坦克，有四只眼睛和同样数量的导弹炮插槽。

Quad Gun分为四个阶段进行战斗，每个阶段只有一只眼睛是睁开的。要对这个中级Boss造成伤害，卡比（Kirby）坦克需要在眼睛出现时射击与该眼睛颜色相对应的按钮。击中骷髅按钮会导致Quad Gun翻向四门导弹炮，然后全部发射。这些导弹可以通过射击来摧毁，而导弹炮可以在两次命中后被摧毁。

在最后的红色阶段，Quad Gun会切换框架，而按钮需要被射击，需要被击中多次。它还会不断与骷髅按钮交换位置。一旦Quad Gun最终被击败，它会给予玩家3000分。
wikirby-page:12649.description_en:
Quad Gun is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. It appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 2, and chases the 卡比（Kirby） tank. It is a very large tank in its own right, with four eyes and as many slots for missile cannons.

Quad Gun is fought in four phases, with only one of its eyes being open per phase. To damage this mid-boss, the 卡比（Kirby） tank needs to fire at a button that corresponds with the color of the open eye when it appears. Hitting a skull button will cause the Quad Gun to roll over to four missile cannons, then fire them all off. The missiles the cannons shoot can be destroyed by firing at them, and the cannons can be destroyed in two hits.

During the last red phase, Quad Gun switches frames, and the button that needs to be shot will need to be hit many times. It will also continually swap places with skull buttons. Once Quad Gun is finally defeated, it confers 3,000 points to the player.

wikirby-page:12668.description_zh:
“正漂浮在这个岛的某个地方。据说他拥有一件宝物，但你需要找到一把特殊的金库钥匙才能获得它。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Skullseer是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中型Boss。他出现在Volcano Valley - Stage 5，只能通过将大骷髅钥匙带到关卡末端附近的门来进入。Skullseer是Skull Gang的一部分，并指挥该地区的头骨儿（Skully）。他看起来像头骨儿（Skully），但更大，并且有角。与Skullseer战斗类似于与Skullys战斗。卡比（Kirby）必须抓住他并使他倒地三次才能击败他。Skullseer会召唤一群Skullys来攻击Kirbys，而他只有在Skullys被击倒后才会攻击他们。在第二阶段，他会召唤更多Skullys。在第三阶段，他会与他的Skullys一起攻击。如果Skullseer抓住一个卡比（Kirby），他会将其击倒。必须击败Skullseer才能在他出现的关卡中获得彩虹勋章，并且击败他会奖励3,000分。

Skullseer也出现在Survival Rush，在单个卡比（Kirby）的门后。
wikirby-page:12668.description_en:
“The leader of the Skullys, the Skullseer, is floating around this island somewhere. It's said that he possesses a treasure, but you'll need to find a special vault key to get at it.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Skullseer is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. He appears in Volcano Valley - Stage 5, and can only be accessed by bringing the big skull key to the door near the end of the stage. Skullseer is part of the Skull Gang, and commands the 头骨儿（Skully）s in the region. He looks similar to 头骨儿（Skully）, but is larger, and has horns. Fighting Skullseer is similar to fighting the Skullys. 卡比（Kirby）s have to latch onto him and bring him down three times to defeat him. Skullseer will summon a horde of Skullys to attack the Kirbys, and he will only attack them once the Skullys are taken down. In the second phase, he summons more Skullys. In the third phase, he attacks along with his Skullys. If Skullseer nabs a 卡比（Kirby）, he will KO him. Skullseer must be defeated to obtain the rainbow medal in the stage he appears in, and will award 3,000 points upon defeat.

Skullseer also appears in Survival Rush, behind the one-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12598.description_zh:
“那条在这座岛周围游动的机甲蛇叫做Steelsnapper。如果你被吞下，不要放弃。他消化任何东西都需要一段时间。如果有卡比（Kirby）卡在他的胃里，你有时间将它撬出来。所以在挑战那条蛇时一定要带上很多Kirby。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Steelsnapper是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个中boss。他出现在Dedede Resort - Stage 6的水下舱室里。Steelsnapper是一个大型机械蛇形生物，拥有带刺的头部、十个可以承受尖刺的金属节段，以及发射鱼雷的能力，鱼雷能够摧毁金属块。他还可以吸入水，将吃下的任何东西存储在他的节段中，包括卡比（Kirby）。要击败Steelsnapper，the卡比必须抓住每一段并将其摧毁，而当这些段上没有尖刺时才能这样做。然而，Steelsnapper会使这变得困难，因为他可以钻入墙中。击败Steelsnapper会给玩家带来3,000点积分。

Steelsnapper会在Survival Rush中再次出现，在三道卡比（Kirby）门的后面。
wikirby-page:12598.description_en:
“That mecha-snake swimming around this island is called Steelsnapper. If you get gulped down, don't give up. It takes him a while to digest anything. If a 卡比（Kirby） gets lodged in his stomach, you have time to pry him back out. So be sure to have a lot of Kirbys when you take on that snake.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Steelsnapper is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. He appears in Dedede Resort - Stage 6, in an underwater chamber. Steelsnapper is a large mechanical snake-like creature with a spiked head, ten metal segments which can bear spikes, and the ability to shoot torpedoes, which are capable of destroying metal blocks. He can also suck in water, storing anything he eats inside his segments, including 卡比（Kirby）s. To defeat Steelsnapper, the Kirbys will have to latch onto and destroy each of the segments while they don't have spikes on them. Steelsnapper will make doing this difficult, however, as he can burrow into the walls. Defeating Steelsnapper confers 3,000 points onto the player.

Steelsnapper appears again in Survival Rush, behind the three-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:12508.description_zh:
“一条路线会把你引向Tortletummy。他是一个大腹便便的敌人，总是把宝藏藏起来。就是藏在他的肚子里。一定有办法把它从他身上拿出来。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Tortletummy是Kirby Mass Attack的一个中boss。他出现在Green Grounds - Stage 10，居住在一个水下房间。他总是斜靠着坐着，让他那丰满的肚子暴露出来遭到Kirbys攻击，Kirbys必须被弹入他体内才能造成伤害。然而，Tortletummy的头盔始终提供保护。Tortletummy会尝试通过制造强水流带入小型或大型电水母来防御自己，这些水母会伤害Kirbys。气泡和水果也可能通过水流出现。他只能持续这么做在耗尽之前。Tortletummy被击败时奖励3,000点。

Tortletummy在Dedede Resort - Stage 5中再次出现，这次呈现紫色。他的战斗方式大致相同，不过他还会召唤Tortletummy Thorn，它们从墙上伸出，试图刺伤Kirby们，而它们的主人则向他们制造气流。一旦在这里被击败，Tortletummy将吐出一个Rainbow Medal。

Tortletummy在Survival Rush中再度面对，可以在三扇卡比（Kirby）门的后面找到。
wikirby-page:12508.description_en:
“One route will lead you to Tortletummy. He's a big-bellied foe who keeps his treasure hidden. In his belly, that is. There must be some way to get it out of him.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Tortletummy is a mid-boss in Kirby Mass Attack. He appears in Green Grounds - Stage 10, residing in an underwater chamber. He sits reclined at all times, leaving his ample belly exposed to attack by the Kirbys, who have to be flicked into him to deal damage. However, Tortletummy's helmet provides protection at all times. Tortletummy will attempt to defend himself by causing strong currents of water to carry in small or large electric jellyfish which can hurt the Kirbys. Air bubbles and fruit can also appear through the currents. He can only do this for so long before becoming exhausted. Tortletummy rewards 3,000 points when defeated.

Tortletummy appears again in Dedede Resort - Stage 5, this time sporting a purple hue. He fights much the same, though he also recruits the aid of Tortletummy Thorns which jut out of the walls to try and prick the Kirbys while their master creates a current toward them. Once defeated here, Tortletummy will spit out a Rainbow Medal.

Tortletummy is faced one more time in Survival Rush, where he can be found behind the three-卡比（Kirby） door.

wikirby-page:62792.description_zh:
Dedede Robo是一个大型可驾驶机器人，属于帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）。在卡比（Kirby）游戏系列中，它正式出现的只有在Kirby Quest的第2章作为最终对手，这是一款Sub-Game在Kirby Mass Attack中的游戏，尽管它最初计划出现在为任天堂GameCube取消的卡比（Kirby）中作为Boss。

Dedede Robo体积大而笨重，涂装模仿帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的皇冠和长袍的颜色。它的右手被替换成一个大型钻头，没有腿和脚，通过在空中飞行移动。它的头部内部有一个座位，Dedede可以用来控制机器人，不过它也可以自主行动。头部内还包含一个大型激光炮，并在胸壳。

重新喷漆和重新改装的这个机器人的版本后来出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，以HR-D3的名义，并由金属将军EX（Metal General EX）拥有。许多粉丝最初认为HR-D3和Dedede Robo是同一个，但补充材料，如Kirby JP Twitter上的Dedede Directory特辑，证实它们是不同的（画廊下方的图片）。
wikirby-page:62792.description_en:
Dedede Robo is a large pilotable robot that belongs to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）. In the 卡比（Kirby） video game series, it only formally appears as the final opponent of Chapter 2 of Kirby Quest, a Sub-Game in Kirby Mass Attack, though it was originally planned to appear as a boss in the canceled 卡比（Kirby） for Nintendo GameCube.

Dedede Robo is large and bulky, painted after the color of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s crown and robe. Its right hand is replaced with a large drill, and it has no legs or feet, moving around by flying through the air. Inside the head is a seat which Dedede can use to control the robot, though it can also act autonomously. It contains a large laser cannon inside its head as well, and bears 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s insignia on its chest casing.

A repainted and re-tooled version of this robot would later appear in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, under the moniker of HR-D3 and owned by 金属将军EX（Metal General EX）. Many fans initially thought HR-D3 and Dedede Robo were one and the same, but supplementary materials such as the Dedede Directory feature on the Kirby JP Twitter confirm them to be separate (image in gallery below).

wikirby-page:12071.description_zh:
“据说这个岛的老板是这个沙漠的女王。她被称为Lady Ivy。像所有美人一样，她有着带刺的一面！所以你绝对不能直接碰她。相反，要用某样东西敲她的头。我想她头上的跷跷板可能能用。她可是个狡猾的家伙。如果她把尾巴伸到跷跷板上，立刻攻击它！”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
Lady Ivy中是Kirby Mass Attack的一个老板。她担任Sandy Canyon的老板，并在Necro Nebula和Survival Rush中再次对战。Lady Ivy是一个缠绕的藤蔓生物，头上有一个紫色圆形的头颅，头颅长在茎上，戴着一个时尚的帽子。她与Snoozroot有些相似（并且在日语版本中与其有类似的名字），但行为并不相同相同的方式.
wikirby-page:12071.description_en:
“The boss of this island is said to be the queen of this desert. She's known as Lady Ivy. Like all beauties, she's got a thorny side! So you mustn't touch her directly. Instead, bonk her on the head with something. I imagine the seesaw over her head might work. She's a crafty one, though. If she snakes her tail onto the seesaw, attack it at once!”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
Lady Ivy is a boss from Kirby Mass Attack. She serves as the boss of Sandy Canyon, and is fought again in Necro Nebula and Survival Rush. Lady Ivy is a tangled vine creature with a purple circular head on a stalk wearing a stylish hat. She has a passing resemblance to Snoozroot (and shares a similar name with it in the Japanese version), but does not behave in the same manner.

wikirby-page:9280.description_zh:
“A彩虹似乎是和谐的普遍象征！但我想知道Necrodeus在看到彩虹时会看到什么？可能会让他头疼。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）在Kirby Mass Attack
Necrodeus中是Kirby Mass Attack的主要反派，也是Skull Gang的领导者。他是游戏中的最后一个Boss，并且在他的故乡Necro Nebula被挑战。Necrodeus负责将卡比（Kirby）分裂成十个较小的副本，以便更容易摧毁他。他在某种程度上类似于梦魇（Nightmare），尽管他具有更骨骼化的外观。
wikirby-page:9280.description_en:
“A rainbow seems to be a universal symbol for harmony! But I wonder what Necrodeus sees when he looks at a rainbow? Probably gives him a headache.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） in Kirby Mass Attack
Necrodeus is the primary villain of Kirby Mass Attack and the leader of the Skull Gang. He is the final boss of the game and is fought in his homeland, Necro Nebula. Necrodeus is responsible for splitting 卡比（Kirby） into ten smaller copies in order to more easily destroy him. He resembles 梦魇（Nightmare） to a certain extent, though he has a more skeletal appearance.

wikirby-page:38728.description_zh:
Robo Moley是Moley的机器人版本，只在Kirby Mass Attack Sub-Game Field Frenzy中出现。作为游戏中较为详细的敌人之一，Robo Moley拥有漂浮可拆卸的黑色球体作为“耳朵”、具有三指的机械手臂，以及一组正面的小装置，在一定程度上类似于Moley的脸。头顶是一个玻璃壳，里面勉强可以看到一个Mogmole驾驶着这台机器人。

Robo Moley有可能作为Field Frenzy回合的最终对手出现，取代Moley，不过战斗过程完全相同。要击败Robo Moley，玩家必须使用Nintendo DS手写笔重复点击它。如果这是动作太慢，Robo Moley将会发动攻击并造成失败。

与其他敌人不同，Robo Moley的日文名称不会出现在日本敌人点名表上，因为它是子游戏敌人。
wikirby-page:38728.description_en:
Robo Moley is a robotic version of Moley that appears exclusively in the Kirby Mass Attack Sub-Game Field Frenzy. Among one of the more detailed enemies in the game, Robo Moley sports floating detachable black spheres that act as "ears", robotic arms with three fingers, and a set of gadgets on the front that resemble Moley's face to a degree. The top of the head is a glass case, inside of which a Mogmole can just barely be seen piloting the robot.

Robo Moley has a chance to appear as the final opponent of the Field Frenzy round in place of Moley, though the battle is exactly the same regardless. To defeat Robo Moley, the player must repeatedly tap it using the Nintendo DS stylus. If this is done too slowly, Robo Moley will unleash its attack and force a loss.

Unlike other enemies, Robo Moley's Japanese name is not shown on the Japanese enemy roll call, as it is a Sub-Game enemy.

wikirby-page:12077.description_zh:
“据说Necrodeus将一些贪婪的猪赋予了他的黑暗力量。那听起来像是一场灾难的配方。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）指的是头骨大王（Skullord），在Kirby Mass Attack
头骨大王（Skullord）是Kirby Mass Attack中的一个Boss。他是Volcano Valley的Boss，并且在Necro Nebula和Survival Rush中再次遭遇。头骨大王（Skullord）戴着一个巨大的燃烧骷髅，有猪的鼻子和短粗的脚，他在火山顶部掌控时间并指挥Skull Gang。击败他将打破帮派对Popopo Islands的控制。
wikirby-page:12077.description_en:
“It's said that Necrodeus has imbued some greedy pig with his dark powers. That sounds like a recipe for disaster.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach） referring to 头骨大王（Skullord）, in Kirby Mass Attack
头骨大王（Skullord） is a boss from Kirby Mass Attack. He serves as the boss of Volcano Valley, and is fought again in Necro Nebula and Survival Rush. 头骨大王（Skullord） wears a giant flaming skull and has a pig's nose and stubby feet, who makes his watch and commands the Skull Gang from atop the volcano. Defeating him breaks the gang's hold of the Popopo Islands.

wikirby-page:12736.description_zh:
“当携带它们到Big Birdee时，你不能丢失哪怕一个Wee Birdee。请非常小心地进行。你无法避免将它们带入战斗，所以要谨慎作战。”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach），在Kirby Mass Attack
Wee Birdee是一个Birdee宝宝，具体来说是一只Big Birdee的小鸟，它出现在Kirby Mass Attack。共有六只，卡比（Kirby）将它们从Geg中救出并带回Sandy Canyon - Stage 11的母亲那里。成功完成后，Big Birdee和大部分较小的Birdee将成为Kirbys的盟友，在游戏的余下部分帮助他们。

如果携带Wee Birdee的卡比（Kirby）被击倒，Wee Birdee将飞到另一只没有携带任何东西的卡比（Kirby）。如果每只卡比（Kirby）的手已满，舞台将在Game Over结束。
wikirby-page:12736.description_en:
“You can't lose even a single Wee Birdee when carrying them to Big Birdee. Proceed very carefully. You can't help carrying them into battle, so fight cautiously.”
— 怪盗洛切（Daroach）, in Kirby Mass Attack
Wee Birdee is a baby Birdee, specifically a chick of Big Birdee, which appears in Kirby Mass Attack. There are six of them, and the 卡比（Kirby）s rescue them from the Gegs and carry them to their mother in Sandy Canyon - Stage 11. This done successfully, Big Birdee and most of the smaller Birdees become allies of the Kirbys, helping them throughout the rest of the game.

If a 卡比（Kirby） holding a Wee Birdee is KO'd, the Wee Birdee will fly to another 卡比（Kirby） who is not holding anything. If every 卡比（Kirby）'s hands are full, the stage will end in a Game Over.

wikirby-form:5702.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5702.description_zh:
“让奇迹光束（Flare Beam）屈服于你的意志！将电力聚集到棒子上，然后用你的心灵控制它！只需随意甩动——无需担心！”
— 奇迹光束（Flare Beam）来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）Deluxe的设定文本。
奇迹光束（Flare Beam）在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中是一种Super Ability。它是光束（Beam）复制能力（Copy Ability）的极其强大的变体，通过吞下Super Waddle Doo获得。

卡比（Kirby）的外观变为他光束（Beam）变形的夸张版本；卡比（Kirby）戴着一个非常大的小丑帽，帽子末端带有星星，帽子前方有星星标志。
wikirby-form:5702.description_en:
“Make 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） bend to your will! Gather electricity into the rod, then control it with your mind! Just fling it around—no need to worry!”
— 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） flavor text from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
奇迹光束（Flare Beam） is a Super Ability in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is an extremely powerful variation of the 光束（Beam） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and is obtained by swallowing a Super Waddle Doo.

卡比（Kirby）'s appearance changes to an exaggerated version of his 光束（Beam） transformation; 卡比（Kirby） dons a very large jester hat with stars at the ends and a star emblem in the front of the hat.

wikirby-form:5700.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5700.description_zh:
“用这个巨型锤子敲击地面大乱斗（Smash）！摇动+控制板来充能，达到3个能量等级。也能压扁巨大的桩！”
— 十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）豪华版的风味文字
十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）是一种Super Ability，目前仅在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版中独家提供。它是锤子（Hammer）卡比（Kirby）的一种极其强大的变体，可以通过击败中途Boss超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers）获得。

十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）卡比（Kirby）的外观变化，他头上有一条大蓝红相间的绳带，还有一个锤子。
wikirby-form:5700.description_en:
“大乱斗（Smash） the ground with this GIANT-SIZED hammer! Wiggle +Control Pad to charge it up and reach 3 power levels. Flatten HUGE stakes too!”
— 十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） flavor text from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） is a Super Ability that is currently exclusively available in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake. It is an extremely powerful variation of 锤子（Hammer） 卡比（Kirby）, and is obtained by defeating the mid-boss 超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers）.

十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） 卡比（Kirby）'s appearance changes with a large blue and red rope ribbon around his head, as well as a hammer.

wikirby-form:5636.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5636.description_zh: 叶子（Leaf）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），它首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，并且可以从敌人叶片怪（Leafan）和Bulby获取。当获得该能力时，卡比（Kirby）获得一个带有胸针的叶冠，胸针底部镶有绿色宝石，类似于烈火（Fire）皇冠。叶子（Leaf）卡比（Kirby）的攻击包括旋转的锋利叶片，主要以漩涡的方式投掷。这些叶片，像弯刀（Cutter）刀片和类似的投射物一样，能够切断绳索。此外，叶子（Leaf）卡比（Kirby）还会获得一个独特的Guard，在这个能力下，卡比（Kirby）并不像平时那样站在防御姿势中，而是藏在叶子（Leaf）堆中，使其几乎免疫所有攻击。具有其独特Guard和中程攻击能力，叶子（Leaf）是一种防御能力，谨慎的玩家可以非常有效地使用。
wikirby-form:5636.description_en: 叶子（Leaf） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and can be obtained from the enemies 叶片怪（Leafan） and Bulby. When acquiring this ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a crown of leaves with a brooch at the base with a green gem inset, similar to the 烈火（Fire） tiara. 叶子（Leaf） 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks include swirling razor-sharp leaves and throwing them mostly in a vortex fashion. These leaves, like 弯刀（Cutter） blades and similar projectiles, are able to cut ropes. In addition, 叶子（Leaf） 卡比（Kirby） also receives a unique Guard, where instead of standing in defensive pose like he normally would, 卡比（Kirby） hides in a 叶子（Leaf） pile, which renders him immune to almost all attacks. With its unique Guard and the ability to attack from medium range, 叶子（Leaf） is a defensive ability that cautious players can use very effectively.

wikirby-form:5710.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5710.description_zh:
“一条炽热的龙飞越天空！冲入战斗，它的龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）的愤怒将燃烧它路径上的每一个敌人！”
— 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）Deluxe的风味文本。
龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）是Super Ability，可在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中使用。它是烈火（Fire）能力的极其强大的形式，通过吞下Super Hot Head获得。

龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）卡比（Kirby）的外观发生变化，他获得了一个大的红色烈火（Fire）皇冠，前面有一颗星。
wikirby-form:5710.description_en:
“A fiery dragon flies through the sky! Storming into battle, the fury of its 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） will burn every foe in its path!”
— 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） flavor text from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） is a Super Ability available in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is an extremely powerful form of the 烈火（Fire） ability, and is obtained by swallowing a Super Hot Head.

龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） 卡比（Kirby）'s appearance changes in that he obtains a large red crown of 烈火（Fire）, with a star on the front.

wikirby-form:5717.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5717.description_zh:
“下雪天！变成一个巨大的雪球，然后碾过敌人把他们冻住！通过爆开恢复原状，或者继续滚动并击散敌人！”
— 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）的趣味文本是Super Ability，可在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中获取，通过击败Super Chilly获得。获得该能力后，卡比（Kirby）会得到一个类似软冰淇淋蛋筒的帽子，前面有大水晶图案和一颗星星。冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）也会以卡比（Kirby）的Special招式之一再次出现于卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）。
wikirby-form:5717.description_en:
“Snow day! Transform into a giant snowball, then roll over foes to freeze 'em! Change back by bursting, or roll on and scatter foes!”
— 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） flavor text from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） is a Super Ability available in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, obtained by defeating a Super Chilly. By gaining the ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a hat resembling a soft ice cream cone with a large crystal pattern and a star on the front. 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） also reappears as one of 卡比（Kirby）'s Special moves in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

wikirby-form:5637.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5637.description_zh:
“那个枪（Spear）...你加入了瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）军队还是怎么的？！长矛既可以刺击也可以投掷？明白了吗？！”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）在Kirby Battle Royale
枪（Spear）中的评论是复制能力（Copy Ability），它首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），可以赋予卡比（Kirby）一个坚固的枪（Spear）来攻击敌人。使用枪（Spear），卡比（Kirby）可以轻松从安全距离击打敌人和物体，也可以穿墙攻击。枪（Spear）在水下尤其有用，让卡比（Kirby）可以向四个方向攻击，并到达大多数其他能力无法到达的区域。卡比（Kirby）还可以像标枪一样投掷他的枪（Spear），使它向前移动，然后沿弧线下落（与锤子（Hammer）能力不同），卡比（Kirby）在这样做的时候不会失去枪（Spear）。当卡比（Kirby）获得枪（Spear）能力时，他会得到一顶类似士兵头带的帽子。像其他带有锋利工具的能力一样，枪（Spear）能够切断绳索。

从星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）开始，头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）也拥有很大程度上基于枪（Spear）能力的动作组合。因此，卡比（Kirby）通常不会出现在卡比（Kirby）系列中，因为头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）在其中是可操作的角色。
wikirby-form:5637.description_en:
“That 枪（Spear）... Did you join the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） army or something?! Spears are great for both thrusting and throwing? Get the point?!”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）'s comment in Kirby Battle Royale
枪（Spear） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that grants 卡比（Kirby） a sturdy 枪（Spear） to jab his enemies with. Using the 枪（Spear）, 卡比（Kirby） can easily strike enemies and objects at a safe distance, as well as through walls. 枪（Spear） is exceptionally useful underwater, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to strike in all four directions, and reach areas where most other abilities could not. 卡比（Kirby） can also toss his 枪（Spear） like a javelin, causing it to move forward, then down in an arc (and unlike the 锤子（Hammer） ability, 卡比（Kirby） will not lose the 枪（Spear） when doing so). When 卡比（Kirby） acquires the 枪（Spear） ability, he gains a hat which resembles a soldier's headband. Like other abilities featuring sharp utensils, 枪（Spear） is capable of cutting ropes.

Starting with 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） also has a moveset largely based on the 枪（Spear） ability. As such, it is often the case that 枪（Spear） 卡比（Kirby） does not appear in a 卡比（Kirby） title because 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） is playable in it instead.

wikirby-form:5715.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5715.description_zh:
“装载着纯粹的破坏力，它是一项超级能力！它的名字：究极剑士（Ultra Sword）！它摧毁路径上的一切，甚至连地面也不放过！”
— 究极剑士（Ultra Sword）来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）Deluxe的究极剑士（Ultra Sword）设定文字。
究极剑士（Ultra Sword）是一项Super Ability，首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），可以通过吸入或击败Super Blade Knight获取。像普通的利剑（Sword）能力一样，卡比（Kirby）在获得此能力时也会带上一个软绿色帽子，虽然帽檐上有额外的设计，额头和帽尖上有星形徽章。

究极剑士（Ultra Sword）是游戏中最常见的超级能力，而且出现在北美版星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）盒装封面的正面。究极剑士（Ultra Sword）也是卡比（Kirby）在Nintendo 3DS / Wii U的超级大乱斗（Smash）中以及Ultimate中的Final Smash，此外还有作为他在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的特殊攻击之一。
wikirby-form:5715.description_en:
“Packing pure destructive power, it's a Super Ability! Its name: 究极剑士（Ultra Sword）! It destroys everything in its path, even the ground!”
— 究极剑士（Ultra Sword） flavor text from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
究极剑士（Ultra Sword） is a Super Ability that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, obtained by inhaling or defeating a Super Blade Knight. Like the regular 利剑（Sword） ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a floppy green cap with the ability, though with extra designs on the brim and star emblems on the forehead and tip.

究极剑士（Ultra Sword） is the most common Super Ability in the game by a fair margin, and is featured on the front of the North American box art for 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. 究极剑士（Ultra Sword） is also 卡比（Kirby）'s Final Smash in Super 大乱斗（Smash） for Nintendo 3DS / Wii U and Ultimate, and serves as one of his special attacks in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

wikirby-form:5648.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5648.description_zh: 清水（Water）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，通过吞下与清水（Water）相关的敌人获得。这个能力给予卡比（Kirby）一个由清水（Water）制成的帽子，类似于其他元素能力如烈火（Fire）、冰冻（Ice）和龙卷风（Tornado）。清水（Water）卡比（Kirby）可以在他创造的一种清水（Water）形态上冲浪，从而能够轻松穿越熔岩。他还可以使用该能力中和熔岩块（但不能中和熔岩本身），这使得访问某些区域和Energy Sphere成为必须。卡比（Kirby）还可以向下喷射清水（Water）并悬浮，在此过程中摧毁敌人，还可以将清水（Water）向上射出。此外，清水（Water）卡比（Kirby）拥有更强大的Water Gun，吹出三个清水（Water）脉冲而不是一个。
wikirby-form:5648.description_en: 清水（Water） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which makes its first game appearance in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, obtained by swallowing 清水（Water）-related enemies. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a hat made of 清水（Water）, similar to other elemental abilities like 烈火（Fire）, 冰冻（Ice）, and 龙卷风（Tornado）. 清水（Water） 卡比（Kirby） can surf on a form of 清水（Water） he creates, thus being able to easily traverse through lava. He can also neutralize lava blocks (though not lava itself) using the ability, making it a requirement to access some areas and Energy Spheres. 卡比（Kirby） can also spit 清水（Water） downwards and hover, destroying enemies along the way, as well as shoot 清水（Water） upwards. In addition, 清水（Water） 卡比（Kirby） has a more powerful Water Gun, blowing out three 清水（Water） pulses rather than one.

wikirby-form:5649.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-form:5649.description_zh:
“那个鞭子（Whip）很酷……但真正厉害的是那顶帽子。鞭子（Whip）让你的敌人服服帖帖！顺便把他们包起来吧！”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）在Kirby Battle Royale
鞭子（Whip）的评论是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），通过吞噬与鞭子（Whip）相关的敌人获得。鞭子（Whip）卡比（Kirby）戴着一顶红色皮质牛仔帽，上面装饰着浅蓝色星星。帽沿有黄色花状设计，并用棕色线固定在一起。卡比（Kirby）通过多种方式挥动他的鞭子（Whip）进行攻击。该能力可以用来获取坚固墙壁之外的物品，因为卡比（Kirby）的鞭子（Whip）可以穿透墙壁。这使他能够到达原本无法到达的开关和星星。卡比（Kirby）还可以使用鞭子（Whip）可以从远处抓取敌人和物品，然后将前者四处投掷以击败他们，包括将他们投向其他敌人以造成附带伤害。这一方面使得鞭子（Whip）的能力在Kirby Fighters游戏中尤其强大。
wikirby-form:5649.description_en:
“That 鞭子（Whip） is cool and all... but the hat is where it's really at. 鞭子（Whip） your enemies into shape! Wrap 'em up while you're at it!”
— 格斗家乔（Knuckle Joe）'s comment in Kirby Battle Royale
鞭子（Whip） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, obtained by swallowing 鞭子（Whip）-related enemies. 鞭子（Whip） 卡比（Kirby） wears a red leather cowboy hat adorned with light blue stars. The brim has a yellow flower-like design and a brown thread keeping it together. 卡比（Kirby） attacks by lashing out his 鞭子（Whip） in several ways. The ability can be used to obtain items across solid walls, as 卡比（Kirby）'s 鞭子（Whip） can go through them. This allows him to reach otherwise unreachable switches and stars. 卡比（Kirby） can also use the 鞭子（Whip） to grab enemies and items from a distance, and then toss the former around to defeat them, including tossing them at other enemies to deal collateral damage. This aspect makes the 鞭子（Whip） ability a particularly potent one in the Kirby Fighters games.

wikirby-variant:1747:bonkers-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:1747:bonkers-ex.description_zh:
锤星猩EX（Bonkers EX）是锤星猩（Bonkers）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“他来这里是为了用他的锤子摧毁东西——而且他不是在胡闹！”
— 锤星猩（Bonkers）Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
锤星猩（Bonkers）中的任务描述是一个类似猿猴的中boss，挥舞着一把巨大的锤子，类似于帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的。他在《星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）》中首次亮相。为了攻击，锤星猩（Bonkers）可以冲向卡比（Kirby），跳到空中并挥动锤子，或者向卡比（Kirby）投掷Coconut造成伤害。这些椰子可能会被吸入然后射出来伤害他。一旦被击败，锤星猩（Bonkers）会像所有中boss一样在地上躺一会儿，此时卡比（Kirby）可以吸入他并获得锤子（Hammer）能力。由于锤星猩（Bonkers）是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）之前唯一拥有锤子的敌人，因此他是锤子（Hammer）能力的帮助者。他以锤子（Hammer）能力出现在每场游戏中，并有许多衍生作品和变体。
wikirby-variant:1747:bonkers-ex.description_en:
Bonkers EX is an EX version of Bonkers in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“He's here to destroy things with his hammer—and he's not monkeying around!”
— 锤星猩（Bonkers） Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
锤星猩（Bonkers） is a simian-like mid-boss, wielding an enormous hammer which resembles 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s. He made his first appearance in 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）. In order to attack, 锤星猩（Bonkers） may charge at 卡比（Kirby）, jump in the air and swing his hammer, or throw Coconuts at 卡比（Kirby） to deal damage. These Coconuts may be inhaled then shot out to harm him. Once defeated, 锤星猩（Bonkers） lays on the ground for a bit, like all mid-bosses, at which point 卡比（Kirby） can inhale him and get the 锤子（Hammer） ability. Since 锤星猩（Bonkers） was the only enemy with a hammer prior to 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, he is the helper for the 锤子（Hammer） ability. He appears in every game with the 锤子（Hammer） ability, and has had many spin-offs and variations.

wikirby-variant:1268:halcandra-bouncy.name_zh: 哈鲁炕德拉弹跳蝴蝶结
wikirby-variant:1268:halcandra-bouncy.display_name: 哈鲁炕德拉弹跳蝴蝶结（Halcandra Bouncy）
wikirby-variant:1268:halcandra-bouncy.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:1268:halcandra-bouncy.description_zh:
哈鲁炕德拉弹跳蝴蝶结（Halcandra Bouncy）是弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“每个人都知道弹力球喜欢弹得这么高的唯一原因是因为它们喜欢从空中看到的景色。那里的一切看起来更加……平静。对于Bouncys来说，每一天都是美好的一天。没人能阻止他们！”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）中的雕像描述，最初称为弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）Ty（双关语“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）”）玩具”、“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）领带”，或者只是拼写错误），是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的敌人。她是一个粉红色的、有弹性的、像玩具一样的生物，戴着一条淡红色的丝带，有两只圆圆的眼睛，弹簧上方有一个红色的座位。正如她的名字一样，弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）不断弹跳，尽管有时她可能会向前跳跃并试图踩踏卡比（Kirby）。弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）吸入时不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-variant:1268:halcandra-bouncy.description_en:
Halcandra Bouncy is a distinct form or variant of Bouncy in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Everyone knows the only reason Bouncys like to bounce so high is 'cause they like the view from up in the air. Things just seem more...peaceful up there. Every day is a good day to Bouncys. No one's gonna keep 'em down!”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）'s figurine description in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）, originally known as 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Ty (either a pun on "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Toy", "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Tie", or simply a misspelling), is an enemy debuting in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. She is a pink, springy, toy-like creature that wears a pale red ribbon, has two beady eyes and a red seat above her spring. Fitting to her name, 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） continually bounces, although sometimes she may leap forward attempting to stomp 卡比（Kirby）. 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled.

wikirby-variant:7664:halcandra-bowby.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:7664:halcandra-bowby.description_zh:
哈鲁炕德拉鲍比（Halcandra Bowby）是Bowby的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
Bowby是一个首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人。它会悬浮在空中，如果卡比（Kirby）或他的朋友靠得太近，它会试图向他们发射箭矢。Bowby被吞下时不会提供任何能力。

Bowby是一种棕色、弓形的生物，有蓝色的眼睛、嘴巴和白色弯角（类似公牛或黄牛的角）；它那弯角之间悬挂着一条像线一样的细绳，它会把箭矢放在上面。弓形生物会出现在四个基本方向中的任意一个。如果横向面对，它的箭矢在飞行一小段距离后会开始呈弧线落下。Halcandra上存在一种金属变种，名为Halcan Bowby。
wikirby-variant:7664:halcandra-bowby.description_en:
Halcandra Bowby is a distinct form or variant of Bowby in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
Bowby is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It hovers in the air and will attempt to fire an arrow at 卡比（Kirby） or his friends if they come too close. Bowby does not provide any ability when swallowed.

Bowby is a brown, bow-shaped creature which sports blue eyes, a mouth, and white curved horns (resembling those of a bull or ox); suspended between these horns is a stringy, thread-like line which it rests arrows on. Bowbies will appear in any of the four cardinal directions. If facing sideways, its arrows will start to fall in an arc after traveling a short distance. There is a metallic variant that exists on Halcandra, which is named Halcan Bowby .

wikirby-variant:1264:halcandra-bronto-bu.display_name: 哈鲁炕德拉飞翅球球（Halcandra Bronto Burt）
wikirby-variant:1264:halcandra-bronto-bu.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:1264:halcandra-bronto-bu.description_zh:
哈鲁炕德拉飞翅球球（Halcandra Bronto Burt）是飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“啊哈！！我找到了下一个受害者！！Kirby's Avalanche”
— 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）中的
飞翅球球（Bronto Burt），最初名为Bront Burt，是一种圆形飞行生物，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最常见的敌人之一，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）并出现在随后的30多款卡比（Kirby）游戏中。在他的整个出现过程中，他的行为保持相对不变：他以各种模式在空中飞行并通过碰撞攻击卡比（Kirby）。一些Bronto Burt以设定的波浪图案飞行，其他的则遵循卡比（Kirby），还有一些在以设定的图案飞行之前通过俯冲和循环出现。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）经常出现在以天空为主题的关卡中，但他也可以出现在清水（Water）之外的任何地方。

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）通常可以被描述为小而圆，有两对半透明的昆虫状翅膀、黄色或橙色的小脚、长眉毛的大眼睛和一张小嘴。在后来的出场中，他有类似于卡比（Kirby）的脸红痕迹。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）在他的Super Smash Bros. Brawl奖杯中被描述为“一只看起来很像卡比（Kirby）的鸟……”，但这种“鸟”的名称并未在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）本身中得到证实。另外根据这个奖杯，他不发球帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），他时不时地俯冲轰炸，伤害卡比（Kirby）只是因为他挡路了。飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）也有颜色变体，如星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）和Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中所示，尽管它们通常只是美观。这些颜色变体并不像粉色变体那么常见。

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最普遍的敌人之一，出现在除Kirby's Star Stacker (Game Boy)及其SNES重制版以及Team Kirby Clash游戏之外的所有游戏中。
wikirby-variant:1264:halcandra-bronto-bu.description_en:
Halcandra Bronto Burt is a distinct form or variant of Bronto Burt in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Ah HA!! I have found my next victim!!”
— 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） in Kirby's Avalanche
飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, originally named Bront Burt, is a round flying creature who is one of the most prevalent enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having first appeared in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and since showing up in over 30 subsequent 卡比（Kirby） games. Throughout his appearances, his behavior has stayed relatively unchanged: he flies through the air in various patterns and attacks 卡比（Kirby） by collision. Some Bronto Burts fly in a set wavy pattern, others follow 卡比（Kirby）, and still others appear by diving and looping before flying in a set pattern. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is often found in sky-themed levels, but he can occur anywhere outside of 清水（Water）.

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） can typically be described as being small and round with two pairs of semi-transparent, insect-like wings, tiny yellow or orange feet, large eyes with long eyebrows, and a small mouth. In later appearances, he has blush marks similar to 卡比（Kirby）'s. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is described in his Super Smash Bros. Brawl trophy as "A bird that looks a lot like 卡比（Kirby）...", but this designation of "bird" is not corroborated within the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） itself. Also according to this trophy, he does not serve 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and he divebombs from time to time, hurting 卡比（Kirby） only because he is in the way. 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） also has color variants, as seen in 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land） and Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, although they are typically only aesthetic. These color variants are not as common as the pink variation.

飞翅球球（Bronto Burt） is among the most ubiquitous enemies in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, appearing in every game except for Kirby's Star Stacker (Game Boy) and its SNES remake, and the Team Kirby Clash games.

wikirby-variant:5901:dubior-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5901:dubior-ex.description_zh:
镀比亚EX（Dubior EX）是镀比亚（Dubior）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
镀比亚（Dubior）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。它类似于U.F.O.的漂浮机器人，拥有黄色闪亮的眼睛。它的下方是橙色的，周围有五个发射激光的突出物。被击败并吸收后，它会给予电火花（Spark）能力。

镀比亚（Dubior）相比大多数其他中型Boss有一个优势，即它可以悬浮，并且大部分时间都离开地面。除了施展一系列电击攻击之外，它还能够召唤被称为镀比亚（Dubior）Jr.的小型手下来保护自己。
wikirby-variant:5901:dubior-ex.description_en:
Dubior EX is an EX version of Dubior in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
镀比亚（Dubior） is a mid-boss that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It resembles a U.F.O.-like floating robot, with yellow shining eyes. Its underside is orange, and surrounding that side are five stubs that shoot lasers. It yields the 电火花（Spark） ability when defeated and inhaled.

镀比亚（Dubior） has an advantage over most other mid-bosses in that it can hover, and spends much of its time off the ground. In addition to delivering an arsenal of electrical attacks, it is also capable of summoning little minions known as 镀比亚（Dubior） Jr. to defend itself.

wikirby-variant:5883:fatty-puffer-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5883:fatty-puffer-ex.description_zh:
缓冲肥肥EX（Fatty Puffer EX）是缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“啊oy！缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer），这个海洋的贪吃者，出现了！当他吸气时，他会膨胀到巨大的体型。哦，看起来他还吞下了一部分船！也许这就是他变得如此强大的原因……”
— VS缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）特别页面在星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）是一个首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的Boss。正如他的名字所暗示的，他是一条胖河豚。他的外观类似于王者身份，他的攻击特点是利用巨大的体型进行身体猛撞和滚动攻击。他是Onion Ocean的Boss，并守卫着Lor Starcutter的左风羽（Wing）。
wikirby-variant:5883:fatty-puffer-ex.description_en:
Fatty Puffer EX is an EX version of Fatty Puffer in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Ahoy! 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）, a glutton of the sea, has surfaced! As he inhales, he'll puff up to a massive size. Oh, and it looks like he's swallowed a ship part! Maybe that's how he got so strong...”
— VS 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer） is a boss that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. As his name implies, he is a fat pufferfish. His appearance resembles that of kingship, and his attacks are characterized by using his girth to perform body slams and rolling attacks. He's the boss of Onion Ocean and guards the Lor Starcutter's Left 风羽（Wing）.

wikirby-variant:5882:gigant-edge-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5882:gigant-edge-ex.description_zh:
庞大刃EX（Gigant Edge EX）是庞大刃（Gigant Edge）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“士兵回来了，他比以往任何时候都更加武装且危险！”
— Tough:庞大刃（Gigant Edge）任务描述在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
庞大刃（Gigant Edge）是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）首次登场的中Boss，击败后会获得利剑（Sword）复制能力（Copy Ability），这是该系列中首次有中Boss提供此奖励。他穿着比利剑骑士（Sword Knight）或剑骑士（Blade Knight）更加坚固的铠甲，并且还持有一面盾牌（他偶尔会使用）。庞大刃（Gigant Edge）的攻击方式是向地面发射波动以试图击中卡比（Kirby），或持剑冲向卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-variant:5882:gigant-edge-ex.description_en:
Gigant Edge EX is an EX version of Gigant Edge in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“The soldier returns, and he's more armed and dangerous than ever!”
— Tough: 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
庞大刃（Gigant Edge） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that grants the 利剑（Sword） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and is the first mid-boss in the series to do so. He wears different, tougher armor than 利剑骑士（Sword Knight） or 剑骑士（Blade Knight）'s, and also sports a shield (which he occasionally uses). 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） attacks by shooting waves across the ground in an attempt to hit 卡比（Kirby）, or charging toward 卡比（Kirby） with his sword.

wikirby-variant:5884:goriath-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5884:goriath-ex.description_zh:
戈力牙斯EX（Goriath EX）是戈力牙斯（Goriath）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“雪山是戈力牙斯（Goriath）的家。当这个强大的斗士生气时，他不会冷静……但你仍然必须与他战斗，因为一部分船只藏在他的巢穴里！去拿吧！”
— 对战戈力牙斯（Goriath）特别页面在星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
戈力牙斯（Goriath）是一个类似雪人的老板，出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版——星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）。他作为White Wafers的老板出现，并守护着Lor Starcutter的徽章。他的大部分攻击是直接的近战攻击，例如拳打和踩踏，尽管他也会爬墙并投掷诸如雪球的物体，或从手中发射光束（类似于格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby））。

戈力牙斯（Goriath）的名字是“猩猩”和“Goliath”两个词的合成词。尽管如此，他实际上并不是那样大，特别是与卡比（Kirby）只有八英寸的高度相比。
wikirby-variant:5884:goriath-ex.description_en:
Goriath EX is an EX version of Goriath in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“The snowy mountains are 戈力牙斯（Goriath）'s home. When this powerful brawler gets mad, he won't calm down...but you'll have to battle him anyway, because a ship part is hiding in his lair! Go get it!”
— VS 戈力牙斯（Goriath） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
戈力牙斯（Goriath） is a yeti-like boss that appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake—星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. He appears as the boss of White Wafers and guards the Lor Starcutter's Emblem. Most of his attacks are direct melee attacks, such as punches and stomps, though he will also climb the walls and throw objects such as snowballs, or shoot beams from his hand (similar to 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby）).

戈力牙斯（Goriath）'s name is a portmanteau of the words "gorilla" and "Goliath". Despite this, he really isn't that large, especially compared to 卡比（Kirby）'s height of only eight inches.

wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-ex.description_zh:
伟大喽啪EX（Grand Doomer EX）是伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“它是所有末世者的老板，金色的伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）！当疯狂正午的天空开始扭曲时，这个可怕的敌人俯冲而来，夺取了球体——以及它们穿越维度的力量！”
— VS伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）豪华版星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）特别页面
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）是一个大型的光谱火焰球形生物，有翅膀，来自Another Dimension，首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），作为Nutty Noon的Boss出现。他是所有球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的Boss，并通过Lor Starcutter的桅杆制造的维度裂隙来到卡比（Kirby）的维度。当卡比（Kirby）和朋友们接近包含桅杆的零件球时，伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）将其吞噬，并开始与他们战斗。他的攻击方式类似于烈火（Fire）球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer），尽管他的攻击更加强大。
wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-ex.description_en:
Grand Doomer EX is an EX version of Grand Doomer in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“It's the boss of all Doomers, the golden 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）! As the skies over Nutty Noon began to warp, this fearsome foe swooped in to claim the spheres—and their dimension-traveling powers!”
— VS 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） Special Page from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） is a large spectral flaming ball-shaped creature with wings from Another Dimension that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, appearing as the boss of Nutty Noon. He is the boss of all 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, and arrived in 卡比（Kirby）'s dimension thanks to a dimensional rift created by the Lor Starcutter's mast. When 卡比（Kirby） and friends approach the Part Sphere containing the mast, 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） consumes it, and begins to fight them. He attacks in a similar fashion as the 烈火（Fire） 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, though his attacks are much more powerful.

wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-third-.display_name: 伟大喽啪第三阶段（Grand Doomer Third Phase）
wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-third-.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-third-.description_zh:
伟大喽啪第三阶段（Grand Doomer Third Phase）是伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）的独立阶段形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“它是所有末世者的老板，金色的伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）！当疯狂正午的天空开始扭曲时，这个可怕的敌人俯冲而来，夺取了球体——以及它们穿越维度的力量！”
— VS伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）豪华版星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）特别页面
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）是一个大型的光谱火焰球形生物，有翅膀，来自Another Dimension，首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），作为Nutty Noon的Boss出现。他是所有球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的Boss，并通过Lor Starcutter的桅杆制造的维度裂隙来到卡比（Kirby）的维度。当卡比（Kirby）和朋友们接近包含桅杆的零件球时，伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）将其吞噬，并开始与他们战斗。他的攻击方式类似于烈火（Fire）球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer），尽管他的攻击更加强大。
wikirby-variant:6039:grand-doomer-third-.description_en:
Grand Doomer Third Phase is a distinct phase of Grand Doomer in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“It's the boss of all Doomers, the golden 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）! As the skies over Nutty Noon began to warp, this fearsome foe swooped in to claim the spheres—and their dimension-traveling powers!”
— VS 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） Special Page from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） is a large spectral flaming ball-shaped creature with wings from Another Dimension that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, appearing as the boss of Nutty Noon. He is the boss of all 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, and arrived in 卡比（Kirby）'s dimension thanks to a dimensional rift created by the Lor Starcutter's mast. When 卡比（Kirby） and friends approach the Part Sphere containing the mast, 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） consumes it, and begins to fight them. He attacks in a similar fashion as the 烈火（Fire） 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, though his attacks are much more powerful.

wikirby-variant:11931:parasol-halcandra-.name_zh: 阳伞哈鲁炕德拉瓦豆鲁迪
wikirby-variant:11931:parasol-halcandra-.display_name: 阳伞哈鲁炕德拉瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Halcandra Dee）
wikirby-variant:11931:parasol-halcandra-.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:11931:parasol-halcandra-.description_zh:
阳伞哈鲁炕德拉瓦豆鲁迪（Parasol Halcandra Dee）是Halcandle Dee的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
Halcandle Dee是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的替代品，可以在Halcandra上找到。它具有许多与标准瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）相同的特性，包括它经常懒散的动作和无忧无虑的行为，但可以通过其外观来区分，穿着灰色连体服，顶部有一个小折痕，只露出一双椭圆形的眼睛，类似于魔法洛亚（Magolor）的样子。

像瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）一样，Halcandle Dee被吞下时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability），除非它还携带Parasol。Armor Waddle Dee也存在，它们看起来与标准品种不同。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，Halcandle Dee可以在Halcandra关卡中看到，Egg Engines和Dangerous Dinner。在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中，可以在New Challenge Stages和Last Land挑战中找到。
wikirby-variant:11931:parasol-halcandra-.description_en:
Parasol Halcandra Dee is a distinct form or variant of Halcandle Dee in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
Halcandle Dee is a stand-in for 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） which can be found on Halcandra. It bears many of the same qualities as a standard 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, including its often lazy movements and carefree behavior, but it can be distinguished by its appearance, wearing a gray jumpsuit which has a small fold on the top and shows only a pair of oval-shaped eyes, similar to 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s.

Like 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, Halcandle Dee provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed, unless it is also carrying a Parasol. Armor Waddle Dee also exist, which look distinct from the standard variety.

In 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, Halcandle Dee can be seen in the Halcandra levels, Egg Engines and Dangerous Dinner. In Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition, it can be found in New Challenge Stages and Last Land challenges.

wikirby-variant:6553:kibble-blade-ex.display_name: 弯刀骑士老大EX（Kibble Blade EX）
wikirby-variant:6553:kibble-blade-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:6553:kibble-blade-ex.description_zh:
弯刀骑士老大EX（Kibble Blade EX）是弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“Witness银色盔甲的回归，刀刃刚刚磨利，准备就绪！”
— 艰难：弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）任务描述在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）首次登场的中型Boss，当吸入时会产生弯刀（Cutter）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它的攻击方式与其较小的表亲弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）类似，因为它会抛出头顶的刀刃。它可以以几种不同的模式进行攻击。它还会尝试撞击卡比（Kirby），就像大多数其他中型Boss一样。
wikirby-variant:6553:kibble-blade-ex.description_en:
Kibble Blade EX is an EX version of Kibble Blade in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Witness the return of the silver armor, blade newly sharpened and ready!”
— Tough: 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） is a mid-boss who debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that yields the 弯刀（Cutter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled. Its attacks are similar to that of its smaller cousin, 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）, in that it tosses the blade on its head. It can do this in several different patterns. It will also attempt to ram 卡比（Kirby）, much like most of the other mid-bosses.

wikirby-variant:5806:king-doo-ex.display_name: 瓦豆鲁笃老大EX（King Doo EX）
wikirby-variant:5806:king-doo-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5806:king-doo-ex.description_zh:
