瓦豆鲁笃老大EX（King Doo EX）是瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“在最终战斗中，小心闪电鞭！不要让卡比（Kirby）队被击退！”
— 在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe中的困难任务描述
瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。他是一只大型黄色瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），头顶有明显的毛发丛，鞋尖向上翘起。

作为典型的瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），他可以使用光束鞭攻击，这攻击基本上与普通瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的攻击一样（只是明显更大），他还可以在跳跃后在空中使用。瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）也拥有波纹光束（Beam）能力，可以横向发射强大的能量冲击波覆盖整个战场。他还有一种非光束攻击，即直接冲撞屏幕。一旦被击败，瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）可以被吸入用于光束（Beam）能力.
wikirby-variant:5806:king-doo-ex.description_en:
King Doo EX is an EX version of King Doo in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“In the final battle, watch out for lightning whips! Don't let Team 卡比（Kirby） be driven back!”
— Tougher Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He is a large yellow 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） with a pronounced tuft of hair and shoes with tips that point upward.

As expected from a 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, he can use a beam whip attack, which appears essentially identical to a regular 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）'s (though obviously much larger) which he can also use in the air after a jump. 瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） also has the Wave 光束（Beam） ability, firing a large blast of energy sideways across the field. He also has one non-beam attack, which involves simply charging across the screen. Once defeated, 瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） can be inhaled for the 光束（Beam） ability.

wikirby-variant:6048:landia-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:6048:landia-ex.description_zh:
龙帝亚EX（Landia EX）是龙帝亚（Landia）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“龙帝亚（Landia），这个栖息在哈尔德拉火山的四头守护者，自古以来一直被尊为这颗星球的守护者……那么为什么它现在醒了呢？而且看起来这么生气？！啊！”
— VS龙帝亚（Landia）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
龙帝亚（Landia）特殊页面，是一条古龙，是Halcandra上古代文物的守护者；最著名的是Lor Starcutter和Master Crown，后者他戴在最高的头上。他由四条独立的龙组成，可以根据情况合并成一个类似九头蛇的实体，也可以再次分开。除了这股力量外，龙帝亚（Landia）还可以喷火、召唤有害的强风，并产生电场，尽管这些力量中的一些可能来自Master Crown而不是龙帝亚（Landia）自身的天赋能力。除此之外，龙帝亚（Landia）的主要攻击策略是向对手俯冲攻击，可以是单个攻击，也可以分开攻击。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次作为Dangerous Dinner的Boss登场，之后龙帝亚（Landia）在几款卡比（Kirby）游戏中再次出现，最著名的是''Team Kirby Clash'' series，在那里他和他的各种变体会被多次对战。尽管作为敌人频繁出现，龙帝亚（Landia）被描述为仁慈的守护天使和保护者，只因附身或误会才与卡比（Kirby）及其盟友战斗。在卡比（Kirby）游戏之外，龙帝亚（Landia）还以Spirit的身份出现在Super Smash Bros. Ultimate。
wikirby-variant:6048:landia-ex.description_en:
Landia EX is an EX version of Landia in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“龙帝亚（Landia）, the 4-headed guardian who sleeps in Haldera Volcano, has been revered as this planet's protector since ancient times...so why is it awake now? And looking this way so angrily?! Eep!”
— VS 龙帝亚（Landia） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
龙帝亚（Landia） is an ancient dragon and the protector of ancient artifacts on Halcandra; most notably the Lor Starcutter and the Master Crown, the latter of which he wears on his highest head. He consists of four separate dragons which can combine into a single hydra-like entity or split apart again depending on circumstances. In addition to this power, 龙帝亚（Landia） can also breathe fire, conjure up harmful gusts of wind, and generate electric fields, though some of these powers may be drawn from the Master Crown rather than 龙帝亚（Landia）'s own innate ability. Aside from this, 龙帝亚（Landia）'s main attack strategy is to dive at his opponents, either as one or separated.

Introduced in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） as the boss of Dangerous Dinner, 龙帝亚（Landia） has since reappeared in several 卡比（Kirby） games, most notably in the ''Team Kirby Clash'' series, where he and variants of him are fought multiple times. Despite appearing so often as an opponent, 龙帝亚（Landia） is described as a benevolent guardian angel and protector, who only fights 卡比（Kirby） and his allies due to possession or misunderstanding. Outside of the 卡比（Kirby） games, 龙帝亚（Landia） has appeared in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate as a Spirit.

wikirby-variant:71265:lor-ex-and-magolor.display_name: 洛亚EX&魔法洛亚（Lor EX & Magolor）
wikirby-variant:71265:lor-ex-and-magolor.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:71265:lor-ex-and-magolor.description_zh:
洛亚EX&魔法洛亚（Lor EX & Magolor）是洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“洛尔·星际切割者，现在被叛徒魔法洛亚（Magolor）控制，被用作对抗卡比（Kirby）及其朋友的武器！如果这艘神秘的飞船有自己的意识……它此刻会有什么感受？”
— 对战洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）特别页面星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版的结尾，卡比（Kirby）及其朋友必须与Lor Starcutter对抗，同时乘骑龙龙帝亚（Landia）。这场Boss战正式称为洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor），并作为关卡Another Dimension的第一个Boss进行战斗。在战斗过程中，当它被魔法洛亚（Magolor）操控时，洛尔的外观会变为深紫色和粉色（或在Extra Mode中为黑色、金色和红色的组合），并能够使用它自己的部件去攻击卡比（Kirby）及其盟友。
wikirby-variant:71265:lor-ex-and-magolor.description_en:
Lor EX & Magolor is an EX version of Lor & Magolor in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“The Lor Starcutter, now controlled by the traitor 魔法洛亚（Magolor）, is being used as a weapon against 卡比（Kirby） and friends! If the shadowy ship had a mind of its own...how would it feel at this moment?”
— VS 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
Near the end of the 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 卡比（Kirby） and his friends have to face off against the Lor Starcutter, whilst riding the dragon 龙帝亚（Landia）. This boss fight is formally called 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）, and is fought as the first boss of the level Another Dimension. During the battle, as it is being puppeteered by 魔法洛亚（Magolor）, the Lor's appearance changes to a dark purple and pink coloration (or a combination of black, gold and red in Extra Mode) and is capable of using its own parts to attack 卡比（Kirby） and his allies.

wikirby-variant:6216:metal-general-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:6216:metal-general-ex.description_zh:
金属将军EX（Metal General EX）是金属将军（Metal General）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“很久以前，无魂战斗机器人金属将军（Metal General）会被它的主人派遣去访问其他星球并消灭敌人。现在它作为保安，永远守护这个地方。”
— VS金属将军（Metal General）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的特别页面
金属将军（Metal General）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中Egg Engines的老板。

当卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们首次进入金属将军（Metal General）的竞技场时，机器人是静止的，但当他们靠近它时，它会激活并喷出一阵蒸汽，表示战斗已经开始。击败金属将军（Metal General）是进入下一关的必要条件。
wikirby-variant:6216:metal-general-ex.description_en:
Metal General EX is an EX version of Metal General in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Long ago, the soulless battle robot 金属将军（Metal General） would be dispatched by its master to visit other planets and exterminate their foes. Now it serves as security, guarding this spot for eternity.”
— VS 金属将军（Metal General） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
金属将军（Metal General） is the boss of Egg Engines in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）.

When 卡比（Kirby） and his friends first enter 金属将军（Metal General）'s arena, the robot is stationary, but when they get close to it, it will activate and let out a burst of steam, signifying that the battle has begun. Defeating 金属将军（Metal General） is necessary to advance to the next level.

wikirby-variant:7094:moundo-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:7094:moundo-ex.description_zh:
山石EX（Moundo EX）是山石（Moundo）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
山石（Moundo）是出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版中的中级Boss。它看起来像一块大棕色岩石（有点像硬石（Rocky）），头顶有三根灰色尖刺。它穿着黄色的双脚上穿着一双草鞋，头上系着一条红白相间的头带，带有日本风格。它的脸总是带着永久的皱眉，嘴巴呈锯齿状，与它的岩石外观相辅相成。

正如其本性所示，山石（Moundo）一旦被卡比（Kirby）击败并吸收，就会获得石块（Stone）能力。
wikirby-variant:7094:moundo-ex.description_en:
Moundo EX is an EX version of Moundo in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
山石（Moundo） is a mid-boss appearing in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake. It resembles a large, brown rock (bearing a slight resemblance to 硬石（Rocky）) with three gray spikes on top of its head. On its yellow feet, it wears a pair of zōri sandals, while a headband with red and white stripes is tied around its head, giving it a Japanese look. Its face is stuck in a perpetual frown, its mouth forming a jagged shape to compliment its lithic appearance.

As its nature suggests, 山石（Moundo） yields the 石块（Stone） Ability once defeated and inhaled by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-variant:5881:mr-dooter-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5881:mr-dooter-ex.description_zh:
达乌塔先生EX（Mr. Dooter EX）是达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“永远是那位艺人，达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）是一位危险的魔术师，能够从帽子里召唤出蛇和骷髅。但你不是来观看表演的。你是来找他发现的船零件的！”
— 在达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）的特别页面星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）（在英国英语Wii版本中解析为Mr Dooter）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中Raisin Ruins的老板。他看起来像是魔术师和精灵的结合体，他的攻击风格像魔术师或街头艺人。他守护着Lor Starcutter的右风羽（Wing）。
wikirby-variant:5881:mr-dooter-ex.description_en:
Mr. Dooter EX is an EX version of Mr. Dooter in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Ever the entertainer, 达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） is a dangerous magician able to summon snakes and skulls from his hat. But you're not here for the show. You're here for the ship part he found!”
— VS 达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） (parsed Mr Dooter in the British English Wii version) is the boss of Raisin Ruins in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He resembles a cross between a magician and a genie and his attacks are characterized in the style of a magician or street performer. He guards the Lor Starcutter's Right 风羽（Wing）.

wikirby-variant:1525:angered-hunter-scar.display_name: 发怒的猎人尖耳怪（Angered Hunter Scarfy）
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-hunter-scar.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-hunter-scar.description_zh:
发怒的猎人尖耳怪（Angered Hunter Scarfy）是尖耳怪（Scarfy）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“他们一开始看起来很友好，但等等...”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）网站上的尖耳怪（Scarfy）的描述
尖耳怪（Scarfy）是一种橙色的、漂浮的猫状生物，是卡比（Kirby）系列中最古老和最普遍的敌人之一。出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中，并出现在此后的所有主系列游戏以及一些衍生作品中。他漂浮在空中，有着一张卡比（Kirby）般的天真面孔和灿烂的笑容。然而，如果卡比（Kirby）激怒了他，尖耳怪（Scarfy）就会变成一个可怕的独眼恶魔，张开下巴，长着锋利的獠牙，全身呈暗褐色，被称为愤怒的尖耳怪（Scarfy），并追捕他，直到尖耳怪（Scarfy）被击败、爆炸或返回。正常。

在整个系列中，尖耳怪（Scarfy）可以采取多种不同的行为模式，但他最常见的策略是原地盘旋，只有在试图吸入卡比（Kirby）或以其他方式攻击他时才追逐卡比（Kirby）。有些人可能只会在卡比（Kirby）或其他角色持有钥匙等随身物品（这些被称为猎人围巾）时才会变形，而其他人可能会在卡比（Kirby）经过他们时变得敌对。其他人仍然可能立即变得敌对。当尖耳怪（Scarfy）生气时，他通常会追赶卡比（Kirby）几分钟，然后减速并爆炸。这种爆炸性可能就是为什么当在星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）和Kirby Super Star Ultra中使用Copy进行扫描时，尖耳怪（Scarfy）授予爆裂（Crash）复制能力（Copy Ability）的原因。否则，尖耳怪（Scarfy）无法提供能力，因为他无法被吸入。
wikirby-variant:1525:angered-hunter-scar.description_en:
Angered Hunter Scarfy is a distinct form or variant of Scarfy in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“They look friendly at first, but just wait...”
— Description of 尖耳怪（Scarfy） from the 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） website
尖耳怪（Scarfy） is an orange, floating catlike creature who is one of 卡比（Kirby）'s oldest and most ubiquitous enemies in the series, first appearing in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land） and being present in all of the main-series titles since then, as well as several spin-offs. He can be found floating in the air sporting an innocent-looking 卡比（Kirby）-like face and bright open smile. However, if 卡比（Kirby） angers him, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns into a hideous cycloptic demon with sharp fangs in a gaping jaw and a duller brown coloration, known as Angry 尖耳怪（Scarfy）, and chases him down until 尖耳怪（Scarfy） is defeated, explodes, or returns to normal.

Throughout the series, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） can take on a number of different behavior patterns, but his most common strategy is to hover in place, only chasing 卡比（Kirby） if he tries to inhale him or otherwise attacks him. Some may only transform when 卡比（Kirby） or another character is holding a carry item such as a key (these are called Hunter Scarfies), while others may turn hostile when 卡比（Kirby） passes by them. Others still may turn hostile immediately. When 尖耳怪（Scarfy） turns angry, he will typically chase 卡比（Kirby） down for several moments before slowing down and detonating in an explosion. This explosive nature is likely the reason why 尖耳怪（Scarfy） grants the 爆裂（Crash） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when scanned using Copy in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star） and Kirby Super Star Ultra. Otherwise, 尖耳怪（Scarfy） cannot provide an ability, because he cannot be inhaled.

wikirby-variant:1525:hunter-scarfy.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:1525:hunter-scarfy.description_zh:
猎人尖耳怪（Hunter Scarfy）是尖耳怪（Scarfy）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“他们一开始看起来很友好，但等等...”

wikirby-variant:7709:primed-searches.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:7709:primed-searches.description_zh:
危险状态瑟奇斯（Primed Searches）是Searches的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
Searches是一种会悬浮的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，被吞噬时会赋予爆裂（Crash）能力。它看起来像一个水雷，但也具有噴火輪（Flamer）的几个特征。

Searches是一个黑色的圆盘形炸弹，带有黄色的脸，仅有一对愤怒的眼睛，以及四个红色凸起（每个指向一个基本方向）。像水雷一样，它会悬浮在原地，等待入侵者进入其范围。如果有人进入，Searches会开始脉动，身体变红并带有白色凸起，如果不阻止，它会在大范围内引发爆炸，造成伤害并击中两次。
wikirby-variant:7709:primed-searches.description_en:
Primed Searches is a distinct form or variant of Searches in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
Searches is a hovering enemy which first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and grants the 爆裂（Crash） ability when swallowed. It resembles a naval mine, though it also shares several traits with 噴火輪（Flamer）.

Searches is a black, disc-shaped bomb with a yellow face consisting of only a pair of angry eyes, and four red bumpy extrusions (each pointing in one cardinal direction). Like a mine, it hovers in place and waits for an intruder to enter its proximity. If one does, Searches begins to pulsate, its body turning red with white extrusions, and, if not stopped, detonates in a large explosion that can harm at great range and hits twice.

wikirby-variant:7759:exposed-shelt.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:7759:exposed-shelt.description_zh:
无头盔壳特（Exposed Shelt）是Shelt的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
Shelt是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的敌人，被吞下时不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Shelt是一个小型蓝色生物，穿着带有前端尖头的保护金属壳，并会尝试冲向任何靠近它的人，同时会跳过路上的任何障碍物。Shelt可以承受打击，但最终会失去它的壳并变得脆弱，这时它会尝试逃跑。在对付冲撞的Shelt时必须小心，因为攻击它不一定会让它退缩。也许更好的是直接绕过去，而不是浪费宝贵的时间和精力。当然，卡比（Kirby）可以吸入Shelt的壳来降低它的威胁。威胁.
wikirby-variant:7759:exposed-shelt.description_en:
Exposed Shelt is a distinct form or variant of Shelt in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
Shelt is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, which does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Shelt is a small blue creature that wears a protective metal shell with a point at the front tip, and will attempt to charge anyone who approaches it, jumping over any obstacles in its way. Shelt can take a beating, but it will eventually lose its shell and become vulnerable, at which point it will try to run away. Caution must be taken when dealing with a charging Shelt, as attacking it will not necessarily cause it to flinch. It may be better to just move past it, rather than waste valuable time and energy. Of course, 卡比（Kirby） can inhale Shelt's shell to make it less of a threat.

wikirby-variant:5718:sphere-doomer-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5718:sphere-doomer-ex.description_zh:
球体喽啪EX（Sphere Doomer EX）是球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“A超能力帮助你进入了这个奇怪的空间，同时一个球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）也从不同的维度飞了进来！它不会让你窃取球体的能量……所以准备迎接攻击吧！”
— VS球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
的描述球毁灭者是一类首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的中级Boss怪。它们是来自Another Dimension的生物，对Energy Sphere有吸引力。球毁灭者通常在许多关卡的跨维度段落结束时遭遇，可以通过使用Super Ability发现的维度裂缝进入。发生在故事模式（Story Mode）或Extra Mode的球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）遭遇总是会产生两个能量球。
wikirby-variant:5718:sphere-doomer-ex.description_en:
Sphere Doomer EX is an EX version of Sphere Doomer in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“A Super Ability helped you enter this strange space, and a 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） has flown in from a different dimension as well! It won't let you steal the energy of the spheres...so brace for an attack!”
— VS 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） description from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
Sphere Doomers are a collection of mid-bosses first appearing in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. They are creatures from Another Dimension that are attracted to Energy Spheres. Sphere Doomers are usually encountered at the end of interdimensional segments in many stages, which can be entered through dimensional rifts revealed using a Super Ability. A 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） encounter taking place in 故事模式（Story Mode） or Extra Mode always yields two Energy Spheres.

wikirby-variant:5856:super-bonkers-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5856:super-bonkers-ex.description_zh:
超级锤星猩EX（Super Bonkers EX）是超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers）是中boss锤星猩（Bonkers）的一个稍强版本，后者首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。他的独特之处在于，他是一个会掉落Super Ability的中boss，而其他所有超级能力都是由普通敌人掉落的。
wikirby-variant:5856:super-bonkers-ex.description_en:
Super Bonkers EX is an EX version of Super Bonkers in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers） is a slightly stronger version of the mid-boss 锤星猩（Bonkers） who debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He is unique in that he is a mid-boss that yields a Super Ability, whereas all the other Super Abilities are yielded by normal enemies.

wikirby-variant:66777:traitor-magolor-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:66777:traitor-magolor-ex.description_zh:
魔法洛亚EX（Traitor Magolor EX）是魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“无论如何……MUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA！时候到了，你的星球……不！是整个宇宙向我低头的时刻到了。为了在这一切中提供如此大的帮助，你的星球将先行！准备下跪吧，波普之星（Popstar）！欢迎你的新统治者！”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）在背叛卡比（Kirby）及星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的朋友之后
魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor）（通常简称为魔法洛亚（Magolor））是魔法洛亚（Magolor）背叛卡比（Kirby）及其朋友时的形态，他从龙帝亚（Landia）手中夺取Master Crown并戴在头上，变成一个巨大的幽灵般威胁，并获得“无限力量”。在这种形态下，魔法洛亚（Magolor）的外貌与他原来的小型蛋状体显著不同，获得类似Necrodeus的幽灵般身体，原本的棕色皮肤变为漆黑，耳朵变成长而向下弯曲的角状耳朵，并拥有带魔法手铐的完全关节化双手。他的眼睛也变为凶恶的红色，王冠像大爪子般紧紧抓在头上。他获得轻松撕开通向Another Dimension、还可以使用大量强大的魔法攻击，例如他的巨型魔法洛亚（Magolor）加农炮、Black Hole、致命针以及更多技能。魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的倒数第二个Boss，在击败洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）后于Level 8: Another Dimension中进行战斗。击败他会使他变异为第二形态（或在Extra Mode中为魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）），进行最后一次对决。
wikirby-variant:66777:traitor-magolor-ex.description_en:
Traitor Magolor EX is an EX version of Traitor Magolor in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Anyway... MUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! The time has come for your planet... No! The time has come for the ENTIRE UNIVERSE to bow down to me. And for being such a big help in all of this, your planet gets to go first! Prepare to bow, 波普之星（Popstar）! Welcome your new overlord!”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor） after betraying 卡比（Kirby） and friends in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor） (usually referred to as simply 魔法洛亚（Magolor）) is the form that 魔法洛亚（Magolor） assumes when he betrays 卡比（Kirby） and his friends by taking the Master Crown from 龙帝亚（Landia） and placing it upon his head, turning into a large spectral menace and gaining "limitless power". In this form, 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s appearance changes significantly from his original small egg-shaped stature, gaining a wraith-like body similar to that of Necrodeus, his original brown skin becoming pitch-black, longer horn-like ears that curve downward, and fully articulated hands with magic cuffs. His eyes also turn a menacing red and the crown hangs on his head like a large claw gripping it tightly. He gains the ability to casually rip holes in space which lead to Another Dimension, and can also use a large number of powerful magical attacks, such as his giant 魔法洛亚（Magolor） Cannon, Black Hole, Deadly Needles, and more. 魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor） is the penultimate boss of 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, fought in Level 8: Another Dimension after defeating 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）. Defeating him causes him to mutate into a second form (or 魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul） in Extra Mode) for one last confrontation.

wikirby-variant:5755:water-galboros-ex.display_name: 清水加尔波洛斯EX（Water Galboros EX）
wikirby-variant:5755:water-galboros-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:5755:water-galboros-ex.description_zh:
清水加尔波洛斯EX（Water Galboros EX）是清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。它看起来像一个较大的清水加爾波（Water Galbo），带有黄色条纹。
wikirby-variant:5755:water-galboros-ex.description_en:
Water Galboros EX is an EX version of Water Galboros in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It appears as a larger 清水加爾波（Water Galbo） with yellow stripes.

wikirby-variant:475:whispy-woods-ex.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-variant:475:whispy-woods-ex.description_zh:
风语大树EX（Whispy Woods EX）是风语大树（Whispy Woods）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）》。
“请不要践踏我的根，这不是一个明智的决定。”
— 风语大树（Whispy Woods），在Kirby's Avalanche
风语大树（Whispy Woods）（简写为Whispy，在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中标题为森林守护者）是一个拟人化的居住在Dream Land的树，最著名的是卡比（Kirby）在许多冒险中面临的早期（如果不是第一个）Boss。在他最简单的化身中，他无法移动，只能通过在卡比（Kirby）处扔下苹果和吹Air Bullet来进行攻击，但他的多种外观和变体给了他各种额外的攻击，在某些情况下，允许他跳来跳去，甚至追赶对手。

与独眼云（Kracko）一起，风语大树（Whispy Woods）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中最具标志性的Boss角色之一，自在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）中首次亮相以来，已出现数十次，并出现在Super Smash Bros.系列以及动漫和小说系列等其他媒体中。此外，整个系列中还有许多其他实体要么与风语大树（Whispy Woods）有关，要么受他启发，要么两者兼而有之。风语大树（Whispy Woods）几乎总是卡比（Kirby）的敌人，尽管他偶尔会作为中立角色甚至盟友出现。风语大树（Whispy Woods）作为盟友的最显着的例子是Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble和动漫系列星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.
wikirby-variant:475:whispy-woods-ex.description_en:
Whispy Woods EX is an EX version of Whispy Woods in Kirby's Return to Dream Land.
“Please don't tread on my roots, it would not be a wise decision.”
— 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, in Kirby's Avalanche
风语大树（Whispy Woods） (known in shorthand as Whispy, and titled Guardian of the Forest in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）) is an anthropomorphic tree who resides in Dream Land and is most well known as being an early (if not the first) boss that 卡比（Kirby） faces in many of his adventures. In his simplest incarnations, he is incapable of moving, and can only attack by dropping apples and blowing Air Bullets at 卡比（Kirby）, but his many appearances and variants give him a variety of additional attacks, and in some cases, allow him to hop around or even run after his opponents.

Along with 独眼云（Kracko）, 风语大树（Whispy Woods） is one of the most iconic boss characters in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, having made dozens of appearances since his debut in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）, as well as appearing in the Super Smash Bros. series and in other media such as the anime and novel series. Additionally, there are many other entities throughout the series that are either related to 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, inspired by him, or both. 风语大树（Whispy Woods） is almost always an enemy to 卡比（Kirby）, though he does very occasionally appear as a neutral character or even an ally. The most notable examples of 风语大树（Whispy Woods） being an ally are in Kirby Tilt 'n' Tumble and the anime series, 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

wikirby-page:23545.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:23545.description_zh:
蝴蝶在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中很常见，首次出现在星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的Green Greens介绍中。特别是那些具有明显红色和橙色的蝴蝶，它们是反复出现的背景角色，通常出现在过场动画中，尤其是在游戏开始和结束时的过场动画中。这些蝴蝶首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的开场和结尾过场动画中，并且自那以后出现在所有主要卡比（Kirby）游戏中。在冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）的两次出场中，它最初看起来像是这样的Butterfly，但在吸收了一个强大的存在之后，它变成了骑士的形态。

目前尚不清楚出现在过场动画中的蝴蝶是否彼此相同和/或是否为冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）。在在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的结尾处，屏幕上同时出现两只红色和橙色的蝴蝶，显示它们有多只。值得注意的是，星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）日文版中对冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）角色的描述使用了“一頭の夢見鳥”这个词，可以翻译为“一只Butterfly”或“其中一只蝴蝶”，但也可以理解为“孤独的Butterfly”或“那只Butterfly”。当被问及这些蝴蝶是否完全相同时，Shinya Kumazaki表示他不想确认也不想否认，并评论了卡比（Kirby）世界中某些方面经常留给玩家自由解读，以便每个玩家可以以自己的方式体验游戏。
wikirby-page:23545.description_en:
Butterflies are a common sight in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, first seen in the intro of Green Greens in 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）. In particular, butterflies with a distinct red and orange coloration are recurring atmospheric background characters that are typically seen in cutscenes, especially those at the start and end of a game. These butterflies were first seen in the opening and ending cutscenes of 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and have appeared in all mainline 卡比（Kirby） games since. In both of 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）'s appearances, it initially appears to be such a Butterfly, but then takes the form of a knight after absorbing a powerful being.

It is unclear if the butterflies that appear in cutscenes are the same entity as each other and/or 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）. In the ending of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, two red and orange butterflies appear on-screen at the same time, showing that there are multiple of them. Notably, the description of the 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） figure in the Japanese version of 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） uses the term "一頭の夢見鳥", which can be translated as "a Butterfly" or "one of the butterflies", but it could also mean "the lone Butterfly" or "the one Butterfly". When asked if the butterflies were all the same, Shinya Kumazaki said he didn't want to confirm or deny it, and commented on how often certain aspects of the world of 卡比（Kirby） are left up to interpretation, so that each player can experience the games in their own ways.

wikirby-page:5624.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5624.description_zh:
“你好！我的名字是魔法洛亚（Magolor）。我来自另一个维度，但我就是喜欢波普之星（Planet Popstar）。我怎么也玩不够！我刚到的时候情况有点混乱，但现在一切都过去了，多亏了卡比（Kirby）。”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）在New Challenge Stages中的开场对白Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中
魔法洛亚（Magolor）是一只猫咪般的外星魔法师，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中担任主要反派角色。他来自另一个世界，自称居住在行星Halcandra上，并掌控一艘名为Lor Starcutter的跨维度星际飞船。此后，他在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的后续游戏中多次登场。魔法洛亚（Magolor）以他矮小的身材、飞行和施展魔法的能力以及他有效（但有时具有欺骗性）的的销售能力。他首次登场之外的重要角色包括：在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中主持New Challenge Stages及Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe课程，管理Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的the Shoppe，在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中以Dream Friend身份出现，以及在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）、星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler和卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中作为可操作角色出现。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的首次亮相中，魔法洛亚（Magolor）将Lor Starcutter撞入Dream Land，并将其零件及Energy Sphere散落在波普之星（Popstar）星球上。卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们通过收集这些零件来帮助魔法洛亚（Magolor）修理飞船，而他通过带领团队前往他的家园Halcandra来表示感谢。一旦到达，他们遭到守护天使龙帝亚（Landia）的攻击，魔法洛亚（Magolor）请求卡比（Kirby）和他的团队击败了龙。然而，当龙帝亚（Landia）被打败时，魔法洛亚（Magolor）偷走了龙的Master Crown——揭示出他一直在寻找这个强大的物品——然后利用它变身成一个可怕的最终Boss，企图统治整个宇宙。在龙帝亚（Landia）的帮助下，卡比（Kirby）和朋友们击败了他。王冠被摧毁，魔法洛亚（Magolor）恢复了原来的状态，并在穿越另一个维度后，最终与卡比（Kirby）和解。
wikirby-page:5624.description_en:
“Hi there! My name is 魔法洛亚（Magolor）. I'm from another dimension, but I just love 波普之星（Planet Popstar）. I can't get enough of it! Things got a bit hectic when I first arrived, but that's all in the past, thanks to 卡比（Kirby）.”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s opening dialogue from New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition
魔法洛亚（Magolor） is a cat-like alien magician who first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） as the main antagonist. He is from another world, claims to live on the planet Halcandra, and commands a dimension-crossing starship called the Lor Starcutter. He has since made several appearances in subsequent games in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. 魔法洛亚（Magolor） is defined by his diminutive stature, his ability to fly and cast magical spells, and his effective (but sometimes deceptive) salesmanship. Notable roles beyond his debut appearance include being the host of both New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition and the courses in Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe, running the Shoppe in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, appearing as a Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, and as a playable character in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）s Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler, and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

In his debut in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） crashes the Lor Starcutter into Dream Land and scatters its parts and Energy Spheres all over Planet 波普之星（Popstar）. 卡比（Kirby） and his friends aid 魔法洛亚（Magolor） by collecting these pieces to repair the ship, and he thanks them by taking the group to his homeworld, Halcandra. Once there, they are attacked by the guardian angel 龙帝亚（Landia）, and 魔法洛亚（Magolor） requests that 卡比（Kirby） and his team defeat the dragon. When 龙帝亚（Landia） is beaten, however, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） steals the dragon's Master Crown—revealing that he was after this powerful object the whole time—and then uses it to transform into a menacing final boss, aiming to rule over the entire universe. With help from 龙帝亚（Landia）, 卡比（Kirby） and friends defeat him. The crown is shattered, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） returns to his normal state, and after making his way through another dimension, he eventually makes amends with 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:6879.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6879.description_zh:
Armor Waddle Dee是一个大型机器人外壳，类似于瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。它配备了潜望镜和机械锤状杆作为手臂。它是Puppet Waddle Dee的一个稍微强硬的变体，因为它略微更难击败，动作也稍慢。与Puppet Waddle Dee一样，它缺少真正的双脚，由三台Waddle Dees控制。它可以被正常摧毁，从而释放出内部的Waddle Dees，或者如果卡比（Kirby）用Super Inhale吞下它，它也可以迅速被击败。它只会试图与卡比（Kirby）接触，从而对双方造成伤害（尽管Armor Waddle Dee的高耐久性使其对它的影响较小）。一个名为Armor Halcandle Dee出现在Halcandra中，尽管它仅在外观上有所不同。它是银色的，具有更明显的机器人特征，并且由三个Halcandle Dee控制。与原始形式相比，它还缺少潜望镜。

Armor Waddle Dee还出现在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition的New Challenge Stages中。
wikirby-page:6879.description_en:
Armor Waddle Dee is a large robotic shell resembling a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, making its first appearance in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It sports a periscope and mechanical hammer-like bars to appear as its arms. It serves as a somewhat tougher variation of Puppet Waddle Dee, as it is slightly harder to defeat and slightly more sluggish. As with Puppet Waddle Dee, it lacks proper feet and is controlled by three Waddle Dees underneath. It can be destroyed normally to throw out the Waddle Dees inside, or can be quickly defeated if 卡比（Kirby） swallows it with a Super Inhale. It will simply attempt to make contact with 卡比（Kirby）, thereby dealing damage to them both (though the Armor Waddle Dee's high durability makes this less of a concern for it). A variant named Armor Halcandle Dee appears on Halcandra, though it differs only in aesthetics. It is silver with more noticeable robotic features, and is controlled instead by three Halcandle Dees. It also lacks a periscope opposed to its original form.

Armor Waddle Dee additionally appears in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition in the New Challenge Stages.

wikirby-page:7716.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7716.description_zh:
Barbar是一种巨大的类鳗水生生物，喜欢栖息在墙壁的洞穴中，如果卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们试图游过去，它会伸出身体试图吃掉他们。所有Barbars都很大，尽管有些比其他的更大，有几只甚至非常巨大。Barbar完全免疫任何攻击，因此必须将其视为需要避开的场景障碍，而不是可以战斗的对象。如果卡比（Kirby）被吸进它的嘴里，玩家需要摇动手柄或猛按摇杆来将卡比（Kirby）重新弄出来。

Barbar最早出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，此后又在一些其他2.5D卡比（Kirby）游戏中再次出现。它有一些亲戚，即可吸入的Land Barbar和居住在熔岩中的Iron Barbar。
wikirby-page:7716.description_en:
Barbar is a gigantic aquatic eel-like creature who likes to reside in holes in the wall and reach out to try and eat 卡比（Kirby） and his friends if they try to swim past. All Barbars are large, though some are bigger than others, a few much so. Barbar is completely invulnerable to attack, so it must be treated as a course obstacle to avoid rather than something to fight. If 卡比（Kirby） gets sucked into its mouth, the player needs to shake the controller or mash the stick to get 卡比（Kirby） out again.

Barbar first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and has since reappeared in a handful of other 2.5D 卡比（Kirby） games. It has a few relatives, namely the 超新星（Hypernova）-inhalable Land Barbar and the lava-dwelling Iron Barbar.

wikirby-page:7691.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7691.description_zh:
Barracu是来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的水生敌人。第一次遇到它是在Onion Ocean关卡，它在所有四个阶段都会出现。Barracu在名字和形状上都类似于梭鱼。它尖锐的牙齿会咬住任何碰到的人，玩家需要旋转控制杆或猛按控制板上的方向（或者仅在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中摇动Wii遥控器）来让卡比（Kirby）逃脱，从而减少受到的伤害。

Barracu被吞下时不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7691.description_en:
Barracu is an aquatic enemy from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It is first encountered in the Onion Ocean level, where it appears in all four stages. Barracu resembles both in name and in shape a barracuda fish. Its sharp teeth will latch onto anyone it bumps into, and the player will need to spin the Control Stick or mash directions on the Control Pad (or shake the Wii Remote, in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） only) to allow 卡比（Kirby） to escape and take less damage.

Barracu does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

wikirby-page:7780.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7780.description_zh:
Bomb Machine是一个敌人，首次登场于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），仅出现在Egg Engines - Stage 1。它来回滚动并偶尔改变高度，同时发射导弹。只能通过龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）Super Ability打败，因此无法被吸入。

炸弹（Bomb）机器看起来像带笑脸和发光眼睛的巨型炸弹，位于可伸缩的移动升降台上。它们侧面有星形雕刻。升降台偶尔会伸缩，从而重新定位Bomb Machine。定期地，Bomb Machine的嘴会张开，发射导弹向前飞出。这些导弹可以被吸入获得炸弹（Bomb）能力，尽管考虑到Bomb Machine必须被击败。

要摧毁一个Bomb Machine，卡比（Kirby）必须使用龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）点燃Bomb Machine的引信。这会导致Bomb Machine爆炸，并留下星星和其他可收集物品。

在关卡的尽头还有一个巨大的Bomb Machine，其导弹需要超级吸入以获得炸弹（Bomb）能力。用龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）摧毁它会为该特定关卡打开通往另一个维度的裂隙。
wikirby-page:7780.description_en:
Bomb Machine is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, appearing only in Egg Engines - Stage 1. It rolls back and forth and occasionally changes height, and fires missiles. It can only be defeated with the 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） Super Ability and as such cannot be inhaled.

炸弹（Bomb） Machines resemble large bombs with smiling faces and glowing eyes situated on an extendable lift on wheels. They present star-shaped engravings on their sides. The lift occasionally expands and contracts, re-positioning the Bomb Machine as it does so. At regular intervals, the Bomb Machine's mouth opens, and a missile comes out that flies forward. These missiles can be inhaled for the 炸弹（Bomb） ability, though that is hardly necessary considering how the Bomb Machine must be defeated.

To destroy a Bomb Machine, 卡比（Kirby） must use 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） to light the Bomb Machine's fuse. This will cause the Bomb Machine to explode, leaving behind stars and other collectibles.

There is also a giant Bomb Machine at the end of the stage, whose missiles need to be Super Inhaled to get the 炸弹（Bomb） ability. Destroying it with 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） opens the rift to another dimension for that particular stage.

wikirby-page:7056.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7056.description_zh:
“Bouncy Sis非常希望自己能跳得像弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）一样高，但她有点太大，无法在弹簧和地面之间获得足够的空气。当然，这让她非常烦恼，但你永远不会让她承认。”
— Figurine来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的描述。
Bouncy Sis是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次出现的稀有敌人，外观上类似于更大、更装饰华丽的弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）。虽然她的外观与她较小的表亲大体相似，但Bouncy Sis头上的大红蝴蝶结点缀有波点，而她两侧可以看到两个较小的普通红色蝴蝶结。她还穿着带花边的褶饰服装，腰部由红色和橙色交替组成。在她下面，她有一个灰色弹簧帮助她弹跳，尽管她不能像她较小的表亲那样跳得高。
wikirby-page:7056.description_en:
“Bouncy Sis desperately wishes she could jump as high as 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）, but she's a bit too big to get much air between her spring and the ground. This, of course, bothers her to no end, but you'll never get her to admit it.”
— Figurine description from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse.
Bouncy Sis is a rare enemy debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） which resembles a larger, more decorated version of 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）. While her appearance is mostly similar to that of her smaller cousins, the large, red bow on Bouncy Sis' head is adorned with polka dots, while two smaller, plain red bows can be seen on each side of her. She furthermore wears a frilly lace and her mid-section consists of alternating red and orange parts. Beneath her, she has a gray spring to help her bounce, though she cannot bounce as high as her smaller cousins.

wikirby-page:7664.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7664.description_zh:
Bowby是一个首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人。它会悬浮在空中，如果卡比（Kirby）或他的朋友靠得太近，它会试图向他们发射箭矢。Bowby被吞下时不会提供任何能力。

Bowby是一种棕色、弓形的生物，有蓝色的眼睛、嘴巴和白色弯角（类似公牛或黄牛的角）；它那弯角之间悬挂着一条像线一样的细绳，它会把箭矢放在上面。弓形生物会出现在四个基本方向中的任意一个。如果横向面对，它的箭矢在飞行一小段距离后会开始呈弧线落下。Halcandra上存在一种金属变种，名为Halcan Bowby。
wikirby-page:7664.description_en:
Bowby is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It hovers in the air and will attempt to fire an arrow at 卡比（Kirby） or his friends if they come too close. Bowby does not provide any ability when swallowed.

Bowby is a brown, bow-shaped creature which sports blue eyes, a mouth, and white curved horns (resembling those of a bull or ox); suspended between these horns is a stringy, thread-like line which it rests arrows on. Bowbies will appear in any of the four cardinal directions. If facing sideways, its arrows will start to fall in an arc after traveling a short distance. There is a metallic variant that exists on Halcandra, which is named Halcan Bowby .

wikirby-page:7723.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7723.description_zh:
Bulby是来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的一个稀有敌人。它首次出现在Onion Ocean关卡，当被吞噬时会获得叶子（Leaf）能力。

与同时出现的Clayn类似，Bulby起初隐藏，只有它的花可见，当接近时才会从地下冒出来。它的身体由一个球茎组成，带有一双黑眼睛和小型根状腿。顶部有几片叶子和花朵，它会从花中发射孢子，可以击中其上方目标。一旦发射孢子，它会立即重新潜入地下，除非受到攻击。孢子本身并不是问题，真正的问题是它从地下冒出时的攻击，因为这可能让任何不谨慎的冒险者措手不及当接近时，游戏中的其他花朵会产生星星，有时还会掉落食物，这会让人感到惊讶。
wikirby-page:7723.description_en:
Bulby is a rare enemy from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It is first encountered in the Onion Ocean level and yields the 叶子（Leaf） ability when swallowed.

Much like the Clayn which is encountered along with this enemy, Bulby hides at first, only its flower visible, then pops up out of the ground when approached. Its body consists of a bulb, with a pair of black eyes and small root legs. It is topped with a couple leaves and the flower, from which it will shoot spores that can hit above it. Once it shoots its spore, it will immediately burrow itself back into the ground unless dealt with. The spore is not so much an issue as much as its attack when it pops out of the ground, as that can take any unwary adventurer by surprise when other flowers in the game will yield stars and occasionally food when approached.

wikirby-page:7186.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7186.description_zh: Cerulean是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中的敌人。它出现在Raisin Ruins、White Wafers和Nutty Noon中。如果吞下，它不会提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7186.description_en: Cerulean is an enemy in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition. It is found in Raisin Ruins, White Wafers and Nutty Noon. It provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

wikirby-page:7720.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7720.description_zh:
Clayn是一种无害的蛞蝓状敌人，出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版中，只在Onion Ocean的Stage 3和Egg Engines的Stage 4中出现。

Clayn是一种胶状、无肢的生物，具有两个眼柄。它在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中最初呈浅黄色，但在重制版中被更新为米色。静止时，Clayn看起来像一坨无特征的黏土状块，因此得名。当接近时，它会一边扭动一边显现自己，对触碰到的任何人造成伤害。Clayn不是很强的敌人，也不太具有攻击性，但在它膨胀之前很难被注意到，这常常导致不警觉的冒险者受到攻击。在Egg Engines的第4关中，它们也可以被看到守卫着门口和躲在黑暗的地方，有时甚至两者都做。

Clayn如果吞下去不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7720.description_en:
Clayn is an innocuous slug-like enemy that appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, appearing only in Stage 3 of Onion Ocean and Stage 4 of Egg Engines.

Clayn is a gelatinous, limbless creature with two eye stalks. It was originally pale yellow in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, but was updated to a beige color in the remake. At rest, Clayn appears as a featureless, clay-like lump, hence the name. When approached, it reveals itself while wiggling, damaging anyone it touches. Clayn is not a very tough enemy, nor is it all that aggressive, but it can be hard to notice until it puffs up, which can often lead to the unwary adventurer taking a hit. In stage 4 of Egg Engines, they can also be seen guarding doorways and hiding in dark places, sometimes even both.

Clayn does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

wikirby-page:7747.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7747.description_zh: Coldtzo是一个无敌的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。它会停在一个地方，发射无法吸入或反射的大型冰弹，尽管这些冰弹可以被Prism Shield阻挡。与黑大炮（Shotzo）不同，且与星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的其他大型加农炮（巨大炮（Gigatzo）和Volttzo）相似，Coldtzo不能瞄准射击，总是以相同方向开火。它也可能从背景中发射射击，先飞到空中，然后在同一水平区域落下。像黑大炮（Shotzo）一样，它是无敌的，尽管如果支撑它的地面被移除，它在某些情况下也可能会掉落。
wikirby-page:7747.description_en: Coldtzo is an invincible enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It stays in one place and shoots large ice bolts in a straight line that cannot be inhaled or reflected, though they can be blocked by the Prism Shield. Unlike 黑大炮（Shotzo） and like the other large cannons in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） (巨大炮（Gigatzo） and Volttzo), Coldtzo cannot aim its shots, always firing in the same direction. It may also fire shots from the background, flying up into the air before falling back down in the same horizontal area. Like 黑大炮（Shotzo）, it is invulnerable, though it can fall in certain instances if its supporting floor is removed.

wikirby-page:7704.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7704.description_zh:
Craby是一种两栖敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。Craby如果被吞噬，不会掉落任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

它的名称、移动模式和攻击方式类似于螃蟹，但其身体更像章鱼，其“螯”是从头顶射出的球状活塞。它不一定是一个让人害怕的敌人，但如果游泳者从上方接近，它在攻击上surprisingly有效。

Craby主要出现在水中，会慢慢在地板上或在方块上前后移动。也可以在陆地上发现。
wikirby-page:7704.description_en:
Craby is an amphibious enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. Craby does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Its name, movement patterns and method of attack resemble that of a crab, but its body is more octopus-like, with its 'claws' being ball-edged pistons that shoot out from the top of its head. It is not necessarily an enemy to be feared, but it is surprisingly effective at hitting an approaching swimmer if they come in from above.

Craby is primarily found in water, where it will scuttle slowly along the floor or back and forth on blocks. It can also be found on land.

wikirby-page:63872.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:63872.description_zh:
啦啪（Darpa）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中遇到的敌人Another Dimension。它只在Another Dimension中出现，并且在重制版的新Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler额外模式中与其对应的哩啪（Dippa）、噜啪（Dupa）和Leaper一起出现。

啦啪（Darpa）是一种小型、紫色的Butterfly样生物，头上有一个小附肢，类似于球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）。它还有两个黄色的眼睛，这是它的对应者共同的特征。

这个敌人是它四个同类中最简单最常见的。它非常弱，因为它唯一的攻击是试图撞向卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们。它的生命值也很低，相对容易躲避。这种攻击模式使它与Pata和Dakuga非常相似，都是来自星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中类似射击序列的敌人。
wikirby-page:63872.description_en:
啦啪（Darpa） is an enemy from Another Dimension encountered in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is only encountered in Another Dimension and in the new Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler extra mode in the remake, alongside its counterparts, the 哩啪（Dippa）s, 噜啪（Dupa）s, and Leapers.

啦啪（Darpa） is a small, purple Butterfly-like creature with a small appendage on its head, resembling a 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）. It also has two yellow eyes, a characteristic shared with its counterparts.

This enemy is the simplest and most common of its four brethren. It is very weak, as its only attack is to attempt to ram into 卡比（Kirby） and his friends. It also has very low health and is relatively easy to dodge. This pattern of attack makes it very similar to both Pata and Dakuga, enemies from a similar shooting sequence in 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）.

wikirby-page:7178.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7178.description_zh: Degout是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的敌人。它可以被认为是尖耳怪（Scarfy）和芒比尸（Mumbies）的“表亲”，但在机器人外观和高生命值方面与它们不同。
wikirby-page:7178.description_en: Degout is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It can be considered cousins with the 尖耳怪（Scarfy） and the 芒比尸（Mumbies）, but is distinct from them in its robotic appearance and high HP.

wikirby-page:63903.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:63903.description_zh:
哩啪（Dippa）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中遇到的Another Dimension的敌人。它只在Another Dimension中出现，并且在重制版的新Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler额外模式中与其对应的啦啪（Darpa）、噜啪（Dupa）和Leaper一起出现。

哩啪（Dippa）类似于啦啪（Darpa），尽管稍大一些。它是一个中等大小的红粉色Butterfly类生物，头上有三条附肢呈冠状排列。它的黄色眼睛显露出愤怒的表情，这是高阶球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）特有的特征。

这一敌人比啦啪（Darpa）复杂一些，并且在同类中相对稀有。它拥有发射投射物的能力会锁定目标，如果接触到卡比（Kirby）及其朋友，可以造成伤害。躲避这些子弹的一个简单方法是直接把它们射下，这比单纯地躲开风险更小。哩啪（Dippa）也可以撞向卡比（Kirby）及其伙伴，但它只会直线移动，不会改变方向。它的生命值不多，比啦啪（Darpa）稍微难以躲避。
wikirby-page:63903.description_en:
哩啪（Dippa） is an enemy from Another Dimension encountered in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is only encountered in Another Dimension and in the new Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler extra mode in the remake, alongside its counterparts, the 啦啪（Darpa）s, 噜啪（Dupa）s, and Leapers.

哩啪（Dippa） resembles a 啦啪（Darpa）, albeit slightly larger. It is a moderately sized reddish-pink Butterfly-like creature with a three appendages on its head arranged in a crest-like manner. It wields a grumpy expression from its yellow eyes, a characteristic shared with higher-ranking 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）s.

This enemy is slightly more complex than a 啦啪（Darpa） and it is relatively rare among its brethren. It has the ability to fire projectiles which zero in on and can damage 卡比（Kirby） and his friends if they make contact with one. An easy way to dodge these bullets is to simply shoot them down, which is less risky than simply running away from it. The 哩啪（Dippa） can also ram into 卡比（Kirby） and co, but it only moves in a straight line and doesn't change direction. It doesn't have so much health and is slightly harder to dodge than a 啦啪（Darpa）.

wikirby-page:24682.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:24682.description_zh:
Drill Machine是一个危险物体，可以在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的Egg Engines - Stage 3中找到。它是一个一侧有尖刺表面、内部有活塞机构的箱子，活塞会定期射出尖刺并旋转它。如果卡比（Kirby）接触到这些尖刺，会受到伤害。

卡比（Kirby）可以绕过这个危险，但如果他拥有奇迹光束（Flare Beam）或龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）能力，他可以将其摧毁。摧毁后，Point Star有时会从箱子残骸中掉落食物。
wikirby-page:24682.description_en:
Drill Machine is a hazardous object which can be found in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, in Egg Engines - Stage 3. It is a box with a spiky surface on one side and a piston mechanism inside which regularly shoots out the spiky side while spinning it. 卡比（Kirby） will take damage if he touches the spikes.

卡比（Kirby） can make his way past this hazard, but if he has either the 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） or 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） ability, he can destroy it. Doing so will cause Point Stars and occasionally food to drop from the remains of the box.

wikirby-page:63904.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:63904.description_zh:
噜啪（Dupa）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中遇到的Another Dimension的敌人。它仅在Another Dimension中出现，并且在重制版的新Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler额外模式中也能遇到，与其对应的敌人啦啪（Darpa）s、哩啪（Dippa）s和Leapers一同出现。

噜啪（Dupa）是其四个兄弟中最小的，也是唯一有脚的一个，因为它是唯一在其占据的表面上行走的。它是一个绿色偏青的蛋形生物，头上有三根小羽毛，类似于更高阶的球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）s。它的黄色眼睛带有愤怒的表情，也类似于Sphere Doomers。

这个敌人是其组中最复杂的。它具有发射的弹丸像哩啪（Dippa），但它们只能快速沿直线移动。这些弹丸如果与卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友接触，可能会造成伤害。这些子弹也可以被击落以避免被击中。噜啪（Dupa）总是附着在坚固的表面上，并在表面的一个小而看不见的区域内快速来回移动。它有中等的生命值，但像啦啪（Darpa）一样容易击败。它的行为与星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）中的Bolum非常相似，扮演几乎相同的角色。
wikirby-page:63904.description_en:
噜啪（Dupa） is an enemy from Another Dimension encountered in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is only encountered in Another Dimension and in the new Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler extra mode in the remake, alongside its counterparts, the 啦啪（Darpa）s, 哩啪（Dippa）s, and Leapers.

噜啪（Dupa） is the smallest out of its four brethren, as well as the only one with feet, as it is the only one to walk along the surfaces it occupies. It is a greenish-cyan egg-shaped creature with three small feathers on its head, similar to those of the higher-ranking 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）s. It bears an angry expression from its yellow eyes, also like the Sphere Doomers.

This enemy is the most complex of its group. It has the ability to fire projectiles like the 哩啪（Dippa）, but they only quickly travel in a straight line. These projectiles can damage 卡比（Kirby） and his friends if they make contact with one. These bullets can also be shot down to avoid getting hit. The 噜啪（Dupa） is always attached to a solid surface and moves quickly back and forth within a small unseen section of the surface. It has moderate health, but is about as easy to defeat as a 啦啪（Darpa）. It behaves very similarly to Bolum from 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）, filling a near-identical role.

wikirby-page:7782.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7782.description_zh:
Elec是一个首次在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中登场的敌人。被吞下后，它会获得电火花（Spark）技能。它的内部名称来源于“electricity（电）”，这与其电击攻击相符。Elec在外观和功能上几乎与噴火輪（Flamer）相同。然而，它具有更多细节，包括眼皮和外壳的分段，并且主要呈绿色。

Elec主要通过沿接触到的墙壁滚动来移动，并在每个墙角根据需要转弯。但如果它生气，它会脱离墙壁并漂浮在空中，试图猛撞目标。它可能很难对付，因为它可以滚动得非常快，并且耐久度不错。与噴火輪（Flamer）不同，Elec在生气时倾向于通过电场从上方进行攻击。它还倾向于顺时针滚动，不像噴火輪（Flamer）通常逆时针滚动。
wikirby-page:7782.description_en:
Elec is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It yields the 电火花（Spark） ability when swallowed. Its internal name comes from "electricity", which fits its electrical attack. Elec is almost identical in appearance and function to 噴火輪（Flamer）. However, it bears more detail, including an eyelid and segmentation of its outer shell, and is largely green in color.

Elec primarily moves by rolling along whatever wall it is in contact with, turning with each corner of the wall as necessary. However, if angered, it will detach from the wall and float in the air, in an attempt to ram its target. It can be tough to deal with, as it can roll very quickly and has decent durability. Unlike 噴火輪（Flamer）, Elec tends to attack from above via an electrical field upon getting angry. It also tends to prefer rolling clockwise, unlike 噴火輪（Flamer）, which usually rolls counterclockwise.

wikirby-page:7755.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7755.description_zh:
Gemra是来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的悬浮敌人。被吞下后，它会授予光束（Beam）能力。

Gemra看起来像一个戴着弄臣帽的水晶球，帽子上有一双愤怒的眼睛。当接近时，Gemra会从它的球体发射一道光束，并旋转一圈，类似于光束（Beam）鞭子（Whip）被光束（Beam）卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）使用的方式。这种攻击不太难躲避，使得该敌人相对容易击败。当受到攻击时，Gemra的帽子会短暂从球体上弹起，以强调其后坐力。
wikirby-page:7755.description_en:
Gemra is a hovering enemy from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It grants the 光束（Beam） Ability when swallowed.

Gemra resembles a crystal ball with a jester hat, with the hat possessing a pair of angry eyes. When approached, Gemra will unleash a beam from its ball, and spin in a circle, similar to the way the 光束（Beam） 鞭子（Whip） is used by 光束（Beam） 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）. The attack is not too difficult to avoid, making this enemy rather easy to defeat. When hit, Gemra's hat will briefly pop off of the ball to accentuate its recoil.

wikirby-page:24684.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:24684.description_zh:
Giant Flotzo是一个大型敌人和障碍物，可以在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和Onion Ocean - Stage 3中找到，就在Merman Statue之后。像Flotzo一样，它是一只章鱼，但体型更大，颜色更苍白。它藏在一艘木制船只残骸中，只偶尔会探出头来。

卡比（Kirby）可以通过从Giant Flotzo下面经过来绕过它，但如果他拥有龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）能力，他可以攻击它使其着火。然而，只有当它显现时才能进行此操作。成功的攻击会导致Giant Flotzo融化，露出通往Another Dimension的裂缝。
wikirby-page:24684.description_en:
Giant Flotzo is a large enemy and obstacle which can be found in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, in Onion Ocean - Stage 3, just after the Merman Statues. Like Flotzo, it is an octopus, though considerably larger and paler on color. It hides inside a wooden ship wreckage, only popping out occasionally.

卡比（Kirby） can bypass Giant Flotzo by going underneath it, but if he has the 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） ability, he can strike it to set it aflame. However, this can only be done when it reveals itself. A successful hit will cause Giant Flotzo to melt away, revealing the rift to Another Dimension.

wikirby-page:6847.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6847.description_zh: 巨大炮（Gigatzo）是一个无敌的固定敌人，首次登场于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。它是黑大炮（Shotzo）的更大版本，其特点是巨大的红色炮管和沿直线路径发射的巨型火焰投射物，这些投射物不能被吸入或反射，但它通常不频繁射击这些物体。
wikirby-page:6847.description_en: 巨大炮（Gigatzo） is an invincible stationary enemy that debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It is a larger counterpart to 黑大炮（Shotzo）, characterized by its large red barrel and giant flaming projectiles it fires in a straight path that cannot be inhaled or reflected, though it usually fires these infrequently.

wikirby-page:11931.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:11931.description_zh:
Halcandle Dee是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的替代品，可以在Halcandra上找到。它具有许多与标准瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）相同的特性，包括它经常懒散的动作和无忧无虑的行为，但可以通过其外观来区分，穿着灰色连体服，顶部有一个小折痕，只露出一双椭圆形的眼睛，类似于魔法洛亚（Magolor）的样子。

像瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）一样，Halcandle Dee被吞下时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability），除非它还携带Parasol。Armor Waddle Dee也存在，它们看起来与标准品种不同。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，Halcandle Dee可以在Halcandra关卡中看到，Egg Engines和Dangerous Dinner。在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中，可以在New Challenge Stages和Last Land挑战中找到。
wikirby-page:11931.description_en:
Halcandle Dee is a stand-in for 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） which can be found on Halcandra. It bears many of the same qualities as a standard 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, including its often lazy movements and carefree behavior, but it can be distinguished by its appearance, wearing a gray jumpsuit which has a small fold on the top and shows only a pair of oval-shaped eyes, similar to 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s.

Like 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, Halcandle Dee provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed, unless it is also carrying a Parasol. Armor Waddle Dee also exist, which look distinct from the standard variety.

In 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, Halcandle Dee can be seen in the Halcandra levels, Egg Engines and Dangerous Dinner. In Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition, it can be found in New Challenge Stages and Last Land challenges.

wikirby-page:7795.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7795.description_zh:
Iron Barbar是一个无敌敌人，首次出现在Dangerous Dinner关卡星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。

它与它的水生表亲Barbar类似，但它拥有红黑相间的颜色方案，且平均体型通常要大得多。它栖息在熔岩坑中，与Barbar不同，它会完全隐藏，直到突然出现尝试吞食任何入侵者。如果它抓住了卡比（Kirby）或他的朋友之一，玩家需要摇动Wii遥控器（或在星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中旋转控制杆）以挣脱。无论如何，这通常会导致卡比（Kirby）失去他当时拥有的复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Iron Barbar是一个非常罕见的敌人，只会出现在Dangerous Dinner的第1关和第3关。
wikirby-page:7795.description_en:
Iron Barbar is an invincible enemy first encountered in the Dangerous Dinner level in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）.

It is similar to its aquatic cousin, the Barbar, but it bears a red and black color scheme and is generally much larger on average. It resides in lava pits, and, unlike the Barbar, remains completely hidden until it pops out to attempt to eat any intruder. If it catches 卡比（Kirby） or one of his friends, the player will need to shake the Wii Remote (or spin the Control Stick in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）) in order to break free. Regardless, this will usually end up costing 卡比（Kirby） his 复制能力（Copy Ability） if he had one at the time.

Iron Barbar is a very rare enemy, only appearing in stage 1 and stage 3 of Dangerous Dinner.

wikirby-page:7761.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7761.description_zh:
Jackle是一种悬浮敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的Nutty Noon关卡中。被吞下后可获得弯刀（Cutter）能力。

Jackle外观类似特技轮（Wheelie），但其上半身为蓝色，下半身为黄色。它在顶部和底部带有刀刃，前方有一个红色的鼻子。它悬浮在空中，保持原地不动，并会尝试沿直线投掷刀片攻击入侵者。其刀片可以飞行相当远的距离，但击败它并不难。虽然大多数Jackles只会向四个预设方向之一攻击，但有些可以在半圆范围内转向目标，包括对角线方向。
wikirby-page:7761.description_en:
Jackle is a hovering enemy that made its debut in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） in the Nutty Noon level. It yields the 弯刀（Cutter） ability when swallowed.

Jackle resembles a 特技轮（Wheelie） in appearance, but its top half is blue and its bottom half is yellow. It bears blades on its top and bottom sides, as well as a red nose on its forward-facing side. It hovers in the air, staying in place, and will attempt to throw a cutter projectile in a straight line in order to hit intruders. Its cutter blades can go fairly far, but it is not difficult to defeat. While most Jackles attack in only one of four preset directions, some can turn towards their target within a semicircle, including diagonally.

wikirby-page:5875.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5875.description_zh: Key Dee（在游戏内部数据中被称为Carry Dee和Wonkey）是一种颜色鲜艳的敌人，形似瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），拥有一个小尾巴和红色的脸颊漩涡。它首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），并且自此以来出现在大多数主系列作品（以及一些衍生作品）中。几乎可以肯定，它总是携带物品，通常是钥匙。卡比（Kirby）或其他角色经常被指派去在Key Dee逃走之前收集手中的物品。
wikirby-page:5875.description_en: Key Dee (known as Carry Dee and Wonkey in internal game data) is a brightly colored enemy that resembles a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） and sports a small tail and red swirls on its cheeks. It first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and has appeared in most main series installments (and some spin-offs) since then. It is almost without exception seen carrying items, usually keys. 卡比（Kirby） or another character is often tasked to collect the item in hand before the Key Dee gets away.

wikirby-page:7750.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7750.description_zh: Lanzer是一个反复出现的敌人，当被吞下时会赋予卡比（Kirby）枪（Spear）复制能力（Copy Ability）。这个敌人首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），它使用一把三叉戟并戴着一顶彩虹色的紫色头盔。Lanzer与星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的某些其他骑士相似，即三叉戟骑士（Trident Knight）和弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）。从Lanzer的球形体型和相对较大的脚可以明显看出这一点。然而，与三叉戟骑士（Trident Knight）不同，Lanzer在攻击时不会投掷三叉戟。尽管如此，它在刺击时具有极佳的攻击距离，所以在面对它时应格外小心。
wikirby-page:7750.description_en: Lanzer is a reoccurring enemy which grants 卡比（Kirby） the 枪（Spear） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. The enemy, which debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, wields a trident and sports an iridescent purple helmet. Lanzer bears a resemblance to certain other knights in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, namely 三叉戟骑士（Trident Knight） and 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）. This is apparent given Lanzer's spherical build and comparatively large feet. Unlike 三叉戟骑士（Trident Knight）, however, Lanzer does not toss its trident when attacking. Nonetheless, it has excellent range when jabbing, so it should be treated with the utmost caution when faced.

wikirby-page:5675.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5675.description_zh:
叶片怪（Leafan）是一个首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人。它看起来像一种植物状生物，由一个圆形的红橙色身体或头部组成，头部上有一对黑色的圆眼睛，眼睛周围是浅橙色。几个绿色的叶子附着在它的底部，充当双脚，而更多的叶子形成头顶的一个圆圈。

当它首次出现在屏幕上时，叶片怪（Leafan）通常位于空中，像螺旋桨那样旋转头上的叶子，以便缓慢沿一条垂直直线下滑。一旦着陆，叶片怪（Leafan）就会成为完全静止的敌人（尽管攻击可能会移动它），选择用投射物攻击卡比（Kirby）及其盟友，而不是进行近战战斗；在常规间隔期间，它的叶子形成一个球茎，这个球茎会迅速膨胀，直到释放出两颗小的棕色岩石或种子，这些岩石或种子接触有害，会沿弧线飞出，最终落到敌人的左右两侧。

叶片怪（Leafan）拥有极少的生命值，容易受到任何攻击。吸入和吞下其中一个会赋予卡比（Kirby）叶子（Leaf）的能力。
wikirby-page:5675.description_en:
叶片怪（Leafan） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It resembles a plant-like creature consisting of a bulbous, red-orange body or head with a pair of round, black eyes surrounded by a lighter shade of orange. Several green leaves are attached to its bottom and act as feet, while several more form a circle atop its head.

When it first appears on the screen, a 叶片怪（Leafan） is usually located in midair, spinning the leaves on its head like a propeller in order to slowly glide down in a straight, vertical line. Once it has landed, the 叶片怪（Leafan） becomes an entirely stationary foe (although attacks may move it), choosing to attack 卡比（Kirby） and his allies with projectiles rather than engaging in melee combat; at regular intervals, it forms a bulb with its leaves, which quickly expands until giving way to two small, brown rocks or seeds that are harmful to touch and fly in an arc, eventually landing to the left and right of the enemy.

叶片怪（Leafan） possesses little health and is vulnerable to any attack. Inhaling and swallowing one grants 卡比（Kirby） the 叶子（Leaf） ability.

wikirby-page:63929.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:63929.description_zh:
Leaper是来自Another Dimension的一个大型敌人，可以在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中遇到。它仅在Another Dimension中出现，并且在重制版的新Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler额外模式中与其对应的敌人啦啪（Darpa）、哩啪（Dippa）和噜啪（Dupa）一起出现。

Leaper是其同类中体型最大的。它是一个大红紫色的地雷形状生物，头上有三根小羽毛，呈鸡冠形排列。它拥有黄色眼睛中透露的愤怒表情，这是高阶球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的典型特征。

这个敌人是它所在小组中最强的，同时也是最稀有的。它具有像哩啪（Dippa）一样发射投射物的能力，但它们只快速直线移动。这些投射物如果击中卡比（Kirby）及其朋友会造成伤害。这些子弹也可以被击落以避免被击中。Leaper总是停留在屏幕的右侧，因此可以发射投射物。当它被击败时，会作为最后手段向右对角方向射出四个尖刺。这些也可以被摧毁。Leaper的生命值在其小队中最高，所以可能会有一些麻烦。
wikirby-page:63929.description_en:
Leaper is a large enemy from Another Dimension encountered in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is only encountered in Another Dimension and in the new Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler extra mode in the remake, alongside its counterparts, the 啦啪（Darpa）s, 哩啪（Dippa）s, and 噜啪（Dupa）s.

Leaper is the largest of its brethren. It is a big reddish-purple landmine-shaped creature with three small feathers on its head, arranged in a crest shape. It wields an angry expression from its yellow eyes, a characteristic shared with higher-ranking 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）s.

This enemy is the strongest out of its group, and it is also the rarest one encountered. It has the ability to fire projectiles like the 哩啪（Dippa）, but they only quickly travel in a straight line. These projectiles can damage 卡比（Kirby） and his friends if they make contact with one. These bullets can also be shot down to avoid getting hit. The Leaper always stays on the right side of the screen so it can fire projectiles. When it is defeated, it will shoot four spikes in right diagonals as a last resort. These, too, can be destroyed. Leaper also has the highest health of its group, so it can be a bit of trouble.

wikirby-page:24686.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:24686.description_zh: Merman Statue是一种敌人和障碍，可以在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）、Onion Ocean - Stage 3以及Giant Flotzo前面找到。它会从左到右移动，然后停下并短暂张开嘴以露出弱点；一个带星星的木桶。不过，卡比（Kirby）只能使用龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）能力来利用这个弱点，如果曝露出来会摧毁木桶，然后导致雕像崩塌。毁坏的雕像会掉落Point Star并且可能掉落食物。
wikirby-page:24686.description_en: Merman Statue is an enemy and obstacle which can be found in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, in Onion Ocean - Stage 3, ahead of the Giant Flotzo. It shuffles from left-to-right, then stops and opens its mouth briefly to reveal its weak point; a wooden barrel with a star on it. However, 卡比（Kirby） can only exploit this weakness using the 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） ability, which will destroy the barrel if exposed and then cause the statue to crumble. Destroyed statues will drop Point Stars and possibly food items.

wikirby-page:24688.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:24688.description_zh:
Moai Block是一种可以在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）、Raisin Ruins - Stage 2和Raisin Ruins - Stage 4中发现的危险。摩艾方块是类似石像怪（Kabu）外观的石头结构，尽管有各种方块组成了类似石像怪（Kabu）头部下的“身体”。较温和的方块不会对卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们构成威胁，但红色的摩艾面孔能够周期性地喷出火焰。

这些方块只能使用奇迹光束（Flare Beam）和究极剑士（Ultra Sword）Super Abilities进行摧毁。这样做会留下Point Star，并可能留下食物。
wikirby-page:24688.description_en:
Moai Block is a hazard which can be found in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, in Raisin Ruins - Stage 2 and Raisin Ruins - Stage 4. Moai Blocks are stone formations which resemble 石像怪（Kabu） in appearance, though there are a variety of blocks which form 'bodies' under the 石像怪（Kabu）-like heads. The fairer blocks do not pose a threat to 卡比（Kirby） and his friends, but the red Moai faces are capable of spouting flames on a regular cycle.

These blocks can only be destroyed using the 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） and 究极剑士（Ultra Sword） Super Abilities. Doing so will leave behind Point Stars and potentially food items as well.

wikirby-page:7739.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7739.description_zh: 月影（Moonja）是一个首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人。它在体型上类似卡比（Kirby），但手和脚更加分明，具有黄色的脸，主要是紫色的忍者服装，以及白色的手套和袜子。它以多种不同的方式跳跃以躲避攻击，同时投掷手里剑，并且能够在抓住墙壁时投掷这些武器。它有时会突然出现并利用瞬移技巧偷袭卡比（Kirby）。它有相当的生命值，但无法抵挡卡比（Kirby）的吸入攻击，也经不起任何其他攻击的猛烈打击。
wikirby-page:7739.description_en: 月影（Moonja） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It resembles 卡比（Kirby） in physique, but bears more defined hands and feet, along with a yellow face, a mostly purple ninja garb, and white gloves and socks. It hops in many different fashions to avoid getting hit while tossing shurikens, and is able to toss these while clinging onto walls. It sometimes can appear suddenly and get the jump on 卡比（Kirby） by using its teleporting technique. It has a fair amount of health, but cannot withstand 卡比（Kirby）'s inhale, nor a good pummeling with any other attack.

wikirby-page:48261.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:48261.description_zh:
“沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）在隔壁房间。你可以在他身上练习你的招式！”
— 艾菲灵（Elfilin），在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）中，是一个无活动且无害的训练假人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。他在某种程度上像卡比（Kirby）；然而，他没有嘴，并且——正如他的名字所暗示——由沙子装在一个木偶形状的袋子里组成（他是米色的，有排球般的图案，手脚是棕色的）。沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）的工作是保持静止并让卡比（Kirby）打他，这样粉色的小球就可以练习各种复制能力（Copy Ability），而不会让自己处于危险之中。
wikirby-page:48261.description_en:
“沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag） is in the next room. You can practice your moves on him!”
— 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag） is an inert and harmless training dummy that first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He somewhat resembles 卡比（Kirby）; however, he has no mouth and—as his name implies—is made of sand in a puppet-shaped sack (he is beige with a volleyball-like pattern and brown hands and feet). 沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）'s job is to sit still and take a beating from 卡比（Kirby） so the pink puffball can practice various 复制能力（Copy Ability） without putting himself in danger.

wikirby-page:7763.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7763.description_zh:
Owgulf是来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人，首次登场于Nutty Noon。当吸入时，卡比（Kirby）会从他那里获得风羽（Wing）能力。

Owgulf有一张带角猫头鹰的脸，身体红色，眼睛蓝色，冠毛橙色，翅膀和尾巴小且橙色。它来回飞行，一旦从下方发现入侵者，会尝试朝他们投掷羽毛针。Owgulf是《返回梦幻之地》中唯一会产生风羽（Wing）能力的生物，也是该游戏中最后一个会产生已回归能力的生物。
wikirby-page:7763.description_en:
Owgulf is an enemy from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that debuts in Nutty Noon. When inhaled, 卡比（Kirby） gets the 风羽（Wing） ability from him.

Owgulf has the face of a horned owl, with red body, blue eyes and an orange crest, with small orange wings and tail. It flies back and forth and, upon spotting an intruder from below, will attempt to toss feather needles at them. Owgulf is the only creature in Return to Dream Land that yields the 风羽（Wing） ability, and is also the last yielder of a returning ability in that game.

wikirby-page:7775.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7775.description_zh:
Pacloud是一种漂浮的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，它仅在Nutty Noon中出现。它在形态和功能上与帕克特（Pacto）基本相同，但外观呈云状，并带有类似公羊的角。虽然它不能像平时一样被吸入，但可以像它的同类一样被超级吸入，尽管不会提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。除此之外，它也容易受到其他攻击的伤害。

尽管与帕克特（Pacto）其余方面完全相同，但Paclouds比它们的普通同类更耐打，使它们优于普通的帕克特（Pacto）。因此，通常最好是避开它们，而不是冒着被吃掉并被迫摇Wii遥控器（或旋转Control插入星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）以获取免费。

Pacloud只出现在Stages 3和Nutty Noon的四个位置。
wikirby-page:7775.description_en:
Pacloud is a hovering enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, where it appears exclusively in Nutty Noon. It is essentially identical to a 帕克特（Pacto） in both form and function, though it sports a cloud-like appearance and horns similar to that of a ram. Although it cannot be inhaled normally, it can be Super Inhaled like its cousin, although it does not give any 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Apart from that, it is also vulnerable to any other attack.

While otherwise identical to a 帕克特（Pacto）, Paclouds are more durable than their normal cousins are, making them superior to the normal 帕克特（Pacto）. As such, it is often better to avoid them, instead of risking being eaten and being forced to shake the Wii Remote (or spin the Control Stick in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）) to get free.

Pacloud only appears in Stages 3 and 4 of Nutty Noon.

wikirby-page:7695.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7695.description_zh:
穿刺蜂（Pierce）是一种首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的飞行敌人。被吞下时，它会赋予枪（Spear）能力。

穿刺蜂（Pierce）看起来像一只拿着矛的大熊蜂，头很大，戴着紫色耳罩。当发现卡比（Kirby）或他的朋友时，它会缓慢地向他们冲锋，并试图用矛攻击他们。通常来说，不是很难对付。
wikirby-page:7695.description_en:
穿刺蜂（Pierce） is a flying enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It grants the 枪（Spear） ability when swallowed.

穿刺蜂（Pierce） resembles a large bumblebee with a spear in hand and a very big head and purple earmuffs. When spotting 卡比（Kirby） or his friends, it will charge slowly toward them and attempt to strike them with its spear. It is generally not tough to deal with.

wikirby-page:7732.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7732.description_zh:
Pluid是出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的敌人，吞下它会获得清水（Water）能力。

Pluid看起来像一个带有两只红眼的水滴。它在天花板上会释放水滴，但从长远来看，这不会影响它的大小。

Pluid大部分时间挂在天花板上，如果有人接近，它会掉下来。它唯一的攻击方式是接触，虽然它的掉落可能会让不谨慎的冒险者吃惊，但并不难以击败。
wikirby-page:7732.description_en:
Pluid is an enemy that appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, which grants the 清水（Water） ability when swallowed.

Pluid resembles a droplet of water with two red eyes. It releases droplets while on the ceiling, but this does not affect its size in the long run.

Pluid spends most of its time hanging from ceilings, and will drop down if approached. Its only means of attack is by contact, and although its drop may take the unwary adventurer by surprise, it is not hard to defeat.

wikirby-page:6652.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6652.description_zh:
Puppet Waddle Dee是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的大型敌人。它是一个纸质傀儡，类似于大型瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），由下面三个普通的Waddle Dees控制。这个外壳使Waddle Dees更加耐久。它的攻击方式是缓慢地向卡比（Kirby）移动并进行接触攻击，或者保持静止阻挡通道。正常击败它时，外套会爆炸，三个Waddle Dees会飞出去，恢复为普通敌人，并在恢复后像平常一样蹒跚移动，尽管也可以使用Super Inhale整个吞下。Puppet Waddle Dee的机器人版更加威猛（尽管更慢）为Armor Waddle Dee，其中一个变体可作为Puppet Waddle Dee在Halcandra中。在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，Puppet Waddle Dee对基于烈火（Fire）/能力效果（Power Effect）的攻击很弱，会立即燃烧并瞬间击败里面的三名Waddle Dees。

这套服装很快就被发现了，因为工艺粗糙，外面能看到接缝、缝线和胶带。两边突出的球体连接在棍子上，看起来像它的手臂，下面可以看到四只脚，属于里面三名Waddle Dees中的两名。木偶的眼睛是洞，推测允许第三名瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）从服装里看到外面。
wikirby-page:6652.description_en:
Puppet Waddle Dee is a large enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It is a paper-like puppet resembling a large 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, which is controlled by three regular Waddle Dees underneath. This outer shell gives the Waddle Dees more durability. It attacks by moving slowly toward 卡比（Kirby） and hitting him by contact, or by holding still and blocking off a walkway. When defeated normally, the costume explodes and the three Waddle Dees go flying, returning to regular enemies who will then proceed to waddle about as usual once they collect themselves, although it can be swallowed whole using Super Inhale. A robotic, more formidable (albeit slower) variation of Puppet Waddle Dee is the Armor Waddle Dee, which a variant of acts as a replacement for Puppet Waddle Dee in Halcandra. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, Puppet Waddle Dee is weak against 烈火（Fire）/能力效果（Power Effect）-based attacks, burning up immediately and defeating the three Waddle Dees inside instantly.

The costume is quickly given away, as the craftsmanship is shoddy, with seams, stitches, and tape visible on the outside. Balls connected to sticks poke out of each side to appear as its arms, and four feet can be seen below, belonging to two out of the three Waddle Dees inside. The eyes on the puppet are holes, presumably allowing the third 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） to see out of the costume.

wikirby-page:7709.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7709.description_zh:
Searches是一种会悬浮的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中，被吞噬时会赋予爆裂（Crash）能力。它看起来像一个水雷，但也具有噴火輪（Flamer）的几个特征。

Searches是一个黑色的圆盘形炸弹，带有黄色的脸，仅有一对愤怒的眼睛，以及四个红色凸起（每个指向一个基本方向）。像水雷一样，它会悬浮在原地，等待入侵者进入其范围。如果有人进入，Searches会开始脉动，身体变红并带有白色凸起，如果不阻止，它会在大范围内引发爆炸，造成伤害并击中两次。
wikirby-page:7709.description_en:
Searches is a hovering enemy which first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, and grants the 爆裂（Crash） ability when swallowed. It resembles a naval mine, though it also shares several traits with 噴火輪（Flamer）.

Searches is a black, disc-shaped bomb with a yellow face consisting of only a pair of angry eyes, and four red bumpy extrusions (each pointing in one cardinal direction). Like a mine, it hovers in place and waits for an intruder to enter its proximity. If one does, Searches begins to pulsate, its body turning red with white extrusions, and, if not stopped, detonates in a large explosion that can harm at great range and hits twice.

wikirby-page:7759.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7759.description_zh:
Shelt是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的敌人，被吞下时不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Shelt是一个小型蓝色生物，穿着带有前端尖头的保护金属壳，并会尝试冲向任何靠近它的人，同时会跳过路上的任何障碍物。Shelt可以承受打击，但最终会失去它的壳并变得脆弱，这时它会尝试逃跑。在对付冲撞的Shelt时必须小心，因为攻击它不一定会让它退缩。也许更好的是直接绕过去，而不是浪费宝贵的时间和精力。当然，卡比（Kirby）可以吸入Shelt的壳来降低它的威胁。威胁.
wikirby-page:7759.description_en:
Shelt is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, which does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

Shelt is a small blue creature that wears a protective metal shell with a point at the front tip, and will attempt to charge anyone who approaches it, jumping over any obstacles in its way. Shelt can take a beating, but it will eventually lose its shell and become vulnerable, at which point it will try to run away. Caution must be taken when dealing with a charging Shelt, as attacking it will not necessarily cause it to flinch. It may be better to just move past it, rather than waste valuable time and energy. Of course, 卡比（Kirby） can inhale Shelt's shell to make it less of a threat.

wikirby-page:7736.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7736.description_zh:
Snowl是一个首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的飞行敌人，首次遇见于White Wafers关卡。当被吞下时会获得冰冻（Ice）能力。

它看起来像一只小型角鸮，羽毛为白色，面部为紫色，眼睛为黄色，有蓝色羽冠。它来回飞行，留下冰的轨迹，并偶尔掉落可对卡比（Kirby）及其朋友造成伤害的冰块。

Snowl出现在White Wafers - Stage 2和Dangerous Dinner - Stage 2。
wikirby-page:7736.description_en:
Snowl is a flying enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, first encountered in the White Wafers level. It yields the 冰冻（Ice） ability when swallowed.

It resembles a small horned owl with white plumage, a purple face, yellow eyes and blue feather tufts. It flies back and forth, leaving a trail of ice in its wake, and occasionally drops ice that can deal damage to 卡比（Kirby） and his friends.

Snowl appears in White Wafers - Stage 2 and Dangerous Dinner - Stage 2.

wikirby-page:7706.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7706.description_zh:
Sodory是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）、New Challenge Stages、星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）、Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe和星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中出现的敌人，吞下后可以获得利剑（Sword）能力。

Sodory是一个活剑敌人，剑柄上有一只眼睛，十字护手的位置有翅膀。它闲置时刀刃轻轻插入地面，但一旦发现入侵者可以迅速挥动攻击。它的攻击范围相当不错，因此优先处理它以避免被砍伤。

Sodory在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中再次出现，但有趣的是，它只在Dedede's Drum Dash中遇到，在那里它作为需要避免的障碍。它还出现在Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe中，角色与原版Sub-Game中相同。
wikirby-page:7706.description_en:
Sodory is an enemy featured in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, New Challenge Stages, 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe, and 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe） and grants the 利剑（Sword） ability when swallowed.

Sodory is a living sword enemy, with an eye in the hilt and wings in place of the cross-guard. It spends its idle time with its blade embedded softly in the ground, but can quickly swing about when it spots an intruder. Its reach can be quite good, so dealing with it is a priority to avoid getting slashed.

Sodory returns in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, but, interestingly enough, is only encountered in Dedede's Drum Dash, where it serves as an obstacle to be avoided. It has also appeared in Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe, with the same role it had in the original Sub-Game.

wikirby-page:7742.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7742.description_zh:
Strike Box是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的White Wafers第二关首次遇到的敌人。它只能在伸展状态下被十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）Super Ability攻击击败。它不能被吸入，但它的投射物可以被吸入，获得冰冻（Ice）。它也出现在Nutty Noon第四关。

Strike Box类似于盒子里的Jack，尽管它是石头做的，有一个奇怪的猫头鹰般的脸，上面装饰着发光的星星。它住在许多盒子里，每次只会从一个盒子里出来，要么只是探出头，要么向卡比（Kirby）发射。卡比（Kirby）只能在敌人探出头时用十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）攻击它击败敌人。这样做会导致它和它的所有盒子爆裂，产生许多星星和食物，同时通常会产生一条路径。

还有各种各样的Strike Box，它们通常守护着重要的区域。
wikirby-page:7742.description_en:
Strike Box is an enemy first encountered in stage 2 of White Wafers in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It can only be defeated by striking it with the 十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） Super Ability while it is extended. It cannot be inhaled, but its projectiles can, which yield 冰冻（Ice）. It also appears in stage 4 of Nutty Noon.

Strike Box resembles a Jack in the Box, though it is made of stone and has a strange owl-like face and is adorned with glowing stars. It resides in many boxes, and only comes out of one at a time, either just to poke its head out, or to fire at 卡比（Kirby）. 卡比（Kirby） can only defeat this enemy by striking it with the 十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） while its head is poking out. Doing so causes it and all of its boxes to burst, yielding many stars and food items while also usually yielding a path.

There is a giant variety of Strike Box as well, which usually guards important areas.

wikirby-page:5859.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5859.description_zh:
Super Blade Knight是敌人剑骑士（Blade Knight）的一个稍强版本，该敌人首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），并在它的重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中回归。

Super Blade Knight看起来与普通的剑骑士（Blade Knight）仅有轻微差别。它的头盔上的流苏稍长，护甲颜色更浅，并配有一把弯刀形刀刃，这与普通的剑骑士（Blade Knight）不同。它的头上还有一颗发光的星星，并有一个多彩的星形光环围绕它，就像所有其他Super Ability敌人一样。如果被吸入（或击败并捡起能力之星），卡比（Kirby）将获得究极剑士（Ultra Sword）能力。
