Super Blade Knight的攻击与剑骑士（Blade Knight）的攻击极为相似（用刀刃攻击等）。
wikirby-page:5859.description_en:
Super Blade Knight is a slightly stronger version of the enemy 剑骑士（Blade Knight） that debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and returns in its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）.

Super Blade Knight looks only slightly different than a normal 剑骑士（Blade Knight）. It has slightly longer tassels on its helmet, paler colored armor, and a cutlass shaped blade, unlike a normal 剑骑士（Blade Knight）. It also has a glowing star on its head and a multicolored star-shaped aura surrounding it, like all other Super Ability Enemies. If inhaled (or defeated and the Ability Star is picked up), 卡比（Kirby） receives the 究极剑士（Ultra Sword） Ability.

Super Blade Knight's attacks are extremely similar to 剑骑士（Blade Knight）'s attacks (slashing with blade, etc.)

wikirby-page:5862.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5862.description_zh:
Super Chilly是敌人粗眉雪人（Chilly）的一种变种，于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）首次出现，并在吸入后赋予卡比（Kirby）冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）能力。

Super Chilly与普通粗眉雪人（Chilly）有一些差异，但最多也只是极小的差别。它有紫色的眼睛，下面有蓝色的图案，身体颜色较浅，紫色颈圈上有三只小铃铛，这与普通粗眉雪人（Chilly）不同。它的头上还有一个发光的星星，并且像所有其他Super Ability敌人一样，它周围有一个星形多彩光环。

Super Chilly和它的普通同类一样，只使用基础的冰冻场来防御自己并攻击敌人。
wikirby-page:5862.description_en:
Super Chilly is a variety of the enemy 粗眉雪人（Chilly） that debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and gives 卡比（Kirby） the 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） ability when inhaled.

Super Chilly has some differences from a normal 粗眉雪人（Chilly）, but these are minimal at most. It has purple eyes, a blue pattern underneath, a lighter body coloration, and three bells on a purple neck collar unlike a normal 粗眉雪人（Chilly）. It also has a glowing star on its head and a star-shaped multicolored aura surrounding it, like all other Super Ability enemies.

Super Chilly, like its normal cousin, only uses basic freeze fields to defend itself and attack foes.

wikirby-page:6646.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6646.description_zh: Super Hot Head是炽热头（Hot Head）的一种更强形式，它出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。它们与标准Hot Heads在外观上有所不同：颜色更亮，框架更鲜艳，额头上有一个大星星。被击败时，Super Hot Heads会掉落龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame）能力，这是烈火（Fire）能力的更强形式，可以帮助卡比（Kirby）破坏大型物体，这是卡比（Kirby）打开通往平行维度门户所必需的。
wikirby-page:6646.description_en: Super Hot Head is a stronger form of a 炽热头（Hot Head） that appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. They differ in appearance to standard Hot Heads in that they are brighter, have a more vibrant frame, and have a large star on their forehead. When defeated, Super Hot Heads yield the 龙袭怒吼（Monster Flame） ability, a stronger form of the 烈火（Fire） ability, which helps 卡比（Kirby） destroy large objects, which is necessary to allow 卡比（Kirby） to open portals to alternate dimensions.

wikirby-page:5858.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5858.description_zh:
Super Waddle Doo是常见敌人瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的略强版本，后者首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）。

Super Waddle Doo在外观上与普通的瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）几乎没有差别。它的头发更粗，脚呈尖状，颜色比瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）更深。它的眼睛上方有一个明亮的黄色星星，并且周围有一个多彩的星形光环，就像其他所有Super Ability敌人一样。如果被吸入（或击败并拾取能力星），卡比（Kirby）将获得奇迹光束（Flare Beam）能力。

Super Waddle Doo的唯一攻击是普通瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）使用的基本Beam Whip。不过，和所有其他超级能力敌人一样，它以及对应的超级能力在被击败后如果卡比（Kirby）向舞台前进，然后以某种方式返回，使敌人所在的区域有几秒钟不在屏幕上。
wikirby-page:5858.description_en:
Super Waddle Doo is a slightly stronger version of the common enemy 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） who debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）.

Super Waddle Doo looks at most only marginally different than a normal 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）. It has thicker hair strands on its head, pointed feet, and a darker color than a 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）. It also has a bright yellow star above its eye and a multicolored star-shaped aura around it, like all other Super Ability Enemies. If inhaled (or defeated and the Ability Star is picked up), 卡比（Kirby） gains the 奇迹光束（Flare Beam） ability.

Super Waddle Doo's only attack is the basic Beam Whip that the normal 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） uses. Still, like all other Super Ability enemies, it, and the Super Ability in question, can regenerate after defeat if 卡比（Kirby） advances through the stage and comes back in just such a way so that the area where the enemy is is off-screen for a few seconds.

wikirby-page:7181.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7181.description_zh: 托天甲（Totenga）是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的敌人。托天甲（Totenga）看起来像一个杆状仙人掌，带有大块突出的刺和一个顶部有单只眼睛的小橙色头部，头部也覆盖着刺。在其在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的原始出现中，托天甲（Totenga）无法移动，但在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中它获得了前后移动的能力。它们的内部名称Togekuki来自日语“stem thorn”的翻译。
wikirby-page:7181.description_en: 托天甲（Totenga） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. 托天甲（Totenga） resembles a pole-shaped cactus with large protruding spikes and a small orange head with a single eye on top, also covered in spikes. In its original appearance in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, 托天甲（Totenga） was unable to move, but it gained the ability to shuffle back and forth in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）. Their internal name, Togekuki, is based on the Japanese translation of "stem thorn".

wikirby-page:7773.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7773.description_zh: Volttzo是一个无敌的敌人，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。它会停留在一个地方，直线发射大型火花球，这些火花球不能被吸入或反弹。与黑大炮（Shotzo）不同，且像星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的其他大型加农炮（巨大炮（Gigatzo）和Coldtzo）一样，Volttzo无法瞄准射击，总是朝同一个方向开火。它也可能从背景发射子弹，先飞到空中，然后在同一水平区域落下。像黑大炮（Shotzo）一样，它是无敌的，虽然在某些情况下，如果它的支撑地板被移除，它可能会倒下。
wikirby-page:7773.description_en: Volttzo is an invincible enemy that first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It stays in one place and shoots large spark balls in a straight line that cannot be inhaled or reflected. Unlike 黑大炮（Shotzo） and like the other large cannons in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） (巨大炮（Gigatzo） and Coldtzo), Volttzo cannot aim its shots, always firing in the same direction. It may also fire shots from the background, flying up into the air before falling back down in the same horizontal area. Like 黑大炮（Shotzo）, it is invulnerable, though it can fall in certain instances if its supporting floor is removed.

wikirby-page:7693.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7693.description_zh: 沃尔夫（Walf）是一种小型两栖的乌龟状敌人，主要出现在清水（Water）关卡中。它看起来像乌龟浮水玩具，并且像那些玩具一样，会在水上漂浮，而不像大多数陆地敌人那样下沉。它的力量不大，只能通过接触伤害卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们。如果被吸入，沃尔夫（Walf）不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7693.description_en: 沃尔夫（Walf） is a small amphibious turtle-like enemy that is found mainly in 清水（Water） levels. It resembles a turtle floatie toy, and, much like those, will float on water as opposed to sinking like most land-based enemies. It is not very strong, and can only harm 卡比（Kirby） and his friends by making contact. 沃尔夫（Walf） does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled.

wikirby-page:5880.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5880.description_zh: 清水加爾波（Water Galbo）是火焰喷射敌人Galbo的一种变体，该敌人首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。与标准Galbo的主要区别在于，清水加爾波（Water Galbo）喷出一股水流，而不是火焰，并且颜色是蓝色而不是红色。这股水流会沿地面移动，直到撞到卡比（Kirby）、障碍物或墙壁。当吸入时，会产生清水（Water）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它有一个中Boss变体，称为清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）。
wikirby-page:5880.description_en: 清水加爾波（Water Galbo） is a variation on the fire-breathing Galbo enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. The main difference from a standard Galbo is that the 清水加爾波（Water Galbo） spits a stream of water as opposed to bursts of fire and is blue instead of red. The stream of water continues to move along the ground until it hits 卡比（Kirby）, an obstacle, or a wall. When inhaled, it yields the 清水（Water） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. It has a mid-boss variant called 清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）.

wikirby-page:6649.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6649.description_zh:
鞭皮（Whippy）是一个首次登场于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的敌人，被吞下后会获得鞭子（Whip）的能力。

鞭皮（Whippy）有一个椭圆形的身体，略带猫科动物特征，并在顶部有一条长而像鞭子的尾巴。它的头部两侧有橙色胡须，毛发由温暖的颜色组成，主要是红色和橙色。鞭皮（Whippy）的表情阴郁，眉毛更显其愁苦。

鞭皮（Whippy）会在空中旋转尾巴一次，然后将鞭子甩向最近的目标。这个攻击有相当的射程，使得鞭皮（Whippy）相当危险。
wikirby-page:6649.description_en:
鞭皮（Whippy） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, yielding the 鞭子（Whip） ability when swallowed.

鞭皮（Whippy） has an oval shaped body with vaguely feline features and a long, whip-like tail on top. It has orange whiskers on the side of its head, and its fur consists of warm colors, mainly reds and oranges. 鞭皮（Whippy） bears a dour expression, accented by its brow.

鞭皮（Whippy） spins its tail around in the air once, then snaps the whip toward the closest target. This has a decent amount of range to it, making 鞭皮（Whippy） rather dangerous.

wikirby-page:5901.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5901.description_zh:
镀比亚（Dubior）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。它类似于U.F.O.的漂浮机器人，拥有黄色闪亮的眼睛。它的下方是橙色的，周围有五个发射激光的突出物。被击败并吸收后，它会给予电火花（Spark）能力。

镀比亚（Dubior）相比大多数其他中型Boss有一个优势，即它可以悬浮，并且大部分时间都离开地面。除了施展一系列电击攻击之外，它还能够召唤被称为镀比亚（Dubior）Jr.的小型手下来保护自己。
wikirby-page:5901.description_en:
镀比亚（Dubior） is a mid-boss that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It resembles a U.F.O.-like floating robot, with yellow shining eyes. Its underside is orange, and surrounding that side are five stubs that shoot lasers. It yields the 电火花（Spark） ability when defeated and inhaled.

镀比亚（Dubior） has an advantage over most other mid-bosses in that it can hover, and spends much of its time off the ground. In addition to delivering an arsenal of electrical attacks, it is also capable of summoning little minions known as 镀比亚（Dubior） Jr. to defend itself.

wikirby-page:5882.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5882.description_zh:
“士兵回来了，他比以往任何时候都更加武装且危险！”
— Tough:庞大刃（Gigant Edge）任务描述在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
庞大刃（Gigant Edge）是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）首次登场的中Boss，击败后会获得利剑（Sword）复制能力（Copy Ability），这是该系列中首次有中Boss提供此奖励。他穿着比利剑骑士（Sword Knight）或剑骑士（Blade Knight）更加坚固的铠甲，并且还持有一面盾牌（他偶尔会使用）。庞大刃（Gigant Edge）的攻击方式是向地面发射波动以试图击中卡比（Kirby），或持剑冲向卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:5882.description_en:
“The soldier returns, and he's more armed and dangerous than ever!”
— Tough: 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
庞大刃（Gigant Edge） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that grants the 利剑（Sword） 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and is the first mid-boss in the series to do so. He wears different, tougher armor than 利剑骑士（Sword Knight） or 剑骑士（Blade Knight）'s, and also sports a shield (which he occasionally uses). 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） attacks by shooting waves across the ground in an attempt to hit 卡比（Kirby）, or charging toward 卡比（Kirby） with his sword.

wikirby-page:6553.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6553.description_zh:
“Witness银色盔甲的回归，刀刃刚刚磨利，准备就绪！”
— 艰难：弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）任务描述在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade）是一个在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）首次登场的中型Boss，当吸入时会产生弯刀（Cutter）复制能力（Copy Ability）。它的攻击方式与其较小的表亲弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）类似，因为它会抛出头顶的刀刃。它可以以几种不同的模式进行攻击。它还会尝试撞击卡比（Kirby），就像大多数其他中型Boss一样。
wikirby-page:6553.description_en:
“Witness the return of the silver armor, blade newly sharpened and ready!”
— Tough: 弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
弯刀骑士老大（Kibble Blade） is a mid-boss who debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） that yields the 弯刀（Cutter） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled. Its attacks are similar to that of its smaller cousin, 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）, in that it tosses the blade on its head. It can do this in several different patterns. It will also attempt to ram 卡比（Kirby）, much like most of the other mid-bosses.

wikirby-page:5806.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5806.description_zh:
“在最终战斗中，小心闪电鞭！不要让卡比（Kirby）队被击退！”
— 在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe中的困难任务描述
瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。他是一只大型黄色瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），头顶有明显的毛发丛，鞋尖向上翘起。

作为典型的瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo），他可以使用光束鞭攻击，这攻击基本上与普通瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）的攻击一样（只是明显更大），他还可以在跳跃后在空中使用。瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）也拥有波纹光束（Beam）能力，可以横向发射强大的能量冲击波覆盖整个战场。他还有一种非光束攻击，即直接冲撞屏幕。一旦被击败，瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo）可以被吸入用于光束（Beam）能力.
wikirby-page:5806.description_en:
“In the final battle, watch out for lightning whips! Don't let Team 卡比（Kirby） be driven back!”
— Tougher Quest description in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He is a large yellow 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo） with a pronounced tuft of hair and shoes with tips that point upward.

As expected from a 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）, he can use a beam whip attack, which appears essentially identical to a regular 瓦豆鲁笃（Waddle Doo）'s (though obviously much larger) which he can also use in the air after a jump. 瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） also has the Wave 光束（Beam） ability, firing a large blast of energy sideways across the field. He also has one non-beam attack, which involves simply charging across the screen. Once defeated, 瓦豆鲁笃老大（King Doo） can be inhaled for the 光束（Beam） ability.

wikirby-page:7094.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:7094.description_zh:
山石（Moundo）是出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版中的中级Boss。它看起来像一块大棕色岩石（有点像硬石（Rocky）），头顶有三根灰色尖刺。它穿着黄色的双脚上穿着一双草鞋，头上系着一条红白相间的头带，带有日本风格。它的脸总是带着永久的皱眉，嘴巴呈锯齿状，与它的岩石外观相辅相成。

正如其本性所示，山石（Moundo）一旦被卡比（Kirby）击败并吸收，就会获得石块（Stone）能力。
wikirby-page:7094.description_en:
山石（Moundo） is a mid-boss appearing in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake. It resembles a large, brown rock (bearing a slight resemblance to 硬石（Rocky）) with three gray spikes on top of its head. On its yellow feet, it wears a pair of zōri sandals, while a headband with red and white stripes is tied around its head, giving it a Japanese look. Its face is stuck in a perpetual frown, its mouth forming a jagged shape to compliment its lithic appearance.

As its nature suggests, 山石（Moundo） yields the 石块（Stone） Ability once defeated and inhaled by 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:5718.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5718.description_zh:
“A超能力帮助你进入了这个奇怪的空间，同时一个球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）也从不同的维度飞了进来！它不会让你窃取球体的能量……所以准备迎接攻击吧！”
— VS球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
的描述球毁灭者是一类首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的中级Boss怪。它们是来自Another Dimension的生物，对Energy Sphere有吸引力。球毁灭者通常在许多关卡的跨维度段落结束时遭遇，可以通过使用Super Ability发现的维度裂缝进入。发生在故事模式（Story Mode）或Extra Mode的球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）遭遇总是会产生两个能量球。
wikirby-page:5718.description_en:
“A Super Ability helped you enter this strange space, and a 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） has flown in from a different dimension as well! It won't let you steal the energy of the spheres...so brace for an attack!”
— VS 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） description from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
Sphere Doomers are a collection of mid-bosses first appearing in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. They are creatures from Another Dimension that are attracted to Energy Spheres. Sphere Doomers are usually encountered at the end of interdimensional segments in many stages, which can be entered through dimensional rifts revealed using a Super Ability. A 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） encounter taking place in 故事模式（Story Mode） or Extra Mode always yields two Energy Spheres.

wikirby-page:5856.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5856.description_zh: 超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers）是中boss锤星猩（Bonkers）的一个稍强版本，后者首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中。他的独特之处在于，他是一个会掉落Super Ability的中boss，而其他所有超级能力都是由普通敌人掉落的。
wikirby-page:5856.description_en: 超级锤星猩（Super Bonkers） is a slightly stronger version of the mid-boss 锤星猩（Bonkers） who debuts in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He is unique in that he is a mid-boss that yields a Super Ability, whereas all the other Super Abilities are yielded by normal enemies.

wikirby-page:5755.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5755.description_zh: 清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）是在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次登场的中型Boss。它看起来像一个较大的清水加爾波（Water Galbo），带有黄色条纹。
wikirby-page:5755.description_en: 清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros） is a mid-boss debuting in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. It appears as a larger 清水加爾波（Water Galbo） with yellow stripes.

wikirby-page:5883.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5883.description_zh:
“啊oy！缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer），这个海洋的贪吃者，出现了！当他吸气时，他会膨胀到巨大的体型。哦，看起来他还吞下了一部分船！也许这就是他变得如此强大的原因……”
— VS缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）特别页面在星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）是一个首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的Boss。正如他的名字所暗示的，他是一条胖河豚。他的外观类似于王者身份，他的攻击特点是利用巨大的体型进行身体猛撞和滚动攻击。他是Onion Ocean的Boss，并守卫着Lor Starcutter的左风羽（Wing）。
wikirby-page:5883.description_en:
“Ahoy! 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）, a glutton of the sea, has surfaced! As he inhales, he'll puff up to a massive size. Oh, and it looks like he's swallowed a ship part! Maybe that's how he got so strong...”
— VS 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer） is a boss that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. As his name implies, he is a fat pufferfish. His appearance resembles that of kingship, and his attacks are characterized by using his girth to perform body slams and rolling attacks. He's the boss of Onion Ocean and guards the Lor Starcutter's Left 风羽（Wing）.

wikirby-page:5884.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5884.description_zh:
“雪山是戈力牙斯（Goriath）的家。当这个强大的斗士生气时，他不会冷静……但你仍然必须与他战斗，因为一部分船只藏在他的巢穴里！去拿吧！”
— 对战戈力牙斯（Goriath）特别页面在星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
戈力牙斯（Goriath）是一个类似雪人的老板，出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版——星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）。他作为White Wafers的老板出现，并守护着Lor Starcutter的徽章。他的大部分攻击是直接的近战攻击，例如拳打和踩踏，尽管他也会爬墙并投掷诸如雪球的物体，或从手中发射光束（类似于格斗家（Fighter）卡比（Kirby））。

戈力牙斯（Goriath）的名字是“猩猩”和“Goliath”两个词的合成词。尽管如此，他实际上并不是那样大，特别是与卡比（Kirby）只有八英寸的高度相比。
wikirby-page:5884.description_en:
“The snowy mountains are 戈力牙斯（Goriath）'s home. When this powerful brawler gets mad, he won't calm down...but you'll have to battle him anyway, because a ship part is hiding in his lair! Go get it!”
— VS 戈力牙斯（Goriath） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
戈力牙斯（Goriath） is a yeti-like boss that appears in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake—星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. He appears as the boss of White Wafers and guards the Lor Starcutter's Emblem. Most of his attacks are direct melee attacks, such as punches and stomps, though he will also climb the walls and throw objects such as snowballs, or shoot beams from his hand (similar to 格斗家（Fighter） 卡比（Kirby）).

戈力牙斯（Goriath）'s name is a portmanteau of the words "gorilla" and "Goliath". Despite this, he really isn't that large, especially compared to 卡比（Kirby）'s height of only eight inches.

wikirby-page:6039.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6039.description_zh:
“它是所有末世者的老板，金色的伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）！当疯狂正午的天空开始扭曲时，这个可怕的敌人俯冲而来，夺取了球体——以及它们穿越维度的力量！”
— VS伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）豪华版星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）特别页面
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）是一个大型的光谱火焰球形生物，有翅膀，来自Another Dimension，首次亮相于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land），作为Nutty Noon的Boss出现。他是所有球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的Boss，并通过Lor Starcutter的桅杆制造的维度裂隙来到卡比（Kirby）的维度。当卡比（Kirby）和朋友们接近包含桅杆的零件球时，伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）将其吞噬，并开始与他们战斗。他的攻击方式类似于烈火（Fire）球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer），尽管他的攻击更加强大。
wikirby-page:6039.description_en:
“It's the boss of all Doomers, the golden 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）! As the skies over Nutty Noon began to warp, this fearsome foe swooped in to claim the spheres—and their dimension-traveling powers!”
— VS 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） Special Page from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxe
伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） is a large spectral flaming ball-shaped creature with wings from Another Dimension that debuted in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, appearing as the boss of Nutty Noon. He is the boss of all 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, and arrived in 卡比（Kirby）'s dimension thanks to a dimensional rift created by the Lor Starcutter's mast. When 卡比（Kirby） and friends approach the Part Sphere containing the mast, 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） consumes it, and begins to fight them. He attacks in a similar fashion as the 烈火（Fire） 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）, though his attacks are much more powerful.

wikirby-page:5877.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5877.description_zh:
“受机械能量的驱动，这台古老的战争机器通过一个跨维隧道穿越了时空。准备好与一名钢铁巨型战士进行梦幻般的战斗吧！”
— VS HR-D3星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中的特别页面
HR-D3是一个特大号机器人Boss，出现在Extra Mode的星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中。它基于Dedede Robo，这款机器人曾出现在Kirby Mass Attack的Sub-Game和Kirby Quest，并且原本计划出现在Nintendo GameCube的卡比（Kirby）中。HR-D3由金属将军EX（Metal General EX）驾驶，在Extra Mode的Egg Engines第6关击败后直接进行战斗。在The True Arena中，它也是最终五场战斗的一部分（豪华版为六场）。它的名称向星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的HR-H致敬，“D3”指的是它与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的相似之处。
wikirby-page:5877.description_en:
“Drawn by the mechanical energy here, this ancient war machine crossed time and space through an interdimensional tunnel. Get ready for a dream battle with a king-sized warrior of steel!”
— VS HR-D3 Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
HR-D3 is an extra-large robot boss which appears in Extra Mode in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is based on Dedede Robo, which appeared in Kirby Mass Attacks Sub-Game Kirby Quest and was originally planned to appear in 卡比（Kirby） for Nintendo GameCube. HR-D3 is piloted by 金属将军EX（Metal General EX）, and is fought directly after the latter is defeated in stage 6 of Egg Engines in Extra Mode. It is also fought in The True Arena as part of the final five battles (six in Deluxe). Its name is an homage to HR-H from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, with the "D3" referring to its resemblance to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）.

wikirby-page:6048.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6048.description_zh:
“龙帝亚（Landia），这个栖息在哈尔德拉火山的四头守护者，自古以来一直被尊为这颗星球的守护者……那么为什么它现在醒了呢？而且看起来这么生气？！啊！”
— VS龙帝亚（Landia）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
龙帝亚（Landia）特殊页面，是一条古龙，是Halcandra上古代文物的守护者；最著名的是Lor Starcutter和Master Crown，后者他戴在最高的头上。他由四条独立的龙组成，可以根据情况合并成一个类似九头蛇的实体，也可以再次分开。除了这股力量外，龙帝亚（Landia）还可以喷火、召唤有害的强风，并产生电场，尽管这些力量中的一些可能来自Master Crown而不是龙帝亚（Landia）自身的天赋能力。除此之外，龙帝亚（Landia）的主要攻击策略是向对手俯冲攻击，可以是单个攻击，也可以分开攻击。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中首次作为Dangerous Dinner的Boss登场，之后龙帝亚（Landia）在几款卡比（Kirby）游戏中再次出现，最著名的是''Team Kirby Clash'' series，在那里他和他的各种变体会被多次对战。尽管作为敌人频繁出现，龙帝亚（Landia）被描述为仁慈的守护天使和保护者，只因附身或误会才与卡比（Kirby）及其盟友战斗。在卡比（Kirby）游戏之外，龙帝亚（Landia）还以Spirit的身份出现在Super Smash Bros. Ultimate。
wikirby-page:6048.description_en:
“龙帝亚（Landia）, the 4-headed guardian who sleeps in Haldera Volcano, has been revered as this planet's protector since ancient times...so why is it awake now? And looking this way so angrily?! Eep!”
— VS 龙帝亚（Landia） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
龙帝亚（Landia） is an ancient dragon and the protector of ancient artifacts on Halcandra; most notably the Lor Starcutter and the Master Crown, the latter of which he wears on his highest head. He consists of four separate dragons which can combine into a single hydra-like entity or split apart again depending on circumstances. In addition to this power, 龙帝亚（Landia） can also breathe fire, conjure up harmful gusts of wind, and generate electric fields, though some of these powers may be drawn from the Master Crown rather than 龙帝亚（Landia）'s own innate ability. Aside from this, 龙帝亚（Landia）'s main attack strategy is to dive at his opponents, either as one or separated.

Introduced in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） as the boss of Dangerous Dinner, 龙帝亚（Landia） has since reappeared in several 卡比（Kirby） games, most notably in the ''Team Kirby Clash'' series, where he and variants of him are fought multiple times. Despite appearing so often as an opponent, 龙帝亚（Landia） is described as a benevolent guardian angel and protector, who only fights 卡比（Kirby） and his allies due to possession or misunderstanding. Outside of the 卡比（Kirby） games, 龙帝亚（Landia） has appeared in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate as a Spirit.

wikirby-page:71265.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:71265.description_zh:
“洛尔·星际切割者，现在被叛徒魔法洛亚（Magolor）控制，被用作对抗卡比（Kirby）及其朋友的武器！如果这艘神秘的飞船有自己的意识……它此刻会有什么感受？”
— 对战洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）特别页面星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版的结尾，卡比（Kirby）及其朋友必须与Lor Starcutter对抗，同时乘骑龙龙帝亚（Landia）。这场Boss战正式称为洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor），并作为关卡Another Dimension的第一个Boss进行战斗。在战斗过程中，当它被魔法洛亚（Magolor）操控时，洛尔的外观会变为深紫色和粉色（或在Extra Mode中为黑色、金色和红色的组合），并能够使用它自己的部件去攻击卡比（Kirby）及其盟友。
wikirby-page:71265.description_en:
“The Lor Starcutter, now controlled by the traitor 魔法洛亚（Magolor）, is being used as a weapon against 卡比（Kirby） and friends! If the shadowy ship had a mind of its own...how would it feel at this moment?”
— VS 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
Near the end of the 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 卡比（Kirby） and his friends have to face off against the Lor Starcutter, whilst riding the dragon 龙帝亚（Landia）. This boss fight is formally called 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）, and is fought as the first boss of the level Another Dimension. During the battle, as it is being puppeteered by 魔法洛亚（Magolor）, the Lor's appearance changes to a dark purple and pink coloration (or a combination of black, gold and red in Extra Mode) and is capable of using its own parts to attack 卡比（Kirby） and his allies.

wikirby-page:50717.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:50717.description_zh:
“Magolor被揭示为一个狡猾的法师，他欺骗了卡比（Kirby）和朋友们修理他的飞船，然后偷走了Halcandra的传说宝物Master Crown！拯救宇宙的重任落在了卡比（Kirby）的肩上！”
— 对战Magolor特别页面来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
。在魔法洛亚（Magolor）被究极剑士（Ultra Sword）击倒后，Master Crown接管了他，并将他变成了幽灵形态。他的服装几乎完全改变，他的围巾、披风（在之前的形态中已经破裂并呈幽灵状）以及长袍都消失了。因此，揭示出他有一张白色的嘴，随着战斗的进行，最终发现其中包含一个红色的眼球，让人联想到零（Zero）和零二（0²）。此外，他的耳朵变得更大，现在从身体两侧向下指。他的手在前一形态中已经长出了手指，现在手指尖是黑色的。

Master Crown对Magolor的抓握也变得更加明显，它像爪子一样的利爪延伸抓住他，四只爪子抓住他身体的下方，每只耳朵也螺旋下垂着一只大爪子。皇冠顶部的爪子现在在一个关节处聚合，而不仅仅是分别附着在皇冠的不同位置。皇冠本身也从顶部长出了四个倒置的水滴形尖刺，并且还长出了大型蓝色附属物。Magolor前一形态的红色和蓝色幽灵般的身体附着在这些附属物上，形成翅膀。

他面对着与他在The Arena的第一形态分开。在Extra Mode和The True Arena中，他被魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）取代，魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）是Magolor的更强版本，拥有新的攻击方式。在故事模式（Story Mode）中Magolor被击败后，他倒下，露出Magolor头上的原始形态Master Crown，该物在Magolor消失前破裂成碎片。然而，在竞技场中，Magolor在被击败后只是直接倒下消失。
wikirby-page:50717.description_en:
“Magolor is revealed as a manipulative mage who tricked 卡比（Kirby） and friends into fixing his ship, then stole Halcandra's legendary treasure, the Master Crown! It's up to 卡比（Kirby） to save the universe!”
— VS Magolor Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
After 魔法洛亚（Magolor） is struck down with the 究极剑士（Ultra Sword）, the Master Crown takes control of him and transforms him into a ghostly form. His outfit has almost completely changed, with his scarf, his cape (which became torn and ghostly in his previous form), and his robe having all disappeared. Due to this, it is revealed he has a white mouth that, as the battle progresses, eventually turns out to contain a red eyeball inside, reminiscent of 零（Zero） and 零二（0²）. In addition, his ears are larger and now point downwards from the sides of his body. His hands, which gained fingers in his previous form, now have black fingertips.

The Master Crown's grip on Magolor also becomes much more evident, as its talon-like claws extend their grasp on him, with four claws gripping the bottom of his body and a large one spiraling down each ear. The claws at the top of the crown now join in at one joint instead of just attaching to the crown in separate areas. The crown itself also has four upside-down drop-shaped spikes coming up from the top of it, and has additionally sprouted large blue appendages. The red and blue ghostly body of Magolor's previous form attach to these appendages and become wings.

He is faced separately from his first form in The Arena. In the Extra Mode and The True Arena, he is replaced with 魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）, who is a more powerful version of Magolor with new attacks. After Magolor is defeated in 故事模式（Story Mode）, he collapses, revealing Magolor's original form with the Master Crown on his head, which shatters into pieces before Magolor vanishes. However, in The Arena, Magolor simply collapses into nothing upon his defeat.

wikirby-page:6259.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6259.description_zh:
“剩下的魔法洛亚（Magolor）只是一个悲伤的躯壳。他被Master Crown的无限力量所附身，被前任统治者的仇恨和执念所囚禁。现在……击败它，解放魔法洛亚（Magolor）的灵魂！”
— 对战魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）豪华版特别模式
魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中Extra Mode和The True Arena的最终Boss，在击败魔法洛亚（Magolor）EX后挑战。他的形态基于魔法洛亚（Magolor）在主线故事中作为最终Boss的形态；然而，现在他呈现非常深的青绿色，并戴着更复杂、带有尖刺的王冠。此外，原始形态只有在第二阶段开始时才会在嘴中显示第三只眼，而魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）则从开始。他在这种形态下的大多数攻击与他在故事模式（Story Mode）战斗第二阶段使用的攻击相同。然而，现在这些攻击造成的伤害更大或外观有所不同，例如他的致命针现在带有刺，并且出现在不同的位置。他还获得了一种新攻击，结合了十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer）和冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）Super Abilities的属性。
wikirby-page:6259.description_en:
“What remains of 魔法洛亚（Magolor） is a sad shell. He's possessed by the limitless power of the Master Crown, imprisoned by the hatred and obsessions of prior rulers. Now...defeat it and free 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s soul!”
— VS 魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul） Special Page from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） Deluxes Extra Mode
魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul） is the final boss of Extra Mode and The True Arena in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, fought after 魔法洛亚（Magolor） EX is defeated. He is based on the form that 魔法洛亚（Magolor） takes as the final boss of the main story; however, he is now a very dark teal color and wears a more elaborate crown with a spikier build. Additionally, while the original form only shows the third eye in his mouth once the second phase begins, 魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul） shows it from the start. Most of his attacks in this form are the same as the ones he uses in the second phase of his battle in 故事模式（Story Mode）. However, they now do more damage or look different, such as his Deadly Needles now having thorns and being done in different locations. He also gains a new attack that combines the attributes of the 十亿吨锤子（Grand Hammer） and 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） Super Abilities.

wikirby-page:6216.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:6216.description_zh:
“很久以前，无魂战斗机器人金属将军（Metal General）会被它的主人派遣去访问其他星球并消灭敌人。现在它作为保安，永远守护这个地方。”
— VS金属将军（Metal General）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的特别页面
金属将军（Metal General）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）和星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中Egg Engines的老板。

当卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们首次进入金属将军（Metal General）的竞技场时，机器人是静止的，但当他们靠近它时，它会激活并喷出一阵蒸汽，表示战斗已经开始。击败金属将军（Metal General）是进入下一关的必要条件。
wikirby-page:6216.description_en:
“Long ago, the soulless battle robot 金属将军（Metal General） would be dispatched by its master to visit other planets and exterminate their foes. Now it serves as security, guarding this spot for eternity.”
— VS 金属将军（Metal General） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
金属将军（Metal General） is the boss of Egg Engines in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）.

When 卡比（Kirby） and his friends first enter 金属将军（Metal General）'s arena, the robot is stationary, but when they get close to it, it will activate and let out a burst of steam, signifying that the battle has begun. Defeating 金属将军（Metal General） is necessary to advance to the next level.

wikirby-page:5881.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:5881.description_zh:
“永远是那位艺人，达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）是一位危险的魔术师，能够从帽子里召唤出蛇和骷髅。但你不是来观看表演的。你是来找他发现的船零件的！”
— 在达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）的特别页面星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）（在英国英语Wii版本中解析为Mr Dooter）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中Raisin Ruins的老板。他看起来像是魔术师和精灵的结合体，他的攻击风格像魔术师或街头艺人。他守护着Lor Starcutter的右风羽（Wing）。
wikirby-page:5881.description_en:
“Ever the entertainer, 达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） is a dangerous magician able to summon snakes and skulls from his hat. But you're not here for the show. You're here for the ship part he found!”
— VS 达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） Special Page in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter） (parsed Mr Dooter in the British English Wii version) is the boss of Raisin Ruins in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. He resembles a cross between a magician and a genie and his attacks are characterized in the style of a magician or street performer. He guards the Lor Starcutter's Right 风羽（Wing）.

wikirby-page:66777.display_work: 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
wikirby-page:66777.description_zh:
“无论如何……MUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA！时候到了，你的星球……不！是整个宇宙向我低头的时刻到了。为了在这一切中提供如此大的帮助，你的星球将先行！准备下跪吧，波普之星（Popstar）！欢迎你的新统治者！”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）在背叛卡比（Kirby）及星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的朋友之后
魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor）（通常简称为魔法洛亚（Magolor））是魔法洛亚（Magolor）背叛卡比（Kirby）及其朋友时的形态，他从龙帝亚（Landia）手中夺取Master Crown并戴在头上，变成一个巨大的幽灵般威胁，并获得“无限力量”。在这种形态下，魔法洛亚（Magolor）的外貌与他原来的小型蛋状体显著不同，获得类似Necrodeus的幽灵般身体，原本的棕色皮肤变为漆黑，耳朵变成长而向下弯曲的角状耳朵，并拥有带魔法手铐的完全关节化双手。他的眼睛也变为凶恶的红色，王冠像大爪子般紧紧抓在头上。他获得轻松撕开通向Another Dimension、还可以使用大量强大的魔法攻击，例如他的巨型魔法洛亚（Magolor）加农炮、Black Hole、致命针以及更多技能。魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor）是星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）及其重制版星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的倒数第二个Boss，在击败洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）后于Level 8: Another Dimension中进行战斗。击败他会使他变异为第二形态（或在Extra Mode中为魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul）），进行最后一次对决。
wikirby-page:66777.description_en:
“Anyway... MUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! The time has come for your planet... No! The time has come for the ENTIRE UNIVERSE to bow down to me. And for being such a big help in all of this, your planet gets to go first! Prepare to bow, 波普之星（Popstar）! Welcome your new overlord!”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor） after betraying 卡比（Kirby） and friends in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）
魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor） (usually referred to as simply 魔法洛亚（Magolor）) is the form that 魔法洛亚（Magolor） assumes when he betrays 卡比（Kirby） and his friends by taking the Master Crown from 龙帝亚（Landia） and placing it upon his head, turning into a large spectral menace and gaining "limitless power". In this form, 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s appearance changes significantly from his original small egg-shaped stature, gaining a wraith-like body similar to that of Necrodeus, his original brown skin becoming pitch-black, longer horn-like ears that curve downward, and fully articulated hands with magic cuffs. His eyes also turn a menacing red and the crown hangs on his head like a large claw gripping it tightly. He gains the ability to casually rip holes in space which lead to Another Dimension, and can also use a large number of powerful magical attacks, such as his giant 魔法洛亚（Magolor） Cannon, Black Hole, Deadly Needles, and more. 魔法洛亚（Traitor Magolor） is the penultimate boss of 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） and its remake, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, fought in Level 8: Another Dimension after defeating 洛亚&魔法洛亚（Lor & Magolor）. Defeating him causes him to mutate into a second form (or 魔法洛亚灵魂（Magolor Soul） in Extra Mode) for one last confrontation.

wikirby-page:70306.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:70306.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:70306.description_zh: Chef Kawasaki是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个经常出现的角色，首次出现在Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!中。他的描写与动画中的对应角色形成了巨大对比——他是Dream Land中最有天赋的厨师，并经营着那里最受欢迎的餐厅。在这里，Chef Kawasaki被描绘为一个比平时更聪明、更严肃的角色。如果发生严重情况，无论是否影响到他，他也会很容易感到沮丧。牛排被展示为川崎的招牌菜之一。卡比（Kirby）和帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）都是他烹饪的忠实粉丝。
wikirby-page:70306.description_en: Chef Kawasaki is a recurring character in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, first appearing in Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!. His depiction massively contrasts his anime counterpart — he is the most talented chef in Dream Land, and he runs the most popular restaurant there. Here, Chef Kawasaki is depicted as a much more smart and serious character than usual. He also gets easily distressed if a heavy situation is occurring, whether it affects him or not. Steak is shown to be one of Kawasaki's signature dishes. 卡比（Kirby） and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） are huge fans of his cooking.

wikirby-page:48120.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48120.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48120.description_zh:
King Dedede是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的四大主要主角之一，其他三位分别是卡比（Kirby）、魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。他居住在自己的城堡中，自称为Dream Land之王，他的仆人瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）常常受到很差的对待。他经常愿意与卡比（Kirby）和其他角色发生不必要的争斗。然而，当他不太注意时，他有时与卡比（Kirby）相处得特别好，并且似乎与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）有友谊，尽管他们之间有许多明显的差异。

King Dedede拥有自己的专题卷——Kirby: King Dedede's Great Escape Mission!——在其中，他担任主角，而不是卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:48120.description_en:
King Dedede is one of the four primary protagonists of the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, alongside 卡比（Kirby）, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. He resides in his castle as the self-proclaimed King of Dream Land, with his often poorly treated servant, 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. He is very often willing to get into unnecessary fights with 卡比（Kirby） and other characters. He sometimes gets along particularly well with 卡比（Kirby） when not paying much attention, however, and seems to have a friendship with 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, despite their many noticeable differences.

King Dedede received his own featured volume—Kirby: King Dedede's Great Escape Mission!—where he took the role of protagonist instead of 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:46413.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:46413.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:46413.description_zh: Kirby是Kirby小说系列中的四位主要主角之一，与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）、魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）一起，并且几乎在系列中的每一卷小说中都以主要主角身份出现。他住在Dream Land，经常花时间吃东西、做白日梦或小睡。就像他在电子游戏中的对应角色一样，他被描绘成一个年轻、天真、贪吃的圆球，并且能够吸入某些生物以获得它们各自的复制能力（Copy Ability）。他是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的朋友，并且是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的挚友，但他经常与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）发生冲突，因为他们通常不太喜欢对方。
wikirby-page:46413.description_en: Kirby is one of the four primary protagonists of the Kirby novel series, alongside 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, and stars in almost every novel volume in the series as the main focused protagonist. He resides in Dream Land, often spending his time either eating, daydreaming, or taking a nap. Much like his video game counterpart, he is portrayed as a young, naïve puffball with a very large appetite, along with the ability to inhale certain creatures to gain their respective 复制能力（Copy Ability）. He is friends with 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and best friends with 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, but he is often in conflict with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, as they are usually not particularly fond of each-other.

wikirby-page:48262.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48262.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48262.description_zh:
Meta Knight是卡比（Kirby）小说系列的四大主角之一，其他三位分别是卡比（Kirby）、帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。他是一个自豪、技艺高超的剑士，但性急易怒，当受到侮辱时会显得缺陷明显。和游戏中一样，他的出身及居住地大多不为人知，面容始终隐藏在银色面具之下。甚至有人认为他根本不住在Dream Land，而只是出于特定原因才会前往。他基本上是一个孤独的人，如果不直接涉及自己，他对别人的问题兴趣不大。尽管如此，作为朋友，他会在需要时帮助卡比（Kirby）、帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），但通常会有其他做事和解决问题的动机，这些动机很少被完全揭示。

 Meta Knight偶尔会收到他自己的专题卷，在这些卷中，他扮演主角的角色，而不是卡比（Kirby）。目前有四卷这样的书：Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess、Kirby: Meta Knight and the Galaxy's Greatest Warrior、Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi和Kirby: Meta Knight and the Monster of the Magic Stone。
wikirby-page:48262.description_en:
Meta Knight is one of the four primary protagonists of the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, alongside 卡比（Kirby）, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. He is a proud, skilled swordsman who comes to a fault when he is humiliated because of his quick temper. Like in the games, his origins and place of residence are largely unknown, and his face is concealed under a silver mask at all times. It is even suggested that he does not live in Dream Land at all, and instead only visits for specific reasons. He is largely a loner who has little interest in the problems of others if it does not significantly involve himself. As they are his friends, he will assist 卡比（Kirby）, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） if needed despite this, but usually has other motivations for doing deeds and unraveling problems, which are rarely revealed in full.

Meta Knight occasionally receives his own featured volumes, where he takes the role of protagonist instead of 卡比（Kirby）. There are currently four of these volumes: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess, Kirby: Meta Knight and the Galaxy's Greatest Warrior, Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi, and Kirby: Meta Knight and the Monster of the Magic Stone.

wikirby-page:50056.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:50056.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:50056.description_zh:
Mrs. Parfaitski是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一位客串角色，并在Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!中客串出现。她是一个挑剔的美食家——尽管外表看起来——却很无知且傲慢。她搬入Dream Land，并建造了一座以甜点为主题的大宅邸，正式邀请了数十位客人来参加她的生日庆祝。然而，她在庆祝过程中被绑架，必须由卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们救出。

她的日文名字是パフェスキー (Pafesukī)，这是一个文字游戏，也可以翻译为“我喜欢百汇甜点”。这有时会导致故事中其他角色的困惑，例如瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）第一次向卡比（Kirby）提到她时，以及卡比（Kirby）错误地认为他说他“喜欢百汇”，于是问他喜欢哪种百汇。
wikirby-page:50056.description_en:
Mrs. Parfaitski is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes her guest appearance in Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!. She is a picky gourmet who—despite her outward portrayal—is ignorant and stuck-up. She moves into Dream Land and builds a large mansion heavily based on sweets, which she formally invites several dozen guests to for her birthday celebration. However, she is kidnapped during it, and must be rescued by 卡比（Kirby） and his friends.

Her name in Japanese is パフェスキー (Pafesukī), which is a play on words, as it can also be translated as "I like parfait." It causes confusion between other characters in the story sometimes, such as when 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） first tells 卡比（Kirby） about her, and 卡比（Kirby） mistakenly thinks he said he "likes parfait", and so asks him what kind of parfait he likes.

wikirby-page:48973.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48973.display_work: Kirby and the Dangerous Gourmet Mansion?!
wikirby-page:48973.description_zh: Waddle Dee，也在后续卷中称为头巾Waddle Dee，是卡比（Kirby）小说系列的四个主要角色之一，和卡比（Kirby）、帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）以及魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）并列。他居住在Castle Dedede，在那里担任帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）最忠诚的仆人。他通常在国王心情不好时遭受国王的虐待，常常被归咎于引起国王不快的事。他也是卡比（Kirby）的至交好友，令Dedede不知情。
wikirby-page:48973.description_en: Waddle Dee, also called Bandana Waddle Dee in later volumes, is one of the four primary protagonists of the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, alongside 卡比（Kirby）, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, and 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. He resides in Castle Dedede, where he serves as 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s most loyal servant. He usually ends up being the primary victim of the king's abusiveness when he is in a bad mood and is often blamed for whatever it is setting him off. He is also best friends with 卡比（Kirby）, unbeknownst to Dedede.

wikirby-page:53300.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!
wikirby-page:53300.display_work: Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!
wikirby-page:53300.description_zh:
Kerota, Keroji, and Kerolina是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中登场的客串角色，并在Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!中客串亮相。他们是一组三个青蛙状的兄妹，包括老大Kerota，他领导团队；老二Keroji，他几乎在一切事情上跟随其他人；以及最小的妹妹Kerolina，她最为冷静，但在某些情况下会表现得很粗鲁。他们主要寻找位于Dream Land神秘Gloomy Woods中传闻的魔法Stardust Fruit，并渴望成为宇宙中最令人畏惧的反派，但在了解卡比（Kirby）及其朋友后，对事情有了更好的理解。

三个名字的开头是ケロ (Kero)，这是日语青蛙叫声的拟声词，也用作对它们青蛙般外貌的双关语。
wikirby-page:53300.description_en:
Kerota, Keroji, and Kerolina are guest characters featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and make their guest appearance in Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!. They are a trio of frog-like siblings, consisting of the eldest brother Kerota, who leads the group, the middle brother Keroji, who follows the others along with most everything, and the youngest sister Kerolina, who is the most level-headed, but rude during a situation. They are primarily after the rumored magical Stardust Fruit within the mysterious Gloomy Woods in Dream Land, and seek to be the most intimidating villains in the universe, but gain a better perspective on things once getting to know 卡比（Kirby） and his friends.

The beginning of the three's name, being ケロ (Kero), is a Japanese onomatopoeia for frogs' croaking, and is used as a play on words with their frog-like appearance.

wikirby-page:53351.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!
wikirby-page:53351.display_work: Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!
wikirby-page:53351.description_zh: Woodkeeper是在卡比（Kirby）小说系列中登场的客串角色，并在Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!中客串登场。他是一个骗子，来到Dream Land称为Gloomy Woods的神秘森林，并冒充其守护者，而实际上只是为了里面神圣的“Stardust Crystal”。他设法利用帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）引导他到水晶并企图带走它。然而卡比（Kirby）等人迅速抓住了他，使事物恢复正常。
wikirby-page:53351.description_en: The Woodkeeper is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby and the Big Panic in Gloomy Woods!. He is a fraud who came to the mysterious woods in Dream Land called the Gloomy Woods, and posed as its guardian, when really only after the sacred "Stardust Crystal" within. He manages to manipulate 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） into leading him to the crystal and proceeds to attempt to escape with it. 卡比（Kirby） and co. swiftly catch him however, and return things back to normal.

wikirby-page:61411.description_zh: Acti Blade是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby Meets the Squeak Squad!中客串登场。她是一只大型鸟类，在一座古老神庙的祭坛上孵蛋。当怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）试图偷走她的蛋时，她被神庙的陷阱之一弄伤了腿。当卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）来到神庙时，Acti Blade信任他们来保护她的蛋。为了让伤势恢复，她在家乡停留了大部分时间。在Acti Blade回来时，当怪盗洛切（Daroach）透露他只想要绑在蛋上的垫子来保护蛋时，她与怪侠洛切团（Squeaks）和解。
wikirby-page:61411.description_en: Acti Blade is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes her guest appearance in Kirby Meets the Squeak Squad!. She is a large bird that nests her egg at an altar deep in an ancient temple. She injures her leg from one of the temple's traps when the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） try to steal the egg. When 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） come to the temple, Acti Blade trusts them with protecting her egg. She stays in her hometown for the majority of the story to let her injury heal. When Acti Blade returns, she reconciles with the 怪侠洛切团（Squeaks） when 怪盗洛切（Daroach） reveals that he only wanted the cushion that was tied to the egg to protect it.

wikirby-page:61470.description_zh: 巫师Wham Bam Gaia，或简称Wham Bam Gaia，是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的次要反派角色。他仅在Kirby Meets the Squeak Squad!中出现一次。Wham Bam Gaia是卡比（Kirby）等人发现的古老寺庙的主人，他睡在一个孤立的地下房间里。他很容易发脾气，这种脾气以前曾吓跑大多数来访者，因此他的寺庙才一直空无一人。在故事接近结尾时，卡比（Kirby）等人与Wham Bam Gaia意外相遇。
wikirby-page:61470.description_en: Sorcerer Wham Bam Gaia, or just Wham Bam Gaia, is a secondary antagonist featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series. He makes his only appearance in Kirby Meets the Squeak Squad!. Wham Bam Gaia is the owner of the old temple that 卡比（Kirby） and co. discover, where he sleeps in an isolated, underground room. He easily loses his temper, which had previously scared most visitors away from his temple, and is why it remains deserted. 卡比（Kirby） and co. have an unexpected encounter with Wham Bam Gaia near the end of the story.

wikirby-form:7442.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-form:7442.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-form:7442.description_zh:
“等待合适的时机，然后开火。隐藏在阴影中，成为一名神枪手！你的精准瞄准可以让你从远距离击中小目标。”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）暂停说明
狙击手（Archer）是复制能力（Copy Ability），它赋予卡比（Kirby）一把弓和箭，可以从远处精准射击敌人。这项能力首次在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中引入，可以通过吞下敌人的矢派南（Spynum）获得。与天使（Cupid）能力不同，狙击手（Archer）卡比（Kirby）可以从屏幕的一端向另一端快速射出快速、直飞的箭矢。此外，卡比（Kirby）可以仔细调整箭的角度以获得更精确的命中，也可以蓄力发射强力穿透的箭矢。投射物。其他动作包括能够在近距离用像利剑（Sword）一样的箭进行劈砍，或伪装以躲避敌人攻击。

当卡比（Kirby）获得狙击手（Archer）能力时，他会获得一顶华丽的紫色帽子，白色帽边，并在后面插着一根大大的黄色羽毛。他的弓是红色的，中间有一颗星形标志，箭头为银色，箭杆是金棕色的。自首次出现以来，狙击手（Archer）仅在主系列中出现过一次（在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中），其余出现在卡比（Kirby）Fighters系列游戏中。在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中，狙击手（Archer）是唯一能够击中Target Switches的能力，这对于解决几个谜题是必需的。
wikirby-form:7442.description_en:
“Wait for the right moment, and open fire. Hide in the shadows, and become a Sharpshooter! Your precision aiming will let you hit a small target from long distance.”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） pause caption
狙击手（Archer） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which gives 卡比（Kirby） a bow and arrow with which to sharp-shoot his foes with from a distance. The ability was first introduced in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, where it can be obtained by swallowing the enemy 矢派南（Spynum）. Unlike with the 天使（Cupid） ability, 狙击手（Archer） 卡比（Kirby） can shoot rapid-fire volleys of fast and straight-flying arrows from one end of the screen to the other. In addition, 卡比（Kirby） can carefully angle his arrows for a more precise hit, and can also charge them up to create powerful penetrating projectiles. Other moves include the ability to slash with an arrow like a 利剑（Sword） at close quarters or don camouflage to avoid enemy attacks.

When 卡比（Kirby） gains the 狙击手（Archer） ability, he obtains a fancy purple hat with a white trim and a big yellow feather sticking out the back. His bow is red with a star insignia in the center, and his arrows are silver-tipped with golden-brown shafts. Since its debut, 狙击手（Archer） has only appeared one other time in the main series (in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）), with the rest of its appearances being in the 卡比（Kirby） Fighters games. In 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, 狙击手（Archer） is the only ability able to hit Target Switches, which is required for several puzzles.

wikirby-form:7410.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-form:7410.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-form:7410.description_zh:
“A一道光芒从它的角上反射出来，当虫类之王在天空中翱翔时闪闪发光！在用角冲向敌人抓住他们后，你可以将他们猛摔到地面上！”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）暂停字幕
独角仙（Beetle）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它给卡比（Kirby）装备了一顶基于日本犀牛甲虫角和翅膀设计的头盔。与许多带有抓取敌人动作的能力不同，卡比（Kirby）在抓住敌人后仍然可以行走和跳跃，尽管步行速度更慢，跳跃高度更低。卡比（Kirby）在携带敌人时只能面对一个方向，这迫使他在向相反方向移动时倒着走，并且只能将敌人投掷到他所面向的方向。另一件关于独角仙（Beetle）的显著特点是，它拥有能够既用硬头猛击钉入桩子，又用各种穿刺攻击切断绳索，并具备悬停风羽（Wing）的能力。结合其抓取功能和爆发能力，独角仙（Beetle）是一种极其多功能的能力，可与Master相提并论，在解决许多谜题和应对敌人方面非常有效。这种能力的唯一自然提供者是敌人大角甲虫（Beetley）和中Boss盔角虫（Hornhead）。它在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中首次引入，同时引入了铜铃（Bell）、马戏团（Circus）、狙击手（Archer）和超新星（Hypernova）。随后在缺席星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）后，它又在Kirby Battle Royale和星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中回归，并在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中进行了最新亮相。
wikirby-form:7410.description_en:
“A flash of light reflects off its horn as the king of bugs soars through the sky! After charging your enemies to grab them with your horn, you can slam them into the ground!”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） pause caption
独角仙（Beetle） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that gives 卡比（Kirby） a helmet based on the horn and wings of a Japanese rhinoceros 独角仙（Beetle）. Unlike many abilities with enemy-grabbing moves, 卡比（Kirby） can still walk and jump after grabbing, albeit more slowly and less high, respectively. 卡比（Kirby） also only faces one direction when carrying enemies, forcing him to walk backwards when moving in the opposite direction, making him only able to toss the enemy in whichever direction he is facing. Another notable thing about 独角仙（Beetle） is that it has the ability to both pound down stakes with Hardhead Slam and cut ropes with the various piercing attacks and its Hover 风羽（Wing）. Combined with its grappling function and burst capabilities, 独角仙（Beetle） is an extremely versatile ability, on par with the likes of Master in its ability to solve many puzzles and deal with enemies. The ability's only natural providers are the enemy 大角甲虫（Beetley） and the mid-boss 盔角虫（Hornhead）. It was introduced in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） along with 铜铃（Bell）, 马戏团（Circus）, 狙击手（Archer）, and 超新星（Hypernova）. It later returned in Kirby Battle Royale and 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） after being absent from 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, and made its latest appearance in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）.

wikirby-form:7437.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-form:7437.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-form:7437.description_zh:
“叮咚，叮咚！这是一个金色的铜铃（Bell）。摇一摇，它会发出奇怪的声音。说到惊人的结局——快来看看叮终章！”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）美式英语暂停屏幕描述
铜铃（Bell）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），它给卡比（Kirby）配备了一顶大的铜铃（Bell）帽子，帽子前面有一个粉红色的星星，手柄上绑有蓝色丝带，还有两个额外的手铃可以作为武器使用。铜铃（Bell）的能力主要用于制造强大的破坏性声波并迅速击打敌人，但铃铛本身也可以投掷以远程造成伤害。此外，卡比（Kirby）可以躲在他的铜铃（Bell）帽子里以获得更有效的Guard，当被攻击时会反击攻击者。的铜铃（Bell）能力属于那些可以在水下使用的能力之一。铜铃（Bell）唯一的提供者是神秘的铜铃（Bell）敌人叮叮当（Ringle），它只能偶尔被发现在空中漂浮或在地面行走。

铜铃（Bell）首次亮相是在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中，与狙击手（Archer）、独角仙（Beetle）和马戏团（Circus）一起。从那以后，它没有在主系列中出现（使其成为《Triple Deluxe》中唯一具有此特点的新复制能力（Copy Ability）），但它确实在Kirby Fighters Deluxe及其续作卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中再次出现。特别是在Kirby Fighters Deluxe中，铜铃（Bell）必须通过在同一系统上拥有星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的StreetPass数据来解锁。
wikirby-form:7437.description_en:
“Ring dong, ding dong! It's a golden 铜铃（Bell）. Shake it, and a strange tone issues forth. Talk about stunning conclusions--get a load of the Ding Finale!”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） American English pause screen description
铜铃（Bell） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which gives 卡比（Kirby） a large 铜铃（Bell） hat with a pink star on the front and blue ribbon tied to the handle, with two additional handbells to use as weapons. The 铜铃（Bell） ability is primarily used to create large damaging sound waves and pounding foes in rapid succession, but the bells themselves can also be thrown to deal damage from afar. Additionally, 卡比（Kirby） can hide inside his 铜铃（Bell） hat for a more effective Guard, which will retaliate against attackers when struck. The 铜铃（Bell） ability is among those which can be used underwater. 铜铃（Bell）'s sole provider is the elusive 铜铃（Bell） enemy 叮叮当（Ringle）, who can only be occasionally found floating in the air or walking along the ground.

铜铃（Bell） made its debut appearance alongside 狙击手（Archer）, 独角仙（Beetle）, and 马戏团（Circus） in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. Since then, it has made no main-series appearances (making it the only new 复制能力（Copy Ability） introduced in Triple Deluxe to have this distinction), but it does appear again in Kirby Fighters Deluxe and its sequel 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）. In Kirby Fighters Deluxe in particular, 铜铃（Bell） has to be unlocked by having StreetPass data for 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） on the same system.

wikirby-form:7439.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-form:7439.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-form:7439.description_zh:
“这是真的吗？当然是真的吗！跳过燃烧的火圈，展示你最精彩的杂技！当帷幕在你的敌人面前落下时，他们会明白小丑艺术不是闹着玩的。”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）美式英语暂停文本
马戏团（Circus）是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），给卡比（Kirby）一个奇特的帽子，这个帽子看起来像传统的“大顶”马戏团（Circus），上面画着小丑般的面孔。它只能从Clown Acrobot获得。这个能力给卡比（Kirby）提供了多种基于马戏团（Circus）表演的武器。这些包括投掷杂耍棒、在球上保持平衡、跳蹦床、做翻筋斗、跳过燃烧的火圈（此攻击可以破坏冰块）以及制作气球动物。这些气球动物形成了许多诸如花朵、魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），甚至梦魇（Nightmare）的东西。它于星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）推出，连同独角仙（Beetle）、铜铃（Bell）、狙击手（Archer）和超新星（Hypernova），并且与狙击手（Archer）一起，于星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）回归。这种复制能力也可以通过在卡比（Kirby）《星之卡比：机器人星球》中扫描Game & Watch先生的amiibo获得。
wikirby-form:7439.description_en:
“Is this for real? You bet it is! Jump through a flaming hoop, and show off your finest Acrobatics! After the curtains close on your foes, they'll know the clown arts are no joke.”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） American English pause text
马戏团（Circus） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that gives 卡比（Kirby） an odd hat that is made to look like a traditional "big-top" 马戏团（Circus） with a clown-like face on it. It can only be obtained from the Clown Acrobot. The ability gives 卡比（Kirby） several different weapons based around 马戏团（Circus） acts. These include throwing juggling pins, balancing on a ball, jumping on a trampoline, doing somersaults, jumping through a flaming hoop (this attack can destroy ice blocks), and creating balloon animals. These balloon animals form many things such as flowers, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, and even 梦魇（Nightmare）. It was introduced in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, along with 独角仙（Beetle）, 铜铃（Bell）, 狙击手（Archer）, and 超新星（Hypernova）, and, along with 狙击手（Archer）, returned in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. This copy ability can also be obtained by scanning in a Mr. Game and Watch amiibo in 卡比（Kirby） Planet Robobot.

wikirby-form:7444.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-form:7444.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-form:7444.description_zh:
“吃下奇迹果会赋予卡比（Kirby）这种特殊能力。在能量爆发之后，卡比（Kirby）的胃会变成一个真正的黑洞，让他能够吸入巨大的物体！”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）美式英语暂停字幕
超新星（Hypernova）是一种特殊能力，每当卡比（Kirby）在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中触碰到Miracle Fruit时就会获得，这会将他的胃变成一个“真正的黑洞”，使他能够吸入并移动比以前更大的敌人和物体。这种能力在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的关卡中经常出现，并被用来解决专门的谜题，以及与专门为这种‘吸入并吐出’能力设计的中型Boss战斗，例如Mowlee Bros.、Gigant Chicks。和Winged Eggers。当卡比（Kirby）拥有超新星（Hypernova）能力时，他会发出彩虹色的光（主要是黄色和粉色），同时在常规关卡背景音乐上会播放一个特别的音乐主题。

超新星（Hypernova）不是普通的复制能力（Copy Ability），但它是一种特殊能力，类似于道具效果（如Invincible Candy或Mint Leaf）以及来自星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的Super Abilities，因为该能力是从道具获得，并且“覆盖”了卡比（Kirby）当前的复制能力（Copy Ability）。然而，与超级能力不同，超新星（Hypernova）激活前的复制能力（Copy Ability）将在超新星（Hypernova）效果结束时返回给他。此外，超新星（Hypernova）不能通过暂停并退出菜单。自从它在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）首次亮相以来，超新星（Hypernova）在其他任何卡比（Kirby）游戏中都没有作为能力出现，尽管它在某些地方被提及过。
wikirby-form:7444.description_en:
“Eating a Miracle Fruit imbues 卡比（Kirby） with this special ability. After an explosion of energy, 卡比（Kirby）'s stomach becomes a veritable black hole, allowing him to inhale giant objects!”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） American English pause caption
超新星（Hypernova） is a special ability that is granted to 卡比（Kirby） whenever he touches a Miracle Fruit in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） which turns his stomach into a "veritable black hole", allowing him to inhale and move much larger foes and objects than he could previously. This ability appears regularly throughout stages in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, and is used to solve specialized puzzles as well as battle mid-bosses catered specifically to the 'inhale and spit' dynamic of the ability, such as the Mowlee Bros., the Gigant Chicks, and the Winged Eggers. When 卡比（Kirby） has the 超新星（Hypernova） ability, he glows a rainbow color (though predominantly yellow and pink) and a special musical theme plays over the regular stage theme.

超新星（Hypernova） is not a regular 复制能力（Copy Ability）, but it is a Special Ability which is similar to an item effect (such as Invincible Candy or Mint Leaf) and the Super Abilities from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, since the ability is acquired from an item and "overrides" 卡比（Kirby）'s current 复制能力（Copy Ability）. Unlike the Super Abilities, however, 卡比（Kirby）'s 复制能力（Copy Ability） before activating 超新星（Hypernova） will be returned to him at the end of the stage when 超新星（Hypernova） wears off. Additionally, 超新星（Hypernova） cannot be taken out of the stage it appears in by pausing and exiting from the menu. Since its debut in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, 超新星（Hypernova） has not appeared as an ability in any other 卡比（Kirby） game, though it has been referenced here and there.

wikirby-page:10480.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10480.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10480.description_zh: People of the Sky是原生于Floralia王国的花朵状生物。它们首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe），并且其中一个以贴纸的形式出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）。
wikirby-page:10480.description_en: The People of the Sky are the flower-like beings native to the Kingdom of Floralia. They debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, and one appears as a sticker in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）.

wikirby-page:8008.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:8008.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:8008.description_zh:
“好了，来自下界的英雄。你愿意为这片土地冒生命危险吗？你敢反抗我——天界的统治者吗？很好……你将会在伟大的女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）面前屈服！我的美丽可与神明媲美……而我的力量将粉碎你所珍视的一切！”
— 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）是一个痴迷美丽的昆虫型君主和魔法师，也是星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的主要反派，她首次以各种形态在该游戏的最终Boss中登场。女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）是一个渴望权力且半疯的暴君，他在凝视某面镜子过久后企图征服整个Floralia。她首次在游戏中出现是在卡比（Kirby）击败了塔狼蛛（Taranza）（她是女王忠诚的仆人）以及面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）之后，谁塔狼蛛（Taranza）一直在操纵傀儡。在她在战斗中被击败后，她与Dreamstalk结合进入第二阶段。在The True Arena中，这一形态被Soul of Sectonia取代，后者有一个额外阶段。

虽然仅在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中正式登场，女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）在之后的多款卡比（Kirby）游戏中有多次客串出现，但由于她被认为已经死亡，没有一次是其实体出现。
wikirby-page:8008.description_en:
“Now then, hero of the lower world. You would risk your life for this land? You would stand against me, the ruler of the heavens? Very well... You will bow before the great 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）! My beauty rivals the divine... And my power will crush all that you hold dear!”
— 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） is a beauty-obsessed insectoid monarch and magician, and the primary antagonist of 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, making her debut as the final boss of that game in various forms. 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） is a power-hungry and half-crazed tyrant who sought to subjugate all of Floralia after gazing for too long into a certain mirror. She first appears in-game after 卡比（Kirby） beats 塔狼蛛（Taranza）, who was the queen's loyal servant, and 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）, who 塔狼蛛（Taranza） had been puppeteering. After she is defeated in battle, she combines with the Dreamstalk for her second phase. In The True Arena, this form is replaced with Soul of Sectonia, who has an additional phase.

Though only making a proper appearance in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） has made multiple cameo appearances in later 卡比（Kirby） games, though due to her presumed death, none have her physically appear.

wikirby-page:7375.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7375.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7375.description_zh:
“想到你已经走到这一步。你不是一个坚持的小东西吗？”
— 塔狼蛛（Taranza）在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
塔狼蛛（Taranza）中是一个年轻、笨拙、具有蜘蛛类特征的巫师，他在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的一些游戏中担任重要角色。他首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe），当时根据女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）的命令，他绑架了帝帝帝大王（King Dedede），以阻止他破坏他们征服Floralia的计划。然而，最终他意识到自己抓错了目标，因为卡比（Kirby）会一路追到女王的寝宫，并在战斗中击败他们。塔狼蛛（Taranza）后来会被女王背叛，并最终来到卡比（Kirby）和帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的身边，协助他们消灭融入Dreamstalk。从那时起，他将成为卡比（Kirby）和帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的盟友。

自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）以来，塔狼蛛（Taranza）在后续的游戏中有过各种出现。在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe中，他作为主要反派之一登场，并且在系列中首次直接对战（他在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中也作为次要剧情元素出现）。就在这里，他获得了“操纵师魔术师”的绰号。塔狼蛛（Taranza）将在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中首次作为Dream Friend可玩角色出现，并且也在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中作为可玩骑手登场，尽管他在两款游戏的剧情中都没有具体角色。他还在其他各种游戏中有过小范围的出现。
wikirby-page:7375.description_en:
“To think that you've made it this far. Aren't you a persistent little thing?”
— 塔狼蛛（Taranza） in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
塔狼蛛（Taranza） is a young, clumsy wizard with arachnid-like characteristics who serves as a prominent character in a few games in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He first appeared in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） when, on orders from 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）, he kidnapped 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in order to prevent him from foiling their plans to conquer Floralia. In the end, however, he realized he had captured the wrong target, as 卡比（Kirby） would pursue him all the way to the queen's chambers and defeat them in combat. 塔狼蛛（Taranza） would later be betrayed by his queen, and eventually come to 卡比（Kirby） and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s aid in dispatching her after she had merged with the Dreamstalk. From then on, he would be an ally to 卡比（Kirby） and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）.

Since 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, 塔狼蛛（Taranza） has made various appearances in subsequent games. In Team Kirby Clash Deluxe, he serves as one of the principal villains, and is battled directly for the first time in the series (he also serves as a more minor plot element in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）). This is where he gained the moniker of The Puppeteer Magician. 塔狼蛛（Taranza） would become playable for the first time as a Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, and also appears as a playable rider in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, though he does not serve a specific role in either game's story. He has also made minor appearances in various other games.

wikirby-page:10542.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10542.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10542.description_zh:
鹿角（也称为虫子）是首次在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中登场的召唤敌人，仅在与女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）的战斗中出现。它们有四种不同大小，每种大小比之前更强，并且吸入时间更长。

每一个Antler，无论类型如何，都类似于装饰华丽的拟人化蚂蚁战士，手持魔法权杖和盾牌。然而，它们的盾牌主要是装饰性的，因为无法保护它们免受投射物伤害。它们缓慢接近目标，然后将狼牙棒挥向地面进行攻击。

它们的名字是“ant”（敌人的外形）和“Antler”（鹿或驼鹿的分叉角）这两个词的双关语。
wikirby-page:10542.description_en:
Antlers (also referred to as Bugs) are summoned enemies that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） which appear only during the fights with 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）. They come in four different sizes, with each size being tougher and taking longer to inhale than before.

Each Antler, regardless of type, resembles a lavishly decorated anthropomorphic ant soldier with a magic scepter and a shield. Their shield is largely cosmetic, however, as it will not protect them from projectiles. They slowly approach their target, then swing their mace into the ground to attack.

Their names are a pun on both the word "ant" (what the enemy resembles) and "Antler" (the branching horns of a deer or moose).

wikirby-page:7872.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7872.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7872.description_zh:
大角甲虫（Beetley）是一种圆形生物，有两只小脚和类似甲虫的外壳，首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中。当被卡比（Kirby）吞下时，他会赋予独角仙（Beetle）能力。

在很多方面，大角甲虫（Beetley）看起来与飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）相似，但他有不同的配色方案，眼睛更深凹，头上有甲虫的冠饰。尽管有翅膀，大角甲虫（Beetley）通常不飞行，而是选择沿地面移动并尝试刺击入侵者。他还可以通过原地旋转来向上推进自己，然后落下进行攻击。尽管有外壳，大角甲虫（Beetley）也不是世界上最强的敌人。
wikirby-page:7872.description_en:
大角甲虫（Beetley） is a round creature with two small feet and a beetle-like carapace that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. He grants the 独角仙（Beetle） ability when swallowed by 卡比（Kirby）.

In many ways, 大角甲虫（Beetley） looks similar to 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）, but he bears a different color scheme, has more indented eyes, and a beetle's crest on his head. Despite having wings, 大角甲虫（Beetley） does not typically fly, instead choosing to pace along the ground and try to stab intruders. He can also attack by spinning in place to propel himself upwards before falling down. 大角甲虫（Beetley）, despite his carapace, is not the toughest enemy in the world.

wikirby-page:7908.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7908.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7908.description_zh:
Big Missile是出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中的敌人，在Lollipop Land的第二关中占有重要位置。它只能用超新星（Hypernova）能力击败。

Big Missile是一个涂有鲨鱼脸的巨大导弹，使它类似于马里奥游戏中的Bullet Bill。它不能被超新星（Hypernova）吞下，但可以被吸入然后再吐出来。要击败Big Missile，卡比（Kirby）必须将导弹吐回发射器以摧毁它。

除了出现在Lollipop Land的第二关中，Big Missile还出现在基于它的Royal Road第三关的区域中。
wikirby-page:7908.description_en:
Big Missile is an enemy that appears in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, featuring prominently in the second stage of Lollipop Land. It can only be defeated with the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

Big Missile is a giant missile with a shark-like face painted on it, making it similar to a Bullet Bill from the Mario games. It can't be swallowed with 超新星（Hypernova）, but it can be sucked in and spat back out again. To defeat Big Missile, 卡比（Kirby） must spit the missile out at its launcher to destroy it.

Along with its appearance in Lollipop Land's second stage, Big Missile features in the area based on it in Royal Road's third stage.

wikirby-page:24990.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:24990.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:24990.description_zh:
Burner Guardian是一个巨大的金色蛇雕像，在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中作为舞台障碍。它可以在Wild World的第4关和EX关找到。Burner Guardian是无实体的，无法与之互动。

Burner Guardian位于它出现的区域的前景和背景之间的空间中，并不断旋转以面对卡比（Kirby），跟踪其移动。它会定期从嘴里向卡比（Kirby）的最后位置发射火球，每次攻击之间等待三秒。火焰守护者经常成排出现，使穿越它们栖息的区域非常危险。
wikirby-page:24990.description_en:
Burner Guardian is a massive golden snake statue which serves as a stage hazard in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It can be found in Stage 4 and Stage EX of Wild World. Burner Guardian is intangible, and cannot be interacted with.

Burner Guardian resides in the space between the foreground and background in the areas where it appears, and continuously pivots to face 卡比（Kirby）, tracking him as it moves. It regularly shoots fireballs from its mouth toward 卡比（Kirby）'s last position, waiting three seconds between each volley. Burner Guardians often appear in rows together, making traversal through the areas they inhabit very dangerous.

wikirby-page:7885.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7885.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7885.description_zh:
Cannon tower是一种敌人，首次在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中登场，在Fine Fields关卡中首次遭遇。它只能被超新星（Hypernova）技能击败。

Cannon tower由一个旋转的砖块炮组成，它发射导弹，然后旋转一周再尝试再次发射。它的背面有一个弱点，如果击中，它将会破碎。卡比（Kirby）需要吸入它发射的导弹，然后用同一枚导弹击中其弱点。

Cannon tower也可能成堆出现，这些堆通常会锁住顶部的门。在这种情况下，塔的最后一堆通常会有一个惊喜攻击，包括射出一根长刺棒，然后旋转it.

 Cannon tower出现在Fine Fields - Stage 3和Royal Road - Stage 3。
wikirby-page:7885.description_en:
The Cannon tower is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, first encountered in the Fine Fields level. It can only be defeated with the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

The Cannon tower consists of a rotating brickwork cannon, which fires a missile, then turns around before attempting to fire again. It has a weak point on its backside which, if hit, will cause it to shatter. 卡比（Kirby） needs to inhale the missile it shoots, then hit it on its weak point with the same missile.

The Cannon tower may also come in stacks, which usually keep a doorway locked up top. In such instances, the last stack of the tower will usually have a surprise attack, which consists of shooting out a long spiky bar, then spinning around with it.

The Cannon tower appears in Fine Fields - Stage 3 and Royal Road - Stage 3.

wikirby-page:7877.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7877.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7877.description_zh:
Clown Acrobot是一个在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）首次亮相的敌人。当被吞下时，它会产生马戏团（Circus）能力。

Clown Acrobot看起来像小丑，只是它的脚部是像陀螺一样旋转的底座。它用呼啦圈或杂耍球在地上弹跳，除了射程惊人之外，并不十分危险。Clown Acrobot目前是唯一能够产生马戏团（Circus）能力的敌人。

“Acrobot”一词来源于“acrobat”（杂技演员）和“robot”（机器人）的组合。
wikirby-page:7877.description_en:
Clown Acrobot is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It yields the 马戏团（Circus） ability when swallowed.

Clown Acrobot resembles a clown, except it has a spinning top-like bottom where its feet would be. It bounces along the ground with either a hula hoop or juggling balls, and apart from its surprising range, is not all that dangerous. Clown Acrobot is currently the only enemy to yield the 马戏团（Circus） ability.

The “Acrobot” part of their name is a portmanteau of “acrobat” and “robot”.

wikirby-page:24971.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:24971.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:24971.description_zh:
Ghost Book是一本由看不见的力量操控的敌对飞行书，它可以在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的Wild World - Stage 3的单一区域和Royal Road - Stage 3的分支路径中找到。它只会出现在卡比（Kirby）拥有超新星（Hypernova）能力的区域。

Ghost Book看起来像一本棕色皮革封面的古籍。当它移动时，会像鸟一样扑动，并且书页会掉落，但没有实际影响。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，Ghost Book会向他逼近并试图通过碰撞伤害他。Ghost Book可以轻松被超新星（Hypernova）打败，但也可以通过更简单的方式打败，例如Air Bullet或Slide攻击。由于它只出现在具备超新星（Hypernova）能力的区域，因此尚不清楚这个敌人是否是能力中立的.
wikirby-page:24971.description_en:
Ghost Book is a hostile flying book possessed by an unseen force which can be found in a single area of Wild World - Stage 3 and a branching path in Royal Road - Stage 3 in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It only appears in areas where 卡比（Kirby） has the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

Ghost Book resembles an old tome with a brown leather cover. When moving, it flaps like a bird and pages fall out of it with no real consequence. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, Ghost Book will close in on him and try to hurt him by collision. Ghost Book is easily defeated using 超新星（Hypernova）, but it can also be defeated by more modest means, such as an Air Bullet or Slide attack. Due to only appearing in areas featuring the 超新星（Hypernova） ability, it is not known whether or not this enemy is ability-neutral.

wikirby-page:24972.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:24972.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:24972.description_zh:
Ghost Dish是一种敌对飞行盘，由看不见的力量操控，可以在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的Wild World - Stage 3的单一区域和Royal Road - Stage 3的分支路径中找到。它只会出现在卡比（Kirby）拥有超新星（Hypernova）能力的区域。

Ghost Dish是一个悬浮的餐盘，表面有明显的磨损，包括裂纹和缺口。它在空中原地旋转，类似于流行文化中的U.F.O.。当卡比（Kirby）接近时，Ghost Dish会靠近他并试图通过碰撞伤害他。Ghost Dish使用超新星（Hypernova）容易被击败，但也可以通过更简单的方法击败，例如Air Bullet或Slide。
wikirby-page:24972.description_en:
Ghost Dish is a hostile flying plate possessed by an unseen force which can be found in a single area of Wild World - Stage 3 and a branching path in Royal Road - Stage 3 in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It only appears in areas where 卡比（Kirby） has the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

Ghost Dish is a hovering dinner plate with noticeable wear and tear, featuring cracks and chips on its surface. It spins around in place in the air, similar to a U.F.O. in popular culture. When 卡比（Kirby） approaches, Ghost Dish will close in on him and try to hurt him by collision. Ghost Dish is easily defeated using 超新星（Hypernova）, but it can also be defeated by more modest means, such as an Air Bullet or Slide.

wikirby-page:24973.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:24973.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:24973.description_zh: 幽灵黑刺球（Ghost Gordo）是黑刺球（Gordo）的一种苍白幽灵变体，首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe），作为一种次要危害，它拥有一个大眼睛而不是两个小眼睛。它通常出现在幽暗的鬼区域。后来，它在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中有了更重要的出现，并获得了一套新的行为。
wikirby-page:24973.description_en: 幽灵黑刺球（Ghost Gordo） is a pale ghostly variant of 黑刺球（Gordo） that first appeared in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） as a minor hazard, which has one large eye rather than two smaller ones. It is typically found in dark haunted regions. It has since made a more substantial appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, where it gained a new set of behaviors.

wikirby-page:7875.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7875.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7875.description_zh:
Grandy是一种大型的类似瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的敌人，首次亮相于星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）。如果吞下它不会得到复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Grandy实际上是一个大型瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），功能类似于前作中的Big Waddle Dee，只是在其身体上增加了羊毛。它的攻击模式与瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）完全相同，但拥有更高的生命值，需要时间吸入。
wikirby-page:7875.description_en:
Grandy is a large 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）-like enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Grandy is effectively a large 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, and has a similar function to Big Waddle Dee from previous games, just with the addition of wool on its body. Its attack patterns are exactly the same as a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s, though it has much higher HP and takes time to inhale.

wikirby-page:10518.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10518.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10518.description_zh:
Land Barbar，也被称为游戏文件中的管道Barbar，是首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的敌人，第一次遭遇在Endless Explosions - Stage 2。它只能被超新星（Hypernova）技能击败。Land Barbar仅在Royal Road - Stage 8 EX中出现过一次。

Land Barbar类似于基本的Barbar，但（由其名称暗示）它生活在陆地上，占据前景和背景之间旋转的大管道。它呈现出醒目的品红色，并且舌头上有一颗蓝色的星星。

当卡比（Kirby）拥有超新星（Hypernova）技能时，他可以通过吸入在Barbar尝试咬合后伸出舌头时将Land Barbar整个吞下。卡比（Kirby）需要与Barbar要做到这一点，因为他需要在吞下它之前与生物的舌头进行短暂的拔河。Barbar消失后，卡比（Kirby）可以使用它的管道旅行。
wikirby-page:10518.description_en:
Land Barbar , also known as Pipe Barbar in the game files, is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, first encountered in Endless Explosions - Stage 2. It can only be defeated with the 超新星（Hypernova） ability. Land Barbar makes only one other appearance, in Royal Road - Stage 8 EX.

Land Barbar resembles a basic Barbar, but (implied by its name) it lives on land, occupying large pipes that swivel between the foreground and background. It bears a striking magenta coloration, and has a blue star on its tongue.

When 卡比（Kirby） has the 超新星（Hypernova） ability, he can swallow the Land Barbar whole by inhaling when the Barbar's tongue is sticking out after an attempted chomp. 卡比（Kirby） needs to be on the same level as the Barbar to do this, as he will need to engage in a brief tug-o-war with the creature's tongue before he can swallow it. After the Barbar is gone, 卡比（Kirby） can use its pipe to travel.

wikirby-page:12805.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:12805.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:12805.description_zh:
Lollipop Tank是出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中的敌人。它是一种大型滚动车辆，由瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）驾驶——通常出现在背景中——在前景中持续向卡比（Kirby）或帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）发射齐射，同时它能够保持移动。它无法直接被伤害，但可以通过将其掉入无底坑中来摧毁。Lollipop Tank能够通过碾过或者射击来破坏石块和金属块。当卡比（Kirby）穿越棒棒糖乐园的第一关时，棒棒糖坦克首次出现。

在Royal Road中出现的一种变体称为Sectra坦克，由两个Sectra Dee驾驶，并发射带刺的炮弹。Sectra坦克能够连续快速射击几发。由于它们位于背景中，Sectra坦克无法被正常摧毁，但卡比（Kirby）可以将它们送入无底深渊。第三阶段，卡比（Kirby）可以使用超新星（Hypernova）能力吞下其中一个，显示目标门。
wikirby-page:12805.description_en:
Lollipop Tank is an enemy which appears in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It is a large rolling vehicle which is piloted by a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） - usually found in the background - which continually fires volleys at 卡比（Kirby） or 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in the foreground while it can keep up. It cannot be harmed directly, but it can be destroyed by dropping it into a bottomless pit. The Lollipop Tank is capable of breaking stone and metal blocks by driving over them or by firing at them. Lollipop Tanks make their first appearance when 卡比（Kirby） traverses the first stage of Lollipop Land.

There is a variety found in Royal Road referred to as Sectra Tank , which is piloted by two Sectra Dees and fires spiked cannonballs. The Sectra Tank is capable of firing several rounds in rapid succession. Due to their location in the background, Sectra Tanks cannot be destroyed normally, but 卡比（Kirby） can send them falling to their doom in a bottomless pit. In the third stage, 卡比（Kirby） can use the 超新星（Hypernova） ability to swallow one, revealing the goal door.

wikirby-page:24957.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:24957.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:24957.description_zh:
Lumberjack Waddle Dee（在游戏文件中称为樵夫瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee））是一个敌人和关卡障碍物，首次出现在游戏星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中。他们是戴着绿色帽子、拿着斧头的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他们的唯一任务是在背景中砍伐大树，这些树会在卡比（Kirby）接近时定时倒下。树倒下后，它不会重新出现，樵夫只会挥动手臂和斧头。当树倒下时，它能够破坏重石块和金属块。

虽然瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）本身可能是无敌的，也可能不是，但它总是出现在卡比（Kirby）自己无法到达的区域。

Lumberjack Waddle Dee只出现在Fine Fields的6 EX和Royal Road的7 EX关卡中。
wikirby-page:24957.description_en:
Lumberjack Waddle Dee (referred to in the game files as Woodcutter 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）) is an enemy and stage hazard that debuted in the game 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. They are 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s who wear green hats and carry axes, and their only job is to cut down large trees in the background which are timed to fall when 卡比（Kirby） draws near. After the tree falls, it will not reappear, leaving the lumberjack to simply wave its arms and axe. When the tree falls, it is capable of breaking heavy stone and metal blocks.

While the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） itself may or may not be invulnerable, it is always found in an area where 卡比（Kirby） himself cannot reach.

Lumberjack Waddle Dee only appears in stages 6 EX of Fine Fields, and 7 EX of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:7900.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7900.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
