wikirby-page:7900.description_zh: 蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee），也称为Mamanti，是一个大型水生敌人，首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中，是蛙镜鱼（Blipper）的更大版本，但拥有蝠鲼的鳍。它在清水（Water）中缓慢而优雅地移动，经常在前景和背景之间做慵懒的循环。然而，它经常试图在卡比（Kirby）跃出水面，然后在陆地上无助地扑腾，就像蛙镜鱼（Blipper）一样。蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee）有相当高的生命值，因此需要几次攻击才能消灭。基本上，它在水中的作用与Grandy在陆地上的作用相同。
wikirby-page:7900.description_en: 蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee）, also referred to as Mamanti, is a large aquatic enemy who first appears in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） and serves as a bigger analogue to 蛙镜鱼（Blipper）, but with the fins of a manta ray. It moves slowly and gracefully through the 清水（Water）, often seen performing lazy loops between the foreground and background. It will however often attempt to jump out of the water at 卡比（Kirby）, where it will then flop about helplessly on land, just like a 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） would. 蛙镜魟鱼（Mamatee） has a fairly high amount of health, and as such takes a few hits to take out. Essentially, it serves the same role in the water as Grandy does on land.

wikirby-page:10487.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10487.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10487.description_zh:
Pacflower是一个首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的悬浮敌人，它会出现在Wild World关卡中。它在形态和功能上与帕克特（Pacto）基本相同，但它看起来像一朵丛林花。吸入它不会获得复制能力（Copy Ability）.

像Pacloud一样，Pacflowers是一种略微更耐久的帕克特（Pacto），并且在冒险过程中比它们的老表兄弟出现得晚。敌人的花状外观也在一定程度上帮助它融入丛林环境。
wikirby-page:10487.description_en:
Pacflower is a hovering enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） which appears in the Wild World stage. It is essentially identical to a 帕克特（Pacto） in both form and function, but it resembles a jungle flower. Inhaling it grants no 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Like Paclouds, Pacflowers serve as a slightly more durable form of 帕克特（Pacto）, and are encountered later in the adventure than their older cousin. The enemy's flower-like appearance also somewhat helps it blend in with its jungle surroundings.

wikirby-page:7904.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7904.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7904.description_zh: 漂浮洛巴（Phanta）是一种幽灵飞行敌人，首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）。它看起来像一个戴着红色骷髅面具的白色床单鬼，面部保持永久悲伤的表情，眼睛发出黄色光芒。它通常通过突然出现然后漂向卡比（Kirby）来攻击，类似于芒比尸（Mumbies），不过漂浮洛巴（Phanta）在被看见时不会退缩。如果受到攻击，它可能会消失并在其他地方重新出现。漂浮洛巴（Phanta）可以用任何普通攻击击败，并且被吸入时不会给予复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7904.description_en: 漂浮洛巴（Phanta） is a ghostly flying enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It resembles a white sheet ghost with a red skull-shaped mask, bearing a permanent sorrowful expression with glowing yellow eyes. It typically attacks by appearing out of nowhere and then drifting towards 卡比（Kirby）, similar to 芒比尸（Mumbies）, though 漂浮洛巴（Phanta） will not recoil if looked at. If attacked, it may vanish and reappear elsewhere. 漂浮洛巴（Phanta） can be defeated with any regular attack, and grants no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled.

wikirby-page:7883.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7883.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7883.description_zh:
Pipe Worm是在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）首次登场的敌人，首次遇到它是在Fine Fields关卡。它只能用超新星（Hypernova）技能击败。

Pipe Worm看起来像一只橙色毛毛虫，但脸部略带龙的特征。它总是躲在空心树干里，如果卡比（Kirby）接近，它会尝试咬他。Pipe Worm会定期交换头部和尾部的位置。只有当它的蓝色星状尾巴伸出来时，卡比（Kirby）才能吸入这个怪物并击败它。之后，卡比（Kirby）可以使用它的管道进入区域的不同部分。

Pipe Worm只出现在Fine Fields的第3关和Royal Road的第3关。
wikirby-page:7883.description_en:
Pipe Worm is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, first encountered in the Fine Fields level. It can only be defeated with the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

Pipe Worm resembles an orange caterpillar, but with a vaguely dragon-like face. It always hides in hollow logs, and will attempt to bite 卡比（Kirby） if he ventures too close in. Pipe Worm will periodically switch out its head and tail positions. Only when its blue star-tipped tail is sticking out can 卡比（Kirby） inhale the beast and defeat it. From there, 卡比（Kirby） can use its pipe to access different parts of the area.

Pipe Worm is only found in stage 3 of Fine Fields and stage 3 of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:7870.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7870.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7870.description_zh:
叮叮当（Ringle）是一个首次出现在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中的敌人。它是一个小型黑色生物，有红色的脚、蓝色的眼睛，头上戴着一个大的金色铃铛。在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中，它是唯一一个当被卡比（Kirby）吸入时会掉落铜铃（Bell）复制能力（Copy Ability）的敌人。

它只是简单地在地面上走动，但也能够悬浮在空中。如果卡比（Kirby）或帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）接近它，它会摇响铃铛，传出的声波如果太靠近它们会对它们造成伤害。叮叮当（Ringle）只有少量HP。
wikirby-page:7870.description_en:
叮叮当（Ringle） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It is a small black creature with red feet, blue eyes, and a large golden bell on its head. It is the only enemy in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series） that yields the 铜铃（Bell） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled by 卡比（Kirby）.

It simply walks around on the ground, but it is also capable of hovering in the air. If 卡比（Kirby） or 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） get close to it, it tolls its bell, and the sound waves that come off of it can harm them if they get too close. 叮叮当（Ringle） only has a mild amount of HP.

wikirby-page:11936.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:11936.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:11936.description_zh:
A Sectra Dee是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的敌人。它们几乎与瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）相同，但具有独特的昆虫外观，并为女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）服务。Sectra Dees是绿色的，眼睛呈红棕色。它们仅在Royal Road、独眼云（Kracko）DX的战斗中出现（在其敌人掉落动作中可能被掉落），以及Kirby's Blowout Blast的EX关卡中出现。

与标准Waddle Dees一样，Sectra Dees可以被看到使用Parasol，驾驶Lollipop Tank，或仅在卡比（Kirby）的Blowout Blast中使用矛。Sectra Tanks在行为和设计上类似于Lollipop Tanks，但具有更军事化的配色方案。
wikirby-page:11936.description_en:
A Sectra Dee is an enemy from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. They are practically identical to 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s, but bear a unique insectoid look and serve 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）. Sectra Dees are green and their eyes are reddish-brown. They are found only in Royal Road, 独眼云（Kracko） DX's battle (where they may be dropped in his enemy drop move), and in the EX Stages in Kirby's Blowout Blast.

Like standard Waddle Dees, Sectra Dees can be seen wielding Parasol, driving Lollipop Tank, or using spears in 卡比（Kirby）'s Blowout Blast only. Sectra Tanks bear a resemblance to Lollipop Tanks in their behavior and design, but have a more militaristic scheme.

wikirby-page:7902.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7902.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7902.description_zh: 恐怖踏步怪（Spookstep）是一个在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中首次出现的幽灵敌人。它看起来有点像瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的幽灵版本，但它的脸更恐怖，只有一只眼睛，嘴巴大张，头顶有一个肿块。它追逐卡比（Kirby）时会以典型怪物的方式举起双臂。如果被吸入，它不会产生任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:7902.description_en: 恐怖踏步怪（Spookstep） is a ghostly enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It looks somewhat like a ghostly version of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, but it has a much creepier face with only one eye, a gaping mouth and a lump on the top of its head. It raises its arms up in a stereotypical monster manner when it runs after 卡比（Kirby）. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled.

wikirby-page:25013.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:25013.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:25013.description_zh: A弹力手（Springy Hand）是一种来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的无敌舞台危险物，由一个连接在长弹簧上的右手形状板组成。它会持续弹出，然后以固定间隔缩回。如果卡比（Kirby）站在弹力手（Springy Hand）弹出时的前方，他将被弹向第四面墙并撞上墙壁，同时受到伤害。弹簧手通常成群出现，以固定的模式激活。与弹出时不同，卡比（Kirby）在手缩回时不会受到影响，这意味着在手弹出后立即通过是安全的。
wikirby-page:25013.description_en: A 弹力手（Springy Hand） is an invulnerable stage hazard originating from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, consisting of a right hand-shaped plate attached to a long spring. It continuously springs out, then back in on a regular interval. If 卡比（Kirby） is standing in front of a 弹力手（Springy Hand） when it extends, he will be launched into the fourth wall and splat against it, taking damage in the process. Springy Hands are often found in groups, where they activate in a fixed pattern. Unlike when it has extended, 卡比（Kirby） will be unaffected by the hand while it retracts, meaning that it is safe for him to cross right after the hand has extended.

wikirby-page:7879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7879.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7879.description_zh: 矢派南（Spynum）是在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中首次亮相的敌人。吞下它后会获得狙击手（Archer）能力，到目前为止，它是唯一可以给予该能力的敌人。矢派南（Spynum）是一个蓝色的、模糊类人的身影，戴着红色羽毛帽和紫色披风。它持有一把弓，可以用相当准确的方式向入侵者射击，不论是在屏幕的远处还是背景或前景。它的HP很低，因此如果卡比（Kirby）设法接近，矢派南（Spynum）并没有太多防御手段，因为它的射击速度相当慢。
wikirby-page:7879.description_en: 矢派南（Spynum） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It yields the 狙击手（Archer） ability when swallowed, and so far is the only enemy who yields this ability. 矢派南（Spynum） is a blue vaguely humanoid figure who wears a red feather cap and purple cloak. It wields a bow, which it can use with decent accuracy to fire at intruders, from across the screen as well as from the background or foreground. It has low HP, so if 卡比（Kirby） manages to get up close, 矢派南（Spynum） does not have much in the means of defense, since its firing speed is rather slow.

wikirby-page:11948.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:11948.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:11948.description_zh:
Toughness Waddle Dee是一种特定的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），只在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）和星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的Copy Ability Room中出现。它以钢铁外壳和闪亮的面部与身体区别于它的普通同类。Toughness Waddle Dee可以被攻击和击打，但无法被击败或吸入（与沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）不同）。它也无法伤害卡比（Kirby），尽管如果两者碰撞，会导致他被击退。

Toughness Waddle Dee不会移动，即使被击打也选择原地站立。它似乎不会被卡比（Kirby）的任何攻击伤害，尽管更强的攻击会使它飞得更远。
wikirby-page:11948.description_en:
Toughness Waddle Dee is a specific 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） encountered only in the Copy Ability Rooms of 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） and 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is distinguished from its normal cousins by its steel skin and gleaming face and body. Toughness Waddle Dee can be attacked and knocked around, but it cannot be defeated or inhaled (unlike 沙袋先生（Mr. Sandbag）). It also cannot hurt 卡比（Kirby）, though it will cause him to be knocked back if the two collide.

Toughness Waddle Dee does not move, and simply elects to stand in place, even after being knocked around. It doesn't appear to be hurt by any of 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks, though stronger attacks will send it flying further.

wikirby-page:7940.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7940.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7940.description_zh: Waddle Dee Train是一个在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）首次登场的危险敌人，首次遭遇是在Old Odyssey关卡。它只能被超新星（Hypernova）能力击败。
wikirby-page:7940.description_en: Waddle Dee Train is a hazard enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, first encountered in the Old Odyssey level. It can only be defeated with the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

wikirby-page:10504.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10504.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10504.description_zh: Ace Phanta是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的一个不常见的胡子戴帽鬼魂敌人，主要出现在Wild World - Stage 3。它有附身于鬼屋中无生命物体的习惯，可以使用超新星（Hypernova）能力与其战斗。顾名思义，它是漂浮洛巴（Phanta）的大型版本。
wikirby-page:10504.description_en: Ace Phanta is an infrequent bearded hat-wearing ghost enemy from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, which is found primarily in Wild World - Stage 3. It has a habit of possessing inanimate objects in the haunted mansion, and can be fought using the 超新星（Hypernova） ability. As its name suggests, it is a larger version of 漂浮洛巴（Phanta）.

wikirby-page:7847.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7847.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7847.description_zh:
“出生于岩浆之中，成长在火山里，它会喷射火球只是为了说“嗨！”离它远点，否则你会被烧伤！”
— 来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的更强挑战风格文本
火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros）是一个大型Galbo式敌人，曾零sporadically出现在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中。火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros）从本质上来说是出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的中级Boss清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros）的火焰版本。除了喷火，它的攻击方式基本相同，包括身体重击和冲刺。击败并吞噬它会获得卡比（Kirby）的烈火（Fire）能力。
wikirby-page:7847.description_en:
“Born from magma and raised in a volcano, it vomits fireballs just to say "hi!" Stay away or you'll get burned!”
— Tougher Quest flavor text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros） is a large Galbo-like enemy which has appeared sparsely throughout the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. 火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros） is essentially a fire version of the mid-boss 清水加尔波洛斯（Water Galboros） that appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. Apart from shooting fire, its attacks are fundamentally similar, which include body slams and dashes. Defeating and swallowing it yields 卡比（Kirby） the 烈火（Fire） ability.

wikirby-page:7946.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7946.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7946.description_zh:
Gigant Chicks是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的中型Boss。它们使用超新星（Hypernova）技能进行战斗。

这些小鸟每个看起来都像一个巨大的球形鸟，带有宽大的翅膀和豌豆形的黄色眼睛。每只颜色不同，并且系有一定颜色的领结。它们通过飞行并发射Air Bullet（类似风语大树（Whispy Woods）或Flowery Woods使用的）来攻击。要击败它们，卡比（Kirby）必须用从竞技场中心生长出来的曼陀罗根击中它们，通过他的超新星（Hypernova）技能吸入它们。小鸟们会一次一只地进行战斗，顺序由下表指定。
wikirby-page:7946.description_en:
The Gigant Chicks are mid-bosses from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. They are fought using the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

The chicks each resemble a large spherical bird with wide wings and pea-shaped yellow eyes. Each one is of a different color and bears a bowtie of a certain color. They attack by flying around and firing Air Bullets (similar to the ones used by 风语大树（Whispy Woods） or Flowery Woods). To defeat them, 卡比（Kirby） must hit them with the Mandola Roots that grow out of the center of the arena by inhaling them with his 超新星（Hypernova） ability. The chicks battle one at a time, the order of which is specified in the table below.

wikirby-page:7405.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7405.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7405.description_zh:
“盔角虫（Hornhead），当地森林的一个友好居民，长大后开始在海滨肆虐！为什么？”
— 来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
盔角虫（Hornhead）的盔角虫（Hornhead）派对任务说明是一只中型首领独角仙，拥有靛蓝色的外壳，四条腿，腿上的杯状脚在后腿更大，脸部有一根巨大的角，另外还有两根较小的角，镶嵌着两只棕色眼睛。作为昆虫，它有翅膀，可以飞，但它大部分时间倾向于停留在地面，并会试图用角撞击卡比（Kirby）或抓住他。盔角虫（Hornhead）在被吸入时会赋予独角仙（Beetle）复制能力（Copy Ability）的效果。
wikirby-page:7405.description_en:
“盔角虫（Hornhead）, a friendly resident of the local forest, grew up big and started wreaking havoc on the Seaside! Why?”
— Party Quest caption for 盔角虫（Hornhead） from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
盔角虫（Hornhead） is a giant rhinoceros beetle mid-boss with an indigo carapace, four legs with cup-like feet that are larger on the hind legs, and a massive horn for a face, along with two smaller horns above, with two brown eyes inset. Being an insect, he has wings and can fly, but he tends to stay on the ground most of the time, where he will attempt to ram 卡比（Kirby） or grab him with his horn. 盔角虫（Hornhead） grants the 独角仙（Beetle） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled.

wikirby-page:10496.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10496.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10496.description_zh:
Mowlee Bros.是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的中级Boss，可以使用超新星（Hypernova）能力进行战斗。Mowlee Bros.是大型鼹鼠状生物，戴着有色护目镜，颜色多样。它们的主要策略是在洞穴之间移动，并出现以向卡比（Kirby）投掷巨石。这些巨石可以被Inhaled弹回，但卡比（Kirby）需要掌握好时机才能击中它们，因为在投掷巨石后它们很快就会潜入地下。

Mowlee Bros.需要按顺序作战，前面三个在Fine Fields第一关结束时依次作战，第四个则在Royal Road第8关EX单独作战。
wikirby-page:10496.description_en:
The Mowlee Bros. are mid-bosses from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, who are fought using the 超新星（Hypernova） ability. The Mowlee Bros. are large mole-like creatures who wear tinted goggles and come in various colors. Their primary strategy is to move between burrow holes, and emerge to toss boulders at 卡比（Kirby）. These boulders can be Inhaled and spat back, but 卡比（Kirby） will need to employ good timing in order to hit them, as they will burrow underground shortly after tossing the boulders.

The Mowlee Bros. are fought in sequence, with the first three being fought one-after-the-other at the end of Stage 1 of Fine Fields, and the fourth being fought solo in Stage 8 EX of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:10495.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10495.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10495.description_zh:
Waddle Dee Steel Fortress是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的中型Boss。它使用超新星（Hypernova）技能进行战斗。该堡垒会在Old Odyssey的Stage 5末尾出现，然后在Royal Road的Stage 8 EX再次出现。它会从坑中升起，并在侧平台上由三名瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）操作（尽管他们似乎没有做任何帮助的事情）。

这座堡垒通过从炮口射出导弹来攻击，卡比（Kirby）可以将其吐回去。然而，卡比（Kirby）需要击中支撑梁，而支撑梁仅在短时间内可作为目标来对塔造成伤害。每次支撑梁被摧毁时，塔会变得更加愤怒和快速，而Waddle Dees会变得更加害怕。当塔只剩下最后一根支撑梁时，它除了导弹之外，还会偶尔发射尖锐光束，它会试图击中卡比（Kirby）。

一旦被击败，塔楼会崩塌，将Waddle Dees甩飞，并揭示前方的门。

在皇家之路遇到的钢铁要塞拥有Sectra Dee而不是常规类型。
wikirby-page:10495.description_en:
The Waddle Dee Steel Fortress is a mid-boss from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It is fought using the 超新星（Hypernova） ability. The fortress appears at the end of Stage 5 of Old Odyssey, then again in Stage 8 EX of Royal Road. It appears by rising out of a pit, and has three 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s manning it on a side-platform (though they don't appear to be doing anything to help).

The fortress attacks by shooting missiles from its cannon mouth, which 卡比（Kirby） can spit back at it. However, 卡比（Kirby） needs to hit its support beams, which are only target-able for a short time to damage the tower. Each time a beam is taken out, the tower gets angrier and faster, while the Waddle Dees become more frightened. When the tower is down to its last beam, it will, in addition to the missiles, also occasionally spit out a spiky beam, which it will try to smack 卡比（Kirby） with.

Once defeated, the tower crumbles, sending the Waddle Dees flying, and revealing the door forward.

The Steel Fortress encountered in Royal Road has Sectra Dees instead of the regular type.

wikirby-page:10499.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:10499.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:10499.description_zh:
Winged Eggers是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的中型Boss。它们需要使用超新星（Hypernova）技能战斗。

 Eggers是四只丰满的类龙生物，拥有短粗的四肢和带装甲的背部。它们每只都携带一面大盾，并以队形在卡比（Kirby）周围飞行。它们通过喷火和从嘴里吐出巨石进行攻击。当它们防御松懈时，这些巨石可以被反击回来击倒它们。

 Eggers是逐一击败的，每击败一只，其余的会更加愤怒并加速。

 Winged Eggers会在Endless Explosions的第4阶段和Royal Road的第8 EX阶段中出现。每击败一个Egger，都会将它击入背景中的火山。一旦全部其中四个被敲入，火山将爆发，导致它们被抛出。
wikirby-page:10499.description_en:
The Winged Eggers are a mid-boss from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. They are fought using the 超新星（Hypernova） ability.

The Eggers are four plump dragon-like creatures with stumpy appendages and armored backs. They each carry a large shield and fly around 卡比（Kirby） in formation. They attack by breathing fire and spitting out boulders from their mouths. These boulders can be fired back at them when their guard is down to knock them out.

The Eggers are defeated one-at-a-time, with each one knocked out causing the rest to get angrier, and faster.

The Winged Eggers are encountered in Stage 4 of Endless Explosions and again in Stage 8 EX of Royal Road. Each Egger defeated will be knocked into a volcano in the background. Once all four of them are knocked in, the volcano will erupt, causing them to be flung out.

wikirby-page:7843.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7843.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7843.description_zh:
“A一尊巨蛇雕像，自古以来一直受到People of the Sky的崇敬。它的身体覆盖着天界的金色盔甲，但古文记载它的头部没有保护！”
— 三重豪华老板说明。这揭示了它如何受到伤害。
Coily Rattler是星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的一个Boss。它是一座巨型响尾蛇的活体金色雕像，曾经在过去被People of the Sky视为神明和和平的象征。它通过多种方式使用蛇形身体进行攻击，包括在舞台上盘绕、用尾巴打击和咬击，然后将受害者带到舞台另一端。Coily Rattler还可以分裂成若干部分，并通过从空中落下攻击舞台。Coily Rattler是卡比（Kirby）：Triple Deluxes第四级，Wild World，并且它也在The Arena以及Royal Road的第2阶段中进行战斗。
wikirby-page:7843.description_en:
“A giant snake statue revered by the People of the Sky since the dawn of time. Its body lies sheathed in celestial golden armor, but the old texts say that its head lacks protection!”
— Triple Deluxe Boss description. This reveals how it can be damaged.
Coily Rattler is a boss from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It is an animated golden statue of a giant rattlesnake, and was originally revered as a deity and a symbol of peace to the People of the Sky in the past. It attacks by using its serpentine body in various ways, including snaking around the stage, striking with its rattle, and biting, following up by carrying its victim across the stage. Coily Rattler can also split into several pieces and attack by raining itself down onto the stage. Coily Rattler is the boss of 卡比（Kirby）: Triple Deluxes fourth Level, Wild World, and it is also battled in The Arena and Stage 2 of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:8010.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:8010.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:8010.description_zh: 在女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）最初的失败之后，她与Dreamstalk融合，获得一个新的形态，在未使用的数据中被称为Flowered Sectonia（或英国英语数据中的Sectonia's Flower）。在这个形态下，她作为星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的故事模式（Story Mode）的最终Boss，竭尽全力击败卡比（Kirby）并吞并Floralia、Dream Land以及波普之星（Planet Popstar）的所有内容。
wikirby-page:8010.description_en: After 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）'s initial defeat, she merges with the Dreamstalk to take on a new form, referred to in unused data as Flowered Sectonia (or Sectonia's Flower in the British English data). In this form, she serves as the final boss of 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）s 故事模式（Story Mode）, doing everything she can to defeat 卡比（Kirby） and subsume Floralia, Dream Land, and all of 波普之星（Planet Popstar）.

wikirby-page:7351.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7351.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7351.description_zh:
“曾是浮动王国Floralia的一种小型盛开花朵，Flowery Woods由于Dedede神秘绑架者塔狼蛛（Taranza）的魔法而变得敌对且过度生长。小心这棵树锋利的花瓣！”
— 三重豪华关卡Boss描述
Flowery Woods是星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的一个Boss。它的外观与风语大树（Whispy Woods）极为相似，只是在基部有绿色的树干，上面开着花朵，鼻子顶端长着一朵小花，并且从星形的小花簇中绽放出又大又锋利的花朵，这些小花簇分别替代了原本的苹果和叶子。Flowery Woods是三重豪华的第一级关卡Fine Fields的Boss，它也会在The Arena、Stage 4和Stage 5的Royal Road.
wikirby-page:7351.description_en:
“Once a small blooming flower native to the floating kingdom of Floralia, Flowery Woods has become hostile and overgrown due to the magic of Dedede's mysterious kidnapper, 塔狼蛛（Taranza）. Watch out for this tree's razor-sharp blossoms!”
— Triple Deluxe Boss description
Flowery Woods is a boss in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. It bears a strikingly similar appearance to 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, only with a green trunk at the base of which flowers bloom, a small flower blooming from the tip of its nose, and large, razor-sharp blossoms blooming from star-shaped clusters of smaller flowers that replace the expected apples and leaves, respectively. Flowery Woods is the boss of Triple Deluxes first Level, Fine Fields, and it is also battled in The Arena and in Stage 4 and Stage 5 of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:7811.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7811.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7811.description_zh:
“曾经有一幅画，据说描绘了一对生来被分开的姐妹。它在画家的工作室里默默沉睡了无数年，直到有一天，它复活了，并对世界发誓要复仇。”
— 星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）Boss描述
Paintra是一位首次登场于星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的Boss。她看起来像一位女巫，但实际上是一幅活生生的画作，由塔狼蛛（Taranza）的魔力赋予生命。Paintra穿着色彩斑斓的服装，脚上像画笔一样，她的攻击方式包括洒颜料、发射能量冲击以及画出会活过来的画来攻击敌人，就像之前游戏中的Ado和阿朵莱妮（Adeleine）一样。Paintra是Triple Deluxe第二关Lollipop Land的Boss，她也是在The Arena和Stage 4的Royal Road中作战。
wikirby-page:7811.description_en:
“There was once a painting said to depict a pair of sisters separated at birth. It slept, unnoticed, in a painter's studio for countless years before it came to life and vowed revenge on the world.”
— 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe） Boss description
Paintra is a boss making her debut in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. She resembles a witch, but is in fact a living painting, brought to life by the magic power of 塔狼蛛（Taranza）. Paintra bears a colorful outfit, complete with two paintbrushes for feet, and attacks by spreading paint, firing energy blasts, and painting pictures that come to life to attack her enemies, much like Ado and 阿朵莱妮（Adeleine） from previous games would. Paintra is the boss of Triple Deluxes second Level, Lollipop Land, and she is also battled in The Arena and in Stage 4 of Royal Road.

wikirby-page:7850.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7850.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7850.description_zh:
“这只烤得香喷喷的蟾蜍非常火热，他用熔岩当洗澡水！他最喜欢的爱好是引发火山爆发和到处跳跃！”
— 特色页面来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
火山蛙（Pyribbit）是第一次在星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）中遇到的Boss。他是一只巨大的卵状火山碎屑蛙，带有一条小尾巴，经常被称为“火山之主”。他看起来像一只巨大的有角蟾蜍，尽管戴着皇冠且没有手臂。他的皇冠看起来像一个冒着烟的火山口，熔岩和火成岩巨石可以从中喷出。他还可以在熔岩中游泳并生存，喷火，并且具有引发地震和召唤熔岩波的能力。
wikirby-page:7850.description_en:
“This toasty toad is so hot, he uses molten lava for his bathwater! His favorite hobbies are causing volcanic eruptions and hopping all over the place!”
— VS 火山蛙（Pyribbit）, Special Page from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
火山蛙（Pyribbit） is a boss first confronted in 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）. He is a massive ovaloid pyroclastic frog with a small tail who is often referred to as the "Volcano Lord". He resembles a giant horned toad, though he bears a crown and has no arms. His crown appears to be a smoldering caldera, out of which magma and igneous boulders can be spewed. He can also swim and survive in lava and breathe fire, along with having the ability to cause tremors and summon lava waves.

wikirby-page:8012.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:8012.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:8012.description_zh:
“在女王大厅里悬挂的一面神秘镜子的深处，黑暗国王正等待着，Shadow Dedede！他与所有来者作战，但Shadow Dedede真正的对手是他自己内心的黑暗。”
— 对战Shadow Dedede，星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
Shadow Dedede是星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的Dededetour中的倒数第二个boss，并且在该游戏中作为The True Arena的梦魇（Nightmare）四人组中的第二个出现。Shadow Dedede看起来像是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的邪恶分身，尽管他的暂停描述将他形容为一个可悲的自动人，因无知而愤怒地发泄。Shadow Dedede看起来与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）大致相同，但颜色明显更暗，眼睛空白呈白色，外套和大锤上的符号也不同，类似于单色的靶心。

 Shadow Dedede从Dimension Mirror出现，在帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在Dededetour的第6级击败女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）DX之后。
wikirby-page:8012.description_en:
“In the depths of a mysterious mirror hanging in the hall of the queen waits the dark king, Shadow Dedede! He wages battle against all comers, but Shadow Dedede's true opponent is the darkness in his own heart.”
— VS Shadow Dedede, 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
Shadow Dedede is the penultimate boss in Dededetour of 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, and appears as the second of the 梦魇（Nightmare） Four from The True Arena in that game. Shadow Dedede appears to be an evil doppelgänger of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, though his pause description describes him as a miserable automaton, lashing out in anger because he knows nothing else. Shadow Dedede looks more or less the same as 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, but with an obviously darker color scheme, blank white eyes, and a different symbol on his coat and hammer, resembling a monochrome bulls-eye.

Shadow Dedede comes out of the Dimension Mirror after 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） defeats 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） DX in Level 6 of Dededetour.

wikirby-page:7835.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 三重豪华版
wikirby-page:7835.display_work: 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）
wikirby-page:7835.description_zh: Soul of Sectonia是来自星之卡比三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）的秘密Boss，她只在该游戏中作为The True Arena的最终Boss出现。她是女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）（具体是Flowered Sectonia）的灵魂形态，因为在几乎被卡比（Kirby）消灭后，为了生存和恢复力量，她吞食了几只Miracle Fruit而被创造出来。击败她将彻底摧毁她。
wikirby-page:7835.description_en: Soul of Sectonia is a secret boss from 星之卡比 三重豪华版（Kirby: Triple Deluxe）, and makes her only appearance as the final boss of The True Arena in that game. She is the soul form of 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia） (specifically Flowered Sectonia), having been created when she ate several Miracle Fruits to survive and return to power after being nearly obliterated by 卡比（Kirby）. Defeating her destroys her for good.

wikirby-page:14802.description_zh: Team DDD（在英国英语版本中简称为Dedede）是Kirby Fighters Deluxe单人模式的最终Boss。团队由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和23-63个更小的克隆组成——迷你（Mini）Dedede（粉色且小型）和Combo Dedede（橙色且中型）。
wikirby-page:14802.description_en: Team DDD (simply referred to as Dedede in the British English version) is the final boss of Kirby Fighters Deluxes Single Player Mode. The team consists of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and 23-63 smaller clones—迷你（Mini） Dededes (pink & small-sized) and Combo Dededes (orange & medium-sized).

wikirby-page:69232.debut_work_en: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:69232.display_work: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:69232.description_zh: Kizario是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的客串角色，并在Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!中客串亮相。他自称是由母亲管理的Comet TV的制作人，为了寻找失踪的宠物Peperon，他前往Dream Land主持赛道活动。
wikirby-page:69232.description_en: Kizario is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!. Claiming to be the producer of Comet TV, a studio managed by his mother, he travels to Dream Land to host a race course in order to find his missing pet Peperon.

wikirby-page:66921.debut_work_en: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:66921.display_work: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:66921.description_zh: Kurron是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的客串角色，并在Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!中客串亮相。他是一个魔术师，担任Kizario的看护人。Kurron在小说事件中照看Kizario，并帮助他修复与宠物Peperon、Kizario的关系。
wikirby-page:66921.description_en: Kurron is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!. He is a magician who works as Kizario's caretaker. Kurron watches over Kizario during the events of the novel and helps him mend his relationship with Peperon, Kizario's pet.

wikirby-page:66905.debut_work_en: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:66905.display_work: Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!
wikirby-page:66905.description_zh: Peperon是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!中客串亮相。Peperon是Kizario的宠物和亲密朋友。当Kizario使用魔法使Peperon急剧成长时，它逃到了Dream Land，Kizario在那里设置了一个赛道以寻找它。
wikirby-page:66905.description_en: Peperon is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes its guest appearance in Kirby: Big Race in Pupupu Land!. Peperon is Kizario's pet and dear friend. When Kizario uses magic to make Peperon grow dramatically, it escapes to Dream Land, and Kizario sets up a race course there in order to find it.

wikirby-page:66609.debut_work_en: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66609.display_work: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66609.description_zh:
Baron Gallic是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的客串角色，并在Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess中作为主要反派登场。他同时是Malice Stone的受害者和主要使用者。在恶意石块（Stone）的帮助下，他操纵并绑架了Chiffon Star的公主Princess Marona，为小说的事件奠定了基础。

Gallic作为男爵的身份受到质疑，而他的名字让人联想到“garlic”（大蒜）一词，这与小说中其他以甜点为主题的角色名字形成对比，并被帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）用来称呼他。
wikirby-page:66609.description_en:
Baron Gallic is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his appearance in Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess as the main antagonist. He is simultaneously a victim and the main user of the Malice Stone. With the help of the Malice 石块（Stone）, he manipulates and abducts the princess of Chiffon Star, Princess Marona, setting the stage for the events of the novel.

Gallic's identity as a baron is questioned, while his name is reminiscent of the word "garlic", which contrasts with the dessert-themed names of other characters in the novel and is used referring to him by 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）.

wikirby-page:66560.debut_work_en: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66560.display_work: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66560.description_zh:
Merengue XIII是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中出现的客串角色，并在Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess中亮相。Merengue XIII是Chiffon Star的国王，也是Princess Marona的父亲。在他的生日不久前，他的女儿逃离了宫殿，这让他非常烦恼，他接受了魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的帮助来寻找她。

Merengue XIII的名字是对蛋白霜的双关语，这是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在称呼他时错误使用的名字。
wikirby-page:66560.description_en:
Merengue XIII is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his appearance in Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess. Merengue XIII is the king of Chiffon Star and the father of Princess Marona. Not long before his birthday, his daughter escaped the palace, which upset him immensely, and he accepts 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s aid in finding her.

Merengue XIII's name is a pun on meringue, a name 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） mistakenly uses when adressing him.

wikirby-page:66541.debut_work_en: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66541.display_work: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess
wikirby-page:66541.description_zh:
Princess Marona是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess中客串登场。她是Chiffon Star的同名公主，也是国王Merengue XIII的独生女。她对肩负的期望感到沮丧，并被Baron Gallic操控而离开了王宫。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）决心去救公主，而公主也意识到自己有多么珍惜家人和家园。

她的名字听起来与“马卡龙”有些相似，这一相似性导致了帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的发音错误。
wikirby-page:66541.description_en:
Princess Marona is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes her guest appearance in Kirby: Meta Knight and the Puppet Princess. She is the titular princess of Chiffon Star and only daughter of the king, Merengue XIII. She grew frustrated with the expectations laid upon her and was manipulated by Baron Gallic into abandoning the royal castle. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） resolves to rescue the princess, who comes to realize how much she cherishes her family and home.

Her name sounds somewhat similar to "macaron", a similarity that sources mispronunciations on 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s behalf.

wikirby-form:11615.description_zh:
“Kirby Rocket会在空中飞行，并在触碰彩虹绳时改变方向。”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse电子手册，第14页
thumb|right|200px|Kirby Rocket

的艺术作品Kirby Rocket是卡比（Kirby）在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中可以进行的一种变形。它会将他变成一个白色机身和红色喷射器的圆柱形火箭。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）能在空中自由飞行，并自动击败大部分他碰撞到的敌人。他可以使用Rainbow Rope进行引导，其操作方式类似于摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）中的导弹（Missile）复制能力（Copy Ability）。Kirby Rocket用于Kirby Rocket's Big Blastoff、返回战舰关卡以及The Final Battle。Kirby Rocket还会出现在Challenge Mode的几个关卡中。
wikirby-form:11615.description_en:
“Kirby Rocket will zoom through the air and change course when he touches a rainbow rope.”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse electronic manual, page 14
thumb|right|200px|Artwork of the Kirby Rocket

The Kirby Rocket is a transformation that 卡比（Kirby） can undergo in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It transforms him into a cylindrical rocket with a white body and red thrusters. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） flies freely through the air and automatically defeats most enemies he crashes into. He can be guided using the Rainbow Rope, and controls similarly to the 导弹（Missile） 复制能力（Copy Ability） in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）. The Kirby Rocket is used in the stages Kirby Rocket's Big Blastoff, Back to the Battleship, and The Final Battle. Kirby Rocket also appears in several stages in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-form:11614.description_zh:
“Kirby Submarine在发射鱼雷的同时向你点击的点移动。使用彩虹绳引导鱼雷的路径。”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse电子手册，第14页
thumb|right|200px|Kirby Submarine

的插画Kirby Submarine是卡比（Kirby）在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中可以进行的转变。它将他变成一艘带潜望镜的小型潜艇，拥有两个红色窗框和一个旋翼。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）可以在清水（Water）中更加自由地移动，并自动发射鱼雷，鱼雷的路径可以使用Rainbow Rope进行引导。Kirby Submarine用于关卡Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time和Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine。Kirby Submarine还多次出现在Challenge Mode中。
wikirby-form:11614.description_en:
“Kirby Submarine moves toward the point you tap while firing torpedoes. Use rainbow ropes to guide the torpedoes' path.”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse electronic manual, page 14
thumb|right|200px|Artwork of the Kirby Submarine

The Kirby Submarine is a transformation that 卡比（Kirby） can undergo in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It transforms him into a small submarine with a periscope, two red window frames, and a rotor. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） can move more freely in the 清水（Water）, and automatically shoots out torpedoes that can be guided using the Rainbow Rope. The Kirby Submarine is used in the stages Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time and Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine. Kirby Submarine also appears several times in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-form:11613.description_zh:
“Kirby Tank会自动前进，并且在轻触时可以进行冲刺。他还会在你点击的任何地方开火。”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse电子手册，第14页
右侧缩略图|250px|Kirby Tank的艺术作品。

 Kirby Tank是卡比（Kirby）可以通过艾莉妮（Elline）的绘画技巧在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中进行的变形。使用画布，她将他变成一个小型坦克，嘴巴是加农炮，脚是履带。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）能够从他的“嘴巴”连续不断地发射炮弹，迅速击败敌人，同时慢慢沿地面滚动。Kirby Tank用于关卡Deploy the Kirby Tank!和Woodland Battle中。它也出现在几个Challenge Mode关卡中。
wikirby-form:11613.description_en:
“Kirby Tank moves forward automatically and can dash when tapped. He will also fire his cannon at any point you tap.”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse electronic manual, page 14
thumb|right|250px|Artwork of the Kirby Tank.

The Kirby Tank is a transformation that 卡比（Kirby） can undergo in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse using 艾莉妮（Elline）'s painting skills. Using a canvas, she transforms him into a small tank with a cannon for a mouth and treads for feet. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） is able to shoot endless volleys of cannonballs from his "mouth" to quickly defeat enemies as he rolls slowly along the ground. The Kirby Tank is used in the stages Deploy the Kirby Tank! and Woodland Battle. It also appears in several Challenge Mode stages.

wikirby-page:11600.description_zh:
“一个堕落的艺术家，黏土西亚（Claycia）使用神秘的力量偷走梦境之地的色彩。不公平，黏土西亚（Claycia）！”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse英文网站-故事部分。
黏土西亚（Claycia）是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的一个角色。她是一名魔法泥塑师，建造了Seventopia及其中的所有生物。对她了解不多，但她似乎是一个友好快乐的艺术家，喜欢与她的朋友艾莉妮（Elline）一起雕塑东西。她也非常喜欢颜色。在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中，她神秘地变得冷酷邪恶，并抢走了波普之星（Popstar）的色彩。后来揭示，她是被邪恶的Dark Crafter附身，卡比（Kirby）帮助她摆脱了这个威胁。
wikirby-page:11600.description_en:
“An artist gone bad, 黏土西亚（Claycia） uses mysterious powers to steal the colors from Dream Land. No fair, 黏土西亚（Claycia）!”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse English website - Story section.
黏土西亚（Claycia） is a character from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. She is a magical clay sculptor who built the realm of Seventopia and all the creatures within it. Nothing much is known about her, but she seems to be a friendly and happy artist who likes sculpting things with her friend, 艾莉妮（Elline）. She also loves colors. In Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, she mysteriously turns cold and evil, and robs 波普之星（Popstar） of its colors. It is later revealed that she was being possessed by the villainous Dark Crafter, and 卡比（Kirby） helps to rid her of this menace.

wikirby-page:11604.description_zh:
“I我想知道我和黏土西亚（Claycia）是否还能重新成为朋友。我有些怀疑……但是当我和卡比（Kirby）在一起时，我可以做任何事情！”
— 艾莉妮（Elline）的Secret Diary第21页在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
艾莉妮（Elline）是一个魔法画笔仙子，她在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中首次登场。在游戏事件发生之前，她和黏土西亚（Claycia）是最好的朋友。当黏土西亚（Claycia）发狂并试图用Grab Hand绑架艾莉妮（Elline）时，她遇到了卡比（Kirby）和头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee），他们一起出发，试图让黏土西亚（Claycia）和梦境国恢复正常。

艾莉妮（Elline）负责绘制Rainbow Rope，这些Rainbow Rope被卡比（Kirby）用来在Seventopia中移动。她还可以将卡比（Kirby）变换成三种不同的形式之一：Kirby Tank, Kirby Submarine和Kirby Rocket。自她首次登场以来，她通过客串出现在各种其他卡比（Kirby）游戏中。
wikirby-page:11604.description_en:
“I wonder if 黏土西亚（Claycia） and I will be friends again. I have my doubts... But when I'm with 卡比（Kirby）, I can do anything!”
— 艾莉妮（Elline）'s Secret Diary Page 21 in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
艾莉妮（Elline） is a magical paintbrush fairy who debuted in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. Prior to the events of the game, she and 黏土西亚（Claycia） were best friends. When 黏土西亚（Claycia） goes mad and tries to kidnap 艾莉妮（Elline） using Grab Hands, she encounters 卡比（Kirby） and 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, and they all set out to return both 黏土西亚（Claycia） and Dream Land to normal.

艾莉妮（Elline） is responsible for painting the Rainbow Ropes which 卡比（Kirby） uses to get about in Seventopia. She can also transform 卡比（Kirby） into one of three different forms: the Kirby Tank, Kirby Submarine, and Kirby Rocket. Since her debut appearance, she has appeared via cameos in various other 卡比（Kirby） games.

wikirby-page:45748.description_zh: Barampa是一种会飞的蓝色虫子状敌人，它首次（也是目前唯一一次）出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。它是游戏中少数几种从未拥有自己Figurine的敌人之一（因此，在游戏的日文指南之外，它从未被命名）。它出现在Sky-High Whispy Woods关卡中，与其他Barampas排成一线飞行（最初看起来像是一个整体的蜈蚣状生物），试图通过碰撞攻击卡比（Kirby）。当卡比（Kirby）碰到这一列时，Barampas会分散。每只Barampas都可以通过常规攻击方法击败，获得100分和3个Point Star。
wikirby-page:45748.description_en: Barampa is a flying blue bug-like enemy which makes its first (and so far only) appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is one of the few enemies in the game that was never given its own Figurine (and hence, was never named outside of the Japanese guidebook for the game). It appears in the Sky-High Whispy Woods stage, where it flies in lines with other Barampas (making them appear to be a single centipede-like creature at first) and tries to attack 卡比（Kirby） by collision. When 卡比（Kirby） crashes into the line, the Barampas break apart. Each one can be defeated for 100 points and 3 Point Stars using regular attack methods.

wikirby-page:23842.description_zh:
“Bombzways宁愿携带星星而不是炸弹，因为星星远比炸弹轻。但命令就是命令，而且黏土西亚（Claycia）的命令往往是：“去投下一些炸弹！”Bombzway该怎么办？”
— Figurine对Bombzway的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bombzway，它是一个飞行的绿色虫状敌人，有两个像爪子的钳子，它首次（也是目前为止唯一一次）出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。在Kirby Tank阶段可以看到它沿直线飞行，通常携带Point Star或炸弹，但它偶尔也会携带Treasure Chest。它容易飞入场景，短暂停留，然后再次飞走，或者可能以恒定速度慢慢飞行而不停止。如果它携带炸弹，它将尝试在卡比（Kirby）飞过他上方时投下炸弹，但这枚炸弹可以被射击以提前引爆。

Bombzway需要被Kirby Tank或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的加农炮击中两次才能击败。被击中一次时，它会变红并露出痛苦的表情。击败后，它会给予100分和3个积分星，以及它持有的其他物品。
wikirby-page:23842.description_en:
“Bombzways would rather carry stars than bombs, since stars are far less heavy than bombs. But orders are orders, and more often than not, 黏土西亚（Claycia）'s orders are: "Go drop some bombs!" What's a Bombzway to do?”
— Figurine description of Bombzway from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bombzway is a flying green bug-like enemy with two claw-like pincers which makes its first (and so far only) appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It can be seen during Kirby Tank stages flying in straight lines, usually carrying Point Stars or bombs, but it can also occasionally be seen carrying a Treasure Chest. It is prone to fly into the scene, briefly stop, then fly away again, or it may slowly fly at a constant rate without stopping. If it is carrying a bomb, it will try to drop the bomb on 卡比（Kirby） as it flies over him, but this bomb can be shot to detonate it early.

Bombzway takes two shots from the Kirby Tank or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s cannon to defeat. It turns red and adopts a wincing expression when hit once. When defeated, it confers 100 points and 3 Point Stars, in addition to whatever other item it was holding.

wikirby-page:22505.description_zh:
“Bronto Knight必须同时穿戴重甲并飞行——真令人惊讶他不会不断倒在地上。但这种行为可不符合骑士的风范！”
— Figurine对Bronto Knight的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bronto Knight，是一个类似飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）的飞行敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。他通常悬浮在空中，或与其他暴龙骑士一起盘旋以形成屏障，并且对卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash以及瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛免疫。要击败他，卡比（Kirby）必须使用Star Dash，从而获得100分和10个Point Star。
wikirby-page:22505.description_en:
“Bronto Knight has to wear heavy armor and fly at the same time—it's a wonder he's not constantly collapsing on the ground. But that sort of behavior would not become a knight!”
— Figurine description of Bronto Knight from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bronto Knight is a flying 飞翅球球（Bronto Burt）-like enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is usually suspended in midair or flying in circles with other Bronto Knights to create a barrier, and is immune to both 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. To defeat him, 卡比（Kirby） must use a Star Dash, granting 100 points and 10 Point Stars in the process.

wikirby-page:23843.description_zh:
“这个小灯泡以纯洁的心散发着爱的光芒，但没有人愿意靠近他。每当有人碰到你时就会被电击，交朋友可不容易。不过，他依然继续发光，因为那就是你该做的事情。”
— Figurine来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的Bzztbulb描述
Bzztbulb是一个敌人，他首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse，看起来像一个小床单鬼，头上带着灯，腰间绑着黄色腰带。他会待在一个地方，周期性地用一个危险的电障护住自己，障碍一段时间后会消失。当他没有保护时，很容易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛击败，击败后可获得100点和3个Point Star。他可以有时也可以看到附在气球上。
wikirby-page:23843.description_en:
“This little bulb glows with the love of a pure heart, but no one wants to get anywhere near him. It's tough to make friends when you electrocute anyone who touches you. Still, he keeps on glowing, 'cause that's what you do.”
— Figurine description of Bzztbulb from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bzztbulb is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, resembling a small bed-sheet ghost with a light on his head and a yellow sash around his waist. He stays in one place, periodically enveloping himself with a hazardous electric barrier that disappears after a while. While he is unprotected, he can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear, and confers 100 points and 3 Point Stars when defeated. He can also sometimes be seen attached to balloons.

wikirby-page:23833.description_zh:
“当你是Cotta并对黏土西亚（Claycia）说话时，就会发生这种情况。她会把你变成大炮！有些人认为她这样做相当刻薄。但那确实是一门外观漂亮的大炮，你不觉得吗？”
— Figurine从Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的Cannon Cotta描述
Cannon Cotta是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。它是一个Cotta，被重塑成一门大炮，类似于黑大炮（Shotzo），据其手办描述，当一个Cotta说黏土西亚（Claycia）坏话时，就会发生这种情况。它保持在一个地方，一旦发现卡比（Kirby），就会追踪他的位置，并定期发射沿直线移动的炮弹。它可以被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛，炮弹本身在撞到彩虹绳时也可以被阻挡。击败一个Cannon Cotta可以获得100分和3个Point Star。

在The Final Battle期间，黏土西亚（Claycia）可以从天花板召唤炮筒，它们会向卡比（Kirby）发射气泡炸弹（有时也会发射积分星），而不是通常的炮弹。这些炮筒比普通炮筒的颜色更深，并且在一段时间后会消失。
wikirby-page:23833.description_en:
“This is what happens when you're a Cotta and you mouth off to 黏土西亚（Claycia）. She turns you into a cannon! Some folks think that's pretty mean of her. But that certainly is a fine-looking cannon, don't you think?”
— Figurine description of Cannon Cotta from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Cannon Cotta is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is a Cotta which has been reshaped into a cannon, similar to 黑大炮（Shotzo）, which is said to happen when a Cotta badmouths 黏土西亚（Claycia）, according to its figurine description. It stays in one place, and upon spotting 卡比（Kirby）, tracks his position, periodically firing cannonballs that move in straight lines. It can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear, and the cannonballs themselves can be blocked when they hit a rainbow rope. Defeating a Cannon Cotta rewards 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

During The Final Battle, 黏土西亚（Claycia） can conjure Cannon Cottas from the ceiling which will fire bubbled bombs (and occasionally Point Stars) at 卡比（Kirby） instead of the usual cannonballs. These Cannon Cottas are a darker hue than the normal ones, and disappear after a short while.

wikirby-page:22549.description_zh:
“这条坚韧的小鱼一生只有一个目标：直冲瀑布而上。他已经梦想这一目标有一段时间了。也许他在担心，在达到那个隐喻的瀑布顶端之后会发生什么。”
— 美式英语对Carpa的模型描述，来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Carpa是来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的鱼类敌人。通常可以看到他原地顺着瀑布骑行，但也可能慢慢地向上或向下游动。如果水流被彩虹绳阻挡，Carpa会掉到坚硬的地面上，并开始无目的地扑腾。在这种状态下，他们很容易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的矛击败。Carpa通常会携带物品，包括Point Stars、Food和Treasure Chests。击败Carpa可获得100点分数和3个点星。在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Carpa只会出现在Great Cave Escape关卡。Carpa也可以在少数Challenge Mode关卡中找到。
wikirby-page:22549.description_en:
“This scrappy little fish has just one goal in life: to swim straight up a waterfall. He's had that dream for a while, though. Maybe he's worried about what comes after he's reached the top of that metaphorical waterfall.”
— American English figurine description of Carpa from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Carpa is a fish-like enemy from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is usually seen riding up waterfalls while staying in place, but may also be seen slowly swimming up or down it. If the water is blocked via rainbow rope, the Carpa will fall onto solid ground and start flopping around aimlessly. In the latter state, they are easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. Carpa are usually seen carrying items, including Point Stars, Food, and Treasure Chests. Carpa are worth 100 points and 3 Point Stars when defeated.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Carpa appears exclusively in the Great Cave Escape stage. Carpa can also be found in a few Challenge Mode stages.

wikirby-page:46222.description_zh: Clay Ball是一个会漂浮的带刺球型敌人，它首次（也是迄今为止唯一一次）出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。它是游戏中少数从未拥有自己Figurine的敌人之一（因此也从未在日本以外的资料中命名过）。它出现在The Final Battle中，在那里它被黏土西亚（Claycia）用在她的Boss战中，试图攻击卡比（Kirby）。黏土球通常沿直线漂移，不受重力影响，并会从接触到的任何表面弹开。当它们伸出刺时，黏土球是危险的，但它们会定期收回刺并进入休眠状态，这时卡比（Kirby）可以撞击它们，使它们飞出去并在一次弹跳后爆炸。如果一个Clay Ball击中黏土西亚（Claycia），她将被击倒在地并容易受到后续攻击。击败黏土球不会获得任何奖励。
wikirby-page:46222.description_en: Clay Ball is a floating spiky ball enemy which makes its first (and so far only) appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is one of the few enemies in the game that was never given its own Figurine (and hence, was never named outside of Japanese sources). It appears in The Final Battle, where it is used by 黏土西亚（Claycia） in her boss fight to try and rough up 卡比（Kirby）. Clay Balls tend to drift in straight lines without being affected by gravity, and bounce off of any surface they come into contact with. When their spikes are out, Clay Balls are dangerous to touch, but they regularly retract these spikes and go dormant, at which point 卡比（Kirby） can knock into them to cause them to fly off and explode after a single bounce. If a Clay Ball hits 黏土西亚（Claycia）, she will be knocked to the ground and made vulnerable to follow-up attacks. Clay Balls do not reward anything when defeated.

wikirby-page:23832.description_zh:
“Cotta是黏土西亚（Claycia）和艾莉妮（Elline）为他们的新世界创造的第一个生物。黏土西亚（Claycia）用粘土雕刻它们，艾莉妮（Elline）给每个生物上色。这些小家伙不擅长战斗，但别告诉他们！”
— 美国英语中关于Cotta的小雕像描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。
Cotta是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。作为游戏中最基本的敌人，它会漫无目的地游荡或站立不动，很容易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛击败。击败后，Cotta将给玩家提供100分和3个Point Star。

Cotta可以在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的各种情况下被发现。此外按照它们通常的蹒跚方式，可以看到它们挂在气球上（有时挂着时会向卡比（Kirby）挥手），并且经常出现在无法够到的地方。它们也经常被用作引入某些舞台危险的素材，例如The Long-Lost Ruins中的Cotta，会被掉落的墙压扁。

根据其手办说明，Cottas是黏土西亚（Claycia）和艾莉妮（Elline）为Seventopia制作的第一批生物。
wikirby-page:23832.description_en:
“The Cotta were the first creatures 黏土西亚（Claycia） and 艾莉妮（Elline） made for their new world. 黏土西亚（Claycia） sculpted them out of clay, and 艾莉妮（Elline） painted each one. These little critters aren't very good at fighting, but don't tell them that!”
— American English figurine description of Cotta from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Cotta is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. Being the most basic enemy in the game, it wanders around aimlessly or stands still and can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. When defeated, Cotta confers 100 points and 3 Point Stars onto the player.

Cotta can be found in a variety of situations throughout Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. In addition to their usual waddling, they can be seen hanging from balloons (sometimes waving at 卡比（Kirby） while doing so) and are frequently found in areas out of reach. They are also often used as fodder to introduce certain stage hazards, with an example being the Cotta in The Long-Lost Ruins which gets flattened by a falling wall.

According to its figurine description, Cottas were the first creatures 黏土西亚（Claycia） and 艾莉妮（Elline） made for Seventopia.

wikirby-page:23837.description_zh:
“这个家伙是Cotta骑士的领袖。但他并不急于召集他的军队。他需要在做任何费力的事情之前，先在心理上为战斗做好准备！”
— Figurine关于Cotta General的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Cotta General是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他是Cotta Knight的较大对应体，并且像他的小型对应体一样，通常待在一个地方，并且对卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛免疫。卡比（Kirby）必须使用Star Dash击败他，从而获得30个Point Star和500分。
wikirby-page:23837.description_en:
“This fellow is the leader of the Cotta Knights. But he's in no big rush to assemble his army. He needs to mentally prepare himself for battle before he does anything strenuous!”
— Figurine description of Cotta General from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Cotta General is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is the larger counterpart of a Cotta Knight, and somewhat like his smaller counterparts, he usually stays in one place, and is immune to both 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. 卡比（Kirby） must take him out using a Star Dash to defeat him, earning the player 30 Point Stars and 500 points.

wikirby-page:23836.description_zh:
“这个Cotta弄到了一顶特别的头盔，变成了一个颇有声望的骑士。但它立刻忘记了骑士实际上应该做什么，所以现在它只是到处游荡，炫耀它的头盔。”
— Figurine对Cotta Knight从Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的描述
Cotta Knight是一个敌人，它首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。它是一个Cotta，戴着骑士头盔，使其耐久度增加。它通常毫无目的地游荡或静止不动，并且免疫卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛。卡比（Kirby）必须使用Star Dash来消灭它，从而为玩家赢得100分和10个Point Star。
wikirby-page:23836.description_en:
“This Cotta got its grubby little hands on a special helmet and turned into a knight of some esteem. But it immediately forgot what a knight is actually supposed to do, so now it just wanders around and shows off its helmet.”
— Figurine description of Cotta Knight from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Cotta Knight is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is a Cotta who wears a knight's helmet, giving it increased durability. It usually wanders around aimlessly or stands still, and is immune to both 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. 卡比（Kirby） must take it out using a Star Dash instead, earning the player 100 points and 10 Point Stars.

wikirby-page:23851.description_zh:
“这个脾气暴躁的角色会从头上发射覆盖着泡沫的炸弹。他很想用这些炸弹在海底挖出一个温泉，但他仍然不确定如何向下扔而不是向上扔。”
— Figurine关于Crabbo的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Crabbo。Crabbo是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他看起来像一只头顶有白色藤壶的红色螃蟹。他固定在一个地方，向上射出包含炸弹（Bomb）的气泡。用Kirby Submarine的鱼雷或Touch Dash击中一次即可击败Crabbo，可获得100分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Crabbo仅出现在Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time关卡中。他也会出现在Challenge Mode的几个关卡中。
wikirby-page:23851.description_en:
“This crabby character shoots foam-covered bombs out of his head. He'd love to use these bombs to unearth a hot spring on the ocean floor, but he's still not sure how to throw them down instead of up.”
— Figurine description of Crabbo from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Crabbo is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He resembles a red crab with a white barnacle on the top of his head. He stays grounded in one place, shooting upwards bubbles that contain 炸弹（Bomb）s. It takes one hit from Kirby Submarine's torpedoes or a Touch Dash to defeat Crabbo, conferring 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Crabbo appears only in the stage Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time. He also appears in a few stages in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:24666.description_zh:
“这些垂头丧气的生物过去常常平静地挂在藤蔓上并投掷炸弹捕捉鱼类。但后来有人说：“嘿！那很危险！”所以现在它们只是向卡比（Kirby）投掷炸弹。”
— Figurine对Dangle Sloth的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dangle Sloth。Dangle Sloth是一种黄色类猿的敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。它会吊在藤蔓上，周期性地伸手进口袋里，拿出两个圆柱状炸弹同时投掷，炸弹会在一段时间后爆炸。需要对Kirby Submarine造成两次击中才能击败它，可获得100点积分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Dangle Sloth仅出现在关卡Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine，但它也会出现在Challenge Mode的关卡中。
wikirby-page:24666.description_en:
“These droopy creatures used to hang peacefully from vines and throw bombs to catch fish. But then someone was like, "Hey! That's dangerous!" So now they just throw bombs at 卡比（Kirby）.”
— Figurine description of Dangle Sloth from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dangle Sloth is a yellow ape-like enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It dangles on a vine, periodically reaching into its pocket to pull out and toss two cylindrical bombs at a time that detonate after a while. It takes two hits from Kirby Submarine to defeat, conferring 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Dangle Sloth appears only in the stage Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine, but it also appears in the Challenge Mode stages.

wikirby-page:23849.description_zh:
“Dethskullks会吸走他们触碰的任何生物的生命力，所以在看到它们时请谨慎行事。这群奇怪的家伙乘海盗船旅行，他们非常、非常努力地避免互相碰撞。”
— Figurine对Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的Dethskullk描述
Dethskullk是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse专属的敌人。它会不规律地漂浮，并在发现卡比（Kirby）时缓慢追逐。触碰Dethskullk会立即击倒卡比（Kirby）或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），无论他们当时有多少生命值，因此通常应避免Dethskullks。击败它们的唯一方法是使用Invincible Candy，从而获得100分（但不会获得Point Star）。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Dethskullk专属出现in The Haunted Ship，虽然它在Challenge Mode中也出现过几次。
wikirby-page:23849.description_en:
“Dethskullks suck the life force out of anyone they touch, so proceed with caution when you see one. This bizarre crew travels by pirate ship, where they try very, very hard not to bump into each other.”
— Figurine description of Dethskullk from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dethskullk is an enemy exclusive to Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It floats around erratically, and upon spotting 卡比（Kirby）, slowly chases after him. Touching a Dethskullk will instantly K.O. 卡比（Kirby） or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, regardless of how much health they had at the time, so Dethskullks should generally be avoided. The only way to defeat one is through the use of an Invincible Candy, thereby scoring 100 points (but no Point Stars).

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Dethskullk appears exclusively in The Haunted Ship, though it does make a few more appearances in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:23850.description_zh:
“这个家伙相当重要。他是Dethskullk帮派的黄金级领袖。下次如果你被困在海盗船上，很可能需要从这个人那里拿到钥匙。祝你好运。”
— Figurine对Dethskullk King在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的描述
Dethskullk King是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。像他的普通同类一样，他会不规则地飘来飘去，并且一旦发现卡比（Kirby），会慢慢追逐他。Dethskullk King还戴着一把钥匙在脖子上。接触Dethskullk King会立即将卡比（Kirby）或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）击倒，无论他们当时有多少生命值，因此通常应避免接触他。打败他的唯一方法是使用Invincible Candy，从而得分500分（但没有Point Star），同时也允许卡比（Kirby）收集他的钥匙。

整个游戏中只有一个Dethskullk King，出现在关卡The Haunted Ship的接近尾声处。
wikirby-page:23850.description_en:
“This guy is kind of a big deal. He's the solid-gold leader of the Dethskullk gang. Next time you get trapped in a pirate ship, you're probably gonna need to get the key from this guy. Good luck with that.”
— Figurine description of Dethskullk King from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dethskullk King is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. Like his normal counterparts, he floats around erratically, and upon spotting 卡比（Kirby）, slowly chases after him. The Dethskullk King also carries a key around his neck. Touching the Dethskullk King will instantly K.O. 卡比（Kirby） or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, regardless of how much health they had at the time, so he should generally be avoided. The only way to defeat him is through the use of an Invincible Candy, thereby scoring 500 points (but no Point Stars), but also allowing 卡比（Kirby） to collect his key.

There is only one Dethskullk King in the entire game, appearing near the end of the stage The Haunted Ship.

wikirby-page:23839.description_zh:
“这个Cotta配有一台钻机，他用它来，你知道的，钻东西。他曾经试图钻取宝藏，但那块粘土实在太硬，把他的钻头弄坏了。不幸的是，破坏的还不止这些——它还伤了他的心。”
— Figurine对Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中Drill Cotta的描述
Drill Cotta是一种敌人，只在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中出现。他固定在一个地方，一旦发现卡比（Kirby），就会朝钻头所指的方向冲去，一边冲刺一边穿过软粘土或沙子，然后一旦撞到坚硬障碍物就永久卡住。当头部被攻击时，可以很容易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛击败，但尝试攻击钻头只会导致攻击者受到伤害。有两种不同大小的Drill Cotta；较小的只需一击即可击败，奖励100分和3个Point Star，而较大的需要两击才能击败，奖励500分和10颗点星。

Drill Cotta仅出现在关卡Dig and Dash。
wikirby-page:23839.description_en:
“This Cotta comes with a drill, which he uses to, you know, drill. He tried to drill for treasure once, but that clay was just too hard and broke his drill. Unfortunately, it did even more than that—it broke his heart.”
— Figurine description of Drill Cotta from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Drill Cotta is an enemy which exclusively appears in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He stays in one place, and upon spotting 卡比（Kirby）, charges in the direction his drill is facing, digging through soft clay or sand as he does so, then gets permanently stuck once he hits a solid obstacle. He can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear when struck in the head, though attempting to attack the drill bit will only result in the attacker taking damage. There are two different sizes of Drill Cotta; the smaller one is defeated in one hit and awards 100 points and 3 Point Stars, while the bigger one takes two hits to defeat and awards 500 points and 10 Point Stars.

Drill Cotta appears exclusively in the stage Dig and Dash.

wikirby-page:24664.description_zh:
“这个小生物比看起来更脆弱——你一碰它它就会爆炸。这并不是容易的生活，但这就是它生来的使命。”
— Figurine对Explortle的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Explortle是一种敌人，它首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。一旦Kirby Tank靠近，它会从空中的随机位置出现，持续停留在一个地方或向一个方向漂移。被Kirby Tank击中一次即可击败它，击败后会爆炸，摧毁任何被冲击波波及的方块并击败任何敌人。击败Explortle还会奖励100分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Explortle仅出现在关卡Woodland Battle中，尽管它也可以在其他地方找到在Challenge Mode的几个阶段。
wikirby-page:24664.description_en:
“This little creature is more delicate than it looks—it'll explode the second you touch it. It's not an easy life, but that's what it was born to do.”
— Figurine description of Explortle from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Explortle is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It emerges from a random spot in midair once Kirby Tank gets close enough, continuously staying in one place or drifting in one direction. It takes one hit from Kirby Tank to defeat, and explodes once defeated, breaking any blocks and defeating any enemies caught in the blast. Defeating Explortle also awards 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Explortle appears exclusively in the stage Woodland Battle, though it can also be found in a few stages in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:24665.description_zh:
“这个Bzztbulb跳上了一只缆车去兜风，但他从未弄清楚如何从车辆中退出。现在他每天都在荡来荡去，没有什么大问题要报告，非常感谢。”
— Figurine对Gondola Bzztbulb的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Gondola Bzztbulb。Gondola Bzztbulb是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。他要么停留在一个地方，要么沿缆车线路行驶，定期用缆车绳电击来伤害卡比（Kirby）。可以使用Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛来击败他，给予玩家100点积分和3个Point Star。在击败Gondola Bzztbulb后，卡比（Kirby）可以乘坐他的缆车，前提是他能够到达（通常只在Challenge Mode）。
wikirby-page:24665.description_en:
“This Bzztbulb hopped into a gondola to take it for a joyride, but he never figured out how to exit the vehicle. Now he spends his days swinging around and has no major issues to report, thank you very much.”
— Figurine description of Gondola Bzztbulb from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Gondola Bzztbulb is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He either stays in one place or rides along the gondola line, periodically electrifying the rope his gondola is attached on to damage 卡比（Kirby）. He can be defeated by using a Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear, conferring 100 points and 3 Point Stars to the player. After defeating Gondola Bzztbulb, 卡比（Kirby） can ride in his gondola, assuming he is reachable in the first place (typically only in Challenge Mode).

wikirby-page:11607.description_zh:
“在多人游戏过程中，Grab Hand会出现并攻击卡比（Kirby）。只要Waddle Dees攻击并击败Grab Hand，卡比（Kirby）就可以继续前进。”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse电子手册，第15页
Grab Hand是来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的敌人。他是Dark Crafter的化身，并且如果有Waddle Dees帮助他，会尝试追赶并抓住卡比（Kirby）。能否击退Grab Hand取决于Waddle Dees的行动，因为卡比（Kirby）自身无法应对该生物；抓手可以抓住卡比（Kirby），即使他正在使用Touch Dash或Star Dash攻击他们。如果卡比（Kirby）被Grab Hand绑架并带离屏幕，他将自动失去一条生命。如果瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）接触到Grab Hand，他将投掷他们在同一个房间里消失。

“抓手”在大多数多人游戏关卡中都会出现的一部分，它们会阻止卡比（Kirby）向前移动，直到被击败，击败后奖励100分和15个Point Star。它们不会出现在Deploy the Kirby Tank!、The Haunted Ship、Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time、Kirby Rocket's Big Blastoff、Woodland Battle、Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine、“重返战舰”、Kirby + Kirby或任何Boss关卡。在它们出现的关卡中，Burning Secrets是唯一一个在多人游戏中出现两次独立Grab Hand遭遇的关卡。

在开场过场动画中，可以看到两个抓手试图抓住艾莉妮（Elline），直到卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）将它们赶走。两个抓手也可以看到附着在被附身的黏土西亚（Claycia）身上，并协助她制造在整个战斗中使用的雕塑。它们也出现在Dark Crafter本人身上，当他从黏土西亚（Claycia）出现时，这表明它们是他的手；在Dark Crafter被击败后，它们很可能被摧毁。
wikirby-page:11607.description_en:
“During multiplayer gameplay, Grab Hand will appear and attack 卡比（Kirby）. 卡比（Kirby） can progress as long as Waddle Dees attack and defeat Grab Hand.”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse electronic manual, page 15
Grab Hand is an enemy from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is an incarnation of Dark Crafter, and will try to chase and grab 卡比（Kirby） if there are Waddle Dees helping him. It is up to the Waddle Dees to knock the Grab Hand away, as 卡比（Kirby） cannot deal with the creature by himself; Grab Hands can grab 卡比（Kirby） even while he is attacking them with a Touch Dash or Star Dash. If 卡比（Kirby） is abducted and carried off-screen by a Grab Hand, he will automatically lose a life. If a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） touches a Grab Hand, he will toss them away in the same room.

Grab Hands appear in one portion of most stages during multiplayer gameplay, and will prevent 卡比（Kirby） from moving forward until they are defeated, rewarding 100 points and 15 Point Stars. They do not appear in Deploy the Kirby Tank!, The Haunted Ship, Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time, Kirby Rocket's Big Blastoff, Woodland Battle, Deep-Divin' Kirby Submarine, Back to the Battleship, Kirby + Kirby or any boss stage. In the stages they appear in, Burning Secrets is the only one to feature two separate Grab Hand encounters in multiplayer.

Two Grab Hands are seen in the intro cutscene trying to grab 艾莉妮（Elline） before 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） drive them off. Two Grab Hands can also be seen attached to 黏土西亚（Claycia） while she is possessed and assist her in making sculptures used throughout the fight. They are also seen on Dark Crafter himself once he emerges from 黏土西亚（Claycia）, suggesting that they are his hands; they are likely destroyed after Dark Crafter's defeat.

wikirby-page:23844.description_zh:
“有些敌人为了尊重而行动，但Grinkey是为了追逐的刺激。他花了太多时间逃避那些想要开门的人，以至于从来不记得锁自己的门。”
— Figurine对Grinkey的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Grinkey是一种敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他四处乱飞，试图躲避卡比（Kirby）。需要三次被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛击中才能击败Grinkey，击败后他会变成普通的Key，并奖励500分和3个Point Star。
wikirby-page:23844.description_en:
“Some enemies do it for respect, but Grinkey is in it for the thrill of the chase. He spends so much time running away from people who want to unlock doors that he never remembers to lock his own door.”
— Figurine description of Grinkey from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Grinkey is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He flies around erratically, trying to avoid 卡比（Kirby）. It takes three hits from 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear to defeat Grinkey, upon which he becomes a regular Key, along with rewarding 500 points and 3 Point Stars.

wikirby-page:23845.description_zh:
“这个Cotta是以一种积极进取的态度设计的。但每台需要30个Bzztbulb才能运行，所以它实际上并不太经济。而且，当涉及到战斗时，它的心并不在其中。”
— Figurine对Mecha Cotta的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Mecha Cotta，它是一个敌人，同时也是Cotta的一种形式，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。它没有自己的攻击，只是漫无目的地游荡。它的身体由三部分组成：面部、顶部和背部。摧毁每一部分会显示内部的电气危险。Mecha Cotta一旦外壳的三部分全部被摧毁就被击败；面部需要四次攻击，其他两部分各需要两次攻击。这还会奖励500分和10个Point Star。
wikirby-page:23845.description_en:
“This Cotta was designed with a can-do attitude. But it takes 30 Bzztbulbs to keep each one running, so it's not really all that cost effective. Plus, when it comes to fighting, its heart really isn't in it.”
— Figurine description of Mecha Cotta from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Mecha Cotta is an enemy and a form of Cotta that first appears in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It has no attacks of its own, and simply wanders around aimlessly. Its body consists of three parts: its face, its top, and its back. Destroying each part reveals an electric hazard on the inside. Mecha Cotta is defeated once all three parts of its outer shell are destroyed; the face taking four hits and the other two sections taking two hits each. This also awards 500 points and 10 Point Stars.

wikirby-page:23852.description_zh:
“这种生物喜欢无缘无故地向可怜的小卡比（Kirby）发射鱼雷。而且他不是为了报酬——他只是为了好玩。这几乎就像对他来说只是一种游戏。”
— Figurine对Mini Deepsee来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的描述
Mini Deepsee是一种海葵状敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。它固定在一个地方，追踪卡比（Kirby）的位置，并周期性地发射沿直线移动的导弹。击中Kirby Submarine两次即可击败Mini Deepsee，导弹本身在碰到彩虹绳时也可以被摧毁。击败Mini Deepsee可获得100点积分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Mini Deepsee只在Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time出现，虽然他也出现在Challenge Mode.
wikirby-page:23852.description_en:
“This creature loves to fire torpedoes at poor little 卡比（Kirby） for no good reason at all. And he's not getting paid to do this—he does it for fun. It's almost like it's just some sort of game to him.”
— Figurine description of Mini Deepsee from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Mini Deepsee is a sea anemone-like enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He stays in one place, tracking 卡比（Kirby）'s position and periodically shooting missiles that move in straight lines. It takes two hits from Kirby Submarine to defeat Mini Deepsee, and the missiles themselves can be destroyed when they hit a rainbow rope. Mini Deepsee awards 100 points and 3 Point Stars when defeated.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Mini Deepsee appears only in Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time, though he also appears in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:24671.description_zh:
“Shieldster真不想让你越过他。他会阻挡你每一次尝试，只是为了证明他比你强。经过他身边时尽量不要直视他的眼睛。他有一种令人毛骨悚然的凝视。”
— Figurine关于Shieldster的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Shieldster，他是一个只在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中出现的敌人。他往往会突然出现，在走廊中巡逻，手持一个即便对其他敌人也危险的盾牌。当发现卡比（Kirby）时，Shieldster会高度警觉并冲上去防守位置。从背后攻击他时，需要卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛击打三次才能击败Shieldster。然而，用这种方式击败他只能暂时击倒他，他大约在10秒后会重新站起来。要永久击败他，需要用Star Dash或Cannon射击。当以这种方式击败时，Shieldster会奖励100分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Shieldster只会出现在Wonder Space关卡，但他也会在Challenge Mode中出现。
wikirby-page:24671.description_en:
“Shieldster really doesn't want you to get past him. He's going to block each and every one of your attempts, just to prove he's stronger than you. Try not to look him right in the eye as you go by. He's got a creepy stare.”
— Figurine description of Shieldster from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Shieldster is an enemy which exclusively appears in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He tends to appear out of nowhere to patrol a hallway, carrying in front of him a shield that is hazardous to touch, even to other enemies. When spotting 卡比（Kirby）, Shieldster will go on high alert and rush to defend the position. When attacked from behind, it takes three hits from 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear to defeat Shieldster. However, defeating him this way will only knock him down temporarily, and he will get back up after about 10 seconds. To defeat him permanently, a Star Dash or shot from a Cannon is needed. When defeated this way, Shieldster rewards 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Shieldster only appears in the stage Wonder Space, but he also makes an appearance in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:24670.description_zh:
“这些不同寻常的生物可以以电的形式储存能量，这是非常惊人的。然而，它们所做的只是无目的地爬行，这是完全浪费时间和精力。”
— Figurine对Shockcreepa来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的描述
Shockcreepa是一种敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中，类似于一个高大的无定形紫色团块，带有类似卡比（Kirby）风格的黄色脸。它会出现在坚固地面的随机位置，并在地板、墙壁和天花板上无目的地移动。Shockcreepa即使攻击也很危险，而击败它的唯一方法是使用Invincible Candy。以这种方式击败它可以获得100分和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Shockcreepa出现只出现在Infiltrate the Junk Factory!中，但它也出现在一些Challenge Mode阶段。
wikirby-page:24670.description_en:
“These unusual creatures can store energy in the form of electricity, which is a pretty amazing thing. But all they do is creep around aimlessly, and that is a complete waste of time and energy.”
— Figurine description of Shockcreepa from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Shockcreepa is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, resembling a tall amorphous purple blob with a yellow face similar in style to 卡比（Kirby）'s. It appears in a random spot on solid ground, and aimlessly moves along floors, walls, and ceilings. Shockcreepa is hazardous even to attack, and the only way to defeat it is through the use of an Invincible Candy. Defeating it in this way awards 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Shockcreepa appears only in Infiltrate the Junk Factory!, but it also appears in a few Challenge Mode stages.

wikirby-page:23922.description_zh:
“这个家伙唯一开始练习投矛的原因是为了练习从风语大树（Whispy Woods）摘取美味的苹果。没有人想告诉他，这个世界上的风语大树（Whispy Woods）并不长苹果。”
— Figurine关于Spear Cotta的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Spear Cotta，Spear Cotta是一个敌人，首次出现于Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他通常呆在一个地方，向卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）投掷矛。尽管矛触碰起来很危险，但Spear Cotta本人却可以轻易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）自己的矛击败，击败后可获得100分和3个Point Star。

他的手办描述称，他练习投矛是为了可以从风语大树（Whispy Woods）获取苹果，尽管如此后者（或他的一种版本）不在Seventopia种苹果。
wikirby-page:23922.description_en:
“The only reason this guy took up spear throwing was to practice snagging delicious apples from 风语大树（Whispy Woods）. No one wants to tell him that the 风语大树（Whispy Woods） on this world doesn't grow apples.”
— Figurine description of Spear Cotta from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Spear Cotta is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He usually stays in one place, hurling spears at 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. Despite the spears being hazardous to touch, Spear Cotta himself can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s own spear, awarding 100 points and 3 Point Stars on defeat.

His figurine description states that he took up spear throwing so he could practice getting apples from 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, despite that the latter (or a version of him) does not grow apples in Seventopia.

wikirby-page:23976.description_zh:
“一旦这个圆滚滚的家伙拿到那顶花哨的头盔，他就停止关注作为一个Spear Cotta Knight最重要的部分——投矛。他现在的瞄准真的很差。”
— Figurine对Spear Cotta Knight的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Spear Cotta Knight是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。他通常待在一个地方，向卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）投掷矛。矛接触起来很危险，而Spear Cotta Knight本身对卡比（Kirby）的普通Touch Dash和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）自己的矛免疫。卡比（Kirby）必须使用Star Dash或类似的东西将他击倒。击败Spear Cotta Knight可获得100点和10个Point Star。

Spear Cotta Knight仅出现在The Wild Red Yonder。可以看到其中两个试图在卡比（Kirby）被大炮发射飞过时向他投掷长矛，但投得非常不准，从而解释了他们的小雕像描述。
wikirby-page:23976.description_en:
“As soon as this round fellow got his hands on that fancy helmet, he stopped focusing on the important part of being a Spear Cotta Knight—the spear throwing. His aim is really bad now.”
— Figurine description of Spear Cotta Knight from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Spear Cotta Knight is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He usually stays in one place, hurling spears at 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）. The spears are hazardous to touch, and Spear Cotta Knight himself is immune to 卡比（Kirby）'s regular Touch Dash and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s own spear. 卡比（Kirby） must take him out using a Star Dash or something comparable. Defeating Spear Cotta Knight grants 100 points and 10 Point Stars.

Spear Cotta Knight appears only in The Wild Red Yonder. Two of them can be seen trying to toss their spears at 卡比（Kirby） as he flies by after being shot from a cannon, but miss quite badly, thus explaining their figurine description.

wikirby-page:24662.description_zh:
“运动精灵完全是关于结识新朋友和游览新地方，因此当他们一看到卡比（Kirby）就必须跟随他也就不足为奇了。粉色运动精灵是该物种中最稀有的。”
— Figurine对Sportle出自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sportle的描述是，一个敌人只出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse，并且只在Woodland Battle关卡中出现。当Kirby Tank靠近足够近时，它会从空中随机位置出现，并持续锁定卡比（Kirby）。需要Kirby Tank击中两次才能击败它，击败后会分裂成两个Sportletini。它本身不会奖励任何积分。它的手办描述指出有稀有的粉色运动精灵，但游戏中运动精灵唯一的颜色是红色。in-game是红色。
wikirby-page:24662.description_en:
“Sportles are all about meeting new people and seeing new places, so it should come as no surprise that they simply must follow 卡比（Kirby） the second they spot him. Pink Sportles are the rarest of the species.”
— Figurine description of Sportle from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sportle is an enemy which exclusively appears in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, and is only found in the Woodland Battle stage. It emerges from a random spot from the air once the Kirby Tank gets close enough, continuously homing in on 卡比（Kirby）. It takes two hits from the Kirby Tank to defeat, and splits into two Sportletinis once defeated. It does not reward any points on its own. Its figurine description states that there are rare pink Sportles, but the only color Sportles have in-game is red.

wikirby-page:24663.description_zh:
“如果你击败一个Sportle，它会变成一群这些小生物。没人知道如何把它们拼回去，但它们似乎并不介意。我们可以从它们身上学到很多关于不要活在过去的道理。”
— Figurine对Sportletini的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sportletini。Sportletini是一个敌人，首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse。它不是自然出现的，而是从被击败的Sportle分裂出来并乱飞。只需一次Kirby Tank的攻击即可击败它，奖励100分和3个Point Star。

Sportletini从Sportle出现，而Sportle只出现在关卡Woodland Battle。
wikirby-page:24663.description_en:
“If you defeat a Sportle, it'll turn into a bunch of these little creatures. No one knows how to put them back together, but they don't seem to mind. We could learn a lot from them about not living in the past.”
— Figurine description of Sportletini from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Sportletini is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. Rather than appearing naturally, it splits apart from a defeated Sportle and flies around erratically. It takes one hit from Kirby Tank to defeat, awarding 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

Sportletini emerges from Sportle, who only appears in the stage Woodland Battle.

wikirby-page:24669.description_zh:
“年轻的桑斯比认为自己了不起，但中年的桑斯比无疑更有智慧。而年老的桑斯比根本不在乎你对他们的看法。”
— Figurine对Thornsby从Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的描述
Thornsby是一个敌人，它首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。它通常以三个或更多为一组固定在一个地方，虽然有时也会被看到向左或向右移动。棕色的桑斯比长有尖刺，触碰有危险，而黄色的桑斯比可以很容易被卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的矛击败。击败Thornsby可获得100点分数和3个Point Star。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Thornsby只出现在关卡Volcanic Panic中。它可以更频繁地在Challenge Mode.
wikirby-page:24669.description_en:
“The young Thornsbys think they're hot stuff, but the middle-aged Thornsbys definitely have more wisdom. And the old Thornsbys don't really care what you think about them.”
— Figurine description of Thornsby from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Thornsby is an enemy which made its first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It stays rooted in one place in a totem of three or more, though it is also sometimes seen shuffling to the left or right. While the brown Thornsbys are spiked and therefore hazardous to touch, the yellow Thornsbys can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear. Defeating Thornsby confers 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

In the 故事模式（Story Mode）, Thornsby appears only in the stage Volcanic Panic. It can however be encountered more frequently in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:23856.description_zh:
“这名雇佣枪手会为出价最高的人工作，因此黏土西亚（Claycia）支付给他一份合理的工资。但这工作相当危险。在这种疯狂的环境下，他能撑多久谁也不知道！”
— Figurine对Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中Trakker的描述
Trakker是一个敌人，他首次出现在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中。他悬浮在一个地方，一旦发现卡比（Kirby），就会追踪他的位置，定期发射追踪他的导弹。卡比（Kirby）的Touch Dash或瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的长矛可以轻松打败他，而导弹本身在击中彩虹绳时也可以被摧毁。打败Trakker可以获得100点和3个Point Star。

Trakker仅出现在关卡Rainbow Across the Skies.

在第19页的Secret Diary中，标题为“垃圾电视”，节目中展示了一个标注为“戏剧”的Trakker，扮演西部对决中的牛仔角色，看起来类似于Quick Draw来自星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）.
wikirby-page:23856.description_en:
“This gun-for-hire will work for the highest bidder, so 黏土西亚（Claycia） pays him a fair wage. But this is pretty dangerous work. Who knows how long he can last under these crazy conditions!”
— Figurine description of Trakker from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Trakker is an enemy which made his first appearance in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He hovers in one place, and upon spotting 卡比（Kirby）, tracks his position, periodically firing missiles that home in on him. He can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s Touch Dash or 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s spear, and the missiles themselves can be destroyed when they hit a rainbow rope. Defeating Trakker confers 100 points and 3 Point Stars.

Trakker appears exclusively in the stage Rainbow Across the Skies.

In page 19 of the Secret Diary, titled "Junk TV", a Trakker is depicted in the show labeled "Drama", taking the role of a cowboy in a western showdown that looks similar to Quick Draw from 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）.

wikirby-page:46181.description_zh:
“这些坏蛋用它们的舌头舀起面前的任何东西，然后在另一个地方吐出来。它们一定认为卡比（Kirby）尝起来像棉花糖，因为它们一次又一次地吞下他！”
— Figurine从Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Warpspace对Warpspace的描述是，一个大而方形的生物，在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中作为一个无敌的舞台危险和装置，特别是在关卡Wonder Space中。它固定在原地等待以卡比（Kirby）形式出现的“食物”滚到它面前。当这种情况发生时，它会用舌头将卡比（Kirby）舔起来，然后通过尾巴将他射到另一个位置，就像从Cannon发射一样。这个过程不会伤害卡比（Kirby），并且是有时为了在关卡中取得进展是必要的，但更多时候，被Warpspace吃掉是一种阻碍，因为这通常会导致卡比（Kirby）被送回到之前的区域。

在故事模式（Story Mode）中，Warpspace仅在关卡Wonder Space中出现。它也可以在Challenge Mode中找到。
wikirby-page:46181.description_en:
“These baddies use their tongues to scoop up anything in front of them and spit them out in another place. They must think 卡比（Kirby） tastes like cotton candy, because they keep swallowing him over and over!”
— Figurine description of Warpspace from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
