Warpspace is a large squarish creature that serves as an invincible stage hazard and device in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, particularly in the level Wonder Space. It sits in place and waits for a meal in the form of 卡比（Kirby） to come rolling in front of it. When this happens, it laps 卡比（Kirby） up with its tongue, then ejects him through its tail in a different location, shooting him straight as if being launched from a Cannon. This process cannot harm 卡比（Kirby）, and is sometimes necessary to make progress through the stage, but more often than not, getting eaten by Warpspace is a hindrance, as it often leads to 卡比（Kirby） being sent back to a previous area.

In 故事模式（Story Mode）, Warpspace appears exclusively in the stage Wonder Space. It can also be found in Challenge Mode.

wikirby-page:23921.description_zh:
“最初设计用于游船旅游，这个飞行怪物现在是一艘巨型战舰。曾经有建造第二艘的计划，但你知道现在黏土的价格是多少吗？比你想象的还高。”
— Figurine关于Bastron的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bastron是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的一个中小Boss和阶段障碍。它是一艘巨大的飞行紫色战舰，整体轮廓像一个橡胶鸭，但嘴巴的位置长出了一个大鼻子。它的身体像一个钟形，背部敞开的地方有一个小插口。Bastron由黏土西亚（Claycia）建造，最初的目的是用于游船旅游，但在被Dark Crafter接管后，它被改造为战斗舰，并装备了几门炮。
wikirby-page:23921.description_en:
“Originally designed for pleasure cruises, this flying monstrosity is now a giant battleship. There were plans to build a second one, but do you have any idea how much clay costs nowadays? More than you'd think.”
— Figurine description of Bastron from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Bastron is a mid-boss and stage-hazard in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. It is a giant flying purple battleship with the general profile of a rubber ducky, but with a large snout in place of a beak. Its body is shaped like a bell, with a small plug in its open back. Bastron was built by 黏土西亚（Claycia） with the original intent being to use it for pleasure cruises, but after she was taken over by Dark Crafter, it was repurposed into a combat vessel and outfitted with several cannons.

wikirby-page:23853.description_zh:
“当迷你（Mini）Deepsee长大后会发生这种情况。它看起来像是与某种其他生物共生，但我完全不知道是什么。我敢打赌黏土西亚（Claycia）知道！有人绝对应该去问她。”
— Figurine来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse对Deepsee的描述
Deepsee是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的一个中Boss，外观像绿色和黄色相间的海葵，有粉色触手，盘踞在一个大寄居蟹的壳上。Deepsee悬挂在上方的墙壁和天花板附近，它的主要攻击方式是在移动到某个地方的同时迅速射击每个停留点的一个导弹。它还会偶尔在一段时间后召唤一个蛙镜鱼（Blipper）。当它受到足够多Kirby Submarine的鱼雷，可获得1000分，但掉落时没有Point Star。

Deepsee仅出现在Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time阶段。
wikirby-page:23853.description_en:
“This is what happens to a 迷你（Mini） Deepsee when it grows up. It looks like it lives in symbiosis with some other creature, but I have no idea what. I bet 黏土西亚（Claycia） would know! Someone should totally go ask her.”
— Figurine description of Deepsee from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Deepsee is a mid-boss in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse who resembles a green and yellow striped sea anemone with pink tentacles, which sits upon a large hermit crab's shell. The Deepsee hangs near the upper walls and ceiling, and its main attack consists of moving to a certain place very quickly while shooting one missile from each place it stops at. It also occasionally summons one 蛙镜鱼（Blipper） after a while. It is defeated when it takes enough hits from Kirby Submarine's torpedoes, conferring 1000 points, but no Point Stars when it falls.

Deepsee appears exclusively in the Kirby Submarine's Torpedo Time stage.

wikirby-page:10337.description_zh:
“这个神秘生物控制了黏土西亚（Claycia）的身体，然后试图戴上太阳镜伪装自己。他想偷走梦境乐园的绚丽色彩并统治世界，但卡比（Kirby）阻止了那件事！”
— Figurine对Dark Crafter的描述来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dark Crafter是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的一个Boss。他是游戏的最终Boss，紧接着黏土西亚（Claycia）战斗，被控制的方式类似于早期游戏中的暗物质（Dark Matter）。
wikirby-page:10337.description_en:
“This mysterious being took control of 黏土西亚（Claycia）'s body and then tried to disguise himself with sunglasses. He wanted to steal the vibrant colors from Dream Land and take over the world, but 卡比（Kirby） put a stop to that!”
— Figurine description of Dark Crafter from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Dark Crafter is a boss from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse. He is the final boss of the game, fought directly after 黏土西亚（Claycia）, having been possessing her in a manner similar to 暗物质（Dark Matter） from earlier games.

wikirby-page:9795.description_zh:
“黏土西亚（Claycia）参考了一些古代蓝图来雕刻这个新敌人。她甚至使用了古代粘土来赋予它那种复古的感觉，但不要告诉Hooplagoon。他认为自己很酷，很现代。”
— 美国英语中由Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Hooplagoon描述的玩偶是Kirby and the Rainbow Curse中的一个老板，出现在Yellow Dunes和Orange Woodland的结尾。它由黏土西亚（Claycia）用古老的粘土制作，并被赋予任务，去消灭所有遇到的入侵者。
wikirby-page:9795.description_en:
“黏土西亚（Claycia） turned to some ancient blueprints in order to sculpt this new enemy. She even used ancient clay to give it that old-world feel, but don't tell Hooplagoon that. He thinks he's all cool and modern.”
— American English figurine description from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
Hooplagoon is a boss from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, appearing at the end of both Yellow Dunes and Orange Woodland. He was built by 黏土西亚（Claycia） using ancient clay, and tasked to destroy any intruders he encountered.

wikirby-page:11596.description_zh:
“你不想惹The Claykken，否则他会追着你——我可不是在开玩笑！他可能是个大坏蛋，但他使用他的墨管只是为了最无害的目的：他喜欢吹海泡泡。”
— Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
The Claykken是来自Kirby and the Rainbow Curse的老板，出现在Indigo Ocean和Red Volcano的结尾。他看起来像一只巨型鱿鱼，他的名字是一个基于粘土的搞笑双关。
wikirby-page:11596.description_en:
“You don't want to get all up in The Claykken's ink, or he'll come after you—and I'm not squiddin'! He may be a baddie, but he only uses his pipe for the most innocent of purposes: he likes to blow sea-foam bubbles.”
— American English figurine description from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
The Claykken is a boss from Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, appearing at the end of Indigo Ocean and Red Volcano. He resembles a giant squid, with his name being a clay-based pun on The Kraken.

wikirby-page:66779.description_zh: Magolor是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的半经常出现的配角，首次登场于Kirby's Labyrinth Rescue!，并最近一次出现在卡比（Kirby）：《快来欢乐魔法乐园！》。每个故事对Magolor的描写各不相同，尽管所有描写都与主视频游戏中的形象有共通之处。
wikirby-page:66779.description_en: Magolor is a semi-recurring supporting character in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, debuting in Kirby's Labyrinth Rescue!, and appearing most recently in 卡比（Kirby）: Come On Over to Merry Magoland!. Each story portrays Magolor in a different way, though all of them share commonalities with the main video game incarnation.

wikirby-form:9044.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9044.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9044.description_zh:
“及时的法师！保持距离，用时间光束（Beam）破解敌人的防御！”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe描述
魔法光束（Beam Mage）是Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash及其扩展中可以扮演的四个角色之一，Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）。它基于光束（Beam），但有一些显著的区别。光束（Beam）卡比（Kirby）戴着小丑帽，而魔法光束（Beam Mage）卡比（Kirby）戴着尖尖的巫师帽，手持魔法杖。魔法光束（Beam Mage）也是招式的一个非常简化的变体，只有四种攻击选项。然而，有一个特殊招式称为“时间光束（Beam）”，它有三个蓄力等级，可以在敌人身上积累效果。一旦效果满值，敌人（以及计时器)被冻结较长时间，使卡比（Kirby）团队可以自由造成伤害。每次卡比（Kirby）团队在一次战斗中冻结时间时，再次冻结时间会变得更加困难。魔法光束（Beam Mage）卡比（Kirby）还可以使用Revival Spell复活倒下的队友，但这会消耗少量生命值（尽管这不会直接击倒魔法光束（Beam Mage）卡比（Kirby））。
wikirby-form:9044.description_en:
“The timely mage! Keep your distance, and break enemy defenses with a Time 光束（Beam）!”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe description
魔法光束（Beam Mage） is one of the four roles that can be taken on in the Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash and its expansions, Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is based on 光束（Beam）, though it bears some noteworthy differences. Whereas 光束（Beam） 卡比（Kirby） dons a jester cap, 魔法光束（Beam Mage） 卡比（Kirby） has a pointy wizard's hat and wields a magical staff. 魔法光束（Beam Mage） is also a very simplified variant of the moveset, only containing four offensive options. However, there is a special move known as 'Time 光束（Beam）', which has three levels of charge and can build up an effect in the enemy. Once that effect is full, the enemy (and the timer) is frozen for an extended period of time, allowing Team 卡比（Kirby） to deal damage freely. Each time Team 卡比（Kirby） freezes time in a single battle, it becomes more difficult to do so again. 魔法光束（Beam Mage） 卡比（Kirby） can also revive a fallen teammate using the Revival Spell, but this costs a small amount of health to perform (although this cannot outright KO 魔法光束（Beam Mage） 卡比（Kirby）).

wikirby-form:8484.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:8484.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:8484.description_zh:
“精通医学和科学，医生（Doctor）卡比（Kirby）拥有多种快速而致命的攻击！”
— 暂停屏幕文本
医生（Doctor）是游戏星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中引入的复制能力（Copy Ability）。卡比（Kirby）可以通过吸入并吞下Chemitory（胶囊形分配敌人）或吞下它扔向卡比（Kirby）的药丸来获得这种能力。获得此能力后，卡比（Kirby）穿上白大褂，佩戴头灯和一副圆形蓝色眼镜。

卡比（Kirby）在开发此能力后获得各种攻击。他的主要攻击是向敌人投掷药丸，类似于Super Smash Bros.游戏中的Dr. Mario。他还获得了旋转绷带的能力，可以用巨型剪贴板，可以用注射器向上发射，并且可以调制化学混合物。

这个能力最独特的动作可能是科学实验室动作，它允许卡比（Kirby）创造四种化学混合物中的一种。一种是火药水，可以喷出强烈的火焰。另一种是冰药水，可以冻结卡比（Kirby）上方的敌人。第三种是电力混合物，以喷泉般的方式发射几个小型电器投射物。最后，也是最稀有的一种（在某些模式下不可用），是一种绿色混合物，卡比（Kirby）饮用它来恢复Health。三种进攻性的药水都可以用于其相应的元素难题，使这一能力非常多才多艺。一旦他已经酿好了，或者他可以Guard或在释放前跳跃以便稍后使用。
wikirby-form:8484.description_en:
“Knowledgeable in medicine and the sciences, 医生（Doctor） 卡比（Kirby） has a variety of quick and devastating attacks!”
— Pause screen text
医生（Doctor） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） introduced in the game 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. 卡比（Kirby） can obtain this ability by inhaling and swallowing Chemitory, the capsule-shaped dispensary enemy, or by swallowing the pills it throws at 卡比（Kirby）. When acquiring this ability, 卡比（Kirby） sports a white coat, a headlamp, and a pair of round blue glasses.

卡比（Kirby） gains a variety of attacks when developing this ability. His primary attack involves throwing pills at enemies, in a similar vein to Dr. Mario from the Super Smash Bros. games. He also gains a bandage twirling ability, can hit enemies with a giant clipboard, can fire upward with a syringe, and brew chemical concoctions.

Perhaps the most unique move of this ability is the Science Lab move, which allows 卡比（Kirby） to create one of four chemical concoctions. One is a fire potion, which spouts a powerful flame. Another is an ice potion that freezes enemies above 卡比（Kirby）. The third is an electric concoction that fires several small electric projectiles in a fountain-like manner. The last, and by far the rarest (unavailable in some modes), is a green concoction that 卡比（Kirby） drinks to recover Health. All three of the offensive brews can be used on their respective elemental puzzles, making this ability very versatile. 卡比（Kirby） will automatically use the concoction once he is done brewing it, or he can Guard or jump before releasing to store it for later use.

wikirby-form:9046.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9046.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9046.description_zh:
“具有治疗能力的学者！攻击力弱，但治疗区域让队友能够继续战斗！”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe描述
治愈医生（Doctor Healmore）是Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash及其扩展Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中可以担任的四个角色之一。它基于医生（Doctor），但有一些显著区别。治愈医生（Doctor Healmore）不像现代医生，而更像文艺复兴时期的学者，会投掷宝石而非药丸。此外，取代“药丸投掷者”技能的是一个区域治疗技能，会在地面上投下一个水洼，任何踏入其中的队友都能获得治疗。该技能有三个充能，充能时间越长，水洼越大、持续时间越长、治疗效果越强。治愈医生（Doctor Healmore）卡比（Kirby）还可以使用Revival Spell复活倒下的队友，并且在这一点上比其他三个角色更有效。
wikirby-form:9046.description_en:
“The scholar with the healing power! Weak in attack, but Healing Area lets teammates fight on!”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe description
治愈医生（Doctor Healmore） is one of the four roles that can be taken on in the Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash and its expansions, Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is based on 医生（Doctor）, though it bears some noteworthy differences. Rather than resembling a modern doctor, 治愈医生（Doctor Healmore） resembles a scholar from the Renaissance, and throws jewels rather than pills. In addition, in place of the 'Pill Bopper' move is an area healing move that tosses a puddle onto the ground which heals any party member who steps in it. This move has three charges, with longer charges leading to bigger puddles that last longer and heal more. 治愈医生（Doctor Healmore） 卡比（Kirby） can also revive a fallen teammate using the Revival Spell, and is more effective at it than the other three roles.

wikirby-form:8517.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:8517.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:8517.description_zh:
“这种心灵动力能力允许你隐身并产生令人震惊的电场，就像某个拥有超能力的男孩一样。这一科学领域仍largely未被探索。”
— 暂停超能力（ESP）在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的风格文字
超能力（ESP）是复制能力（Copy Ability），于星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）首次亮相。在获得此能力时，卡比（Kirby）获得了一顶蓝色棒球帽，红色帽檐倾斜戴在一侧，看起来类似于''EarthBound''中Ness的帽子。卡比（Kirby）还会从他的手中不断释放蓝色能量。

超能力（ESP）卡比（Kirby）能够瞬移短距离以避免伤害，可以控制一个在玩家视野内自由操控的能量球（类似于奇迹光束（Flare Beam）），并能用一次强大的心灵闪光。这些心灵攻击也可以传导电流以解决相关谜题。
wikirby-form:8517.description_en:
“This psychokinetic ability allows you to turn invisible and produce shocking electric fields, just like a certain boy with PSI. This field of science is still largely unexplored.”
— Pause flavor text of 超能力（ESP） in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
超能力（ESP） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. When acquiring this ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a blue baseball cap with red visor and tilted off to the side, which looks similar to the cap of Ness from ''EarthBound''. 卡比（Kirby） also emits constant blue energy from his hands.

超能力（ESP） 卡比（Kirby） is able to teleport short distances to avoid damage, can control a freely-steering ball of energy around the player's field of view (similar to 奇迹光束（Flare Beam）), and counter attacks with a large psychic flash. These psychic attacks can also conduct electricity to solve related puzzles.

wikirby-form:9041.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9041.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9041.description_zh:
“强大的战士！用锤子（Hammer）翻转碾压敌人，弥补灵活性不足！”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe描述
重锤子（Hammer Lord）是Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash及其扩展包Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中可以扮演的四个角色之一。它基于锤子（Hammer），尽管有一些显著的差异。默认服装是卡比（Kirby）戴着类似维京人的帽子，锤子带刺且由金属制成。由于这套装备，重锤子（Hammer Lord）卡比（Kirby）移动非常缓慢，几乎无法漂浮。他通过拥有四个角色中伤害最高的攻击来弥补这一点，其中包括改良版的锤子（Hammer）翻转。该变体有三级蓄力，第三级造成惊人的伤害。重锤子（Hammer Lord）卡比（Kirby）也可以使用Revival Spell复活倒下的队友，但执行此操作会消耗少量生命值（尽管这不能直接击倒重锤子（Hammer Lord）卡比（Kirby））。
wikirby-form:9041.description_en:
“The powerful warrior! Crushing enemies with 锤子（Hammer） Flip makes up for a lack of agility!”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe description
重锤子（Hammer Lord） is one of the four roles that can be taken on in the Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash and its expansions, Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is based on 锤子（Hammer）, though it bears some noteworthy differences. The default costume has 卡比（Kirby） wearing a Viking-like hat, and his hammer is spiked and made of metal. Due to this gear, 重锤子（Hammer Lord） 卡比（Kirby） is very slow, and cannot float very well at all. He makes up for this by boasting the most damaging attacks of all four roles, including a modified 锤子（Hammer） Flip. This variant has three levels of charge, the third of which deals incredible damage. 重锤子（Hammer Lord） 卡比（Kirby） can also revive a fallen teammate using the Revival Spell, but this costs a small amount of health to perform (although this cannot outright KO 重锤子（Hammer Lord） 卡比（Kirby）).

wikirby-form:8485.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:8485.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:8485.description_zh:
“这是对所有生命形式（有机的和其他的）来说相当危险的能力。它可以用含有有害物质的腐蚀性液体攻击敌人。”
— 星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停字幕（美式英语）
Poison是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），目前仅出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中。它可以通过吞下Venogg敌人、Dakuga敌人或战胜毒波洛斯（Miasmoros）中型首领后获得。当获得此能力时，卡比（Kirby）会获得一条饰有骷髅的头带，顶部会喷出有毒液体，与其他基于液体的帽子相似。头带的边缘颜色图案与珊瑚蛇非常相似，珊瑚蛇以其危险的毒液而闻名。

卡比（Kirby）通过的Poison能力与清水（Water）的能力类似。然而，它们中的许多功能与清水（Water）的对应能力不同，有些则是Poison独有的。这些攻击包括简单的喷射动作、喷泉类型的动作、一种允许卡比（Kirby）在水面滑行的冲浪动作、一系列类似Final Cutter的拳击动作以及吐出有毒气体的动作。尤其是气体云会持续一段时间，并且在某些关卡中可以被风力推动。独特的是，Poison的许多动作会在地面上留下Poison的水洼，如果敌人站在其中会受到伤害。同一时间最多可以存在四个这样的水洼。如果生成更多水洼，之前的水洼将消失。像的清水（Water）能力，所有来自Poison的攻击都能消除Flame Blocks.
wikirby-form:8485.description_en:
“This is a rather dangerous ability for all life-forms, organic and otherwise. It can be used to attack enemies with a corrosive liquid that contains damaging substances.”
— 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） pause caption (American English)
Poison is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that has so far appeared exclusively in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is obtained by swallowing a Venogg enemy, a Dakuga enemy, or the 毒波洛斯（Miasmoros） mid-boss after defeating it. When acquiring this ability, 卡比（Kirby） obtains a skull-adorned headband, with poisonous fluid spewing out the top, similar to other fluid-based hats. The rim of the headband has a color pattern very similar to that of coral snakes, which are known for their dangerous venom.

The attacks 卡比（Kirby） gains with the Poison ability are similar to the 清水（Water） ability. However, many of them function differently from 清水（Water）'s counterparts, and some are completely unique to Poison. Among these attacks are simple spewing moves, a geyser-type move, a surfing move that allows 卡比（Kirby） to glide over water, a Final Cutter-like series of punches involving Poison, and exhaling clouds of toxic gas. The gas clouds in particular linger for a good while, and can be pushed by wind currents in some stages. Uniquely, many of Poison's moves cause puddles of Poison to linger on the ground that harm enemies if they stand in them. Up to four of these puddles may linger around at a time. If more are created, previous puddles will disappear. Like the 清水（Water） ability, all attacks from Poison can put out Flame Blocks.

英雄利剑（Sword Hero），也曾被称为Blade英雄和英雄利剑（Sword），是Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash及其扩展包Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中可以扮演的四个角色之一。它基于利剑（Sword），但也有一些显著差异。与利剑（Sword）服装不同，卡比（Kirby）的装扮为骑士，配备头盔、剑和盾。此外，在执行Guard时，英雄利剑（Sword Hero）卡比（Kirby）会生成一个大型气泡盾，可以保护自己和队友。英雄利剑（Sword Hero）卡比（Kirby）还可以使用Revival Spell复活倒下的队友，但这需要a少量的生命值以执行（尽管这不能直接击倒英雄利剑（Sword Hero）卡比（Kirby））。
wikirby-form:9039.description_en:
“The master swordsman! Dash, slash, and protect your team with the Hero Shield!”
— Team Kirby Clash Deluxe description
英雄利剑（Sword Hero）, also once referred to as Blade Hero and Hero 利剑（Sword）, is one of the four roles that can be taken on in the Sub-Game Team Kirby Clash and its expansions, Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is based on 利剑（Sword）, though it bears some noteworthy differences. Unlike the 利剑（Sword） costume, 卡比（Kirby） is dressed as a knight, with a helmet, sword and shield. In addition, when performing a Guard, 英雄利剑（Sword Hero） 卡比（Kirby） creates a large bubble shield that can protect his teammates as well as himself. 英雄利剑（Sword Hero） 卡比（Kirby） can also revive a fallen teammate using the Revival Spell, but this costs a small amount of health to perform (although this cannot outright KO 英雄利剑（Sword Hero） 卡比（Kirby）).

机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）（在英式英语版本中解析为Robobot装甲）是一套可驾驶的机器人装甲，首次亮相于星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）。卡比（Kirby）在击败敌人Invader Armor后，或者在关卡的各个地方找到它存放的地方时，都会获得这套装甲并穿上它。在装甲内，卡比（Kirby）的耐力增加，大多数攻击造成的伤害减少，并且可以通过踩敌人来击败敌人，同时还能执行新的更强的攻击。此外，这套装甲还兼容某些复制能力（Copy Ability），能够以与卡比（Kirby）的吸入类似的方式“扫描”敌人，根据获得的能力改变形态和功能。那些不提供能力或不兼容的小型敌人在被扫描时会被直接蒸发，这类似于星之卡比超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）的Copy能力。当卡比（Kirby）进入机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）时，他的生命值会完全恢复。此外，当穿上新的一套盔甲时，他之前使用的机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的数据会迁移到新的盔甲上。
wikirby-form:8476.description_en:
“This mysterious mech produces different powers depending on its pilot. 卡比（Kirby）'s 复制能力（Copy Ability） power has transformed it into a shape-shifting copy robot!”
— American English pause text
机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） (parsed Robobot Armour in the British English version) is a pilotable suit of robotic armor that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. 卡比（Kirby） acquires this suit and dons it after defeating the enemy Invader Armor, or by finding it stowed away in various parts of stages. While inside it, 卡比（Kirby） gains increased endurance, taking less damage from most attacks and allowing him to defeat enemies by jumping on them, and is capable of performing new and stronger attacks on top of that. In addition, the suit is compatible with certain 复制能力（Copy Ability）, being able to 'scan' in enemies in the same vein as 卡比（Kirby）'s inhale, changing in form and function depending on the ability acquired. Minor enemies that do not provide abilities or are incompatible are simply vaporized when scanned, similar to the Copy ability from 星之卡比 超级豪华版（Kirby Super Star）. When 卡比（Kirby） enters the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）, his health is completely restored. Additionally, when getting into a new suit of armor, his data from the previous 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） he used will migrate to the new one.

wikirby-variant:8972:star-dream-third-ph.description_zh:
星之梦（第三阶段）（Star Dream Phase 3）是Star Dream的独立阶段形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）》。
“F与Haltmann一起融合，银河系中最先进的计算机已经具有自我意识。为了实现它的老主人永恒繁荣的愿望……它决定消灭所有存在的生命形式！”
— 对战Star Dream，星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停屏幕说明（美版）
Star Dream（有时称为母计算机）是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的总体反派，作为Mind in the Program的Boss出现，并担任主故事模式（Story Mode）的最终Boss。它是一台由总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）使用在多个行星上发现的蓝图和技术建造的自我意识计算机，这些技术可能是由古代文明留下的，并用它来推动Haltmann Works Company的运作。
wikirby-variant:8972:star-dream-third-ph.description_en:
Star Dream Phase 3 is a distinct phase of Star Dream in Kirby: Planet Robobot.
“Fusing together with Haltmann, the most advanced computer in the galaxy has become self-aware. To realize its old master's wish of eternal prosperity...it's decided to eradicate all life-forms in existence!”
— Vs. Star Dream, 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Pause Screen description (American version)
Star Dream (sometimes called the Mother Computer) is the overarching antagonist of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, appearing as the boss of Mind in the Program, and serving as the final boss of the main 故事模式（Story Mode）. It is a sentient computer built by 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） using the blueprints and technology he found on numerous planets, possibly left there by ancient civilizations, using it to fuel the operations of the Haltmann Works Company.

wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.name_zh: 星之梦 Soul OS（第三阶段）
wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.display_name: 星之梦 Soul OS（第三阶段）（Star Dream Soul OS Phase 3）
wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.description_zh:
星之梦 Soul OS（第三阶段）（Star Dream Soul OS Phase 3）是Star Dream Soul OS的独立阶段形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）》。
“最终程序已被激活。其计算得出的胜利概率为99.99%。然而，Haltmann的灵魂还有一小部分未被清除，这可能会扰乱它的计划。”
— 星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停画面描述
Star Dream Soul OS是Star Dream的一种升级版“EX”形态，只能在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的The True Arena中遭遇，作为该模式的最终Boss以及整个游戏的最后Boss。顾名思义，Star Dream Soul OS是一个灵魂Boss，但名字中的“灵魂”部分也指总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）的摇摇欲坠的灵魂，据说该灵魂停留在程序中，在战斗过程中被计算机系统慢慢净化。

Star Dream Soul OS的战斗在很大程度上与其主游戏对应版本相同，为前三个阶段，尽管它的所有攻击都显著更强和/或模式更复杂。然而，第四阶段完全不同：卡比（Kirby）没有使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的钻头来击败老板，而是被吸入机器的核心并与他的装甲分离，被迫在一个圆形竞技场中徒步与核心战斗。

击败Star Dream Soul OS完成真正的竞技场，并且是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）100%完成所必需的。
wikirby-variant:9037:star-dream-soul-os-.description_en:
Star Dream Soul OS Phase 3 is a distinct phase of Star Dream Soul OS in Kirby: Planet Robobot.
“The final program has been activated. Its calculated victory probability is 99.99%. However, a small bit of Haltmann's soul has yet to be purged, which could throw a wrench in its plans.”
— 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Pause Screen description
Star Dream Soul OS is a souped-up "EX" form of Star Dream encountered exclusively in The True Arena in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, serving as the final boss of that mode and the last boss of the entire game. As the name implies, Star Dream Soul OS is a soul boss, but the "Soul" part of the name also refers to the sputtering soul of 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） which is said to linger in the program, slowly being purged by the computer's system over the course of the battle.

Star Dream Soul OS' battle is largely the same as its main game counterpart for the first three phases, though all its attacks are significantly stronger and/or have more complicated patterns. The fourth phase, however, is entirely different: instead of 卡比（Kirby） using the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s drill to finish off the boss, 卡比（Kirby） is instead sucked into the heart of the machine and separated from his armor, forced to fight the heart on foot in a circular arena.

Defeating Star Dream Soul OS completes The True Arena, and is required for 100% completion of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）.

wikirby-form:9009.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9009.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9009.description_zh:
“用岩石般的拳头释放你的愤怒！震地破岩者！”
— 游戏内引用
Stone Mode是机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）模式之一。它用巨石拳替换卡比（Kirby）机甲上的双手，可用来向前砸重物并击碎敌人。
wikirby-form:9009.description_en:
“Release your rage with rocky punches! Earth-shaking Rock Crusher!”
— In-game quote
Stone Mode is one of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） modes. It replaces the hands on 卡比（Kirby）'s mech with big stone fists, which can be used to pound heavy objects forward and smash enemies.

wikirby-form:9005.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9005.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9005.description_zh:
“用科学之剑削减邪恶！力量光束（Beam）光剑！”
— 暂停字幕
Sword Mode是机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）模式之一。它用沿手臂延展的光束剑替换卡比（Kirby）机甲上的双手。这让机甲能够进行大范围劈砍和下劈，对敌人造成巨额伤害并切断大型链条。
wikirby-form:9005.description_en:
“Cut evil down to size with the sword of science! Power 光束（Beam） Saber!”
— Pause caption
Sword Mode is one of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） modes. It replaces the hands on 卡比（Kirby）'s mech with beam swords that stretch up the arms. This allows the suit to perform large slashes and down thrusts, dealing massive damage to enemies and cutting large chains.

wikirby-form:9010.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-form:9010.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-form:9010.description_zh:
“传说中的赛车手在赛道上飞驰。3，2，1……涡轮加速！”
— 暂停字幕
车轮模式（Wheel Mode）是机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）模式之一。它将卡比（Kirby）的机甲变换为三轮赛车，赋予它额外的速度以及随意在前景和背景之间跳跃的能力，这是该技能独有的特性。由于在游戏关卡中需要使用它，因此无法丢弃。
wikirby-form:9010.description_en:
“The legendary racer zooms down the track. 3, 2, 1... Turbo Accelerate!”
— Pause caption
车轮模式（Wheel Mode） is one of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） modes. It transforms 卡比（Kirby）'s mech into a three-wheeled racecar, granting it extra speed and the ability to jump between foreground and background at will, a trait unique to this ability. Due to its use in stages of the game, it cannot be discarded.

wikirby-page:8964.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8964.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8964.description_zh:
“嗯……请允许我详细说明。根据Star Dream制定的商业计划……自今天起，你被……解雇了！”
— 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）（全名：Max Profitt Haltmann）是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的一个角色，担任游戏中的主要反派。他是Haltmann Works Company的总裁，甚至在其荣耀中拥有一首国歌的尊严，并且负责入侵波普之星（Planet Popstar）及之前的许多世界。他在Haltmann Works旗舰——行星级的Access Ark上，从舒适的行政套房里管理这次入侵，这颗旗舰由他称为Star Dream的古代遗物提供动力。

在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中，总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）直到关卡Access Ark（尽管在此之前已有对他的暗示）。他作为该关卡的最终Boss出现，使用他的“执行套装”（一套由纯金制成并镶有宝石的大型机器人套装）与卡比（Kirby）作战。在卡比（Kirby）击败他之后，总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）试图通过启动母计算机来复仇，但被他的执行助理秘书苏姿（Susie）破坏，无意中导致Haltmann的意识与Star Dream融合，并导致计算机失控。在卡比（Kirby）和魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）击败Star Dream之后，总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）也可能随之被摧毁，波普之星（Popstar）的入侵也因此结束。
wikirby-page:8964.description_en:
“Well... Allow me to elaborate. In compliance with the business plan drafted by Star Dream... effective today, you are... terminated!”
— 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） (full name Max Profitt Haltmann) is a character in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, serving as the game's main antagonist. He is the President of the Haltmann Works Company, even receiving the dignity of an anthem in his glory, and is responsible for the invasion of 波普之星（Planet Popstar） and many worlds before it. He manages this invasion from the comfort of his executive suite on the Haltmann Works' flagship, the planet-sized Access Ark, powered by an ancient relic which he refers to as the Star Dream.

In 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） is not formally introduced until the final stage of the level Access Ark (though allusions to him exist prior to this point). He is faced as the final boss of the level, engaging 卡比（Kirby） using his "Executive Suit" (a large robot suit made of solid gold and covered in jewels). After 卡比（Kirby） defeats him, 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） attempts to take revenge by activating the Mother Computer, but is sabotaged by his Executive Assistant 秘书苏姿（Susie）, inadvertently causing Haltmann's mind to merge with Star Dream's and causing the computer to go haywire. After 卡比（Kirby） and 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） defeat Star Dream, 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） is presumably destroyed along with it, and the invasion of 波普之星（Popstar） comes to an end.

wikirby-page:8546.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8546.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8546.description_zh:
“你知道，在一个完全受控的环境中工作是多么美妙。但这是你永远不会理解的。”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie）在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
秘书苏姿（Susie）（全名苏珊娜·帕特里亚·哈尔特曼）是一个活泼的粉发女孩，首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）。她是Haltmann Works Company的执行助理和总统秘书，该公司机械化职业项目的主要股东，她是总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）的女儿，后者似乎已经忘记了这一点。秘书苏姿（Susie）精通机械，能够驾驶多种不同的机器人武器，包括一台被称为她的“商务装”的个人机甲，同时还携带个人爆能枪。她的动机尚不完全清楚，但暗示她打算她从父亲手中篡夺了赫特曼工厂公司。

秘书苏姿（Susie）的首次登场时，她是卡比（Kirby）的反派和对手，亲自与他交战作为老板，后来又派出赫特曼工厂的其他创造物追杀他，同时在大部分卡比（Kirby）：机器人星球故事中，通过她的说明性对话成为有关公司的主要信息来源。在公司的母电脑失控并试图毁灭宇宙后，她与卡比（Kirby）及其朋友达成了停战协议。在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，她将成为可操控的主角之一，作为卡比（Kirby）的Dream Friend之一，在Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!和Heroes in Another Dimension中拥有自己的部分。游戏中解释了她希望复兴赫特曼工厂公司在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）被摧毁之后。
wikirby-page:8546.description_en:
“You know, it's wonderful to work in a perfectly controlled environment. But that's something you'd never understand.”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie） in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
秘书苏姿（Susie） (full name Susanna Patrya Haltmann ) is a spry pink-haired girl who first appeared in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. She is the executive assistant and presidential secretary of the Haltmann Works Company, the primary stakeholder of the company's Mechanizing Occupation Project, and the daughter of 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）, who seems to have forgotten this about her. 秘书苏姿（Susie） is adept with machinery, able to pilot many different robotic weapons, including a personal mech referred to as her "Business Suit", and also carries a personal blaster. Her motives are not entirely clear, but it is implied that she intends to usurp the Haltmann Works Company from her father.

In 秘书苏姿（Susie）'s debut appearance, she was a villain and antagonist to 卡比（Kirby）, fighting him personally as a boss and later sending other creations of Haltmann Works after him, while also being the primary source of information about the company through her expository dialogue for most of 卡比（Kirby）: Planet Robobots story. She would make a truce with 卡比（Kirby） and his friends after the company's mother computer went haywire and attempted to end the universe. In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, she would become a playable protagonist as one of 卡比（Kirby）'s Dream Friends, gaining her own part in Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go! and Heroes in Another Dimension. It is explained in said game that she wishes to revive the Haltmann Works Company after its destruction in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）.

wikirby-page:25634.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:25634.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:25634.description_zh:
Bar Waddle Dees是一对戴着安全帽的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他们来回搬动一根带刺的金属棒。Waddle Dees沿着卡比（Kirby）的路线以固定的模式和区域摆动金属棒，而他们自己则保持在路径两侧稍远的地方。卡比（Kirby）如果触碰到金属棒就会受到伤害。

要击败这些Waddle Dees，卡比（Kirby）必须利用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）。一旦装备，卡比（Kirby）可以使用任何机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）攻击，或者直接跳到金属棒上来击败Bar Waddle Dees。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）也可以使用Meta Knightmare Returns中的任何攻击击败Bar Waddle Dees。
wikirby-page:25634.description_en:
The Bar Waddle Dees are a pair of hard hat-wearing 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s who carry a spiky metal bar back and forth. The Waddle Dees swing the bar along 卡比（Kirby）'s path in a fixed pattern and area, while they themselves remain just out of reach on both sides of the path. 卡比（Kirby） will take damage if he touches the bar.

To defeat these Waddle Dees, 卡比（Kirby） must make use of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Once equipped, 卡比（Kirby） can use any 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） attack or simply jump on the bar to defeat the Bar Waddle Dees. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） is also able to defeat the Bar Waddle Dees with any attack in Meta Knightmare Returns.

wikirby-page:9067.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9067.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9067.description_zh: Capsule J3是一个敌人，首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot），并且在被吞下时授予喷射机（Jet）能力。它的外形类似之前的Capsule J2，但脸现在位于喷气机的下部，眼睛为黄色。身体也更像现代喷气机，配有红色推进器。它通常在空中悬停，改变高度，并在接触卡比（Kirby）时造成伤害。在机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）喷射机模式（Jet Mode）关卡中也可见到，它向前飞行。
wikirby-page:9067.description_en: Capsule J3 is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） and grants the 喷射机（Jet） ability when swallowed. Its appearance resembles the previous Capsule J2, but its face is now in the lower portion of the jet, with yellow eyes. The body also resembles a more modern jet, with red boosters. It is typically seen hovering above the ground, changing altitude, and harms 卡比（Kirby） on contact. It also can be seen during the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） 喷射机模式（Jet Mode） sections, flying forward.

wikirby-page:9061.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9061.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9061.description_zh:
Chemitory是一个首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的敌人，当被吞下时会获得医生（Doctor）能力。它看起来像一个大胶囊，里面装着更小的药丸，同时具有生物的黑色身体和黄色眼睛，有点类似于魔法洛亚（Magolor）。它用两只分离的手打开自身并向卡比（Kirby）扔药丸，这些药丸也可以被吞下以获得医生（Doctor）能力。这些药丸除了可以常规抛掷形成弧线外，还可以在前景和背景之间抛掷。

这个敌人的名字是“chemical”和“laboratory”两个词的合成词。
wikirby-page:9061.description_en:
Chemitory is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, which yields the 医生（Doctor） ability when swallowed. It resembles a large capsule containing smaller pills inside, as well as the creature's black body and yellow eyes, somewhat similar to 魔法洛亚（Magolor）. It uses its two disembodied hands to open itself up and toss pills at 卡比（Kirby）, which can also be swallowed for the 医生（Doctor） ability. These pills can be tossed between foreground and background in addition to being tossed regularly in arcs.

The enemy's name is a portmanteau of the words "chemical" and "laboratory".

wikirby-page:9020.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9020.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9020.description_zh: Chippurus是一个首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的大型敌人。它是标准Chip的更大版本，外观更加复杂，拥有凌乱的头发、白色腹部毛发和三条尾巴。像普通的Chip一样，它可以在前景和背景之间跳跃，吞下时不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。它还拥有大量的Health。
wikirby-page:9020.description_en: Chippurus is a large enemy that made its debut in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is the larger counterpart to the standard Chip, and has a more elaborate look to it, possessing frazzled hair, white belly fur, and three tails. Like the regular Chip, it can hop between foreground and background, and provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed. It also possesses a good deal of Health.

wikirby-page:14302.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:14302.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:14302.description_zh:
Covered Looker，内部代号为Guardrobo，是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的一个敌人。它是一个绿色的漂浮机器人，外观类似Metal Guardian.

当它的外壳关闭时，头部会形成一个红色圆圈。关闭的Covered Looker对卡比（Kirby）的任何攻击都无效，但仍会受到机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）任意攻击的伤害。当其外壳打开时，可以看到内部有三个棕色镜片，用于发射电光球。打开的Covered Looker现在对卡比（Kirby）的任何攻击都有效。无论是关闭还是打开状态，Covered Looker都无法被卡比（Kirby）吸入。此外，它不会触发机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的“扫描眼镜”，因此不会掉落任何复制能力（Copy Ability）.
wikirby-page:14302.description_en:
Covered Looker , internally titled Guardrobo, is an enemy in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is a green floating robot that resembles Metal Guardian.

When its case is closed, a red circle forms on its head. The closed Covered Looker is invulnerable to any attack from 卡比（Kirby） but still takes damage from any of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s attacks. When its case is opened, it reveals three brown lenses inside to fire an electric orb. The opened Covered Looker is now vulnerable to any of 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks. Whether closed or opened, Covered Looker cannot be inhaled by 卡比（Kirby）. In addition, it does not trigger 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s "Scan Specs" and thus does not yield any 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:25636.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:25636.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:25636.description_zh:
Dice是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的赌场主题区域中出现的大型舞台危险物。它们是巨大的金色金属方块，带有尖刺边缘，模仿六面体的Dice，通常按固定模式在平坦区域滚动。如果卡比（Kirby）接触到它们，会受到伤害，如果它们滚到卡比（Kirby）身上，会被压扁，但实际上不会被压碎。

Dice无法被攻击或摧毁，除非借助机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）。一旦受到任何Robobot攻击，Dice方块会被猛烈抛动，然后落下，显示出的那一面朝向玩家，之后碎裂成块。卡比（Kirby）将根据Dice方块显示的哪一面获得特定物品或一组物品屏幕如下：*1 -一个1-Up *2 -两个Point Star *3 -三颗闪点*4 -四颗闪点*5 -五颗闪点*6 -六颗闪点

魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）也可以使用他在Meta Knightmare Returns中的任何攻击摧毁Dice，在那里它们将掉落相应数量的Meta Point，而不是闪点。

Hazards使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）击败的敌人不可吸入的敌人Enemies in Kirby: Planet Robobot
wikirby-page:25636.description_en:
Dice are large stage hazards present in the casino-themed areas of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. They are giant gold-colored metal blocks with spiked fringes made to resemble six-sided Dice which regularly roll across flat areas in fixed patterns. 卡比（Kirby） will take damage if he touches them, and will be flattened if they roll onto him, though not actually crushed.

Dice cannot be attacked or destroyed without the help of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Once hit by any Robobot attack, the Dice block will be flung wildly around, and then land on the side last shown facing the player before bursting into pieces. 卡比（Kirby） will get a specific item or set of items depending on which side of the Dice block faces the screen, as follows: *1 - a 1-Up *2 - two Point Stars *3 - three Point Stars *4 - four Point Stars *5 - five Point Stars *6 - six Point Stars

魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can also destroy Dice with any of his attacks in Meta Knightmare Returns, where they will drop the respective number of Meta Points instead of Point Stars.

Hazards Enemies defeated using 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） Uninhalable enemies Enemies in Kirby: Planet Robobot

wikirby-page:11963.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11963.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11963.description_zh: Driver Waddle Dee是一名敌人和关卡障碍，首次出现在游戏星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中。他们是驾驶车辆的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），车辆大小从乘用车到大型卡车和公共汽车不等。车辆本身的前灯看起来像眼睛。如果卡比（Kirby）被其中一辆撞到，他会根据车辆行驶的方向被甩向屏幕或背景。驾驶员Waddle Dees也会对交通信号灯作出反应（如果有的话），红灯时停车，绿灯时行驶。他们可以被机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）攻击并击败，或者通过魅塔骑士（Meta Knight），这通常会导致Point Star或Food物品出现。
wikirby-page:11963.description_en: Driver Waddle Dee is an enemy and stage hazard that debuted in the game 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. They are 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s who drive vehicles, ranging in size from passenger cars to larger trucks and buses. The vehicles themselves have headlights that resemble eyes. If 卡比（Kirby） is hit by one, he is sent flying toward the screen or the background, depending on the direction they are driving in. Driver Waddle Dees also respond to traffic lights if there are any, stopping at red lights and driving at green lights. They can be attacked and defeated with the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） or by 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, which will often cause Point Stars or Food items to appear.

wikirby-page:9052.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9052.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9052.description_zh:
Flotzo Borg是一种大型水生敌人，首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）。它看起来像Flotzo，但体型更大，并戴着黄色潜水头盔。它通过向卡比（Kirby）喷墨或跳到路上进行攻击。

Flotzo Borg无法被吸入，或者在没有机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的帮助下无法击败。一旦被击败，它会掉落特定的Food物品，形式是章鱼小丸子球。
wikirby-page:9052.description_en:
Flotzo Borg is a large aquatic enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It resembles Flotzo, but is much larger and wears a yellow diving helmet. It attacks by spitting ink at 卡比（Kirby） or jumping in the way.

Flotzo Borg cannot be inhaled, or defeated without the help of the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Once it is beaten, it drops a specific Food item, in the form of balls of takoyaki.

wikirby-page:9069.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9069.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9069.description_zh:
Grand Propeller是一种大型浮游敌人，首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）。它看起来像Propeller，但头上有两个螺旋桨，而且体型更大。随着卡比（Kirby）的临近，它的脸会发生变化，变得明显更加凶恶。它通常只在喷射机模式（Jet Mode）部分出现，在那里会试图阻碍玩家，并且需要更多射击才能消灭。被吞下时不会掉落复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Grand Propeller是一种非常罕见的敌人，只会在Resolution Road的第二关和Gigabyte Grounds的第四关出现。
wikirby-page:9069.description_en:
Grand Propeller is a large floating enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It resembles a Propeller, but bears two propellers on its head, and is bulkier. Its face changes as 卡比（Kirby） approaches, becoming significantly more menacing. It is typically only seen during the 喷射机模式（Jet Mode） sections, where it will attempt to get in the way, and require more shots to dispatch. It yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed.

Grand Propeller is a very rare enemy, only making an appearance in stage 2 of Resolution Road, and stage 4 of Gigabyte Grounds.

wikirby-page:9059.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9059.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9059.description_zh:
Haltworker（在游戏数据文件中被称为Warkers）是首次在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中登场的敌人。它在体型上有点像卡比（Kirby），但头部更长，面部是一个黑屏，并且有其他护甲部件。它使用一把发射不可吸入弹药的等离子手枪，也曾被看到驾驶Invader Armor。吞下Haltworker可以获得电火花（Spark）能力。

作为一种常见敌人，类似于瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），这类敌人与游戏中的反派直接相关，并且只在特定区域出现，Haltworkers也可以与Halcandle Dee、Sectra Dee和Jambeliever作比较。
wikirby-page:9059.description_en:
Haltworker (known as Warkers in the game's data files) is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It resembles 卡比（Kirby） somewhat in physique, albeit with a longer head, a black screen for a face, and other armor pieces. It wields a plasma pistol that fires non-inhalable shots, and is also seen piloting the Invader Armor. Swallowing the Haltworker yields the 电火花（Spark） ability.

As a common enemy similar to 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s which directly relates to the game's villains and only shows up in select areas, Haltworkers can also be compared to Halcandle Dees, Sectra Dees, and Jambelievers.

wikirby-page:11250.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11250.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11250.description_zh:
Iron Ball是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）首次登场的敌人。它作为舞台危险元素，在多个地点围绕固定点旋转。它只能被机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）摧毁。

Iron Ball是一个附在轴上的金色子弹形撞锤。它在各个关卡中沿这个轴旋转，在卡比（Kirby）可以占据的区域进出移动。如果它击中卡比（Kirby），会根据击中的方向要么把他弹飞出去，要么把他撞到屏幕上。它自身对卡比（Kirby）的任何攻击都是免疫的，但可以被机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的任何攻击摧毁。在Meta Knightmare Returns中，魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）可以通过攻击it.

Iron Ball不是一个常见的敌人，只出现在Patched Plains - Stage 3和Stage 6 EX，以及Access Ark - Stage 8 EX.
wikirby-page:11250.description_en:
Iron Ball is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It serves as a stage hazard, rotating about a fixed point in various places. It can only be destroyed using the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）.

Iron Ball is a golden bullet-shaped battering ram attached to a pivot. It spins about this axis in place in various stages, moving in and out of the area where 卡比（Kirby） can occupy. If it hits 卡比（Kirby）, it will either send him flying off into the distance, or splat him against the screen, depending on which way it hits him from. It is invulnerable to any of 卡比（Kirby）'s attacks on his own, but can be destroyed with any attack from the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. In Meta Knightmare Returns, 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can easily destroy an Iron Ball by attacking it.

Iron Ball is not a common enemy, only appearing in Patched Plains - Stage 3 and Stage 6 EX, and Access Ark - Stage 8 EX.

wikirby-page:10995.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:10995.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:10995.description_zh:
Iron Hammer是出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的一个关卡危险物。它首次出现在Gigabyte Grounds关卡的工厂阶段。它看起来像一个大玩具锤子，连接在一个沿z轴旋转的转子上。因此，锤子的头部会定期进出卡比（Kirby）可以行走的区域，如果击中他会造成危险。如果卡比（Kirby）被锤子击中，他要么会被打飞到远处，要么会被撞到屏幕上，这取决于锤子的运动方向。在锤子运动过程中从侧面接触卡比（Kirby）只会伤害他，而不会将他击飞。

Iron Hammer可以使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的任何攻击将其摧毁。这样做有时会丢下Point Stars。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）也可以用他的利剑（Sword）摧毁Iron锤子。
wikirby-page:10995.description_en:
Iron Hammer is a stage hazard that appears in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It first appears in the Gigabyte Grounds level, in the factory stages. It resembles a large toy hammer, attached to a rotor that spins it along the z axis. As such, the head of the hammer routinely flies in and out of the area where 卡比（Kirby） can walk, presenting a hazard if it hits him. Should 卡比（Kirby） get hit by the hammer, he will either get sent flying off into the distance, or smacked into the screen, depending on which way the hammer was moving. Contact with the hammer from the side while it is in 卡比（Kirby）'s field of motion will only hurt him, not launch him.

Iron Hammer can be destroyed using any attack from the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Doing so will sometimes drop Point Stars. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can also destroy Iron Hammers with his 利剑（Sword）.

wikirby-page:9050.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9050.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9050.description_zh:
Labotory（复数形式：Labotories）是一个在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中首次登场的敌人。它是一个小型圆形生物，体型类似于卡比（Kirby）。它穿着灰色紧身服，戴着类似潜水面罩的面具，并挥舞连枷攻击，可以向卡比（Kirby）伸出以对其造成伤害。它可以被吞食，但不会掉落复制能力（Copy Ability）。

Labotories似乎与瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s对应。它们的日文名称格式相似，并且外观和移动模式也类似。根据“星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）绘画和截图挑战”的官方评论，Labotories是Haltmann Works Company的科学人员，专门开发公司使用的武器。它们是从另一颗行星被雇佣来的，并对公司，每天早上唱公司的国歌。这可以被看作是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）与他的Waddle Dees之间关系的一个类比。
wikirby-page:9050.description_en:
Labotory (plural: Labotories) is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is a small round creature with a physique similar to 卡比（Kirby）. It wears a gray body suit with a scuba-like mask and wields a flail, which it extends toward 卡比（Kirby） to do him harm. It can be swallowed, but yields no 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

Labotories appear to be a parallel to 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s. Their Japanese names are similarly formatted and they have similar appearances and movement patterns. According to official comments from the "星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Drawing and Screenshot Challenge", Labotories are the science staff for the Haltmann Works Company, and specialize in developing the weapons the company uses. They were hired from another planet, and are deeply loyal to the company, singing its anthem every morning. This can be seen as a parallel to the relationship between 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and his Waddle Dees.

wikirby-page:11011.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11011.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11011.description_zh:
Metal Acro是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的敌人和舞台危险。它类似于鲸虎（Acro），但完全是机械的，并且在前景和背景之间以惊人的速度游动。如果卡比（Kirby）被Metal Acro击中，他要么被甩向远处，要么撞到屏幕上，这取决于Metal Acro从哪个方向击中他。

Metal Acro不能被吸入，也不能以任何有意义的方式被击败。
wikirby-page:11011.description_en:
Metal Acro is an enemy and stage hazard found in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It resembles 鲸虎（Acro）, but is entirely mechanical, and swims with alarming speed between the foreground and background. If 卡比（Kirby） is hit by Metal Acro, he will either be flung into the distance, or splat against the screen, depending on which way Metal Acro hits him from.

Metal Acro cannot be inhaled, or defeated in any meaningful way.

wikirby-page:9054.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9054.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9054.description_zh:
“嘻嘻嘻……虽然还不完全是成年人，但他充满了新一代的力量！他预感到黑暗中有某样东西，于是出发去寻找它……还可以进行瞬间移动！”
— 咒术师（NESP）、星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的暂停屏幕说明。
咒术师（NESP）（在游戏内部数据中称为Esper）是一种浮空敌人，首次登场于星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot），并在被吞下时提供超能力（ESP）能力。他在体型上有点像魔法洛亚（Magolor），拥有小巧的身体和两只悬空的手。他戴着一顶带有灵能之眼标志的黑色兜帽，并通过向卡比（Kirby）方向发射振荡能量波进行攻击。咒术师（NESP）偶尔也会进行瞬间移动，这是他作为敌人的唯一移动方式。
wikirby-page:9054.description_en:
“Hee hee hee..." Though not quite yet an adult, he brims with the power of a new generation! He predicts there’s something out in the darkness and sets off to find it...with teleportation!”
— Pause screen caption for 咒术师（NESP）, 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
咒术师（NESP） (referred to in internal game data as Esper) is a floating enemy that debuts in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, and provides the 超能力（ESP） ability when swallowed. He somewhat resembles 魔法洛亚（Magolor） in physique, bearing a small body and two disembodied hands. He wears a black hood with a psychic eye insignia on it and attacks by sending an oscillating wave of energy in 卡比（Kirby）'s direction. 咒术师（NESP） will also occasionally teleport about, with this being his only form of movement as an enemy.

wikirby-page:11009.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11009.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11009.description_zh:
Prism Ball是一种只出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的舞台危险。它由两个在较大电场内相互绕行的电球组成。这些电球按顺序互相绕行，始终保持相等的距离。每当它们停止时，会发出持续的电火花，如果卡比（Kirby）接触它们，会受到伤害。

 Prism Ball对大多数攻击具有无敌状态，也无法被吸入，但可以使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）将其摧毁。有时，摧毁它们会掉落Point Star、Food甚至1-Up。
wikirby-page:11009.description_en:
Prism Ball is a stage hazard found exclusively in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It consists of two electric orbs which orbit each-other inside a larger electric field. The orbs orbit each-other in sequence, always equidistant from each-other. Whenever they stop, they emit a continuous electric spark that can hurt 卡比（Kirby） if he is touching them.

The Prism Ball is invulnerable to most attacks, and cannot be inhaled, but it can be destroyed using the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Sometimes, destroying them will yield Point Stars, Food or even 1-Ups.

wikirby-page:11007.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11007.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11007.description_zh:
Security Laser是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中发现的一个舞台危险物。它闭合时看起来像一个悬浮的金属立方体，当卡比（Kirby）靠近时会打开，从内部的中心眼状装置发射激光。

Security Laser的激光是连续的，并且可以慢慢在舞台上扫过。如果卡比（Kirby）在任何时刻触碰到激光，他将受到伤害。Security Laser对大多数攻击无效，不能被吸入，但可以使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）将其破坏。有时，破坏它会产生Point Star。
wikirby-page:11007.description_en:
Security Laser is a stage hazard found in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It resembles a floating metallic cube when closed, and opens when 卡比（Kirby） approaches to fire its laser from a central eye-like apparatus inside of it.

Security Laser's laser is continuous, and can be slowly swept across the stage. 卡比（Kirby） will take damage if he touches the laser at any point. The Security Laser is invulnerable to most attacks, and cannot be inhaled, but it can be destroyed using the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. Sometimes, destroying it will yield Point Stars.

wikirby-page:9057.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9057.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9057.description_zh: Sleepy Turtle大部分时间都在它的位置上睡觉，会覆盖物品和其他东西。如果卡比（Kirby）或魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）接近它的脸部，乌龟会试图吃掉他，如果成功，玩家将不得不疯狂按+控制板或圆盘控制器以让卡比（Kirby）或魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）逃脱。触碰乌龟的其他任何部位都不会伤害卡比（Kirby）或魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）。
wikirby-page:9057.description_en: Sleepy Turtle spends most of its time sleeping in its location, covering up items and other things. If 卡比（Kirby） or 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） approaches its face, the turtle will attempt to eat him, and if successful, the player will have to mash the + Control Pad or Circle Pad to allow 卡比（Kirby） or 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） to escape. Touching any other part of the turtle will not hurt 卡比（Kirby） or 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）.

wikirby-page:25637.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:25637.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:25637.description_zh:
Spring Note是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）各种Rhythm Route关卡中出现的一个阶段危险。它由一个大型圆形霓虹灯标牌组成，标牌上描绘了一个音乐符号或五线谱符号，连接在一根长弹簧上。随着背景音乐的节奏，Spring Note会发射到卡比（Kirby）的路径上，然后再次缩回。向前发射时，琴符面板可能会击中卡比（Kirby），将其弹向第四面墙。

为了摧毁Spring Note，需要机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）。任何Robobot攻击都能摧毁琴符面板，导致一些Point Star出现，但只能在其伸出时击中。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）也可以在Meta Knightmare Returns中用他的任何攻击摧毁弹簧琴符。
wikirby-page:25637.description_en:
Spring Note is a stage hazard present in various Rhythm Route stages in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It consists of a large circular neon-lit sign depicting a musical note or clef attached to a long spring. In-rhythm with the background music, the Spring Note launches into 卡比（Kirby）'s path and then retracts again. When launching forward, the note panel can hit 卡比（Kirby）, flinging him into the fourth wall in the process.

In order to destroy the Spring Note, the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） is required. Any Robobot attack will destroy the note panel, causing some Point Stars to appear, though it can only be hit while it is extended. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） can also destroy Spring Notes with any of his attacks in Meta Knightmare Returns.

wikirby-page:9063.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9063.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9063.description_zh: Venogg是一个首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的敌人，被吞下后会获得Poison能力。它外形类似蟾蜍，但身体像蛞蝓，呈病态的青绿色和蓝色。它通过扭动身体进行攻击，并从口中喷出有毒的泥浆，这些泥浆会在地面上留下持久的水洼。
wikirby-page:9063.description_en: Venogg is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, yielding the Poison ability when swallowed. It resembles a toad in appearance, but with the body of a slug, and a sickly teal and blue coloration. It attacks by slithering about, and spitting toxic sludge out of its mouth, which then leaves a lasting puddle on the ground.

wikirby-page:9022.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9022.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9022.description_zh:
Vol是一个出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的特殊敌人。它是一个相当大的绿色机器人，外观上有点像R.O.B.，不过它只有一只眼睛。它的攻击方式是旋转手臂。通过让卡比（Kirby）的机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）拧开它头上的螺丝，或通过反复攻击它，都可以轻松击败它。

整个游戏中只出现两个Vols，在Patched Plains - Stage 3中。一旦两个都被击败，卡比（Kirby）就必须与它们的主人铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）对抗。
wikirby-page:9022.description_en:
Vol is a special enemy appearing in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is a fairly large green robot that somewhat resembles R.O.B. in appearance, though it only has one eye. It attacks by spinning its arms. It is easily defeated by having 卡比（Kirby）'s 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor） unscrew the screw on its head or by repeatedly attacking it.

Only two Vols appear in the entire game, in Patched Plains - Stage 3. Once both are defeated, 卡比（Kirby） must then contend with their master, 铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）.

wikirby-page:11929.display_name: 步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:11929.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:11929.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:11929.description_zh:
步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）是一种敌人，目前仅出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中。步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）是一名瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他操作着一个机械步行器，由覆盖下半身的底盘组成，配有两只机械脚和背后的发条齿轮。被吞下时，步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）不会提供任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。

步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）的操作方式与标准瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）类似，会保持静止或缓慢在区域内行走。当卡比（Kirby）攻击步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）时，步行器将承受大部分伤害，直到被摧毁，同时弹出瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）本体。步行器部分也可以被吸入，将其从瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）所有者那里夺走。

还有其他两种Walker Waddle Dees版本存在。第一种是Cannon Waddle Dees，步行器上配有火箭发射器，可以发射具有轻微自导功能的导弹，这些导弹可以被炸弹（Bomb）能力吞噬。第二种，Propeller Waddle Dees，使步行器能够通过在腿部安装的螺旋桨起飞，并可以通过火箭发射器发射导弹。Propeller Waddle Dees通常出现在各种喷射机模式（Jet Mode）部分。
wikirby-page:11929.description_en:
步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee） is an enemy which is currently exclusive to 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. 步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who operates a mechanical walker, consisting of a chassis that covers the lower half of the body, with two mechanical feet and a wind-up gear on the back. 步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee） provides no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when swallowed.

步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee） operates similarly to a standard 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, and will either hold still, or walk about the area slowly. When 卡比（Kirby） attacks 步行者瓦豆鲁迪（Walker Waddle Dee）, the walker will take the brunt of the damage until it is destroyed, ejecting the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） in the process. The walker part can also be inhaled, robbing it from its 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） owner.

Two other varieties of Walker Waddle Dees also exist. The first, Cannon Waddle Dees, have a rocket launcher attached to the walker, which is capable of firing missiles with slight homing properties that can be swallowed for the 炸弹（Bomb） ability. The second, Propeller Waddle Dees, allows the walker to take flight with an attached propeller in place of legs, in addition to firing missiles via rocket launcher. Propeller Waddle Dees are commonly seen in the various 喷射机模式（Jet Mode） sections.

wikirby-page:9065.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9065.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9065.description_zh:
“世界的宝藏全都是我的！"他以西方式风格和花花公子般的心态接受任何任务，只为再次出发去探索世界！凭借他灵巧的鞭子，他寻找宝藏！”
— Guest Star Wester Wild-West Whip暂停画面中星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
牛仔（Wester）的描述是一个首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的敌人，被吞下后可以获得鞭子（Whip）能力。他看起来像一个牛仔，戴着帽子、围巾和挥舞鞭子，但身体是黑色的，眼睛是黄色的。牛仔（Wester）可以被看到站立不动或四处走动，但他会用抽鞭攻击并使用鞭子（Whip）龙卷风（Tornado）技能。他也可以利用该技能在前景和背景之间移动。
wikirby-page:9065.description_en:
“The world's treasure is all mine!" With western style and a dandy heart, he takes on any task, all so he can set out again to explore the world! With his flexible whip, he searches for treasure!”
— Guest Star Wester Wild-West Whip Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
牛仔（Wester） is an enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） that yields the 鞭子（Whip） ability when swallowed. He resembles a cowboy, with hat, scarf and whip, but has a black body with yellow eyes. 牛仔（Wester） can be seen standing still or walking about, but he attacks by using whip lashes and the 鞭子（Whip） 龙卷风（Tornado） technique. He can also move between foreground and background with said technique.

wikirby-page:23642.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:23642.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:23642.description_zh:
Yesman是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中出现的大型敌人。“阿谀者”只会在总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）在其首领战中召唤时出现，并且无法被吸入。在与总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）2.0战斗时，它们看起来像穿着黑色商务制服。它们的名字来源于一个商业术语：指一个人，无论个人信念如何，总是支持上司的意见以获得认可。

在战斗中，Yesman通过拳击进行攻击。每当它攻击时，会留下一个星星。它还为总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）提供保护，给他一个看不见的护盾，减少所有对Haltmann造成的伤害，直到Yesman被摧毁。此外，一个Yesman可能在经过10秒后仍然存活时自毁。

当他的第二阶段开始时，总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）会部署一个Yesman。在故事模式（Story Mode）和The Arena的第三阶段开始以及第四阶段，会出现两个Yesmen。在Meta Knightmare Returns和The True Arena的第四阶段开始时，会出现四个Yesmen。第四阶段开始时召唤的Yesmen（除非被卡比（Kirby）或魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）摧毁）会被Haltmann的“重组冲击”攻击摧毁。
wikirby-page:23642.description_en:
Yesman is a large enemy appearing in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. Yesmen make their only appearance when summoned by 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） during his boss battle, and they cannot be inhaled. When fighting against 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） 2.0, they appear to "wear" black business uniforms on their body. Their name comes from a business term: a person who, regardless of personal convictions, always supports the opinions of their superior in order to earn approval.

In battle, a Yesman attacks by punching. Whenever it does so, it leaves a star behind. It also provides protection to 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）, giving him a shield which cannot be seen, which reduces all damage dealt to Haltmann until the Yesman is destroyed. Additionally, a Yesman may self-destruct after 10 seconds have passed and it is still alive.

When his second phase starts, 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） deploys a single Yesman. At the start of Phase 3 and in Phase 4 of 故事模式（Story Mode） and The Arena, two Yesmen appear. At the start of Phase 4 in Meta Knightmare Returns and The True Arena, four of them appear. The Yesmen that are summoned at the start of Phase 4 (unless they are destroyed by 卡比（Kirby） or 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）) get destroyed by Haltmann's "Restructuring Shock" attack.

wikirby-page:8795.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8795.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8795.description_zh: Invader Armor（在英式英语版本中解析为入侵者装甲）是出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的中级Boss。顾名思义，它是Haltmann Works Company为入侵波普之星（Popstar）而部署的众多机甲之一。击败它后，驾驶员会飞出装甲，让卡比（Kirby）亲自接管。跳入其中后，卡比（Kirby）的无限力量将其转变为机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）。
wikirby-page:8795.description_en: Invader Armor (parsed Invader Armour in the British English version) is a mid-boss that appears in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. As its name implies, it is one of many mech suits deployed by the Haltmann Works Company to invade 波普之星（Popstar）. When defeated, the pilot flies out of the armor, leaving 卡比（Kirby） to take it for himself. After jumping into it, 卡比（Kirby）'s infinite power transforms it into the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）.

wikirby-page:8869.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8869.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8869.description_zh:
“不要碰这个蔓延的恐怖——那翻滚的毒液是纯毒！”
— 来自Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
毒波洛斯（Miasmoros）的艰难任务风味文字是一个大型有毒污泥生物，在它出现的游戏中，它是卡比（Kirby）的主要障碍。它看起来像一个病态颜色的粘液团，有黄色眼睛、张开的嘴巴，背上长着真菌。尚不清楚毒波洛斯（Miasmoros）在粘液下是否有更坚固的身体，还是完全是粘稠的，但它似乎是Galbo怪物家族的远亲。
wikirby-page:8869.description_en:
“Don't touch this creeping horror—that roiling venom is pure poison!”
— Tough Quest flavor text from Team Kirby Clash Deluxe
毒波洛斯（Miasmoros） is a large toxic sludge creature that serves as a major roadblock to 卡比（Kirby） in the games in which it appears. It resembles a sickly-colored mass of goo with yellow eyes, a gaping mouth, and fungus growing on its back. It is unclear if 毒波洛斯（Miasmoros） has a more solid body underneath the goopy mass, or if it is entirely viscous in nature, but it appears to be a distant relative of the Galbo family of monsters.

wikirby-page:8944.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8944.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8944.description_zh: Security Force是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的一个中级Boss。它是一个紧凑型、略呈人形的机器人，类似于星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的金属将军（Metal General），但喷成白色，并在头部带有Haltmann Works Company标志。Security Force是游戏中出现的最后一个新颖中级Boss，首次出现在游戏的倒数第二关Access Ark中，在单个关卡中可能出现数个。与大多数中级Boss不同，Security Force不是瞬移出现，而是在卡比（Kirby）撞上它时就已经到位，当卡比（Kirby）接近到触发距离时，它会伴随警告警报激活。Security Force也是涉及机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的喷射机模式（Jet Mode）片段中的障碍物。在这里，它表现得更像一个普通敌人，只需几下就可以被摧毁
wikirby-page:8944.description_en: Security Force is a mid-boss in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is a compact vaguely humanoid robot which resembles the 金属将军（Metal General） from 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, but is painted white and bears the Haltmann Works Company logo on its head. Security Force is the last novel Mid-Boss that appears in the game, making its first appearance in the penultimate level of the game, Access Ark, where several can appear in a single stage. Instead of warping in like most Mid-Bosses, Security Force is already in place when 卡比（Kirby） runs into it, and activates with a warning siren when 卡比（Kirby） draws near enough to activate it. Security Force is also an obstacle during segments involving the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s 喷射机模式（Jet Mode）. Here, it behaves more like a regular enemy, and can be destroyed with only a few hits.

wikirby-page:8862.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8862.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8862.description_zh:
传送帕托利斯（Telepathos）是一个中boss，首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中。当吸入时，他会产生超能力（ESP）复制能力（Copy Ability）。他发射的弹丸可以吞下以获得电火花（Spark）能力。

他是一个形状奇异、神秘且极其强大的飞行生物。他的主体是白色，呈模糊的U形，覆盖着不断变化颜色的条纹。他还有两只独立的手，每只手上有三个等距分布的平圆形大拇指。传送帕托利斯（Telepathos）通过发射能量球和短距离瞬移来攻击，以躲避攻击。
wikirby-page:8862.description_en:
传送帕托利斯（Telepathos） is a mid-boss that made his first appearance in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. He yields the 超能力（ESP） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled. The projectiles he fires can be swallowed for the 电火花（Spark） ability.

He is a bizarrely-shaped, mysterious and eminently potent flying creature. His main body is white and forms a vague U-shape covered with stripes of constantly changing colors. He also possesses two disembodied hands which have three equally-spaced flat circular thumbs on each. 传送帕托利斯（Telepathos） attacks by throwing out orbs of energy and teleporting short distances in order to dodge attacks.

wikirby-page:8867.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8867.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8867.description_zh:
“A由巨型齿轮组成的装备基地守卫着这条路线。电池会随着齿轮的运动一起旋转，以瞄准目标。除非摧毁这个基地，否则无法前进。”
— 对抗C.O.G.S.特别页（美式英语）
C.O.G.S.是首次出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的Boss。它出现在Resolution Road的第2阶段和Gigabyte Grounds的第4阶段，并且只能使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的喷射机模式（Jet Mode）来战斗。

名副其实，C.O.G.S.只是墙边的一系列齿轮和齿轮装置。附着在这些齿轮上的是一系列炮塔，会尝试向卡比（Kirby）发射导弹、等离子射击和激光爆炸。要击败C.O.G.S.，卡比（Kirby）只需对单个齿轮开火直到它们被摧毁，使C.O.G.S.无法逐块操作。
wikirby-page:8867.description_en:
“A geared-up base made of gigantic cogs defends this route. Batteries turn along with the gear movement to aim at targets. Unless this base is destroyed, there is no way forward.”
— Vs. C.O.G.S. Special Page (American English)
C.O.G.S. is a boss that first appeared in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It appears in Stage 2 of Resolution Road and Stage 4 of Gigabyte Grounds and is fought exclusively with the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s 喷射机模式（Jet Mode）.

True to its name, C.O.G.S. is little more than a series of cogs and gears on the side of a wall. Attached to these cogs are a series of turrets that will attempt to fire missiles, plasma shots and laser blasts at 卡比（Kirby）. To defeat C.O.G.S., 卡比（Kirby） must simply fire at the individual gears until they are destroyed, rendering C.O.G.S. inoperable piece-by-piece.

wikirby-page:8792.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8792.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）

wikirby-page:9031.display_name: 复制剑士暗物质（Dark Matter Clone）
wikirby-page:9031.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9031.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9031.description_zh:
“创造这个黑暗剑士把Star Dream的能力推到了极限。克隆过程取得了成功，但只能进行部分数据分析，其真实形态尚未出现。”
— 对战复制剑士暗物质（Dark Matter Clone）暂停画面描述来自星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
复制剑士暗物质（Dark Matter Clone）是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的Meta Knightmare Returns末期遇到的一个Boss。它是由Star Dream根据暗物质（Dark Matter）克隆的，因此它的战斗方式与星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中暗物质（Dark Matter）的战斗方式非常相似。它的外观几乎与真品相同，但它的眼睛上有一个橘色的靶心图案，而不是正常的虹膜和巩膜。
wikirby-page:9031.description_en:
“Creating this dark swordsman pushed Star Dream to the limits of its abilities. The cloning process was a success, but only a partial data analysis was possible, and its true form has not yet emerged.”
— Vs. 复制剑士暗物质（Dark Matter Clone） pause screen description from 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
复制剑士暗物质（Dark Matter Clone） is a boss encountered near the end of Meta Knightmare Returns in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is a clone made by Star Dream based on 暗物质（Dark Matter）, and as such, it fights much like 暗物质（Dark Matter） does in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. Its appearance is nearly identical to the real article, but its eye has an orange bull's-eye pattern rather than a proper iris and sclera.

wikirby-page:8937.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8937.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8937.description_zh:
“不过不用担心！下一个应该能镇压你的叛乱。他是由最新的纳米基因技术创造的。他无情。他有动力。他是……一个具有皇家规格的克隆体！嘻嘻！而且看起来他对你怀有长久的怨恨！准备好迎接……型号#D-0030 Dedede Clone！瞧，那只小粉色麻烦吗？毁掉它！”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie）在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
Dedede Clone中是一个在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中战斗的老板，出现在Rhythm Route的老板，并且也在The Arena中战斗。它是由Haltmann Works Company使用帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的DNA创造的，并充满了摧毁卡比（Kirby）的冲动。
wikirby-page:8937.description_en:
“Don't worry, though! This next one should quash your rebellion. He was created from the latest in nanogenetic technology. He's ruthless. He's driven. He's...a clone of royal proportions! Heehee! And it seems he has a long-standing grudge against you! Get ready for... Model #D-0030 Dedede Clone! Here, see that little pink nuisance? Destroy it!”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie） in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
Dedede Clone is a boss fought in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, appearing as the boss of Rhythm Route and is also fought in The Arena. It was created by the Haltmann Works Company using 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s DNA, and filled with an urge to destroy 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:8941.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8941.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8941.description_zh:
“德迪德的克隆体缺少了一样东西——一件强大的武器。当秘书苏姿（Susie）意识到这一点时，她引入了D3加农炮，这是一门由三个德迪德克隆控制的三维加农炮。”
— Vs。Dedede Clones & D3
Dedede Clones & D3是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中战斗的Boss，作为Rhythm Route的第二个Boss出现。他们是在击败Dedede Clone后直接交战的，分裂的克隆体随后撤退去操控由Haltmann Works Company制造的D3加农炮。
wikirby-page:8941.description_en:
“Something was missing from Dedede's clone--a weapon of immense power. When 秘书苏姿（Susie） realized this, she introduced the D3 Cannon, a tridimensional cannon controlled by three Dedede Clones.”
— Vs. Dedede Clones & D3
Dedede Clones & D3 are a boss fought in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, appearing as the second boss of Rhythm Route. They are fought directly after Dedede Clone is defeated, and the split clones retreat to pilot the D3 Cannon created by the Haltmann Works Company.

wikirby-page:8852.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8852.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8852.description_zh:
“一台由神秘入侵者制造的令人印象深刻的机器。它充满了先进技术。目前尚不清楚这台巨型机器人是否有任何弱点。”
— 对战铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）暂停画面描述在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中。
铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）是出现在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中的一个Boss。它首次出现在Stage 3的Patched Plains中，并且只用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）对战。铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）也作为危险出现在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）的同名战斗舞台上。

铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt）尤其巨大；即使在背景中也占据了屏幕的大部分。它是一台高耸的绿色机器人，拥有圆柱形的头、长臂和矩形的手，显然没有腿，因为它的躯干似乎直接与地面相连。尽管如此令人畏惧的体型，但并不难击败。
wikirby-page:8852.description_en:
“An impressive machine built by the mysterious invaders. It's chock full of advanced technology. It is unknown if this giant robot has any weak spots.”
— Vs. 铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt） Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt） is a boss that appears in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It is first seen in Stage 3 of Patched Plains and is fought exclusively with the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）. 铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt） also appears as a hazard in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2） on the eponymous Battle Stage.

铁巨兵钜甲螺丝（Gigavolt） is notably large; given that it takes up a majority of the screen even being in the background. It's a towering green robot with a cylindrical head, long arms with rectangular hands, and apparently no legs, as its torso seems to just connect directly to the ground. Despite its intimidating size, it is not hard to defeat.

wikirby-page:8880.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8880.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8880.description_zh:
“防御该区域免受入侵的全息安全系统。它分析过去的战斗数据，并一个接一个地生成全息保安。”
— Vs. Holo Defense API星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的暂停屏幕描述（美式英语）
Holo Defense API（在英式英语版本中拼写为Holo Defence API）是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中Resolution Road的Boss。它在某种程度上类似于星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的Pix，但由四个钻石组成，而不是三个，同时还有环绕它的灰色梯形面板。
wikirby-page:8880.description_en:
“The holographic security system that defends this area from intruders. It analyzes past battle data and produces one holographic security guard after another.”
— Vs. Holo Defense API pause screen description in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） (American English)
Holo Defense API (spelled Holo Defence API in the British English version) is the boss of Resolution Road in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It somewhat resembles Pix from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）, but consists of four diamonds rather than just three, and also has gray, trapezoidal panels that surround it.

wikirby-page:8907.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8907.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）

wikirby-page:8956.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8956.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8956.description_zh:
“好吧，我今天为你准备了一些特别的东西。先来看看我们最新的产品，刚下生产线的新货！它已经完全更新了最新技术。它可以连续工作24小时无需充电……而且它被设定为一台无情的战斗机器。我们称它为Mecha Knight+！希望你会喜欢。祝你有美好的一天！拜拜！”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie）在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中，
Mecha Knight+是一个Boss，在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中出现，作为Access Ark的Boss。他是Mecha Knight的升级版，也就是说他仍然是受到Haltmann Works Company控制的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）。他现在涂成了红色，并且战斗方式与原版有很大不同。
wikirby-page:8956.description_en:
“Well, I have something special for you today. Have a sneak peek at our latest product, hot off the production line! It's been completely updated with the newest technology. It's capable of working for 24 hours without recharging... And it's been programmed to be a merciless fighting machine. We call it Mecha Knight+! I hope you like it. Have a nice day! Buh-bye!”
— 秘书苏姿（Susie） in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
Mecha Knight+ is a boss fought in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, appearing as the boss of Access Ark. He is an upgraded version of Mecha Knight, which means to say that he is still 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） under the thrall of the Haltmann Works Company. He now sports a red paint job, and fights in a very different manner to his original version.

wikirby-page:9033.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9033.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9033.description_zh:
“数据是从入侵者偶然发现的一朵巨型花的痕迹中收集的。克隆它产生了昆虫女王。其数据包含跨越1000年的生物元素。”
— 星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停屏幕描述
Sectonia Clone是在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中Meta Knightmare Returns接近末尾时遇到的意外Boss。它是利用采自Dreamstalk的女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）基因材料残余创建的，战斗方式类似于后期的Queen。
wikirby-page:9033.description_en:
“Data was collected from traces of a giant flower the invaders stumbled upon. Cloning it produced the insect queen. Its data contains elements of creatures spanning a period of 1,000 years.”
— 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Pause Screen description
Sectonia Clone is a surprise boss encountered near the end of Meta Knightmare Returns in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. It was created using remnants of 女王·塞昆托霓雅（Queen Sectonia）'s genetic material harvested from the Dreamstalk, and fights much like the late Queen.

wikirby-page:8972.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:8972.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:8972.description_zh:
“F与Haltmann一起融合，银河系中最先进的计算机已经具有自我意识。为了实现它的老主人永恒繁荣的愿望……它决定消灭所有存在的生命形式！”
— 对战Star Dream，星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停屏幕说明（美版）
Star Dream（有时称为母计算机）是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的总体反派，作为Mind in the Program的Boss出现，并担任主故事模式（Story Mode）的最终Boss。它是一台由总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）使用在多个行星上发现的蓝图和技术建造的自我意识计算机，这些技术可能是由古代文明留下的，并用它来推动Haltmann Works Company的运作。
wikirby-page:8972.description_en:
“Fusing together with Haltmann, the most advanced computer in the galaxy has become self-aware. To realize its old master's wish of eternal prosperity...it's decided to eradicate all life-forms in existence!”
— Vs. Star Dream, 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Pause Screen description (American version)
Star Dream (sometimes called the Mother Computer) is the overarching antagonist of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, appearing as the boss of Mind in the Program, and serving as the final boss of the main 故事模式（Story Mode）. It is a sentient computer built by 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） using the blueprints and technology he found on numerous planets, possibly left there by ancient civilizations, using it to fuel the operations of the Haltmann Works Company.

wikirby-page:9037.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9037.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9037.description_zh:
“最终程序已被激活。其计算得出的胜利概率为99.99%。然而，Haltmann的灵魂还有一小部分未被清除，这可能会扰乱它的计划。”
— 星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）暂停画面描述
Star Dream Soul OS是Star Dream的一种升级版“EX”形态，只能在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）的The True Arena中遭遇，作为该模式的最终Boss以及整个游戏的最后Boss。顾名思义，Star Dream Soul OS是一个灵魂Boss，但名字中的“灵魂”部分也指总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann）的摇摇欲坠的灵魂，据说该灵魂停留在程序中，在战斗过程中被计算机系统慢慢净化。

Star Dream Soul OS的战斗在很大程度上与其主游戏对应版本相同，为前三个阶段，尽管它的所有攻击都显著更强和/或模式更复杂。然而，第四阶段完全不同：卡比（Kirby）没有使用机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）的钻头来击败老板，而是被吸入机器的核心并与他的装甲分离，被迫在一个圆形竞技场中徒步与核心战斗。

击败Star Dream Soul OS完成真正的竞技场，并且是星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）100%完成所必需的。
wikirby-page:9037.description_en:
“The final program has been activated. Its calculated victory probability is 99.99%. However, a small bit of Haltmann's soul has yet to be purged, which could throw a wrench in its plans.”
— 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） Pause Screen description
Star Dream Soul OS is a souped-up "EX" form of Star Dream encountered exclusively in The True Arena in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）, serving as the final boss of that mode and the last boss of the entire game. As the name implies, Star Dream Soul OS is a soul boss, but the "Soul" part of the name also refers to the sputtering soul of 总裁·哈鲁特曼（President Haltmann） which is said to linger in the program, slowly being purged by the computer's system over the course of the battle.

Star Dream Soul OS' battle is largely the same as its main game counterpart for the first three phases, though all its attacks are significantly stronger and/or have more complicated patterns. The fourth phase, however, is entirely different: instead of 卡比（Kirby） using the 机器博博装甲（Robobot Armor）'s drill to finish off the boss, 卡比（Kirby） is instead sucked into the heart of the machine and separated from his armor, forced to fight the heart on foot in a circular arena.

Defeating Star Dream Soul OS completes The True Arena, and is required for 100% completion of 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）.

wikirby-page:9016.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 机器博博星球
wikirby-page:9016.display_work: 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）
wikirby-page:9016.description_zh:
“这款量产型号基于升级版的Mecha Knight型号。如果该型号投入商业生产，公司军事实力将显著增强。”
— 对比Stock Mecha Knight在星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）（美式英语）中的特别页面描述
Stock Mecha Knight是由Haltmann Works Company制造的Mecha Knight的全机器人复制品，作为星之卡比机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）中Mecha Knight战斗的“2.0”版本。顾名思义，它是Mecha Knight的升级量产版，由Haltmann Works公司计划用于作战营销。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）在Meta Knightmare Returns的Gigabyte Grounds结尾面对这个危险的机器人双生体，而卡比（Kirby）在The True Arena面对它。
wikirby-page:9016.description_en:
“This mass-production model is based on an upgraded Mecha Knight model. If this model goes into commercial production, the company's military power will dramatically increase.”
— Vs. Stock Mecha Knight Special Page description in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot） (American English)
Stock Mecha Knight is an entirely robotic duplicate of Mecha Knight built by the Haltmann Works Company, which serves as the "2.0" version of the Mecha Knight battle in 星之卡比 机器博博星球（Kirby: Planet Robobot）. As the name implies, it is an upgraded mass-produced version of Mecha Knight, which the Haltmann Works Company intends to market for combat purposes. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） faces down this dangerous robot doppelgänger at the end of Gigabyte Grounds in Meta Knightmare Returns, and 卡比（Kirby） faces it in The True Arena.

wikirby-page:10245.display_name: 大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head）
wikirby-page:10245.description_zh:
“这一次，你将面对一个满腔怒火、寻求复仇的炽热头（Hot Head）！”
— 巨大三人组风格文本
大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head）是一个首次出现在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe中的敌人，并且在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中再次出现。它比普通的炽热头（Hot Head）大得多、强得多，尽管移动速度较慢。在Team Kirby Clash Deluxe中，大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head）只会在击败Colossal Waddle Dee和大型・石像怪（Colossal Kabu）之后，以三人组对战的形式出现。在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中，大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head）可以出现四次，每次都以团队形式，无论是作为与大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee）和大型・石像怪（Colossal Kabu）组成的巨大三人组的一部分，还是在团队巨大四人组中加入大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee）。
wikirby-page:10245.description_en:
“This time you'll face a 炽热头（Hot Head） who's all fired up and looking for revenge!”
— Colossal Triple-Team flavor text
大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head） is an enemy that debuted in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and appears again in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is much larger and tougher than a standard 炽热头（Hot Head）, though it moves much slower. In Team Kirby Clash Deluxe, 大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head） is exclusively faced in a triple tag-team battle after both Colossal Waddle Dee and 大型・石像怪（Colossal Kabu） are defeated.
