He is a cloaked enemy with a body shape similar to 卡比（Kirby） who wears a headdress and a veil, though he also has pronounced gloves. He can often be seen carrying a 如意棒（Staff） and leading a line of creatures which look similar to him, but have less-prominent hats. 邪哈鲁武人（Jammerjab） can be inhaled and swallowed for the 如意棒（Staff） ability, or can be recruited as a friend.

邪哈鲁武人（Jammerjab） appears to be a servant of Jambandra, and bears physical similarities to 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）.

wikirby-page:89307.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:89307.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:89307.description_zh: Mega Blado是出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的一个关卡危害。像Blado一样，它是一个圆形的、坚不可摧的生物，几乎总是带有斧状刀刃；然而，它要大得多，看起来像是由砖块组成，并且有一个由齿轮和棒条组成的面孔（根据Mega Blado的方向，这张脸可以显得狡猾或悲伤）。它总是旋转的；卡比（Kirby）可以利用这一点避开它巨大的刀刃。其主要“头部”的表面在接触时也不会伤害卡比（Kirby），并且可以安全行走。
wikirby-page:89307.description_en: Mega Blado is a stage hazard that appears in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. Like Blado, it is a circular, indestructible creature which almost always sports axe-like blades; however, it is much larger, appears as if made of bricks, and sports a face made of gears and bars (which can appear devious or sad depending on Mega Blado's orientation). It is always found spinning; 卡比（Kirby） can make use of this to get past its massive blades. The surface of its main "head" also does not damage 卡比（Kirby） on contact, and is safe to walk on.

wikirby-page:41880.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:41880.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:41880.description_zh: Meteor是出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）火成区的阶段性危险物体。它是一块巨大的下落岩石，表面覆盖着火焰，并且熔岩呈星形，它慢慢地在空中移动，直到撞击地面并爆炸。当Meteor撞击时，它会摧毁所碰到的任何脆弱地形，并对接触到它的任何人造成伤害。陨石无法被任何攻击摧毁，除非使用盟友新星（Friend Star）的Blizzard、Bluster或Zap注入的攻击。当以这种方式被摧毁时，Meteor会掉落一些Point Stars。
wikirby-page:41880.description_en: Meteor is a stage hazard that appears in magmatic areas in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. It is a giant falling rock that is covered in flames and lava shaped into stars that travels slowly through the air until it hits the ground and bursts. When a Meteor strikes, it will destroy any fragile terrain it hits and deal damage to anyone who touches it. Meteors cannot be destroyed by any attack except for shots infused with Blizzard, Bluster or Zap from the 盟友新星（Friend Star）. When destroyed in this way, the Meteor drops some Point Stars.

wikirby-page:23166.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:23166.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:23166.description_zh:
Rolling Waddle Dee是出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的敌人和舞台危险。这个名字指的是任何数量可能在滚动的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），无论是单个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），还是一团紧密聚集在一起的它们。一个球通常由一百个或一千个Waddle Dees紧密聚集而成，虽然单个的可以通过正常方式被击败或吸入，但这些球不能使用任何常规方法攻击。在地板上滚动或下坡之外，还可以看到滚动的Waddle Dees球从背景中弹入。里面的Waddle Dees似乎无法控制（也不想处于）球体形式，而且它们被紧密聚在一起的原因也不完全清楚。一旦一个Rolling Waddle Dee Ball撞到墙壁或其他障碍物时，它会破碎，使组成它的Waddle Dees向各个方向飞散。

瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）球在接触时会伤害卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们，并且可以突破如Star Block、石块和金属块等障碍物。球体阵列对普通攻击免疫，但可以通过盟友新星（Friend Star）的连续攻击摧毁，每次击中都会使球体变小，直到破裂。
wikirby-page:23166.description_en:
Rolling Waddle Dee is an enemy and stage hazard present in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. The name refers to any number of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s who may be rolling, whether it be an individual 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, or a packed ball of them. A ball typically consists of a hundred or a thousand Waddle Dees packed tightly together, and while an individual can be defeated or inhaled by normal means, the balls cannot be attacked using any conventional methods. Balls of rolling Waddle Dees can be seen bouncing in from the background in addition to merely rolling along floors and down hills. The Waddle Dees inside appear to have no control over (or desire to be in) the ball formation, and it is not entirely clear what is holding them together. Once a Rolling Waddle Dee Ball hits a wall or other obstacle, it will break apart, sending the Waddle Dees composing it flying off in various directions.

The 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） balls will hurt 卡比（Kirby） and his friends on contact and can break through obstacles such as Star Blocks, stone blocks, and metal blocks. The ball formation is immune to normal attacks, but can be destroyed using repeated volleys from the 盟友新星（Friend Star）, with each hit causing the ball to become smaller until it breaks.

wikirby-page:13730.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13730.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13730.description_zh: 拉炮鳥（Tootlebam）是一种小型漂浮的敌人，首次登场于星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies），当被摄入时会提供庆典（Festival）和复制能力（Copy Ability）。它看起来像一只五彩斑斓的圆形小鸟，嘴巴是一个派对帽，还有一个领结。它的攻击方式是飞向卡比（Kirby）或从嘴里射出彩纸。
wikirby-page:13730.description_en: 拉炮鳥（Tootlebam） is a small floating enemy that debuted in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, which provides the 庆典（Festival） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when ingested. It resembles a colorful round bird with a party cone for a mouth and a bow-tie. It attacks by flying in toward 卡比（Kirby） or by shooting confetti out of its mouth.

wikirby-page:12019.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:12019.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:12019.description_zh:
“看着我，姐妹们！我会尽我最大的努力！”她以自己的❤发誓要尽最大努力，所以她不会在战斗或艺术上输给她的姐妹们！她出发去证明自己……并希望能进入一所好艺术学校！”
— Guest Star Vividria A Colorful ❤暂停屏幕描述在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
彩绘比比提安（Vividria）是首次亮相于星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的中型Boss。她的名字是“vivid”的双关语。被吞下时，她会释放艺术家（Artist）能力。彩绘比比提安（Vividria）穿着连衣裙，有粗糙的头发形成画笔。她的马尾刷上总是涂有颜料，用于艺术创作。她没有脚，但能够悬浮。她看起来与艾莉妮（Elline）相似，不过更加紧凑。
wikirby-page:12019.description_en:
“Watch me, sisters! I'll do my best!" She swears on her ❤ to do her best, so she doesn't lose to her sisters, not in battle and not in artistry! She sets off to prove herself... and hopefully get into a good art school!”
— Guest Star Vividria A Colorful ❤ Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
彩绘比比提安（Vividria） is a mid-boss that debuted in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. Her name is a pun on "vivid". She yields the 艺术家（Artist） ability when swallowed. 彩绘比比提安（Vividria） wears a dress and has coarse hair that forms a paintbrush. Her ponytail brush is always covered with paint for art creation. She does not have feet, but is capable of hovering. She looks similar to 艾莉妮（Elline）, though much more compact.

wikirby-page:77512.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:77512.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:77512.description_zh:
“海内司（Hyness）掉进了通向另一个维度的洞里。黑暗离开了它的主人，变成了一个巨大的Jamba心并将他整个吞下。还有逃脱的希望吗？另一个维度的朋友提供了一线希望……”
— 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）的暂停画面描述（阶段1）
暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness），名为堕落祭司，是海内司（Hyness）的腐化、更强大的版本，在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Heroes in Another Dimension模式中作为Boss战斗。在打开每个传送门并进入Final Dimension后，卡比（Kirby）遇到了Jamba Heart，这通过心脏的四支长矛被打开，从而揭示了暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）。他看起来基本像海内司（Hyness），但穿着深蓝色长袍，皮肤更深蓝，耳朵上有红色条纹，在面部被揭示之前拥有红色闪光的眼睛。因为三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）在这场战斗之前还没有找到他，他在解开头巾后召唤三个穿着法师服装的木头作为武器和盾牌。暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）也作为第十一关boss出现在The Ultimate Choice的灵魂熔炼EX难度中。

当暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）在《异维英雄》中被击败时，雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）最终到达并喊出他的名字，却发现他已经昏迷不醒。然后她召唤冰斧基斯（Francisca）和炎剑露啾（Flamberge），他们对他的状态感到愤怒，三人开始与卡比（Kirby）战斗。如果卡比（Kirby）击败三位法师姐妹并拥有100个或更多Friend Heart，他会与姐妹们成为朋友，她们随后给卡比（Kirby）一个传送之星（Warp Star）。当他离开时，一颗心从中落下变回暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness），这使他恢复正常形态，并让他醒来看到将军们，他们很高兴看到他没事。如果模式在99个或更少好友心击败，暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）将保持昏迷且未治愈，屏幕随即变黑。
wikirby-page:77512.description_en:
“海内司（Hyness） has fallen into a hole leading to another dimension. The darkness left its master, transforming into a giant Jamba Heart and swallowing him whole. Is there hope for escape? Friends in another dimension offer a sliver of hope...”
— Pause screen description for 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness） (Phase 1)
暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）, titled Fell Officiant, is a corrupted, more powerful version of 海内司（Hyness） who is fought as a boss in the Heroes in Another Dimension mode in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. After opening every portal and entering the Final Dimension, 卡比（Kirby） is met by a Jamba Heart, which is opened up by the four spears of the heart to reveal 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）. He essentially looks the part of 海内司（Hyness）, but wears a dark-blue robe, has darker blue skin, has red stripes on his ears, and has red glowing eyes before his face is revealed. Because 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters） haven't found him yet prior to this battle, he summons three logs with the mages' costumes as his weapons and shields when unhooded. 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness） also appears as the eleventh boss in the Soul Melter EX difficulty of The Ultimate Choice.

When 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness） is defeated in Heroes in Another Dimension, 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） finally arrives and calls his name, only to find him out cold. She then calls on 冰斧基斯（Francisca） and 炎剑露啾（Flamberge）, who are angered by the state he is in, and all three begin to fight 卡比（Kirby）. If 卡比（Kirby） defeats the Three Mage-Sisters with 100 or more Friend Hearts, he befriends the sisters, who then give 卡比（Kirby） a 传送之星（Warp Star）. As he leaves, a heart falls from it onto 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness）, which transforms him back into his normal form and causes him to wake up and see the generals, who are delighted to see that he is okay. If the mode is beaten with 99 Friend Hearts or less, 暗化海内司（Corrupt Hyness） is left unconscious and uncured as the screen fades to black.

wikirby-page:13064.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13064.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13064.description_zh:
“巴哈哈！谁能想到我寻找Jamba Heart碎片的旅程会把我带回你和你的自夸面前！这一定是命运的炽烈之火在作祟！哦耶！我的火焰和我现在完全被点燃了！小心吧，你这微不足道的粉色害虫！以海内司（Hyness）大人的名义……我会把你变成一团燃烧的多事之球！”
— 炎剑露啾（Flamberge）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
炎剑露啾（Flamberge）中是一位首次亮相于星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的大Boss。她被描述为三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）的炽焰将军（其他两位为冰斧基斯（Francisca）和雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）），并效忠于游戏的主要反派海内司（Hyness）。

炎剑露啾（Flamberge）穿着与其他两位魔法姐妹相同的制服，但她以较深的肤色、红色配色和刺状发型而与众不同。她主要在战斗中使用火焰；她携带一个带有火焰附魔的炎剑露啾（Flamberge），并且还使用火焰喷射器。她的火焰能力是在被海内司（Hyness）从大火中救出后获得的。炎剑露啾（Flamberge）性情火爆，很容易生气和沮丧。她与冰斧基斯（Francisca）关系特别亲密，不允许任何人攻击她。
wikirby-page:13064.description_en:
“Bahaha! Who would have thought my search for the Jamba Heart pieces would lead me back to you and your puffery! This must be the fiery flames of fate at work! Ooooh yeaaaah! My flames and I are fully stoked now! Beware, you puny pink pest! In the name of Lord 海内司（Hyness）... I'll turn you into a burning ball of meddlesomeness!”
— 炎剑露啾（Flamberge） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
炎剑露啾（Flamberge） is a boss who made her debut in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. She is described as the Blazing General of 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters） (the other two being 冰斧基斯（Francisca） and 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）), and serves 海内司（Hyness）, the main antagonist of the game.

炎剑露啾（Flamberge） is dressed in the same habit as the other two Mage-Sisters, but she is distinguished by her darker skin, red color scheme, and spiky hair. She mainly uses fire in battle; she carries a 炎剑露啾（Flamberge） with a fiery enchantment, and also uses a flamethrower. Her fire powers were granted to her after she was saved from an inferno by 海内司（Hyness）. 炎剑露啾（Flamberge） has a hot-headed temperament and is quick to anger and frustration. She has a particularly close bond with 冰斧基斯（Francisca）, and will not countenance her being attacked by anyone else.

wikirby-page:12023.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:12023.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:12023.description_zh:
“但我不想在无意义的聊天上浪费时间。所以我不会！只要知道，如果你试图反对我们……我别无选择，只能把你冻结……永远！”
— 冰斧基斯（Francisca）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
冰斧基斯（Francisca）中是一位首次登场的Boss。她被描述为三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）的冰冻将军（另外两个分别是炎剑露啾（Flamberge）和雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）），并效忠于游戏中的主要反派海内司（Hyness）。

冰斧基斯（Francisca）穿着与其他两位魔法师姐妹相同的制服，但她以较白的皮肤、蓝色的配色和长发区别开来。她使用冰斧、冰系魔法（这是在被海内司（Hyness）从低温死亡中拯救后获得的能力）和汽水枪作战。在姐妹中，冰斧基斯（Francisca）是最安静和内向的。她与炎剑露啾（Flamberge）尤其关系密切。
wikirby-page:12023.description_en:
“But I do not wish to waste my time with pointless chatter. So I won't! Just know that should you attempt to oppose us... I'll have no choice but to put you on ice...FOREVER!”
— 冰斧基斯（Francisca） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
冰斧基斯（Francisca） is a boss who made her debut in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. She is described as the Frozen General of 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters） (the other two being 炎剑露啾（Flamberge） and 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）), and serves 海内司（Hyness）, the main antagonist of the game.

冰斧基斯（Francisca） is dressed in the same habit as the other two Mage-Sisters, but she is distinguished by her paler skin, blue color scheme, and long hair. She fights with her icy axe, ice-based magic (powers she was granted after being saved by 海内司（Hyness） from a death from hypothermia), and a soda gun. Of the sisters, 冰斧基斯（Francisca） is the most quiet and reserved. She has a very close bond with 炎剑露啾（Flamberge） in particular.

wikirby-page:13219.name_zh: 金角银角 金狸&银狐
wikirby-page:13219.display_name: 金角银角 金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox）
wikirby-page:13219.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13219.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13219.description_zh:
“这对闪亮的二人组在某个小行星的偏远岛屿上安了家，他们会猛烈攻击任何闯入其领地的人。小心Goldon和Silvox的毛茸茸的愤怒！”
— VS金角银角金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox）
金角银角金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox），名为《Metal重器》，是一对首次亮相于星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的双头目。金角银角金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox）与阿狸&阿狐（Pon & Con）非常相似，可被视为它们的强化版。外观差别不大，但它们没有穿着盔甲，而是拥有金色和银色毛发的金属躯体。它们可以在故事模式（Story Mode）的Mareen Moon中发现，也可以在Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!和The Ultimate Choice的高难度关卡中遇到。
wikirby-page:13219.description_en:
“This glittering duo made their home on a backwater island on a certain planetoid, and they’ll viciously attack anyone who stumbles into their territory. Beware the furry fury of Goldon and Silvox!”
— VS 金角银角 金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox）
金角银角 金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox）, titled The Metal Heavies, are a duo boss who made their debut in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. 金角银角 金狸&银狐（Goldon & Silvox） are very similar to 阿狸&阿狐（Pon & Con）, and can be considered a harder version of them. They look much the same, but they are not trussed up in armor, instead having metal bodies with golden and silver fur. They can be found in 故事模式（Story Mode） on Mareen Moon in Far-Flung Starlight Heroes, and can also be encountered in Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go! and The Ultimate Choice on higher difficulties.

wikirby-page:13159.name_zh: 顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆
wikirby-page:13159.display_name: 顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）
wikirby-page:13159.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13159.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13159.description_zh:
“顽强的大母巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）以她坚不可摧的钢铁盔甲而自豪！甚至盟友新星（Friend Star）的子弹也会对她无害地弹开。组队并尝试各种能力来找到她的弱点，将这位叮叮作响的灾难击倒！”
— VS顽强的大母巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）暂停屏幕描述
顽强的大母巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam），名为“大坏妈妈”，是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中出现的Boss。她是一个巨大的装甲对手，装备炸弹手套，头顶戴着大蝴蝶结。与其他Boss不同，她只在故事模式（Story Mode）中进行战斗，并且只能使用盟友新星（Friend Star）在Grott Moon中对付她。

在顽强的大母巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）的战斗中，她将尝试冲向盟友新星（Friend Star）并将她的炸弹手臂砸向地面。她还可以召唤援军传送到战场上，包括弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）、剑骑士（Blade Knight）和燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo）（这些敌人的能力是击败本boss的关键）。要击败顽强的大母巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam），星之盟友必须先在炸弹出现时让其中一颗炸弹脱落，然后点燃断开的导火索，使其在她头上爆炸。完成这一步后，她的护甲将被击落，使她的身体在短时间内可以受到盟友新星（Friend Star）的攻击，然后她会恢复护甲。
wikirby-page:13159.description_en:
“顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam） prides herself on her impenetrable steel armor! Even the bullets of the 盟友新星（Friend Star） bounce off her harmlessly. Team up and experiment with abilities to find her weak points, and bring that clanking calamity down!”
— VS 顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam） pause screen description
顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）, titled Big Bad Mama, is a boss who appears in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. She is a giant armored opponent with bombs for gauntlets and a large bow atop her head. Unlike other bosses, she is only fought in 故事模式（Story Mode） and is faced exclusively using the 盟友新星（Friend Star） on Grott Moon.

During 顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）'s battle, she will attempt to charge the 盟友新星（Friend Star） and launch her bomb arms into the ground. She can also call on reinforcements to warp into the battlefield, including 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）, 剑骑士（Blade Knight）, and 燃烧鬃冠（Burning Leo） (enemies whose abilities are key to defeating this boss). To defeat 顽强的大母 巨大装甲玛姆（Grand Mam）, the Star Allies must first cut loose one of the bombs while it is out, then light the severed fuse to make it explode on top of her. This done, her armor will be knocked off, leaving her body open to attacks from the 盟友新星（Friend Star） for a short duration before she restores her armor.

wikirby-page:13184.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13184.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13184.description_zh:
“你现在看到了……是不是？任何打断我们复兴仪式的人……我们必须好心地请求他们……请永远消失！”
— 海内司（Hyness），星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
海内司（Hyness），名为魔神官（Officiant of Doom），是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的主要反派，在故事模式（Story Mode）中担任倒数第二个Boss。他是一个疯狂的牧师，崇拜终焉·虚无（Void Termina），并且从堡垒世界Jambandra领导他的邪教，他的黑暗神在古代被封印。作为魔神官（Officiant of Doom），海内司（Hyness）是一位年长的巫师，隐藏在白色长袍中，长长的拖袖和遮住脸的面纱，使人只能看到他那双微小的黄色眼睛。虽然他的形状和动作暗示他有四肢，但这些从长袍下从未显现出来，这完全有可能他根本没有任何东西。海内司（Hyness）领导着一群课题，其中最显著的是三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）:冰斧基斯（Francisca）、炎剑露啾（Flamberge）和雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）。当他的兜帽被摘下时，他露出蓝色的脸、蓝黄相间的条纹耳朵，眼睛能够像变色龙一样独立移动。除了大鼻子之外，海内司（Hyness）的脸（特别是他的耳朵）与魔法洛亚（Magolor）的头型有着惊人的相似。

在Soul Melter EX中，冰斧基斯（Francisca）、炎剑露啾（Flamberge）和雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）各自的The Ultimate Choice特别页面中暗示，海内司（Hyness）曾从厄运中救过他们的命。从那时起，他们对他心存敬佩并寻求他的指导，这种忠诚是最终被疯狂的祭司利用。
wikirby-page:13184.description_en:
“You see it now... don't you? Anyone who interrupts our revival ceremony... we must kindly ask that they... PLEASE DISAPPEAR FOREVER!”
— 海内司（Hyness）, 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
海内司（Hyness）, titled 魔神官（Officiant of Doom）, is the principal villain in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, serving as the penultimate boss in 故事模式（Story Mode）. He is a mad priest who worships 终焉·虚无（Void Termina）, and leads his cult from the fortress world Jambandra, where his dark god was sealed in ancient times. Known as the 魔神官（Officiant of Doom）, 海内司（Hyness） is a venerable wizard who conceals himself in a white robe with long trailing sleeves and a veil that covers his face, such that only his beady yellow eyes can be seen. While his shape and motions would suggest he has limbs, these are never seen from under the robe, which makes it entirely possible that he does not have any. 海内司（Hyness） leads a host of subjects, the most prominent of which are 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）: 冰斧基斯（Francisca）, 炎剑露啾（Flamberge）, and 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）. When his hood is removed, he is revealed to have a blue face, blue and yellow striped ears, and eyes that move independently of each other like those of a chameleon's. Aside from the huge nose, 海内司（Hyness）'s face (particularly his ears) has an uncanny resemblance to the shape of 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s head.

It is implied in the separate The Ultimate Choice Special Pages for 冰斧基斯（Francisca）, 炎剑露啾（Flamberge）, and 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） in Soul Melter EX that 海内司（Hyness） saved their lives from doom. Since then, they look up to him with admiration and seek his guidance, a loyalty that is ultimately exploited by the crazed officiant.

wikirby-page:13247.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13247.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13247.description_zh:
“在审判之日，这个飘忽不定的恶魔将会付诸行动。由“银河中最伟大的战士”创造，并通过多年的磨难重生为末日骑士——现在将开始与被黑暗过去扭曲的纯洁存在的史诗般战斗。”
— VS冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）(星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）)
冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight），名为重生Butterfly与飘动的梦魇食者，是在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中首次亮相的Boss。它是来自Yomi的Butterfly天堂，从另一个维度飞来执行审判，并在吞噬强大存在的灵魂后变身为戴面具的剑士。它出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!最终Boss中，篡夺星河骑士（Galacta Knight），以及星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）的Forgo Dreams中，篡夺侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）。在Guest Star The Three Mage-Sisters和The Ultimate Choice的灵魂熔炼者EX难度中，它有一个更强的形态，称为冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）EX（标题为暗翼灾厄）。

冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）是一个神秘的角色。关于它的动机知之甚少，除了它想要对强大的存在进行审判，并在这个过程中吸收它们的灵魂。同样可以说它的个性（如果它有的话），尽管它通常被称为“翩翩恶魔”。冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）主要与死亡、重生和冥界相关——它的设计和背景描述参考了许多文化对于死后世界的概念，如蝴蝶、诸神的黄昏、Sukhavati、Yomi以及凤凰等。它在战斗中以火焰作为首选元素。
wikirby-page:13247.description_en:
“On the day of judgment, this fluttery fiend will fly into action. Brought into existence by "the greatest warrior in the galaxy" and reborn as a knight of doom through years of adversity—now begins an epic battle with a pure being twisted by a dark past.”
— VS 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） (星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）)
冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）, titled Reborn Butterfly and Fluttering Dream Eater, is a boss who debuted in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. It is a Butterfly of paradise from Yomi, which flies in from another dimension to pass down judgment, and transforms into a masked sword wielder after feasting on a powerful being's soul. It appears as the final boss of Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go! in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, where it usurps 星河骑士（Galacta Knight）, and Forgo Dreams in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, where it usurps 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）. In Guest Star The Three Mage-Sisters and The Ultimate Choice's Soul Melter EX difficulty, it has a stronger form called 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） EX (titled Dark-Winged Disaster).

冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） is an enigmatic character. Little is known about its motives besides its desire to pass down judgment onto powerful entities, absorbing their souls in the process. The same can be said about its personality (if it has any), though it is commonly called a "fluttering fiend". 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） is primarily associated with death, rebirth, and the underworld—its design and flavor text reference many cultures' concepts of life after death, such as butterflies, Ragnarök, Sukhavati, Yomi, and the phoenix, among many others. It utilizes fire as its element of choice in combat.

wikirby-page:21976.name_zh: 异空间的大乱云 异次元大独眼云
wikirby-page:21976.display_name: 异空间的大乱云 异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko）
wikirby-page:21976.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:21976.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:21976.description_zh:
“你如何击败那种虚无缥缈的存在？从纯粹的仇恨和漆黑闪电般天空的可怕力量中重生，独眼云（Kracko）再次出现！被赋予守护门扉的任务，独眼云（Kracko）比以往更大、更凶、更危险。请注意……”
— VS异空间的大乱云异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko）(英文)
异空间的大乱云异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko），标题为《超凡雷霆》，是首次出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Heroes in Another Dimension的一个BOSS。此阶段承接自异空间的丛云异次元双重独眼云（Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko），他比非平行版本大得多。
wikirby-page:21976.description_en:
“How do you defeat that which is ethereal? Reborn from pure hate and the terrible power of a jet-black sky, 独眼云（Kracko） lives again! Tasked with keeping the gate, 独眼云（Kracko） is bigger, badder, and more dangerous than ever. Be warned...”
— VS 异空间的大乱云 异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko） (English)
异空间的大乱云 异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko）, titled Unearthly Thunderhead, is a boss who first appeared in Heroes in Another Dimension of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. This phase follows from 异空间的丛云 异次元双重独眼云（Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko）, and he is much larger than his non-parallel counterpart.

wikirby-page:21979.name_zh: 异界的暗君 异次元帝帝帝
wikirby-page:21979.display_name: 异界的暗君 异次元帝帝帝（Otherworldly Dark Liege, Parallel Dedede）
wikirby-page:21979.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:21979.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:21979.description_zh:
“A黑暗领主诞生于帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）带到海内司（Hyness）的Jamba之心！与国王本人的灵魂一道被流放到另一个维度，这个邪恶的复制体并不是原版的德德迪！小心他异常的愤怒。”
— VS异界的暗君异次元帝帝帝（Otherworldly Dark Liege, Parallel Dedede）
异界的暗君异次元帝帝帝（Otherworldly Dark Liege, Parallel Dedede），称为异界黑暗领主，是一个平行的Boss，首次出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Heroes in Another Dimension中。他的战斗发生在第四维度。
wikirby-page:21979.description_en:
“A dark liege was born from the Jamba Heart that 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） brought to 海内司（Hyness）! Cast out into another dimension along with the King's own spirit, this foul doppelganger is NOT the original Dedede! Beware his aberrant rage.”
— VS 异界的暗君 异次元帝帝帝（Otherworldly Dark Liege, Parallel Dedede）
异界的暗君 异次元帝帝帝（Otherworldly Dark Liege, Parallel Dedede）, titled Otherworldly Dark Liege, is a parallel boss who first appeared in Heroes in Another Dimension of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. His battle takes place in the fourth dimension.

wikirby-page:22063.name_zh: 异界的霜刃 异次元魅塔骑士
wikirby-page:22063.name_en: Otherworldly Frost Blade, Parallel Meta Knight
wikirby-page:22063.display_name: 异界的霜刃 异次元魅塔骑士（Otherworldly Frost Blade, Parallel Meta Knight）
wikirby-page:22063.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:22063.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:22063.description_zh: 异界的霜刃异次元魅塔骑士（Otherworldly Frost Blade, Parallel Meta Knight），标题为《异世冰霜》Blade，是魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的平行对应者，他作为Boss出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Heroes in Another Dimension中。
wikirby-page:22063.description_en: 异界的霜刃 异次元魅塔骑士（Otherworldly Frost Blade, Parallel Meta Knight）, titled Otherworldly Frost Blade, is the Parallel counterpart to 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, who makes his appearance as a boss in Heroes in Another Dimension of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-page:22078.name_zh: 异空间的丛云 异次元双重独眼云
wikirby-page:22078.name_en: Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko
wikirby-page:22078.display_name: 异空间的丛云 异次元双重独眼云（Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko）
wikirby-page:22078.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:22078.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:22078.description_zh: 异空间的丛云异次元双重独眼云（Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko），标题为《非凡风暴前线》，是一个首次出现在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的Heroes in Another Dimension中的双人boss。这名boss基于主线故事模式（Story Mode）中的乱舞双云双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）设计，但战斗开始时就会遇到，之后会变为异空间的大乱云异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko）。
wikirby-page:22078.description_en: 异空间的丛云 异次元双重独眼云（Unearthly Storm Front, Parallel Twin Kracko）, titled Unearthly Storm Front, is a duo boss who first appeared in Heroes in Another Dimension of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. This boss is based on 乱舞双云 双重独眼云（Twin Kracko） in the main 故事模式（Story Mode）, though it is fought at the start of the battle, and later transforms into 异空间的大乱云 异次元大独眼云（Unearthly Thunderhead, Parallel Big Kracko）.

wikirby-page:21972.name_zh: 异界的人面树 异次元大树
wikirby-page:21972.display_name: 异界的人面树 异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods）
wikirby-page:21972.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:21972.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:21972.description_zh:
“时空的结构已经崩溃，产生了通往另一个维度的四个裂隙。每一个裂隙都通向过去敌人的不祥化身——就像风语大树（Whispy Woods）一样！腐烂、枯萎的树木被注入了可怕的新力量！”
— VS异界的人面树异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods）(英语)
异界的人面树异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods），名为异界树，是一位首次出现在Heroes in Another Dimension的星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的Boss。他是风语大树（Whispy Woods）的替代对应体，但他呈现出漆黑的外观，眼睛和嘴巴发出黄色光芒，使他在某种程度上有点像魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）。像他在故事模式（Story Mode）的正常对应体一样，异界的人面树异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods）是玩家在Heroes in Another Dimension中面对的第一个Boss。他也可以出现在The Ultimate Choice中，取代风语大树（Whispy Woods）本人和残樱的古树远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）。
wikirby-page:21972.description_en:
“The fabric of spacetime has broken down, creating four rifts to another dimension. Each of these rifts leads to an unholy incarnation of a past foe—like 风语大树（Whispy Woods）! The rotten, blighted arbor has been imbued with terrible new power!”
— VS 异界的人面树 异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods） (English)
异界的人面树 异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods）, titled Otherworldly Arbor, is a boss who first appeared in Heroes in Another Dimension of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. He is the alternate counterpart to 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, but he takes on a pitch-black appearance with glowing yellow eyes and mouth, making him somewhat resemble 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） in a way. Like his normal counterpart in 故事模式（Story Mode）, 异界的人面树 异次元大树（Otherworldly Arbor, Parallel Woods） is the first boss fought in Heroes in Another Dimension. He can also appear in The Ultimate Choice, replacing 风语大树（Whispy Woods） himself and 残樱的古树 远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）.

wikirby-page:13221.name_zh: 乱舞双云 双重独眼云
wikirby-page:13221.display_name: 乱舞双云 双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）
wikirby-page:13221.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13221.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13221.description_zh:
“两只眼睛在阴暗中闪烁，像天空中的愤怒面孔——这可不是独眼云（Kracko）在波普之星（Popstar）时的样子！两倍的毛茸茸，两倍的凶猛，乱舞双云双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）的组合攻击非常残酷——但它们无法匹敌友情的力量！”
— 对战乱舞双云双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）
乱舞双云双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中遇到的一个Boss。他们出现在Far-Flung Starlight Heroes的Gabbel Moon关卡中，就在独眼云（Kracko）被打败之后，并且这两朵云共享并保持了他的设计。他们还在Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!和The Ultimate Choice中被战斗——同样是在独眼云（Kracko）本人被击败之后（虽然是在同一回合中连续进行）。
wikirby-page:13221.description_en:
“Two eyes glare in the gloom like an angry face in the sky—this isn't what 独眼云（Kracko）'s like back on 波普之星（Popstar）! Twice as fluffy and twice as mean, 乱舞双云 双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）'s combo attacks are brutal—but they're no match for the power of friendship!”
— VS 乱舞双云 双重独眼云（Twin Kracko）
乱舞双云 双重独眼云（Twin Kracko） is a boss fought in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. They are encountered on the Gabbel Moon stage in Far-Flung Starlight Heroes, right after 独眼云（Kracko） is defeated, and the two clouds share and retain his design. They are also fought in Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go! and The Ultimate Choice - again after 独眼云（Kracko） himself is defeated (although back-to-back in the same round).

wikirby-page:22095.display_name: 星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void）
wikirby-page:22095.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:22095.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:22095.description_zh:
“最终的战斗在即，星诞虚无（Astral Birth, Void）踏出了迈向新时代的第一步。在专横的愤怒之外，他会找到……午睡时间吗？温柔的微风？零食？他甚至可能再次做梦……”
— VS星诞虚无（Astral Birth, Void）
星诞虚无（Astral Birth, Void），名为《星体诞生》，是一个秘密Boss，只在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的The Ultimate Choice中出现，在'灵魂融化者EX'难度下击败终焉·虚无（Void Termina）的前三个阶段后面对。他是魂沌虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）的强化版，自版本4.0.0以来作为星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的真正最终Boss，因此成为第一个比灵魂Boss等级更高的Boss。尽管他是最终Boss，星诞虚无（Astral Birth, Void）并非必须击败才能完成游戏的100%，但击败他是冠以存档文件所必需的，并将解锁Dream Button，它可以在卡比（Kirby）的默认现代外观和星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）的经典风格之间切换。
wikirby-page:22095.description_en:
“The final battle at hand, 星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void） takes his first steps toward a new age. In place of tyrannical rage, will he find...naptime? Gentle breezes? Treats? He may even dream again...”
— VS 星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void）
星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void）, titled Astral Birth, is a secret boss who is faced only in The Ultimate Choice of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, at the end of 'Soul Melter EX' difficulty after defeating the first three phases of 终焉·虚无（Void Termina）. He is a souped-up version of 魂沌 虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）, serving as the true final boss of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） since Version 4.0.0, and thus making him the first boss to be a rank above a Soul boss. Despite his position as the true final boss, 星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void） does not need to be defeated for 100% completion of the game, but beating him is needed to crown a save file and will unlock the Dream Button, which can switch 卡比（Kirby）'s look between the default modern one and the classic style from 星之卡比（Kirby's Dream Land）.

wikirby-page:13262.display_name: 魂沌 虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）
wikirby-page:13262.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13262.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13262.description_zh:
“无法确定是否属实，但根据古代卷轴记载，终焉·虚无（Void Termina）可能会以其他形式再次出现，这取决于正能量或负能量的积聚情况。看来这个黑暗存在将徘徊于银河系，直到有一天他以新的存在形式重生。当他回来时，希望他会成为……一个朋友。”
— VS。魂沌虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）暂停画面文本
魂沌虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul），名为混沌精华，是一位秘密Boss，仅在The Ultimate Choice的“灵魂熔融者”难度结束时面对。他是终焉·虚无（Void Termina）终极核心的强化版，并且在版本4.0.0之前，他曾是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的真正最终Boss，之后游戏加入了他更强的形态星诞虚无（Astral Birth, Void）。击败魂沌虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）是完成终极选择并完成星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的100%。
wikirby-page:13262.description_en:
“No telling if it's true, but according to the ancient scrolls, 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） may rise again in other forms depending on whether positive or negative energy is gathered. It seems this being of darkness will wander the galaxy until one day he is reborn into a new existence. When he returns, hopefully it will be as...a friend.”
— VS. 魂沌 虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul） pause screen text
魂沌 虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul）, titled Essence of Chaos, is a secret boss who is faced only in The Ultimate Choice, at the end of the 'Soul Melter' difficulty. He is a souped-up version of 终焉·虚无（Void Termina）'s Final Core, and used to be the true Final Boss of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies） prior to version 4.0.0, which added his stronger form, 星诞 虚无（Astral Birth, Void） to the game. Defeating 魂沌 虚无之灵魂（Essence of Chaos, Void Soul） is required to complete The Ultimate Choice and attain 100% completion of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-page:13232.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13232.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13232.description_zh:
“复活，破神（Destroyer of Worlds）...复活，终焉·虚无（Void Termina）!!”
— 海内司（Hyness），当他在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中为终焉·虚无（Void Termina）自我牺牲时。
终焉·虚无（Void Termina）是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的最终Boss。被称为破神（Destroyer of Worlds），他是由海内司（Hyness）从Jamba Heart召唤出的纯混沌存在，为了摧毁银河系，在被四位古代英雄最初封印于其中之后。作为神被海内司（Hyness）及其追随者崇拜，终焉·虚无（Void Termina）是一个极其强大的原始宇宙存在，似乎只对摧毁他遇到的一切感兴趣。终焉·虚无（Void Termina）初始出现为巨大的类大猩猩人形，但在战斗中能够改变自己的形态，最终形态极大地类似于卡比（Kirby）和暗物质（Dark Matter）。卡比（Kirby）和Friends必须使用闪耀新星同盟（Star Allies Sparkler）对抗终焉·虚无（Void Termina），在海内司（Hyness）牺牲自己和他的魔法将军以复活巨兽之后。

在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中，终焉·虚无（Void Termina）在游戏的最终关卡星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中被面对，他的失败完成了主要的故事模式（Story Mode）。终焉·虚无（Void Termina）也可以在地狱危机（Infernal Crisis）、灵魂熔融者（Soul Melter）和灵魂熔融者EX难度的The Ultimate Choice中战斗。自星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）以来，终焉·虚无（Void Termina）只在之后的一款卡比（Kirby）游戏中短暂客串一次，作为Character Treat出现在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中。
wikirby-page:13232.description_en:
“Rise, 破神（Destroyer of Worlds）... RISE, 终焉·虚无（Void Termina）!!”
— 海内司（Hyness）, when sacrificing himself to 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.
终焉·虚无（Void Termina） is the final boss of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. Known as the 破神（Destroyer of Worlds）, he is a being made of pure chaos conjured from the Jamba Heart by 海内司（Hyness） in order to destroy the galaxy, after having been initially sealed within it by four ancient heroes of yore. Having been worshiped as a god by 海内司（Hyness） and his followers, 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） is an immensely powerful primal cosmic being who seems only interested in destroying everything he comes across. 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） initially appears as a gigantic gorilla-like humanoid, but is capable of changing his form as the battle goes on, with his last form greatly resembling both 卡比（Kirby） and 暗物质（Dark Matter）. 卡比（Kirby） & Friends have to battle 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） using the 闪耀新星同盟（Star Allies Sparkler） after 海内司（Hyness） sacrifices himself and his generals of magic to revive the great beast.

In 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） is faced in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, the final level of the game, and his defeat completes the main 故事模式（Story Mode）. 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） can also be fought in The Ultimate Choice on the Infernal Crisis, Soul Melter and Soul Melter EX difficulties. Since 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, 终焉·虚无（Void Termina） has made only a single cameo in a subsequent 卡比（Kirby） game, as a Character Treat in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）.

wikirby-page:13156.name_zh: 残樱的古树 远古巨树
wikirby-page:13156.display_name: 残樱的古树 远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）
wikirby-page:13156.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13156.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13156.description_zh:
“不——那不是风语大树（Whispy Woods）！这位德高望重的长者是残樱的古树远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods），古老的树王。任何误入他领地的旅行者都将感受到大自然的全部怒火！”
— 对残樱的古树远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）暂停画面描述在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
残樱的古树远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）中，标题为老林长者，是星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的一个Boss。他的外观和攻击模式与风语大树（Whispy Woods）类似，但更强大。从美学上看，他被设计得比Whispy更显老态；他的树皮磨损且深棕色，覆盖面部的叶子像浓密的眉毛和胡须。他的叶子是秋天的红色，间中有樱花盛开，并且掉落的是樱桃，而不是Whispy通常的苹果。

Yggy主要出现在Far-Flung Starlight Heroes中，被战斗在击败Whispy后出现在Falluna Moon阶段。他也出现在Extra Planet δ阶段，在Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!和The Ultimate Choice阶段的火焰对决、地狱危机和灵魂熔炼难度等级上。
wikirby-page:13156.description_en:
“No—that’s not 风语大树（Whispy Woods）! This venerable elder is 残樱的古树 远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）, ancient king of trees. Any travelers who stray into his neck of the woods will feel the full force of nature’s wrath!”
— VS 残樱的古树 远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods） Pause Screen description in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
残樱的古树 远古巨树（Old-Growth Elder, Yggy Woods）, titled Old-Growth Elder, is a boss in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. He has a similar appearance and attack pattern as 风语大树（Whispy Woods）, though he is more formidable. Aesthetically, he is made to look older than Whispy; his bark is worn and dark brown, and leaves over his face resemble bushy eyebrows and a mustache. His leaves are an autumnal red, with cherry blossoms blooming among them, and he drops cherries rather than Whispy's usual apples.

Yggy is primarily seen in Far-Flung Starlight Heroes, being fought in the Falluna Moon stage after Whispy is defeated. He also appears in the Extra Planet δ stage, in Guest Star ???? Star Allies Go!, and in The Ultimate Choice on the Fiery Showdown, Infernal Crisis, and Soul Melter difficulty levels.

wikirby-page:13154.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 新星同盟
wikirby-page:13154.display_work: 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
wikirby-page:13154.description_zh:
“但恐怕你不受欢迎的游荡就此结束。根据我们敬爱的君主海内司（Hyness）的旨意，魔神官（Officiant of Doom）...我将现在就摧毁你！”
— 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）中的首次亮相是在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中。她被描述为三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters）的闪电将军（其他两个分别是冰斧基斯（Francisca）和炎剑露啾（Flamberge））。她也是三人组中等级最高的将军，直接听命于游戏中的主要反派海内司（Hyness）。

雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）穿着与另外两位魔法姐妹相同的服饰，但她以更华丽的头饰、黄色的配色方案和齐肩短发来区别。正如她的称号所示，雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne）在战斗中使用电力，并通过她的长柄武器，以及绑在背上的一套巨大鼓，这套鼓是模仿日本雷神Raijin所佩戴的鼓制作的。她获得这些能力是在即将被致命雷暴击倒时，但被海内司（Hyness）救了。从那时起，她对他保持永远的忠诚，尽管他对她的待遇在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）事件发生前一直在恶化。
wikirby-page:13154.description_en:
“But I am afraid your unwanted wanderings end here. By the will of our beloved liege, Lord 海内司（Hyness）, 魔神官（Officiant of Doom）... I shall destroy you here and now!”
— 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）
雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） is a boss who made her debut in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. She is described as the Lightning General of 三魔官（The Three Mage-Sisters） (the other two being 冰斧基斯（Francisca） and 炎剑露啾（Flamberge）). She is also the highest-ranking general of the trio, taking orders directly from 海内司（Hyness）, the main antagonist of the game.

雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） is dressed in the same habit as the other two Mage-Sisters, but she is distinguished by her more elaborate headgear, yellow color scheme, and bobbed hair. As her title implies, 雷枪帕噜提扎努（Zan Partizanne） uses electricity in battle, conducted through her polearm when she swings at the Star Allies, as well as a giant set of drums she straps onto her back, which are modeled after the drums worn by the Japanese God of Thunder Raijin. She gained these powers when she was about to succumb to a deadly thunderstorm, but was rescued by 海内司（Hyness）. Since then, she has been eternally loyal to him, despite his worsening treatment of her up to the events of 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-form:23890.description_zh:
“随意甩动你的Bobbin悠悠球！”
— 暂停的风味文本
Bobbin是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中存在的六个Ravel Abilities之一。获得后，它会给卡比（Kirby）一个Bobbin帽子，使他能够像主系列中的溜溜球（Yo-Yo）技能那样在使用Yarn Whip时将Bobbin向前投掷。

 Bobbin本身的射程约为纱线鞭的两倍，可以朝多个方向投掷。如果玩家按住B键，Bobbin本身将保持原位，而卡比（Kirby）可以自由移动，一旦释放B键，它将返回到他手中。Bobbin可以击败触碰到的任何普通敌人，也可以用来破坏纱线方块，但不能用于直接攻击boss.
wikirby-form:23890.description_en:
“Flick your Bobbin yo-yo with abandon!”
— Pause flavor text
Bobbin is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When obtained, it gives 卡比（Kirby） a Bobbin hat which allows him to throw the Bobbin forward like the 溜溜球（Yo-Yo） ability in the main series when he uses the Yarn Whip.

The Bobbin itself has about twice the range of the yarn whip and can be tossed in many different directions. If the player holds down the B button, the Bobbin itself will stay in place while 卡比（Kirby） is free to move around, and will return to him the moment the B button is released. The Bobbin will defeat any regular enemies it touches and can also be used to destroy yarn blocks, but it cannot be used to directly attack bosses.

wikirby-form:23889.description_zh:
“Toss Button可以炸毁各种物体。你甚至可以开辟一条道路！”
— 暂停的剧情文本
Button是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中六个Ravel Abilities之一。获得后，它会给卡比（Kirby）佩戴安全帽，并允许他在使用Yarn Whip时召唤Button炸弹。

要让炸弹出现，玩家必须按下B Button来触发Yarn鞭子（Whip），同时不能让卡比（Kirby）碰到敌人或墙壁。一旦卡比（Kirby）拿到炸弹，他可以像处理毛线球一样投掷或轻轻放下它。如果炸弹击中敌人，或者经过短时间后，它会爆炸，击败附近的任何敌人。卡比（Kirby）自身不会被自己的炸弹伤害。此外，a的炸弹爆炸可以拉动标签，尽管它在其他方面不能取代Yarn Whip的功能。卡比（Kirby）还可以使用纱线鞭子（Whip）重新抓取他轻轻放下的炸弹，尽管由于它们在不久后就要爆炸，可再次投掷的时间会更少。

如果将帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）amiibo扫描进游戏，这一能力也可以用于卡比（Kirby），使卡比（Kirby）获得Dedede帽子作为替代外观。
wikirby-form:23889.description_en:
“Toss Button bombs that can blow up all kinds of things. You could even blast open a path!”
— Pause flavor text
Button is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When obtained, it gives 卡比（Kirby） a hard hat and allows him to conjure up Button bombs when he uses the Yarn Whip.

To make a bomb appear, the player must press the B Button to trigger a Yarn 鞭子（Whip） without letting 卡比（Kirby） hit an enemy or wall. Once 卡比（Kirby） has a bomb, he can toss it or place it down gently in a similar manner to a yarn ball. If it hits an enemy, or after a short amount of time, the bomb will explode, defeating any enemies nearby. 卡比（Kirby） himself cannot be harmed by his own bombs. Additionally, a bomb's explosion can pull tabs, though it does not otherwise substitute the functions of the Yarn Whip. 卡比（Kirby） can also re-grab bombs he gently puts down by using the Yarn 鞭子（Whip）, although there would be less time to toss them again as they are about to explode shortly after.

This ability is also available to 卡比（Kirby） if the 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） amiibo is scanned into the game, giving 卡比（Kirby） the Dedede Hat as an alternate look.

wikirby-form:23888.description_zh:
“随时制作毛线球！或者通过缠住敌人制作一个巨大的毛线球。”
— 暂停风味文本
Knitting Needles是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中的六个Ravel Abilities之一。获得它时，它会给予卡比（Kirby）一顶毛线帽，这让他可以在不先缠住敌人的情况下创建毛线球。

要制作毛线球，玩家应按下B按钮来触发卡比（Kirby）的Yarn Whip，并且不要让它撞到墙。如果按钮持续按下且敌人被鞭子缠住，Knitting Needles可以用来通过将敌人与正在制作的毛线球结合来编织一个更大的毛线球。通过此能力制作的毛线球具有与由敌人制作的标准毛线球相同的特性。

此外，还有是这顶帽子的两个不同替代版本，可以通过将卡比（Kirby）和瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）amiibo扫描到游戏中获得。前者的帽子叫做星星帽，后者的帽子叫做瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）帽子。除了名称和外观，它们的功能与普通能力完全相同。
wikirby-form:23888.description_en:
“Make a yarn ball anytime! Or make a HUGE yarn ball by wrapping up an enemy.”
— Pause flavor text
Knitting Needles is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When obtained, it gives 卡比（Kirby） a hat of yarn which allows him to create yarn balls without having to wrap up an enemy first.

To create a yarn ball, the player should press the B button to trigger 卡比（Kirby）'s Yarn Whip without letting it hit a wall. If the button is held and an enemy is ensnared by the whip, the Knitting Needles can be used to weave an even larger yarn ball by combining the enemy with the yarn ball being produced. Yarn balls produced by this ability have the same properties as standard yarn balls made from enemies.

In addition, there are two separate alternate versions of this hat that can be obtained by scanning the 卡比（Kirby） and 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） amiibo into the game. The former hat is called the Star Hat, while the latter is called the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Hat. Aside from the names and look, they function exactly the same as the regular ability.

wikirby-form:5670.description_zh:
“投擲（Throw）那些Marking Pins！把它们向敌人到处扔去！”
— 暂停剧情文字
Marking Pins是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中存在的六个Ravel Abilities之一。获得后，它会给卡比（Kirby）一个针垫帽，当他使用Yarn Whip时可以向对手投掷Marking Pins。

当卡比（Kirby）投掷针时，他会投掷一组三枚针，这些针向前移动时只略微展开。这些针能够穿过整个舞台，并会击败遇到的任何普通敌人，同时摧毁毛线和布块。针可以直线前投、向上投或斜角投掷。
wikirby-form:5670.description_en:
“投擲（Throw） those Marking Pins! Toss 'em at enemies left and right!”
— Pause flavor text
Marking Pins is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When obtained, it gives 卡比（Kirby） a pincushion hat which allows him to throw Marking Pins at his opponents when he uses the Yarn Whip.

When 卡比（Kirby） tosses pins, he throws a set of three which fan out only slightly as they move forward. These pins are capable of traveling across the stage, and will defeat any standard foes they come across and destroy yarn and cloth blocks. The pins can be thrown either straight ahead, straight up, or at a diagonal angle.

wikirby-form:23887.description_zh:
“成为旋风。旋转，旋转，再旋转！”
— 暂停说明文字
Nylon是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中存在的六个Ravel Abilities之一。
wikirby-form:23887.description_en:
“Become a whirlwind. Spin, spin, and spin some more!”
— Pause flavor text
Nylon is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn.

wikirby-form:23886.description_zh:
“挥动你的剑，斩开一切！用一连串的猛劈大幅扭转局势。”
— 暂停风味文本
Wire是Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中存在的六个Ravel Abilities之一。获得后，它会给卡比（Kirby）一个Wire的帽子和剑，使他能够切割和剁碎对手。他的面部表情也会变化，这张脸总是带着皱眉。

Wire是少数几种可以替代卡比（Kirby）标准Yarn Whip的ravel技能之一，这意味着剑挥击同样能够扫开被标签隐藏的障碍物并破坏毛线方块。Wire的剑让卡比（Kirby）在站立或跳跃时拥有三次挥击和旋转剑的连招，也可以用于在水下会旋转。空中使用完整连招会使卡比（Kirby）在空中无法攻击或变形，让他在落地前处于脆弱状态。

此外，通过将魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）amiibo扫描进游戏，可以获得这顶帽子的不同版本。卡比（Kirby）获得魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）帽子，这顶帽子类似他的面具，但戴在卡比（Kirby）的头顶上。然而，区别仅在外观上。
wikirby-form:23886.description_en:
“Swing your sword and cut through anything! Turn the tables in a big way with a flurry of slashes.”
— Pause flavor text
Wire is one of the six Ravel Abilities present in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. When obtained, it gives 卡比（Kirby） a Wire hat and sword which allows him to slice and dice his opponents. His facial expression also changes, and he always has a frown on this face.

Wire is one of the few ravel abilities that replaces 卡比（Kirby）'s standard Yarn Whip, which means that the sword swipes are also capable of pulling away obstacles concealed by tags and destroying yarn blocks. The Wire sword gives 卡比（Kirby） a three-swipe and spin sword combo when standing on the ground or jumping, and can also be used in a spinning motion when underwater. Using the full combo in the air makes 卡比（Kirby） unable to attack or transform while still in the air, leaving him vulnerable until he lands.

In addition, a different version of this hat can be obtained by scanning the 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） amiibo into the game. 卡比（Kirby） gains the 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） Hat, which resembles his mask, but is worn on top of 卡比（Kirby）'s head. The difference is only aesthetic, however.

wikirby-page:48885.description_zh:
链状火焰者是一系列类似噴火輪（Flamer）的生物，它们成行行进，只能在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Slash & Bead关卡的伏击区域找到。虽然每个成员在外观上都像噴火輪（Flamer），但这些敌人不能爆发伤害魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）。当它们出现时，会以复杂的移动模式成行行进，每条链通常有数个个体。大多数链状火焰者是绿色的，但其中有一个是粉色的。链中的每个Chain Flamer都可以通过多次剑击单独击败，但击败粉色噴火輪（Flamer）会导致链中其余所有个体自动消失。或者，也可以使用魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的特殊攻击。

链式火焰器可以在《Slash & Bead》的每个关卡中找到，尽管它们只出现在伏击区域。每一个被击败时都会掉落几个珠子，并且用普通的剑击需要多次攻击才能打倒，因此在不使用特殊攻击时，最好专门攻击粉色的噴火輪（Flamer）。

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn无害的敌人
wikirby-page:48885.description_en:
Chain Flamers are a series of 噴火輪（Flamer）-like creatures that travel in a line together, which can only be found in the ambush sections of stages in Slash & Bead in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. Although each member resembles 噴火輪（Flamer） in appearance, these enemies are not capable of flaring up and harming 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）. When they appear, they travel in a line with complex movement patterns, in chains several individuals long. Most of the Chain Flamers are green, but one in particular is pink. Each Chain Flamer in the line can be individually defeated with numerous sword slashes, but defeating the pink 噴火輪（Flamer） will cause all the rest in the line to perish automatically. Alternatively, the entire chain can be destroyed in one go using 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s Special attack.

Chain Flamers can be found in every stage of Slash & Bead, though they only appear in ambush sections. Each one will drop a few beads when defeated and take several hits each to fell with normal sword swipes, so it is always ideal to target the pink 噴火輪（Flamer） exclusively when not using the Special attack.

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn Harmless enemies

wikirby-page:23840.description_zh:
“A一个有着大翅膀的强大魔鬼。当心他从空中掉下来的球。”
— Patch Plaza描述
本大爷·恶魔（Me-Devil）是出现在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Devilish Mode中三种Devil类型之一。本大爷·恶魔（Me-Devil）有一个紫色圆形身体，小脚，一只头顶的独角，一个带眉毛的纽扣眼和一个十字标志（×），还有一对大红翼。他通过向卡比（Kirby）投掷带刺球进行攻击。
wikirby-page:23840.description_en:
“A powerful devil with big wings. Watch out for the balls he drops from above.”
— Patch Plaza description
The 本大爷·恶魔（Me-Devil） is one of the three types of Devils who appear in the Devilish Mode of Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. The 本大爷·恶魔（Me-Devil） has a purple round body, with small feet, a single horn atop his head, a button eye with an eyebrow and a cross sign (×), and big red wings. He attacks by dropping spiked balls at 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:48883.description_zh:
Red Buttonbee是一个红色和黄色的按钮，带有翅膀、腿和可伸缩的刺，只在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Dedede Gogogo关卡中出现。它的身体颜色与Buttonbee相同，但有红色轮廓，使其也有点类似Buttonbug。Red Buttonbee通常被看到悬停在原地或沿Dedede Gogogo关卡以各种模式飞行。当静止不动时，它可能会伸出刺并在原地旋转，如果帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）接触到尖端会受到伤害，但否则不会伤害他。

Red Buttonbee可以在Dedede Gogogo的每个关卡中找到。被锤子或Head Slide击败时会掉落15个火花珠，否则碰撞时不会掉落任何东西。与之相遇，尽管它仍然会被击败。此外，如果被攻击击中，它会弹出屏幕，并在此过程中掉落更多的珠子。

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn
wikirby-page:48883.description_en:
Red Buttonbee is a red and yellow button with wings, legs and a retractable stinger that appears exclusively in the stages of Dedede Gogogo in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It has the same body color as Buttonbee, but has a red outline making it also somewhat resemble Buttonbug. Red Buttonbee is typically seen either hovering in place or flying in various patterns along the stages of Dedede Gogogo. When holding still, it may extend its stinger and spin in place, dealing damage to 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） if he comes into contact with the pointy end, but otherwise not harming him.

Red Buttonbee can be found in every stage of Dedede Gogogo. It drops 15 fuse beads when defeated with a hammer or Head Slide, but otherwise will drop nothing when collided with, though it will still be defeated. Additionally, if struck with an attack, it will careen off the screen, dropping additional beads as it does so.

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn

wikirby-page:23868.description_zh:
“一个有着长长尾巴的可爱小恶魔。她会像小狗对咬咬玩具一样锁定你。”
— Patch Plaza描述
那我们·恶魔（We-Devil）是出现在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn的Devilish Mode中的三种Devil之一。我们·恶魔（We-Devil）拥有一个小的紫色三角形身体，小脚，头顶上有一只角，巨大的紫红色耳朵，一个尖长的尾巴，尾端有心形，带睫毛和加号（+）的纽扣状眼睛，以及小蓝色翅膀。她可以从尾巴发射心形激光束来击中卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:23868.description_en:
“A cute devil with a looong tail. She locks onto you like a puppy with a chew toy.”
— Patch Plaza description
The 我们·恶魔（We-Devil） is one of the three types of Devils who appear in the Devilish Mode of Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. The 我们·恶魔（We-Devil） has a small purple triangular body, with small feet, a single horn atop her head, large magenta ears, a pointed long tail with a heart at the tip, a button eye with eyelashes and a plus sign (+), and small blue wings. She can fire heart-shaped laser beams from her tail to hit 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-page:48884.description_zh:
Yarn mole是一种棕色的鼹鼠状生物，只出现在Dedede Gogogo的Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn中。当帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）接近时，它会从地面各处冒出来，外表看似不起眼，但它似乎戴着三角形的太阳镜。在正常情况下，帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）会直接从这个敌人身边经过而不会有任何互动，但他可以用锤子攻击Yarn mole或使用Head Slide来击败它并获得一些引线珠。

Yarn mole可以在Dedede Gogogo的每个关卡中找到。用锤子或头部滑行击败时，会掉落15个Fuse Beads。此外，如果被攻击击中，它会撞出屏幕，同时掉落更多的珠子。

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn无害敌人
wikirby-page:48884.description_en:
Yarn mole is a brown mole-like creature that appears exclusively in Dedede Gogogo from Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. It pops out of the ground in various places when 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） gets near and has an unassuming appearance, though it appears to be wearing triangular sunglasses. Under normal circumstances, 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） will pass right by this enemy without any sort of interaction, but he can attack the Yarn mole with his hammer or Head Slide to defeat it and earn some fuse beads.

Yarn mole can be found in every stage of Dedede Gogogo. It drops 15 Fuse Beads when defeated with a hammer or Head Slide. Additionally, if struck with an attack, it will careen off the screen, dropping additional beads as it does so.

Enemies in Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn Harmless enemies

wikirby-page:23838.description_zh:
“A尖头的不良恶魔。他瞄准并冲向你。”
— Patch Plaza描述
哇·恶魔（Ye-Devil）是出现在Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn Devilish Mode中的三种Devil类型之一。哇·恶魔（Ye-Devil）拥有紫色的椭圆形身体，小脚，一个带等号（=）的扣子眼睛，以及巨大的红色翅膀。他戴着电钻帽，通过水平冲撞来击打卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-page:23838.description_en:
“A delinquent devil with a pointy head. He takes aim and charges right at you.”
— Patch Plaza description
The 哇·恶魔（Ye-Devil） is one of the three types of Devils who appear in the Devilish Mode of Kirby's Extra Epic Yarn. The 哇·恶魔（Ye-Devil） has a purple oval body, with small feet, a button eye with an equals sign (=), and big red wings. He wears a drill hat to hit 卡比（Kirby） via charging horizontally.

wikirby-page:24757.description_zh: 缩略图|右|300px|Square Kirby官方艺术作品Square Kirby是卡比（Kirby）的方形身体版本，于2019年4月1日作为日本卡比（Kirby）官方网站的愚人节恶作剧推出。此前在2018年有瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）25周年恶作剧。
wikirby-page:24757.description_en: thumb|right|300px|Official artwork of Square Kirby Square Kirby is 卡比（Kirby） but with a square body, which was introduced on April 1st, 2019 as the official Japanese 卡比（Kirby） website's April Fool's prank. It was preceded by the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） 25th Anniversary prank in 2018.

wikirby-page:70879.description_zh: Pirika是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby: Save the Rainbow Islands!中作为主要反派登场。在本卷的事件发生之前，她对湖施了魔法，使雨水落在Rainbow Islands上，以便让饮用其水的人都成为她的傀儡。她操纵卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们帮助她，从而推动了故事的发展。到故事结束时，她认识到自己的错误，并与卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们成为朋友。
wikirby-page:70879.description_en: Pirika is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes her appearance in Kirby: Save the Rainbow Islands! as the main antagonist. Prior to the events of this volume, she casts a spell on the lake that pours rain onto the Rainbow Islands in order to make everyone who drinks its water become her puppet. She manipulates 卡比（Kirby） and his friends to help her, thus setting the events of the story in motion. By the end of the story, she learns the errors of her ways and becomes friends with 卡比（Kirby） and his friends.

wikirby-page:26455.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26455.description_zh:
“另一个Team Colossal的成员出现了！大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee）用倾泻的水攻击Team卡比（Kirby）！”
— 最强者：Team Colossal四重任务描述来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee）是一个在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）首次登场的敌人。它比普通的噗噜鳗（Driblee）大得多，也更强，但移动速度更慢。在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中，大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee）可以被挑战两次，每次都是Team Colossal四重任务的一部分，前面有大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee）、大型・石像怪（Colossal Kabu）和大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head）。
wikirby-page:26455.description_en:
“Another member of Team Colossal appears! 大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee） attacks Team 卡比（Kirby） with torrents of water!”
— Toughest: Team Colossal Quad Quest Description from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee） is an enemy that debuted in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is much larger and tougher than a standard 噗噜鳗（Driblee）, though it moves much slower. In 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, 大型・噗噜鳗（Colossal Driblee） can be fought twice, each time as part of Team Colossal Quad, with 大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee）, 大型・石像怪（Colossal Kabu）, and 大型・炽热头（Colossal Hot Head） preceding it.

wikirby-page:26135.display_name: 大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:26135.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26135.description_zh:
“这个巨大的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）有一个同样巨大的长矛，可以将其攻击范围延伸得更远。不要让它刺到你！”
— 来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的风味文本
大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee）是一个巨大的枪瓦豆鲁迪（Spear Waddle Dee），在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中作为Boss首次登场，作为超级卡比（Kirby）冲突的对应角色，对比Colossal Waddle Dee，后者没有出现在本作中。在总共七个不同的Quest中进行战斗，除了第一个，其余都是与其他巨型敌人搭档。
wikirby-page:26135.description_en:
“This huge 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） has an equally large spear to extend its reach even farther. Don't let it run you through!”
— flavor text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
大型・枪瓦豆鲁迪（Colossal Spear Waddle Dee） is a giant 枪瓦豆鲁迪（Spear Waddle Dee） that debuts as a boss in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, serving as Super 卡比（Kirby） Clashs counterpart to Colossal Waddle Dee, who does not appear in this game. It is fought in a total of seven distinct Quests, with all but the first partnering it with other Colossal enemies.

wikirby-page:26420.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26420.description_zh:
“那些黑暗的眼睛中闪烁着雷电。它可能比它的冰霜同类更温暖，但你仍然需要小心电龙（Electric Dragon）！”
— Tough Quest风格文字来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
电龙（Electric Dragon）是冰龙（Ice Dragon）的黄色闪电替代形态，首次出现在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中。电龙（Electric Dragon）拥有与其冰霜对应物相同的比例和战斗风格，但它的背鳍呈雷电形状，并且肚子上有黄色闪电标记，尾巴上有白色标记。电龙（Electric Dragon）在五个不同的任务中会出现，首次在Empyrean遭遇。之后，它可以与冰龙（Ice Dragon）和火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros）一起出现，组成超级等级的Team Kaiju三人组。
wikirby-page:26420.description_en:
“Lightning crackles in those dark eyes. It may be warmer than its icy kin, but you should still beware of the 电龙（Electric Dragon）!”
— Tough Quest flavor text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
电龙（Electric Dragon） is a yellow lightning-powered alternative to 冰龙（Ice Dragon） first encountered in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. The 电龙（Electric Dragon） has the same proportions and battle style as its icy counterpart, but its dorsal fins are shaped into lightning bolts, and it has yellow lightning-bolt-shaped marks on its belly as well as white marks on its tail. The 电龙（Electric Dragon） is faced in five different Quests, and is first encountered in the Empyrean. Later on, it can be found alongside 冰龙（Ice Dragon） and 火焰加尔波洛斯（Flame Galboros） to form the Super-rank Team Kaiju Trio.

wikirby-page:26409.display_name: 冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）
wikirby-page:26409.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26409.description_zh:
“A一套蓝色盔甲，手持冰刃，突然出现在海边！在克服这一考验之前，一定要检查你的装备！”
— 过场动画文本在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的一个主要对手。它是一套大型蓝色盔甲，头盔上附有寒冷切割刀。冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）在五个不同的任务中出现，但在其第一次战斗中，它是游戏的第三个考验。之后，它可以在超级任务组Team Elementrio中与炎刃（Ignite Edge）和电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers）一起出现，并且也会作为Team Frozen Stiff的一部分与冰龙（Ice Dragon）一起出现。冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）的武器类似于卡比（Kirby）或弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble）手持的武器，并附有能力效果（Power Effect）弯刀（Cutter）来自星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）。
wikirby-page:26409.description_en:
“A suit of blue armor wielding an ice blade appeared suddenly at the Seaside! Be sure to check your gear before you overcome this ordeal!”
— Cutscene text in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade） is a major opponent in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is a large blue suit of armor with a chilly cutter blade attached to its helmet. 冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade） is faced in five different Quests, but in its first battle, it serves as the third ordeal of the game. Later on, it can be found alongside 炎刃（Ignite Edge） and 电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers） in the Super Party Quest Team Elementrio, and also appears alongside 冰龙（Ice Dragon） as part of Team Frozen Stiff. 冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）'s weapon bears a resemblance to the one wielded by 卡比（Kirby） or 弯刀骑士（Sir Kibble） with the 能力效果（Power Effect） 弯刀（Cutter） from 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

wikirby-page:26298.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26298.description_zh:
“A持剑的盔甲战士阻挡在卡比（Kirby）队伍穿越沙丘的道路上。小心——这个敌人持有一把燃烧的剑！奋力战胜这场考验！”
— 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
炎刃（Ignite Edge）中的叙述者是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的主要对手。他是一名身披华丽红色盔甲、手持大盾和能攻击时发热焰的剑的巨大士兵。他的剑与卡比（Kirby）或剑骑士（Blade Knight）所使用的剑相似，并带有能力效果（Power Effect）利剑（Sword）来自星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）的特征。

在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中，炎刃（Ignite Edge）面临五个不同的任务，他的第一次战斗作为游戏的第一个考验。之后，他可以和冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）及电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers）一起作为元素瑞奥队（Team Elementrio）的一员出现。他也出现在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中，与庞大刃（Gigant Edge）一起，作为双刃（Duo Edge）的一部分。
wikirby-page:26298.description_en:
“A sword-wielding suit of armor stands in Team 卡比（Kirby）'s way as they head through The Dunes. Watch out--this foe carries a flaming sword! Fight through this ordeal!”
— The narrator in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
炎刃（Ignite Edge） is a major opponent in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. He is a great big soldier wearing decorated red armor and wielding a large shield and a sword which produces flames on impact. His sword bears a resemblance to the one wielded by 卡比（Kirby） or 剑骑士（Blade Knight） with the 能力效果（Power Effect） 利剑（Sword） from 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

In 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, 炎刃（Ignite Edge） is faced in five different Quests, and his first battle serves as the first ordeal of the game. Later on, he can be found alongside 冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade） and 电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers） as part of Team Elementrio. He also appears in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2） together with 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） as part of 双刃（Duo Edge）.

wikirby-page:26442.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26442.description_zh:
“He……看起来他想去游泳？这是什么可怕的水中怪兽！最好带上你的毛巾！”
— Tough:泳将先生（Mr. Floaty）任务描述在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
泳将先生（Mr. Floaty）是一种天蓝色夏季主题的替代品，取代了在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）首次遇到的冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）。泳将先生（Mr. Floaty）拥有与其冰冷对应物相同的比例和战斗风格，但他没有穿连体衣和鞋子，而是选择了一条游泳短裤和帽子，并戴上潜水镜和呼吸管。泳将先生（Mr. Floaty）在三个不同的任务中会面对，首次出现在Seaside的队伍任务中。之后，他可以与冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）一起在超级队伍任务Team Shimmy中发现。
wikirby-page:26442.description_en:
“He...looks like he wants to go for a swim? It's some kind of terrifying water beast! Better bring your towel for this one!”
— Tough: 泳将先生（Mr. Floaty） Quest description in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
泳将先生（Mr. Floaty） is a sky blue summer-themed alternative to 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） first encountered in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. 泳将先生（Mr. Floaty） has the same proportions and battle style as his icy counterpart, but instead of overalls and shoes, 泳将先生（Mr. Floaty） opts for a pair of swimming trunks and cap, and a scuba mask and snorkel on his head. 泳将先生（Mr. Floaty） is faced in three different Quests, and is first encountered in the Seaside as part of a Party Quest. Later on, he can be found alongside 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） in the Super Party Quest Team Shimmy.

wikirby-page:26402.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26402.description_zh:
“团队卡比（Kirby）的调查发现了有关一个奇怪披风男子的传闻。感受到恶作剧的气息，团队跟随他的足迹，在一个黑暗的夜晚来到了遗迹……”
— 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的过场动画文本
异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的主要反派，同时也是星之卡比梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure）和星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）中梦魇（Nightmare）的对应角色。像他的普通对应体一样，异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）呈现出一个巨大的披袍巫师形象，手指细长，面容可怕。他头戴一副护目镜和角，穿着一件星际斗篷，斗篷内有蓝色的太空般景象，配有护甲护肩，并在躯干上佩戴新月形奖章，而他的躯干仅由灰色龙卷风状的附属物组成。

异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）的配音演员是Banjō Ginga，也为星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）中的ENeMeE提供了日语配音。

异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）在六个独立的任务中被战斗。在其中的三个任务中，他以被称为异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）的复仇的另一种形态出现；除了颜色更暗外，他的肩甲边缘有裂痕和破损，左角断裂，披风边缘破损且内侧呈红色，他的龙卷附属物周围有闪电，他护目镜的左侧破裂，露出了发出电流的红色“眼睛”。在倒数第二个故事任务Toughest: The Final Battle中，异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）的复仇形态在战斗星河骑士（Galacta Knight）之前被击败。
wikirby-page:26402.description_en:
“Team 卡比（Kirby）'s investigations turned up rumors of a strange, caped man. Sensing mischief, the team followed his footprints and arrived at the Ruins on a dark night...”
— Cutscene text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare） is the principal villain of 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, and a counterpart to 梦魇（Nightmare） from 星之卡比 梦之泉物语（Kirby's Adventure） and 星之卡比——梦幻大陆（Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land）. Like his normal counterpart, 异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare） takes on the appearance of a giant robed wizard with spindly hands and a frightening face. On his head, he wears a pair of goggles and horns, and he wears an astral cloak with a blue space-like visage inside of it, armored pauldrons, and a crescent moon-shaped medallion over his torso, which consists only of a gray tornado-like appendage.

异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare） is voiced by Banjō Ginga, who also provided the Japanese voice of ENeMeE in 星之卡比（Kirby: Right Back at Ya!）.

异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare） is fought in six separate quests. In three of these, he is faced in his alternate form known as 异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）'s Revenge; aside from having a darker color, his pauldrons are cracked and broken on the edges, his left horn is broken, his cloak is torn at the edge and the inside of it is colored red, his tornado appendage has lightning surrounding it, and the left side of his goggles is cracked which reveals his red "eye" that produces electricity from it. In the penultimate Story Quest, Toughest: The Final Battle, 异次元梦魇（Parallel Nightmare）'s Revenge is fought prior to fighting the 星河骑士（Galacta Knight）.

wikirby-page:26457.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26457.description_zh:
“来自另一个世界的入侵者带着可怕的力量和愤怒到来了！她显然是某种总统……”
— Toughest Quest的文字描述来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie）（完整名称：总统异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie）），她是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中出现的一个Boss。她作为异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie）的更强版本存在，就像异次元龙帝亚（Parallel Landia）是龙帝亚（Landia）EX的更强版本一样。她的名字和游戏中的文字描述暗示她是自己世界版本的Haltmann Works Company的总统。目前尚不清楚异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie）和Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie）是否是同一个人，因为Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie）的商务套装上有不同的标记。
wikirby-page:26457.description_en:
“An invader from another world arrives with terrible strength and fury! She is apparently some kind of president...”
— Toughest Quest flavor text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie） (full: President 异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie）) is a boss who appears in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. She serves as a tougher counterpart to 异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie） in the same way that 异次元龙帝亚（Parallel Landia） is a tougher version of 龙帝亚（Landia） EX. Her name and the in-game flavor text imply that she is the president of her universe's version of the Haltmann Works Company. It is left unclear whether 异次元苏姿（Parallel Susie） and Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie） are intended to be the same individual, as Pres.异次元苏姿（Pres. Parallel Susie） has different markings on her Business Suit.

wikirby-page:26378.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26378.description_zh:
“这个令人震惊的暴徒在寻找战斗对象时首次露面！他巨大的大槌带来雷霆！”
— 来自超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的派对任务风味文本
电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers）是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的一个对手。他是锤星猩（Bonkers）的电蓝色对应体，拥有尖刺的黄色发型，并挥舞着一个电力大槌，其属性类似于卡比（Kirby）或锤星猩（Bonkers）所使用的大槌，并带有能力效果（Power Effect）锤子（Hammer）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的特性。

电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers）在五个不同的任务中出现，尽管他在参与主线剧情之前，就已在派对任务中出现。他在四个任务中单独作战，并在一个任务中与冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade）和炎刃（Ignite Edge）搭档组成超级等级的团队Elementrio。
wikirby-page:26378.description_en:
“This shocking brute makes his dastardly debut as he searches for someone to fight! His massive mallet brings the lightning!”
— Party Quest flavor text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers） is an opponent in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. He is an electric-blue analogue to 锤星猩（Bonkers） who wears a spiky yellow hairstyle and wields an electric mallet with similar properties to the one wielded by 卡比（Kirby） or 锤星猩（Bonkers） with the 能力效果（Power Effect） 锤子（Hammer） in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）.

电火花锤星猩（Spark Bonkers） is faced in five different Quests, though he appears in Party Quests well before appearing in the main story. He is fought solo in four Quests, and is paired with 冻霜弯刀骑士老大（Frost Kibble Blade） and 炎刃（Ignite Edge） to form the Super-rank Team Elementrio in one Quest.

wikirby-page:26451.display_work: 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
wikirby-page:26451.description_zh:
“A毒云在一个冰冷的夜晚升起在沙丘上，让卡比（Kirby）队在这场磨难中躲避有毒的雨！”
— 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）的磨难过场动画文本
毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko）是超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中一个强大的对手。它是一个病态的绿色和品红色的独眼云（Kracko）类似物，拥有一个独特的侧向猫眼。毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko）会在四个不同的任务中出现，尽管它在故事任务出现之前就出现在队伍任务中。毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko）作为游戏中的第十个磨难出现，是在最后一组老板之前面对的最后一个磨难。之后，它可以在超级队伍任务Team Floatrio中与传送帕托利斯（Telepathos）和大洛啪（Greater Doomer）一起找到。
wikirby-page:26451.description_en:
“A thundercloud of poison rose over the Dunes on an icy-cold night, leaving Team 卡比（Kirby） to dodge their way through the poisonous rain in this ordeal!”
— Ordeal cutscene text from 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）
毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko） is a potent opponent in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）. It is a sickly green and magenta analogue to 独眼云（Kracko） who has a singular sideways cat's eye. 毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko） is faced in four different Quests, though it appears in Party Quests well before appearing in a Story Quest. 毒液独眼云（Venom Kracko） appears as the tenth Ordeal in the game, making it the very last Ordeal faced before the final set of bosses. Later on, it can be found alongside 传送帕托利斯（Telepathos） and 大洛啪（Greater Doomer） in the Super Party Quest Team Floatrio.
