wikirby-page:71331.display_work: Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!
wikirby-page:71331.description_zh: Great Elder of the Magic Guild是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，他在Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!中客串亮相。他是一位伟大的巫师，赠予卡比（Kirby）Star Compass帮助他寻找齿轮。他还帮助向Diamond Town的市民揭露Hugo的阴谋。
wikirby-page:71331.description_en: The Great Elder of the Magic Guild is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!. He is a great wizard who gifted 卡比（Kirby） the Star Compass which helps him find the gears. He also helps expose Hugo's scheme to the citizens of Diamond Town.

wikirby-page:71329.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!
wikirby-page:71329.display_work: Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!
wikirby-page:71329.description_zh: Hugo是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears!中以主要反派身份登场。他是一个贪婪的百万富翁，拥有一座钻石矿和大部分Diamond Town。他发现了这台古老的机器，并想利用它的力量来获取利益。他向那些地方的创始人提供奖金，从而推动了故事情节的发展。魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）和怪盗洛切（Daroach）了解到他修复古老机器的动机，并试图阻止他。在故事结尾，Hugo的计划失败，他被揭露并离开了小镇。
wikirby-page:71329.description_en: Hugo is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his appearance in Kirby and the Search for the Dreamy Gears! as the main antagonist. He is a greedy millionaire who owns a diamond mine and most of Diamond Town. He finds the ancient machine and wants to use its power to make profit. He offers a prize money to the founders of those parts, thus setting the plot in motion. 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） and 怪盗洛切（Daroach） learn about his motivation for repairing the ancient machine and try to stop him. In the end of the story, Hugo's plan fails, he is exposed and leaves the town.

wikirby-page:71561.debut_work_en: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi
wikirby-page:71561.display_work: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi
wikirby-page:71561.description_zh:
Beryl是出现在卡比（Kirby）系列小说中的客串角色，并在Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi中客串亮相，担任主要反派之一。Beryl是一个伪装大师，他偷走了Galaxia，并试图通过将魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）送入冥界并毁掉其声誉来取代他成为银河系最强剑士。

“Beryl”这个名字来源于一种会根据其他矿物杂质变化颜色的半透明矿物，反映了Beryl的角色。
wikirby-page:71561.description_en:
Beryl is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi, serving as one of its main antagonists. A master of disguise, Beryl steals the Galaxia and attempts to take over 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s position as the best swordsman of the galaxy by sending him to the underworld and ruining his reputation.

The name "Beryl" comes from a translucent mineral that changes color depending on other mineral impurities, reflecting Beryl's role.

wikirby-page:69236.debut_work_en: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi
wikirby-page:69236.display_work: Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi
wikirby-page:69236.description_zh: Papi是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，并在Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi中客串亮相。他是地狱中的一只蝴蝶居民，Yomi，因为尝过了这个世界的花而被困在此世界，与日本神Izanami类似。在上述小说中，他成为魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的向导和朋友，帮助魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）返回人间。
wikirby-page:69236.description_en: Papi is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his guest appearance in Kirby: Meta Knight and the Knight of Yomi. He is a butterfly resident of the underworld, Yomi, trapped in this world due to having tasted its flowers, similarly to the Japanese deity Izanami. In the aforementioned novel, he becomes 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s guide and friend, aiding 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） in his return to the world of the living.

wikirby-form:38359.description_zh: 蒙面摔角手（Wrestler）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），它赋予卡比（Kirby）多种不同的抓取和摔跤动作。它首次出现在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2），并且目前仅限于该游戏，这意味着没有敌人在被吞下时会赋予此能力，使它成为两种具有此特性的Copy能力之一，另一种是在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中的果凍（Jelly）（尽管与果凍（Jelly）不同，它完全没有提供者）。它也是第二个在衍生游戏中引入的复制能力（Copy Ability），第一个是Balloon，首次登场于摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）。当使用蒙面摔角手（Wrestler）能力时，卡比（Kirby）戴上了一顶鲜艳的红黄色摔跤面具，上面有类似火焰的图案，覆盖了上半身，仅留下他前面有两个眼睛的孔。这种能力赋予卡比（Kirby）几种不同的近战攻击，此外还有突刺、抓取和投掷，使其与格斗家（Fighter）和摔角手（Suplex）的能力非常相似。
wikirby-form:38359.description_en:
蒙面摔角手（Wrestler） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） which gives 卡比（Kirby） several different grappling and wrestling moves. It first appeared in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, and is currently exclusive to that game, meaning there is no enemy that grants this ability when swallowed, making it one of two Copy Abilities to have this trait, the other being 果凍（Jelly） in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet） (although, unlike 果凍（Jelly）, it also has no provider at all). It is also the second 复制能力（Copy Ability） to be introduced in a spin-off game, the first being Balloon, which debuted in 摸摸卡比（Kirby: Canvas Curse）.

When using the 蒙面摔角手（Wrestler） ability, 卡比（Kirby） dons a brightly-colored red and yellow luchador mask with flame-like decals which covers the upper half of his body, leaving only two holes in the front for his eyes. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） several different melee attacks, in addition to lunges, grabs, and throws, making it very similar to both the 格斗家（Fighter） and 摔角手（Suplex） abilities.

wikirby-page:40298.description_zh:
“双刃（Duo Edge）来了！这对黑钢巨人在你面前以组队的形式出现！”
— 加载画面标题描述双刃（Duo Edge）在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中的情况
双刃（Duo Edge）是卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中的双人Boss，由庞大刃（Gigant Edge）和炎刃（Ignite Edge）组成。这两人总共在Story Mode: The Destined Rivals中出现四次，在Buddy Fighters塔的特定楼层遭遇，并在The Empyrean Battle Stage上进行战斗。Gigant和炎刃（Ignite Edge）都保留了他们在超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的外观和攻击模式，尽管他们之间会努力协调各自的攻击，并且共享一条生命值，在第二阶段被击倒并同时被击败。当生命值低时，双刃（Duo Edge）会振动并闪烁红色，这类似于敌人在卡比（Kirby）冲突系列中所做的。
wikirby-page:40298.description_en:
“Here comes 双刃（Duo Edge）! This pair of black-steel giants stands before you as a tag team!”
— Loading screen caption describing 双刃（Duo Edge） in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）
双刃（Duo Edge） is a duo boss in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2） consisting of 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） and 炎刃（Ignite Edge）. These two appear a total of four times throughout Story Mode: The Destined Rivals, being encountered on specific floors of the Buddy Fighters Tower and fought on The Empyrean Battle Stage. Both Gigant and 炎刃（Ignite Edge） retain their look and attack patterns from their appearances in 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, though an effort is made between them to coordinate their respective attacks, and they share a single bar of health, being knocked into the second phase and defeated simultaneously. When at low health, 双刃（Duo Edge） will vibrate and flash red, which is similar to what enemies do in the 卡比（Kirby） Clash series.

wikirby-page:40312.display_name: 帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight）
wikirby-page:40312.description_zh:
“帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）……他们以前多次阻挡过卡比（Kirby）的道路，有时甚至会结盟。现在，为了最终击败卡比（Kirby），这些老对手成为了伙伴，组成战队应战卡比（Kirby）！于是他们向卡比（Kirby）发出了挑战。”
— 关于卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight）的Story Mode: The Destined Rivals开场旁白
帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight）是卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）中的一对双人Boss，由帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）和魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）组成的团队。他们是Story Mode: The Destined Rivals的主要反派，并在每章节的结尾与玩家战斗（虽然他们在第二章的首次遭遇并不是真正的战斗）。与双重大树（Twin Woods）和双刃（Duo Edge）不同，帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight）有许多需要团队协作才能完成的攻击。

在第2章和第3章中，帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight）在一个未命名的Battle Stage上进行战斗，该关卡不能用于普通游戏。在第4章中，他们在Stage of Destined Rivals上进行战斗，击败他们后会解锁该关卡用于普通游戏，同时解锁魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）作为可玩角色。在最终章中，他们在Stage of the Partners上进行战斗，完成战斗后该关卡也会被解锁，同时解锁帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）作为可玩角色。
wikirby-page:40312.description_en:
“帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）... Many times before have they stood in 卡比（Kirby）'s path, even allying with one another on occasion. Now, to finally defeat 卡比（Kirby）, the old rivals have become partners, taking on 卡比（Kirby） as a battle team! And so they sent 卡比（Kirby） a challenge.”
— Opening narration for Story Mode: The Destined Rivals in reference to 帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight） in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）
帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight） are a duo boss in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2） consisting of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） and 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） paired together as a team. They are the main antagonists of Story Mode: The Destined Rivals, and are fought at the end of each chapter after Chapter 1 (though their first encounter in Chapter 2 is not genuine). Unlike 双重大树（Twin Woods） and 双刃（Duo Edge）, 帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight） have many more attacks that specifically require teamwork to pull off.

In Chapters 2 and 3, 帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight） are fought on an unnamed Battle Stage that is not selectable for regular play. In Chapter 4, they are battled on the Stage of Destined Rivals, and defeating them there unlocks the stage for regular play as well as unlocking 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） as a playable fighter. In the Final Chapter, they are fought on the Stage of the Partners, and that stage too is unlocked after completing the fight, as well as unlocking 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） as a playable fighter.

wikirby-page:40346.page_title: Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight
wikirby-page:40346.variant_key: Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight
wikirby-page:40346.name_zh: 月下无双 下弦的蒙面·帝帝帝&上弦的蒙面·魅塔骑士
wikirby-page:40346.name_en: Moon Warriors, Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight
wikirby-page:40346.display_name: 月下无双 下弦的蒙面·帝帝帝&上弦的蒙面·魅塔骑士（Moon Warriors, Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight）
wikirby-page:40346.description_zh:
“Wearing戴着隐藏骑士真实本性的神秘面具，他们就像月光下的残月和新月！老对手准备迎接他们的命运。时机已到。战斗开始吧！”
— 暂停屏幕标题用于残月面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）和新月戴面具魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）于卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）
月下无双下弦的蒙面·帝帝帝&上弦的蒙面·魅塔骑士（Moon Warriors, Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight）（简称为残落面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede）与新生遮面魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）），名为月之战士，是卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）的最终boss，出现在Story Mode: The Destined Rivals的最终章节结尾。他们是被一个名为“黑暗羁绊面具”的诅咒遗物赋予力量的帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight），这件遗物还赋予了他们全新的独特武器。国王和骑士采取此策略，是为了最终在与卡比（Kirby）及其伙伴的战斗中占据上风，并在战斗中获得惊人的力量。然而，即便如此，仍不足以击败卡比（Kirby），月之战士最终被Buddy Star Blaster击败，并在过程中摧毁了面具。
wikirby-page:40346.description_en:
“Wearing the mysterious masks that hid the knight's true nature, they are like the waning and waxing crescent moons in the moonlight! Old rivals prepare to meet their destiny. The time is ripe. Let the battle be joined!”
— Pause screen caption for Waning 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） & Waxing Masked 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）
月下无双 下弦的蒙面·帝帝帝&上弦的蒙面·魅塔骑士（Moon Warriors, Waning Crescent Masked Dedede & Waxing Crescent Masked Meta Knight） (referred to in short as Waning 面具帝帝帝（Masked Dedede） & Waxing Masked 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）), titled the Moon Warriors, are the final boss of 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, appearing at the end of the Final Chapter of Story Mode: The Destined Rivals. They are 帝帝帝大王＆魅塔骑士（King Dedede & Meta Knight） empowered by a cursed relic called the Mask of Dark Bonds, which also gives them new distinct weapons. The king and knight have resorted to this tactic in order to finally gain the upper hand over 卡比（Kirby） and his buddy, and gain frightening power in battle. However, even this is not enough to best 卡比（Kirby）, and the Moon Warriors are dispatched using the Buddy Star Blaster, destroying the mask in the process.

wikirby-form:53255.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:53255.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:53255.description_zh:
“用你强大的钻击（Drill）在地下潜行！你可以用它来躲避敌人的攻击。如果你在特定的地点挖掘，你可能能够偷偷进入禁止区域！呵呵……”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
钻击（Drill），它是一个复制能力（Copy Ability），可以装备卡比（Kirby）的黄色带护目镜的安全帽，并在上面放置一个大型钻击（Drill）。这个能力允许卡比（Kirby）用钻击（Drill）直接攻击敌人，或者通过挖入地下并从别处弹出从下方攻击敌人。这个能力首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中，并以胡萝卜主题的Copy Food Ability再次出现在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中，并在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中有不同的设计。
wikirby-form:53255.description_en:
“Burrow underground with your mighty 钻击（Drill）! You can use this to dodge enemy attacks. If you dig in certain spots, you might be able to sneak into off-limits areas! Heh heh...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
钻击（Drill） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that equips 卡比（Kirby） with a yellow hard hat with a visor and a large 钻击（Drill） on top. This ability allows 卡比（Kirby） to attack foes either directly using the 钻击（Drill）, or by digging into the ground and popping up elsewhere to attack from below. This ability made its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and reappears as a carrot-themed Copy Food Ability in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet） and with a different design in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

wikirby-form:53256.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:53256.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:53256.description_zh:
“该是展示流星般神射手的时刻了！啪，啪！按住按钮来蓄力并瞄准，然后松开按钮发射闪亮的子弹。蓄力可以产生更大的爆炸！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
探巡队（Ranger）的描述是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），为卡比（Kirby）装备了一顶猎人帽，帽子上有一个星形头灯（可以在一定程度上照亮卡比（Kirby）前方的区域）以及一把手柄上带有星星的燧发巨炮小枪。这个能力允许卡比（Kirby）通过以各种方式发射星星来攻击敌人，同时也允许非常远程的攻击。该能力首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中。探巡队（Ranger）还有两种Evolved Copy Ability形态，分别是辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger）和太空探巡队（Space Ranger）。探巡队（Ranger）及其变体是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中唯一能够击中Target Switches.

的能力。在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中，可以通过吸入伯纳犬（Bernard）获得探巡队（Ranger）。在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，也可以通过吸入魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）在The Ultimate Cup Z EX的一次攻击中使用的黄色眼睛来获得探巡队（Ranger）.
wikirby-form:53256.description_en:
“Time for some shooting-star sharpshooting! Pew, pew! Hold the button down to charge and aim, then let go to send a sparkling shot flying. Charge it up for bigger blasts!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
探巡队（Ranger） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that equips 卡比（Kirby） with a hunter's cap that has a star-shaped headlamp on it (which can somewhat illuminate the area in front of 卡比（Kirby）) and a small flintlock blunderbuss gun with stars on its handles. This ability allows 卡比（Kirby） to attack foes by firing stars at them in various ways, and also allows for very long-range attacks. This ability made its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）. 探巡队（Ranger） also has two Evolved Copy Ability forms, those being 辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger） and 太空探巡队（Space Ranger）. 探巡队（Ranger） and its variants are the only abilities in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） able to hit Target Switches.

In 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, 探巡队（Ranger） can be obtained by inhaling 伯纳犬（Bernard）. In 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, 探巡队（Ranger） can also be obtained by inhaling the yellow eyes that 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） uses during one of its attacks in The Ultimate Cup Z EX.

wikirby-form:54946.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54946.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54946.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿过那个旋涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把一整个金属拱门塞进嘴里！这种形态会让你变成一个在风中飞翔的优雅滑翔机。穿越狭窄空间，并使用你的旋转冲撞扫开敌人。享受飞行吧！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拱门塞满嘴（Arch Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），它涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个大型金属拱门上以控制它，从而让他可以变成滑翔机在空中飞行。在这些飞行阶段中，卡比（Kirby）不能丢弃拱门，并且会像''Star Fox''等轨道飞行器一样持续前进。在飞行时，卡比（Kirby）可以向左转向，向右、向上或向下移动，并可以使用“旋转冲撞”进行攻击。这个招式对于他在不受伤的情况下击败敌人或突破障碍物是必需的。
wikirby-form:54946.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire metal arch into his mouth! This form turns you into a graceful glider that soars on the wind. Steer through tight spaces, and use your Spin Tackle to swat away enemies. Enjoy your flight!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拱门塞满嘴（Arch Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a big metal archway in order to take control of it, allowing him to transform into a glider and fly through the air. During these flying sections, 卡比（Kirby） cannot discard the arch, and constantly moves forward in a similar manner to rail flyers like ''Star Fox''. While flying, 卡比（Kirby） can steer left, right, up, or down, and can attack using the "Spin Tackle". This move is required for him to defeat enemies without taking damage or bust through obstacles.

wikirby-form:55439.display_name: 巨大联结车塞满嘴（Big-Rig Mouth）
wikirby-form:55439.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55439.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55439.description_zh:
“为了拯救两个世界，卡比（Kirby）的最后一口必须是他最大的一口！看起来量很大，但他似乎完全没问题。加油，卡比（Kirby）！承载你和艾菲灵（Elfilin）对未来的共同希望！飞跃天空，给予最后一击！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
巨大联结车塞满嘴（Big-Rig Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）和Last Battle Ability在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其Nintendo Switch 2版本中的表现。它涉及卡比（Kirby）包裹在带拖车的半挂卡车顶部，以便控制车辆，让他能够高速行驶并碾过敌人。它的功能类似汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth），只是专门用于对抗完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）战斗的最终阶段。Big-Rig-Mouth卡比（Kirby）在前进驾驶时转向有困难，但他可以突破任何障碍。如果头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）在此过程中出现，他可以骑上Big-Rig-Mouth卡比（Kirby）并向敌人投掷长矛。然而，与与Car-Mouth卡比（Kirby）组队时不同，他投掷的长矛飞行距离更远，并带有发光的蓝色外观。在战斗接近尾声时，艾菲灵（Elfilin）使用他的力量将Big-Rig-Mouth卡比（Kirby）弹射到空中，并给予他突破完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）最后一次用坠落碎片试图摧毁他的力量。
wikirby-form:55439.description_en:
“To save two worlds, 卡比（Kirby）'s final mouthful must be his biggest! It looks like a lot to handle, but he seems totally fine somehow. Go, 卡比（Kirby）! Carry your and 艾菲灵（Elfilin）'s combined hope for the future! Race through the sky and deliver the final blow!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
巨大联结车塞满嘴（Big-Rig Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） and Last Battle Ability in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. It involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself over the top of a semi-truck with a trailer in order to take control of it, allowing him to drive around at high speed and run over enemies. It functions much like 汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）, except that it is used exclusively during the final phase of the fight against 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）. Big-Rig-Mouth 卡比（Kirby） has difficulty turning while he is driving forward, but he can power through any obstacles in the way. If 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） is present during this sequence, he can ride Big-Rig-Mouth 卡比（Kirby） and throw spears at enemies. Unlike when teaming up with Car-Mouth 卡比（Kirby）, however, the spears he throws travel much further and have a glowing, blue appearance. Near the end of the fight, 艾菲灵（Elfilin） uses his power to propel Big-Rig-Mouth 卡比（Kirby） through the air, and give him the strength he needs to break through 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）' last attempts to destroy him using falling debris.

wikirby-form:55882.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55882.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55882.description_zh:
“戴上一顶美丽的冰制王冠，成为一股冰冷的自然力量！使用这个能力在敌人周围滑行，然后用一阵冻结敌人的冰刺让他们瞬间凝固。呼呼！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice）的描述是基于冰冻（Ice）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。拥有这个能力后，卡比（Kirby）戴上比标准冰冻（Ice）帽子拥有更大冰晶的冰制王冠，并能够发射远程冰刺来冻结敌人，同时生成地面的冰刺，卡比（Kirby）可以将其踢出。

暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice）的蓝图可以在关卡Collector in the Sleepless Valley中找到，击败舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）后获得。暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice）是游玩Treasure Road关卡Freeze and Find! Magma Skating所必需的。
wikirby-form:55882.description_en:
“Don a beautiful tiara of ice, and become a frigid force of nature! Use this ability to skate around enemies, then stop them cold with a volley of foe-freezing icicles. Brrr!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 冰冻（Ice） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） wears a tiara of ice with much larger ice crystals than the standard 冰冻（Ice） hat and is able to spew out long-ranged icicles to both freeze enemies and create grounded icicles which 卡比（Kirby） can then kick.

The blueprint for 暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice） can be found in the stage Collector in the Sleepless Valley, rewarded after defeating 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）. 暴风雪冰冻（Blizzard Ice） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Freeze and Find! Magma Skating.

wikirby-form:55807.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55807.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55807.description_zh:
“怎么了，哥们？这个弯刀（Cutter）进化版提升了威力和飞行距离。它还会从墙壁反弹，所以瞄准时要小心，把它射得更远！叮当，咔嗒，嗡嗡嗡！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter），是一个基于弯刀（Cutter）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。卡比（Kirby）现在装备了一个附在机械动力锯帽上的旋转锯，它可以将锯子向前发射，拖拽敌人并穿透他们。与之前的进化不同，这些旋转锯弹能够从墙壁反弹，以镜像方式弹开。

全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter）的蓝图可以在Searching the Oasis中找到，位于主路径后方的一个隐藏Treasure Chest中。篱笆。全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter）需要在Treasure Road阶段Off the Wall! Ricochet Switches中玩。
wikirby-form:55807.description_en:
“What's the buzz, cuz? This 弯刀（Cutter） evolution has increased power and flying distance. It'll also ricochet off walls, so aim carefully to send it extra far! Clink, clank, BUZZZZZ!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 弯刀（Cutter） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 卡比（Kirby） now wields a buzz-saw attached to a mechanical power saw hat, which shoots the saw forward to drag enemies along and pass through them. Unlike the previous evolutions, these buzz-saw projectiles have the ability to ricochet off walls, bouncing off of them in a mirror-like projection.

The blueprint for 全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter） can be found in Searching the Oasis, in a hidden Treasure Chest off the main path behind a fence. 全金属弯刀（Buzz-Saw Cutter） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Off the Wall! Ricochet Switches.

wikirby-form:53909.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:53909.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:53909.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整辆车塞进嘴里！当他这么做时，他会变成一辆活泼、粉红色的汽车，可以跳跃并使用涡轮冲刺。今天是进行风景驾驶的好日子。把收音机音量调高吧！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）的描述是，一个塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）的能力，涉及卡比（Kirby）把自己包裹在汽车顶部以控制它，使他可以高速驾驶并碾过敌人。在使用这种模式时，卡比（Kirby）可以加速以获得速度并冲破障碍（包括破裂的墙壁），并进行一次小的单跳以越过坑洞。卡比（Kirby）可以通过吸入出现的不同汽车来获得这种模式在各个阶段。有两种类型的汽车可以用于汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）：第一种在大多数宣传材料中可以看到，是一种蓝色的类似沙滩车的汽车；第二种是红色赛车，装饰有黄色和蓝色的装饰。在至少某些情况下，汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）用于类似赛道的课程，在那里卡比（Kirby）可以通过到达终点来创造纪录时间。

在Waddle Dee Café可购买的食物物品之一是基于汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）制作的。同时还有一个基于它的人偶。
wikirby-form:53909.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire car into his mouth! When he does, he turns into a peppy, pink car that can jump and use Turbo Dash. It's a nice day for a scenic drive. Turn up the radio!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself over the top of a car in order to take control of it, allowing him to drive around at high speed and run over enemies. While using this mode, 卡比（Kirby） can boost to gain speed and plow through obstacles (including cracked walls) and make a small singular jump to get over pits. 卡比（Kirby） can acquire this mode by inhaling different cars that appears in the stages. There are two types of cars that 卡比（Kirby） can use for 汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）: the first, which is seen in most promotional material, is a blue buggy-like car, while the second is a red race car decorated with yellow and blue accents. In at least some cases, the 汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth） is used in racetrack-like courses where 卡比（Kirby） can set record times by reaching the finish.

One of the food items purchasable at the Waddle Dee Café is based on 汽车塞满嘴（Car Mouth）. There is also a figure based on it.

wikirby-form:55077.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55077.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55077.description_zh:
“将你的炸弹连接在一起以一次性引爆所有炸弹！按住按钮，瞄准并投掷以放置它们。连接的炸弹越多，造成的伤害就越大！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb）的描述是基于Evolved Copy Ability的炸弹（Bomb），它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。使用它时，当卡比（Kirby）将两个链式炸弹投掷得足够近，它们会通过发光链条连接在一起。最多可以连接六颗炸弹，当它们爆炸时，会出现一个大型绿色穹顶形爆炸，并持续几秒钟。连接的炸弹越多，这些爆炸的规模就越大。卡比（Kirby）的帽子将变为常规炸弹（Bomb）帽子的变体有一个绿色的顶部和链条边缘，而炸弹外面有黑色凸点，内部有火花时会变绿。

连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb）的蓝图可以在关卡Fast-Flowing Waterworks中找到。它位于主路径上的Treasure Chest内，在清除敌人埋伏后出现。连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb）是玩Treasure Road关卡Cast a Line! Chain Bomb Trial所必需的。
wikirby-form:55077.description_en:
“Chain your bombs together to explode all of them at once! Hold the button down, aim, and throw to place them. The more bombs you connect, the more damage they'll do!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 炸弹（Bomb） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With it, when 卡比（Kirby） throws two chain bombs close enough to each-other, they will link together via a glowing chain. Up to six bombs can be linked together like this, and when they detonate, a large, green, dome-shaped explosion will appear and linger for a couple of seconds. The size of these explosions becomes larger when more bombs are connected together. 卡比（Kirby）'s hat becomes a variant of the regular 炸弹（Bomb） hat with a green top and a chain-link brim, while the bombs turn green with black bumps on the outside and a spark inside.

The blueprint for 连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb） may be found in the stage Fast-Flowing Waterworks. It is located inside a Treasure Chest along the main path, which appears after clearing an enemy ambush. 连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Cast a Line! Chain Bomb Trial.

wikirby-form:55102.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55102.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55102.description_zh:
“你可以使用双切割刀？！哇！同时向前投掷两个回旋镖刀来劈砍你前方的广阔区域。看它们飞起来很有趣……只要你自己在投掷就行。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter）的描述是一种基于弯刀（Cutter）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它的外观和行为与弯刀（Cutter）基本相同，但使用它时，除了通常造成更高伤害和更快连续投掷刀刃之外，卡比（Kirby）现在装备了一对回旋镖刀，可以单独投掷，也可以同时投掷，两者会回旋飞回他手中。在外观方面，它的帽子最显著的变化是两侧现在可以滑入两把刀，其眼睛看起来恼怒。不同于最进化的Copy能力，没有Blueprint可用于环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter）。相反，一旦在Waddle Dee Town中建造了Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop，武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）允许卡比（Kirby）立即进化为它，同时还有火山烈火（Volcano Fire），通过提供足够的Rare Stone和Star Coin给他，如果他愿意的话。

在Everbay Coast中，进入Fling, Twirl, Return! Hit the Switches Treasure Road阶段需要环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter）。这个阶段由两个难度星标记，并且让卡比（Kirby）利用他的曲锋回旋刀击中开关。
wikirby-form:55102.description_en:
“You can wield dual cutters?! Whoa! Sling both chakrams forward to slash a wide area in front of you. It's fun to watch 'em fly...as long as you're doing the throwing.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 弯刀（Cutter） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It looks and behaves largely the same as 弯刀（Cutter）, but with it, in addition to generally dealing more damage and throwing his blades in quicker succession, 卡比（Kirby） now wields a pair of chakrams that he can throw individually, or both simultaneously, which will curve back towards him. In terms of appearance, its hat most notably now allows for two blades to slide into it on the sides, and its eyes appear aggravated. Unlike most Evolved Copy Abilities, there is no Blueprint to be found for 环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter）. Instead, once Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop is built in Waddle Dee Town, 武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） allows 卡比（Kirby） to evolve into it right away, along with 火山烈火（Volcano Fire）, by giving him enough Rare Stones and Star Coins to do so if he pleases.

In Everbay Coast, 环刃弯刀（Chakram Cutter） is required to enter the Fling, Twirl, Return! Hit the Switches Treasure Road stage. It is marked by two stars of difficulty and has 卡比（Kirby） make use of his curving chakram blades to hit switches.

wikirby-form:55657.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55657.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55657.description_zh:
“尖尖、带刺的杂物全都卷成一个球？简直是针上的针！多么强大的武器！向前滚动，然后松手可以将锐利的杂物向周围飞射。哎哟！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
废品针（Clutter Needle）的描述是基于针（Needle）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。使用它，卡比（Kirby）在滚动时可以投掷带刺的投射物，对敌人造成额外伤害。

废品针（Clutter Needle）的帽子上装饰了各种不同的尖锐物品，包括：*一株有盆的仙人掌*一个螺旋开瓶器*一个城堡塔*一个红色向上箭头*一个锥形海螺壳*一颗竹子种子*一艘火箭*一根蜜蜂刺这些物品的几个不同变体出现在卡比（Kirby）身上，如他正在滚动。

废品针（Clutter Needle）的蓝图可以在关卡Scale the Cement Summit中找到，它出现在第一座塔中间的Bomb Block障碍物下面。废品针（Clutter Needle）是玩Treasure Road关卡Roll Up and Throw! Clutter Needle Trial所必需的。
wikirby-form:55657.description_en:
“Pointy, spiky clutter all rolled up into a ball? It's needles upon needles! What a powerful weapon! Roll forward, then release to send sharp clutter flying out around you. OUCH!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
废品针（Clutter Needle） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 针（Needle） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With it, 卡比（Kirby） can drop spiky projectiles as he rolls which will deal additional damage to enemies.

废品针（Clutter Needle）'s hat features a variety of different pointy items set on it, including the following: *A potted saguaro cactus *A corkscrew *A castle tower *A red up arrow *A conical sea snail shell *A bamboo seed *A rocket ship *A bee stinger A few different variants of these items appear on 卡比（Kirby） as he is rolling.

The blueprint for 废品针（Clutter Needle） can be found in the stage Scale the Cement Summit, where it appears underneath a Bomb Block barrier partway up the first tower. 废品针（Clutter Needle） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Roll Up and Throw! Clutter Needle Trial.

wikirby-form:55033.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55033.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55033.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整座过山车塞进嘴里！沿着轨道冲刺，左右倾斜以躲避。大家系好安全带，因为奇迹宇宙飞船正在飞向未来！哇哦！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
云霄飞车塞满嘴（Coaster Mouth）的描述是一个塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），它涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在奇迹宇宙飞船过山车车厢上以掌控它，从而让他可以沿着过山车轨道骑行。在骑行过程中，卡比（Kirby）会自动前进，速度会根据他在轨道上升或下降而变化。他在骑行时唯一能做的就是左右倾斜来躲避敌人、抓取道具，或击中开关。因此，这是少数几种不能用来对抗敌人的满口模式之一。卡比（Kirby）在太空船Wondaria乘坐车辆完全停稳之前，不能丢弃此塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）。
wikirby-form:55033.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire roller coaster into his mouth! Zip along the rails, and tilt left or right to dodge. Everybody strap in, because the Spaceship Wondaria is blasting into the future! Wheee!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
云霄飞车塞满嘴（Coaster Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around the Spaceship Wondaria roller coaster car in order to take control of it, allowing him to ride the roller coaster rail. While riding, 卡比（Kirby） moves forward automatically, changing speed depending on whether he is moving up or down the track. All he can do while riding is tilt left or right to dodge enemies, grab items, or hit switches. As such, this is one of the few Mouthful Modes that cannot be used to fight enemies. 卡比（Kirby） cannot discard this 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） until the Spaceship Wondaria ride vehicle comes to a full and complete stop.

wikirby-form:53923.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:53923.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:53923.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整个圆锥塞进嘴里！用你尖尖的头向下戳，打破地面或管道上的裂缝。卡比（Kirby），你已经无法控制圆锥了！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），这涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个大圆锥上以控制它，从而让他能够倒扣着撞击地面来击败敌人并打破障碍物。这种异常强力的撞击攻击是打破某些关卡装置（如破裂的水管）所必需的，同时也用于击败特定敌人。该攻击还具有相当广的范围效果，让卡比（Kirby）即使他没有直接落到敌人身上，也会伤害敌人。

这种能力的锥形物外观可能各不相同。通常使用一个大型橙色交通锥，但也包括黑色金属音箱和软冰淇淋交通锥。
wikirby-form:53923.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire cone into his mouth! Use your pointy head to jab below you and bust open cracks in the ground or on pipes. You're out of cone-trol, 卡比（Kirby）!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a big cone in order to take control of it, allowing him to slam into the ground upside-down to defeat enemies and bust open obstacles. This exceptionally strong slam attack is needed to bust open certain stage devices such as cracked water pipes, and is also used to defeat specific enemies. The attack also has a fairly wide area of effect, allowing 卡比（Kirby） to harm enemies even if he doesn't land right on top of them.

The cone 卡比（Kirby） uses to take on this ability can vary in appearance. Typically, a large orange Traffic Cone is used, but others include a black metal Speaker and a Soft-Serve Traffic Cone.

wikirby-form:55802.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55802.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55802.description_zh:
“O哦，好漂亮……哎哟！而且很锋利！在滚动时松开按钮，可以在你前方发射尖刺水晶。你还可以滚得更远，并在身后留下尖刺！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水晶针（Crystal Needle）中的描述是基于Evolved Copy Ability的针（Needle），它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。这个能力赋予卡比（Kirby）一顶镶有长珍珠水晶的银色头冠。使用水晶针（Crystal Needle），卡比（Kirby）在滚动过程中可以留下水晶尖刺轨迹，同时还能够整体滚动得更久。当他收回水晶时，他会向前发射一个或多个水晶球作为投射物。

水晶针（Crystal Needle）的设计图可以在The Wastes Where Life Began关卡中找到，位于a Treasure Chest在第一区域搁浅的船上方。需要水晶针（Crystal Needle）才能玩Treasure Road关卡Rush and Roll! Falling Needle Road.
wikirby-form:55802.description_en:
“Ooh, how pretty...ouch! And sharp! Release the button while rolling to launch spiky crystals in front of you. You'll also roll longer and leave spikes in your wake!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水晶针（Crystal Needle） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 针（Needle） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a silver tiara with long pearlescent crystals embedded in it. Using 水晶针（Crystal Needle）, 卡比（Kirby） can leave behind a trail of crystal spikes as he rolls along as well as being able to roll around for longer in general. When he retracts his crystals, he shoots one or more balls of crystals forward as projectiles.

The blueprint for 水晶针（Crystal Needle） can be found in the stage The Wastes Where Life Began, located in a Treasure Chest atop the grounded ship in the first area. 水晶针（Crystal Needle） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Rush and Roll! Falling Needle Road.

wikirby-form:55749.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55749.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55749.description_zh:
“M嗯……Zzz……走到……床上……变得全身舒适温暖……Zzz……你会向大家展示……你全部的潜力……在醒来之后……Zzz……Zzz……Zzzzz……”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
深层睡觉（Deep Sleep）的描述是基于睡觉（Sleep）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。与标准变体不同，当卡比（Kirby）获得此能力时，他不会自动进入睡眠状态：相反，他可以像平常一样自由移动（并吸入与塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）相关的物体），只是眼睛半睁，显得慵懒。卡比（Kirby）的帽子也变成了类似枕头的帽子，像云上的新月——云上的星星在特定位置会在黑暗中发光。卡比（Kirby）可以选择激活此能力在任何时间和地点：通过这样做，他可以立即召唤一张床并在上面小憩片刻（他甚至可以在不寻常的地形上，比如清水（Water）表面、熔岩和有毒泥浆上做床而不受到伤害）。这次小憩会完全治愈他（33.4%生命值× 3），并且在醒来时会随机获得一次攻击、速度或生命值的提升，类似于在Waddle Dee's Item Shop出售的强化物品。像标准变体一样，深层睡觉（Deep Sleep）不能在Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop被强化。

像其基础能力睡觉（Sleep）一样，深层睡觉（Deep Sleep）没有Treasure Road阶段。
wikirby-form:55749.description_en:
“Mmm.... Zzz... Walk to...bed...and get all...cuddly cozy... Zzz... You'll show everyone...your full potential...after you wake up... Zzz... Zzz... Zzzzz...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
深层睡觉（Deep Sleep） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 睡觉（Sleep） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. Unlike the standard variant, when 卡比（Kirby） acquires this ability, he is not automatically put to sleep: instead, he is free to move around as usual (and inhale objects associated with 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）s), just with lazy half-open eyes. 卡比（Kirby）'s hat also becomes a pillow-like hat resembling a crescent moon on a cloud—the stars present on the cloud also glow in the dark in specific locations. 卡比（Kirby） can choose to activate this ability at any time and anywhere: by doing so, he conjures a bed on the spot and takes a brief nap on it (he can even make his bed on unconventional terrain like the surface of 清水（Water）, lava and toxic goop without taking damage). This nap fully heals him (33.4% health x 3), as well as giving him one random boost to his attack, speed, or health when waking up, similar to the power-up items sold at Waddle Dee's Item Shop. Like the standard variant, 深层睡觉（Deep Sleep） cannot be Powered Up at Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop.

Like its base ability, 睡觉（Sleep）, 深层睡觉（Deep Sleep） does not have a Treasure Road stage.

wikirby-form:54218.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54218.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54218.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整个圆顶塞进嘴里！把其中一个物体缠绕起来，然后扭开直到它弹开。里面有什么好东西吗？只有一种方式可以弄清楚！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
巨蛋塞满嘴（Dome Mouth），这是一个涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在圆顶上以将其从固定装置上剥离的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），从而让他能够打开某些储藏处来获取物品或隐藏的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）笼子。值得注意的是，与其对象在他吸气时向他靠近相比，卡比（Kirby）反而会被吸向圆顶，从而贴在上面。

一旦卡比（Kirby）剥下圆顶，他将被留在直到他把它吐出来为止。然而，他仍然可以继续扭动，但无法移动位置。在卡比（Kirby）吐出穹顶后，它将消失，卡比（Kirby）无法再次吸入它。

这个塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）是用来完成对完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的第一阶段战斗的，其中卡比（Kirby）必须拧开困住艾菲灵（Elfilin）的能量球，然后矛会刺向他。这也用于在类似情况下结束魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）战斗的第一阶段。
wikirby-form:54218.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire dome into his mouth! Wrap around one of these, then twist until it pops open. Think there's anything good inside? Only one way to find out!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
巨蛋塞满嘴（Dome Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a dome in order to peel it off its fixture, allowing him to open up certain caches to get at items or hidden 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） cages. Notably, rather than the object coming toward 卡比（Kirby） when he inhales, 卡比（Kirby） instead is sucked toward the dome in order to stick on top of it.

Once 卡比（Kirby） has peeled off the dome, he will be left stuck to it until he spits it back out. He can continue wiggling around, however, but will be unable to move from his spot. After 卡比（Kirby） has spat out the dome, it will disappear and 卡比（Kirby） cannot inhale it again.

This 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） is the one used to finish the first phase against 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）, where 卡比（Kirby） has to unscrew an energy sphere holding 艾菲灵（Elfilin） captive before a spear impales him. This is also done to conclude the first phase of the 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） battle as well, under similar circumstances.

wikirby-form:55747.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55747.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55747.description_zh:
“成为拥有龙之力量的传奇怪物！像火焰喷射器一样喷火。跳跃、攻击，并在天空中滑翔。你可以做各种龙的动作！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
龙之烈火（Dragon Fire）的描述是基于烈火（Fire）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。这个能力给卡比（Kirby）提供了一个类似龙爪和翅膀的帽子，并在背后喷出紫色烈焰。使用这个能力，卡比（Kirby）可以用类似火焰喷射器的长距离火焰烧灼敌人，他的燃烧攻击范围和持续时间大幅增加，使他能够用火焰龙翼在空中飞行。

龙之烈火（Dragon Fire）的蓝图可以在关卡Windy, Freezing Seas，通过在关卡末端附近使用作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth）找到可访问的Treasure Chest。播放Treasure Road关卡《熔化与滑翔！赛向大炮》需要龙之烈火（Dragon Fire）。
wikirby-form:55747.description_en:
“Become a legendary monster with the power of a dragon! Spew fire like a flamethrower. Jump, attack, and glide through the sky. You can do all sorts of dragon-y stuff!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
龙之烈火（Dragon Fire） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 烈火（Fire） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a hat that resembles the claw and wings of a dragon with a large purple fire spewing out the back. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） can scorch enemies with a long blast of fire akin to a flamethrower, and his Burn attack is greatly increased in reach and duration, allowing him to fly through the air with fiery dragon wings.

The blueprint for 龙之烈火（Dragon Fire） can be found in the stage Windy, Freezing Seas, by locating a Treasure Chest accessible using 作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth） near the end of the stage. 龙之烈火（Dragon Fire） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Melt and Glide! Race to the Cannon.

wikirby-form:55528.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55528.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55528.description_zh:
“优雅、典雅、美丽……还有残酷的攻击。将你的敌人拉入羽毛的旋风之中，把战斗变成高雅的芭蕾舞。哎呦！几乎和足尖鞋一样疼……”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）的描述是基于龙卷风（Tornado）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。借助它，卡比（Kirby）可以更长时间地移动，并随着时间的推移增加他的漩涡能力。帽子的设计基于中Boss天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）。

天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）的蓝图可以在关卡The Wondaria Dream Parade中找到，并可通过使用水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）将疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car）发射到受损遮板后方的脆弱墙壁来访问。天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）是玩Treasure Road关卡所必需的。Swirl and Twirl! Turn the Windmills.
wikirby-form:55528.description_en:
“Grace, elegance, beauty...and brutal attacks. Pull your enemies into a flurry of feathers, and turn battles into sophisticated ballets. Ow! Hurts almost as much as pointe shoes...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 龙卷风（Tornado） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With it, 卡比（Kirby） can travel longer and grow his vortex over time with this ability. The design for the hat is based on the mid-boss 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）.

The blueprint for 天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado） can be found in the stage The Wondaria Dream Parade, and can be accessed by using 水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth） to launch a 疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car） into a fragile wall behind a damaged shutter. 天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Swirl and Twirl! Turn the Windmills.

wikirby-form:55880.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55880.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55880.description_zh:
“冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）赋予你冰冷的能力……还有一顶非常可爱的帽子！喷出冻结的气流，创造一排雪人。啊，它们都有Frosty的脸！他一定很骄傲。”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice），是基于冰冻（Ice）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。拥有它后，卡比（Kirby）现在戴着一顶类似狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的派克帽（在某种程度上也像来自Kirby Battle Royale的冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）帽子），并且可以喷出冰冻气息来冻结敌人，同时创造雪人，卡比（Kirby）还可以踢这些雪人。如果卡比（Kirby）在奔跑中使用冰冻（Ice）风暴攻击，也会创造一排雪人。

冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）的蓝图可以在The Battle of Blizzard Bridge，来自击败狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）后出现的Treasure Chest。需要冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）才能玩Treasure Road阶段Freezing Fight! Frosty Ice Trial.
wikirby-form:55880.description_en:
“冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice） gives you chilling powers...and a really cute hat! Blow out freezing blasts of air and create a line of snowmen. Aww, they all have Frosty's face! He must be so proud.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 冰冻（Ice） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With it, 卡比（Kirby） now wears a parka hat that resembles 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty） (and the 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） Hat from Kirby Battle Royale to an extent), and can spew freezing breath to both freeze enemies and create snowmen which 卡比（Kirby） can then kick. Using the 冰冻（Ice） Storm attack will also create a line of snowmen if used while 卡比（Kirby） has running momentum.

The blueprint for 冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice） can be found in The Battle of Blizzard Bridge, from a Treasure Chest that appears after defeating 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）. 冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Freezing Fight! Frosty Ice Trial.

wikirby-form:55873.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55873.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55873.description_zh:
“这把大刀绝对是巨大无比的！虽然挥动起来有点困难，但它能很好地保护你。用它来挡住攻击，然后展开反击！”
— Figure关于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）的描述是一个基于利剑（Sword）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。拥有这个能力后，卡比（Kirby）可以装备一套服装以及类似狂野刃（Wild Edge）的剑与盾。虽然动作较慢，但这个能力的剑击能够造成相当大的伤害。当Guard时，卡比（Kirby）会拿出一个能抵挡大多数伤害的盾牌。他也能在举盾状态下移动，但无法闪避。

庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）的图纸可以在Circuit Speedway中找到，它出现在在Treasure Chest内部，沿着主要路径，它会作为在该关卡中击败狂野刃（Wild Edge）的奖励出现。庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）是Treasure Road关卡Slash and Slice! Gigant Sword Trial所需的。
wikirby-form:55873.description_en:
“This big ol' sword is definitely gigant...ic! It's a bit hard to swing around, but it'll keep you well guarded. Use it to shield yourself from an attack, then go on the offensive!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
庞大利剑（Gigant Sword） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 利剑（Sword） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） wields an outfit as well as a sword and shield that resembles 狂野刃（Wild Edge）. Although slow, this ability's sword swings can do considerable damage. When Guarding, 卡比（Kirby） pulls out a shield that negates most forms of damage. He is also able to move around with the shield up, but he cannot dodge.

The blueprint for 庞大利剑（Gigant Sword） can be found in Circuit Speedway, appearing inside a Treasure Chest along the main path which pops up as a reward for defeating 狂野刃（Wild Edge） in that stage. 庞大利剑（Gigant Sword） is required for the Treasure Road stage Slash and Slice! Gigant Sword Trial.

wikirby-form:55745.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55745.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55745.description_zh:
“Toss变成自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb），然后观察它工作！它会在区域内巡逻，直到发现敌人，然后冲向他们并爆炸。将炸弹连锁起来以围堵敌人！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb）的描述是一种基于炸弹（Bomb）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。当卡比（Kirby）扔出落在地上或清水（Water）表面的炸弹时，它会获得轮子（如果在水面上则额外获得游泳圈）并开始沿扔出方向移动。如果炸弹接近敌人，它会锁定敌人并开始向其移动，随后爆炸。类似于连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb），这些追踪炸弹也可以连锁在一起。卡比（Kirby）的帽子会变成黑色并带有粉色信号。波形图案、一个耳机和一个雷达盘，而炸弹是粉色的，前端是蓝色，天线是黑色的，顶部有绿色火花。

自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb）的蓝图可以在关卡An Unexpected Beast King中找到，击败帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）会获得该蓝图。要玩Treasure Road关卡Seek the Switches! Homing Bomb Hunt，需要自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb）。
wikirby-form:55745.description_en:
“Toss a 自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb）, then watch it get to work! It'll patrol the area until it spots an enemy, then race toward them and explode. Chain bombs together to corner your foes!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 炸弹（Bomb） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. When 卡比（Kirby） throws a bomb that lands on the floor or even the surface of 清水（Water）, it will gain wheels (plus a swimming ring if on water) and start moving in the direction it was thrown. If the bomb gets close to an enemy, it will lock on to it and start moving towards it, exploding afterwards. Similar to the 连锁炸弹（Chain Bomb）, these homing bombs can also be linked together. 卡比（Kirby）'s hat becomes black with pink signal wave patterns, a headset, and a radar dish, while the bombs are pink with a blue front and a black antenna that has a green spark on the top.

The blueprint for 自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb） can be found in the stage An Unexpected Beast King, and is rewarded for defeating 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）. 自动追踪炸弹（Homing Bomb） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Seek the Switches! Homing Bomb Hunt.

wikirby-variant:17:cafe-staff-kirby.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-variant:17:cafe-staff-kirby.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-variant:17:cafe-staff-kirby.description_zh:
咖啡店员卡比（Cafe-Staff Kirby）是卡比（Kirby）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）》。
“Hiii！”
— 卡比（Kirby）
卡比（Kirby）是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的主角和同名者。他是一种粉红色的小生物，居住并保护着整个波普之星（Planet Popstar），但他的真正起源尚不清楚。尽管卡比（Kirby）的外表很简单，但他球形的身材、闪亮的大眼睛和开朗的举止很容易被认出。人们经常看到他骑着传送之星（Warp Star），但也可以通过吸入空气并像气球一样膨胀来飞行。虽然卡比（Kirby）有很多方法来对抗他的敌人，但迄今为止最广为人知的是他能够张开大嘴吸走对手，然后将他们整个吞掉。这样做可以让卡比（Kirby）复制他刚刚吃的任何东西的属性，以难以预测的方式扩展他的力量。使用这些能力对于卡比（Kirby）克服冒险中面临的更大挑战通常至关重要。卡比（Kirby）被归类为沉默主角；也就是说，在大多数情况下，他不会以声音或文字方式与玩家交谈，但游戏中的角色暗示可以理解他。然而，某些补充材料，尤其是该系列历史的早期材料，表明卡比（Kirby）具有正常说话的能力，通常是在与游戏不同的连续性中。不管他说话的能力如何，他通常都很大声，使用大量的咕哝、喊叫和单音节词——最著名的是他欢快地拉长的“嗨！”
wikirby-variant:17:cafe-staff-kirby.description_en:
Cafe-Staff Kirby is a distinct form or variant of Kirby in Kirby and the Forgotten Land.
“Hiii!”
— 卡比（Kirby）
卡比（Kirby） is the main character and namesake of the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. He is a small pink creature who resides on and protects all of 波普之星（Planet Popstar）, though his true origins are unknown. Despite his simplistic appearance, 卡比（Kirby） is easily recognizable by his ball-like stature, his large glossy eyes, and his cheerful demeanor. He is often seen riding a 传送之星（Warp Star）, but can otherwise fly by taking in air and puffing up like a balloon. While 卡比（Kirby） has many ways to combat his foes, the most well-known by far is his ability to open his mouth wide to suck up his opponents and then swallow them whole. Doing this allows 卡比（Kirby） to copy the attributes of whatever he just ate, expanding his powers in ways that are difficult to predict. Using these abilities is often crucial for 卡比（Kirby） to overcome the greater challenges he faces on his adventures. 卡比（Kirby） is classified as a silent protagonist; that is, he does not speak audibly or in text to the player in most instances, but characters in-game are implied to understand him. However, certain supplementary material, especially earlier in the series' history, has shown 卡比（Kirby） with the ability to speak normally, often in separate continuities from the games. Regardless of his ability to speak, he is generally very vocal, using lots of grunts, shouts, and monosyllables — most famously, his cheery elongated "Hi!"

wikirby-variant:17:fishing-pond-kirby.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）

wikirby-form:54866.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54866.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54866.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞入那个漩涡之后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以将整个灯泡塞进嘴里！用你嗓子里发出的光照亮周围环境。当你被照亮时移动很困难，所以要仔细观察周围环境，然后再熄灭光，谨慎地摇晃前进！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
灯泡塞满嘴（Light-Bulb Mouth）的描述是一种塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个大灯泡上以控制它，从而照亮周围区域。这可以在黑暗区域使用，也可以用于需要光才能激活的开关。当卡比（Kirby）照亮区域时，他移动得较慢。这种照明也会吸引幽灵黑刺球（Ghost Gordo）s，无论何时他被点亮，都会追逐卡比（Kirby）。
wikirby-form:54866.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire light bulb into his mouth! Illuminate your surroundings with the glow from your gullet. It's hard to move when you're lit up, so study your surroundings, go dark again, and wobble onward—carefully!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
灯泡塞满嘴（Light-Bulb Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a big light bulb in order to take control of it, allowing him to light up the surrounding area. This can be used on dark areas, and can also be used on switches that require light to activate. When 卡比（Kirby） is illuminating the area, he moves slower. This illumination also attracts the attention of 幽灵黑刺球（Ghost Gordo）s, who will pursue 卡比（Kirby） whenever he is lit up.

wikirby-form:55818.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55818.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55818.description_zh:
“自称国王的重锤现在属于你了！让面具的力量接管，释放带有火焰炫耀的毁灭性攻击！”
— Figure星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer）的描述是一种基于锤子（Hammer）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。卡比（Kirby）挥舞着一个面具和两把类似于狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）的锤子，这些锤子既快速又能造成重大伤害。这些锤子还赋予卡比（Kirby）使用某些攻击时发射追踪敌人的火旋风弹的能力。

蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer）的蓝图由家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）代表帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）提供给卡比（Kirby），这发生在他出现在Waddle Dee Town之后（主线剧情完成后）。蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer）也需要解锁并玩Treasure Road阶段Attack! Masked Hammer Trial.
wikirby-form:55818.description_en:
“The self-proclaimed king's hard-hitting hammers are now yours! Let the power of the mask take over to unleash devastating attacks with a fiery flourish!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 锤子（Hammer） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 卡比（Kirby） wields a mask and two hammers akin to 狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede） that are both fast and have the capability to deal heavy damage. These hammers also give 卡比（Kirby） the ability to launch fiery twister projectiles when using certain attacks that home in on enemies.

The blueprint for 蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer） is given to 卡比（Kirby） by 家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee） on behalf of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） after he appears in Waddle Dee Town (after the main story is completed). 蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer） is also required to unlock and play the Treasure Road stage Attack! Masked Hammer Trial.

wikirby-form:55876.display_name: 魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）
wikirby-form:55876.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55876.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55876.description_zh:
“魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）有一系列很酷的攻击——就像它的名字一样！利剑（Sword）滑行、跳跃并攻击以使用上级卡利伯。满血状态下，你甚至可以发射新月射击！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）是一个基于利剑（Sword）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。拥有此能力时，卡比（Kirby）使用Galaxia的复制品，戴上面具，并长有小蝙蝠翅膀，除了翅膀外几乎与魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）相同，因为这个能力是以他为基础的。如果卡比（Kirby）在使用滑行攻击后跳起并攻击，他将施展一个较短版本的Upper Calibur。卡比（Kirby）可以通过触碰魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）或孤高的幻梦魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）的Galaxia来获得此能力，当他掉落（即使卡比（Kirby）尚未在Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop解锁它）。

在完成Colosseum中的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）杯赛后，卡比（Kirby）将获得魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）的蓝图。Treasure Road的Slash! Meta Knight Sword Trial关卡需要魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）。
wikirby-form:55876.description_en:
“The 魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword） has a bunch of cool attacks—just like its namesake! 利剑（Sword） Slide, jump, and attack to use Upper Calibur. With full health, you'll even sling Crescent Shots!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 利剑（Sword） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） wields a replica of Galaxia, wears a mask, and has tiny bat wings, all almost identical to that of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s aside from the wings, as the ability is based off him. If 卡比（Kirby） jumps and attacks after using his slide attack, he'll perform a shorter version of Upper Calibur. 卡比（Kirby） can obtain this ability by touching 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s or 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）'s Galaxia when he drops it after beating him in his Upper Calibur attack in the Colosseum (even if 卡比（Kirby） has not unlocked it at Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop yet).

The blueprint for 魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword） is rewarded to 卡比（Kirby） upon clearing the 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） Cup in the Colosseum. 魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Slash! Meta Knight Sword Trial.

wikirby-form:55819.display_name: 冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword）
wikirby-form:55819.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55819.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55819.description_zh:
“在最终战斗之前，一只振翅的恶魔到来以施行裁决。这种危险的武器将这种形态赋予任何使用它的人。对于卡比（Kirby）来说，掌握这种力量是……轻而易举的。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword）的描述是基于利剑（Sword）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。卡比（Kirby）挥舞一把类似冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）的红色长剑，该剑能够像魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword）一样发射弯月光束，并能够像庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）一样暂时大幅增加体积。卡比（Kirby）的闪避也得到了升级，达到了在闪避持续时间内完全消失的程度。某些攻击使卡比（Kirby）在击中敌人时能够回复一些生命值，这就是由一个发光的球体释放并飞向他来表示。他可以通过在空中Guard然后攻击来使用“Sukhavati音阶波”攻击，这会在他周围产生一个保护波，同时也可以通过在地面上防御然后攻击来使用“Sukhavati心灵兽”攻击。

冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword）的蓝图可以在关卡Forgo Land中找到，在击败冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）后出现。冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword）也是解锁并游玩Treasure Road关卡Slash! Morpho Knight Sword Trial所必需的。
wikirby-form:55819.description_en:
“Before the final battle, a fluttering fiend arrives to cast its judgment. This dangerous weapon grants that form to any who wield it. For 卡比（Kirby）, handling this power is...a breeze.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 利剑（Sword） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 卡比（Kirby） wields a reddish sword akin to 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） which has the capability to fire crescent beams like 魅塔骑士利剑（Meta Knight Sword） and temporarily grow in size substantially like 庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）. 卡比（Kirby）'s dodge is upgraded as well to where 卡比（Kirby） will vanish completely for the entirety of the dodge's duration. Certain attacks allow 卡比（Kirby） to recover a bit of health when he hits an enemy, which is represented by a glowing orb being released and flying into him. He can use the "Sukhavati Scale Wave" attack by Guarding in the air and then attacking, which creates a protective wave around him, as well as the "Sukhavati Psychic Beast" attack by guarding and then attacking on the ground.

The blueprint for 冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword） can be found in the stage Forgo Land, appearing after defeating 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）. 冥蝶骑士利剑（Morpho Knight Sword） is also required to unlock and play the Treasure Road stage Slash! Morpho Knight Sword Trial.

wikirby-form:55719.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55719.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55719.description_zh:
“最有经验的枪手需要最花哨的帽子。烈火（Fire）用双持玩具枪进行一连串的射击。你也可以释放一阵充能射击！嘭嘭，嘭嘭！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger）的描述是一个基于探巡队（Ranger）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。拥有它后，卡比（Kirby）现在使用一对花哨的类似火铳的枪，使他能更快地向敌人发射小星星。他的帽子也显得更加花哨，像殖民时期船长的帽子，帽顶有镀金星徽章，并有两根蓬松的黄色羽毛从顶部伸出。

辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger）的图纸可以在关卡The Tropical Terror中找到，出现在南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）被击败。要进入Treasure Road阶段Long Shots! Noble Ranger Trial，需要此能力。
wikirby-form:55719.description_en:
“The most experienced of marksmen requires the fanciest of hats. 烈火（Fire） a barrage of shots with dual-wielded pop guns. You can release a flurry of charged shots too! P-pew, p-pew!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 探巡队（Ranger） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With it, 卡比（Kirby） now wields a fancy pair of blunderbuss-like guns, allowing him to fire small stars much more rapidly at his foes. His hat also becomes noticeably fancier, resembling that of a colonial-era ship captain with a gold-plated star on the crest and two voluminous yellow feather plumes coming out the top.

The blueprint for 辉煌探巡队（Noble Ranger） can be found in the stage The Tropical Terror, appearing after 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） is defeated. This ability is required to play the Treasure Road stage Long Shots! Noble Ranger Trial.

wikirby-form:55529.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55529.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55529.description_zh:
“这个钻头进化非常强大且富含石墨感！它不太适合书写，但你可以用它从地面发射出去并发射铅笔火箭。这才是真正的书写工具！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
铅笔钻击（Pencil Drill）的描述，是一个基于钻击（Drill）出现于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Evolved Copy Ability。有了这个能力，卡比（Kirby）会获得一个带着短铅笔的巨型削铅笔器帽子，铅笔朝外。当卡比（Kirby）使用这个能力从地面挖出时，他会将铅笔当作投射物发射以造成额外伤害。

该能力的图纸可以在关卡“危险”中的大Top下找到，击败卡洛凌（Clawroline）后获得。玩阶段Treasure Road阶段Dig and Dash! Path of Fences.
wikirby-form:55529.description_en:
“This drill evolution is mighty and graphite-y! It's not ideal for writing, but you can use it to launch out of the ground and shoot out pencil rockets. Now that's the write stuff!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
铅笔钻击（Pencil Drill） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 钻击（Drill） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. With this ability equipped, 卡比（Kirby） gains a large pencil sharpener for a hat with a short pencil stuck inside pointing outward. When 卡比（Kirby） digs out of the ground using this ability, he shoots the pencil as a projectile for extra damage.

The blueprint for this ability can be found in the stage Danger under the Big Top, rewarded after defeating 卡洛凌（Clawroline）. This ability is required to play the Treasure Road stage Dig and Dash! Path of Fences.

wikirby-form:54917.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54917.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54917.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整根管子塞进嘴里！做一个好的前滚翻，没有什么能阻挡你……假设你的跳跃时机掌握得好，可以越过空隙。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水管塞满嘴（Pipe Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），它涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一根大金属管上以控制它，从而让他能够快速沿斜坡滚动，击败敌人并沿途破坏所有障碍物。在卡比（Kirby）使用这种模式时，他无法控制移动的方向或速度。相反，他唯一能做的就是在合适的时候跳跃，以避免掉入坑中或者无法到达所需的地点。水管塞满嘴（Pipe Mouth）用于突破脆弱的墙壁，通常用于发现隐藏的房间并拯救瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）.

就像云霄飞车塞满嘴（Coaster Mouth）一样，卡比（Kirby）直到到达“轨道”的尽头并撞上无法破坏的墙壁，压扁管子并迫使卡比（Kirby）吐出来以继续前进之前，无法吐出管子。
wikirby-form:54917.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire pipe into his mouth! Get a good forward roll going, and nothing can stop you...assuming you time your jumps over gaps well, that is.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水管塞满嘴（Pipe Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a big metal pipe in order to take control of it, allowing him to roll rapidly down slopes, defeating enemies and breaking all obstacles along the way. While 卡比（Kirby） is using this mode, he cannot control the direction or speed at which he moves. Instead, all he can do is jump at opportune times to avoid falling into pits or otherwise not going where he needs to. 水管塞满嘴（Pipe Mouth） is used to break through fragile walls, typically to uncover a hidden chamber and save a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）.

Much like 云霄飞车塞满嘴（Coaster Mouth）, 卡比（Kirby） is unable to spit out the pipe until he reaches the end of the "track" and hits an unbreakable wall, flattening the pipe and forcing 卡比（Kirby） to spit it out in order to progress.

wikirby-form:54857.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54857.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54857.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整个金属环塞进嘴里！呼出强大的气流来吹走沙子、打败敌人，或者驱动风车！”
— Figure对来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
圈圈塞满嘴（Ring Mouth）的Ring-Mouth卡比（Kirby）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），其中涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个大金属圈上以控制它，从而让他能向敌人吹出强力的风击败他们。使用这种风攻击，卡比（Kirby）还可以吹散堆积的沙子，驱动Windmill Switch或推动水中的船只撞击物体并快速穿越液体区域。当Ring-Mouth卡比（Kirby）掌舵船只时，他是官方称为Boating Ring-Mouth卡比（Kirby）.
wikirby-form:54857.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire metal ring into his mouth! Huff and puff out blasts of air to blow sand away, defeat enemies, or spin windmills!”
— Figure description for Ring-Mouth 卡比（Kirby） from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
圈圈塞满嘴（Ring Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a big metal hoop in order to take control of it, allowing him to blow powerful gusts of wind at his enemies to defeat them. Using this wind attack, 卡比（Kirby） can also blow away piles of sand, power Windmill Switches, or power a boat in the water to ram into things and quickly traverse fluid-filled areas. When Ring-Mouth 卡比（Kirby） is steering a boat, he is officially known as Boating Ring-Mouth 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-form:54919.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54919.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54919.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整个剪叉式升降机塞进嘴里！升降自己以够到物品并躲避敌人的攻击。你还可以在升起时吐出升降机以到达高处的平台顶端！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth），是一种塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）技能，需要卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在剪叉式升降机上以控制它，使他能够沿着设定路径移动并向上延伸一段距离以获取物品、击败敌人并到达高处。在使用作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth）时，卡比（Kirby）只能向左或向右移动。卡比（Kirby）还可以改变自己的高度，向上延伸或根据需要缩回以够到物品、触发开关或避开障碍物。当向上伸展时，该动作可以攻击并击败卡比（Kirby）上方的敌人。卡比（Kirby）还可以在伸展时将剪叉升降台弹出，从而跳到上面并将其用作高平台。
wikirby-form:54919.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire scissor lift into his mouth! Raise and lower yourself to reach items and dodge enemy attacks. You can also spit the lift out while extended to reach the top of tall platforms!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a scissor lift in order to take control of it, allowing him to move along a set path and extend himself upward a good distance in order to grab items, defeat enemies, and reach high places. While using 作业车塞满嘴（Scissor-Lift Mouth）, 卡比（Kirby） can only move to the left or right. 卡比（Kirby） can also change his height, extending or retracting as needed to reach items, hit switches, or avoid obstacles. When extending upward, the action can hit and defeat enemies above 卡比（Kirby）. 卡比（Kirby） can also spit the scissor lift out while it is extended to pop up on top of it and use it as a high platform.

wikirby-form:55879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55879.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55879.description_zh:
“发射吧，太空探巡队（Space Ranger）！烈火（Fire）从你可靠的激光枪发射激光束。如果完全充能的射击击中敌人，他们将被困在一阵火花中并受到额外伤害！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）的描述
太空探巡队（Space Ranger）是一个基于探巡队（Ranger）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。卡比（Kirby）现在戴着一顶银色和青色的宇航员头盔，护目镜上有屏幕，背后有一个装饰性的喷气背包，头顶伸出一个卡通天线。他现在还使用一把带有霓虹蓝环的金色光线枪发射激光束。如果完全充能，卡比（Kirby）将改为发射一股巨大的能量冲击波，类似于电离子（Plasma）的全充能波攻击。

太空探巡队（Space Ranger）的蓝图可以在Conquer the Inferno Road关卡中找到，通过在关卡的最后射击Target Switch。需要太空探巡队（Space Ranger）才能游玩Shoot and Scoot! Conveyor Targets关卡Treasure Road.
wikirby-form:55879.description_en:
“Blast off, 太空探巡队（Space Ranger）! 烈火（Fire） laser beams from your trusty laser gun. If a fully charged shot hits an enemy, they'll be caught in a flurry of sparks and take extra damage!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
太空探巡队（Space Ranger） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 探巡队（Ranger） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 卡比（Kirby） now wears a silver and cyan astronaut helmet with a screen on the visor, a cosmetic jetpack on its back, and a cartoonish antenna sticking out from the top. He also now wields a golden ray gun with neon blue rings that shoots laser beams. If fully charged, 卡比（Kirby） will instead shoot a giant blast of energy, similar to 电离子（Plasma）'s fully-charged wave attacks.

The blueprint for 太空探巡队（Space Ranger） can be found in the stage Conquer the Inferno Road, by shooting a Target Switch at the very end of the stage. 太空探巡队（Space Ranger） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Shoot and Scoot! Conveyor Targets.

wikirby-form:54704.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54704.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54704.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿越那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把一整套脚手架楼梯塞进嘴里！移动楼梯以到达难以触及的地方。你还可以把自己倾倒来压扁敌人。砰！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
阶梯塞满嘴（Stairs Mouth）的描述是一种塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一大套脚手架楼梯上以控制它们，可以倾倒以击败敌人、破坏障碍、发现秘密，并将楼梯移动到更有利于到达高处的位置。在使用这种塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）时，卡比（Kirby）无法转身，而必须向左右或向后移动。他还会失去他的能够跳到任何有意义的高度。猛击攻击可以摧毁金属方块和其他障碍物，并且会将接触到的任何敌人压扁。卡比（Kirby）在使用猛击攻击时也免疫伤害。楼梯，无论它们是否在卡比（Kirby）中，也会熄灭经过下面的点燃导火线，因此卡比（Kirby）需要小心放置楼梯的位置。
wikirby-form:54704.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire set of scaffold stairs into his mouth! Move the stairs around to access hard-to-reach spots. You can also tip yourself over to crush enemies. Wham!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
阶梯塞满嘴（Stairs Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a large set of scaffold stairs in order to take control of them, allowing him to tip over to defeat enemies, bust open obstacles, discover secrets, and move the stairs to a more favorable spot for reaching high things. While using this 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）, 卡比（Kirby） cannot turn around, and must instead scoot from side to side or backwards. He also loses his ability to jump with any meaningful height. The slam attack can break metal blocks and other obstacles, and will flatten any enemy it contacts. 卡比（Kirby） is also immune to damage while using the slam attack. The stairs, whether they are in 卡比（Kirby） or not, will also extinguish lit fuses that pass underneath, so 卡比（Kirby） needs to be careful where he puts the stairs.

wikirby-form:54796.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:54796.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:54796.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整套储物柜塞进嘴里！扭动并挣扎，直到你被掀倒……嘿！谁把这个放在储物柜后面了？”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
置物柜塞满嘴（Storage Mouth）中Storage-Mouth的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），使卡比（Kirby）能够环绕一整套储物柜，将它们从墙上拉下来，并揭示其背后的线索和隐藏通道。值得注意的是，当他吸气时，不是物体向卡比（Kirby）移动，而是卡比（Kirby）被吸向储物柜以粘附在上面。

当卡比（Kirby）附着在储物柜上时，他需要不断扭动，直到和储物柜一起倒下。做到这一点后，他就可以吐出储物柜，这些储物柜随后很快就会破裂。还有一种这个塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）的变体叫做Bolted-置物柜塞满嘴（Storage Mouth），可以在关卡《前往Alivel商场的旅程》的结尾找到。在这里，储物柜被固定在它们后面的墙上，因此卡比（Kirby）最终会花费一点额外的力气把整面墙拉下来。
wikirby-form:54796.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire set of lockers into his mouth! Wiggle and thrash until you tip over... Hey! Who put this behind the lockers?”
— Figure description for Storage-Mouth from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
置物柜塞满嘴（Storage Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that allows 卡比（Kirby） to wrap himself around a set of lockers in order to pull them off the wall and reveal clues and hidden passageways behind them. Notably, rather than the object coming toward 卡比（Kirby） when he inhales, 卡比（Kirby） instead is sucked toward the lockers in order to stick to them.

When 卡比（Kirby） is attached to the lockers, he needs to wiggle continuously until he topples over with them. This accomplished, he can then spit out the lockers, which will break shortly afterward. There is also a variant of this 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） called Bolted-置物柜塞满嘴（Storage Mouth）, which can be found at the end of the stage A Trip to Alivel Mall. Here, the lockers are bolted to the wall behind them, so 卡比（Kirby） ends up pulling the entire wall down with a bit of extra effort.

wikirby-form:55768.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55768.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55768.description_zh:
“不祥的乌云！强烈的风！这场可怕的风暴只需按下一个按钮就会咆哮而起。通过旋转将敌人拉入你的旋风中，然后用闪电攻击他们！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado）的描述是一种基于龙卷风（Tornado）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。这个技能赋予卡比（Kirby）一个类似女武神风格的纹章，背后有一个黑色龙卷风，不时伴有闪电。卡比（Kirby）的龙卷风攻击范围比天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）更广，但现在可以在攻击后对敌人施加闪电伤害。此外，任何被卡比（Kirby）龙卷风卷入的敌人在攻击结束时会被甩向附近的敌人。

风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado）可以在关卡Gathering of the Beast Council中找到，位于带有过山车的平台下的一个小角落。玩Treasure Road关卡Whirl 'Em Away! Storm Tornado Trial需要风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado）。风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado）是可获得的最后一个二级进化能力（假设按顺序获得）。
wikirby-form:55768.description_en:
“Ominous clouds! Powerful winds! This scary storm roars to life with the press of a button. Pull enemies into your cyclone by swirling into them, then attack with lightning!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 龙卷风（Tornado） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a Valkyrie-style crest with a black tornado behind it, which regularly flashes with electricity. 卡比（Kirby） has a wider range for his tornado attack like 天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）, but can now strike enemies with lightning after his attack. In addition, any enemies caught in 卡比（Kirby）'s tornado will be flung towards any other nearby foes within range when the attack finishes.

The blueprint for 风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado） can be found in the stage Gathering of the Beast Council, in a small nook under the platform with the roller coaster on it. 风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Whirl 'Em Away! Storm Tornado Trial. 风暴龙卷风（Storm Tornado） is the last second-level Evolved Ability that can be obtained (assuming they are obtained in order).

wikirby-form:55530.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55530.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55530.description_zh:
“我们没想到爆裂（Crash）的能力爆发还能变得更强……但这个可以打破时间本身！减慢时间，然后快速行动，造成真正的破坏！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
时间爆裂（Time Crash）的描述是基于爆裂（Crash）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。装备此能力时，卡比（Kirby）会获得一顶金色礼帽，帽子上嵌有闪亮的沙漏，并在前方有一个计时盘。时间爆裂（Time Crash）允许卡比（Kirby）在几秒钟内制造一个显著减慢时间的爆炸，产生棕褐色调效果并降低音乐音量。然而，与爆裂（Crash）不同，爆炸本身不会对敌人造成伤害；相反，它会在卡比（Kirby）周围形成一个能量领域，他可以冲向敌人对其造成重击，方式类似于Invincible Candy。每击败一个新敌人，减速持续时间都会延长。在此动作期间，卡比（Kirby）不会因与普通敌人、中型Boss或Boss碰撞而受到伤害，但他仍可能受到无敌敌人或投射物以及其他危险的伤害。然而，这些敌人会受到减速时间的影响，使卡比（Kirby）更容易躲避它们。随着减速效果消退，时间开始加快，棕褐色滤镜的区域会缩向卡比（Kirby），直到完全消失，并且卡比（Kirby）失去该能力。如果在动作结束前被打断，例如离开该区域、激活塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）或触发过场动画后，该能力不会丢失，并且可以再次使用。

在Wondaria Remains的恐怖屋入侵中可以获得Blueprint用于时间爆裂（Time Crash）。完成主线剧情后，它只能提升一次。时间爆裂（Time Crash）是游玩并完成标有三颗难度星的Treasure Road关卡Stop Time! Slow-World Scramble的必要条件。
wikirby-form:55530.description_en:
“We didn't think the 爆裂（Crash） ability's boom could get any biggest-er...but this one can break time itself! Slow down time, then act fast to cause some real destruction!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
时间爆裂（Time Crash） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 爆裂（Crash） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. While equipped with this ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a golden top hat with a shining hourglass inset and a timer dial on the front. 时间爆裂（Time Crash） allows 卡比（Kirby） to create an explosion that slows time down significantly for a few seconds, creating a sepia-tone effect and muffling the music. Unlike 爆裂（Crash） however, the explosion itself does not deal damage to enemies; instead, it surrounds 卡比（Kirby） with an energy field, and he can run into enemies to deal heavy damage to them, in a manner similar to Invincible Candy. This extends the duration of the slowdown with each new enemy defeated. During the move, 卡比（Kirby） cannot be hurt by collision with normal enemies, mid-bosses, or Bosses, but he can still take damage from invincible enemies or projectiles, as well as other hazards. However, they will be affected by the slow time, letting 卡比（Kirby） avoid them more easily. As the slowdown effect wears off, time begins to move faster and the area of the sepia filter shrinks towards 卡比（Kirby） until it vanishes completely, and 卡比（Kirby） loses the ability.
