If the move is interrupted before it runs out, such as by leaving the area, activating 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）, or triggering a cutscene, the ability will not be lost, and can be used again.

The Blueprint for 时间爆裂（Time Crash） can be obtained in Invasion at the House of Horrors in Wondaria Remains. After completing the main story, it can only be powered-up once. 时间爆裂（Time Crash） is necessary to play and complete the Treasure Road stage Stop Time! Slow-World Scramble, which is marked with three stars of difficulty.

wikirby-form:55650.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55650.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55650.description_zh:
“当然，这可能是史上最可爱的锤击……但这可不是玩具！它拥有快速连续的攻击，足以钉桩并粉碎敌人。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer）的描述是基于锤子（Hammer）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。在这种形态下，卡比（Kirby）挥舞着一个大大的吱吱作响的锤子：它比标准的锤子（Hammer）略强一些，也快得多，连击攻击拥有额外的击打次数。该技能的外观类似于Kirby Battle Royale中的哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer）头饰，只是头带换成了浅蓝色自行车头盔，锤子则颜色稍微鲜艳一些。

哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer）的蓝图出现在关卡欢迎来到沃达利亚，可以通过使用水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）浇灌枯萎的花朵来找到。玩Treasure Road关卡需要哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer）。猛击Top！击打钉子。
wikirby-form:55650.description_en:
“Sure, this may be the cutest bonk to ever bonk a bonk...but this is no plaything! It has rapid, continuous attacks with enough power to hammer stakes and crush enemies.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 锤子（Hammer） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. In this form, 卡比（Kirby） wields a large squeaky hammer: it is slightly more powerful than the standard 锤子（Hammer）, and also much faster, with extra hits for its combo attack. The ability's appearance is similar to the 哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer） headgear in Kirby Battle Royale, only with a light-blue bicycle helmet instead of a color-swapped headband, and a slightly more vibrant hammer.

The blueprint for 哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer） appears in the stage Welcome to Wondaria, and can be found by watering the withered flowers using 水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）. 哔哔锤子（Toy Hammer） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Smack to the Top! Hit the Nails.

wikirby-form:55813.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55813.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55813.description_zh:
“释放双倍钻头威力的猛烈攻击！你的速度和伤害都会提升，并且你在钻入地下的时候还能攻击上方的敌人！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
双重钻击（Twin Drill），它是一个基于钻击（Drill）的Evolved Copy Ability，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。该能力的帽子类似于标准钻击（Drill）帽子，但颜色更深，并且配有两个钻头而非一个。当卡比（Kirby）开始在地面挖掘时，一个迷你锯会跟随他移动，在挖掘过程中可以伤害他经过下方的敌人。双重钻击（Twin Drill）比之前的进化体挖掘速度更快，因此可以造成更大的地震冲击。在卡比（Kirby）挖出火从地面斜向上。

双重钻击（Twin Drill）的蓝图可以在Moonlight Canyon中找到，藏在第一区域悬崖侧的一个桶里。玩Treasure Road关卡Dig and Duck! Runaway Parade需要双重钻击（Twin Drill）。
wikirby-form:55813.description_en:
“Unleash brutal attacks with double the drill power! Your speed and damage are both increased, and you can attack enemies above you while still burrowing below!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
双重钻击（Twin Drill） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 钻击（Drill） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. The hat for this ability resembles the standard 钻击（Drill） hat, but is darker in hue and features two drills instead of one. When 卡比（Kirby） starts digging in the ground, a mini saw follows him around as he digs, which can damage enemies he passes under. 双重钻击（Twin Drill） digs faster than the previous evolutions, so a bigger Quake Surge can be made. In addition, 卡比（Kirby） shoots two additional drill-like projectiles when he digs out of the ground which fire diagonally upward.

The blueprint for 双重钻击（Twin Drill） can be found in Moonlight Canyon, inside a barrel tucked in the cliffside in the first area. 双重钻击（Twin Drill） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Dig and Duck! Runaway Parade.

wikirby-form:53919.display_name: 自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth）
wikirby-form:53919.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:53919.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:53919.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把整个自动售货机塞进嘴里！烈火（Fire）汽水罐会向前攻击敌人并突破障碍物。你的弹药有限，所以注意任何可以捡回的罐子！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth）的描述是一个塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），它涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己裹在自动售货机周围以控制它，使他能够对敌人迅速发射汽水罐以击败他们。这些投射物也可以用来打破路障，并且——如果它们没有击中敌人或飞出地图边缘——将掉落为可收集的食物物品，可以捡起恢复健康并补充机器库存一个罐头。

自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth）只有有限的弹药。如果卡比（Kirby）用完，他将无法再发射任何汽水罐，并且投币机在被他吐回时会损坏。即使卡比（Kirby）将投币机带到其他地方并且还有一些库存，一台补充过库存的新投币机也会出现在最初发现它的地方。
wikirby-form:53919.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff an entire vending machine into his mouth! 烈火（Fire） soda cans forward to attack enemies and blast through barriers. Your ammo is limited, so keep an eye out for any cans that can be picked back up!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a vending machine in order to take control of it, allowing him to spit rapid volleys of soda cans at enemies to defeat them. These projectiles can also be used to bust open barricades, and - if they do not hit an enemy or fly off the edge of the map - will drop as collectable food items that can be picked up to restore health and replenish the machine's stock by one can.

自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth） only has a limited amount of ammunition. If 卡比（Kirby） runs out, he will be unable to fire any more soda cans, and the vending machine will break when he spits it back out. A new vending machine with replenished stock will appear at the spot where the first one was found, even if 卡比（Kirby） left the vending machine somewhere else with some stock left.

wikirby-form:55527.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55527.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55527.description_zh:
“BOOM! FWOOSH!这座火山正在喷发！利用地热能量在你面前喷出熔岩。穿越敌人，让他们感受到炙热！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
火山烈火（Volcano Fire）的描述是一个基于烈火（Fire）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。这个能力赋予卡比（Kirby）一顶由熔岩制成、前面有黑色岩石饰冠的帽子。使用此能力时，卡比（Kirby）可以喷射一股火山碎屑流（类似于星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）中的燃烧石块（Burning Stone）），这股碎屑流的射程比烈火（Fire）的烈火（Fire）呼吸攻击更远，并造成更多伤害。

当卡比（Kirby）首次访问Waddle Dee Town的商店时，可以从武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）获得火山烈火（Volcano Fire）的蓝图。此能力是玩Treasure Road阶段Light 'Em Up! Lantern Switches所必需的.
wikirby-form:55527.description_en:
“BOOM! FWOOSH! This volcano's erupting! Harness the power of geothermal energy to spew lava in front of you. Blaze through enemies and make 'em feel the heat!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
火山烈火（Volcano Fire） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 烈火（Fire） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a hat made of molten lava with a black rock crest at the front. Using this ability, 卡比（Kirby） can breathe a stream of volcanic pyroclast (similar to 燃烧石块（Burning Stone） from 星之卡比64（Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards）) which can travel farther than 烈火（Fire）'s 烈火（Fire） Breath attack and deal more damage.

The blueprint for 火山烈火（Volcano Fire） can be obtained from 武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） when 卡比（Kirby） first visits the shop in Waddle Dee Town. This ability is required to play the Treasure Road stage Light 'Em Up! Lantern Switches.

wikirby-form:55036.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55036.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55036.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过那个漩涡后获得了神秘的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力……现在他可以把大量的水灌入口中！在水管旁把自己灌满水，然后摇晃着走到一片泥潭上，把水喷开清理出一条前行的道路。感谢你的清理！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）技能，它让卡比（Kirby）将自己灌满大量水，使身体像水球一样膨胀（甚至变得像水球一样透明），并可以从嘴里喷出水。卡比（Kirby）可以通过找到蓝色水管并将嘴放在上面获得此能力。这样可以清理泥巴、毒液或熔岩区域，可能会揭示隐藏物品或使平台上下移动。这种水也可以用来攻击敌人，并且需要用来偏转疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car）或击败毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom）和回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket）。自然地，由于卡比（Kirby）的体型膨胀，他成为了更大的目标，除了摇晃和短距离跳跃之外几乎无法移动。最终，随着喷射的水用尽，卡比（Kirby）的体型会逐渐缩小，每次加满水可以连续喷射大约15秒。
wikirby-form:55036.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the mysterious 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through that vortex... Now he can stuff a huge amount of water into his mouth! Fill yourself up at a water pipe, wobble over to a patch of muck, and spray it away to clear a path forward. Thanks for cleaning up!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） that involves 卡比（Kirby） filling himself with a large amount of water, distending his body like a water balloon (and even becoming translucent like one) and allowing him to spray the water from his mouth. 卡比（Kirby） can obtain this ability by finding a blue water pipe and putting his mouth on it. Doing so allows him to clean up patches of mud, toxic goop, or lava, which may uncover hidden items or cause platforms to rise and fall. This water can also be used to attack enemies, and is required to deflect 疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car）s or defeat 毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom）s and 回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket）s. Naturally, due to 卡比（Kirby）'s inflated size, he becomes a bigger target and is unable to move much aside from wobble about and jump short distances. Eventually, 卡比（Kirby） will gradually shrink back down in size as he runs out of water to spray, with each fill giving him enough to spray for about 15 seconds continuously.

wikirby-form:55805.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-form:55805.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-form:55805.description_zh:
“这把沉重的锤子由超坚硬的石头制成！它太重，无法快速击打，但每一次强力挥击都会造成爆炸性的伤害。你甚至可以裂开地面本身！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤子（Wild Hammer）的描述是一个基于锤子（Hammer）的Evolved Copy Ability，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。这个能力赋予卡比（Kirby）一头凌乱的蓝色发型和面部彩绘，使他看起来像狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）。卡比（Kirby）还使用一把石凿；虽然速度慢，但有能力造成可观的伤害，尤其是在使用Hammer Flip充能时。

狂野锤子（Wild Hammer）的蓝图可以在Alivel Mall (Staff Side)中找到，位于击败旁室中的狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）后出现的Treasure Chest内。狂野锤子（Wild Hammer）是需要玩Treasure Road阶段Whack Attack! Wild Hammer Trial.
wikirby-form:55805.description_en:
“This hefty hammer is made from super-tough stone! It's too heavy for quick hits, but each powerful swing will deal explosive damage. You'll even crack the ground itself!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤子（Wild Hammer） is an Evolved Copy Ability based on 锤子（Hammer） that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This ability gives 卡比（Kirby） a frazzled blue hairdo and face paint to make him resemble 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）. 卡比（Kirby） also wields a stone chisel; although it is slow, it has the capability to deal considerable damage, particularly when charged using Hammer Flip.

The blueprint for 狂野锤子（Wild Hammer） can be found in Alivel Mall (Staff Side), inside a Treasure Chest which appears after defeating 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers） in a side room. 狂野锤子（Wild Hammer） is required to play the Treasure Road stage Whack Attack! Wild Hammer Trial.

wikirby-page:56578.display_name: 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:56578.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56578.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56578.description_zh:
“招聘兼职人员！来为瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）镇最棒——也是唯一——的咖啡馆工作吧！”
— 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee），在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的拥有者和运营者，在Waddle Dee Town经营着Waddle Dee Café，并出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其Nintendo Switch 2版本中。他们戴着与咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）相同的白绿色纸帽，只能通过他们的位置（建筑物旁）以及皮肤稍微更红来区分。与咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）交谈是启动Waddle Dee Café: Help Wanted! Sub-Game的必要条件。

如果卡比（Kirby）通过了瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）咖啡馆：招聘！的“疯狂任务”难度等级，咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）将赠送给他一个纪念雕像，描绘Café-如意棒（Staff）卡比（Kirby）作为谢谢.
wikirby-page:56578.description_en:
“Help wanted for a part-time gig! Come work for the best—and only—café in 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Town!”
— 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）, in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee） is the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who owns and operates the Waddle Dee Café in Waddle Dee Town, appearing in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. They wear an identical white and green paper cap to 咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）, and are distinguished only by their location (outside the building to the side), and the fact that their skin is slightly redder. Talking to 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee） is necessary to initiate the Waddle Dee Café: Help Wanted! Sub-Game.

If 卡比（Kirby） clears the "Frenzy Gig" difficulty level of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Café: Help Wanted!, 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee） will give him a commemorative figure depicting Café-如意棒（Staff） 卡比（Kirby） as thanks.

wikirby-page:57812.display_name: 咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57812.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57812.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57812.description_zh:
“这个短期厨师喜欢在镇上的咖啡馆为他的同伴Waddle Dees做饭。他甚至在他们在新世界崩溃后也继续喂养他们！他的食物闻起来非常好……这也是野兽帮找到他们的原因。现在咖啡馆已经重建，是时候开始工作了！”
— Figure出自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）的描述，是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版本中的一个角色。他可以在Waddle Dee Town的Waddle Dee Café中找到，一旦玩家救援了60个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）就可以建造。咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）看起来像一个普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），拥有深橙色的皮肤、光亮的棕色眼睛和大黄色的脚。他戴着一顶与咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）相同的白绿相间纸帽，但可以通过他的的位置在咖啡馆前面，以及他橙色的皮肤。咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）出售四种食物，食用后可以补充卡比（Kirby）的健康值。卡比（Kirby）可以选择在咖啡馆食用这些食物，或者将它们存储为Stock Item以备后用。

要获得咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）的模型，玩家必须在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）咖啡馆花费300个Star Coin。
wikirby-page:57812.description_en:
“This short-order cook loves to feed his fellow Waddle Dees at the café in town. He even kept them fed after they crashed in the new world! His cooking smelled so good...which is how the Beast Pack found them. Now that the café has been rebuilt, it's time to get to work!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. He can be found at the Waddle Dee Café in Waddle Dee Town, which can be built once the player rescues 60 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s. 咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee） resembles a normal 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with deep orange skin, glossy brown eyes and large yellow feet. He wears a white and green paper cap identical to that of 咖啡店长瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Manager Waddle Dee）, but he can be distinguished from his manager by his location at the front of the café as well as by his orange skin. 咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee） sells four food items that replenish 卡比（Kirby）'s health when consumed. 卡比（Kirby） can either eat the food items at the café or store them as Stock Items for later use.

To obtain the figure of 咖啡店员瓦豆鲁迪（Café-Staff Waddle Dee）, the player must spend 300 Star Coins at 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Café.

wikirby-page:53879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53879.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53879.description_zh:
“卡洛凌（Clawroline）在旺达里亚马戏团试图提前结束你的冒险。她通常充当野兽帮老大的联络人，但她无法抗拒亲自追踪卡比（Kirby）的机会。她的优雅和速度相当令人印象深刻，因此帮派的其他成员都把她视为偶像。她有很多粉丝！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
卡洛凌（Clawroline），标题为《致命美洲豹》，简称Carol，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的一个角色，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，作为Beast Pack的理事会成员。她是一个灵活的拟人化美洲豹实体，有着浓密的睫毛和眼影，以及可被大幅延长的涂指甲油的爪子。她非常有名，而根据“Leon & Carol”的角色描述，她只能通过喵喵叫说话。她首次作为Boss被对战，但一旦主线故事完成，她就会成为卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们的盟友。
wikirby-page:53879.description_en:
“卡洛凌（Clawroline） tried to cut your adventure short at the Wondaria circus. She normally acts as a point of contact for the Beast Pack's boss, but she couldn't resist the chance to track 卡比（Kirby） down herself. Her grace and speed are quite impressive, so the rest of the pack think of her as an idol. She has lots of fans!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
卡洛凌（Clawroline）, titled Lethal Leopard and known as Carol for short, is a character in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, appearing in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） as a member of the Beast Pack's council. She is an agile anthropomorphic leopard entity with extended eyelashes and eyeshadow, along with nail polished claws, which are able to be greatly extended. She is famed by many, and according to the "Leon & Carol" figure description, she can only speak through meows. She is first fought as a boss, but once the main story is completed, she becomes an ally to 卡比（Kirby） and his friends.

wikirby-page:56527.display_name: 实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:56527.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56527.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56527.description_zh:
“斗兽场总是为与残暴野兽的战斗做好准备，但当竞技场内出现神秘漩涡时，没有人做好准备！实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee）被吓得几乎想要关闭一切，但最终还是好奇心战胜了恐惧。里面会有怎样的狂野战斗等待着呢？比赛时间到了！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee）的描述是瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他管理星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的Colosseum。他外观与其他瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）相似，但以厚边蓝色眼镜、黄色领结和相配的麦克风（非常像大声公（Walky））为特色。他首次出现是在卡比（Kirby）完成Wondaria Remains并建好地点后，主动提出让他参加魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）杯比赛，以及后来在终极杯、终极杯Z中，并且仅在Nintendo Switch 2版中出现的终极杯Z EX.

在比赛期间，以及在候场室里，实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee）会对卡比（Kirby）的表现发表评论，除了在终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中，由于两个杯赛都发生在另一个领域，他的声音只能在卡比（Kirby）处于候场室并在比赛间隙时传达到他那里。他还会在卡比（Kirby）失败时鼓励他再试一次，并在他成功时报告他的记录.
wikirby-page:56527.description_en:
“The Colosseum is always ready for battles with brutal beasts, but no one was prepared when a mysterious vortex opened inside the arena! 实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee） was so scared that he almost shut everything down, but his curiosity won in the end. What wild battles await within? It's tournament time!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who runs the Colosseum in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. He has the same general look as any other 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）, but is distinguished by his thick-rimmed blue glasses, yellow bow tie, and matching microphone (which strongly resembles 大声公（Walky）). He first appears once 卡比（Kirby） finishes Wondaria Remains and the location is built, offering to let him fight in 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） Cup, and later in The Ultimate Cup, The Ultimate Cup Z and, exclusively in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, The Ultimate Cup Z EX.

During the fights, as well as in the Waiting Room, 实况瓦豆鲁迪（Commentator Waddle Dee） comments on 卡比（Kirby）'s performance, except in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX where, due to both cups taking place in another realm, his voice can only reach 卡比（Kirby） in-between fights while he is in the Waiting Room. He also encourages 卡比（Kirby） to try again when he fails, and reports his record when he succeeds.

wikirby-page:57813.display_name: 快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57813.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57813.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57813.description_zh:
“这位尽职的送货员Dee在城里的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）-配送公司工作。他以惊人的速度把有用的物品送到你家门口！卡比（Kirby）的手写字有时让人很难看清礼物代码，但这位善良的灵魂无论如何都会批准订单。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee）的描述是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版的一名角色。他是Waddle Dee-liveries的老板，这个建筑可以在玩家救出50个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）后在Waddle Dee Town建造。他看起来像普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），有着棕褐色的脸、橙红色的皮肤、光亮的棕色眼睛和大大的黄色脚。他戴着一顶边缘为黑色的蓝色邮递员帽。帽子正面展示的是一颗蓝色流星在黄色背景上的徽章。快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee）是卡比（Kirby）的盟友，可以帮助他兑换Present Code以获得送货礼物。送货礼物会由他送到Kirby's House，里面可能包含Star Coin、Rare Stone、Starry Coin或Food物品。

要获得快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee）的形象，玩家必须在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）服装处输入三个离线礼物代码。
wikirby-page:57813.description_en:
“This dutiful delivery Dee works for 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）-liveries in town. He gets helpful items to your doorstep with blinding speed! 卡比（Kirby）'s handwriting makes it hard to read the Present Codes sometimes, but this kind soul approves the orders anyway.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. He is the owner of Waddle Dee-liveries, which can be built in Waddle Dee Town after the player rescues 50 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s. He resembles a normal 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with a tan face, orange-red skin, glossy brown eyes and large yellow feet. He wears a blue postman's hat with a black brim. Displayed on the front of his cap is an insignia of a blue shooting star on a yellow background. 快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee） is an ally to 卡比（Kirby） and can help him redeem Present Codes for Delivery Presents. The Delivery Presents, which he drops off at Kirby's House, can contain Star Coins, Rare Stones, Starry Coins, or Food Items.

To obtain the figure of 快递员瓦豆鲁迪（Delivery Waddle Dee）, the player must enter three offline Present Codes at 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）-liveries.

wikirby-page:53337.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53337.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53337.description_zh:
“A你在一个神秘的新世界中遇到的神秘新朋友。你在他试图拯救Waddle Dees免受野兽群攻击时找到了艾菲灵（Elfilin）。他似乎很高兴成为卡比（Kirby）的向导，分享帮助Waddle Dees并重建他们小镇的有用建议。谢谢你，艾菲灵（Elfilin）！”
— 艾菲灵（Elfilin）的人物描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
艾菲灵（Elfilin），他是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中出现的配角，作为卡比（Kirby）的主要伙伴。他是一种小型会飞、类似龙猫的生物，能够说话。艾菲灵（Elfilin）起初似乎在很大程度上无助，并且不热衷于战斗，但后来显示出强大的能力，包括通过Another Dimension打开虫洞以连接遥远世界的能力。除此之外，他的主要角色是向卡比（Kirby）（并间接向玩家）提供有关新世界和Waddle Dee Town中各种事情的建议和信息。

在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版本中，艾菲灵（Elfilin）在Point of Arrival关卡从Beast Pack笼子中被救出后加入卡比（Kirby），希望帮助这只粉色圆球拯救所有瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），这些瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）在被捕之前曾被艾菲灵（Elfilin）所熟悉。在此过程中，卡比（Kirby）和艾菲灵（Elfilin）成为了好朋友，但后来在帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）绑架他并将他带到火山顶上的废弃实验室时被迫分开。后来揭示，艾菲灵（Elfilin）（他自己并不知情）是由新世界文明知晓的一种原始生命体衍生而来将“侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）”关在那个实验室里，而谁希望与他团聚以重塑终极生命体：完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）。当这最终发生时，卡比（Kirby）必须与这个生命体战斗，并再次分离出艾菲灵（Elfilin），然后在艾菲灵（Elfilin）的帮助下摧毁剩余的生命体。
wikirby-page:53337.description_en:
“A mystical new friend you met in a mysterious new world. You found 艾菲灵（Elfilin） as he was trying to save the Waddle Dees from the Beast Pack. He seems happy to be 卡比（Kirby）'s guide, sharing helpful advice to save the Waddle Dees and rebuild their town. Thanks, 艾菲灵（Elfilin）!”
— 艾菲灵（Elfilin）'s figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
艾菲灵（Elfilin） is a supporting character who appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, serving as 卡比（Kirby）'s primary companion. He is a small flying chinchilla-like creature capable of speech. 艾菲灵（Elfilin） appears to be largely helpless at first, and is not keen on fighting, but he is later shown to have potent abilities, including the power to open wormholes through Another Dimension to connect distant worlds. Aside from that, his main role is to give 卡比（Kirby） (and the player by extension) advice and information on various things in the new world and in Waddle Dee Town.

In 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, 艾菲灵（Elfilin） joins 卡比（Kirby） after being rescued from a Beast Pack cage in the stage Point of Arrival, hoping to help the pink puffball save all the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s, who 艾菲灵（Elfilin） had gotten to know before they were captured. Along the way, 卡比（Kirby） and 艾菲灵（Elfilin） become fast friends, and are later separated when 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） kidnaps him and takes him to an abandoned laboratory atop a volcano. Later on, it is revealed that 艾菲灵（Elfilin） was (unbeknownst to him) derived from a primordial life-form known to the new world civilization as "侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）", who is kept in that laboratory and who seeks to be reunited with him to reform the ultimate life-form: 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）. When this eventually happens, 卡比（Kirby） has to fight this life-form and split 艾菲灵（Elfilin） back out again, and then destroy the remaining life-form with 艾菲灵（Elfilin）'s help.

wikirby-page:54861.name_zh: 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘
wikirby-page:54861.display_name: 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）
wikirby-page:54861.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54861.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54861.description_zh:
“当ID-F86到达时，它开始攻击所有当地的野生动物。该生物很快被捕获，并被用作实验对象。当地产居民利用它创造出了超乎想象的技术。他们最终使用这些技术彻底离开了这个星球，但ID-F86依然留在原地，被遗忘并支离破碎。”
— Figure对侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）（幼虫）的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo），也被称为标本ID-F86和大者，是一种支离破碎的外星生命体，拥有巨大的心灵能力和恶意的野心，它在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中首次出现，并且是本游戏及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的主要反派。在游戏事件发生之前，该生物以完整形态完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）入侵了新世界。试图将星球上的所有生命纳入自身，但被居住在那里的文明阻止并控制，随后在他们的Lab Discovera中进行了实验。在那里，新世界的文明能够从该生物的能力中学习如何开发“行星扭曲”技术，使他们能够升入一个“梦之国”，永远离开他们的世界。然而，在他们离开之前，一次“扭曲实验事故”导致完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）分裂为两个个体：其中一个是仍处于休眠状态的残余侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo），另一个是艾菲灵（Elfilin），他设法逃脱，但对自己之前的联系或力量没有记忆。
wikirby-page:54861.description_en:
“When ID-F86 arrived, it began attacking all of the native wildlife. The creature was captured soon after and turned into a test subject. The native inhabitants used it to create tech beyond their wildest dreams. They eventually used that tech to leave the planet altogether, but ID-F86 remained, forgotten and fractured.”
— Figure description for 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） (Larva) from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）, also known as specimen ID-F86 and the Great One, is a fractured alien life-form with immense psychic power and malevolent ambitions, which was introduced in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and is the overarching antagonist of the game and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. Prior to the events of the game, the creature had invaded the new world in its whole state as 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）, and attempted to subsume all the life on the planet into itself, but it was stopped and contained by the civilization that lived there, and later subjected to experimentation in their Lab Discovera. There, the new world civilization was able to learn from the creature's abilities how to develop "planetary warp" technology, allowing them to ascend into a "land of dreams" and leave their world behind forever. Before they left, however, a "warp-experiment incident" caused 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） to split into two beings: one of which was the remnant 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） who remained in stasis, and the other of which was 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, who managed to escape, but with no memory of his previous connections or power.

wikirby-page:57817.display_name: 滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57817.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57817.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57817.description_zh:
“快来快来！这个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）操作着镇上最受欢迎的游戏——倾斜与滚动卡比（Kirby）。其他的Waddle Dees喜欢玩他的游戏。事实上，他们不停地向他请求更多！这可能解释了为什么他增加了令人望而生畏的额外困难难度。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee）的描述是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）以及其Nintendo Switch 2版本中的一个角色。他看起来像一个普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），有棕褐色的脸、橙红色的皮肤、光亮的棕色眼睛和大大的黄色脚。他戴着一顶棕黄色的草帽，帽檐上有蓝色和粉红色的条纹。滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee）管理着Waddle Dee Town的游戏厅，该游戏厅在玩家拯救了180个Waddle Dees后解锁。他是卡比（Kirby）的盟友，并会让他在Sub-Game中玩Tilt-and-Roll Kirby以交换Star Coins。

为了获得滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee）的数字，玩家必须在标准难度下完成Tilt-and-Roll卡比（Kirby）中的所有三个关卡。
wikirby-page:57817.description_en:
“Step right up, step right up! This 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） runs the town's favorite game, Tilt-and-Roll 卡比（Kirby）. The other Waddle Dees love to play his game. In fact, they wouldn’t stop asking him for more! That might explain why he added the daunting Extra Hard difficulty.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. He resembles a normal 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with a tan face, orange-red skin, glossy brown eyes and large yellow feet. He wears a brownish-yellow straw boater hat with a blue and pink stripe above the brim. 滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee） runs the Game Parlor in Waddle Dee Town, which is unlocked after the player rescues 180 Waddle Dees. He is an ally to 卡比（Kirby） and will let him play the Sub-Game Tilt-and-Roll Kirby in exchange for Star Coins.

To obtain the figure of 滚球店瓦豆鲁迪（Game-Shop Waddle Dee）, the player must complete all three boards in Tilt-and-Roll 卡比（Kirby） on standard difficulty.

wikirby-page:57814.display_name: 道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57814.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57814.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57814.description_zh:
“这个有进取心的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）在镇上开了自己的商品商店。他出售能帮助你的特殊物品。他还为咖啡馆提供自己手工制作的能量饮料。他们有一个特别的商业安排：两瓶能量饮料换三个卡比（Kirby）汉堡！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee）的描述是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版中的一个角色。他看起来像一只普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），棕褐色亮眼，短小的梨形身体。他的皮肤比大多数其他Waddle Dees更明亮呈橙色，脚呈较浅的黄色。他戴着一顶紫色棒球帽，帽前部是白色的。帽子上有一个四瓣紫色花的标志a黄色中心。卡比（Kirby）可以用Star Coin购买他三种不同的物品——生命提升、攻击提升和速度提升。这些物品分别增加卡比（Kirby）的健康值、伤害输出和移动速度。道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee）可以在Waddle Dee Town的Waddle Dee's Item Shop找到，当玩家成功拯救145个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）后解锁。

要获得道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee）的模型，玩家必须在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的物品商店花费1,050颗星币购买物品。
wikirby-page:57814.description_en:
“This enterprising 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） opened his own item shop in town. He sells special items that will help you out. He also supplies the café with an Energy Drink that he makes by hand. They have a special business arrangement: two Energy Drinks for three 卡比（Kirby） Burgers!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. He resembles a normal 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with a tan face, glossy brown eyes and a short pear-shaped body. His skin is a brighter shade of orange than that of most other Waddle Dees, and his feet are a lighter shade of yellow. He wears a purple baseball cap, the front of which is white. On his cap is an insignia of a purple flower with four petals and a yellow center. 卡比（Kirby） can purchase three different items from him - a Life Up, an Attack Boost and a Speed Boost - with Star Coins. These items increase 卡比（Kirby）'s health, damage output and movement speed, respectively. 道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee） can be found at Waddle Dee's Item Shop in Waddle Dee Town, which is unlocked after the player manages to rescue 145 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s.

To obtain the figure of 道具店瓦豆鲁迪（Item-Shop Waddle Dee）, the player must spend 1,050 Star Coins on items from 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s Item Shop.

wikirby-page:54855.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54855.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54855.description_zh:
“这里坐着凶猛兽群的强大指挥官。他已经成为来自星际之外入侵样本的棋子，负责收集食物，捕获Waddle Dees以用作能源，并且——最重要的是——寻找丢失的标记为ID-F87的样本……”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狮王加尔夫（Leongar）的描述，标题为《兽王》（也称为莱昂），是一只大型拟人化狮子，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，作为Beast Pack的领导者。他有橙色的毛发和红色的鬃毛，拥有巨大的手臂，手上有长爪，使他的比例类似于猩猛霸（Gorimondo）或帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中的雄壮形态。与兽群的其他成员不同，狮王加尔夫（Leongar）能够说话用言语和句子与卡比（Kirby）和艾菲灵（Elfilin）交流，这种能力是在他受到侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）影响时获得的。这种影响也会导致狮王加尔夫（Leongar）落入该生物的控制之下，指挥野兽之群捕捉瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）和艾菲灵（Elfilin），以实现ID-F86的目的。狮王加尔夫（Leongar）后来会被侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）直接吞噬他的身心，使他被困在其梦境中并将他的灵魂分散成碎片。卡比（Kirby）和艾菲灵（Elfilin）进入侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）的梦境之岛，以打破它对莱昂的影响并恢复他的灵魂。
wikirby-page:54855.description_en:
“Here sits the powerful commander of the ferocious Beast Pack. He's become a pawn for an invading specimen from beyond the stars, tasked with gathering food, capturing the Waddle Dees to use as a power source, and—most importantly—retrieving the lost specimen tagged as ID-F87...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狮王加尔夫（Leongar）, titled King of the Beasts (also known as Leon), is a large anthropomorphic lion who appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） as the leader of the Beast Pack. He has orange fur with a red mane, and has giant arms with long claws on his hands, making his proportions similar to 猩猛霸（Gorimondo） or 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s macho form from 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）. Unlike the other members of the Beast Pack, 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） can speak in words and sentences to 卡比（Kirby） and 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, having gained this ability when he was influenced by 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）. This influence would also cause 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） to fall under the creature's control, directing the Beast Pack to capture 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s and 艾菲灵（Elfilin） in order to meet ID-F86's purposes. 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） would later have his body and soul subsumed into 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） directly, keeping him captive within its dreams and scattering his soul into pieces. 卡比（Kirby） and 艾菲灵（Elfilin） venture into 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）'s dreamy isles to break its influence over Leon and recover his soul.

wikirby-page:56068.display_name: 家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:56068.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56068.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56068.description_zh:
“当我们的勇敢国王在我绊倒后把我扔进电梯……并确保保护我……我简直惊叹不已！他平时通常很随性，也许有一点点懒……但在最关键的时候，我们的领袖总是履行他的王者职责。帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）万岁！”
— 家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee），在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）中，有一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版中担任帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的忠实仆人。他们最初作为被俘的Waddle Dees之一出现在关卡In the Presence of the King的结尾，在国王被卡比（Kirby）击败并从侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）手中重新掌控后与国王团聚。然而，他们的重聚很短暂，因为Beast Pack的成员伏击了这五人（如果头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）在场则为六人），迫使他们逃脱通过电梯。家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）在逃跑时绊倒了，而帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）决定回去帮助他们，把他们扔进电梯并击退敌人，同时其他人逃脱。

家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）在清理Lab Discovera后再次出现在Waddle Dee Town，侍奉国王，让他放松。第一次交谈时，他们感谢卡比（Kirby）拯救了德德，并将蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer）的蓝图作为国王送给他的礼物。
wikirby-page:56068.description_en:
“The way our daring king threw me into that elevator after I tripped...and made sure to protect me... I was just in awe! He's usually so carefree, perhaps a teeny-tiny bit lazy... But when it matters most, our leader always does his royal duty. Long live 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）!”
— 家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee）, in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who acts as 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）'s loyal servant in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. They first appear as one of the captured Waddle Dees at the end of the stage In the Presence of the King, reuniting with their king after he is defeated by 卡比（Kirby） and regains control from 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）. Their reunion is short, however, as Beast Pack members ambush the five (six if 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） is present), forcing them to escape through an elevator. 家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee） ends up tripping while running away, and 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） decides to turn back and help them, throwing them into the elevator and fighting off the enemies while the rest escape.

家臣瓦豆鲁迪（Minion Waddle Dee） is later seen again in Waddle Dee Town after clearing Lab Discovera, serving the king while he relaxes. When first talked to, they thank 卡比（Kirby） for saving Dedede and gives the 蒙面锤子（Masked Hammer） blueprint as a gift from the king to him.

wikirby-page:60371.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:60371.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:60371.description_zh:
“她的歌声不仅在这个世界上响起，还跨越银河，乘着从飞船机库发出的无线电波传播开来，即使周围已经没人可以聆听。她的歌在飞船出发的那天首次亮相，没错，这位占卜歌手就在那些选择留在星球上的人中。”
— 《闪烁的星雨》歌曲标识（状况良好）》Figure在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
NEICHEL（新世界文字）中的描述，是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版中提到的角色。她是新世界的著名女歌手，也是《欢迎来到新世界！》和《TWINKLING STAR SHOWERS》的演唱者，同时也是一首未完成歌曲的作者。然而，在游戏主线故事发生时，她已经不在了。在游戏中无法遇到，尽管她的帽子和名字的描绘可以在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的一个标志中找到。

中，NEICHEL由Sammy扮演，Sammy是真正演唱《Welcome to the New World!》和《TWINKLING STAR SHOWERS》的真人。她的真实身份在游戏中未提及（她仅被列为“NEICHEL”），但在Kirby and the Forgotten Land Sound Selection和Kirby and the Forgotten Land: The Complete Soundtrack的说明书中被揭示。
wikirby-page:60371.description_en:
“Her song rang out not only on this world but across the galaxy, riding the radio waves emitting from the spaceship's hangar long after there was no one around to hear it. It debuted on the ship's departure day, and, yes, the soothsaying songstress was among those who chose to remain on the planet.”
— TWINKLING STAR SHOWERS Song Sign (Good Condition)" Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
NEICHEL (in new world script, ) is a mentioned character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. She was a famous diva from the new world and the singer of "Welcome to the New World!" and "TWINKLING STAR SHOWERS", also being the writer of a song she never finished. However, at the time of the game's main story, she is no longer around and she can't be met in the game, though a depiction of her hat and name can be found in a sign in 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）.

NEICHEL is portrayed by Sammy, the real person who actually sang "Welcome to the New World!" and "TWINKLING STAR SHOWERS". Her real identity is not mentioned in-game (she is simply credited as "NEICHEL"), but was revealed in the booklets for Kirby and the Forgotten Land Sound Selection and Kirby and the Forgotten Land: The Complete Soundtrack.

wikirby-page:54668.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54668.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54668.description_zh:
“这是当地的四人迪乐队，豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）！他们喜欢在观众面前即兴演奏，每次开始表演都会喊“Wa-WA！”（走吧！）乐队在咖啡馆的聚会可能因为音乐口味不同而变得激烈，但当曲子响起时，他们完全同步。”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees），这是一支由四个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）组成的乐队（一个弹电吉他，一个弹贝斯，一个打鼓，一个弹键盘），出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其任天堂Switch 2版中。乐队居住在Waddle Dee Town，在卡比（Kirby）清理Lab Discovera后，站在一个看起来位于Waddle Dee Cinema旁边的舞台上，称为“Waddle Live! Corner Stage”。在功能上，他们取代了来自以前的游戏，当与它们互动时，玩家可以为它们选择一首歌来演奏。

并非所有的歌曲一开始都可用；在满足适当条件后，卡比（Kirby）可以将Star Coin放入豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）的开放吉他箱中，以升级舞台并解锁更多音乐。解锁第一次升级需要1,000个星币，第二次升级需要2,000个星币。当达到阈值时，舞台的外观会升级。它最初是简单的木板，然后变为打磨过的木质平台，最后成为带有钢铁框架和舞台灯光的金属平台。将舞台升级到最终形态还会解锁豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）的人物。

Waddle Dees与音乐同步演奏，且仅当各自的乐器为演奏。当他们不表演时，他们会通过拨动和调节琴弦、按下弱音键或敲击钹来玩弄乐器。卡比（Kirby）、艾菲灵（Elfilin）、头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）以及其他附近的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）也会随着节拍移动，看着他们演奏，如果演奏者退出此界面，豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）正在演奏的歌曲将继续，并替换正常的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）城镇音乐，直到卡比（Kirby）离开、进入建筑物，或通过输入成功的礼物码等方式重新加载城镇（或者对于不循环的歌曲，直到歌曲结束）。
wikirby-page:54668.description_en:
“It's the local four-Dee band, 豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）! They love to jam in front of a crowd and start each request off with a "Wa-WA!" (Let's GO!) Band meetings at the café can get heated due to their different musical tastes, but when the tunes kick in, they fall perfectly in sync.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees） are a band consisting of four 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s (one playing the electric guitar, one playing the bass, one playing the drums, and one playing the keyboard) that appear in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. The band resides in Waddle Dee Town after 卡比（Kirby） clears Lab Discovera, standing on a stage that appears next to Waddle Dee Cinema called the "Waddle Live! Corner Stage". Functionally, they replace the Jukebox from previous games, as upon interacting with them, the player can select a song for them to play.

Not all of the songs are available at first; after meeting the right conditions, 卡比（Kirby） can donate Star Coins into 豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）' open guitar case to upgrade their stage and unlock more music. It takes 1,000 Star Coins to unlock the first upgrade, and 2,000 for the second. When the threshold is met, the stage upgrades in appearance. It starts as simple wooden planks, then becomes a polished wood platform, and finally a metal platform with a steel frame and stage lights. Upgrading the stage to its final form also unlocks 豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees）' figure.

The Waddle Dees play in time with the music, and only when their respective instruments are playing. When they are not performing, they will play around with their instruments by plucking and tuning strings, pressing muted keys or striking the cymbals. 卡比（Kirby）, 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, and other nearby 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s will also move to the beat as they watch them play, and if the player exits this screen, the song that 豆鲁迪士（The Deedly Dees） were playing continues and replaces the regular 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Town music until 卡比（Kirby） leaves, enters a building, or reloads the town via methods like entering a successful Present Code (or until the song ends, in the case of songs that do not loop).

wikirby-page:56618.display_name: 兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:56618.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56618.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56618.description_zh:
“I如果你ever感觉想收集更多的手办，我随时准备交换！”
— 兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee），在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他出现在Gotcha Machine Alley中Waddle Dee Town，在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其Nintendo Switch 2版中。他是最后一个出现在镇上的独特瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），在卡比（Kirby）完成Colosseum的终极杯Z之后出现，他的区分标志仅是他手里拿着的蓝色扭蛋机胶囊。他的目的是帮助卡比（Kirby）收集后者仍然缺失的任何手办，他会以Rare Stone交换，给卡比（Kirby）一个随机获得且他尚未拥有的手办。

I如果卡比（Kirby）已经拥有每一个随机获得的手办，兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）会认可这个，但仍会向卡比（Kirby）提供交易机会，给他那些他还没有获得最大数量的角色。当卡比（Kirby）为某个角色收集到最大数量的重复角色时，该角色在角色收藏中会标有皇冠。
wikirby-page:56618.description_en:
“If you ever feel like collecting more figures, I'm always ready to trade!”
— 兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）, in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who appears in Gotcha Machine Alley in Waddle Dee Town, in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. He is the last unique 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） to appear in town, appearing after 卡比（Kirby） completes The Ultimate Cup Z in the Colosseum, and he is distinguished only by the blue Gotcha Machine capsule he holds. His purpose is to help 卡比（Kirby） collect any remaining figures that the latter is missing, and he will give 卡比（Kirby） a randomly-obtained figure he does not already have in exchange for a Rare Stone.

If 卡比（Kirby） already has every randomly-obtained figure, 兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee） will acknowledge this, but will still offer to trade with 卡比（Kirby） regardless, giving him figures that he hasn't obtained the maximum number possible of. Figures are marked with a crown in the figure collection when 卡比（Kirby） has collected the maximum number of duplicates for that figure.

wikirby-page:57809.display_name: 电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57809.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57809.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57809.description_zh:
“在小镇被毁后，这个热爱电影的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）决定电影院需要立刻重建。当然，食物和住所很重要，但电影也同样重要！至于他最喜欢的电影，那可能得是……全部！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee）的描述是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的一个角色以及其Nintendo Switch 2版。他在Waddle Dee Town中操作Waddle Dee Cinema，该设备可以在完成Downtown Grassland阶段后使用。电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee）看起来像一个普通的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），有棕褐色光亮的眼睛、棕褐色脸和短而梨形的身体。他的皮肤比其他大多数Waddle Dees稍暗，脚是橙黄色的。他戴着一个红色蝴蝶结和一个无顶红帽，帽子上有黄色stripe。他可以在电影院的前台找到，当被提示时，他会为卡比（Kirby）排队播放一部短片，并指导卡比（Kirby）在影院就座。

要获得电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee）模型，玩家必须在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）电影院解锁前34部电影，这包括通关Lab Discovera、隔离的梦境之岛以及Colosseum的前三个杯赛。
wikirby-page:57809.description_en:
“After the town was destroyed, this movie-loving 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） decided that the cinema needed to be rebuilt right away. Sure, food and shelter are important, but so are movies! As for his favorite movie, it probably has to be...all of them!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 edition. He operates Waddle Dee Cinema in Waddle Dee Town, which can be accessed upon completion of the stage Downtown Grassland. 电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee） resembles a normal 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with a tan face, glossy brown eyes and a short pear-shaped body. His skin is slightly darker than that of most other Waddle Dees and his feet are an orange-yellow color. He wears a red bow tie and a peakless red hat with a yellow stripe. He can be found at the front desk of the cinema and when prompted, he will queue up a short movie for 卡比（Kirby） to watch and instruct 卡比（Kirby） to take a seat in the theater.

To obtain the 电影院瓦豆鲁迪（Usher Waddle Dee） figure, the player must unlock the first 34 movies at 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Cinema, which involves clearing Lab Discovera, the isolated isles of Forgo Dreams and the first three cups in the Colosseum.

wikirby-page:57808.display_name: 武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:57808.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:57808.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:57808.description_zh:
“这位充满活力的工匠在镇上开了自己的武器商店。他可以提升你的Copy能力！他只需要一份蓝图、一把信赖的锤子，以及一点努力。他不断为每个进化能力制作越来越大的头盔。这就是你知道它们更强大的原因！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）的描述，是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其Nintendo Switch 2版中的一个角色。他是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），拥有棕褐色面孔、橘红色皮肤、光亮的棕色眼睛和巨大的黄色脚。他戴着棕色皮革帽子、带紫色镜片的黑色护目镜，并穿着沾满煤灰的工具围裙。他的脸和手也总是覆盖着看似煤灰和灰尘的东西。

武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）是卡比（Kirby）可以在提供必要的蓝图、Rare Stone和Star Coin时进化并强化卡比（Kirby）的复制能力（Copy Ability）。他也是Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop的所有者，该建筑在完成Natural Plains后位于Waddle Dee Town。除了为卡比（Kirby）提供Evolved Copy Abilities外，武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）还可以在卡比（Kirby）需要时将已进化的能力恢复到普通形态。此外，卡比（Kirby）可以向武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）查询他装备的任何能力的信息，其中包括各种动作的名称及其按钮输入信息。

武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee）也有属于他自己的模型，这是独一无二的。要获得该模型，卡比（Kirby）必须在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）的武器店将每个复制能力（Copy Ability）进化。强化并非必需。
wikirby-page:57808.description_en:
“This energetic craftsman opened his own weapons shop in town. He can power up your Copy Abilities! All he needs is a blueprint, his trusty hammer, and a little elbow grease. He keeps making the headgear for each evolved ability bigger than the one before. That's how you know they're more powerful!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. He is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） with a tan face, orange-red skin, glossy brown eyes and large yellow feet. He wears a brown leather cap, black goggles with purple lenses and a utility apron covered in soot. His face and hands are also perpetually covered in what appears to be soot and dust.

武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） is an ally to 卡比（Kirby） who can evolve and power-up 卡比（Kirby）'s 复制能力（Copy Ability） when provided the necessary blueprints, Rare Stones and Star Coins. He is also the owner of Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop, which is built in Waddle Dee Town after Natural Plains is completed. Along with providing 卡比（Kirby） with Evolved Copy Abilities, 武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） can also revert evolved abilities back to their regular form if 卡比（Kirby） so desires. In addition, 卡比（Kirby） can consult 武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） for information about whichever ability he has equipped, which includes info on the names of various moves and button inputs for them.

武器店瓦豆鲁迪（Weapons-Shop Waddle Dee） also has his own figure, which is one-of-a-kind. To obtain this figure, 卡比（Kirby） must evolve every 复制能力（Copy Ability） at 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）'s Weapons Shop. Power-ups are not required.

wikirby-page:53336.display_name: 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:53336.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53336.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53336.description_zh:
“当你需要智慧时，访问知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）！他总是手边有小窍门，似乎对这个新世界了解很多。他的魔法百科全书可以收集并分享来自世界各地的排行榜！（他到底从哪里找到那本书的？！）”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）的描述是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），戴着眼镜和黑色学者帽，坐在Waddle Dee Town的长椅上，在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，首次出现是在卡比（Kirby）清除了Everbay Coast关卡之后。他为卡比（Kirby）提供信息来源，当靠近他时，他会告诉他各种事情，包括卡比（Kirby）错过的蓝图可以在哪里找到，玩家的个人记录，以及一般提示。如果控制台是已连接到互联网，并且玩家拥有有效的任天堂Switch Online会员订阅，他还可以提供全球记录，例如其他玩家正在使用哪些复制能力（Copy Ability），每个玩家的统计总和（例如开花的Pop Flower数量、拯救的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）数量等），以及Colosseum杯、boss击败时间、Flash Fishing和Waddle Dee Café: Help Wanted!的世界纪录。他可以被看到脚下放着一本打开的书，他解释那是他信息的来源。如果卡比（Kirby）与知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）总共交谈五次，后者将作为奖励赠送自己的一尊模型给卡比（Kirby）。

在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）–任天堂Switch 2版+星缘世界中，提到天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）是知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）的朋友和研究伙伴。
wikirby-page:53336.description_en:
“When you need wisdom, visit 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）! He always has a tip handy and seems to know a lot about this new world. His magical encyclopedia can collect and share rankings from all over the world! (Where did he even find that book?!)”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who wears glasses and a black scholar's cap and sits on a bench in Waddle Dee Town in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, first appearing there after 卡比（Kirby） has cleared the Everbay Coast level. He serves as a source of information for 卡比（Kirby）, and will tell him about various things when approached, including where blueprints that 卡比（Kirby） missed can be found, the player's personal records, and general tips. If the console is connected to the internet and the player has an active Nintendo Switch Online membership subscription, he can also provide worldwide records, such as which 复制能力（Copy Ability） other players are using, combined totals of every player's stats (such as the number of Pop Flowers bloomed, number of 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s saved, etc.), and world records of Colosseum Cups, boss defeat times, Flash Fishing, and Waddle Dee Café: Help Wanted!. He can be seen with an open book at his feet, which he explains is the source of his information. If 卡比（Kirby） talks to 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee） five total times, the latter will give a figure of himself to 卡比（Kirby） as a reward.

In 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World, it is mentioned that 天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） is a pal and research partner of 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）.

wikirby-page:54190.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54190.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54190.description_zh:
“A是一种在新大陆到处都能找到的常见野兽。它们非常可爱，但有危险的野性。任何与它们作对的人都会被它们吼叫和扑过去！一大群这种小动物袭击了Waddle Dees。很有趣，你本以为它们会相处得很好！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的描述（复数：Awoofies）是一种橙色的类狐狸生物，首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中回归。它是游戏中最基本的敌人，也是Beast Pack中最常见的成员。它的工作是追捕瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），以便被群体的Clocker捕获。加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的整体形状像一只狐狸，有着大头、短小的四肢和长尾巴。它的主要毛色是橙色；它的前爪、头顶、耳尖和尾尖是红色的；它的口鼻部和腹部是棕褐色的；它的后爪是黄色的；耳朵内部是浅粉色的。它有棕色的眼睛，风格类似于卡比（Kirby）的。虽然主要是四足行走，但Awoofies常常在观察周围或者静止时站立。

加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的总体行为是原地坐着、巡逻某个区域，或者睡觉，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近到它能够发现为止。当这种情况发生时，加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）会以适中的速度追赶卡比（Kirby），试图通过撞击伤害他。加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）可以通过任何方法轻易击败，被吞食后不会给出复制能力（Copy Ability）。Awoofies在被击败时价值一个Star Coin。
wikirby-page:54190.description_en:
“A common beast that can be found all over the new world. They're pretty cute, but they have a dangerous wild side. They'll growl and jump at anyone who crosses them! A whole bunch of these critters attacked the Waddle Dees. Funny, you'd think they'd get along!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） (plural: Awoofies) is an orange fox-like creature which makes its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and returning in 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is the most basic enemy in the game, and the most common member of the Beast Pack. Its job is to chase down 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s so they can be captured by the pack's Clockers. 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） takes on the general shape of a fox with a large head, stubby limbs, and a long tail. Its main fur color is orange; its front paws, top of the head, tips of the ears, and tip of the tail are red; its muzzle and underbelly are tan; its hind paws are yellow; the inside of its ears are light pink. It has brown eyes similar in style to 卡比（Kirby）'s. Though primarily quadrupedal, Awoofies can often be seen standing upright when looking around or holding still.

加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）'s general behavior is to sit in place, patrol a given area, or sleep until 卡比（Kirby） gets close enough for it to spot him. When this happens, 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） responds by running after 卡比（Kirby） at a modest speed, aiming to hurt him by collision. 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） can be easily defeated with any method, and gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. Awoofies are worth one Star Coin when defeated.

wikirby-page:54912.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54912.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54912.description_zh:
“气球高手（Balloon-Meister）喜欢做把戏！没人知道它是从哪里学会的。也许这是遗传的？无论如何，这些把戏都很有趣！只要不要让球碰到你。试着吸进去以获得炸弹（Bomb）能力。（嘿，等等！它的球是从哪来的？！）”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
气球高手（Balloon-Meister）的描述是一个类似海狮的大型敌人，它是Beast Pack的一部分，并戴着一个绿色的破裂且脏兮兮的桶在头上，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。气球高手（Balloon-Meister）可以被发现静坐在原地，无论是在陆地上还是在水中。它攻击时会在卡比（Kirby）进入范围时召唤并投掷大型爆炸沙滩球。气球高手（Balloon-Meister）可以承受一定的攻击，但仍然容易受到大多数攻击的形式，击败后会掉落绿色的Star Coin。通过一些努力，卡比（Kirby）可以直接吸入气球高手（Balloon-Meister），或者吸入它投掷的沙滩球来获得炸弹（Bomb）的能力。

仅在Nintendo Switch 2版中，气球高手（Balloon-Meister）的更强大的水晶变体会出现在Star-Crossed World。
wikirby-page:54912.description_en:
“气球高手（Balloon-Meister） loves to do tricks! No one knows where it learned 'em. Perhaps it's hereditary? Whatever it is, the tricks are fun! Just don't let the ball touch you. Try to inhale it instead to get the 炸弹（Bomb） Ability. (Hey, wait! Where did it get that ball?!)”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
气球高手（Balloon-Meister） is a large sea lion-like enemy who is part of the Beast Pack and wears a green cracked and dirty bucket atop its head, which appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 气球高手（Balloon-Meister） can be found sitting in place, either on land or in the water. It attacks by conjuring and throwing large explosive beach balls at 卡比（Kirby） when it's in range. 气球高手（Balloon-Meister） can take a bit of a beating, but is regardless vulnerable to most forms of attack, and yields a green Star Coin on defeat. With some difficulty, 卡比（Kirby） can either inhale the 气球高手（Balloon-Meister） directly or the beach balls it tosses for the 炸弹（Bomb） ability.

Exclusively in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, a stronger Crystal variant of 气球高手（Balloon-Meister） appears in Star-Crossed World.

wikirby-page:54762.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54762.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54762.description_zh:
“这只傲慢的小狗是一名射击高手——嗖嗖——在巡逻新世界时身手敏捷。他的眼睛藏在帽子下，但这似乎并不影响他的瞄准！他还有一只出色的嗅觉，可以追踪远近的猎物。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
伯纳犬（Bernard）的描述是敌人，他属于Beast Pack，并出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。他是一只双足紧凑型牧羊犬状敌人，戴着探险家的帽子，携带类似火锤的手枪。伯纳犬（Bernard）通常在空旷处或隐藏在掩体后出现，一旦卡比（Kirby）进入攻击范围就会突然出现射击。伯纳犬（Bernard）的投射物可以阻挡卡比（Kirby）或头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）的大多数普通攻击，所以他们是最好避免。伯纳犬（Bernard）可以被大多数攻击轻松击败，击败后会掉落Star Coin，但也可以吸入并吞下以获得探巡队（Ranger）复制能力（Copy Ability）。

在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World模式中，会出现更强的伯纳犬（Bernard）水晶变体。
wikirby-page:54762.description_en:
“This uppity pup is an expert marksman—pew, pew—who's quick on his feet as he patrols the new world. His eyes are hidden under his hat, but that doesn't seem to affect his aim! He also has an impressive sniffer that can track prey, near or far.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
伯纳犬（Bernard） is an enemy who is part of the Beast Pack and appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. He is a bipedal compact sheepdog-like enemy who wears an explorer's hat and carries a blunderbuss-like pistol. 伯纳犬（Bernard） is usually seen either out in the open or hiding behind cover, popping out to shoot at 卡比（Kirby） when he gets within range. 伯纳犬（Bernard）'s projectiles can block most normal attacks from 卡比（Kirby） or 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, so they are best avoided. 伯纳犬（Bernard） can be defeated easily with most attacks, yielding a Star Coin on defeat, but can also be inhaled and swallowed for the 探巡队（Ranger） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World mode, a stronger Crystal variant of 伯纳犬（Bernard） appears.

wikirby-page:56160.display_name: 红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding）
wikirby-page:56160.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56160.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56160.description_zh:
“所有龟楼中最具攻击性的老板栖息在雷德加的禁区。当这个易怒的家伙找到一个适合的酷热地点时，它就会驻守在那里。它的攻击非常鲁莽，会从嘴里射出混凝土块去击中远处的敌人。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding）的描述是建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）的一种特殊变种，它出现在Beast Pack中，并且在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为敌人出现。像其他龟楼一样，它是一个巨大的类似乌龟的生物，用整栋建筑作为它的龟壳。建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）无法被吸入，也无法被任何普通攻击伤害。与建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）不同，它不会尝试咬卡比（Kirby），而是吐出燃烧的混凝土块。唯一能够打败它的东西是通过使用三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth）或弹簧塞满嘴（Spring Mouth）来猛击它的壳顶以将其打破，尽管这种生物的体型意味着卡比（Kirby）需要站得很高才能落在壳上。

红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding）仅出现在The Beast Pack's Final Stand和Forgo Zone的末端，而水晶红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding）出现在Crystal Beast Pack Volcano Battle的末端。
wikirby-page:56160.description_en:
“The aggressive boss of all Tortuildings dwells within the Forbidden Zone of Redgar. When this hothead finds a suitably sweltering spot, it stays put. It's reckless with its attacks, shooting chunks of concrete out of its mouth to hit faraway enemies.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding） is a special variant of a 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding） who appears as a member of the Beast Pack and an enemy in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. Like other Tortuildings, it is a giant tortoise-like creature that uses an entire building as its shell. 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding） cannot be inhaled nor harmed by any regular attack. Unlike 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）, it does not try to bite 卡比（Kirby）, instead spitting flaming chunks of concrete. The only thing that can defeat it is by using 三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth） or 弹簧塞满嘴（Spring Mouth） to slam the top of its shell to break it, though the size of this creature means 卡比（Kirby） needs to get up high before he can land on the shell.

红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding） is solely found at the end of the The Beast Pack's Final Stand, and Forgo Zone, and Crystal 红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding） appears at the end of Crystal Beast Pack Volcano Battle.

wikirby-page:54209.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54209.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54209.description_zh:
“看哪！这是残暴而粗鲁的巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）！弱攻击根本无法抵挡这家伙的前冲。好在它们很难被阻止！如果你小心点，可以把它们骗到悬崖边上去。他们在下面会没事的。它们非常坚韧。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）的描述
巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）是一个大型敌人，外形像一只紧凑的棕色野牛，会在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为Beast Pack的成员出现。巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）有一个巨大的脑袋，当它生气时，角会向前弯曲，它的主要攻击策略是在看到卡比（Kirby）时向前冲击。巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）有很高的生命值，冲锋时不会被弱攻击打断，但冲锋时会很难会转向，如果撞到墙壁会被击晕。许多Buffahorns根本不尝试转向，而是选择沿一个方向冲锋。正如它的雕像描述所示，巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）也可以通过迫使它从悬崖跌入无底深渊来被击败。

巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）可以被吸入，但吞下后不会获得任何能力。它是一个大型敌人，所以吐出来会形成一个穿透性的投射物。击败巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）会奖励卡比（Kirby）一个绿色的Star Coin。在任天堂Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World中，一种叫做水晶巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）的巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）变体会与其普通同类一起出现。
wikirby-page:54209.description_en:
“Behold! It's the brutal, brutish 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn）! Weak attacks won't stand a chance against this critter's forward tackle. Good thing they have a hard time stopping! If you're careful, you can trick them into running off cliffs. They'll be OK down there. They're real tough.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） is a large enemy resembling a compact brown bison who appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） as a member of the Beast Pack. 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） has a huge head with horns which curve forward when it is angry, and its main attack strategy is to charge forward at 卡比（Kirby） when it sees him. 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） has high health and cannot be interrupted by weak attacks while it is charging, but when charging, it has a hard time turning, and will be stunned if it runs into a wall. Many Buffahorns do not bother trying to turn at all, instead opting to charge in a single direction. As suggested by its figurine description, 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） can also be bested by forcing it to run off a cliff into a bottomless pit.

巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） can be inhaled with enough effort, but it grants no ability if swallowed. It is a large enemy, so spitting it out will create a penetrating projectile. Defeating 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） rewards 卡比（Kirby） with a green Star Coin.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World, a variant of 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） called Crystal 巴伐尔牛角（Buffahorn） appear alongside its regular counterpart.

wikirby-page:54909.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54909.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54909.description_zh:
“对于狄古（Digguh）来说，在地面上移动就像游泳一样容易。它只需潜入地下，然后……扭动、扭动、跳跃！惊喜！你永远不知道什么时候会遇到狄古（Digguh）……实际上有点不礼貌。它还会向你扔土块，并啃食地上的食物。”
— Figure关于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狄古（Digguh）的描述：那是一种矮胖的双足棕色毛发鼹鼠般生物，是Beast Pack的一部分，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为普通敌人。它通常站着或缓慢地走动，直到看到卡比（Kirby），这时它要么钻入地下并从别处（或直接在卡比（Kirby）下方）弹出，要么捡起一块泥土并投掷作为投射物。狄古（Digguh）可以很容易在地面上被击败时可以获得Star Coin，或者可以吸入和吞咽以获得钻击（Drill）复制能力（Copy Ability）。狄古（Digguh）的更强水晶变体也出现在Star-Crossed World.
wikirby-page:54909.description_en:
“For 狄古（Digguh）, moving through the ground is as easy as swimming. It just dives underground, then...wiggle, wiggle, jump! SURPRISE! You never know when to expect 狄古（Digguh）... Kinda rude, actually. It'll also throw clumps of dirt at you and munch on ground-bound meals.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狄古（Digguh） is a stubby bipedal brown-furred mole-like creature who is part of the Beast Pack and appears as a common enemy in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It typically stands around or walks slowly until it sees 卡比（Kirby）, at which it will either dig into the ground and pop up somewhere else (or directly underneath 卡比（Kirby）), or pick up a clod of dirt and throw it at him as a projectile. 狄古（Digguh） can be easily defeated when it is above ground to earn a Star Coin, or can be inhaled and swallowed for the 钻击（Drill） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. A stronger Crystal variant of 狄古（Digguh） also appears in Star-Crossed World.

wikirby-page:54851.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54851.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54851.description_zh:
“这名强壮的游泳者拥有强大的下颚。它漂浮在水面上，观察并等待它的猎物。它的皮肤坚硬如铠甲，所以你需要比复制能力（Copy Ability）更强大的东西才能击倒它……你认为塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能派上用场吗？”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile），是一只类似巨型黑色鳄鱼的敌人，属于Beast Pack，首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）。它通常在清水（Water）中游动，或静止不动，或按照设定巡逻路线移动。如果卡比（Kirby）进入射程，鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile）会进行一次大而戏剧性的潜水动作，然后向上咬试图捕捉他。如果成功，鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile）会将卡比（Kirby）拖入水下并咀嚼锁定在他身上直到卡比（Kirby）逃脱（通过让玩家不断操作控制杆）。鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile）无法被吸入，也无法被普通攻击伤害。要击败鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile），卡比（Kirby）必须使用塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode），通常的方法是用装有圈圈塞满嘴（Ring Mouth）动力的船撞击它。以这种方式击败鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile）会让卡比（Kirby）获得一个绿色Star Coin。

Gnawcodiles也出现在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World模式中，不过它们只出现在Fallen-Star Beach中，并且没有水晶变体。
wikirby-page:54851.description_en:
“This robust swimmer has a powerful jaw. It floats on the water's surface, watching and waiting for its prey. Its hide is as tough as armor, so you'll need something bigger than a 复制能力（Copy Ability） to take him down... Do you think 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） would do the trick?”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile） is a big black crocodile-like enemy that is part of the Beast Pack and first appeared in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is typically seen swimming in 清水（Water）, either holding still or moving in set patrol patterns. If 卡比（Kirby） gets within range, 鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile） will make a big and dramatic dive under his position and then bite upward to try and catch him. If successful, 鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile） will drag 卡比（Kirby） under and chew on him until 卡比（Kirby） escapes (by having the player mash the control stick). 鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile） cannot be inhaled, and cannot be damaged by ordinary attacks. To defeat 鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile）, 卡比（Kirby） must make use of a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）, with the typical method being ramming into it using a boat powered by 圈圈塞满嘴（Ring Mouth）. Defeating 鳄加布尔（Gnawcodile） in this way earns 卡比（Kirby） a green Star Coin.

Gnawcodiles also appear in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World mode, though they only appear in Fallen-Star Beach and do not have a Crystal variant.

wikirby-page:54707.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54707.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54707.description_zh:
黑刺棒（Gordo Bar）是黑刺球（Gordo）的一种变体，它被拉长成条状，而不是其在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中出现的通常球形。黑刺棒（Gordo Bar）可以在空中漂浮在多个位置，占据比其普通同类更多的空间。有些也可以看到沿设定路径移动，横向旋转或纵向旋转。黑刺球（Gordo）条状物也可以有不同的长度。像它的普通同类一样，黑刺棒（Gordo Bar）对所有形式的攻击都是无敌的。虽然它们也出现在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World模式中，但它们没有水晶变体。

尽管黑刺棒（Gordo Bar）是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的新敌人，但它的形象没有描述。
wikirby-page:54707.description_en:
黑刺棒（Gordo Bar） is a variant of 黑刺球（Gordo） that is elongated into a bar shape rather than its usual spherical shape, which appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 黑刺棒（Gordo Bar） can be found floating in the air in various locations, taking up more space than its regular cousin. Some can also be seen moving in set paths, rotating laterally, or spinning vertically. 黑刺球（Gordo） Bars can also come in varying lengths. Like its normal cousin, 黑刺棒（Gordo Bar） is invincible to all forms of attack. While they also appear in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World mode, they do not have a Crystal variant.

Despite being a new enemy in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, 黑刺棒（Gordo Bar）'s figure does not have a description.

wikirby-page:54760.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54760.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54760.description_zh:
“给这些点充能，然后……嗖！让它们飞吧！针猬（Jabhog）在新世界以它的尖刺著称。它小时候短小可爱，但最终长成了危险的针。它会刺伤任何靠得太近的东西，所以接近时请小心！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
针猬（Jabhog）是一种大型薰衣草色毛发的刺猬状生物，它是Beast Pack的一部分，并出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它通常会静坐不动，直到卡比（Kirby）接近，这时它会将刺伸展开成一大片锋利的尖刺，然后慢慢靠近卡比（Kirby）。当它的刺伸展时，针猬（Jabhog）无法被普通攻击或吸入伤害，但在其他情况下仍然脆弱。并会在一段时间后或在刺击卡比（Kirby）后立即收回其刺。吸入它需要相当长的时间，但它可以被吞下以获得针（Needle）复制能力（Copy Ability）。击败针猬（Jabhog）可以获得5个Star Coin。针猬（Jabhog）也出现在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World中，尽管它没有水晶变体。
wikirby-page:54760.description_en:
“Charge those points up, then...zing! Let 'em fly! 针猬（Jabhog） is famous in the new world for its spiky spines. They were short and cute when it was young, but they eventually grew into dangerous needles. It'll jab anything that gets too close, so approach with caution!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
针猬（Jabhog） is a large lavender-furred hedgehog-like creature that is part of the Beast Pack and appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It tends to sit in place until 卡比（Kirby） gets near, at which point it will extend its quills into a very big field of sharp spikes, and then slowly approach 卡比（Kirby）. While its spikes are out, 针猬（Jabhog） cannot be harmed by normal attacks or inhaled, but it is vulnerable otherwise, and will retract its quills after a while or immediately after jabbing 卡比（Kirby）. Inhaling it takes a fair amount of time, but it can be swallowed for the 针（Needle） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. 针猬（Jabhog） is worth 5 Star Coins when defeated. 针猬（Jabhog） also appears in Star-Crossed World in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, though it doesn't have a Crystal variant.

wikirby-page:54884.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54884.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54884.description_zh:
“多么快乐的小猿啊！笑一笑，跳一跳，牧吱斯（Mookie）。看看他荡来荡去，把小锤子到处扔……你可以看出他见到你很高兴。看看那笑容！嗯？那不是笑容吗？他在试图吓唬我们？！嗯，呃……现在起作用了！哎呀！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
牧吱斯（Mookie）的描述是一个拿红色锤子的类猿生物，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，作为Beast Pack的一员。他非常像Oohroo来自Kirby Mass Attack，如果卡比（Kirby）或头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）附近，他会试图向他们扔锤子。战胜牧吱斯（Mookie）会掉落Star Coin，但他也可以被吸入并吞下，用于锤子（Hammer）复制能力（Copy Ability）。他扔出的锤子也可以是为了能力而吞噬。他是在系列中唯一一个拥有锤子（Hammer）能力的普通敌人。在Nintendo Switch 2版中，牧吱斯（Mookie）也出现在Star-Crossed World中，并伴有更强的水晶变种。

牧吱斯（Mookie）的名字可能是“rookie”和“mook”两个词的合成词，同时也让人联想到“monkey”。
wikirby-page:54884.description_en:
“What a happy little ape! Smile and dance, 牧吱斯（Mookie）. Watch him swing and throw his little hammer around... You can tell he's happy to see you. Just look at that smile! Huh? That's not a smile? He's trying to scare us?! Well, uh...it's working now! Yikes!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
牧吱斯（Mookie） is a red hammer-wielding simian-like creature that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） as a member of the Beast Pack. He greatly resembles Oohroo from Kirby Mass Attack, and attempts to throw hammers at 卡比（Kirby） or 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） if either of them are nearby. 牧吱斯（Mookie） yields a Star Coin when defeated, but he can also be inhaled and swallowed for the 锤子（Hammer） 复制能力（Copy Ability）. His hammer when thrown can also be swallowed for the ability. He is the only common enemy in the series to yield the 锤子（Hammer） ability. In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, 牧吱斯（Mookie） also appears in Star-Crossed World alongside a stronger Crystal variant.

牧吱斯（Mookie）'s name is possibly a portmanteau of the words "rookie" and "mook", while also invoking "monkey."

wikirby-page:54879.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54879.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54879.description_zh:
“小的那个？那是拉比兔（Rabiroo）。大的那个呢？那是大拉比兔（Orabiroo）。字母O代表“天哪，看它们能跳多高！”尽量不要在它们落地时站在下面。它们的同类喜欢抚摸它们，因为它们非常毛茸茸。（不要碰尾巴。它们讨厌那样。）”
— Figure对“拉比兔（Rabiroo）&大拉比兔（Orabiroo）”的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
大拉比兔（Orabiroo），它是一种大型的、紫色的兔子状敌人，也是Beast Pack的成员，拥有从鼻子延伸出的长耳状附属物，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它通常要么原地坐着，要么不断上下跳，直到发现卡比（Kirby），然后开始跳着追踪他。大拉比兔（Orabiroo）的攻击方式是快速跳过卡比（Kirby），然后落下之后短暂停顿并进行一次地面重击。大拉比兔（Orabiroo）通常需要多次攻击才能击败，会奖励卡比（Kirby）一个绿色Star Coin。如果吸入，大拉比兔（Orabiroo）不会给予任何复制能力（Copy Ability）。一种名为晶体大拉比兔（Orabiroo）的大拉比兔（Orabiroo）变种也会与其普通版本一起出现在Star-Crossed World中。

大拉比兔（Orabiroo）有一个体型较小且危害较低的表亲，名为拉比兔（Rabiroo），它们共享相同的外形。大拉比兔（Orabiroo）的名字是在拉比兔（Rabiroo）的名字后加上‘(Ō)’，在日语中意为‘大’。
wikirby-page:54879.description_en:
“The little one? That's 拉比兔（Rabiroo）. The big one? That's 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）. The O is for, "OH my gosh, look at how high they can jump!" Try not to be under one when they land. Their fellow critters like to pet them because they're so fluffy. (Don't touch the tail. They hate that.)”
— Figure description for "拉比兔（Rabiroo） & 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）" from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
大拉比兔（Orabiroo） is a large, purple rabbit-like enemy and member of the Beast Pack with long ear-like appendages stemming from its snout, which appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It tends to either sit in place or hop up and down continuously until it spots 卡比（Kirby）, from there hopping after him. 大拉比兔（Orabiroo） attacks by quickly leaping over 卡比（Kirby） and then falling down after a short pause with a ground pound. 大拉比兔（Orabiroo） usually requires multiple attacks in order for it to be defeated, which will reward 卡比（Kirby） with a green Star Coin. 大拉比兔（Orabiroo） grants no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if inhaled. A variant of 大拉比兔（Orabiroo） known as Crystal 大拉比兔（Orabiroo） also appears alongside its regular counterpart in Star-Crossed World.

大拉比兔（Orabiroo） has a smaller and less dangerous cousin named 拉比兔（Rabiroo）, which it shares its figure with. 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）'s name is 拉比兔（Rabiroo）'s name with ' (Ō)' added on, meaning 'big' in Japanese.

wikirby-page:55253.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55253.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55253.description_zh:
“毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom）是一只巨大的青蛙，身上覆盖着黏糊糊的毒液。覆盖其身体的脏东西能够保护它免受所有攻击，但只需迅速泼一泼水，它便会洗净，露出美丽（且脆弱）的蓝色皮肤！它一定有很棒的护肤习惯……”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom）的描述是，一种大型蓝黄相间的无尾目生物，是出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Beast Pack的成员。如果卡比（Kirby）或头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）在附近，它会不断向其吐出毒液团。当它吐出的毒液落在地上时，会形成一个无法防护的残留水洼，能摧毁某些物品，并对卡比（Kirby）或敌人造成类似于更持久毒性污泥。毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom）不能吸入，只能使用水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）的水来消灭。消灭后会掉落六种不同的Food物品（通常是玉米棒和牛奶盒）以及两个红色的Star Coin。

“Croakom”来自“croak”，即青蛙发出的叫声，以及“venom”，动物分泌的毒素。
wikirby-page:55253.description_en:
“毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom） is a giant frog covered in icky, sticky poison. The gunk covering its body protects it from all attacks, but a quick splash of water will wash it clean to reveal a beautiful (and vulnerable) blue hide! It must have a great skin-care routine...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom） is a large blue-and-yellow anuran creature that is a member of the Beast Pack that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It continuously spits globs of poison at 卡比（Kirby） or 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee） if either of them are nearby. When the poison goop it spits hits the floor, it creates a lingering unguardable puddle that can destroy certain items and deal damage to 卡比（Kirby） or enemies in a similar manner to more permanent toxic sludge. 毒毒蛙（Poison Croakom） cannot be inhaled, and can only be defeated using the water from 水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）. It yields six different Food items (usually Ears of Corn and Milk Cartons) and two red Star Coins when defeated.

"Croakom" comes from "croak", the sound a frog makes, and "venom", a toxin secreted by animals.

wikirby-page:55239.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55239.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55239.description_zh:
“原始荒地是野兽族的诞生地，所以那里发现的Awoofies比遥远地区的同类更为野性也就不足为奇了。它们在各方面都更加具有攻击性，从吠叫到咬合力都有所增强。它们的原始祖先一定会感到欣慰！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
