原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的描述是，一种类狼生物首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并且是常见加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的一个变种。它们首次与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）一起出现在An Unexpected Beast King，并且之后的关卡中也能找到它们，主要取代了标准Awoofies。与其橙色对手不同，这些Beast Pack的成员呈灰褐色和白色；它们体型更大，毛发更蓬松。像Awoofies一样，Primal Awoofies主要以四足行走为主，但在四处张望或保持静止时，经常可以看到它们直立站立。

原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的一般行为是坐在原地、巡逻指定区域，或一直睡觉直到卡比（Kirby）靠得够近以便它能发现他。当这种情况发生时，原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）会以适中的速度追赶卡比（Kirby），试图通过碰撞伤害他。Redgar Forbidden Lands内的一些成员会担任警戒，一旦发现卡比（Kirby）就会嚎叫并呼唤其他敌人（在The Beast Pack's Final Stand中这样做的只会在攻击时进行）。原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的生命值比普通同类更高，但仍然可以轻易被吸入，尽管被吞下后仍然不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的价值为one Star Coin被击败时。

在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，一个名为Crystal原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的更强变种出现于Star-Crossed World，与普通的原始Awoofies一起。
wikirby-page:55239.description_en:
“Originull Wasteland is the birthplace of the Beast Pack, so it's no wonder the Awoofies found there are more wild than their far-off cousins. They're more aggressive in every way, from their bark to their bite. Their primal ancestors must be pleased!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） is a wolf-like creature which makes its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and is a variant of the common 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）. They make their first appearance alongside 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in An Unexpected Beast King, and can be found in stages thereafter, largely replacing standard Awoofies. As opposed to their orange counterparts, these members of the Beast Pack are grayish-brown and white; they are also larger, with scruffier fur. Like Awoofies, Primal Awoofies are primarily quadrupedal, but can often be seen standing upright when looking around or holding still.

原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）'s general behavior is to sit in place, patrol a given area, or sleep until 卡比（Kirby） gets close enough for it to spot him. When this happens, 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） responds by running after 卡比（Kirby） at a modest speed, aiming to hurt him by collision. Some members within the Redgar Forbidden Lands will function as lookouts which will proceed to howl and call for additional enemies should they spot 卡比（Kirby） (the one that does so in The Beast Pack's Final Stand simply does so attacking). 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） has more health than its normal counterpart, but it can still be inhaled easily, though it still gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） is worth one Star Coin when defeated.

In 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, a stronger variant of 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） called Crystal 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） appears in Star-Crossed World alongside regular Primal Awoofies.

wikirby-page:54685.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54685.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54685.description_zh:
“小的那个？那是拉比兔（Rabiroo）。大的那个？那是大拉比兔（Orabiroo）。O代表“哦天啊，看看它们能跳得多高！”当它们着陆时尽量不要在它们下面。它们的同伴生物喜欢抚摸它们，因为它们非常毛茸茸。（不要碰尾巴。它们讨厌那个。）”
— Figure对“拉比兔（Rabiroo）&大拉比兔（Orabiroo）”的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拉比兔（Rabiroo）是一种浅蓝色的兔子状敌人，是Beast Pack的成员，拥有从嘴部延伸出来的长耳状附属物，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它通常要么原地坐着，要么持续上下跳动，直到发现卡比（Kirby），然后追着他跳，希望通过碰撞进行攻击。有时，Rabiroos会按照设定模式持续跳跃并如果卡比（Kirby）靠近它们，它们不会改变行为。拉比兔（Rabiroo）并不特别快或具有威胁性，很容易被卡比（Kirby）的吸入或其他攻击击败，击败后可以获得一个Star Coin。吞下拉比兔（Rabiroo）不会获得任何能力。

拉比兔（Rabiroo）有一个更大、更危险的近亲，名为大拉比兔（Orabiroo），它们的外形相似。此外，拉比兔（Rabiroo）的水晶变体会出现在Star-Crossed World星耀体（Starry）关卡中，和普通的Rabiroos一起出现。
wikirby-page:54685.description_en:
“The little one? That's 拉比兔（Rabiroo）. The big one? That's 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）. The O is for, "OH my gosh, look at how high they can jump!" Try not to be under one when they land. Their fellow critters like to pet them because they're so fluffy. (Don't touch the tail. They hate that.)”
— Figure description for "拉比兔（Rabiroo） & 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）" from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拉比兔（Rabiroo） is a light blue rabbit-like enemy and member of the Beast Pack with long ear-like appendages stemming from its snout, appearing in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It tends to either sit in place or hop up and down continuously until it spots 卡比（Kirby）, from there hopping after him, hoping to attack by collision. Sometimes, Rabiroos continuously hop in set patterns and don't change their behavior if 卡比（Kirby） gets near them. 拉比兔（Rabiroo） is not particularly quick or threatening, can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s inhale or another attack, and is worth one Star Coin on defeat. 拉比兔（Rabiroo） grants no ability if swallowed.

拉比兔（Rabiroo） has a larger and more dangerous cousin named 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）, which it shares its figure with. Additionally, a Crystal variant of 拉比兔（Rabiroo） appear alongside regular Rabiroos in the Star-Crossed World 星耀体（Starry） Stages.

wikirby-page:55030.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55030.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55030.description_zh:
疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car）是在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中出现的敌人和关卡障碍，主要出现在Wondaria Remains的关卡中。有四种不同类型，通过形状和大小来区分：一种像一枚侧面有红色油漆的火箭，一种像有眼睛和天线的“外星人”飞碟，一种像一个大绿色玩具机器人，其面部类似于棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）的，一种像带有机器人面孔的蒸汽机车。除了它们的大小之外，每种行为方式相同，以各种预设速度沿固定路径行驶，通常成群出现。失控游行车无法被吸入或被大多数攻击造成伤害，但可以通过使用水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）喷射它们来偏转。偏转后，车辆会失控旋转，并可能成为用于突破障碍物，如蓝色百叶窗和金属方块，也会击败它们碰到的敌人。

疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car）有一个形象，但缺乏描述。逃跑的游行车也出现在Star-Crossed World中，尽管它们只是无生命的障碍物，因此没有水晶变体。
wikirby-page:55030.description_en:
疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car） is an enemy and stage hazard that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, primarily in stages in Wondaria Remains. There are four different types, distinguished by shape and size: one resembles a rocket with red paint on its side, one resembles an "alien" flying saucer with eyes and antenna, one resembles a big green toy robot with a face reminiscent of 棒针狂人（Yin-Yarn）'s, and one resembles a steam locomotive with a robotic face. Aside from their size, each one behaves the same way, driving at various set speeds along a fixed path, often in groups. Runaway Parade Cars cannot be inhaled or harmed by most attacks, but they can be deflected by spraying them using 水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）. When deflected, the cars spin out of control and can be made to break obstacles such as blue shutters and metal blocks, and will also defeat enemies they hit.

疯狂巡游车（Runaway Parade Car） has a figure, but it lacks a description. Runaway Parade Cars also appear in Star-Crossed World, though because they are only inanimate obstacles, they do not have Crystal variants.

wikirby-page:55408.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55408.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55408.description_zh:
“这种贪婪的爬行动物可以将敌人整个吞下！一旦它发现猎物，它会尽可能迅速地爬行追赶。有些它试图吞下的东西看起来不合理地大，但它有弹性的身体可以将它们吞下。等等……为什么这听起来很熟悉？”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker）的描述是一个中等大小的蛇形生物，看起来像是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中Beast Pack的成员。一旦它发现卡比（Kirby）或头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee），它会爬向其中之一，如果接近它们，会短暂地吞食它们。佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker）可以被吸入，但不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability），被击败时会掉落绿色的Star Coin。佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker）也出现在Star-Crossed World中，尽管它不会有一个水晶变体。

它的名字来自“零食”，“sss”前缀是模仿蛇嘶嘶声的拟声词。
wikirby-page:55408.description_en:
“This ravenous reptile can swallow its enemies whole! Once it spots prey, it'll slither after it as swift as it can. Some of the things it tries to swallow seem unreasonably large, but its stretchy body allows it to gulp them down. Wait...why does that sound familiar?”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker） is a moderately large serpentine creature that appears as a member of the Beast Pack in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. Once it spots 卡比（Kirby） or 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, it will crawl towards either of them, briefly consuming them if it approaches them. 佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker） can be inhaled but does not yield a 复制能力（Copy Ability）, and it yields a green Star Coin when defeated. 佳布尔蛇（Sssnacker） also appears in Star-Crossed World, though it doesn't have a Crystal variant.

Its name comes from "snack", with the "sss" prefix being an onomatopoeia for a snake's hiss.

wikirby-page:55106.display_name: 惊吓外星人板（Surprise Alien Board）
wikirby-page:55106.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55106.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55106.description_zh:
惊吓外星人板（Surprise Alien Board）（简称外星人）是一种敌人和关卡障碍，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，主要出现在“恐怖屋入侵”关卡中。它是一个典型外星人的木质剪影（有红色、绿色或蓝色），会从墙上弹出，以惊吓卡比（Kirby）和/或阻挡他的去路。当板子弹出后，它通常会停留片刻，然后再次移开，尽管有些会无限期地保持原位。除非卡比（Kirby）在其弹出时被击中，否则惊吓外星人板不会伤害他，但在其他物体试图伤害他时，它们可能会挡路。惊吓外星人板无法被吸入或用普通攻击破坏，但它们可以可以使用自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth）破坏。它们被摧毁时不会产生任何物品，尽管‘鬼屋入侵’任务的一个目标是破坏其中的13个。

惊吓外星人板（Surprise Alien Board）有一个人物，但没有描述。
wikirby-page:55106.description_en:
惊吓外星人板（Surprise Alien Board） (referred to in short as an alien) is an enemy and stage hazard that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, primarily in the stage Invasion at the House of Horrors. It is a wooden cut-out of a stereotypical space alien (coming in red, green, or blue) that pops out of the wall in order to surprise 卡比（Kirby） and/or block his way. After the board comes out, it will typically linger for a moment before moving back out of the way again, though some will remain in place indefinitely. Surprise Alien Boards cannot harm 卡比（Kirby） unless he is hit by them as they pop out, but they may get in the way while something else seeks to harm him. Surprise Alien Boards cannot be inhaled or damaged using normal attacks, but they can be broken using 自动贩卖机塞满嘴（Vending Mouth）. They yield nothing when destroyed, though one of the mission objectives for Invasion at the House of Horrors is to break 13 of them.

惊吓外星人板（Surprise Alien Board） has a figure, but lacks a description.

wikirby-page:54212.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54212.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54212.description_zh:
“龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）整个壳是由混凝土制成的，就好像它拿走了别人的人行道！它的头骨很厚，咬力很强，但身体相当脆弱。塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）的能力可能会帮助你突破它的壳，从上方给予致命一击！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）的描述是，一个像大乌龟一样的生物，它用一块混凝土作为壳，看起来像是Beast Pack的一员，并且在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中是敌人。龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）会原地不动，慢慢旋转，以尝试伸长脖子去咬卡比（Kirby），如果他在攻击范围内。龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）不能被吸入，也不会受到任何普通攻击的伤害。唯一能打败它的方法是使用三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth）来猛击它的壳顶以打破它。在这样做时，龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）的身体露出，显得短粗，皮肤上有类似泳衣的浅色印记，就像未晒黑的皮肤轮廓。虽然很大，但龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）远不如它的亲戚建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）大。龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中唯一没有出现在Star-Crossed World中的敌人之一。

在Downtown Grassland中，击败龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）会掉落两个黄色的Star Coin、两个绿色星币、两个甜甜圈，以及一个隐藏的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）笼子。

它的名字是“龟”和“角”两个词的合成词。
wikirby-page:54212.description_en:
“龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） has a whole shell made of concrete, as if it walked off with somebody's sidewalk! It has a thick skull and a mean bite, but its body is pretty delicate. A 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability might help you crack through its shell and land a brutal blow from above!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） is a big tortoise-like creature that uses a square of concrete as its shell, which appears as a member of the Beast Pack and an enemy in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） sits in place and slowly swivels around in order to try and extend its neck to bite 卡比（Kirby） if he is in range. 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） cannot be inhaled nor harmed by any regular attack. The only thing that can defeat it is by using 三角锥塞满嘴（Cone Mouth） to slam the top of its shell to break it. When doing this, 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）'s body is revealed to be stubby with a light print of skin resembling a bathing suit, similar to an outline of skin that hasn't been tanned. Although large, 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） is not nearly as big as its relative 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）. 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） is one of the only enemies from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） to not appear in Star-Crossed World.

In Downtown Grassland, defeating 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner） yields two yellow Star Coins, two green Star Coins, two donuts, and a hidden 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） cage.

Its name is a portmanteau of "tortoise" and "corner".

wikirby-page:54214.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54214.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54214.description_zh:
“哇！建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）的壳是一整栋建筑！这个大坏蛋一定是小怪兽们的某种头目。它喜欢晒太阳，所以会爬到高处，把整个区域当作自己的领地。（这个家伙爬到那里一定要花很长时间……）”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）的描述
建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）是一种类似巨型乌龟的生物，它用整栋建筑作为自己的壳，看起来像Beast Pack的成员，并在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中是敌人。它是龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）的大型变种，龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）原地坐着，缓慢地旋转，以试图伸长脖子去咬卡比（Kirby）（如果他在攻击范围内的话）。建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）的一种变种称为红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding），出现在Redgar Forbidden Lands和的Forgo Dreams等效版本，而另一种变体称为Crystal建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）出现在Star-Crossed World.
wikirby-page:54214.description_en:
“Whoa! 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding）'s shell is a whole building! This big baddie must be some kind of boss for the smaller beasts. It enjoys basking in the sun, so it climbs to high spots and claims the whole area as its territory. (It must take a long time for this critter to get up there...)”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding） is a giant tortoise-like creature that uses an entire building as its shell, which appears as a member of the Beast Pack and an enemy in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is a larger variant of 龟塔洛斯（Tortorner）, which sits in place and slowly swivels around in order to try and extend its neck to bite 卡比（Kirby） if he is in range. A variant of 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding） known as 红通通龟塔洛斯（Big Red Tortuilding） appears in Redgar Forbidden Lands and its Forgo Dreams equivalent, while another variant known as Crystal 建筑龟塔洛斯（Tortuilding） appears in Star-Crossed World.

wikirby-page:55032.display_name: 回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket）
wikirby-page:55032.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55032.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55032.description_zh:
回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket）是出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）和星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的敌人和关卡危险物，主要出现在Wondaria Remains的关卡中。它类似于带有宇宙飞船主题的游乐设施，其最简单的形式是一个连接到中央旋转轴的单个火箭座位，且不断旋转，但许多火箭座椅可以堆叠在一起，并相对于旋转轴以各种模式排列。火箭座位会产生火花和烟雾，手柄上覆盖着尖刺，因此该装置接触起来是有害的。它不能被吸入或用常规手段攻击。摧毁它的唯一方法是使用水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）的水喷洒，这可以使旋转轴上的任何剩余火箭暂时减速。每个被摧毁的火箭可获得两个黄色Star Coin和一个绿色星币。

回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket）有一个人物，但缺少描述。旋转星火箭也出现在Star-Crossed World的一个关卡中。
wikirby-page:55032.description_en:
回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket） is an enemy and stage hazard that appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, primarily in stages in Wondaria Remains. It resembles a carnival ride with a spaceship motif, with the simplest form being a single rocket seat attached to a central pivot that rotates constantly, though many can be stacked on top of each-other and arranged in various patterns relative to the pivot. The rocket seat sparks and smokes, and the handle is covered in spikes, so the contraption is harmful to touch. It cannot be inhaled or attacked using conventional means. The only way to destroy it is to spray it using water from 水球塞满嘴（Water-Balloon Mouth）, which can cause any remaining rockets on the pivot to slow down momentarily. Each destroyed rocket yields two yellow Star Coins and one green Star Coin.

回旋星际火箭（Twirling Star Rocket） has a figure, but lacks a description. Twirling Star Rockets also appear in a single stage of Star-Crossed World.

wikirby-page:54944.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54944.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54944.description_zh:
“天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）在攻击时总是展示出优雅的表演。不要被她的表演迷住，否则你会被她的龙卷风卷进去！她对舞蹈事业非常投入，把每一场战斗都看作一堂新的课程。（这让她始终保持警觉。）”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅罗利那（Fleurina），她是一个拟人化的天鹅形芭蕾舞者，以中期Boss和Beast Pack成员身份首次登场于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并且是游戏中唯一一个没有基于星之卡比系列（Kirby series）现有中期Boss设计的中期Boss。她通过旋转自己并伴随强风攻击，同时发射龙卷风射击。恰如其分的是，她在被击败后会给予龙卷风（Tornado）复制能力（Copy Ability），并且也是系列做到这一点。天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）的能力基于天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）。

在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Star-Crossed World故事中以及在《终极杯Z EX》中，天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）从流星雨的影响中获得增强，她的头部和衣服上有各种晶体；这种特殊形态被命名为水晶天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）。
wikirby-page:54944.description_en:
“天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） always puts on an elegant show when she attacks. Don't get too caught up in her performance, or you'll get caught up in her tornado to match! She's very dedicated to her dance career and thinks of every battle as a new lesson. (They keep her on her toes.)”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） is an anthropomorphic swan-like ballerina who makes her debut as a mid-boss and member of the Beast Pack in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and is the only mid-boss in the game that is not based on a pre-existing mid-boss from the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. She attacks by twirling herself along with gale force and throwing out tornado projectiles. Fittingly, she gives the 龙卷风（Tornado） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when defeated and is also the first mid-boss in the series to do so. The 天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado） ability is based on 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）.

In the 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）'s Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on her head and dress; this particular form is named Crystal 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）.

wikirby-page:54854.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54854.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54854.description_zh:
“神秘的漩涡也把锤星猩（Bonkers）带到了新世界！他们比卡比（Kirby）先到达，并迅速加入了可怕的野兽军团。他们非常喜欢自己的新形象，并且与所有新同事相处融洽……尤其是Mookies！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）的描述，是锤星猩（Bonkers）的一个变体，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为中级Boss。他们与普通同类相似，但毛发凌乱呈蓝色，手臂和脸上有战斗彩绘。他们还使用石凿作为锤子，并丢掷榴莲而不是椰子。狂野锤子（Wild Hammer）的能力基于狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）。

在任天堂Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事以及《终极Cup Z EX，锤星猩（Bonkers）在流星雨的影响下获得了能量，身体上覆盖着各种水晶，还挥舞着水晶锤，毛发呈粉色和紫色混合；这种特定形态称为水晶狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）。奇怪的是，水晶狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）以及锤星猩（Bonkers）和牧吱斯（Mookie）的EX人物描述中使用了男性代词“他/他的”来指代他们，而游戏中的其他地方使用的是性别中性的“他们/他们的”。
wikirby-page:54854.description_en:
“The mysterious vortex brought 锤星猩（Bonkers） to the new world too! They arrived before 卡比（Kirby） and quickly joined the ranks of the fearsome Beast Pack. They really like their new look, and they're getting along with all of their new coworkers...especially the Mookies!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers） is a variant of 锤星猩（Bonkers） who appears as a mid-boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They resemble their normal counterpart, but with frazzled bluish fur and war paint on their arms and face. They also wield a stone chisel for a hammer and throw durians instead of coconuts. The 狂野锤子（Wild Hammer） ability is based on 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 锤星猩（Bonkers） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on their body in addition to wielding a crystal hammer and having their fur be a mixture of pink and purple; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）. Strangely, the EX figure descriptions for both Crystal 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers） and 锤星猩（Bonkers） & 牧吱斯（Mookie） refer to them with masculine "he/him" pronouns instead of the gender-neutral "they/them" elsewhere in the game.

wikirby-page:54221.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54221.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54221.description_zh:
“神秘的漩涡也把庞大刃（Gigant Edge）带到了新世界！他们比卡比（Kirby）先到，并加入了野兽团的队伍。尽管换上了野性的服装，他们在团队中仍然非常醒目，但他们仍会以凶猛守护自己的岗位！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野刃（Wild Edge）的描述，是庞大刃（Gigant Edge）的一个变体，在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为中型头目出现。他们与普通同类相似，但铠甲上有战争彩绘，脖子周围戴着毛领。他们还挥舞着一把石剑和一面带刺的防暴盾。庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）的能力基于狂野刃（Wild Edge）。

在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事中以及《The Ultimate Cup Z EX》中，庞大刃（Gigant Edge）在流星雨的影响下获得能量，并且他们的盔甲上有各种水晶，同时颜色比平时更浅；这一特定形态被命名为Crystal狂野刃（Wild Edge）。奇怪的是，Crystal狂野刃（Wild Edge）的EX人物描述在游戏其他地方使用中性'they/them'代词时，却使用了男性'he/him'代词来称呼他们。
wikirby-page:54221.description_en:
“The mysterious vortex brought 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） to the new world too! They arrived before 卡比（Kirby） and fell in with the ranks of the Beast Pack. Despite the wild wardrobe change, they really stand out among the rest of the pack, but they'll still guard their stations with ferocity!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野刃（Wild Edge） is a variant of 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） who appears as a mid-boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They resemble their normal counterpart, but with war paint on their armor and a fur collar around their neck. They also wield a stone sword and a spiky riot shield. The 庞大利剑（Gigant Sword） ability is based on 狂野刃（Wild Edge）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on their armor while also being lighter-colored than usual; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野刃（Wild Edge）. Strangely, Crystal 狂野刃（Wild Edge）'s EX figure description refers to them with masculine "he/him" pronouns instead of the gender-neutral "they/them" elsewhere in the game.

wikirby-page:53927.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53927.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53927.description_zh:
“神秘的漩涡也将冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）带到了新世界！他在卡比（Kirby）到达前不久就来了，并立即加入了野兽队。（服装的变化一定让这个选择变得很容易。）作为新来的确实很难，但他的同伴们很喜欢与他合作。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的描述是冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）的一个变体，他属于Beast Pack，并出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，在游戏中担任中级Boss。他的外观与常规版本相似，但要大得多，且更加凌乱邋遢：他的工装裤破烂不堪，手和脸上有蓝色的毛发条纹或可能是战斗彩绘，并且他有一把大蓝胡子。他的上唇是也部分冻结，挂着像尖牙的冰柱。他通过制造和投掷不同大小的雪球以及雪人来攻击。他还会试图压碎卡比（Kirby）并追击，有时还能成功吃掉他。卡比（Kirby）的其中一个Evolved Copy Abilities——冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）——是基于狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的。在任天堂Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事以及终极杯Z EX中，冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）受到流星雨的影响而增强，身体上布满了各种水晶；这一特殊形态被命名为水晶狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）。
wikirby-page:53927.description_en:
“The mysterious vortex brought 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） to the new world too! He arrived shortly before 卡比（Kirby） and immediately joined the Beast Pack. (The change in wardrobe must have made it an easy choice.) It's tough to be the new guy, but his fellow beasts love working with him.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty） is a variant of 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） who belongs to the Beast Pack and appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, serving as a mid-boss in that game. He is similar in appearance to his regular counterpart, but much larger, and with a more disheveled and unkempt appearance: his overalls are torn up, he has blue streaks of fur or possibly warpaint on his hands and face, and he has a large blue beard. His upper lip is also partially frozen, with hanging icicles that resemble sharp teeth. He attacks by creating and tossing different sizes of snowballs, as well as snowmen. He also will attempt to crush 卡比（Kirby） and dash after him, sometimes managing to eat him. One of 卡比（Kirby）'s Evolved Copy Abilities—冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）—is based on 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals all over his body; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）.

wikirby-page:56063.name_zh: 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯
wikirby-page:56063.name_en: Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis
wikirby-page:56063.display_name: 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）
wikirby-page:56063.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56063.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56063.description_zh:
魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的一个秘密Boss，只在Colosseum遇到。它是完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的一个变体，可以被认为是它们的一个更强版本。尽管没有“灵魂”这个后缀，魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）与其他灵魂Boss有许多相似之处。它是冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）和完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）过去吸收的所有灵魂的融合，包括Beast Pack、无数其他物种，以及侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）和冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）自身。它的配色方案让人想起零二（0²），并且有些元素来源于冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）（尤其是它的长矛，安塔瑞斯）。

魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）有两种不同的形态。第一种类似完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis），并以类似的方式战斗，不过带有新的和更更强的攻击。就像主线故事中的完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）一样，一旦魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）的生命值降到足够低，它会被击倒并在背上出现一个能量球，不过里面并没有艾菲灵（Elfilin），而是看起来不透明。当卡比（Kirby）用巨蛋塞满嘴（Dome Mouth）将其分开时，它显露出其作为魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）的第二个“灵魂”形态。从这里开始，剩余的身体会变成绕着中央灵魂球旋转的肉球，这些肉球可以被吸入并吐向魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis），以在这一阶段造成伤害。在这个第二形态中，它有很多攻击类似于之前的灵魂Boss。
wikirby-page:56063.description_en:
魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） is a secret boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, encountered exclusively at the Colosseum. It is a variant of 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）, and can be considered a stronger version of them. Despite not having the suffix "soul", 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） shares many similarities with other soul bosses. It is an amalgamation of all the souls 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） and 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） have absorbed in the past, including the Beast Pack, countless other species, and 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） and 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） themselves. Its color scheme is reminiscent of 零二（0²）, with some elements being drawn from 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） (particularly on its spear, Antares).

魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） has two distinct forms. The first resembles 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） and fights in a similar manner, though with new and much stronger attacks. Much like 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） in the main story, once 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） is at low enough health, it is knocked down and an orb of energy appears on its back, though instead of containing 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, it seems to be opaque. When 卡比（Kirby） separates it using 巨蛋塞满嘴（Dome Mouth）, it reveals itself as the second "soul" form of 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）. From here, the leftover body transforms into balls of flesh that orbit the central soul orb, and these balls can be inhaled and spat at 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis） to damage it in this phase. In this second form, it has many attacks that are similar to preceding soul bosses.

wikirby-page:54862.name_zh: 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯
wikirby-page:54862.display_name: 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）
wikirby-page:54862.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54862.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54862.description_zh:
“我们第一次见到的艾菲灵（Elfilin）诞生于一个小而有同情心的灵魂，该灵魂隐藏在更大、更具侵略性的野心背后。没有灵魂来调节其力量，这个生物的空间传送能力失控，到处打开神秘的漩涡。现在他们重新完整了，他们已经在计划下一次入侵……”
— 来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的图形描述，标题为终极生命体，是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）主线故事的最终Boss。他们是在吸收了艾菲灵（Elfilin）——其同情心的化身——之后，侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）所采取的形态，也是他们最初到达新世界时的形态。没有艾菲灵（Elfilin），完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）会慢慢变回侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）。即使以他们更富同情心的一面，Elfilis的主要目标是入侵其他行星，根据他们的角色描述。

完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的更强大版本，利用冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）和Beast Pack的灵魂强化，称为魂沌新物种混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis），出现在Colosseum的《终极杯Z》和《终极杯Z EX》中。此外，完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的兄弟寄星晶灭体杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）作为任天堂Switch 2版Star-Crossed World的最终boss出现。
wikirby-page:54862.description_en:
“The 艾菲灵（Elfilin） we first met was born from a small, compassionate soul that hid behind greater, invasive ambitions. Without a soul to temper its power, the creature's spatial-teleportation ability ran amok, opening mysterious vortices left and right. Now that they're whole again, they're already planning their next invasion...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）, titled the Ultimate Life-Form, is the final boss of the main story of 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They are the form that 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） takes after they absorb 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, the embodiment of their compassion, and the form they were originally in when they arrived in the new world. Without 艾菲灵（Elfilin）, 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） slowly reverts back into 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）. Even with their more compassionate side, Elfilis' main goal is invading other planets, according to their figure description.

A more powerful version of 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis） powered up with the souls of 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight） and the Beast Pack, known as 魂沌新物种 混沌·艾菲里斯（Species Born of Chaos, Chaos Elfilis）, appears in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. Additionally, 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）'s brother, 寄星晶灭体 杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）, appears as the final boss of Star-Crossed World in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

wikirby-page:54859.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:54859.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:54859.description_zh:
“站在雷德加火山底部守卫的邪恶魔鬼竟然是……帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）吗？！在你取下他那张威胁性的面具后，他平静了下来。那么，他为什么要绑架艾菲灵（Elfilin）呢？他说他一直被控制，甚至在某个奇怪的生物给他戴上那副面具之前！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）的描述，标题为《他的原始宿敌》，是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）戴上由狮王加尔夫（Leongar）赠送的木制面具以增强力量（并进一步控制他的心智）时的形态。他作为星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中Redgar Forbidden Lands的首领出场，在关卡In the Presence of the King中被对战。除了面具，狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）使用两把锤子，还能召唤火焰柱。当卡比（Kirby）击败狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）时，面具崩溃了，他又恢复了正常。

“放弃”一词用于指代侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo），即在游戏过程中指挥野兽队的生物。
wikirby-page:54859.description_en:
“The foul fiend standing guard at the bottom of Redgar Volcano was...帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） again?! He calmed back down after you removed his menacing mask. So why did he kidnap 艾菲灵（Elfilin）? He said he was being controlled, even before some strange beast put that mask on him!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）, titled His Primal Nemesis, is the form 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） takes when wearing a wooden mask given to him by 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） to increase his power (and further dominate his mind). He serves as the boss of Redgar Forbidden Lands in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, being faced in the stage In the Presence of the King. In addition to the mask, 狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede） uses two hammers and can conjure pillars of flame. When 卡比（Kirby） defeats 狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）, the mask breaks and he reverts to his normal self again.

The term "forgo" is used in reference to 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）, the creature directing the Beast Pack over the course of the game.

wikirby-page:77511.display_name: 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）
wikirby-page:77511.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:77511.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:77511.description_zh:
“编号为ID-F86的标本在一次屈辱的失败后失去了形态并漂浮着，逃到了遗忘之梦以策划下一步行动：创建一支新的幽灵兽军队，然后将狮王加尔夫（Leongar）的身体据为己有。当卡比（Kirby）到来强行将其驱逐时，ID-F86别无选择，只能展现出自己的幽灵形态。”
— Figure对附身兽的描述：来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）的附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon），名为附身兽，是星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的一个Boss。这个Boss是狮王加尔夫（Leongar）的更强形态，狮王加尔夫（Leongar）被侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）附身。附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）在Isolated Isles: Forgo Dreams的最后阶段Forgo Land中进行战斗，同时也是Colosseum中终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX的第十个对手。附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）保留了狮王加尔夫（Leongar）的大部分旧攻击，但也增加了一些新攻击，并对他之前的许多攻击进行了新的变化。Soul Forgo还会在战斗过程中出现，骚扰卡比（Kirby），同时Leon攻击他。在附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）被击败后，Soul Forgo会从Leon的身体中逃出，单独与卡比（Kirby）战斗，然后被冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）对其施加审判。
wikirby-page:77511.description_en:
“The specimen tagged as ID-F86, left formless and floating after a humiliating defeat, fled to Forgo Dreams to plot their next steps: create a new army of phantom beasts, then claim 狮王加尔夫（Leongar）'s body as their own. When 卡比（Kirby） arrived to force them out, ID-F86 had no choice but to reveal their own phantom form.”
— Figure description of Possessed Beast: 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon） from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）, titled Possessed Beast, is a boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. This boss is a stronger form of 狮王加尔夫（Leongar）, who is possessed by 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）. 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon） is fought in the last stage of Isolated Isles: Forgo Dreams, Forgo Land, and is also the tenth opponent of The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon） retains most of 狮王加尔夫（Leongar）'s old attacks, but also gains some new ones and new spins on many of his previous ones. Soul Forgo also appears partway into the fight to harass 卡比（Kirby） while Leon is attacking him. After 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon） is defeated, Soul Forgo flees from Leon's body to fight 卡比（Kirby） on its own, before having judgment cast on it by 冥蝶骑士（Morpho Knight）.

wikirby-page:53333.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53333.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53333.description_zh:
“猩猛霸（Gorimondo）将当地的购物中心视为他个人的领地。作为野兽帮执行委员会的一员，他负责捕捉Waddle Dees并收集食物。他往往自己吃掉所有的水果……他就是忍不住！这种行为不止一次让他老板对他大加训斥。”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
猩猛霸（Gorimondo），标题为《力大无穷的野兽》，他是出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的大型老板，其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）首次出现在Natural Plains关卡——购物中心混战。他是一个巨大的类大猩猩的存在，黑色皮毛和皮肤，面部和手臂上有红色标记，右鼻孔有一枚环，头上有白色毛发条纹，顶部的毛形成了莫霍克发型，另一个较小的一个在下巴下形成了一个小胡子，并在他的嘴巴里有一些尖锐的獠牙。

猩猛霸（Gorimondo）是Beast Pack执行委员会的一部分，而且是该队中最大的成员，甚至比领导者狮王加尔夫（Leongar）还要大。猩猛霸（Gorimondo）是卡比（Kirby）在游戏中面对的第一个老板，他戴着一个金色笼子作为项链，里面关着三只被困的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）。然而，在其他场合中，他项上戴的却是一个锚。

除了出现在《商场混战》中，猩猛霸（Gorimondo）还在Redgar Forbidden Lands的Gathering of the Beast Council关卡中出现，并且参与了Colosseum的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）杯和终极杯。在遗弃梦想的孤岛上，他还有一个更强的变种，终极杯Z，以及被称为刚幻兽猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）的终极杯Z EX。在击败附身兽狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon）后播放的‘放弃梦想’结局过场动画中，野兽团队将莱昂迷失的灵魂碎片归还给他，包括猩猛霸（Gorimondo）.
wikirby-page:53333.description_en:
“猩猛霸（Gorimondo） considers the local shopping mall to be his personal territory. As part of the Beast Pack's executive council, he's in charge of capturing Waddle Dees and gathering food. He tends to eat all the fruit himself... He just can't help it! This behavior has earned him an earful from his boss more than once.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
猩猛霸（Gorimondo）, titled Strong-Armed Beast, is a large boss who appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, first fought in the Natural Plains stage, The Brawl at the Mall. He is a giant gorilla-like entity with black fur and skin, with red accent marks on his face and arms, a ring in his right nostril, and white fur stripes on his head, with the one on top formed into a mohawk, another smaller one formed into a tiny beard under his chin and some sharp fangs in his chops.

猩猛霸（Gorimondo） is part of the executive council of the Beast Pack, and is by far the largest member of the pack, being larger even than the leader 狮王加尔夫（Leongar）. 猩猛霸（Gorimondo） is the first boss that 卡比（Kirby） faces in the game, and he keeps a gold cage containing three trapped 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s as a necklace. In other appearances however, he wears an anchor around his neck instead.

In addition to his appearance in The Brawl at the Mall, 猩猛霸（Gorimondo） is also fought in the stage Gathering of the Beast Council in Redgar Forbidden Lands and is fought in the 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） Cup and The Ultimate Cup in the Colosseum. A stronger variant of him exists in the isolated isles of Forgo Dreams, The Ultimate Cup Z, and The Ultimate Cup Z EX called 刚幻兽 猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）. In the Forgo Dreams ending cutscene that plays after 附身兽 狮王·遗忘（Possessed Beast, Forgo Leon） is defeated, the Beast Pack return wayward pieces of Leon's soul to him, including 猩猛霸（Gorimondo）.

wikirby-page:55976.display_name: 幻爪豹 卡洛凌·幻（Phantom Clawroline）
wikirby-page:55976.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55976.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55976.description_zh:
“真正的卡洛凌（Clawroline）请求卡比（Kirby）帮助她拯救狮王加尔夫（Leongar）。这只幻影猫是假的！它由负面思想和强大的灵能形成，这只野兽似乎根本不关心狮王加尔夫（Leongar）。她可能只是一个幻象，但她的爪子会造成真正的伤害！”
— Figure在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻爪豹卡洛凌·幻（Phantom Clawroline）中的描述，标题为《幻象豹》，是卡洛凌（Clawroline）更强大的幻象形态，它作为星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的Forgo Park的Boss出现，也可以在Colosseum中的终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中挑战。幻爪豹卡洛凌·幻（Phantom Clawroline）的外观和战斗方式与她的真实原型大体相同，但配色不同，拥有明亮的青色、紫色和品红色皮毛，以及眼睛。类似于侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）的那些。
wikirby-page:55976.description_en:
“The real 卡洛凌（Clawroline） asked 卡比（Kirby） to help her save 狮王加尔夫（Leongar）. This phantom feline is a fake! Formed from negative thoughts and powerful psychic energy, this wild beast doesn't seem to care about 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） at all. She may be an illusion, but her claws will cause real damage!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻爪豹 卡洛凌·幻（Phantom Clawroline）, titled Illusory Leopard, is a more powerful illusory form of 卡洛凌（Clawroline） which appears as the boss of Forgo Park in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and can also be fought in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 幻爪豹 卡洛凌·幻（Phantom Clawroline） looks and fights largely the same as her real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, with bright cyan, purple, and magenta fur, and eyes resembling those of 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）.

wikirby-page:56060.name_zh: 幻兽面具 狂野 帝帝帝·幻
wikirby-page:56060.name_en: Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede
wikirby-page:56060.display_name: 幻兽面具 狂野 帝帝帝·幻（Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede）
wikirby-page:56060.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56060.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56060.description_zh:
“狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）是在狮王加尔夫（Leongar）给已经被控制的国王戴上一个面具以进一步迷惑他的心智时形成的。随后，他被派去守护Lab Discovera的唯一入口。这个幻影复制体是基于他那可怕转变的记忆形成的，某种程度上甚至比原版更强大、更危险！”
— Figure在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻兽面具狂野帝帝帝·幻（Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede）中的描述，名为《虚幻原始宿敌》，是一种狂野帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede）的更强大的幻象形态，它作为星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中Forgo Zone的Boss出现，也是Colosseum中对战的四大勇士之一；在《终极杯Z》和《终极杯Z EX》中均有登场。幻兽面具狂野帝帝帝·幻（Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede）的外观和战斗方式与其真实对应物大致相同，但颜色不同计划，现在拥有青绿色的皮肤，穿着紫色外套，带有青色绒毛和品红色羽毛及腰带，眼睛与侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）在其“入侵物种”形态下的眼睛相匹配。它的面具颜色也与这一整体配色方案相符。
wikirby-page:56060.description_en:
“狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede） was formed when 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） gave the already-controlled king a mask to further cloud his mind. He was then tasked with guarding the only entrance to Lab Discovera. This phantom copy, based on memories of his terrifying turn, is somehow even stronger and more dangerous than the original!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻兽面具 狂野 帝帝帝·幻（Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede）, titled Illusory Primal Nemesis, is a more powerful illusory form of 狂野 帝帝帝（Forgo Dedede） which appears as the boss of Forgo Zone in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and is also one of the Four Warriors fought in the Colosseum; appearing in both The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX. 幻兽面具 狂野 帝帝帝·幻（Illusory Primal Nemesis, Phantom Forgo Dedede） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, now sporting teal skin with a purple coat with cyan fluff and magenta feathers and belt, and eyes that match those of 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） in its "Invasive Species" form. The color of its mask also matches this general color scheme.

wikirby-page:55918.display_name: 刚幻兽 猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）
wikirby-page:55918.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55918.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55918.description_zh:
“这只虚幻的野兽是在梦境领域中用强大的心灵能量创造的。它并不是真正的猩猛霸（Gorimondo）——只是由消极思想构成的幻影——但它仍然非常强大！由于它是基于对真正猩猛霸（Gorimondo）的记忆，它无法抗拒水果零食。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
刚幻兽猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）的描述，题为“强臂幻象”，是猩猛霸（Gorimondo）的更强大的虚幻形态，它作为Forgo Plains中星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Boss出现，也可以在Colosseum的终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中战斗。刚幻兽猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）外观和战斗方式与其真实对应物大致相同，但颜色方案不同，现在拥有明亮的青色和洋红色毛发以及青色牙齿，和与侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）在其“入侵物种”形态下相匹配的眼睛.
wikirby-page:55918.description_en:
“This illusory beast was created with powerful psychic energy in a realm of dreams. It's not the real 猩猛霸（Gorimondo）—just a phantom made of negative thoughts—but it's still incredibly strong! Since it's based on memories of the real 猩猛霸（Gorimondo）, it can't resist a fruity snack.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
刚幻兽 猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo）, titled Strong-Armed Illusion, is a more powerful illusory form of 猩猛霸（Gorimondo） which appears as the boss of Forgo Plains in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and can also be fought in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 刚幻兽 猩猛霸·幻（Phantom Gorimondo） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, now sporting bright cyan and magenta fur with cyan teeth, and eyes that match those of 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） in its "Invasive Species" form.

wikirby-page:56000.name_zh: 宿敌之幻梦 帝帝帝大王·幻
wikirby-page:56000.display_name: 宿敌之幻梦 帝帝帝大王·幻（Phantom King Dedede）
wikirby-page:56000.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56000.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56000.description_zh:
“这个迪迪迪双重体由强大的超能力能量构成。它是国王的幻影，基于在ID-F86控制下其尴尬表现的记忆，被迫为狮王加尔夫（Leongar）工作并捕捉艾菲灵（Elfilin）。它对卡比（Kirby）或他们共同经历的冒险没有记忆……它不过是一个傲慢、空洞的躯壳而已。”
— Figure在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
宿敌之幻梦帝帝帝大王·幻（Phantom King Dedede）中的描述，题为《他的虚幻宿敌》，是帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的一个更强大的幻象形态，在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为Forgo Horns的BOSS出现，也可以在Colosseum的终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中进行战斗。宿敌之幻梦帝帝帝大王·幻（Phantom King Dedede）的外观和战斗方式大部分与它的真实对应物相同，但颜色方案不同，现在拥有运动型的青绿色皮肤，紫色外套，青色绒毛和品红色羽毛及腰带，眼睛与侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）在其“入侵物种”形态下的眼睛相匹配。
wikirby-page:56000.description_en:
“This Dedede double is made of powerful psychic energy. It's an illusion of the king based on memories of his embarrassing turn under ID-F86's control, forced to work for 狮王加尔夫（Leongar） and capture 艾菲灵（Elfilin）. It has no memory of 卡比（Kirby） or the adventures they've shared... It's little more than a haughty, hollow husk.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
宿敌之幻梦 帝帝帝大王·幻（Phantom King Dedede）, titled His Illusory Nemesis, is a more powerful illusory form of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） which appears as the boss of Forgo Horns in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and can also be fought in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 宿敌之幻梦 帝帝帝大王·幻（Phantom King Dedede） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, now sporting teal skin with a purple coat with cyan fluff and magenta feathers and belt, and eyes that match those of 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） in its "Invasive Species" form.

wikirby-page:56394.name_zh: 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻
wikirby-page:56394.name_en: The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight
wikirby-page:56394.display_name: 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）
wikirby-page:56394.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56394.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56394.description_zh:
“你在《遗忘之梦》之外遇到的孤独虚幻敌人。当侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）试图像控制帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）那样控制魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）时，有经验的剑士凭借纯粹的意志力获得了胜利……但结果却是这个神秘的替身，由残留的心灵能量形成！”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
孤高的幻梦魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）的描述，题为《孤独幻影》，是一个更强大的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的虚幻复制品，只在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的Colosseum及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为秘密Boss出现。孤高的幻梦魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）的外观和战斗方式与真实对手大致相同，但拥有不同的霓虹配色——现在拥有翡翠般的皮肤和肩甲，以及粉红色的面具和闪烁的眼睛，这些眼睛会在从粉色变为红色，然后变为白色。

如其图示所示，孤高的幻梦魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）并不是由侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）直接创造的，这与其他幻影Boss不同，因为它们无法像控制帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）那样控制魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）；这为其“孤独的幻影”称号增添了一层额外的意义。除此之外，孤高的幻梦魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）是在Colosseum的梦幻版中战斗的，这暗示它可能是基于魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）的记忆而非侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）（因为它们在那里从未直接战斗过）。当被击败时，它的面具像真实的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）一样破碎，但随后会爆炸而不是逃跑。
wikirby-page:56394.description_en:
“The lone illusory foe that you encountered outside of Forgo Dreams. When 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） tried to control 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） like it had 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）, the experienced swordsman came out on top through sheer force of will...but the result was this mysterious doppelgänger, formed by the residual psychic energy!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight）, titled The Lone Illusion, is a more powerful illusory copy of 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） which appears as a secret boss fought exclusively in the Colosseum in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different neon color scheme—now sporting jade skin and pauldrons as well as a salmon pink mask and strobe eyes that shift in from pink to red and then white.

As indicated by its figure description, 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight） was not directly created by 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）, unlike the other phantom bosses, because they could not control 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） like they did with 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）; this adds an extra layer of meaning to its title of "the lone illusion". Adding to this, 孤高的幻梦 魅塔骑士·幻（The Lone Illusion, Phantom Meta Knight） is fought in a dreamlike version of the Colosseum, suggesting that it may be based on 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）'s memories rather than 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）'s (as they are never directly fought there). When defeated, its mask breaks like the real 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）, but it explodes afterwards instead of fleeing.

wikirby-page:56034.name_zh: 舞幻甲兽 犰魔乱舞·幻
wikirby-page:56034.display_name: 舞幻甲兽 犰魔乱舞·幻（Armor-Plated Illusion, Phantom Sillydillo）
wikirby-page:56034.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:56034.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:56034.description_zh:
“由强大的心灵能量形成，并根据他在现实世界中的特定记忆建模，这个舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）的幻影副本将永远在虚空梦境中徘徊，四处寻找艾菲灵（Elfilin）和卡比（Kirby）……至少它的舞蹈动作仍然令人印象深刻！”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
舞幻甲兽犰魔乱舞·幻（Armor-Plated Illusion, Phantom Sillydillo）（标题为装甲幻象），它是舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）更强大的幻象形态，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）中的Forgo Wasteland及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Boss位置，也可以在Colosseum中的终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中进行战斗。舞幻甲兽犰魔乱舞·幻（Armor-Plated Illusion, Phantom Sillydillo）的外观和战斗方式与其真实对应物基本相同，但拥有不同的配色，现在有粉色的毛发、品红色的爪子和鼻子，以及绿色壳体，眼睛与侵略种菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo）在其“入侵物种”形态下的眼睛相匹配。
wikirby-page:56034.description_en:
“Formed from strong psychic energy and modeled on specific memories of his role in the real world, this phantom copy of 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo） will forever wander Forgo Dreams, searching high and low for 艾菲灵（Elfilin） and 卡比（Kirby）... At least its dance moves are still impressive!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
舞幻甲兽 犰魔乱舞·幻（Armor-Plated Illusion, Phantom Sillydillo） (titled Armor-Plated Illusion) is a more powerful illusory form of 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo） which appears as the boss of Forgo Wasteland in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and can also be fought in both The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 舞幻甲兽 犰魔乱舞·幻（Armor-Plated Illusion, Phantom Sillydillo） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, now having pink fur, magenta claws and nose, a green shell, and eyes that match those of 侵略种 菲克特·遗忘（Invasive Species, Fecto Forgo） in its "Invasive Species" form.

wikirby-page:55954.name_zh: 幻国树 热带大树·幻
wikirby-page:55954.display_name: 幻国树 热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）
wikirby-page:55954.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:55954.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:55954.description_zh:
“这种以南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）形式存在的幻影在Forgo Dreams虚幻的阳光下神秘地变得强大。你认为它的椰子也是幻觉吗？真想知道它们的味道……”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻国树热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）的描述，标题为《幻影叶》，是南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）的一种更强大的幻影形式，它作为Forgo Bay在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的BOSS出现，也可以在Colosseum的终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中进行战斗。幻国树热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）的外观和战斗方式与其真实对应物大致相同，但颜色方案不同，叶子部分尤其具有明亮的紫色和紫红色点缀。
wikirby-page:55954.description_en:
“This phantom in the form of 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） has grown mysteriously strong under the illusory sunlight of Forgo Dreams. Do you think its coconuts are illusions too? Wonder what they taste like...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
幻国树 热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）, titled Illusory Fronds, is a more powerful illusory form of 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） which appears as the boss of Forgo Bay in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, and can also be fought in The Ultimate Cup Z and The Ultimate Cup Z EX in the Colosseum. 幻国树 热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods） looks and fights largely the same as its real counterpart, but has a different color scheme, with bright purple and magenta accents, particularly on its foliage.

wikirby-page:53895.name_zh: 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞
wikirby-page:53895.display_name: 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）
wikirby-page:53895.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53895.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53895.description_zh:
“舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）是一个令人难以置信的舞者……只要舞蹈涉及旋转。这是一个夜行性生物，所以它在黑暗中能看得相当清楚。它似乎接到了老板的命令去寻找某些重要的东西，但它带回家的都是垃圾！它本来要找的是什么来着？某个……小的？还能漂浮的？嗯……”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）的描述，标题为装甲步舞者，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的一个头目，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，作为Beast Pack执行委员会的成员，在Originull Wasteland的最后阶段Collector in the Sleepless Valley中战斗。它是一种大型的犰狳状生物，脸部有卡通特征，手臂细长，爪子上有大爪子。由街头标志制成的铠甲标记可以在其背部的外壳上看到，它通过蜷缩起来滚向卡比（Kirby）来进行攻击。正如它巢穴里堆积的物品所显示的，舞转甲兽犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）喜欢收集来自新世界的各种物品。它有制作人偶的习惯，包括三个类似卡比（Kirby）的人偶，这些人偶悬挂在它的战斗场地上，它也是游戏中所有卡比（Kirby）和艾菲灵（Elfilin）通缉海报的制作人。
wikirby-page:53895.description_en:
“舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo） is an incredible dancer...as long as the dance involves spinning. It's a nocturnal critter, so it can see quite well in the dark. It seems to have orders from its boss to find something important, but all it brings home is junk! What was it supposed to find again? Something...small? And floaty? Hmm...”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo）, titled Armor-Plated Prancer, is a boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, appearing in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） as a member of the Beast Pack's executive council, fought at the end of Originull Wasteland in the stage Collector in the Sleepless Valley. It is a large armadillo-like creature with cartoonish features on its face, thin arms, and large claws on its paws. Plated markings made from street signs can be seen attached to its outer shell on its back, and it attacks by curling up and rolling towards 卡比（Kirby） in combat. As evidenced by the hoard of objects in its lair, 舞转甲兽 犰魔乱舞（Armor-Plated Prancer, Sillydillo） likes to collect things from around the new world. It has a habit of creating puppets, including three puppets resembling 卡比（Kirby）, which are suspended above its battle arena, and is also the one responsible for making all of the wanted posters of 卡比（Kirby） and 艾菲灵（Elfilin） seen throughout the game.

wikirby-page:53334.display_name: 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）
wikirby-page:53334.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现
wikirby-page:53334.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
wikirby-page:53334.description_zh:
“新鲜的海洋空气和温暖的阳光帮助南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）健壮成长。它巨大椰子掉落时会引发大爆炸。它也有不会爆炸的椰子，据说非常美味！很少有人真正尝过……但很多人尝试过。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）的描述，标题为《不友好的叶片》，是星之卡比系列（Kirby series）中的一个Boss，它首次亮相于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并在其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中回归。它是风语大树（Whispy Woods）家族的热带衍生版本，外形像棕榈树和菠萝，具有球状树干和浓密的叶子。它的嘴下方还有一小撮由草状纤维形成的胡须。它的一些能力包括利用根部困住卡比（Kirby）并掉落一张网在其面前放置栅栏以进行保护。

南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）作为Everbay Coast的BOSS出场，在阶段The Tropical Terror中进行战斗。正如对植物而言理所当然的，并且在2022年6月《任天堂梦想》杂志关于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）的开发者采访中由Shinya Kumazaki确认，南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）不是Beast Pack的成员，“……虽然它与[他们]相识……”。因此，与其他BOSS不同，南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）不会在Redgar Forbidden Lands中再次战斗。

南国树热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）还会在Colosseum的魅塔骑士（Meta Knight）杯赛和终极杯中面对。它在孤立的Forgo Dreams群岛、终极杯Z和终极杯Z EX中有一个更强的变体，称为幻国树热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）。
wikirby-page:53334.description_en:
“Fresh ocean air and warm sunlight helped 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） grow big and strong. Its giant coconuts will cause big explosions after they drop. It has nonexploding coconuts too, and they're supposed to be delicious! Few have ever tasted them...but many have tried.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods）, titled Unfriendly Fronds, is a boss in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）, making its debut in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and returning in its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is a tropical spin-off of the 风语大树（Whispy Woods） family, resembling both a palm tree and a pineapple with its bulbous trunk and dense foliage. It also has a small soul patch beard made of grass-like fibers under its mouth. Some of its abilities include using its roots to entrap 卡比（Kirby） and dropping a mesh fence in front of its face for protection.

南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） appears as the boss of Everbay Coast, being fought in the stage The Tropical Terror. As might be expected for a plant, and as confirmed by Shinya Kumazaki in the developer interview for 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） in the June 2022 issue of Nintendo Dream Magazine, 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） is not a member of the Beast Pack, "...although it is acquainted with [them]..." As such, unlike other bosses, 南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） is not refought in the Redgar Forbidden Lands.

南国树 热带大树（Unfriendly Fronds, Tropic Woods） is also faced in the Colosseum's 魅塔骑士（Meta Knight） Cup and The Ultimate Cup. It has a stronger variant in the isolated isles of Forgo Dreams, The Ultimate Cup Z, and The Ultimate Cup Z EX called 幻国树 热带大树·幻（Illusory Fronds, Phantom Tropic Woods）.

wikirby-form:58588.display_work: 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）
wikirby-form:58588.description_zh: 果凍（Jelly）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），可以将卡比（Kirby）变成一团无定形的凝胶。这种能力首次出现在卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet），并且可以通过位于Food Box中的摆动的果凍（Jelly）Copy Food物品获得。它可在竞赛和大逃杀模式中使用，就像卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）中的许多其他Copy能力一样。
wikirby-form:58588.description_en: 果凍（Jelly） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that turns 卡比（Kirby） into an amorphous blob of gelatin. This ability first appeared in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）, and is obtainable from the Jiggling 果凍（Jelly） Copy Food item found in Food Boxes. It is available both in Races and Battle Royales, like with many other Copy Abilities in 卡比的美食节（Kirby's Dream Buffet）.

wikirby-page:79612.debut_work_en: Kirby: Sever Evil with a Slash in a Flash!
wikirby-page:79612.display_work: Kirby: Sever Evil with a Slash in a Flash!
wikirby-page:79612.description_zh: Rokuemon是卡比（Kirby）小说系列中的一个客串角色，他在Kirby: Sever Evil with a Slash in a Flash!中登场，显然作为主要反派。在故事中，他是Dream Village的现任领主，神秘地取代了前任领主，并以多种方式对村民进行对抗。
wikirby-page:79612.description_en: Rokuemon is a guest character featured in the 卡比（Kirby） novel series, and makes his appearance in Kirby: Sever Evil with a Slash in a Flash! as the apparent main antagonist. During the story, he is the current lord of Dream Village who mysteriously replaced the previous lord and started antagonizing the residents of the village in many ways.

wikirby-form:59668.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-form:59668.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-form:59668.description_zh:
“这套机器人装甲已经准备好发射！用你的手臂闪电般击打、燃烧并粉碎敌人，然后准备好你的加农炮，发射满能量的猛烈攻击！”
— 暂停屏幕描述来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
装甲（Mecha）是一款复制能力（Copy Ability），于星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）首发，作为基础游戏的补充，与沙子（Sand）一同首次亮相。拥有此能力时，卡比（Kirby）获得一个带半透明护目镜的未来派头盔，类似于喷射机（Jet）卡比（Kirby）的头盔，同时在背部获得两个机械拳和两个巨型加农炮（也能作为喷气背包使用），整体涂成蓝色。

卡比（Kirby）可以使用这套装备通过背部的加农炮对敌人开火，并用炽热之掌近距离打击敌人，释放一个Sizz-Zap突发，可以照亮黑暗的地方，用火球迫击炮攻击空中的敌人，或者向下放置一个Shock炸弹（Bomb）。该能力还附带一个独特的冲刺和悬停动作，其中卡比（Kirby）使用他的喷气背包。

装甲（Mecha）只能从裝甲機器人（Mechamech）获得，这是一种在重制版中新增的敌人。
wikirby-form:59668.description_en:
“This robotic armor is ready for launch! Zap, burn, and smash foes with your arms, then prep your cannon and fire a fully charged blaaast!”
— Pause screen description from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
装甲（Mecha） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe） as an addition to the base game, making its first appearance along with 沙子（Sand）. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a futuristic helmet with a translucent visor similar to the one for 喷射机（Jet） 卡比（Kirby）, and also gains two mechanical fists and two giant cannons (which also function as a jetpack) on his back which are painted blue.

卡比（Kirby） can use this gear to fire his Blaster Cannon at enemies using the cannons on his back, punch them up close with his Blazing Palm, release a Sizz-Zap Burst that can light up dark places, target skyborne enemies with Fireball Mortars, or place a Shock 炸弹（Bomb） downwards. This ability also comes with a unique dash and hover where 卡比（Kirby） uses his jetpacks.

装甲（Mecha） is exclusively obtained from 裝甲機器人（Mechamech）, a new enemy added in the remake.

wikirby-form:61997.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-form:61997.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-form:61997.description_zh:
“沙子（Sand）可以变成各种形状。握成拳头来击打和抓取，然后通过雕塑一个突然出现的沙堡来终结你的敌人！”
— 沙子（Sand）的暂停画面趣味文本来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
沙子（Sand），它是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），首次亮相于星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe），作为基础游戏的新增内容，并首次与装甲（Mecha）一同亮相。通过这种能力，卡比（Kirby）在头戴带有金字塔形状贴花的头饰上方获得由沙子（Sand）制成的王冠，类似于其他元素复制能力（Copy Ability）帽子，如烈火（Fire）、清水（Water）和电火花（Spark）。

使用沙子（Sand）能力时，卡比（Kirby）可以向敌人投掷沙子（Sand）波，制造尘旋风，生成有伤害的沙堡，甚至可以从远处抓取物品，类似于鞭子（Whip）。这种能力也有一个独特的Guard，类似于叶子（Leaf），其中卡比（Kirby）隐藏在一堆沙子（Sand）中。

沙子（Sand）仅由重制版中的一个新敌人沙德蘭（Sandran）提供。
wikirby-form:61997.description_en:
“沙子（Sand） can be shifted into all kinds of shapes. Form a fist to smash and grab, then finish your foes by sculpting a sudden sandcastle!”
— Pause screen flavor text for 沙子（Sand） from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
沙子（Sand） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe） as an addition to the base game, making its first appearance along with 装甲（Mecha）. With this ability, 卡比（Kirby） gains a crown made of 沙子（Sand） atop a tiara with pyramid-shaped decals on it, similar to other elemental 复制能力（Copy Ability） hats like 烈火（Fire）, 清水（Water）, and 电火花（Spark）.

Using the 沙子（Sand） ability, 卡比（Kirby） can throw 沙子（Sand） waves at enemies, create dust devils, produce a damaging sandcastle, and even grab items from afar, similar to 鞭子（Whip）. This ability also has a unique Guard similar to 叶子（Leaf） where 卡比（Kirby） hides in a pile of 沙子（Sand）.

沙子（Sand） is exclusively provided by 沙德蘭（Sandran）, a new enemy in the remake.

wikirby-variant:5624:lost-magolor.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-variant:5624:lost-magolor.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-variant:5624:lost-magolor.description_zh:
Lost Magolor是魔法洛亚（Magolor）的独立形态或变体，首次登场于《星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）》。
“你好！我的名字是魔法洛亚（Magolor）。我来自另一个维度，但我就是喜欢波普之星（Planet Popstar）。我怎么也玩不够！我刚到的时候情况有点混乱，但现在一切都过去了，多亏了卡比（Kirby）。”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）在New Challenge Stages中的开场对白Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中
魔法洛亚（Magolor）是一只猫咪般的外星魔法师，首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中担任主要反派角色。他来自另一个世界，自称居住在行星Halcandra上，并掌控一艘名为Lor Starcutter的跨维度星际飞船。此后，他在星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的后续游戏中多次登场。魔法洛亚（Magolor）以他矮小的身材、飞行和施展魔法的能力以及他有效（但有时具有欺骗性）的的销售能力。他首次登场之外的重要角色包括：在Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition中主持New Challenge Stages及Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe课程，管理Team Kirby Clash Deluxe和超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）中的the Shoppe，在星之卡比新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）中以Dream Friend身份出现，以及在卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）、星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler和卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中作为可操作角色出现。

在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）的首次亮相中，魔法洛亚（Magolor）将Lor Starcutter撞入Dream Land，并将其零件及Energy Sphere散落在波普之星（Popstar）星球上。卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们通过收集这些零件来帮助魔法洛亚（Magolor）修理飞船，而他通过带领团队前往他的家园Halcandra来表示感谢。一旦到达，他们遭到守护天使龙帝亚（Landia）的攻击，魔法洛亚（Magolor）请求卡比（Kirby）和他的团队击败了龙。然而，当龙帝亚（Landia）被打败时，魔法洛亚（Magolor）偷走了龙的Master Crown——揭示出他一直在寻找这个强大的物品——然后利用它变身成一个可怕的最终Boss，企图统治整个宇宙。在龙帝亚（Landia）的帮助下，卡比（Kirby）和朋友们击败了他。王冠被摧毁，魔法洛亚（Magolor）恢复了原来的状态，并在穿越另一个维度后，最终与卡比（Kirby）和解。
wikirby-variant:5624:lost-magolor.description_en:
Lost Magolor is a distinct form or variant of Magolor in Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe.
“Hi there! My name is 魔法洛亚（Magolor）. I'm from another dimension, but I just love 波普之星（Planet Popstar）. I can't get enough of it! Things got a bit hectic when I first arrived, but that's all in the past, thanks to 卡比（Kirby）.”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s opening dialogue from New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition
魔法洛亚（Magolor） is a cat-like alien magician who first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） as the main antagonist. He is from another world, claims to live on the planet Halcandra, and commands a dimension-crossing starship called the Lor Starcutter. He has since made several appearances in subsequent games in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. 魔法洛亚（Magolor） is defined by his diminutive stature, his ability to fly and cast magical spells, and his effective (but sometimes deceptive) salesmanship. Notable roles beyond his debut appearance include being the host of both New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition and the courses in Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe, running the Shoppe in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, appearing as a Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, and as a playable character in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）s Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler, and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

In his debut in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） crashes the Lor Starcutter into Dream Land and scatters its parts and Energy Spheres all over Planet 波普之星（Popstar）. 卡比（Kirby） and his friends aid 魔法洛亚（Magolor） by collecting these pieces to repair the ship, and he thanks them by taking the group to his homeworld, Halcandra. Once there, they are attacked by the guardian angel 龙帝亚（Landia）, and 魔法洛亚（Magolor） requests that 卡比（Kirby） and his team defeat the dragon. When 龙帝亚（Landia） is beaten, however, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） steals the dragon's Master Crown—revealing that he was after this powerful object the whole time—and then uses it to transform into a menacing final boss, aiming to rule over the entire universe. With help from 龙帝亚（Landia）, 卡比（Kirby） and friends defeat him. The crown is shattered, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） returns to his normal state, and after making his way through another dimension, he eventually makes amends with 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-variant:5624:manager-magolor.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）

wikirby-variant:5624:manager-magolor.description_en:
Manager Magolor is a distinct form or variant of Magolor in Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe.
“Hi there! My name is 魔法洛亚（Magolor）. I'm from another dimension, but I just love 波普之星（Planet Popstar）. I can't get enough of it! Things got a bit hectic when I first arrived, but that's all in the past, thanks to 卡比（Kirby）.”
— 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s opening dialogue from New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition
魔法洛亚（Magolor） is a cat-like alien magician who first appeared in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land） as the main antagonist. He is from another world, claims to live on the planet Halcandra, and commands a dimension-crossing starship called the Lor Starcutter. He has since made several appearances in subsequent games in the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. 魔法洛亚（Magolor） is defined by his diminutive stature, his ability to fly and cast magical spells, and his effective (but sometimes deceptive) salesmanship. Notable roles beyond his debut appearance include being the host of both New Challenge Stages in Kirby's Dream Collection Special Edition and the courses in Dedede's Drum Dash Deluxe, running the Shoppe in Team Kirby Clash Deluxe and 超级卡比猎人队（Super Kirby Clash）, appearing as a Dream Friend in 星之卡比 新星同盟（Kirby Star Allies）, and as a playable character in 卡比群星战２（Kirby Fighters 2）, 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）s Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler, and 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）.

In his debut in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） crashes the Lor Starcutter into Dream Land and scatters its parts and Energy Spheres all over Planet 波普之星（Popstar）. 卡比（Kirby） and his friends aid 魔法洛亚（Magolor） by collecting these pieces to repair the ship, and he thanks them by taking the group to his homeworld, Halcandra. Once there, they are attacked by the guardian angel 龙帝亚（Landia）, and 魔法洛亚（Magolor） requests that 卡比（Kirby） and his team defeat the dragon. When 龙帝亚（Landia） is beaten, however, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） steals the dragon's Master Crown—revealing that he was after this powerful object the whole time—and then uses it to transform into a menacing final boss, aiming to rule over the entire universe. With help from 龙帝亚（Landia）, 卡比（Kirby） and friends defeat him. The crown is shattered, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） returns to his normal state, and after making his way through another dimension, he eventually makes amends with 卡比（Kirby）.

wikirby-variant:5718:cyan-sphere-doomer-.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-variant:5718:cyan-sphere-doomer-.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-variant:5718:cyan-sphere-doomer-.description_zh:
冰球体喽啪EX（Cyan Sphere Doomer EX）是球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）的 EX 版本，首次登场于《星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）》。
“A超能力帮助你进入了这个奇怪的空间，同时一个球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）也从不同的维度飞了进来！它不会让你窃取球体的能量……所以准备迎接攻击吧！”
— VS球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
的描述球毁灭者是一类首次出现在星之卡比Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）中的中级Boss怪。它们是来自Another Dimension的生物，对Energy Sphere有吸引力。球毁灭者通常在许多关卡的跨维度段落结束时遭遇，可以通过使用Super Ability发现的维度裂缝进入。发生在故事模式（Story Mode）或Extra Mode的球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）遭遇总是会产生两个能量球。
wikirby-variant:5718:cyan-sphere-doomer-.description_en:
Cyan Sphere Doomer EX is an EX version of Sphere Doomer in Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe.
“A Super Ability helped you enter this strange space, and a 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） has flown in from a different dimension as well! It won't let you steal the energy of the spheres...so brace for an attack!”
— VS 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） description from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
Sphere Doomers are a collection of mid-bosses first appearing in 星之卡比 Wii（Kirby's Return to Dream Land）. They are creatures from Another Dimension that are attracted to Energy Spheres. Sphere Doomers are usually encountered at the end of interdimensional segments in many stages, which can be entered through dimensional rifts revealed using a Super Ability. A 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer） encounter taking place in 故事模式（Story Mode） or Extra Mode always yields two Energy Spheres.
