wikirby-page:62883.display_name: 仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:62883.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:62883.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:62883.description_zh:
“与仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee）交谈，为每个可玩角色装扮上灵感来自星之卡比系列（Kirby series）的有趣面具。”
— 来自英文星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）网站上的仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee）描述
仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee）是星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中的一个角色。他们在Merry Magoland经营一家纪念品商店，完成Cookie Country - Stage 2后即可进入。他们戴着蓝色蝴蝶结和没有帽檐的蓝色帽子，帽子上有红色和黄色条纹以及一颗白色的星星。如果与他们交谈，他们会提供给卡比（Kirby）和他的朋友们选择戴上Dress-Up Masks或带上Souvenir Item的选项。

在欢乐魔法乐园解锁后，他们可以在Lor Starcutter外找到，在主模式的各个关卡中心，以及在The Arena和The True Arena的大厅中。再次给卡比（Kirby）选择佩戴装扮面具或携带纪念品的机会。
wikirby-page:62883.description_en:
“Talk to 仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee） to dress up each playable character with fun masks inspired by the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）.”
— Description of 仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee） from the English 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe） website
仹手礼店瓦豆鲁迪（Souvenir Shop Waddle Dee） is a character in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. They operate a Souvenir Shop in Merry Magoland, which can be accessed upon completion of Cookie Country - Stage 2. They wear a blue bow tie and a peakless blue cap with both red and yellow stripes, as well as a white star. If spoken to, they will offer 卡比（Kirby） and his friends the option to wear Dress-Up Masks or to take along a Souvenir Item.

After Merry Magoland has been unlocked, they can be found standing outside the Lor Starcutter, in the various level hubs in the Main Mode, and in the lobby for The Arena and The True Arena, once again giving 卡比（Kirby） the option to wear a Dress-Up Mask or to take along a Souvenir Item.

wikirby-page:65199.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:65199.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:65199.description_zh: 裝甲機器人（Mechamech）是一个小型悬浮机器人敌人，首次登场于星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）。它的身体形状类似于秘书苏姿（Susie），但头部两侧有明显的矩形激光炮，并戴着一个橙色圆顶头盔，从中可以发射火球迫击炮。吞下这个敌人会获得装甲（Mecha）复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-page:65199.description_en: 裝甲機器人（Mechamech） is a small hovering robot enemy that debuted in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It has a body shape similar to that of 秘书苏姿（Susie）'s, though with pronounced rectangular laser cannons on the sides of its head and an orange dome helmet, out of which a fireball mortar can be launched. Swallowing this enemy yields the 装甲（Mecha） 复制能力（Copy Ability）.

wikirby-page:65200.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:65200.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:65200.description_zh: 沙德蘭（Sandran）是一个爬行动物敌人，首次登场于星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）。它是黄色的，带有鳞片般的沙质纹理，外形像蜥蜴或龙（带绿色背刺）和海豹（有两条前肢，宽大的尾巴代替后肢）的混合体。沙德蘭（Sandran）会通过向卡比（Kirby）喷沙进行攻击，并在被吸入时赋予沙子（Sand）能力。
wikirby-page:65200.description_en: 沙德蘭（Sandran） is a reptilian enemy that debuted in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. It is yellow with a scaly sand-like texture, resembling a cross between a lizard or a dragon (with its green back spikes) and a seal (with its two limbs, and a wide tail in place of hind limbs). 沙德蘭（Sandran） attacks 卡比（Kirby） by spitting sand in his direction, and yields the 沙子（Sand） ability when inhaled.

wikirby-page:65165.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:65165.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:65165.description_zh:
“所有厄运者的老板已经变成了一个黑翼征服者，由王冠的碎片提供力量……而他正在寻找魔法洛亚（Magolor）的红色果实！这是为了让卡比（Kirby）收集那些船只零件的报复吗？！”
— 对战王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）特别页面
王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer）是星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler的倒数第二个Boss，在Ethereal Altar中战斗。他是伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer）的扭曲版本，由Master Crown的碎片和魔法洛亚（Magolor）重新组合的红色果实提供力量。他可以使用与主游戏对应角色相同的许多攻击，此外还有基于其他Boss的攻击的一系列新招式。魔法洛亚（Magolor）必须在碎片自己与果实结合形成最终Master Crown Boss之前击败这个威胁。
wikirby-page:65165.description_en:
“The boss of all Doomers has become a black-winged subjugator powered by the shards of the crown...and he's after 魔法洛亚（Magolor）'s red fruit! Is this payback for making 卡比（Kirby） gather those ship parts?!”
— VS 王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer） Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer） is the penultimate boss of Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）, fought in the Ethereal Altar. He is a twisted version of 伟大喽啪（Grand Doomer） powered up by the shards of the Master Crown and the red fruit which 魔法洛亚（Magolor） had reassembled. He has access to many of the same attacks as his main game counterpart, in addition to a large array of new ones based on those of other bosses. 魔法洛亚（Magolor） has to fight this menace before the shards themselves combine with the fruit to form the final Master Crown boss.

wikirby-page:63625.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:63625.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:63625.description_zh:
“电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter）将这个维度称为自己的家。由专注的电力诞生，他喜欢表演令人震惊的把戏。作为一个下属，他被告知收集果实碎片以获取它们强大的生命能量。”
— VS电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter）的特别页面是Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler中星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的Aerogree Dimension的老板。他是电力主题的达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）的对应角色，穿着绿黄色配色，更像一个巫师而不是精灵。他的帽子里也有一个灯泡，在他进行各种电力攻击时会亮起，并且他的袖口和其他衣物部位类似齿轮，类似于魔法洛亚（Magolor）本人。击败他后，魔法洛亚（Magolor）将获得一个Fruit Fragment，让他能够使用他的魔法洛亚（Magolor）冲击和魔法洛亚（Magolor）加农炮。

除了在Aerogree Dimension - 1-BOSS面对他之外，他也是The True Arena的对手。
wikirby-page:63625.description_en:
“电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter） calls this dimension his home. Born from focused electricity, he loves to perform shocking tricks. As an underling, he was told to gather Fruit Fragments for their powerful life energy.”
— VS 电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter） Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
电阱达乌塔（Electricky Dooter） is the boss of Aerogree Dimension from Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. He is an electric-themed counterpart to 达乌塔先生（Mr. Dooter）, wearing a green and yellow color scheme and more closely resembling a wizard rather than a djinn. He also has a light bulb inside his hat which lights up during his various electrical attacks and has cuffs and other parts of his clothing which resemble gears, similar to 魔法洛亚（Magolor） himself. Upon defeating him, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） will receive a Fruit Fragment that lets him use his 魔法洛亚（Magolor） Surge and 魔法洛亚（Magolor） Cannon.

In addition to being faced in Aerogree Dimension - 1-BOSS, he is also an opponent in The True Arena.

wikirby-page:64336.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:64336.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:64336.description_zh:
“火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer）是来自这个维度的熔岩野兽。它诞生于元素之热，使用灼热的招式，其威力不仅仅是融化。他还必须把找到的果实碎片带回给他的老板……”
— VS火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer）星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer）的特殊页面是Pyred Dimension在Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler模式下星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的老板。这只喷火的野兽是缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）的火元素对应物。虽然他的外形类似缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer），但火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer）拥有棕色的身体，两只大山羊角，以及身体和背部的许多岩石和熔岩斑点。击败他的奖励是Fruit Fragment以及使用维度消失和致命针刺能力的力量。
wikirby-page:64336.description_en:
“火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer） is a lava beast from this dimension. Born from elemental heat, he uses scorching moves that'll do more than melt. He still has to take the Fruit Fragment he found back to his boss...”
— VS 火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer） Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer） is the boss of the Pyred Dimension in the Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler mode in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. This fire-breathing beast is the fire-themed counterpart to 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）. While his appearance is similar to 缓冲肥肥（Fatty Puffer）, 火山缓冲肥肥（Fiery Puffer） has a brown body with two large goat horns and many rocks and lava spots on the top of his body and back. The reward for defeating him is a Fruit Fragment and the power to use the Dimensional Vanish and Deadly Needles abilities.

wikirby-page:64438.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:64438.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:64438.description_zh:
“流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath）生活在这个维度的海洋中。他由水和冰诞生，强大的格斗动作流畅顺利，毫不费力。他的果实碎片将归他的老板所有——除非你先抢到它！”
— VS流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath）来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath）的特别页面是Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler中星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的Poseiblu Dimension的老板。作为戈力牙斯（Goriath）的水主题对应，他全身覆盖蓝色鳞片，头发是由水形成的。击败他后，魔法洛亚（Magolor）将获得一枚Fruit Fragment，使他能够使用黑洞。
wikirby-page:64438.description_en:
“流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath） lives in the oceans of this dimension. Born from water and ice, his powerful brawler moves flow smoothly and effortlessly. His Fruit Fragment will go to his boss—unless you steal it first!”
— VS 流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath） Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
流水戈力牙斯（Hydriath） is the boss of Poseiblu Dimension from Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. As a water-themed counterpart to 戈力牙斯（Goriath）, he is covered in blue scales and his hair is made of water. Upon defeating him, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） will receive a Fruit Fragment that lets him use his Black Hole.

wikirby-page:71261.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:71261.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:71261.description_zh:
“那些戴上Master Crown的人将获得力量，但他们内心的黑暗也会随之增长。多亏了红色果实，它变成了一圈愤怒的花环——一个被称为无主树冠的毁灭者！”
— VS Master Crown星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的第1阶段特殊页面
Master Crown是星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）中Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler的最终Boss。在这里，王冠掌控了魔法洛亚（Magolor）曾在Ethereal Altar收集的红色果实，这些果实的碎片最初被整合进了王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer）。利用果实的力量，Master Crown变成了一个巨大的树状实体，在战斗的大部分时间都漂浮在背景中。王冠坐落在树干与青绿色树冠交汇处，只有一只眼睛被红色水果的碎片包围着。皇冠环绕在树的树干和树枝上，两条大枝形成了手臂。还有另外两条大枝形成了由叶子组成的两个类似翅膀的结构的顶部，叶子的颜色从绿色渐变到紫色。

Master Crown也作为The True Arena中的倒数第二个对手出现，在那里卡比（Kirby）和其他角色可以与它战斗。
wikirby-page:71261.description_en:
“Those who wear the Master Crown will gain power, but so will the darkness in their hearts. Thanks to the red fruit, it's become a wrathful wreath—a destroyer called the tree crown without a ruler!”
— VS Master Crown Phase 1 Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
The Master Crown serves as the final boss of Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. Here, the crown has taken possession of the red fruit that 魔法洛亚（Magolor） had assembled at the Ethereal Altar, after its pieces were initially incorporated into 王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer）. Using the power of the fruit, the Master Crown turns into a gigantic tree-like entity, which floats in the background for the majority of the fight. The crown sits where the trunk of the tree meets the teal-colored canopy, with a single eye surrounded by fragments of the red fruit. The crown wraps around the tree's trunk and branches, with two large limbs forming arms. Two other large limbs also form the top of two wing-like structures made of leaves that fade from green to purple.

The Master Crown is also faced as the penultimate opponent in The True Arena, where 卡比（Kirby） and other characters can fight it.

wikirby-page:65133.debut_work_en: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe
wikirby-page:65133.display_work: 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
wikirby-page:65133.description_zh:
“这些失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers）来自另一个维度。他们不是在追捕球体，而是有人让他们去寻找果实碎片。等等……我们难道没见过所有末日者的大Boss吗？！”
— VS失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers）特殊页面来自星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
这些失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers）是来自Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler中的星之卡比Wii豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）的Locandra Dimension的Boss。他们是一组四个病态的紫色球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）类生物，长有由Energy Sphere齿轮制成的角，并进行协调攻击，无论飞到哪里都会掉落爆炸星尘云。击败他们后，魔法洛亚（Magolor）将获得一个Fruit Fragment，使他能够进一步提升自己的魔法技能。之后会有更多的他们被王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer）召唤，作为他的Boss战的一部分。
wikirby-page:65133.description_en:
“These 失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers） are from another dimension. Instead of hunting spheres, someone is making them seek Fruit Fragments. Wait...haven't we met the big boss of all Doomers already?!”
— VS 失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers） Special Page from 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）
The 失控喽啪们（Rampaging Doomers） are the boss of Locandra Dimension from Magolor Epilogue: The Interdimensional Traveler in 星之卡比Wii 豪华版（Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe）. They are a group of four sickly purple-colored 球体喽啪（Sphere Doomer）-like creatures who have horns made of Energy Sphere gears and who attack in a coordinated manner, dropping explosive stardust clouds wherever they fly. Upon defeating them, 魔法洛亚（Magolor） will receive a Fruit Fragment that lets him upgrade his magical skills even further. More of them are later summoned by the 王冠喽啪（Crowned Doomer） as part of his boss fight.

wikirby-variant:54190:crystal-awoofy.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:54190:crystal-awoofy.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:54190:crystal-awoofy.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:54190:crystal-awoofy.description_zh:
结晶化加鲁鲁菲（Crystal Awoofy）是加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“A是一种在新大陆到处都能找到的常见野兽。它们非常可爱，但有危险的野性。任何与它们作对的人都会被它们吼叫和扑过去！一大群这种小动物袭击了Waddle Dees。很有趣，你本以为它们会相处得很好！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的描述（复数：Awoofies）是一种橙色的类狐狸生物，首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中回归。它是游戏中最基本的敌人，也是Beast Pack中最常见的成员。它的工作是追捕瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），以便被群体的Clocker捕获。加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的整体形状像一只狐狸，有着大头、短小的四肢和长尾巴。它的主要毛色是橙色；它的前爪、头顶、耳尖和尾尖是红色的；它的口鼻部和腹部是棕褐色的；它的后爪是黄色的；耳朵内部是浅粉色的。它有棕色的眼睛，风格类似于卡比（Kirby）的。虽然主要是四足行走，但Awoofies常常在观察周围或者静止时站立。

加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的总体行为是原地坐着、巡逻某个区域，或者睡觉，直到卡比（Kirby）靠近到它能够发现为止。当这种情况发生时，加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）会以适中的速度追赶卡比（Kirby），试图通过撞击伤害他。加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）可以通过任何方法轻易击败，被吞食后不会给出复制能力（Copy Ability）。Awoofies在被击败时价值一个Star Coin。
wikirby-variant:54190:crystal-awoofy.description_en:
Crystal Awoofy is a crystallized form of Awoofy in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“A common beast that can be found all over the new world. They're pretty cute, but they have a dangerous wild side. They'll growl and jump at anyone who crosses them! A whole bunch of these critters attacked the Waddle Dees. Funny, you'd think they'd get along!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） (plural: Awoofies) is an orange fox-like creature which makes its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and returning in 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is the most basic enemy in the game, and the most common member of the Beast Pack. Its job is to chase down 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s so they can be captured by the pack's Clockers. 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） takes on the general shape of a fox with a large head, stubby limbs, and a long tail. Its main fur color is orange; its front paws, top of the head, tips of the ears, and tip of the tail are red; its muzzle and underbelly are tan; its hind paws are yellow; the inside of its ears are light pink. It has brown eyes similar in style to 卡比（Kirby）'s. Though primarily quadrupedal, Awoofies can often be seen standing upright when looking around or holding still.

加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）'s general behavior is to sit in place, patrol a given area, or sleep until 卡比（Kirby） gets close enough for it to spot him. When this happens, 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） responds by running after 卡比（Kirby） at a modest speed, aiming to hurt him by collision. 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy） can be easily defeated with any method, and gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. Awoofies are worth one Star Coin when defeated.

wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.display_name: 结晶化弹跳蝴蝶结（Crystal Bouncy）
wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.description_zh:
结晶化弹跳蝴蝶结（Crystal Bouncy）是弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“每个人都知道弹力球喜欢弹得这么高的唯一原因是因为它们喜欢从空中看到的景色。那里的一切看起来更加……平静。对于Bouncys来说，每一天都是美好的一天。没人能阻止他们！”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）在Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）中的雕像描述，最初称为弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）Ty（双关语“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）”）玩具”、“弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）领带”，或者只是拼写错误），是在星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）中首次亮相的敌人。她是一个粉红色的、有弹性的、像玩具一样的生物，戴着一条淡红色的丝带，有两只圆圆的眼睛，弹簧上方有一个红色的座位。正如她的名字一样，弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）不断弹跳，尽管有时她可能会向前跳跃并试图踩踏卡比（Kirby）。弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）吸入时不会产生复制能力（Copy Ability）。
wikirby-variant:1268:crystal-bouncy.description_en:
Crystal Bouncy is a crystallized form of Bouncy in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“Everyone knows the only reason Bouncys like to bounce so high is 'cause they like the view from up in the air. Things just seem more...peaceful up there. Every day is a good day to Bouncys. No one's gonna keep 'em down!”
— 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）'s figurine description in Kirby and the Rainbow Curse
弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy）, originally known as 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Ty (either a pun on "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Toy", "弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） Tie", or simply a misspelling), is an enemy debuting in 星之卡比2（Kirby's Dream Land 2）. She is a pink, springy, toy-like creature that wears a pale red ribbon, has two beady eyes and a red seat above her spring. Fitting to her name, 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） continually bounces, although sometimes she may leap forward attempting to stomp 卡比（Kirby）. 弹跳蝴蝶结（Bouncy） gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） when inhaled.

wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.display_name: 结晶化天鹅罗利那（Crystal Fleurina）
wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.description_zh:
结晶化天鹅罗利那（Crystal Fleurina）是天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）在攻击时总是展示出优雅的表演。不要被她的表演迷住，否则你会被她的龙卷风卷进去！她对舞蹈事业非常投入，把每一场战斗都看作一堂新的课程。（这让她始终保持警觉。）”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅罗利那（Fleurina），她是一个拟人化的天鹅形芭蕾舞者，以中期Boss和Beast Pack成员身份首次登场于星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并且是游戏中唯一一个没有基于星之卡比系列（Kirby series）现有中期Boss设计的中期Boss。她通过旋转自己并伴随强风攻击，同时发射龙卷风射击。恰如其分的是，她在被击败后会给予龙卷风（Tornado）复制能力（Copy Ability），并且也是系列做到这一点。天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado）的能力基于天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）。

在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Star-Crossed World故事中以及在《终极杯Z EX》中，天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）从流星雨的影响中获得增强，她的头部和衣服上有各种晶体；这种特殊形态被命名为水晶天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）。
wikirby-variant:54944:crystal-fleurina.description_en:
Crystal Fleurina is a crystallized form of Fleurina in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） always puts on an elegant show when she attacks. Don't get too caught up in her performance, or you'll get caught up in her tornado to match! She's very dedicated to her dance career and thinks of every battle as a new lesson. (They keep her on her toes.)”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） is an anthropomorphic swan-like ballerina who makes her debut as a mid-boss and member of the Beast Pack in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and is the only mid-boss in the game that is not based on a pre-existing mid-boss from the 星之卡比系列（Kirby series）. She attacks by twirling herself along with gale force and throwing out tornado projectiles. Fittingly, she gives the 龙卷风（Tornado） 复制能力（Copy Ability） when defeated and is also the first mid-boss in the series to do so. The 天鹅龙卷风（Fleur Tornado） ability is based on 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）.

In the 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）'s Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on her head and dress; this particular form is named Crystal 天鹅罗利那（Fleurina）.

wikirby-form:80548.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-form:80548.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-form:80548.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-form:80548.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿越神秘漩涡后获得了强大的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力。当他在陨石坠落的区域找到一个大齿轮并把它塞进嘴里时，他可以滚动并攀爬物体——甚至是墙壁。在贴着墙壁时，随着令人满意的咔嗒咔嗒声移动！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
齿轮塞满嘴（Gear Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）独有的星耀体（Starry）关卡，出现在Star-Crossed World部分的星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它涉及卡比（Kirby）缠绕在齿轮上，使他能够滚动并贴在墙上，跳跃在墙之间。齿轮塞满嘴（Gear Mouth）通常用于关卡中爬墙并利用齿轮撞击向前移动。
wikirby-form:80548.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the powerful 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through a mysterious vortex. When he finds a large gear in an area where meteors have fallen and stuffs it in his mouth, he can roll along and climb objects—even walls. While sticking to a wall, move along with a satisfying click-clack-click!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
齿轮塞满嘴（Gear Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） exclusive to the 星耀体（Starry） Stages present in the Star-Crossed World portion of 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a gear, allowing him to roll around and stick into walls and jump between them. 齿轮塞满嘴（Gear Mouth） is generally used in stages to climb walls and move forward with the use of its Gear Tackle.

wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.display_name: 结晶化原始加鲁鲁菲（Crystal Primal Awoofy）
wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.description_zh:
结晶化原始加鲁鲁菲（Crystal Primal Awoofy）是原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“原始荒地是野兽族的诞生地，所以那里发现的Awoofies比遥远地区的同类更为野性也就不足为奇了。它们在各方面都更加具有攻击性，从吠叫到咬合力都有所增强。它们的原始祖先一定会感到欣慰！”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的描述是，一种类狼生物首次出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land），并且是常见加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）的一个变种。它们首次与帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）一起出现在An Unexpected Beast King，并且之后的关卡中也能找到它们，主要取代了标准Awoofies。与其橙色对手不同，这些Beast Pack的成员呈灰褐色和白色；它们体型更大，毛发更蓬松。像Awoofies一样，Primal Awoofies主要以四足行走为主，但在四处张望或保持静止时，经常可以看到它们直立站立。

原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的一般行为是坐在原地、巡逻指定区域，或一直睡觉直到卡比（Kirby）靠得够近以便它能发现他。当这种情况发生时，原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）会以适中的速度追赶卡比（Kirby），试图通过碰撞伤害他。Redgar Forbidden Lands内的一些成员会担任警戒，一旦发现卡比（Kirby）就会嚎叫并呼唤其他敌人（在The Beast Pack's Final Stand中这样做的只会在攻击时进行）。原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的生命值比普通同类更高，但仍然可以轻易被吸入，尽管被吞下后仍然不会提供复制能力（Copy Ability）。原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的价值为one Star Coin被击败时。

在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，一个名为Crystal原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）的更强变种出现于Star-Crossed World，与普通的原始Awoofies一起。
wikirby-variant:55239:crystal-primal-awo.description_en:
Crystal Primal Awoofy is a crystallized form of Primal Awoofy in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“Originull Wasteland is the birthplace of the Beast Pack, so it's no wonder the Awoofies found there are more wild than their far-off cousins. They're more aggressive in every way, from their bark to their bite. Their primal ancestors must be pleased!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） is a wolf-like creature which makes its first appearance in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, and is a variant of the common 加鲁鲁菲（Awoofy）. They make their first appearance alongside 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） in An Unexpected Beast King, and can be found in stages thereafter, largely replacing standard Awoofies. As opposed to their orange counterparts, these members of the Beast Pack are grayish-brown and white; they are also larger, with scruffier fur. Like Awoofies, Primal Awoofies are primarily quadrupedal, but can often be seen standing upright when looking around or holding still.

原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy）'s general behavior is to sit in place, patrol a given area, or sleep until 卡比（Kirby） gets close enough for it to spot him. When this happens, 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） responds by running after 卡比（Kirby） at a modest speed, aiming to hurt him by collision. Some members within the Redgar Forbidden Lands will function as lookouts which will proceed to howl and call for additional enemies should they spot 卡比（Kirby） (the one that does so in The Beast Pack's Final Stand simply does so attacking). 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） has more health than its normal counterpart, but it can still be inhaled easily, though it still gives no 复制能力（Copy Ability） if swallowed. 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） is worth one Star Coin when defeated.

In 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, a stronger variant of 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） called Crystal 原始加鲁鲁菲（Primal Awoofy） appears in Star-Crossed World alongside regular Primal Awoofies.

wikirby-variant:54685:crystal-rabiroo.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:54685:crystal-rabiroo.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:54685:crystal-rabiroo.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:54685:crystal-rabiroo.description_zh:
结晶化拉比兔（Crystal Rabiroo）是拉比兔（Rabiroo）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“小的那个？那是拉比兔（Rabiroo）。大的那个？那是大拉比兔（Orabiroo）。O代表“哦天啊，看看它们能跳得多高！”当它们着陆时尽量不要在它们下面。它们的同伴生物喜欢抚摸它们，因为它们非常毛茸茸。（不要碰尾巴。它们讨厌那个。）”
— Figure对“拉比兔（Rabiroo）&大拉比兔（Orabiroo）”的描述来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拉比兔（Rabiroo）是一种浅蓝色的兔子状敌人，是Beast Pack的成员，拥有从嘴部延伸出来的长耳状附属物，出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。它通常要么原地坐着，要么持续上下跳动，直到发现卡比（Kirby），然后追着他跳，希望通过碰撞进行攻击。有时，Rabiroos会按照设定模式持续跳跃并如果卡比（Kirby）靠近它们，它们不会改变行为。拉比兔（Rabiroo）并不特别快或具有威胁性，很容易被卡比（Kirby）的吸入或其他攻击击败，击败后可以获得一个Star Coin。吞下拉比兔（Rabiroo）不会获得任何能力。

拉比兔（Rabiroo）有一个更大、更危险的近亲，名为大拉比兔（Orabiroo），它们的外形相似。此外，拉比兔（Rabiroo）的水晶变体会出现在Star-Crossed World星耀体（Starry）关卡中，和普通的Rabiroos一起出现。
wikirby-variant:54685:crystal-rabiroo.description_en:
Crystal Rabiroo is a crystallized form of Rabiroo in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“The little one? That's 拉比兔（Rabiroo）. The big one? That's 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）. The O is for, "OH my gosh, look at how high they can jump!" Try not to be under one when they land. Their fellow critters like to pet them because they're so fluffy. (Don't touch the tail. They hate that.)”
— Figure description for "拉比兔（Rabiroo） & 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）" from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
拉比兔（Rabiroo） is a light blue rabbit-like enemy and member of the Beast Pack with long ear-like appendages stemming from its snout, appearing in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It tends to either sit in place or hop up and down continuously until it spots 卡比（Kirby）, from there hopping after him, hoping to attack by collision. Sometimes, Rabiroos continuously hop in set patterns and don't change their behavior if 卡比（Kirby） gets near them. 拉比兔（Rabiroo） is not particularly quick or threatening, can be easily defeated by 卡比（Kirby）'s inhale or another attack, and is worth one Star Coin on defeat. 拉比兔（Rabiroo） grants no ability if swallowed.

拉比兔（Rabiroo） has a larger and more dangerous cousin named 大拉比兔（Orabiroo）, which it shares its figure with. Additionally, a Crystal variant of 拉比兔（Rabiroo） appear alongside regular Rabiroos in the Star-Crossed World 星耀体（Starry） Stages.

wikirby-form:80565.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-form:80565.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-form:80565.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-form:80565.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在穿过一个神秘的漩涡后获得了强大的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力。当他在陨石落下的区域发现一个标志物并将其塞入口中时，他可以像滑板一样滑行。他沿着前进，扬起雪和沙子，并且可以通过旋转撞击来加速。”
— Figure对星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
看板塞满嘴（Sign Mouth）的描述是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）在星耀体（Starry）关卡中独有的，这些关卡位于星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Star-Crossed World部分。它包括卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个标志物上，从而允许他沿着长坡滑下。在这些滑行的环节中，卡比（Kirby）无法丢弃标志物，并且不断前进。在滑行过程中，卡比（Kirby）可以向左或向右转向、跳跃，并且可以使用“旋转铲球”进行攻击。要想在不受伤的情况下击败敌人或突破障碍物，他需要使用这个招式。
wikirby-form:80565.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the powerful 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through a mysterious vortex. When he finds a sign in an area where meteors have fallen and stuffs it in his mouth, he can sliiide around in the shape of a board. He moves along, kicking up snow and sand, and he can pick up speed with Spin Tackles.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
看板塞满嘴（Sign Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） exclusive to the 星耀体（Starry） Stages present in the Star-Crossed World portion of 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a sign, allowing him to slide down long slopes. During these sliding sections, 卡比（Kirby） cannot discard the sign, and constantly moves forward. While sliding, 卡比（Kirby） can steer left and right, jump, and can attack using the "Spin Tackle". This move is required for him to defeat enemies without taking damage or bust through obstacles.

wikirby-form:78604.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-form:78604.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-form:78604.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-form:78604.description_zh:
“卡比（Kirby）在飞过一个神秘的漩涡后获得了强大的塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）能力。当他在陨石坠落的区域找到一个大弹簧并把它塞进嘴里时，他可以跳得超级高！像蹦蹦蹦那样高！然后，在他空中时，他可以猛烈地砸下去，像ker-SLAM！”
— Figure由星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
弹簧塞满嘴（Spring Mouth）描述，是塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode）在星耀体（Starry）舞台中独有的能力，这些舞台出现在Star-Crossed World部分星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，涉及卡比（Kirby）将自己缠绕在一个弹簧上，使他持续反弹。在使用这种模式时，卡比（Kirby）可以进行一次特别高的跳跃，以跨越平台之间的大间隙，或在空中砸下去以打破破碎的地面和水晶，并击败他下面的敌人。
wikirby-form:78604.description_en:
“卡比（Kirby） gained the powerful 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） ability after he flew through a mysterious vortex. When he finds a large spring in an area where meteors have fallen and stuffs it in his mouth, he can jump super high! Like boing-boing high! Then, while he's aloft, he can smash down like ker-SLAM!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
弹簧塞满嘴（Spring Mouth） is a 塞满嘴（Mouthful Mode） exclusive to the 星耀体（Starry） Stages present in the Star-Crossed World portion of 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） that involves 卡比（Kirby） wrapping himself around a spring, forcing him to bounce continuously. While using this mode, 卡比（Kirby） can make one especially high jump to conquer large gaps between platforms or smash down in the air to break cracked ground and crystals, and defeat enemies below him.

wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.display_name: 结晶化狂野锤星猩（Crystal Wild Bonkers）
wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.description_zh:
结晶化狂野锤星猩（Crystal Wild Bonkers）是狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“神秘的漩涡也把锤星猩（Bonkers）带到了新世界！他们比卡比（Kirby）先到达，并迅速加入了可怕的野兽军团。他们非常喜欢自己的新形象，并且与所有新同事相处融洽……尤其是Mookies！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）的描述，是锤星猩（Bonkers）的一个变体，它出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为中级Boss。他们与普通同类相似，但毛发凌乱呈蓝色，手臂和脸上有战斗彩绘。他们还使用石凿作为锤子，并丢掷榴莲而不是椰子。狂野锤子（Wild Hammer）的能力基于狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）。

在任天堂Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事以及《终极Cup Z EX，锤星猩（Bonkers）在流星雨的影响下获得了能量，身体上覆盖着各种水晶，还挥舞着水晶锤，毛发呈粉色和紫色混合；这种特定形态称为水晶狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）。奇怪的是，水晶狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）以及锤星猩（Bonkers）和牧吱斯（Mookie）的EX人物描述中使用了男性代词“他/他的”来指代他们，而游戏中的其他地方使用的是性别中性的“他们/他们的”。
wikirby-variant:54854:crystal-wild-bonke.description_en:
Crystal Wild Bonkers is a crystallized form of Wild Bonkers in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“The mysterious vortex brought 锤星猩（Bonkers） to the new world too! They arrived before 卡比（Kirby） and quickly joined the ranks of the fearsome Beast Pack. They really like their new look, and they're getting along with all of their new coworkers...especially the Mookies!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers） is a variant of 锤星猩（Bonkers） who appears as a mid-boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They resemble their normal counterpart, but with frazzled bluish fur and war paint on their arms and face. They also wield a stone chisel for a hammer and throw durians instead of coconuts. The 狂野锤子（Wild Hammer） ability is based on 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 锤星猩（Bonkers） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on their body in addition to wielding a crystal hammer and having their fur be a mixture of pink and purple; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers）. Strangely, the EX figure descriptions for both Crystal 狂野锤星猩（Wild Bonkers） and 锤星猩（Bonkers） & 牧吱斯（Mookie） refer to them with masculine "he/him" pronouns instead of the gender-neutral "they/them" elsewhere in the game.

wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.display_name: 结晶化狂野刃（Crystal Wild Edge）
wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.description_zh:
结晶化狂野刃（Crystal Wild Edge）是狂野刃（Wild Edge）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“神秘的漩涡也把庞大刃（Gigant Edge）带到了新世界！他们比卡比（Kirby）先到，并加入了野兽团的队伍。尽管换上了野性的服装，他们在团队中仍然非常醒目，但他们仍会以凶猛守护自己的岗位！”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野刃（Wild Edge）的描述，是庞大刃（Gigant Edge）的一个变体，在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中作为中型头目出现。他们与普通同类相似，但铠甲上有战争彩绘，脖子周围戴着毛领。他们还挥舞着一把石剑和一面带刺的防暴盾。庞大利剑（Gigant Sword）的能力基于狂野刃（Wild Edge）。

在Nintendo Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事中以及《The Ultimate Cup Z EX》中，庞大刃（Gigant Edge）在流星雨的影响下获得能量，并且他们的盔甲上有各种水晶，同时颜色比平时更浅；这一特定形态被命名为Crystal狂野刃（Wild Edge）。奇怪的是，Crystal狂野刃（Wild Edge）的EX人物描述在游戏其他地方使用中性'they/them'代词时，却使用了男性'he/him'代词来称呼他们。
wikirby-variant:54221:crystal-wild-edge.description_en:
Crystal Wild Edge is a crystallized form of Wild Edge in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“The mysterious vortex brought 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） to the new world too! They arrived before 卡比（Kirby） and fell in with the ranks of the Beast Pack. Despite the wild wardrobe change, they really stand out among the rest of the pack, but they'll still guard their stations with ferocity!”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野刃（Wild Edge） is a variant of 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） who appears as a mid-boss in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They resemble their normal counterpart, but with war paint on their armor and a fur collar around their neck. They also wield a stone sword and a spiky riot shield. The 庞大利剑（Gigant Sword） ability is based on 狂野刃（Wild Edge）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 庞大刃（Gigant Edge） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals on their armor while also being lighter-colored than usual; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野刃（Wild Edge）. Strangely, Crystal 狂野刃（Wild Edge）'s EX figure description refers to them with masculine "he/him" pronouns instead of the gender-neutral "they/them" elsewhere in the game.

wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.display_name: 结晶化狂野冰霜（Crystal Wild Frosty）
wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.description_zh:
结晶化狂野冰霜（Crystal Wild Frosty）是狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的结晶化形态，首次登场于《星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）》。
“神秘的漩涡也将冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）带到了新世界！他在卡比（Kirby）到达前不久就来了，并立即加入了野兽队。（服装的变化一定让这个选择变得很容易。）作为新来的确实很难，但他的同伴们很喜欢与他合作。”
— Figure来自星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的描述是冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）的一个变体，他属于Beast Pack，并出现在星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）及其星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中，在游戏中担任中级Boss。他的外观与常规版本相似，但要大得多，且更加凌乱邋遢：他的工装裤破烂不堪，手和脸上有蓝色的毛发条纹或可能是战斗彩绘，并且他有一把大蓝胡子。他的上唇是也部分冻结，挂着像尖牙的冰柱。他通过制造和投掷不同大小的雪球以及雪人来攻击。他还会试图压碎卡比（Kirby）并追击，有时还能成功吃掉他。卡比（Kirby）的其中一个Evolved Copy Abilities——冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）——是基于狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）的。在任天堂Switch 2版的Star-Crossed World故事以及终极杯Z EX中，冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty）受到流星雨的影响而增强，身体上布满了各种水晶；这一特殊形态被命名为水晶狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）。
wikirby-variant:53927:crystal-wild-frost.description_en:
Crystal Wild Frosty is a crystallized form of Wild Frosty in Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World.
“The mysterious vortex brought 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） to the new world too! He arrived shortly before 卡比（Kirby） and immediately joined the Beast Pack. (The change in wardrobe must have made it an easy choice.) It's tough to be the new guy, but his fellow beasts love working with him.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）
狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty） is a variant of 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） who belongs to the Beast Pack and appears in 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land） and its 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）, serving as a mid-boss in that game. He is similar in appearance to his regular counterpart, but much larger, and with a more disheveled and unkempt appearance: his overalls are torn up, he has blue streaks of fur or possibly warpaint on his hands and face, and he has a large blue beard. His upper lip is also partially frozen, with hanging icicles that resemble sharp teeth. He attacks by creating and tossing different sizes of snowballs, as well as snowmen. He also will attempt to crush 卡比（Kirby） and dash after him, sometimes managing to eat him. One of 卡比（Kirby）'s Evolved Copy Abilities—冰霜冰冻（Frosty Ice）—is based on 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）.

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition's Star-Crossed World story and in The Ultimate Cup Z EX, 冰霜先生（Mr. Frosty） gets powered up from the meteor shower's influence and has various crystals all over his body; this particular form is named Crystal 狂野冰霜（Wild Frosty）.

wikirby-page:80509.display_name: 天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:80509.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-page:80509.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-page:80509.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-page:80509.description_zh:
“天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）对研究充满热情，特别是传奇陨石研究。因此，他和其他Waddle Dees一起赶往火山岛。他的爱好包括收集闪亮的硬币和手办，以及与他的好朋友兼研究伙伴知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）聚会。”
— Figure的描述来自星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee），他是一个只出现在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中的角色。他是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），戴着带有星星装饰的紫色贝雷帽，随身携带望远镜，有时用它来仰望天空。他首次出现是在卡比（Kirby）访问Fallen-Star Volcano时；在那里，他向他，以及艾菲灵（Elfilin）和头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）（如果在场），讲解了Star of Darkness的传说以及落在新世界。一旦他们都意识到封印陨石的关键是星耀体（Starry），卡比（Kirby）便开始踏上旅程，开始Star-Crossed World.

一旦卡比（Kirby）清除了Lost in Alivel Mall，就可以在Waddle Dee Town的长椅上找到天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）。然后他会提供用Starry Coin换取随机EX角色的机会。起初只能抽取Vol.1角色，每个需150星耀体（Starry）币，但在卡比（Kirby）清除Freezing Wind and Some Snowmen后，Vol.2角色将以250星耀体（Starry）币解锁.

一旦完成星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的所有独占内容的100%进度，与天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）对话将触发特殊通知和庆典，并奖励第86个也是最后一个EX角色.
wikirby-page:80509.description_en:
“天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） is passionate about research, especially legendary-meteor research. So he rushed to the volcanic island with the other Waddle Dees. His hobbies include collecting shiny coins and figures and catching up with his good pal and research partner 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） is a character who appears exclusively in 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. He is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who wears a purple beret with star decorations and carries a telescope around with him, which he uses occasionally to look up in the sky. He first appears once 卡比（Kirby） visits the Fallen-Star Volcano; there, he explains to him, as well as 艾菲灵（Elfilin） and 头巾瓦豆鲁迪（Bandana Waddle Dee）, if present, about the legend of the Star of Darkness and the meteors that fell in the new world. Once they all realize that the key to sealing back the meteor is the 星耀体（Starry）, 卡比（Kirby） sets off on a journey, starting Star-Crossed World.

Once 卡比（Kirby） clears Lost in Alivel Mall, 天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） can be found sitting on a bench in Waddle Dee Town. He will then offer to draw random EX figures in trade of Starry Coins. At first only Vol. 1 figures can be drawn, for 150 星耀体（Starry） Coins each, but Vol. 2 figures become available for 250 星耀体（Starry） Coins after 卡比（Kirby） clears Freezing Wind and Some Snowmen.

Once 100% completion of all exclusive content of 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） is achieved, talking to 天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） will trigger a special notification and fanfare, as well as reward the 86th and last EX figure.

wikirby-page:80884.display_name: 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）
wikirby-page:80884.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-page:80884.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-page:80884.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-page:80884.description_zh:
“为了帮助卡比（Kirby），星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）调查Starries掉落的位置。天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee）则在天空中观察陨石，以便星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）可以将它们绘制在地图上。所有12个区域（如果包括火山岛则为13个）都已经绘制完成，这样卡比（Kirby）就可以访问这些地点。”
— Figure关于星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）的描述是一个瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee），他只出现在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中。他首次出现是在卡比（Kirby）清除Lost in Alivel Mall之后，可以在Waddle Dee Town广场的右侧找到，靠近知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee）所在的位置。与兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）类似，他不戴帽子，而是以手持的水晶为特征。他的目的是告知卡比（Kirby）任何缺失的星耀体（Starry）的位置，以及任何Starry Stages尚未清除。如果卡比（Kirby）尚未击败某个区域的Boss，该区域将解锁更多星耀体（Starry）阶段，那么星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）将允许卡比（Kirby）以类似方式前往该区域的最新阶段。一旦击败该区域的Boss，如果在瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）镇与其交谈，星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）将允许卡比（Kirby）选择前往世界地图并发现新开放的区域。

在救出所有Starries后与星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee）交谈会促使他与卡比（Kirby）分享一个独家的Present Code。
wikirby-page:80884.description_en:
“To help 卡比（Kirby）, 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） investigates where the Starries fall. And 天文学者瓦豆鲁迪（Astronomer Waddle Dee） watches the sky for meteors so 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） can plot them on a map. All 12 areas (13 if you include the volcanic island) have been plotted so 卡比（Kirby） can visit the locations.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） is a 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） who appears exclusively in 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. He first appears once 卡比（Kirby） clears Lost in Alivel Mall, and can be found to the right of the plaza in Waddle Dee Town, close to where 知识渊博瓦豆鲁迪（Wise Waddle Dee） stands. Similarly to 兑换瓦豆鲁迪（Trader Waddle Dee）, he does not wear a hat, and is instead distinguished by the crystal he holds. His purpose is to inform 卡比（Kirby） of the location of any missing 星耀体（Starry）, as well as any Starry Stages that haven't been cleared yet. If 卡比（Kirby） hasn't defeated the boss of a given area that will unlock more 星耀体（Starry） Stages, then 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） will allow 卡比（Kirby） to go to the most recent stage in the given area in much the same manner. Once said area's boss is defeated, if spoken to in 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee） Town, 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） will allow 卡比（Kirby） the offer to go to the world map and discover the new area that opened up.

Talking to 星星指引者瓦豆鲁迪（Star Guide Waddle Dee） after rescuing all Starries prompts him to share with 卡比（Kirby） an exclusive Present Code.

wikirby-page:78602.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-page:78602.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-page:78602.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-page:78602.description_zh:
“斯塔瑞充满了神秘。他们来自哪里？他们要去向何方？作为从宝石中诞生的精灵，他们也被称为星之子，因为他们常常在太空中幸福地航行。据说他们曾经将一个能够摧毁整个银河的恶魔晶化。”
— 星球守护者，斯塔瑞人物来自星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
斯塔瑞（单数：星耀体（Starry））是在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）的Star-Crossed World模式中引入的角色。他们是小型、蓝色、星形的生物，没有面孔。就像星之卡比探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）主故事中需要被救的瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）一样，在《星际交错世界》中，斯塔瑞是需要被救的对象。在通过邪恶陨石降落到新世界后，他们四处散开并被收集，以便他们能再次被封印它。
wikirby-page:78602.description_en:
“The Starries are full of mystery. Where are they from? Where do they go? Spirits born from gems, they're also called children of the stars, as they often sail blissfully through space. It's said they once crystallized a fiend capable of destroying the entire galaxy.”
— Planet Protector, Starries figure from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
Starries (singular: 星耀体（Starry）) are characters introduced in the Star-Crossed World mode of 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. They are small, blue star-shaped creatures with no faces. Much like how the 瓦豆鲁迪（Waddle Dee）s have to be rescued in the main story of 星之卡比 探索发现（Kirby and the Forgotten Land）, Starries are the ones being rescued in Star-Crossed World. After falling in the new world via the evil meteor, they spread around and are gathered so that they can reseal it.

wikirby-page:80540.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-page:80540.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-page:80540.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-page:80540.description_zh:
“来自银河深处的邪恶陨石用自身创造了星河结晶体（Galactal）来代表它行动并消灭将其封印的Starries，将它们派往行星的各个区域。发现卡比（Kirby）是威胁后，陨石命令星河结晶体（Galactal）看到就攻击。”
— Figure从星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
星河结晶体（Galactal）的描述中，可以得知它是在星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）中遇到的敌人。它是一种独眼、梨形的生物，覆盖着晶体盔甲。

除了最终Boss以及常规敌人和中Boss的水晶变体外，星河结晶体（Galactal）是Star-Crossed World扩展包中唯一新增的额外对手。Galactals由寄星晶灭体杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）创造，用以消灭封印它的星耀体（Starry）。远离。他们通常必须被击败才能在遇到的关卡中推进。这使他们类似于中途boss，尽管他们没有可见的血条，也不限于在封闭的战斗场景中遇到，类似于普通敌人。随着星际战士受到伤害，他们的护甲越来越多地出现裂痕并在三个独立阶段脱落。一旦他们的护甲全部被摧毁，他们就会消失。
wikirby-page:80540.description_en:
“The evil meteor from the far reaches of the galaxy created the 星河结晶体（Galactal） from its own body to act on its behalf and eradicate the Starries that sealed it away, sending them off to the various regions of the planet. Finding 卡比（Kirby） a threat, the meteor commanded 星河结晶体（Galactal） to attack on sight.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
星河结晶体（Galactal） is a foe encountered within 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）. It is a cycloptic pear-shaped creature coated in crystalline armor.

Aside from the final boss and Crystal variants of regular enemies and mid-bosses, 星河结晶体（Galactal） is the only additional opponent included within the Star-Crossed World expansion. Galactals are created by 寄星晶灭体 杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis） to eliminate the 星耀体（Starry） responsible for sealing it away. They are often necessary to be defeated in order to progress within the stage they are encountered. This makes them akin to mid-bosses, although they do not possess a visible HP bar and aren't exclusively encountered in enclosed arenas, similar to normal enemies. As Galactals take damage, more and more pieces of their armor begin to crack and break off in three separate stages. Once all of their armor is destroyed, they disappear.

wikirby-page:80312.name_zh: 寄星晶灭体 杰内尔·美菲里斯
wikirby-page:80312.display_name: 寄星晶灭体 杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）
wikirby-page:80312.debut_work_zh: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界
wikirby-page:80312.debut_work_en: Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
wikirby-page:80312.display_work: 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
wikirby-page:80312.description_zh:
“流星的传说自古以来就被认为是幻想。但随着ID-F86的发现和群岛的沉没，似乎这个故事里有一些真实成分。正如古代研究者所预测的那样，邪恶的流星在太空中飞驰，决心摧毁世界。”
— Figure来源于星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
寄星晶灭体杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）的描述，标题为《Parastella Crystallis》，是星之卡比探索发现Nintendo Switch 2 Edition +星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）模式Star-Crossed World的最终Boss，在该模式同名关卡中战斗。他是完全体菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）的哥哥，拥有比其兄弟更多的花纹翅膀和额外的角。Meteonelfilis的人形是在吸收了卡比（Kirby）释放的星耀体（Starry）后创造的，当时他们掩盖了已经坠落的流星。
wikirby-page:80312.description_en:
“The legend of the meteor was considered a fantasy from ancient times. But with the discovery of ID-F86 and the sinking of the islands, it seemed there might be some truth to the story. Just as the ancient researchers predicted, the evil meteor soared through space, determined to destroy the world.”
— Figure description from 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World）
寄星晶灭体 杰内尔·美菲里斯（Parastella Crystallis, Genwel Meteonelfilis）, titled Parastella Crystallis, is the final boss of the 星之卡比 探索发现 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + 星耀世界（Kirby and the Forgotten Land – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World） mode Star-Crossed World, battled in the level of the same name of the mode. He is the older brother of 完全体 菲克特·艾菲里斯（Ultimate Life-Form, Fecto Elfilis）, featuring more patterned wings and additional horns than his sibling. Meteonelfilis' humanoid form was created after he absorbed the 星耀体（Starry） freed by 卡比（Kirby） after they cover the fallen meteor.

wikirby-form:81660.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-form:81660.description_zh:
闪光（Flash）是一种在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）首次登场的复制能力（Copy Ability），通过吸入或捕获闪兹（Zapuzu）获得。拥有它后，使用者能够在Boost Dash中变得无敌，并变成闪闪发光的闪光（Flash），在途中晕眩并电击任何敌人。此攻击必须完全充能，否则使用者将正常进行Boost Dash。无论机器如何，冲刺的持续时间始终相同，但冲刺的距离和速度取决于机器的最高速度。

获得闪光（Flash）能力时，使用者在头部两侧佩戴类似耳机、带天线的耳机，在中间有一个倒三角图案，类似提供能力，闪兹（Zapuzu）。特别是，各种类似的二维倒置青色三角形，并且天线还发出电火花。当Boost Charging时，这些三角形聚在一起并开始发光。
wikirby-form:81660.description_en:
闪光（Flash） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, obtained by inhaling or capturing 闪兹（Zapuzu）. With it, the user is able to become invincible during a Boost Dash by turning into a sparkling 闪光（Flash）, stunning and electrifying any opponent on the way. This attack must be fully charged, otherwise the user will Boost Dash normally instead. The dash will always last the same amount of time no matter the machine, however, the distance and speed of the dash depends on the top speed of the machine.

When obtaining the 闪光（Flash） ability, the user wears earpieces on both sides of their head resembling headphones with antennas, with an upside down triangle motif in the center similar to the enemy that provides the ability, 闪兹（Zapuzu）. In particular, various two-dimensional upside down cyan triangles similar to it and electric sparks emanate from the antennas as well. When Boost Charging, these triangles bunch together and start glowing.

wikirby-form:82153.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-form:82153.description_zh:
“成为一个巨大的不可摧毁的力量！”
— ''Kirby Air Riders'' Direct
钢球（Steel Ball）是一种复制能力（Copy Ability），于卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）首次亮相，通过吸入或捕获钢滚（Rollozer）获得。使用它时，用户会变成一个巨大的钢球（Steel Ball），在地面上滚动，并能接触到敌人造成伤害。在这种状态下，用户免疫来自对手或敌人的伤害，但移动相对较慢，除非他们能够积累动量。无法为Boost充能，因为这样只会导致球体减速。正如钢球（Steel Ball）所预期的那样，用户在此状态下无法滑翔，从坡道跳下时会迅速落地。它的大小和功能类似于卡比（Kirby）的冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl）Special。

钢球（Steel Ball）does not在获得时为用户提供任何类型的帽子或服装；在能力持续期间，变身效果持续生效。
wikirby-form:82153.description_en:
“Become a massive indestructible force!”
— ''Kirby Air Riders'' Direct
钢球（Steel Ball） is a 复制能力（Copy Ability） that debuted in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）, obtained by inhaling or capturing 钢滚（Rollozer）. With it, the user turns into a giant 钢球（Steel Ball） that rolls around and can damage foes on contact. While in this state, the user is immune to damage from opponents or enemies, but moves relatively slowly unless they are able to build momentum. It is not possible to charge up for a Boost, as all this will do is cause the ball to slow down. As expected from a 钢球（Steel Ball）, the user cannot glide in this state and falls to the ground quickly when jumping off ramps. It is similar in size and function to 卡比（Kirby）'s 冰晶雪球（Snow Bowl） Special.

钢球（Steel Ball） does not give the user a hat or costume of any kind when acquired; the transformation takes hold for the entire duration of the ability.

wikirby-page:82434.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:82434.description_zh:
“就在巨灵（Gigantes）完全建造之前，佐拉（Zorah）的一片意志碎片挣脱了束缚。模仿某位骑士的形态，“暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede）”起飞了。佐拉（Zorah）自由漫游的愿望终于实现了……”
— Road Trip在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede）中的叙述是一个神秘存在，它以卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的中心角色身份出现在Road Trip模式中，并作为一个可解锁骑士，在New Game +中达成真结局、观看结局动画和真结尾字幕后可以使用。它是被称为佐拉（Zorah）的古老外星生物的意志碎片，在其对自由和行动的渴望导致银河·新星（Galactic Nova）的工作无人机将其撕成碎片后分裂出来，并模仿帝帝帝大王（King Dedede）的形态到变成了他的阴影分身。使用定制的Wheelie Bike，暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede）会在《公路之旅》中定期出现，似乎对英雄骑手表现出敌意。
wikirby-page:82434.description_en:
“Just before 巨灵（Gigantes） was fully constructed, a fragment of 佐拉（Zorah）'s will broke free. Copying the form of a certain rider, "暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede）" took off. 佐拉（Zorah）'s wish to roam freely had finally come true...”
— Road Trip narration in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede） is a mysterious being who appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） as a central character to the Road Trip mode and an unlockable rider, being playable after achieving the true ending in New Game +, and viewing the ending cutscene and True Credits. It is a fragment of the will of an ancient extraterrestrial being known as 佐拉（Zorah）, which split off after its wish for freedom and movement had caused 银河·新星（Galactic Nova）'s worker drones to rip it to pieces, and copied the form of 帝帝帝大王（King Dedede） to turn into his shadowy doppelgänger. Using a custom Wheelie Bike, 暗影帝帝帝（Noir Dedede） appears periodically throughout Road Trip, seemingly antagonizing the heroic rider.

wikirby-page:82128.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:82128.description_zh:
“佐拉（Zorah）。一个有生命的机器。拥有自己的意志，但无法自行移动。很久以前，它在宇宙中漂流，直到落到行星波普之星（Popstar）的一个偏远地区。”
— Road Trip在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
佐拉（Zorah）中的叙述是一名出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）的Road Trip模式中的角色。它是一种非有机生命体，在漂流太空后很久以前就坠落到波普之星（Popstar），是《公路之旅》剧情的推动力。
wikirby-page:82128.description_en:
“佐拉（Zorah）. A living machine. Possessing its own will but unable to move on its own. Long ago, it drifted through the universe until falling upon a remote region of the planet 波普之星（Popstar）.”
— Road Trip narration in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
佐拉（Zorah） is a character who appears in the Road Trip mode of 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is an inorganic lifeform who fell to 波普之星（Popstar） long before the events of the mode after drifting through space, and is the driving force behind Road Trip's plot.

wikirby-page:82158.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:82158.description_zh:
“一个难以置信的机器，也是毁灭的象征！如果它完成，整个世界可能会灭亡！”
— 巨灵（Gigantes）在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中从ver. 1.1.0开始的风格文本。
巨灵（Gigantes）（发音类似于“巨型”）是出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的Air Ride Machine和老板。它是一个巨大的机械结构，由银河·新星（Galactic Nova）在Road Trip的故事中促成建造，它作为普通最终Boss出现。巨灵（Gigantes）也可能作为City Trial中的传奇空气骑行机器之一出现。
wikirby-page:82158.description_en:
“An unbelievable machine and a symbol of ruin! If it's completed, the entire world may perish!”
— 巨灵（Gigantes）'s flavor text in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders） starting with ver. 1.1.0
巨灵（Gigantes） ( , pronounced akin to "gigantic") is an Air Ride Machine and boss that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a giant mechanical structure that 银河·新星（Galactic Nova） facilitated the construction of in the story of Road Trip, where it appears as the regular final boss. 巨灵（Gigantes） may also appear as one of the legendary Air Ride machines in City Trial.

wikirby-page:83101.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:83101.description_zh: 喷火喵（Burnbon）是出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它是一个漂浮的、三眼的生物，拥有四个火焰推进器，并在被吸入或捕获时赋予烈火（Fire）的能力。
wikirby-page:83101.description_en: 喷火喵（Burnbon） is an enemy that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a drifting, three-eyed creature with four fiery thrusters, and grants the 烈火（Fire） ability upon being inhaled or captured.

wikirby-page:83105.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:83105.description_zh: 钻立（Drillan）是出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的一个敌人。它是一种毛茸茸的黄色生物，拥有发光的绿色眼睛和橙色的分离手；它挥舞着一个大型深银色的钻头，这个钻头在浮出水面时戴在头上，有护目孔，而钻头在钻地时会翻到下面。当被吸入或捕获时，它会赋予钻击（Drill）能力。
wikirby-page:83105.description_en: 钻立（Drillan） is an enemy that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a furry yellow creature with glowing green eyes and orange disembodied hands; it wields a large deep silver-colored drill with goggled eye holes that it wears over its head when surfacing, but the drill flips to its underside when burrowing. It grants the 钻击（Drill） ability upon being inhaled or captured.

wikirby-page:83071.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:83071.description_zh: 杰米（Gemaine）是一个特殊且稀有的敌人，出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中。它是一个球形、多彩的晶体敌人，拥有一个类似火焰的黑色眼罩，右侧较长，左侧有一只孤独的白眼。它的主要目的是填充击败它的骑手的Special表。
wikirby-page:83071.description_en: 杰米（Gemaine） is a special, rare enemy appearing in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a spherical, multicoloured, crystalline enemy with what appears to be a fiery black eye-mask, the right side of which is longer, and the left side having a solitary white eye. Its main purpose is to fill the Special gauge of riders that defeat it.

wikirby-page:83144.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:83144.description_zh: J.J.是一个出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它是一个小型灰色生物，穿着青绿色鞋子，戴着飞行头盔，身体两侧各有两个大型推进器。它利用推进器悬停原地，并周期性喷射推进器将自己向赛道下方推进。当被吸入或捕获时，它会授予喷射机（Jet）能力。
wikirby-page:83144.description_en: J.J. is an enemy that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a small gray creature with teal shoes, a flight helmet, and two large thrusters on each side of its body. It uses its thrusters to hover in place, periodically firing them to send itself further down the course. It grants the 喷射机（Jet） ability when inhaled or captured.

wikirby-page:83110.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:83110.description_zh: 咻咻（Jabjab）是出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它是一种小型生物，穿着灰色连帽毛衣、蓝色运动鞋和大红色拳击手套。帽子遮住了它的脸，两个圆眼睛从黑暗中窥视出来。它在空闲时会来回跳动，攻击时用它的弹性手臂拳击。被吸入或捕捉时，可以获得格斗家（Fighter）能力。
wikirby-page:83110.description_en: 咻咻（Jabjab） is an enemy that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is a small creature wearing a gray hooded sweater, blue sneakers, and big red boxing gloves. The hood obscures its face, with two round eyes peering out from the darkness. It hops back and forth while idle, and attacks by punching with its stretchy arms. It grants the 格斗家（Fighter） ability when inhaled or captured.

wikirby-page:82558.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:82558.description_zh: 钢滚（Rollozer）是在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中首次登场的敌人。它的主体非常圆，有两只带爪的脚和一条短尾巴，有点像乌龟；它还有一个类似犰狳或卷甲虫的金属外壳，可以将自己包裹起来进行滚动。被吸入或捕捉时，可以获得钢球（Steel Ball）能力。
wikirby-page:82558.description_en: 钢滚（Rollozer） is an enemy debuting in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. Its main body is very rounded with two clawed feet and a short tail, somewhat resembling a tortoise; it also has a metal-plated shell resembling an armadillo or a pill bug, which it can enclose itself in to roll around. It grants the 钢球（Steel Ball） ability when inhaled or captured.

wikirby-page:82599.display_work: 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）
wikirby-page:82599.description_zh: 闪兹（Zapuzu）是出现在卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）中的敌人。它由六个悬浮的三角形组成，颜色为白色，边缘带有不同深浅的蓝色。中央的三角形最大，其他较小的三角形围绕着它。每个三角形都有小而三角形的眼睛。它以快速的冲刺移动，并通过重新排列其三角形并在自身周围产生电场来攻击。当吸入或捕获时，它授予闪光（Flash）能力。
wikirby-page:82599.description_en: 闪兹（Zapuzu） is an enemy that appears in 卡比的驭天飞行者（Kirby Air Riders）. It is composed of six free-floating triangles, colored white with borders of various shades of blue. The central triangle is the biggest, with the other smaller triangles surrounding it. Each triangle features small, triangular eyes. It moves around in quick dashes and attacks by rearranging its triangles and creating a field of electricity around itself. It grants the 闪光（Flash） ability when inhaled or captured.
